Therein, should one know of a certain region: ‘Indeed, for me, by resorting to this region, unwholesome states decline and wholesome states increase,’ such a region should be resorted to. ‘Bhikkhus, I say that regions are of two kinds: those to be resorted to and those not to be resorted to’—that which was said thus, was said in reference to this.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Senāsanampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? Tattha yaṃ jaññā senāsanaṃ – ‘idaṃ kho me senāsanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ senāsanaṃ na sevitabbaṃ. Tattha yaṃ jaññā senāsanaṃ – ‘idaṃ kho me senāsanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpaṃ senāsanaṃ sevitabbaṃ. ‘Senāsanampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘诸比丘，我所说的住处有二种：应亲近的与不应亲近的。’我曾说此话，此话是缘何而说？在此，若了知某住处：‘我亲近此住处时，不善法增长，善法衰退。’如是住处，不应亲近。在此，若了知某住处：‘我亲近此住处时，不善法衰退，善法增长。’如是住处，应予亲近。‘诸比丘，我所说的住处有二种：应亲近的与不应亲近的。’我所说的这句话，是缘此而说。
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, I say that lodgings are of two kinds: those to be resorted to and those not to be resorted to.’ Indeed, this was said. And in reference to what was this said? Therein, should one know of a certain lodging: ‘Indeed, for me, by resorting to this lodging, unwholesome states increase and wholesome states decline,’ such a lodging should not be resorted to. Therein, should one know of a certain lodging: ‘Indeed, for me, by resorting to this lodging, unwholesome states decline and wholesome states increase,’ such a lodging should be resorted to. ‘Bhikkhus, I say that lodgings are of two kinds: those to be resorted to and those not to be resorted to’—that which was said thus, was said in reference to this.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Puggalampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? Tattha yaṃ jaññā puggalaṃ – ‘imaṃ kho me puggalaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpo puggalo na sevitabbo. Tattha yaṃ jaññā puggalaṃ – ‘imaṃ kho me puggalaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpo puggalo sevitabbo . ‘Puggalampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vutta’’nti. Catutthaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “‘诸比丘，我以两种方式说人：有应亲近的，也有不应亲近的。’此话是这样说的。此话是缘何而说呢？于此，若了知某个人——‘我亲近此人时，不善法增长，善法衰退’，这样的人就不应亲近。于此，若了知某个人——‘我亲近此人时，不善法衰退，善法增长’，这样的人就应亲近。‘诸比丘，我以两种方式说人：有应亲近的，也有不应亲近的。’此话即是缘此而说。”第四。
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, I say that persons are of two kinds: those to be resorted to and those not to be resorted to.’ Indeed, this was said. And in reference to what was this said? Therein, should one know of a certain person: ‘Indeed, for me, by resorting to this person, unwholesome states increase and wholesome states decline,’ such a person should not be resorted to. Therein, should one know of a certain person: ‘Indeed, for me, by resorting to this person, unwholesome states decline and wholesome states increase,’ such a person should be resorted to. ‘Bhikkhus, I say that persons are of two kinds: those to be resorted to and those not to be resorted to’—that which was said thus, was said in reference to this.” The fourth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘lābhīmhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā’ti, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ajjhattaṃ cetosamathe patiṭṭhāya adhipaññādhammavipassanāya yogo karaṇīyo. So aparena samayena lābhī ceva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，若比丘审视时，如是了知：‘我已得内心寂静，未得增上慧法观。’诸比丘，该比丘应安住于内心寂静，致力于增上慧法观。其后，他既得内心寂静，亦得增上慧法观。”
rows.english: If, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, on reviewing, knows thus: ‘I am a gainer of internal serenity of mind, but not a gainer of insight into phenomena through higher wisdom,’ then, bhikkhus, that bhikkhu, being established in internal serenity of mind, should make an effort for insight into phenomena through higher wisdom. At a later time, he becomes a gainer of both internal serenity of mind and insight into phenomena through higher wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace, pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā’ti, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭilābhāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañca karaṇīyaṃ. Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ādittacelo vā ādittasīso vā. Tasseva celassa vā sīsassa vā nibbāpanāya adhimattaṃ chandañca vāyāmañca ussāhañca ussoḷhiñca appaṭivāniñca satiñca sampajaññañca kareyya. Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tena bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭilābhāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañca karaṇīyaṃ. So aparena samayena lābhī ceva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，若有比丘省察时，自知：‘我未得内心之寂止，未得增上慧法观（adhipaññādhammavipassanā）。’诸比丘，彼比丘则应为获得彼等善法，发起极猛利之意欲、精进、勤奋、热诚、不退、正念与正知。诸比丘，譬如衣或头燃之人，为熄灭其衣或头之火，亦会发起极猛利之意欲、精进、勤奋、热诚、不退、正念与正知。正是如此，诸比丘，彼比丘亦应为获得彼等善法，发起极猛利之意欲、精进、勤奋、热诚、不退、正念与正知。他于后时，既得内心之寂止，亦得增上慧法观。”
rows.english: But if, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, on reviewing, knows thus: ‘I am not a gainer of internal serenity of mind, and I am not a gainer of insight into phenomena through higher wisdom,’ then, bhikkhus, for the attainment of those very wholesome qualities, that bhikkhu should apply extraordinary desire, effort, enthusiasm, ardour, persistence, mindfulness, and clear comprehension. Suppose, bhikkhus, one whose robe or head was on fire would apply extraordinary desire, effort, enthusiasm, ardour, persistence, mindfulness, and clear comprehension to extinguish the fire on that very robe or head. In the very same way, bhikkhus, for the attainment of those very wholesome qualities, that bhikkhu should apply extraordinary desire, effort, enthusiasm, ardour, persistence, mindfulness, and clear comprehension. At a later time, he becomes a gainer of both internal serenity of mind and insight into phenomena through higher wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cīvarampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi. Piṇḍapātampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi. Senāsanampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi. Gāmanigamampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi. Janapadapadesampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi. Puggalampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampi.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，我说衣亦有二种：应受用与不应受用。诸比丘，我说施食亦有二种：应受用与不应受用。诸比丘，我说住处亦有二种：应受用与不应受用。诸比丘，我说村镇亦有二种：应亲近与不应亲近。诸比丘，我说地区亦有二种：应亲近与不应亲近。诸比丘，我说人亦有二种：应亲近与不应亲近。”
rows.english: Bhikkhus, I speak of two kinds of robes: to be used and not to be used. I speak of two kinds of almsfood: to be used and not to be used. I speak of two kinds of lodgings: to be used and not to be used. I speak of two kinds of villages and towns: to be resorted to and not to be resorted to. I speak of two kinds of countries and regions: to be resorted to and not to be resorted to. I speak of two kinds of persons: to be associated with and not to be associated with.

rows.pali: 54 . ‘‘No ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paracittapariyāyakusalo hoti, atha ‘sacittapariyāyakusalo bhavissāmī’ti – evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 54. “诸比丘，若比丘不善于了知他人之心，那么，‘我将善于了知自己之心’——诸比丘，你们应如是修学。”
rows.english: 54. “If, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is not skilled in the ways of others’ minds, then he should train himself thus: ‘I will become skilled in the ways of my own mind.’ This, bhikkhus, is how you should train yourselves.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sacittapariyāyakusalo hoti? Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno sace tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, tasseva rajassa vā aṅgaṇassa vā pahānāya vāyamati. No ce tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, tenevattamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo – ‘lābhā vata me, parisuddhaṃ vata me’ti. Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇā bahukārā hoti kusalesu dhammesu – ‘lābhī nu khomhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na nu khomhi lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, lābhī nu khomhi adhipaññādhammavipassanāya, na nu khomhi lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何善于了知自己的心呢？譬如，诸比丘，年轻男女，青春年少，喜好装饰，在清净、明亮、澄澈的镜子或水盆中审视自己的面容，若见到尘垢或瑕疵，便努力去除那尘垢或瑕疵。若未见到尘垢或瑕疵，便因此心满意足，觉得意愿圆满：‘我真是有利得！我真是清净！’同样地，诸比丘，比丘的审视对于善法有极大的助益：‘我是否已得内心寂静？我是否未得内心寂静？我是否已得增上慧法观(adhipaññādhammavipassanā)？我是否未得增上慧法观？’”
rows.english: And how, bhikkhus, is a bhikkhu skilled in the ways of his own mind? Suppose, bhikkhus, a woman or a man—young, youthful, and fond of adornment—were to examine the image of their own face in a clean, bright mirror or in a bowl of clear water. If they see any dust or blemish there, they strive for the removal of that very dust or blemish. But if they do not see any dust or blemish there, they are pleased on that account and their intention is fulfilled, thinking: ‘Indeed, it is a gain for me! Indeed, it is pure!’ In the very same way, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu’s reviewing is of great benefit in regard to wholesome qualities: ‘Am I a gainer of internal serenity of mind, or am I not a gainer of internal serenity of mind? Am I a gainer of insight into phenomena through higher wisdom, or am I not a gainer of insight into phenomena through higher wisdom?’

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Cīvarampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? Tattha yaṃ jaññā cīvaraṃ – ‘idaṃ kho me cīvaraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ na sevitabbaṃ. Tattha yaṃ jaññā cīvaraṃ – ‘idaṃ kho me cīvaraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī’ti, evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ sevitabbaṃ. ‘Cīvarampāhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi – sevitabbampi asevitabbampī’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，我所说的衣有二种：应受用的与不应受用的。”我确实曾如此说过。此话是缘何而说？于此，若了知某件衣——“我受用此衣时，不善法增长，善法减损”，如此的衣不应受用。于此，若了知某件衣——“我受用此衣时，不善法减损，善法增长”，如此的衣应受用。“诸比丘，我所说的衣有二种：应受用的与不应受用的。”我所说的这话，是缘于此而说。
rows.english: ‘Bhikkhus, I speak of two kinds of robes: to be used and not to be used.’ Indeed, this was said. And in reference to what was this said? Therein, should one know of a certain robe: ‘Indeed, for me, by using this robe, unwholesome qualities increase and wholesome qualities decline,’ such a robe should not be used. Therein, should one know of a certain robe: ‘Indeed, for me, by using this robe, unwholesome qualities decline and wholesome qualities increase,’ such a robe should be used. ‘Bhikkhus, I speak of two kinds of robes: to be used and not to be used’—that which was said thus, was said in reference to this.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，当一个人心为欲贪所占据、所征服而住时，他不如实了知已生起的欲贪的出离。在那时，他不如实知见自利，不如实知见他利，也不如实知见自他两利；即使是长时讽诵的明咒也不显现于心，更何况未讽诵的呢。”
rows.english: “Brahmin, at a time when one dwells with a mind beset and overcome by sensual lust, and one does not understand as it really is the escape from arisen sensual lust, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena, uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，婆罗门，当一个人住于心被瞋恚(byāpāda)所占据、为瞋恚所控制时，他不如实了知已生起的瞋恚的出离。在那时，他不如实知见自利，不如实知见他利……乃至……不如实知见自他二利；即使是长时讽诵的明咒也不显现，何况是未讽诵的。
rows.english: Furthermore, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by ill will, overwhelmed by ill will, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen ill will, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati thinamiddhaparetena, uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，婆罗门，当一个人住于心被昏沉睡眠(thīnamiddha)所占据、为昏沉睡眠所控制时，他不如实了知已生起的昏沉睡眠的出离。在那时，他不如实知见自利，不如实知见他利……乃至……不如实知见自他二利；即使是长时讽诵的明咒也不显现，何况是未讽诵的。
rows.english: Furthermore, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by sloth and torpor, overwhelmed by sloth and torpor, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen sloth and torpor, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena, uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，婆罗门，当安住于为掉举恶作所缠之心，为掉举恶作所征服时，不能如实了知已生起的掉举恶作的出离。那时，他不能如实知见自利，亦不能如实知见他利……乃至不能如实知见自他二利；即使是长时讽诵的圣典也不会显现，更何况是未讽诵的呢！
rows.english: Furthermore, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by restlessness and remorse, overwhelmed by restlessness and remorse, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen restlessness and remorse, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi… dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，再者，于某时，当心为疑惑(vicikicchā)所困扰、为疑惑所跟随时，他不如实了知已生起之疑惑的出离。于其时，他不如实知见自利，……乃至……不如实知见自他两利。即使是长期讽诵的明咒也不会显现，更何况是未讽诵的呢？”
rows.english: Furthermore, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by doubt, overwhelmed by doubt, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen doubt, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiñca kho, brāhmaṇa, samaye na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati; dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，于某时，当心不为欲贪(kāmarāga)所困扰、不为欲贪所跟随时，他如实了知已生起之欲贪的出离。在那时，他如实知见自利，也如实知见他利，也如实知见自他两利。即使是长期未讽诵的明咒也会显现，更何况是已讽诵的呢？”
rows.english: But, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by sensual lust, not overwhelmed by sensual lust, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen sensual lust, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time occur to mind, let alone those recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na byāpādaparetena, uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi… dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，婆罗门，当他心不为瞋恚所缠绕，不为瞋恚所征服时，他如实了知已生瞋恚的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的圣典亦能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？
rows.english: Furthermore, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by ill will, not overwhelmed by ill will, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen ill will, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time come to mind, let alone those that have been recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na thinamiddhaparetena, uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi … dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，婆罗门，当他心不为惛沉与昏昧（thīna-middha）所缠绕，不为惛沉与昏昧所征服时，他如实了知已生惛沉与昏昧的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的圣典亦能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？
rows.english: Furthermore, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by sloth and torpor, not overwhelmed by sloth and torpor, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen sloth and torpor, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time come to mind, let alone those that have been recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na uddhaccakukkuccaparetena, uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi… dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，婆罗门，当他心不为掉举追悔所缠绕，不为掉举追悔所征服时，他如实了知已生起之掉举追悔的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的圣典亦能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？”
rows.english: Furthermore, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by restlessness and remorse, not overwhelmed by restlessness and remorse, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen restlessness and remorse, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time occur to mind, let alone those recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti pajānāti passati (syā.) , attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati; ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati; dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，婆罗门，当他安住于心不为疑惑(vicikicchā)所缠绕、不为疑惑所束缚时，他如实了知已生起疑惑的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的明咒也能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？
rows.english: Furthermore, Brahmin, at a time when one dwells with a mind not overcome by doubt, not given over to doubt, and knows as it really is the escape from arisen doubt, at that time one also knows and sees one's own welfare as it really is; at that time one also knows and sees the welfare of others as it really is; at that time one also knows and sees the welfare of both as it really is. Even sacred texts not recited for a long time come to mind, how much more so those that are recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yenekadā dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā? Ko pana, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo yenekadā dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，是何因何缘，有时即使是长时讽诵的明咒也不显现于心，更何况未讽诵的呢？尊者乔达摩，又是何因何缘，有时即使是长时未讽诵的明咒也能显现于心，更何况已讽诵的呢？”
rows.english: “What, Master Gotama, is the cause, what is the reason, why at one time even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited? And what, Master Gotama, is the cause, what is the reason, why at another time even mantras not recited for a long time do come to mind, let alone those recited?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto na sevālapaṇakapariyonaddho. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na thinamiddhaparetena, uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi… dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，譬如一水盆，未被水藻与浮萍覆盖，有眼之人观察自己在其中的面容倒影时，能如实了知、如实看见。同样地，婆罗门，当他心不为惛沉睡眠所缠绕，不为惛沉睡眠所征服时，他如实了知已生起之惛沉睡眠的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的圣典亦能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？”
rows.english: Just as, brahmin, a bowl of water is not covered with moss and algae—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would know and see it as it actually is. In the same way, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by sloth and torpor, not overwhelmed by sloth and torpor, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen sloth and torpor, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time occur to mind, let alone those recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto na agginā santatto na pakkuthito na usmudakajāto, tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya . Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na byāpādaparetena, uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi… dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 婆罗门，譬如一水盆，未被火烧热，未被煮沸，未产生蒸汽，有眼之人观察自己在其中的面容倒影时，能如实了知、如实看见。同样地，婆罗门，当他心不为瞋恚所缠绕，不为瞋恚所征服时，他如实了知已生瞋恚的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的圣典亦能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？
rows.english: Just as, brahmin, a bowl of water is not heated by fire, not boiling, not steaming—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would know and see it as it actually is. In the same way, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by ill will, not overwhelmed by ill will, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen ill will, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time come to mind, let alone those that have been recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto na vāterito na calito na bhanto na ūmijāto. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na uddhaccakukkuccaparetena, uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi… dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，譬如一水盆，未被风吹动，不摇晃，不搅动，不起波浪，有眼之人观察自己在其中的面容倒影时，能如实了知、如实看见。同样地，婆罗门，当他心不为掉举追悔所缠绕，不为掉举追悔所征服时，他如实了知已生起之掉举追悔的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的圣典亦能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？”
rows.english: Just as, brahmin, a bowl of water is not stirred by the wind, not agitated, not swirling, and has no waves—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would know and see it as it actually is. In the same way, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by restlessness and remorse, not overwhelmed by restlessness and remorse, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen restlessness and remorse, at that time one knows and sees as it actually is one's own benefit, the benefit of others, and the benefit of both. Even mantras not recited for a long time occur to mind, let alone those recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto saṃsaṭṭho lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，譬如一个水钵，混有紫胶、或姜黄、或靛青、或茜草。有眼之人在其中观察自己的面相时，不能如实知见。婆罗门，正是如此，当一个人心为欲贪所占据、所征服而住时，他不如实了知已生起的欲贪的出离。在那时，他不如实知见自利……（中略）……也不如实知见自他两利；即使是长时讽诵的明咒也不显现于心，更何况未讽诵的呢。”
rows.english: Just as, Brahmin, there might be a bowl of water mixed with lac-dye, or turmeric, or indigo, or madder. Therein, a man with good eyesight, examining his own facial reflection, would not know or see it as it really is. In the very same way, Brahmin, at a time when one dwells with a mind beset by sensual lust, overcome by sensual lust, and one does not know as it really is the escape from arisen sensual lust, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto agginā santatto pakkuthito pakkudhito (ka.), ukkaṭṭhito (sī.), ukkuṭṭhito (syā.) usmudakajāto ussadakajāto (sī.), usmādakajāto (syā.) . Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena, uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 婆罗门，譬如一盆水，被火加热，沸腾并冒着蒸汽。有眼之人于其中观察自己面容的影像，将不能如实知见。正是如此，婆罗门，当一个人住于心被瞋恚所占据、为瞋恚所控制时，他不如实了知已生起的瞋恚的出离。在那时，他不如实知见自利，不如实知见他利……乃至……不如实知见自他二利；即使是长时讽诵的明咒也不显现，何况是未讽诵的。
rows.english: Just as, Brahmin, a bowl of water heated by fire, boiling and steaming—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would not know or see it as it really is. In the same way, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by ill will, overwhelmed by ill will, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen ill will, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: 236 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . Atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 236. 缘起于舍卫城。尔时，婆罗门桑伽罗瓦(Saṅgārava)前往世尊之处。抵达后，与世尊互致亲切友好的问候，然后坐于一旁。坐于一旁的婆罗门桑伽罗瓦对世尊说此言：——
rows.english: 236. The setting is Sāvatthī. Then the brahmin Saṅgārava approached the Blessed One. Having approached, he exchanged greetings with the Blessed One. When this courteous and memorable talk was concluded, he sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the brahmin Saṅgārava said this to the Blessed One:

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi , brāhmaṇa, udapatto asaṃsaṭṭho lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti…pe….
rows.chinese_simplified: 婆罗门，譬如一个水碗，没有和紫胶（lākhā）、姜黄（haliddī）、靛青（nīlī）或茜草（mañjiṭṭhā）混合。有眼之人观察自己面容的倒影，能如实知见。同样地，婆罗门，当他心不为欲贪所缠绕、不为欲贪所征服时，能如实了知已生欲贪的出离……乃至……
rows.english: Just as, brahmin, a bowl of water is not mixed with lac, or turmeric, or indigo, or madder—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would know and see it as it actually is. In the same way, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind not beset by sensual lust, not overwhelmed by sensual lust, and understands as it actually is the escape from arisen sensual lust...

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto āvilo luḷito kalalībhūto andhakāre nikkhitto. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā. Ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenekadā dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，譬如一个浑浊、搅动、泥泞的水碗，被放置在黑暗中。在那里，有眼之人观察自己的面容影像，将不如实知、不如实见。婆罗门，正是如此，于某时，当心为疑惑所困扰、为疑惑所跟随时，他不如实了知已生起之疑惑的出离。于其时，他不如实知见自利，不如实知见他利，也不如实知见自他两利。即使是长期讽诵的明咒也不会显现，更何况是未讽诵的。婆罗门，此即是因，此即是缘，由此之故，有时即使是长期讽诵的明咒也不会显现，更何况是未讽诵的。”
rows.english: Just as, brahmin, a bowl of water that is turbid, stirred up, and muddy, is placed in darkness—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would neither know nor see it as it actually is. In the same way, brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by doubt, overwhelmed by doubt, and does not understand as it actually is the escape from arisen doubt, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it actually is one's own benefit, nor the benefit of others, nor the benefit of both. Even mantras long recited do not occur to mind, let alone those not recited. This, brahmin, is the cause and this is the reason why sometimes even mantras long recited do not occur to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi , brāhmaṇa, udapatto accho vippasanno anāvilo āloke nikkhitto. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye na vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, paratthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati; dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā. Ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yenekadā dīgharattaṃ asajjhāyakatāpi mantā paṭibhanti, pageva sajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 婆罗门，譬如一水盆，清澈、明净、无浊，置于光下。有眼之人观察自己在其中的面相时，能如实了知、如实看见。同样地，婆罗门，当他安住于心不为疑惑所缠绕、不为疑惑所束缚时，他如实了知已生起疑惑的出离。那时，他如实知见自利，如实知见他利，如实知见自他二利。即使是长期未曾诵习的明咒也能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？婆罗门，这就是因，这就是缘，因此有时即使是长期未曾诵习的明咒也能显现，何况是经常诵习的呢？
rows.english: Just as, Brahmin, a bowl of water that is clear, limpid, and undisturbed, is placed in the light. There, a man with good eyesight, examining the reflection of his own face, would know and see it as it really is. In the same way, Brahmin, at a time when one dwells with a mind not overcome by doubt, not given over to doubt, and knows as it really is the escape from arisen doubt, at that time one also knows and sees one's own welfare as it really is; at that time one also knows and sees the welfare of others as it really is; at that time one also knows and sees the welfare of both as it really is. Even sacred texts not recited for a long time come to mind, how much more so those that are recited. This, Brahmin, is the cause, this is the condition why at times even sacred texts not recited for a long time come to mind, how much more so those that are recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto vāterito calito bhanto ūmijāto. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena, uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 婆罗门，譬如一水碗，被风吹动，摇荡、旋转、生起波浪。有眼之人于其中观察自己的面相时，不能如实知、如实见。同样地，婆罗门，当安住于为掉举恶作所缠之心，为掉举恶作所征服时，不能如实了知已生起的掉举恶作的出离。那时，他不能如实知见自利，亦不能如实知见他利……乃至不能如实知见自他二利；即使是长时讽诵的圣典也不会显现，更何况是未讽诵的呢！
rows.english: Just as, Brahmin, a bowl of water stirred by the wind, agitated, disturbed, and rippling—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would not know or see it as it really is. In the same way, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by restlessness and remorse, overwhelmed by restlessness and remorse, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen restlessness and remorse, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto sevālapaṇakapariyonaddho. Tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya. Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yasmiṃ samaye thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati thinamiddhaparetena, uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, attatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati, paratthampi…pe… ubhayatthampi tasmiṃ samaye yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati; dīgharattaṃ sajjhāyakatāpi mantā nappaṭibhanti, pageva asajjhāyakatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 婆罗门，譬如一水碗，为苔藓与浮萍所覆盖。有眼之人于其中观察自己的面相时，不能如实知、如实见。同样地，婆罗门，当安住于为昏沉睡眠所缠之心，为昏沉睡眠所征服时，不能如实了知已生起的昏沉睡眠的出离。那时，他不能如实知见自利，亦不能如实知见他利……乃至不能如实知见自他二利；即使是长时讽诵的圣典也不会显现，更何况是未讽诵的呢！
rows.english: Just as, Brahmin, a bowl of water is covered with moss and water plants—a person with good eyesight, examining their own facial reflection, would not know or see it as it really is. In the same way, Brahmin, when one dwells with a mind beset by sloth and torpor, overwhelmed by sloth and torpor, and does not know as it really is the escape from arisen sloth and torpor, at that time one neither knows nor sees as it really is one's own welfare, nor the welfare of others, nor the welfare of both. Even mantras long recited do not come to mind, let alone those not recited.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sattime , brāhmaṇa, bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. Katame satta? Satisambojjhaṅgo kho, brāhmaṇa, anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anupakkileso bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati…pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho, brāhmaṇa, anāvaraṇo anīvaraṇo cetaso anupakkileso bhāvito bahulīkato vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattati. Ime kho, brāhmaṇa, satta bojjhaṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattantī’’ti. Evaṃ vutte saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama…pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata’’nti. Pañcamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆罗门，此七觉支无障碍、无诸盖、非心之杂染，若已修习、已多作，则导向明与解脱之果的证悟。是哪七种呢？婆罗门，念觉支无障碍、无诸盖、非心之杂染，若已修习、已多作，则导向明与解脱之果的证悟。……乃至……舍觉支无障碍、无诸盖、非心之杂染，若已修习、已多作，则导向明与解脱之果的证悟。婆罗门，此七觉支无障碍、无诸盖、非心之杂染，若已修习、已多作，则导向明与解脱之果的证悟。”如是说已，桑伽罗瓦婆罗门对世尊说：“妙哉，乔达摩尊者！……从今日起，愿乔达摩尊者忆持我为终生皈依的优婆塞。”第五。
rows.english: Brahmin, these seven factors of awakening are unobstructed, unhindered, not defilements of the mind; when developed and cultivated, they conduce to the realization of the fruit of knowledge and liberation. What seven? The factor of awakening of mindfulness, Brahmin, is unobstructed, unhindered, not a defilement of the mind; when developed and cultivated, it conduces to the realization of the fruit of knowledge and liberation… The factor of awakening of equanimity, Brahmin, is unobstructed, unhindered, not a defilement of the mind; when developed and cultivated, it conduces to the realization of the fruit of knowledge and liberation. These, Brahmin, are the seven factors of awakening that are unobstructed, unhindered, not defilements of the mind; when developed and cultivated, they conduce to the realization of the fruit of knowledge and liberation." When this was said, the brahmin Saṅgārava said this to the Blessed One: "Excellent, Master Gotama!… May Master Gotama remember me as a lay follower who, from this day forward, for as long as life lasts, has gone for refuge." The fifth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, paṭighanimittaṃ . Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是未生起的嗔恚（byāpāda）生起，已生起的嗔恚增长、广大的食呢？诸比丘，有恚相（paṭighanimitta）。于彼，多修不如理作意——此即是未生起的嗔恚生起，已生起的嗔恚增长、广大的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, and for the increase and expansion of arisen ill will? There is, monks, the sign of aversion. In regard to that, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, and for the increase and expansion of arisen ill will.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, asubhanimittaṃ . Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，对于未生起的欲贪之生起，以及已生起的欲贪之增长、广大，其非食为何？诸比丘，有不净相(asubhanimitta)。于此，多多如理作意——此即是对于未生起的欲贪之生起，以及已生起的欲贪之增长、广大之非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen sensual desire, or for the increase and abundance of arisen sensual desire? There is, Bhikkhus, the sign of the foul. Therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen sensual desire, or for the increase and abundance of arisen sensual desire.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, mettācetovimutti. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，对于未生起的瞋恚(byāpāda)之生起，以及已生起的瞋恚之增长、广大，其非食为何？诸比丘，有慈心解脱(mettācetovimutti)。于此，多多如理作意——此即是对于未生起的瞋恚之生起，以及已生起的瞋恚之增长、广大之非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, or for the increase and abundance of arisen ill will? There is, Bhikkhus, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness. Therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, or for the increase and abundance of arisen ill will.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya , uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā’’ti. Paṭhamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是非食，能令未生的舍觉支不生起，或令已生的舍觉支不能修习圆满呢？诸比丘，有作为舍觉支之基的诸法。于彼处，多次不作意——这即是非食，能令未生的舍觉支不生起，或令已生的舍觉支不能修习圆满。”第一经竟。
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is the non-nourishment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity? There are, bhikkhus, states that are the basis for the enlightenment factor of equanimity. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nourishment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity. The First.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, cetaso avūpasamo. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是未生起的掉举恶作（uddhaccakukkucca）生起，已生起的掉举恶作增长、广大的食呢？诸比丘，有心的不寂静（cetaso avūpasama）。于彼，多修不如理作意——此即是未生起的掉举恶作生起，已生起的掉举恶作增长、广大的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, and for the increase and expansion of arisen restlessness and remorse? There is, monks, an unquieted state of mind. In regard to that, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, and for the increase and expansion of arisen restlessness and remorse.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, vicikicchāṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是能令未生起的疑生起，或令已生起的疑增长、广大的食？诸比丘，有作为疑之根据的诸法。于彼，多作不如理作意——此即是能令未生起的疑生起，或令已生起的疑增长、广大的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, and for the increase and expansion of arisen doubt? There are, monks, things that are a basis for doubt. In regard to them, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, and for the increase and expansion of arisen doubt.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, cetaso vūpasamo. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，对于未生起的掉举、追悔(uddhaccakukkucca)之生起，以及已生起的掉举、追悔之增长、广大，其非食为何？诸比丘，有心之止息(cetaso vūpasamo)。于此，多多如理作意——此即是对于未生起的掉举、追悔之生起，以及已生起的掉举、追悔之增长、广大之非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, or for the increase and abundance of arisen restlessness and remorse? There is, Bhikkhus, the calming of the mind. Therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, or for the increase and abundance of arisen restlessness and remorse.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是不令未生之念觉支生起，或不令已生之念觉支修习圆满的非食？诸比丘，有念觉支之依处法。于此，多不作意——这即是不令未生之念觉支生起，或不令已生之念觉支修习圆满的非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness? There are, Bhikkhus, states that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of mindfulness. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是非食，能令未生的喜觉支不生起，或令已生的喜觉支不能修习圆满呢？诸比丘，有作为喜觉支之基的诸法。于彼处，多次不作意——这即是非食，能令未生的喜觉支不生起，或令已生的喜觉支不能修习圆满。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture? There are, Bhikkhus, states that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of rapture. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, kāyappassaddhi cittappassaddhi. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是非食，能令未生的轻安觉支不生起，或令已生的轻安觉支不能修习圆满呢？诸比丘，有身轻安、心轻安。于彼处，多次不作意——这即是非食，能令未生的轻安觉支不生起，或令已生的轻安觉支不能修习圆满。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility? There are, Bhikkhus, tranquility of body and tranquility of mind. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是非食，能令未生的定觉支不生起，或令已生的定觉支不能修习圆满呢？诸比丘，有止相、不散乱相。于彼处，多次不作意——这即是非食，能令未生的定觉支不生起，或令已生的定觉支不能修习圆满。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is the non-nourishment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration? There is, bhikkhus, the sign of serenity and the sign of non-distraction. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nourishment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya , uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，对于未生起的惛沉睡眠(thinamiddha)之生起，以及已生起的惛沉睡眠之增长、广大，其非食为何？诸比丘，有发动界(ārambhadhātu)、出离界(nikkamadhātu)、精勤界(parakkamadhātu)。于此，多多如理作意——此即是对于未生起的惛沉睡眠之生起，以及已生起的惛沉睡眠之增长、广大之非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, or for the increase and abundance of arisen sloth and torpor? There are, Bhikkhus, the element of initiative, the element of setting forth, and the element of striving. Therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, or for the increase and abundance of arisen sloth and torpor.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是不令未生之精进觉支生起，或不令已生之精进觉支修习圆满的非食？诸比丘，有发动界、出离界、精勤界。于此，多不作意——这即是不令未生之精进觉支生起，或不令已生之精进觉支修习圆满的非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy? There are, Bhikkhus, the element of initiative, the element of setting forth, and the element of striving. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, kusalākusalā dhammā sāvajjānavajjā dhammā hīnapaṇītā dhammā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是不令未生之疑生起，或不令已生之疑增长、广大的非食？诸比丘，有善与不善法、有罪与无罪法、下劣与殊胜法、黑白与对应法。于此，多修如理作意——这即是不令未生之疑生起，或不令已生之疑增长、广大的非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, or for the increase and abundance of arisen doubt? There are, Bhikkhus, wholesome and unwholesome states, blameworthy and blameless states, inferior and superior states, and states that are dark and bright with their counterparts. Therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, or for the increase and abundance of arisen doubt.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, anāhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, kusalākusalā dhammā sāvajjānavajjā dhammā hīnapaṇītā dhammā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā. Tattha amanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamanāhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是不令未生之择法觉支生起，或不令已生之择法觉支修习圆满的非食？诸比丘，有善与不善法、有罪与无罪法、下劣与殊胜法、黑白与对应法。于此，多不作意——这即是不令未生之择法觉支生起，或不令已生之择法觉支修习圆满的非食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena? There are, Bhikkhus, wholesome and unwholesome states, blameworthy and blameless states, inferior and superior states, and states that are dark and bright with their counterparts. Therein, the frequent practice of non-attention—this is the non-nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, arati tandi vijambhitā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是未生起的昏沉睡眠（thīnamiddha）生起，已生起的昏沉睡眠增长、广大的食呢？诸比丘，有不乐（arati）、倦怠（tandi）、呵欠（vijambhitā）、饭后昏沉（bhattasammada）与心的萎靡（cetaso līnatta）。于彼，多修不如理作意——此即是未生起的昏沉睡眠生起，已生起的昏沉睡眠增长、广大的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, and for the increase and expansion of arisen sloth and torpor? There are, monks, discontent, languor, yawning, drowsiness after a meal, and sluggishness of mind. In regard to these, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, and for the increase and expansion of arisen sloth and torpor.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, kusalākusalā dhammā sāvajjānavajjā dhammā hīnapaṇītā dhammā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是能令未生起的择法觉支(dhammavicayasambojjhaṅga)生起，或令已生起的择法觉支修习圆满的食？诸比丘，有善与不善的法，有过失与无过失的法，低劣与殊胜的法，黑白有对分的法。于彼，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生起的择法觉支生起，或令已生起的择法觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of states, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of states? There are, monks, wholesome and unwholesome states, blameworthy and blameless states, inferior and superior states, and states with dark and bright counterparts. In regard to them, frequent proper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of states, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of states.

rows.pali: 232 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Pañcannañca, bhikkhave, nīvaraṇānaṃ sattannañca bojjhaṅgānaṃ āhārañca anāhārañca desessāmi; taṃ suṇātha. Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave , subhanimittaṃ. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 232. 舍卫城因缘。“诸比丘，我将为你们宣说五盖（nīvaraṇa）与七觉支的食与非食，且谛听。诸比丘，什么是未生起的欲贪（kāmacchanda）生起，已生起的欲贪增长、广大的食呢？诸比丘，有净相（subhanimitta）。于彼，多修不如理作意（ayonisomanasikāra）——此即是未生起的欲贪生起，已生起的欲贪增长、广大的食。”
rows.english: 232. At Sāvatthī. “Monks, I will teach the nutriment and non-nutriment for the five hindrances and the seven factors of enlightenment. Listen to that. And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sensual desire, and for the increase and expansion of arisen sensual desire? There is, monks, the sign of the beautiful. In regard to that, frequent improper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sensual desire, and for the increase and expansion of arisen sensual desire.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是能令未生起的精进觉支(vīriyasambojjhaṅga)生起，或令已生起的精进觉支修习圆满的食？诸比丘，有发起界、出离界、勇猛界。于彼，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生起的精进觉支生起，或令已生起的精进觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy? There are, monks, the element of initiative, the element of exertion, and the element of striving. In regard to them, frequent proper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是能令未生起的念觉支(satisambojjhaṅga)生起，或令已生起的念觉支修习圆满的食？诸比丘，有作为念觉支之根据的诸法。于彼，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生起的念觉支生起，或令已生起的念觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness? There are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of mindfulness. In regard to them, frequent proper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是令未生起的喜觉支得以生起，令已生起的喜觉支修习圆满的食呢？诸比丘，有喜觉支的所缘法。于彼法多作如理作意——此即是令未生起的喜觉支得以生起，令已生起的喜觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture? There are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of rapture. In regard to them, frequent proper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, kāyappassaddhi cittappassaddhi . Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是令未生起的轻安觉支得以生起，令已生起的轻安觉支修习圆满的食呢？诸比丘，有身轻安、心轻安。于此多作如理作意——此即是令未生起的轻安觉支得以生起，令已生起的轻安觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility? There are, monks, tranquility of body and tranquility of mind. In regard to them, frequent proper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是令未生起的定觉支得以生起，令已生起的定觉支修习圆满的食呢？诸比丘，有止相、不乱相。于此诸相多作如理作意——此即是令未生起的定觉支得以生起，令已生起的定觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration? There are, monks, the sign of calm and the sign of non-distraction. In regard to them, frequent proper attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, and for the development and fulfillment of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是令未生起的舍觉支得以生起，令已生起的舍觉支修习圆满的食呢？诸比丘，有舍觉支的所缘法。于彼法多作如理作意——此即是令未生起的舍觉支得以生起，令已生起的舍觉支修习圆满的食。”
rows.english: And what, Bhikkhus, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity? There are, Bhikkhus, states that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of equanimity. Therein, the frequent practice of wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity.

rows.pali: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhati – ‘dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ – ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti, iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajāneyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如果他愿：‘愿我以清净、超人之天眼，看见众生死时、生时，卑劣与高尚，美貌与丑陋，善趣与恶趣；愿我了知众生随业而趣——“啊，这些众生具足身恶行、语恶行、意恶行，诽谤圣者，怀有邪见，受持邪见所作业，他们身坏命终之后，投生到苦界、恶趣、堕处、地狱；而这些众生具足身善行、语善行、意善行，不诽谤圣者，怀有正见，受持正见所作业，他们身坏命终之后，投生到善趣、天界。”像这样，愿我以清净、超人之天眼，看见众生死时、生时，卑劣与高尚，美貌与丑陋，善趣与恶趣，了知众生随业而趣。’若有其因缘，他即于彼彼处能作证。
rows.english: If he should wish: ‘With the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, may I see beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, in good destinations and in bad destinations. May I know beings who fare according to their kamma: “Indeed, venerable sirs, these beings were endowed with misconduct of body, speech, and mind, were revilers of the noble ones, held wrong view, and undertook actions based on wrong view. They, with the breakup of the body, after death, have been reborn in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a place of downfall, in hell.” Or again: “Indeed, venerable sirs, these beings were endowed with good conduct of body, speech, and mind, were not revilers of the noble ones, held right view, and undertook actions based on right view. They, with the breakup of the body, after death, have been reborn in a good destination, the heavenly world.” Thus, with the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, may I see beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, in good destinations and in bad destinations. May I know beings who fare according to their kamma,’ he attains the capability of witnessing it in that very matter, when there is the basis of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhati – ‘anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ – ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhāpi hutvā eko assaṃ; āvibhāvaṃ, tirobhāvaṃ; tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gaccheyyaṃ, seyyathāpi ākāse; pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ kareyyaṃ, seyyathāpi udake; udakepi abhijjamāno gaccheyyaṃ, seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ; ākāsepi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo; imepi candimasūriye candimasuriye (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parimaseyyaṃ parāmaseyyaṃ (ka.) parimajjeyyaṃ yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若他希望：‘愿我体验种种神通：由一变多，由多变一；或显或隐；穿墙、穿围墙、穿山，无有障碍，犹如行于空中；于地中出没，犹如于水中；于水上行走不沉，犹如于地上；于空中盘腿而行，犹如飞鸟；能以手触及、抚摸有如是大神力、大威德的日月；能以身行使自在力远至梵天界’，只要因缘具备，即能于彼处获得亲证的能力。
rows.english: If he wishes: ‘May I wield the various kinds of psychic power: having been one, may I become many; having been many, may I become one; may I appear and vanish; may I go unhindered through a wall, a rampart, or a mountain as if through space; may I dive in and out of the earth as if it were water; may I walk on water without breaking the surface as if on earth; may I travel seated cross-legged in the sky like a winged bird; may I touch and stroke with my hand these moon and sun, so mighty and powerful; may I exercise mastery with my body even as far as the Brahmā world,’ he attains the capability of witnessing it in that very matter, when there is the basis of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhati – ‘anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ, seyyathidaṃ seyyathīdaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) – ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe – amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ; tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapannoti, iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若他希望：‘愿我能随念种种宿住，即：一生、二生、三生、四生、五生、十生、二十生、三十生、四十生、五十生、百生、千生、十万生，以及许多坏劫、许多成劫、许多成坏劫——在某处我曾是如此名称、如此种姓、如此形貌、如此饮食、感受如此苦乐、寿量如此；我从彼处死后，生于某处；在彼处我也曾是如此名称、如此种姓、如此形貌、如此饮食、感受如此苦乐、寿量如此；我从彼处死后，投生于此处。像这样，随念具足行相与概要的种种宿住’，若有正念此基础，他就在每一处都能获得亲证的能力。
rows.english: If he wishes: ‘May I recollect my manifold past lives, that is: one birth, two births, three births, four births, five births, ten births, twenty births, thirty births, forty births, fifty births, a hundred births, a thousand births, a hundred thousand births; many eons of contraction, many eons of expansion, many eons of contraction and expansion. There I was with such a name, such a clan, such an appearance, such food, experiencing such pleasure and pain, with such a lifespan. Passing away from there, I was reborn elsewhere. There too I was with such a name, such a clan, such an appearance, such food, experiencing such pleasure and pain, with such a lifespan. Passing away from there, I have been reborn here.’ Thus, may I recollect my manifold past lives with their aspects and details,’ he attains the capability of witnessing it in that very matter, when there is the basis of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhati – ‘āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如果他愿：‘愿我因诸漏已尽，于现法中，亲身以殊胜智亲证无漏的心解脱、慧解脱，并具足而住。’若有其因缘，他即于彼彼处能作证。第三经。
rows.english: If he should wish: ‘Through the destruction of the taints, may I, in this very life, realize for myself with direct knowledge, and having attained it, dwell in the taintless liberation of mind and liberation by wisdom,’ he attains the capability of witnessing it in that very matter, when there is the basis of mindfulness.” The Third.

rows.pali: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhati – ‘dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ – dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike cā’ti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他若希望：‘愿我以清净、超人之天耳界，听闻天界与人间、或远或近的两种声音’，若因缘存在，即于彼处达到可亲证的状态。
rows.english: If he wishes: ‘With the divine ear-element, which is purified and surpasses the human, may I hear both kinds of sounds, divine and human, whether far or near,’ he attains the capability of witnessing it in that very matter, when there is the basis of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcime cittassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya. Katame pañca? Kāmacchando, byāpādo, thinamiddhaṃ thīnamiddhaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) , uddhaccakukkuccaṃ, vicikicchā – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca cittassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya. Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi vimuttaṃ hoti, taṃ hoti cittaṃ mudu ca kammaniyañca pabhassarañca na ca pabhaṅgu sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya. Yassa yassa ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，正是如此，心有此五种随染。心为这些随染所染污，则不柔软、不堪任、不明净，且是脆弱的，亦不能为断尽诸漏而正定。是哪五种呢？欲贪(kāmacchanda)、嗔恚(byāpāda)、昏沉睡眠(thinamiddha)、掉举追悔(uddhaccakukkucca)、疑(vicikicchā)。诸比丘，此乃心之五种随染，心为这些随染所染污，则不柔软、不堪任、不明净，且是脆弱的，亦不能为断尽诸漏而正定。诸比丘，当心从此五种随染解脱时，彼心即变得柔软、堪任、明净，且非脆弱，能为断尽诸漏而正定。为以证智亲证任何当证之法而将心倾向于彼时，只要因缘具备，即能于彼处获得亲证的能力。
rows.english: In the same way, bhikkhus, there are these five imperfections of the mind, corrupted by which the mind is not pliable, workable, or radiant; it is brittle and is not properly concentrated for the destruction of the taints. What are the five? Sensual desire, ill will, sloth and torpor, restlessness and remorse, and doubt. These, bhikkhus, are the five imperfections of the mind, corrupted by which the mind is not pliable, workable, or radiant; it is brittle and is not properly concentrated for the destruction of the taints. But when, bhikkhus, the mind is freed from these five imperfections, that mind is pliable, workable, and radiant; it is not brittle and is properly concentrated for the destruction of the taints. For whichever state realizable by direct knowledge he inclines his mind to realize by direct knowledge, he attains the capability of witnessing it right then and there, whenever the basis exists.

rows.pali: 23 . ‘‘Pañcime, bhikkhave, jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya. Katame pañca? Ayo, lohaṃ, tipu, sīsaṃ, sajjhaṃ sajjhu (sī.) – ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā , yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca na ca sammā upeti kammāya. Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, jātarūpaṃ imehi pañcahi upakkilesehi vimuttaṃ vippamuttaṃ (sī.) hoti, taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ mudu ca kammaniyañca pabhassarañca na ca pabhaṅgu sammā upeti kammāya. Yassā yassā ca yassa kassaci (syā. pī.) piḷandhanavikatiyā ākaṅkhati – yadi muddikāya yadi kuṇḍalāya yadi gīveyyakāya gīveyyakena (syā. kaṃ. ka., a. ni. 3.102) yadi suvaṇṇamālāya – tañcassa atthaṃ anubhoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 23. 比丘们，黄金有此五种杂染。黄金被这些杂染染污后，既不柔软，也不堪作业，不发光，而且易碎，不能妥善地用于工艺。是哪五种呢？铁、铜、锡、铅、银。比丘们，这即是黄金的五种杂染，黄金被这些杂染染污后，既不柔软，也不堪作业，不发光，而且易碎，不能妥善地用于工艺。比丘们，而当黄金从此五种杂染中解脱时，那黄金既柔软，又堪作业，且发光，不易碎，能妥善地用于工艺。无论想用它制作何种饰品——无论是戒指、耳环、项链，还是金花环——皆能成其所用。
rows.english: 23. Bhikkhus, there are these five imperfections of gold, corrupted by which gold is not pliable, workable, or radiant; it is brittle and does not lend itself to being properly worked. What are the five? Iron, copper, tin, lead, and silver. These, bhikkhus, are the five imperfections of gold, corrupted by which gold is not pliable, workable, or radiant; it is brittle and does not lend itself to being properly worked. But when, bhikkhus, gold is freed from these five imperfections, that gold is pliable, workable, and radiant; it is not brittle and lends itself to being properly worked. For whatever kind of ornament one wishes—whether a ring, an earring, a necklace, or a golden garland—it can be used for that purpose.

rows.pali: ‘‘So sace ākaṅkhati – ‘parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ – sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṃkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ sauttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他若希望：‘愿我能以心遍知其他众生、其他个人的心：有贪的心，了知为“有贪的心”；离贪的心，了知为“离贪的心”；有嗔的心，了知为“有嗔的心”；离嗔的心，了知为“离嗔的心”；有痴的心，了知为“有痴的心”；离痴的心，了知为“离痴的心”；收摄的心，了知为“收摄的心”；散乱的心，了知为“散乱的心”；广大的心，了知为“广大的心”；不广大的心，了知为“不广大的心”；有上的心，了知为“有上的心”；无上的心，了知为“无上的心”；得定的心，了知为“得定的心”；未得定的心，了知为“未得定的心”；解脱的心，了知为“解脱的心”；未解脱的心，了知为“未解脱的心”’，若因缘存在，即于彼处达到可亲证的状态。
rows.english: If he wishes: ‘May I know the minds of other beings, of other persons, having encompassed them with my own mind. May I know a mind with lust as a mind with lust, and a mind without lust as a mind without lust; a mind with hate as a mind with hate, and a mind without hate as a mind without hate; a mind with delusion as a mind with delusion, and a mind without delusion as a mind without delusion; a constricted mind as a constricted mind, and a distracted mind as a distracted mind; a sublime mind as a sublime mind, and an unsublime mind as an unsublime mind; a surpassed mind as a surpassed mind, and an unsurpassed mind as an unsurpassed mind; a concentrated mind as a concentrated mind, and an unconcentrated mind as an unconcentrated mind; a liberated mind as a liberated mind, and an unliberated mind as an unliberated mind,’ he attains the capability of witnessing it in that very matter, when there is the basis of mindfulness.

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了这番话。那些比丘心生欢喜，随喜世尊所说。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Delighted, those bhikkhus rejoiced in the Blessed One’s words.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti kho, bhikkhave, vivaṭo mayā khemo maggo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo, pihito kummaggo, ūhato okacaro, nāsitā okacārikā. Yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā. Etāni, bhikkhave , rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni; jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādattha; mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如此，诸比丘，安稳、吉祥、令人愉悦的道路已被我开启，邪道已被关闭，诱饵鹿已被拔除，被缚的诱饵鹿已被摧毁。诸比丘，导师为寻求弟子们的利益，出于怜悯而应做之事，我已为你们做了。诸比丘，这里有树下，这里有空屋；你们当禅修，莫放逸，莫要日后追悔。这是我们对你们的教诫。”
rows.english: “Thus, bhikkhus, the safe path, conducive to well-being, and leading to delight has been opened by me; the wrong path has been blocked; the decoy has been uprooted; the decoy doe has been destroyed. Whatever, bhikkhus, should be done by a teacher for his disciples, seeking their welfare, being compassionate, out of compassion, that has been done for you by me. These, bhikkhus, are the roots of trees, these are empty dwellings. Meditate, bhikkhus, do not be heedless; do not be remorseful later. This is our instruction to you.”

rows.pali: 212 . ‘‘So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ. So anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi. Seyyathidaṃ, ekampi jātiṃ…pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi. Ayaṃ kho me, bhikkhave, rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā; avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā; tamo vihato āloko uppanno; yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
rows.chinese_simplified: 212. “当心如此得定、清净、明洁、无瑕、离秽、柔软、堪任、稳固、不动时，我将心导向宿住随念智。我回忆起种种过去生，即：一生……乃至……我如此连同行相与细节，回忆起种种过去生。诸比丘，这是我在初夜时分证得的第一明；无明被破除，明生起了；黑暗被驱散，光明生起了；正如那不放逸、热忱、精勤而住者。”
rows.english: 212. “When my mind was thus concentrated, purified, bright, without blemish, free from corruptions, become malleable, workable, steady, and attained to the imperturbable, I inclined my mind to the knowledge of recollecting past abodes. I recollected my manifold past abodes. That is: one birth… thus, with their aspects and details, I recollected my manifold past abodes. This, monks, was the first true knowledge attained by me in the first watch of the night. Ignorance was dispelled, true knowledge arose; darkness was dispelled, light arose, as it does for one who dwells diligent, ardent, and resolute.”

rows.pali: 208 . ‘‘Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati byāpādavitakko…pe… uppajjati vihiṃsāvitakko. So evaṃ pajānāmi – ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ vihiṃsāvitakko. So ca kho attabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, parabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko’. ‘Attabyābādhāya saṃvattatī’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati; ‘parabyābādhāya saṃvattatī’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati; ‘ubhayabyābādhāya saṃvattatī’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati; ‘paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko’tipi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati. So kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, uppannuppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ pajahameva vinodameva byantameva naṃ akāsiṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 208. “诸比丘，当我如此不放逸、热忱、自我策励地安住时，生起了瞋寻……乃至……生起了害寻。我这样了知：‘我生起了这个害寻。它既导致恼害自己，也导致恼害他人，还导致恼害双方；它障碍智慧，是苦恼品类，不导向涅槃。’诸比丘，当我反思‘它导致恼害自己’时，它就消失了；诸比丘，当我反思‘它导致恼害他人’时，它就消失了；诸比丘，当我反思‘它导致恼害双方’时，它就消失了；诸比丘，当我反思‘它障碍智慧，是苦恼品类，不导向涅槃’时，它就消失了。诸比丘，我就是这样，对每一个生起的害寻，都予以舍断、去除、灭尽。”
rows.english: 208. “Monks, as I was dwelling thus—heedful, ardent, and resolute—a thought of ill will arose in me… a thought of violence arose in me. I understood it thus: ‘This thought of violence has arisen in me. It leads to my own affliction, to the affliction of others, and to the affliction of both; it obstructs wisdom, is on the side of distress, and does not lead to Nibbāna.’ As I reflected, ‘It leads to my own affliction,’ it subsided in me. As I reflected, ‘It leads to the affliction of others,’ it subsided in me. As I reflected, ‘It leads to the affliction of both,’ it subsided in me. As I reflected, ‘It obstructs wisdom, is on the side of distress, and does not lead to Nibbāna,’ it subsided in me. Monks, I would abandon, dispel, and make an end of each thought of violence as it arose.

rows.pali: 206 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘bhikkhavo’’ti. ‘‘Bhadante’’ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 206. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住舍卫城祇陀林给孤独园。在那里，世尊对比丘们说：‘比丘们！’‘尊者！’那些比丘回答世尊。世尊说了这番话：
rows.english: 206. Thus have I heard. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park. There the Blessed One addressed the monks: “Monks.” “Venerable sir,” they replied. The Blessed One said this:

rows.pali: 207 . ‘‘Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati kāmavitakko. So evaṃ pajānāmi – ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ kāmavitakko.
