Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty dwelling, reflects thus: ‘Form is impermanent, feeling is impermanent, perception is impermanent, formations are impermanent, consciousness is impermanent.’ Thus he dwells contemplating impermanence in these five aggregates of clinging. This, Ānanda, is called the perception of impermanence.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cānanda, anattasaññā? Idhānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, sotaṃ anattā, saddā anattā, ghānaṃ anattā, gandhā anattā, jivhā anattā, rasā anattā, kāyā anattā, phoṭṭhabbā anattā, mano anattā, dhammā anattā’ti. Iti imesu chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu anattānupassī viharati. Ayaṃ vuccatānanda, anattasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，何为无我想？阿难，于此，比丘或往林野，或往树下，或往空寂处，如此审察：‘眼是无我，色是无我；耳是无我，声是无我；鼻是无我，香是无我；舌是无我，味是无我；身是无我，所触是无我；意是无我，法是无我。’如是，于此六内外处，随观无我而住。阿难，此谓无我想。”
rows.english: “And what, Ānanda, is the perception of not-self? Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty dwelling, reflects thus: ‘The eye is not-self, forms are not-self; the ear is not-self, sounds are not-self; the nose is not-self, odors are not-self; the tongue is not-self, tastes are not-self; the body is not-self, tangible objects are not-self; the mind is not-self, mental objects are not-self.’ Thus he dwells contemplating not-self in these six internal and external sense bases. This, Ānanda, is called the perception of not-self.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cānanda, ānāpānassati? Idhānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. So satova assasati satova passasati. Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti. Dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti. Rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘rassaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti. Rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘rassaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti. ‘Sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati . Abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ…pe… samādahaṃ cittaṃ…pe… vimocayaṃ cittaṃ…pe… aniccānupassī…pe… virāgānupassī…pe… nirodhānupassī…pe… ‘paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. Ayaṃ vuccatānanda, ānāpānassati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 阿难，什么是入出息念？阿难，于此，比丘或往林野，或往树下，或往空闲处，结跏趺坐，端正其身，置念于面前而坐。他正念地入息，正念地出息。长入息时，他了知‘我入息长’；长出息时，他了知‘我出息长’。短入息时，他了知‘我入息短’；短出息时，他了知‘我出息短’。他修学：‘我将觉知全息身入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知全息身出息’。他修学：‘我将平息身行入息’；他修学：‘我将平息身行出息’。他修学：‘我将觉知喜入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知喜出息’。他修学：‘我将觉知乐入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知乐出息’。他修学：‘我将觉知心行入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知心行出息’。他修学：‘我将平息心行入息’；他修学：‘我将平息心行出息’。他修学：‘我将觉知心入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知心出息’。他修学：‘我将令心喜悦……’；他修学：‘我将令心专注……’；他修学：‘我将令心解脱……’；他修学：‘我将随观无常……’；他修学：‘我将随观离欲……’；他修学：‘我将随观寂灭……’；他修学：‘我将随观舍弃入息’；他修学：‘我将随观舍弃出息’。阿难，此谓入出息念。
rows.english: “And what, Ānanda, is mindfulness of breathing? Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, or to the foot of a tree, or to an empty dwelling, sits down. Having folded his legs crosswise, set his body erect, and established mindfulness before him, ever mindful he breathes in, mindful he breathes out. Breathing in long, he knows: ‘I breathe in long’; or breathing out long, he knows: ‘I breathe out long.’ Breathing in short, he knows: ‘I breathe in short’; or breathing out short, he knows: ‘I breathe out short.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in experiencing the whole body.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the whole body.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in calming the bodily formation.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out calming the bodily formation.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in experiencing rapture.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out experiencing rapture.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in experiencing pleasure.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out experiencing pleasure.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in experiencing the mental formation.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the mental formation.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in calming the mental formation.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out calming the mental formation.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in experiencing the mind.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the mind.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in gladdening the mind.’… He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in concentrating the mind.’… He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in liberating the mind.’… He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in contemplating impermanence.’… He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in contemplating dispassion.’… He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in contemplating cessation.’… He trains himself: ‘I will breathe in contemplating relinquishment.’ He trains himself: ‘I will breathe out contemplating relinquishment.’ This, Ānanda, is called mindfulness of breathing.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cānanda, asubhasaññā? Idhānanda, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānāppakārassa asucino paccavekkhati – ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā mutta’nti. Iti imasmiṃ kāye asubhānupassī viharati. Ayaṃ vuccatānanda, asubhasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，何为不净想？阿难，于此，比丘审察此身，自足底而上，自发顶而下，周遍皮肤，充满种种不净：‘此身中有发、毛、爪、齿、皮、肉、筋、骨、骨髓、肾、心、肝、肋膜、脾、肺、肠、肠系膜、胃中物、粪、胆汁、痰、脓、血、汗、脂肪、泪、膏、唾液、涕、关节液、尿。’如是，于此身中，随观不净而住。阿难，此谓不净想。”
rows.english: “And what, Ānanda, is the perception of foulness? Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu reviews this very body upward from the soles of the feet and downward from the top of the hair, enclosed in skin and full of many kinds of impurity: ‘In this body there are head hairs, body hairs, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, bone marrow, kidneys, heart, liver, pleura, spleen, lungs, intestines, mesentery, contents of the stomach, feces, bile, phlegm, pus, blood, sweat, fat, tears, grease, saliva, snot, synovial fluid, and urine.’ Thus he dwells contemplating foulness in this body. This, Ānanda, is called the perception of foulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cānanda, ādīnavasaññā? Idhānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘bahudukkho kho ayaṃ kāyo bahuādīnavo? Iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyathidaṃ – cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānarogo jivhārogo kāyarogo sīsarogo kaṇṇarogo mukharogo dantarogo oṭṭharogo kāso sāso pināso ḍāho ḍaho (sī. syā.) jaro kucchirogo mucchā pakkhandikā sūlā visūcikā kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso soso apamāro daddu kaṇḍu kacchu nakhasā vitacchikā lohitaṃ pittaṃ lohitapittaṃ (sī.) madhumeho aṃsā piḷakā bhagandalā pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā vātasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā sannipātikā ābādhā utupariṇāmajā ābādhā visamaparihārajā ābādhā opakkamikā ābādhā kammavipākajā ābādhā sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo’ti. Iti imasmiṃ kāye ādīnavānupassī viharati. Ayaṃ vuccatānanda, ādīnavasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，何为过患想？阿难，于此，比丘或往林中，或往树下，或往空屋，如是思惟：‘此身实为多苦、多患。于此身中生起种种疾病，即：眼病、耳病、鼻病、舌病、身病、头病、耳廓病、口病、牙病、唇病、咳嗽、气喘、鼻炎、灼热、发烧、腹病、昏厥、痢疾、腹中剧痛、霍乱、麻风、痈、白癜风、痨病、癫痫、癣、瘙痒、疥疮、甲伤、皲裂、血胆病、糖尿病、痔疮、疖、瘘管；有胆汁所生之病，有痰所生之病，有风所生之病，有三者合集所生之病，有季节变化所生之病，有姿势不当所生之病，有外力所生之病，有业报所生之病；以及寒、热、饥、渴、大便、小便。’如是，彼于此身中安住于随观过患。阿难，此谓过患想。”
rows.english: “And what, Ānanda, is the perception of danger? Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty dwelling, reflects thus: ‘This body has much suffering, much danger. For in this body various diseases arise, such as these: eye disease, ear disease, nose disease, tongue disease, body disease, head disease, external ear disease, mouth disease, tooth disease, lip disease, cough, asthma, nasal catarrh, burning fever, fever, stomach disease, fainting, dysentery, sharp pain, cholera, leprosy, tumors, eczema, consumption, epilepsy, ringworm, itch, scabies, nail-scratch disease, scaly skin disease, disease of blood and bile, diabetes, piles, carbuncles, and fistula; diseases originating from bile, diseases originating from phlegm, diseases originating from wind, diseases from their combination; diseases born of seasonal change, diseases born of uneven care of the body, diseases born of external assaults, and diseases born of kamma-result; as well as cold, heat, hunger, thirst, defecation, and urination.’ Thus he dwells contemplating danger in this body. This, Ānanda, is called the perception of danger.”

rows.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato santike imā dasa saññā uggahetvā yenāyasmā girimānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato girimānandassa imā dasa saññā abhāsi. Atha kho āyasmato girimānandassa dasa saññā sutvā so ābādho ṭhānaso paṭippassambhi. Vuṭṭhahi cāyasmā girimānando tamhā ābādhā. Tathā pahīno ca panāyasmato girimānandassa so ābādho ahosī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 尔时，具寿阿难于世尊处领受此十想后，即往具寿吉利马难陀之处；抵达后，为具寿吉利马难陀宣说此十想。于是，具寿吉利马难陀听闻此十想后，其病即刻平息。具寿吉利马难陀从彼病中痊愈，其病亦如是断除。第十经竟。
rows.english: Then the Venerable Ānanda, having learned these ten perceptions in the Blessed One’s presence, approached the Venerable Girimānanda and spoke these ten perceptions to him. Then, when the Venerable Girimānanda heard these ten perceptions, his affliction subsided on the spot. The Venerable Girimānanda rose up from that affliction, and that affliction of the Venerable Girimānanda was thus abandoned. The tenth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cānanda, nirodhasaññā? Idhānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhippaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo nirodho nibbāna’nti. Ayaṃ vuccatānanda, nirodhasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 阿难，何为灭想？阿难，于此，比丘前往林野、或往树下、或往空寂处，如是思惟：‘此是寂静，此是殊胜，即一切行之止息，一切依之舍离，渴爱之灭尽，灭，涅槃。’阿难，此谓灭想。
rows.english: “And what, Ānanda, is the perception of cessation? Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty dwelling, reflects thus: ‘This is peaceful, this is sublime, namely, the stilling of all formations, the relinquishing of all substrates of existence, the destruction of craving, cessation, Nibbāna.’ This, Ānanda, is called the perception of cessation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Nāhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，于包含天、魔、梵之世间，于包含沙门、婆罗门、天人之众生中，我未见有谁能以解答此等问题而令心意满足，除了如来、如来弟子，或从此处听闻者。”
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, I do not see anyone in this world with its devas, Māras, and Brahmās, in this generation with its ascetics and brahmins, with its devas and humans, who could satisfy the mind with an explanation of these questions, except for the Tathāgata, or a disciple of the Tathāgata, or one who has heard it from this dispensation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi dussamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，正是如此，当心消沉之时，那时不适宜修习轻安觉支，不适宜修习定觉支，不适宜修习舍觉支。何以故？诸比丘，消沉之心难由此等法振作。
rows.english: “Just so, bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is sluggish, it is the wrong time for the cultivation of the tranquility factor of awakening, the wrong time for the cultivation of the concentration factor of awakening, and the wrong time for the cultivation of the equanimity factor of awakening. For what reason? Bhikkhus, a sluggish mind is difficult to arouse by means of these states.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，正是如此，当心消沉之时，那时适宜修习择法觉支，适宜修习精进觉支，适宜修习喜觉支。何以故？诸比丘，消沉之心易由此等法振作。
rows.english: “Just so, bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is sluggish, it is the right time for the cultivation of the investigation-of-phenomena factor of awakening, the right time for the cultivation of the energy factor of awakening, and the right time for the cultivation of the rapture factor of awakening. For what reason? Bhikkhus, a sluggish mind is easy to arouse by means of these states.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，正是这样，当心掉举时，那时不是修习择法觉支(dhammavicayasambojjhaṅga)的时候，不是修习精进觉支(vīriyasambojjhaṅga)的时候，不是修习喜觉支(pītisambojjhaṅga)的时候。那是什么原因呢？诸比丘，掉举的心，用这些法是难以平息的。”
rows.english: “Just so, bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is agitated, it is the wrong time for the cultivation of the investigation-of-phenomena factor of awakening, the wrong time for the cultivation of the energy factor of awakening, and the wrong time for the cultivation of the rapture factor of awakening. For what reason? Bhikkhus, an agitated mind is difficult to calm by means of these states.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa. So tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni gomayāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, mukhavātañca dadeyya, na ca paṃsukena okireyya; bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjālitu’’nti? ‘‘Evaṃ, bhante’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，譬如有人想燃起小火，他将干草、干牛粪、干木柴投入其中，并用口吹气，且不撒上尘土。此人能否燃起那小火呢？”“是的，世尊。”
rows.english: “Suppose, bhikkhus, a man wished to make a small fire blaze. If he were to put dry grass, dry cow-dung, and dry firewood into it, blow on it with his mouth, and not scatter dust over it, would that man be able to make the small fire blaze?” “Yes, venerable sir.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi dussamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，当心识沉滞时，于尔时，修习轻安觉支为非时，修习定觉支为非时，修习舍觉支为非时。此为何因？诸比丘，沉滞的心识，难以被此等法所振奋。”
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is sluggish, it is the wrong time for the cultivation of the tranquility factor of awakening, the wrong time for the cultivation of the concentration factor of awakening, and the wrong time for the cultivation of the equanimity factor of awakening. For what reason? Because, bhikkhus, a sluggish mind is difficult to arouse by means of these states.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiñca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，当心消沉之时，那时适宜修习择法觉支，适宜修习精进觉支，适宜修习喜觉支。何以故？诸比丘，消沉之心易由此等法振作。
rows.english: “And, bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is sluggish, it is the right time for the cultivation of the investigation-of-phenomena factor of awakening, the right time for the cultivation of the energy factor of awakening, and the right time for the cultivation of the rapture factor of awakening. For what reason? Bhikkhus, a sluggish mind is easy to arouse by means of these states.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ , bhikkhave, samaye uddhattaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，当心掉举之时，那时不适宜修习择法觉支，不适宜修习精进觉支，不适宜修习喜觉支。何以故？诸比丘，掉举之心难由此等法平息。
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is agitated, it is the wrong time for the cultivation of the investigation-of-phenomena factor of awakening, the wrong time for the cultivation of the energy factor of awakening, and the wrong time for the cultivation of the rapture factor of awakening. For what reason? Bhikkhus, an agitated mind is difficult to calm by means of these states.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiñca kho, bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，当心掉举时，那时是修习轻安觉支(passaddhisambojjhaṅga)的时候，是修习定觉支(samādhisambojjhaṅga)的时候，是修习舍觉支(upekkhāsambojjhaṅga)的时候。那是什么原因呢？诸比丘，掉举的心，用这些法是容易平息的。”
rows.english: “And, bhikkhus, at a time when the mind is agitated, it is the right time for the cultivation of the tranquility factor of awakening, the right time for the cultivation of the concentration factor of awakening, and the right time for the cultivation of the equanimity factor of awakening. For what reason? Bhikkhus, an agitated mind is easy to calm by means of these states.”

rows.pali: 234 . Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu . (Pariyāyasuttasadisaṃ).
rows.chinese_simplified: 234. 那时，众多比丘于上午时分，着衣，持衣钵，进入舍卫城(Sāvatthī)乞食。（与《法门经》相似。）
rows.english: 234. Then, a number of bhikkhus, having dressed in the morning, took their bowls and robes and entered Sāvatthī for alms. (Similar to the Pariyāya Sutta.)

rows.pali: ‘‘Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti. Satiñca khvāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabbatthikaṃ vadāmī’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，正是如此。当心掉举时，那时是修习轻安觉支之时，是修习定觉支之时，是修习舍觉支之时。是什么原因呢？比丘们，掉举的心能被这些法善加平息。比丘们，我说念于一切处皆是所需。”第三经。
rows.english: Even so, bhikkhus, when the mind is agitated, that is the time for the cultivation of the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the time for the cultivation of the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the time for the cultivation of the enlightenment factor of equanimity. For what reason? Bhikkhus, an agitated mind is well calmed by these dhammas. And I declare, bhikkhus, that mindfulness is desirable in all circumstances. Third.

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃvādino, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā – ‘yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāya? Yasmiṃ panāvuso, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāyā’ti? Evaṃ puṭṭhā , bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti, uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. Taṃ kissa hetu? Yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，对那些有此言说的外道游行者，应如是说：‘贤友，当心识沉滞时，于尔时，修习哪些觉支为非时？修习哪些觉支为适时？贤友，再者，当心识掉举时，于尔时，修习哪些觉支为非时？修习哪些觉支为适时？’诸比丘，被这样提问时，那些外道游行者将无法圆满解答，更将陷入困惑。此为何因？诸比丘，因为这并非他们的境界。”
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, wanderers of other sects who speak thus should be addressed in this way: ‘Friends, at a time when the mind is sluggish, for which factors of awakening is it the wrong time for cultivation, and for which is it the right time for cultivation? And, friends, at a time when the mind is agitated, for which factors of awakening is it the wrong time for cultivation, and for which is it the right time for cultivation?’ When asked thus, bhikkhus, the wanderers of other sects will not be able to answer satisfactorily, and furthermore, they will come to vexation. For what reason? Because, bhikkhus, it is not their domain.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa. So tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, udakavātañca dadeyya, paṃsukena ca okireyya; bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetu’’nti? ‘‘Evaṃ, bhante’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，譬如有人想要熄灭一大堆火。他在那里投入湿草、湿牛粪和湿柴，还洒水，并撒上尘土；那个人能熄灭那一大堆火吗？”“是的，世尊。”
rows.english: “Suppose, bhikkhus, a man wished to extinguish a great mass of fire. If he were to put wet grass, wet cow-dung, and wet firewood into it, apply a damp wind to it, and scatter dust over it, would that man be able to extinguish the great mass of fire?” “Yes, venerable sir.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa. So tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya , udakavātañca dadeyya, paṃsukena ca okireyya; bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjālitu’’nti? ‘‘No hetaṃ, bhante’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，譬如有人想燃起小火，他却向火中投入湿草、湿牛粪、湿木柴，又向其吹带水汽的风，并撒上尘土，那人能否燃起那小火呢？”“不能，世尊。”
rows.english: “Suppose, bhikkhus, a man wished to make a small fire blaze. If he were to put wet grass, wet cow-dung, and wet firewood into it, apply a damp wind to it, and scatter dust over it, would that man be able to make the small fire blaze?” “Certainly not, venerable sir.”

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamano āyasmā rāhulo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了这番话。具寿罗睺罗心意喜悦，欢喜信受世尊所说。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. The Venerable Rāhula, pleased, rejoiced in the Blessed One’s words.

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, rāhula, ānāpānassati, evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā. Evaṃ bhāvitāya, rāhula, ānāpānassatiyā, evaṃ bahulīkatāya yepi te carimakā assāsā tepi viditāva nirujjhanti no aviditā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 罗睺罗，如是修习、如是多作的入出息念，有大果报、大利益。罗睺罗，如此修习、多作入出息念，则最后的入出息亦是在明了中寂灭，而非不明了。
rows.english: Rāhula, when mindfulness of breathing is thus developed and cultivated, it is of great fruit and great benefit. Rāhula, when mindfulness of breathing is thus developed and cultivated, even the final in-breaths and out-breaths cease with knowledge, not without knowledge.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Pītippaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘pītippaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘sukhappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘sukhappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他修学：‘我将觉知喜而出息’；他修学：‘我将觉知喜而入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知乐而出息’；他修学：‘我将觉知乐而入息’；他修学：‘我将觉知心行而出息’；他修学：‘我将觉知心行而入息’；他修学：‘我将平息心行而出息’；他修学：‘我将平息心行而入息’。
rows.english: “He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out experiencing rapture’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in experiencing rapture.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out experiencing happiness’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in experiencing happiness.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the mental formation’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in experiencing the mental formation.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out calming the mental formation’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in calming the mental formation.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Cittappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘cittappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati ; ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他修学：‘我将觉知心而出息’；他修学：‘我将觉知心而入息’；他修学：‘我将令心喜悦而出息’；他修学：‘我将令心喜悦而入息’；他修学：‘我将令心专注而出息’；他修学：‘我将令心专注而入息’；他修学：‘我将令心解脱而出息’；他修学：‘我将令心解脱而入息’。
rows.english: “He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the mind’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in experiencing the mind.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out gladdening the mind’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in gladdening the mind.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out concentrating the mind’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in concentrating the mind.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out liberating the mind’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in liberating the mind.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Aniccānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘aniccānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘virāgānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘virāgānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘nirodhānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘nirodhānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他修学：‘我将随观无常而出息’；他修学：‘我将随观无常而入息’；他修学：‘我将随观离贪而出息’；他修学：‘我将随观离贪而入息’；他修学：‘我将随观灭而出息’；他修学：‘我将随观灭而入息’；他修学：‘我将随观舍遣而出息’；他修学：‘我将随观舍遣而入息’。
rows.english: “He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out contemplating impermanence’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in contemplating impermanence.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out contemplating fading away’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in contemplating fading away.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out contemplating cessation’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in contemplating cessation.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out contemplating relinquishment’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in contemplating relinquishment.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ākāsasamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Ākāsasamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti. Seyyathāpi, rāhula, ākāso na katthaci patiṭṭhito; evameva kho tvaṃ, rāhula, ākāsasamaṃ bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Ākāsasamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “罗睺罗，你当修习如虚空一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如虚空一般的修习时，已生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。罗睺罗，譬如虚空无所依止；同样地，罗睺罗，你当修习如虚空一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如虚空一般的修习时，已生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。”
rows.english: “Rāhula, develop the development that is like space. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development that is like space, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain. Just as, Rāhula, space is not established anywhere, in the same way, Rāhula, develop the development that is like space. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development that is like space, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti; rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘rassaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘rassaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti. ‘Sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “出息长时，他了知‘我出息长’；入息长时，他了知‘我入息长’。出息短时，他了知‘我出息短’；入息短时，他了知‘我入息短’。他学：‘我将觉知全部息身而出息’；他学：‘我将觉知全部息身而入息’。他学：‘我将平息身行而出息’；他学：‘我将平息身行而入息’。”
rows.english: “Breathing out long, he knows distinctly: ‘I am breathing out long’; or breathing in long, he knows distinctly: ‘I am breathing in long.’ Or breathing out short, he knows distinctly: ‘I am breathing out short’; or breathing in short, he knows distinctly: ‘I am breathing in short.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the whole body’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in experiencing the whole body.’ He trains thus: ‘I will breathe out calming the bodily formation’; he trains thus: ‘I will breathe in calming the bodily formation.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tejosamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Tejosamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti. Seyyathāpi, rāhula, tejo sucimpi dahati, asucimpi dahati, gūthagatampi dahati, muttagatampi dahati, kheḷagatampi dahati, pubbagatampi dahati, lohitagatampi dahati, na ca tena tejo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; evameva kho tvaṃ, rāhula, tejosamaṃ bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Tejosamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 罗睺罗，你当修习如火一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如火一般的修习时，生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。罗睺罗，譬如火燃烧洁净之物，也燃烧不净之物，燃烧粪便、尿液、唾液、脓液、血液，火不会因此而烦恼、羞愧或厌恶；同样地，罗睺罗，你当修习如火一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如火一般的修习时，生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。
rows.english: “Rāhula, develop the development that is like fire. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development that is like fire, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain. Just as, Rāhula, fire burns clean things and also burns unclean things; it burns feces, urine, spittle, pus, and blood, yet the fire is not troubled, ashamed, or disgusted by that. In the same way, Rāhula, develop the development that is like fire. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development that is like fire, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Vāyosamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Vāyosamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti. Seyyathāpi, rāhula, vāyo sucimpi upavāyati, asucimpi upavāyati, gūthagatampi upavāyati, muttagatampi upavāyati, kheḷagatampi upavāyati, pubbagatampi upavāyati, lohitagatampi upavāyati, na ca tena vāyo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; evameva kho tvaṃ, rāhula, vāyosamaṃ bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Vāyosamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “罗睺罗，你当修习如风一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如风一般的修习时，已生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。罗睺罗，譬如，风吹拂洁净之物，亦吹拂不净之物，吹拂粪便、尿液、唾液、脓液、血液，风亦不因此而烦恼、羞愧或厌恶。同样地，罗睺罗，你当修习如风一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如风一般的修习时，已生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。”
rows.english: “Rāhula, develop the development that is like the wind. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development that is like the wind, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain. Just as, Rāhula, the wind blows on clean things and also blows on unclean things; it blows on feces, urine, spittle, pus, and blood, yet the wind is not troubled, ashamed, or disgusted by that. In the same way, Rāhula, develop the development that is like the wind. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development that is like the wind, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Āposamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Āposamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti. Seyyathāpi, rāhula, āpasmiṃ sucimpi dhovanti, asucimpi dhovanti, gūthagatampi dhovanti, muttagatampi dhovanti, kheḷagatampi dhovanti, pubbagatampi dhovanti, lohitagatampi dhovanti, na ca tena āpo aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; evameva kho tvaṃ, rāhula, āposamaṃ bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Āposamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 罗睺罗，你当修习如水一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如水一般的修习时，生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。罗睺罗，譬如在水中，人们清洗洁净之物，也清洗不净之物，清洗粪便、尿液、唾液、脓液、血液，水不会因此而烦恼、羞愧或厌恶；同样地，罗睺罗，你当修习如水一般的修习。罗睺罗，当你修习如水一般的修习时，生起的可爱与不可爱的触，将不会占据你的心而停留。
rows.english: “Develop the meditation, Rāhula, to be like water. For when you are developing the meditation to be like water, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain. Just as, Rāhula, people wash clean things in water, and they also wash unclean things, they wash feces, they wash urine, they wash spittle, they wash pus, and they wash blood, yet the water is not troubled, humiliated, or disgusted by that; in the same way, Rāhula, develop the meditation to be like water. For when you are developing the meditation to be like water, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain.”

rows.pali: 119 . ‘‘Pathavīsamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Pathavīsamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti. Seyyathāpi, rāhula, pathaviyā sucimpi nikkhipanti, asucimpi nikkhipanti, gūthagatampi nikkhipanti, muttagatampi nikkhipanti, kheḷagatampi nikkhipanti, pubbagatampi nikkhipanti, lohitagatampi nikkhipanti, na ca tena pathavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā; evameva kho tvaṃ, rāhula, pathavīsamaṃ bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Pathavīsamañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāpāmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 119. 罗睺罗，当修习与大地等同的禅修。罗睺罗，当你修习与大地等同的禅修时，已生起的可爱与不可爱之触，将不会占据你的心而存续。犹如，罗睺罗，人们将净物、不净物、粪、尿、唾、脓、血丢弃于地，大地不因此而苦恼、羞耻或厌恶。正是如此，罗睺罗，当修习与大地等同的禅修。罗睺罗，当你修习与大地等同的禅修时，已生起的可爱与不可爱之触，将不会占据你的心而存续。
rows.english: 119. “Develop the meditation, Rāhula, to be like the earth. For when you are developing the meditation to be like the earth, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain. Just as, Rāhula, people throw clean things on the earth, and they also throw unclean things, they throw feces, they throw urine, they throw spittle, they throw pus, and they throw blood, yet the earth is not troubled, humiliated, or disgusted by that; in the same way, Rāhula, develop the meditation to be like the earth. For when you are developing the meditation to be like the earth, arisen pleasant and unpleasant contacts will not take possession of your mind and remain.”

rows.pali: 120 . ‘‘Mettaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Mettañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo byāpādo so pahīyissati. Karuṇaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Karuṇañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yā vihesā sā pahīyissati. Muditaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Muditañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yā arati sā pahīyissati. Upekkhaṃ , rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Upekkhañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo paṭigho so pahīyissati. Asubhaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Asubhañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo rāgo so pahīyissati. Aniccasaññaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Aniccasaññañhi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo asmimāno so pahīyissati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 120. “罗睺罗，你当修习慈修。罗睺罗，当你修习慈修时，凡是瞋恚，都将被断除。罗睺罗，你当修习悲修。罗睺罗，当你修习悲修时，凡是恼害，都将被断除。罗睺罗，你当修习喜修。罗睺罗，当你修习喜修时，凡是不乐，都将被断除。罗睺罗，你当修习舍修。罗睺罗，当你修习舍修时，凡是恚，都将被断除。罗睺罗，你当修习不净修。罗睺罗，当你修习不净修时，凡是贪欲，都将被断除。罗睺罗，你当修习无常想修。罗睺罗，当你修习无常想修时，凡是我慢，都将被断除。”
rows.english: 120. “Rāhula, develop the development of loving-kindness. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development of loving-kindness, whatever ill will there is will be abandoned. Rāhula, develop the development of compassion. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development of compassion, whatever cruelty there is will be abandoned. Rāhula, develop the development of sympathetic joy. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development of sympathetic joy, whatever discontent there is will be abandoned. Rāhula, develop the development of equanimity. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development of equanimity, whatever aversion there is will be abandoned. Rāhula, develop the development of foulness. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development of foulness, whatever lust there is will be abandoned. Rāhula, develop the development of the perception of impermanence. For, Rāhula, when you are developing the development of the perception of impermanence, whatever conceit ‘I am’ there is will be abandoned.”

rows.pali: 116 . ‘‘Katamā ca, rāhula, tejodhātu? Tejodhātu siyā ajjhattikā, siyā bāhirā. Katamā ca, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu? Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu. Yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu tejodhāturevesā. Taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti – evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā tejodhātuyā nibbindati, tejodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 116. “罗睺罗，什么是火界？火界，或为内在，或为外在。罗睺罗，什么是内在火界？凡是内在的、自身的、属于火、有热性的、被执取的，即：依此而发热，依此而衰老，依此而燃烧，依此而使所食、所饮、所嚼、所尝之物完全消化，以及其他任何内在的、自身的、属于火、有热性的、被执取的，罗睺罗，这被称为内在火界。无论是内在火界，还是外在火界，都只是火界。对此，应以正慧如其本然地看待：‘这不是我的，我不是此，这不是我的我。’如此以正慧如其本然地看待后，他对火界感到厌离，心于火界离染。”
rows.english: 116. “And what, Rāhula, is the fire element? The fire element may be internal or external. And what, Rāhula, is the internal fire element? Whatever is internal, personal, heat, fiery, and clung to—that is to say: that by which one is warmed, ages, and is burnt up; and that by which what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted is properly digested; or whatever else is internal, personal, heat, fiery, and clung to—this, Rāhula, is called the internal fire element. Now, both the internal fire element and the external fire element are simply the fire element. This should be seen as it really is with right wisdom: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Seeing it thus as it really is with right wisdom, one becomes disenchanted with the fire element and detaches the mind from the fire element.”

rows.pali: 117 . ‘‘Katamā ca, rāhula, vāyodhātu? Vāyodhātu siyā ajjhattikā, siyā bāhirā. Katamā ca, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu? Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – uddhaṅgamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭhāsayā koṭṭhasayā (sī. pī.) vātā , aṅgamaṅgānusārino vātā, assāso passāso, iti yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu. Yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā vāyodhātu yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu vāyodhāturevesā. Taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi , na meso attā’ti – evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā vāyodhātuyā nibbindati, vāyodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 117. “罗睺罗，什么是风界？风界有内在的，也有外在的。罗睺罗，什么是内在风界？凡是内在的、自身的、风、风所成的、被执取的，即：上行风、下行风、腹中风、肠中风、流遍肢体的风、入息、出息，或任何其他内在的、自身的、风、风所成的、被执取的——罗睺罗，这称为内在风界。凡是内在风界及外在风界，都只是风界。那风界，应以正慧如其本然地看待为：‘这不是我的，我不是此，这不是我的自我。’如此以正慧如其本然地观见后，他于风界生厌，心于风界离染。”
rows.english: 117. “And what, Rāhula, is the wind element? The wind element may be internal or external. And what, Rāhula, is the internal wind element? Whatever is internal, personal, wind, windy, and clung to—that is to say: upward-going winds, downward-going winds, winds in the belly, winds in the bowels, winds that course through the limbs, the in-breath and the out-breath; or whatever else is internal, personal, wind, windy, and clung to—this, Rāhula, is called the internal wind element. Now, both the internal wind element and the external wind element are simply the wind element. This should be seen as it really is with right wisdom: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Seeing it thus as it really is with right wisdom, one becomes disenchanted with the wind element and detaches the mind from the wind element.”

rows.pali: 115 . ‘‘Katamā ca, rāhula, āpodhātu? Āpodhātu siyā ajjhattikā, siyā bāhirā. Katamā ca, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu ? Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu. Yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu āpodhāturevesā. Taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti – evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āpodhātuyā nibbindati, āpodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 115. “罗睺罗，什么是水界？水界，或为内在，或为外在。罗睺罗，什么是内在水界？凡是内在的、自身的、属于水、有流动性的、被执取的，即：胆汁、痰、脓、血、汗、脂肪、泪、膏、唾、涕、关节滑液、尿，以及其他任何内在的、自身的、属于水、有流动性的、被执取的，罗睺罗，这被称为内在水界。无论是内在水界，还是外在水界，都只是水界。对此，应以正慧如其本然地看待：‘这不是我的，我不是此，这不是我的我。’如此以正慧如其本然地看待后，他对水界感到厌离，心于水界离染。”
rows.english: 115. “And what, Rāhula, is the water element? The water element may be internal or external. And what, Rāhula, is the internal water element? Whatever is internal, personal, liquid, fluid, and clung to—that is to say: bile, phlegm, pus, blood, sweat, fat, tears, grease, saliva, snot, synovial fluid, and urine; or whatever else is internal, personal, liquid, fluid, and clung to—this, Rāhula, is called the internal water element. Now, both the internal water element and the external water element are simply the water element. This should be seen as it really is with right wisdom: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Seeing it thus as it really is with right wisdom, one becomes disenchanted with the water element and detaches the mind from the water element.”

rows.pali: 118 . ‘‘Katamā ca, rāhula, ākāsadhātu? Ākāsadhātu siyā ajjhattikā, siyā bāhirā. Katamā ca, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu? Yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – kaṇṇacchiddaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ ajjhoharati, yattha ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ santiṭṭhati, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ adhobhāgaṃ adhobhāgā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) nikkhamati, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ, aghaṃ aghagataṃ, vivaraṃ vivaragataṃ, asamphuṭṭhaṃ, maṃsalohitehi upādinnaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ (sī. pī.) – ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu. Yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu yā ca bāhirā ākāsadhātu ākāsadhāturevesā. Taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti – evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā ākāsadhātuyā cittaṃ nibbindati, ākāsadhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 118. 罗睺罗，什么是空界？空界可以是内在的，也可以是外在的。罗睺罗，什么是内空界？凡是内在的、自身的，是空间、已成空间，为所执取者，即：耳孔、鼻孔、口门，以及由此吞咽所食、所饮、所嚼、所尝之物，其停留之处，其从下方排出之处；或其他任何内在的、自身的，是空间、已成空间，是空、已成空，是孔隙、已成孔隙，未为血肉所触，为所执取者——罗睺罗，这被称为内空界。凡是内空界及外空界，皆只是空界。对此，应以正慧如其本然地看待：‘这非我所有，我非是此，这非我之我。’如此以正慧如其本然地看待后，他对空界心生厌离，使心于空界离染。
rows.english: 118. “And what, Rāhula, is the space element? The space element may be internal or external. And what, Rāhula, is the internal space element? Whatever is internal, personal, space, spatial, and clung to—that is to say: the ear-hole, the nostril, the opening of the mouth; and that by which one swallows what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted; and where what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted remains; and that by which what is eaten, drunk, chewed, and tasted is expelled from the lower part; or whatever else is internal, personal, space, spatial, void, vacuity, an aperture, a cavity, and, being untouched by flesh and blood, is clung to—this, Rāhula, is called the internal space element. Now, both the internal space element and the external space element are simply the space element. This should be seen as it really is with right wisdom: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Seeing it thus as it really is with right wisdom, one becomes disenchanted with the space element and detaches the mind from the space element.”

rows.pali: 121 . ‘‘Ānāpānassatiṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Ānāpānassati hi te, rāhula, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā. Kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, rāhula, ānāpānassati, kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ? Idha, rāhula, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. So satova assasati satova sato (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) passasati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 121. “罗睺罗，你当修习入出息念。罗睺罗，入出息念若经修习、多作，则有大果报、大利益。罗睺罗，入出息念如何修习、如何多作，而有大果报、大利益呢？罗睺罗，在此，比丘或去往森林，或去往树下，或去往空寂处，结跏趺坐，保持身体端直，置念于面前。他保持正念出息，保持正念入息。”
rows.english: 121. “Rāhula, develop the development of mindfulness of breathing. For, Rāhula, mindfulness of breathing, when developed and made much of, is of great fruit and great benefit. And how, Rāhula, is mindfulness of breathing developed and made much of so that it is of great fruit and great benefit? Here, Rāhula, a bhikkhu—having gone to the forest, or to the root of a tree, or to a secluded place—sits down, having folded his legs crosswise, held his body erect, and established mindfulness before him. Mindful he breathes out, mindful he breathes in.”

rows.pali: 114 . Atha kho āyasmā rāhulo sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘kathaṃ bhāvitā nu kho, bhante, ānāpānassati, kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā’’ti? ‘‘Yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru nahāru (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu paṭhavīdhātu (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) . Yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā pathavīdhātu, pathavīdhāturevesā. Taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti – evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā pathavīdhātuyā nibbindati, pathavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 114. 于是，具寿罗睺罗于傍晚时分从独住中起来，去到世尊那里；抵达后，他顶礼世尊，坐于一旁。坐于一旁的具寿罗睺罗对世尊说：‘世尊，入出息念当如何培育，如何多作，方有大果报、大利益？’‘罗睺罗，凡是内在的、自身的、坚硬的、固体的、被执取的，即：头发、体毛、指甲、牙齿、皮肤、肌肉、筋腱、骨、骨髓、肾、心、肝、肋膜、脾、肺、肠、肠膜、胃中物、粪便，或其他任何内在的、自身的、坚硬的、固体的、被执取的，罗睺罗，这称为内地界。凡是内地界及外地界，皆只是地界。对此，应以正慧如其本然地看待：“这不是我的，我不是此，这不是我的我。”如此以正慧如其本然地看待后，他对地界感到厌离，心对地界离染。’
rows.english: 114. Then, in the evening, the Venerable Rāhula arose from seclusion and approached the Blessed One. Having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, the Venerable Rāhula said to the Blessed One: “Venerable sir, how is mindfulness of breathing developed, how is it cultivated, so that it is of great fruit and great benefit?” “Rāhula, whatever is internal, personal, hard, solid, and clung to—that is to say: head hairs, body hairs, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, bone marrow, kidneys, heart, liver, pleura, spleen, lungs, intestines, mesentery, stomach contents, feces, or whatever else is internal, personal, hard, solid, and clung to—this, Rāhula, is called the internal earth element. Both the internal earth element and the external earth element are simply the earth element. This should be seen as it really is with proper wisdom: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Seeing this as it really is with proper wisdom, one becomes disenchanted with the earth element and detaches the mind from the earth element.”

rows.pali: 113 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. Āyasmāpi kho rāhulo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi. Atha kho bhagavā apaloketvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, rūpaṃ – atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā – sabbaṃ rūpaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabba’’nti. ‘‘Rūpameva nu kho, bhagavā, rūpameva nu kho, sugatā’’ti? ‘‘Rūpampi, rāhula, vedanāpi, rāhula, saññāpi, rāhula, saṅkhārāpi, rāhula, viññāṇampi, rāhulā’’ti. Atha kho āyasmā rāhulo ‘‘ko najja ko nujja (syā. kaṃ.) bhagavatā sammukhā ovādena ovadito gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisissatī’’ti tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. Addasā kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā . Disvāna āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘ānāpānassatiṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. Ānāpānassati, rāhula, bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 113. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住在舍卫城(Sāvatthī)祇陀林(Jetavana)给孤独(Anāthapiṇḍika)园。那时，世尊于上午时分，著衣持钵，进入舍卫城乞食。具寿罗睺罗(Rāhula)也于上午时分，著衣持钵，紧随世尊之后。于是世尊回顾，对具寿罗睺罗说：‘罗睺罗，任何色，无论是过去、未来、现在的，是内或外，是粗或细，是劣或胜，是远或近——一切色都应以正慧如其本然地看待：“这不是我的，我不是此，这不是我的我。”’‘只是色吗，世尊？只是色吗，善逝？’‘罗睺罗，色也是，受也是，想也是，行也是，识也是。’于是，具寿罗睺罗心想：‘今日既已蒙世尊当面教诫，谁还会进村乞食呢？’他便从那里返回，到一棵树下，盘腿而坐，端正身体，将念安住于面前。具寿舍利弗(Sāriputta)看见具寿罗睺罗坐在一棵树下，盘腿而坐，端正身体，将念安住于面前。见到之后，他对具寿罗睺罗说：‘罗睺罗，当培育入出息念(ānāpānassati)。罗睺罗，入出息念若经培育、多作，则有大果报、大利益。’
rows.english: 113. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta's Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park. Then the Blessed One, having dressed in the morning, took his bowl and robe and entered Sāvatthī for alms. And the Venerable Rāhula also, having dressed in the morning, took his bowl and robe and followed right behind the Blessed One. Then the Blessed One, turning around, addressed the Venerable Rāhula: “Rāhula, whatever form there is—past, future, or present; internal or external; gross or subtle; inferior or superior; far or near—all form should be seen as it really is with proper wisdom: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’” “Is it only form, Blessed One? Is it only form, Sugata?” “Form also, Rāhula; feeling also, Rāhula; perception also, Rāhula; formations also, Rāhula; and consciousness also, Rāhula.” Then the Venerable Rāhula thought: “Who today, having been exhorted face to face by the Blessed One, would enter the village for alms?” He then turned back from there and sat down at the foot of a certain tree, folding his legs crosswise, setting his body erect, and establishing mindfulness before him. The Venerable Sāriputta saw the Venerable Rāhula sitting at the foot of a certain tree, folding his legs crosswise, setting his body erect, and establishing mindfulness before him. Seeing this, he addressed the Venerable Rāhula: “Rāhula, develop the meditation of mindfulness of breathing. Mindfulness of breathing, Rāhula, when developed and cultivated, is of great fruit and great benefit.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yo so, mahānāma, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 摩诃男，已证得圣果、了知教法的圣弟子，多作此住。第十经。
rows.english: Mahānāma, that noble disciple who has attained the fruit and understood the teaching dwells frequently in this state.” The tenth discourse.

rows.pali: 10 . Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme. Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno, kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘yo so, bhante, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so katamena vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 10. 一时，世尊住在释迦国的迦毗罗卫（Kapilavatthu）尼拘律园（Nigrodhārāma）。那时，释迦族人摩诃男（Mahānāma）前往世尊之处，礼敬世尊后坐于一旁。坐于一旁的摩诃男对世尊说：‘尊者，那已证得果位、了知教法的圣弟子，多以何种安住而住呢？’
rows.english: 10. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Sakyans at Kapilavatthu in the Banyan Tree Park. Then Mahānāma the Sakyan approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, Mahānāma the Sakyan said to the Blessed One: "Venerable sir, a noble disciple who has attained the fruit and understood the teaching—by what dwelling does he usually abide?"

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni . Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti; ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha. Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，摩诃男，圣弟子随念自己的戒：其戒是不毁坏的、不残缺的、无斑点的、无瑕疵的、自在的、为智者所称赞的、不被执取的、导向禅定的。摩诃男，当圣弟子随念于戒时，那时他的心不为贪欲所困扰，不为瞋恚所困扰，不为愚痴所困扰；那时，他的心缘于戒而变得正直。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子获得义悦，获得法悦，获得与法相应的欢悦。欢悦者生起喜；有喜心者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。摩诃男，这被称为：‘圣弟子在不平等的众生中住于平等，在有瞋恼的众生中住于无瞋恼，入于法流，修习戒随念。’
rows.english: “Furthermore, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his own virtues: that they are unbroken, unbreached, unspotted, unblotched, liberating, praised by the wise, unmisapprehended, and conducive to concentration. When, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his virtues, at that time his mind is not overcome by lust, not overcome by hatred, and not overcome by delusion; at that time his mind is upright, based on virtue. With an upright mind, Mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the Dhamma, gains joy connected with the Dhamma. When he is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One tranquil in body feels pleasure. The mind of one who is pleased becomes concentrated. This, Mahānāma, is called: ‘a noble disciple who dwells peacefully among a turbulent populace, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted populace, who has entered the stream of the Dhamma and develops the recollection of virtues.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati – ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti. Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti ; ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbha. Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhita pāmojjaṃ. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati , dhammasotaṃ samāpanno dhammānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，摩诃男，圣弟子随念于法：‘法是世尊善说的，是自见的，无间的，来即见的，能导向的，为智者们各自亲证的。’摩诃男，当圣弟子随念于法时，那时他的心不为贪欲所困扰，不为瞋恚所困扰，不为愚痴所困扰；那时，他的心缘于法而正直。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子获得义悦，获得法悦，获得与法相应的欢喜。欢喜者生起喜；有喜心者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。摩诃男，这被称为：‘圣弟子在走上邪道的众生中住于正道，在有瞋恼的众生中住于无瞋恼，入于法流，修习法随念。’
rows.english: “Furthermore, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects the Dhamma thus: ‘The Dhamma is well proclaimed by the Blessed One, directly visible, immediate, inviting one to come and see, leading onwards, to be personally experienced by the wise.’ At such a time, Mahānāma, the noble disciple’s mind is not overcome by lust, not overcome by hatred, not overcome by delusion. His mind is upright, based on the Dhamma. With an upright mind, Mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the Dhamma, gains joy connected with the Dhamma. When he is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One tranquil in body feels pleasure. The mind of one who is pleased becomes concentrated. This, Mahānāma, is called ‘a noble disciple who dwells peacefully among a turbulent populace, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted populace, who has entered the stream of the Dhamma and develops the recollection of the Dhamma.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati – ‘lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me! Yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato’ti. Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti , na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti; ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbha. Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno cāgānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，摩诃男，圣弟子随念自己的施舍：‘我实有利得，我实为善得！我于为悭吝之垢所盘踞的众生中，以离悭垢之心住于家中，慷慨布施，净手待施，乐于舍弃，堪于应求，乐于分享布施。’摩诃男，当圣弟子随念施舍时，彼时其心不为贪欲所盘踞，不为瞋恚所盘踞，不为愚痴所盘踞；彼时，他缘于施舍，其心即得正直。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子获得义悦，获得法悦，获得与法相应的欢喜。心生欢喜者，生起喜；意喜者，身轻安；身轻安者，感受乐；有乐者，心入定。摩诃男，此即是说：‘圣弟子于不平等的众生中，安住于平等；于有恼害的众生中，安住于无恼害；已入法流，修习施舍随念。’
rows.english: Furthermore, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his own generosity: ‘It is a gain for me, indeed, it is well-gained by me, that among a generation assailed by the stain of stinginess, I dwell at home with a mind free from the stain of stinginess, freely generous, open-handed, delighting in relinquishment, fit to be asked, delighting in giving and sharing.’ When, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his generosity, at that time his mind is not assailed by lust, not assailed by hatred, and not assailed by delusion. At that time his mind becomes upright, taking generosity as its object. With an upright mind, Mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the Dhamma, gains joy connected with the Dhamma. When he is joyful, rapture arises; for one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil; one tranquil in body feels pleasure; the mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This, Mahānāma, is called: ‘a noble disciple who dwells evenly among an uneven generation, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted generation, who has entered the stream of the Dhamma and develops the recollection of generosity.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati – ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti. Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti; ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti saṅghaṃ ārabbha. Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno saṅghānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，摩诃男，圣弟子随念僧：‘世尊的弟子僧团是善行道者，世尊的弟子僧团是正直行道者，世尊的弟子僧团是如理行道者，世尊的弟子僧团是和敬行道者，即四双八辈个人；这世尊的弟子僧团是应受献礼者，应受款待者，应受供养者，应受合掌者，是世间无上的福田。’摩诃男，当圣弟子随念僧时，那时他的心不被贪欲所困扰，不被瞋恚所困扰，不被愚痴所困扰；那时，他的心缘于僧而正直。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子获得义的喜悦，获得法的喜悦，获得与法相应的欢悦。欢悦者生起喜；有喜心者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。摩诃男，这被称为：‘圣弟子在走上邪道的众生中住于正道，在有瞋恼的众生中住于无瞋恼，入于法流，修习僧随念。’”
rows.english: “Furthermore, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects the Saṅgha: ‘The Saṅgha of the Blessed One’s disciples is practicing the good way; practicing the straight way; practicing the methodical way; practicing the proper way; that is, the four pairs of persons, the eight individuals—this Saṅgha of the Blessed One’s disciples is worthy of gifts, worthy of hospitality, worthy of offerings, worthy of reverential salutation, the unsurpassed field of merit for the world.’ At such a time, Mahānāma, the noble disciple’s mind is not overcome by lust, not overcome by hatred, not overcome by delusion. His mind is upright, based on the Saṅgha. With an upright mind, Mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the Dhamma, gains joy connected with the Dhamma. When he is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One tranquil in body feels pleasure. The mind of one who is pleased becomes concentrated. This, Mahānāma, is called ‘a noble disciple who dwells peacefully among a turbulent populace, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted populace, who has entered the stream of the Dhamma and develops the recollection of the Saṅgha.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yo so, mahānāma, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharati. a. ni. 11.11 Idha, mahānāma, ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti. Yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti; ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha. Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘摩诃男，那已证得果位、了知教法的圣弟子，多以此安住而住。摩诃男，于此，圣弟子随念如来：‘即：彼世尊是阿罗汉、正等正觉、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士调御丈夫、天人师、佛、世尊。’摩诃男，当圣弟子随念如来时，彼时其心不为贪欲所缠，不为瞋恚所缠，不为愚痴所缠；彼时其心缘于如来而正直。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子，获得义之喜悦，获得法之喜悦，获得与法相应的欣悦。欣悦者生喜，意喜者身轻安，身轻安者感受乐，有乐者心入定。摩诃男，此即是说：‘圣弟子于动荡的众生中，住于寂静；于有恼害的众生中，住于无恼害；入于法流，修习佛随念。’
rows.english: “Mahānāma, a noble disciple who has attained the fruit and understood the teaching usually abides by this dwelling. Here, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects the Tathāgata thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is an Arahant, perfectly enlightened, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, the Well-Gone, knower of the world, unexcelled trainer of persons to be tamed, teacher of devas and humans, the Enlightened One, the Blessed One.’ At such a time, Mahānāma, the noble disciple’s mind is not overcome by lust, not overcome by hatred, not overcome by delusion. His mind is upright, based on the Tathāgata. With an upright mind, Mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the Dhamma, gains joy connected with the Dhamma. When he is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One tranquil in body feels pleasure. The mind of one who is pleased becomes concentrated. This, Mahānāma, is called ‘a noble disciple who dwells peacefully among a turbulent populace, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted populace, who has entered the stream of the Dhamma and develops the recollection of the Buddha.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako devatānussatiṃ bhāveti – ‘santi devā cātumahārājikā cātummahārājikā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) , santi devā tāvatiṃsā, santi devā yāmā, santi devā tusitā, santi devā nimmānaratino, santi devā paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttari tatuttariṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), taduttari (ka.) a. ni. 6.25; visuddhi. 1.162 passitabbaṃ . Yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā tattha uppannā (sī.), tatthūpapannā (syā. kaṃ.), tatthupapannā (a. ni. 3.71) , mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati. Yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati. Yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati. Yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati. Yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī’ti. Yasmiṃ , mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti; ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tā devatā ārabbha. Ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ. Pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma – ‘ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati , sabyāpajjāya sabyāpajjhāya… abyāpajjho (ka.) pajāya abyāpajjo sabyāpajjhāya… abyāpajjho (ka.) viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno devatānussatiṃ bhāveti’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，摩诃男，圣弟子修习天随念：‘有四大王天(Cātumahārājikā)，有三十三天(Tāvatiṃsā)，有夜摩天(Yāmā)，有兜率天(Tusitā)，有化乐天(Nimmānaratino)，有他化自在天(Paranimmitavasavattino)，有梵身天(Brahmakāyikā)，以及更上之诸天。那些天神具备怎样的信，从此处死后，投生于彼处，我也具备那样的信；那些天神具备怎样的戒，从此处死后，投生于彼处，我也具备那样的戒；那些天神具备怎样的闻，从此处死后，投生于彼处，我也具备那样的闻；那些天神具备怎样的舍，从此处死后，投生于彼处，我也具备那样的舍；那些天神具备怎样的慧，从此处死后，投生于彼处，我也具备那样的慧。’摩诃男，当圣弟子随念自己与那些天神的信、戒、闻、舍、慧时，其心不为贪所困扰，不为瞋所困扰，不为痴所困扰；那时，他那缘于诸天的心是正直的。摩诃男，心正直的圣弟子获得义之悦，获得法之悦，获得与法相应的喜悦。喜悦者生起喜；有喜心者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。摩诃男，这被称为：‘圣弟子于乖僻的众生中住于正直，于有瞋害的众生中住于无瞋害，入于法流，修习天随念。’
rows.english: Furthermore, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects the deities: ‘There are the deities of the Four Great Kings, there are the Tāvatiṃsa deities, there are the Yāma deities, there are the Tusita deities, there are the Nimmānaratī deities, there are the Paranimmitavasavattī deities, there are the deities of Brahmā’s retinue, and there are deities beyond them. With whatever kind of faith those deities were endowed, because of which they passed away from here and were reborn there—such faith is present in me as well. With whatever kind of virtue those deities were endowed, because of which they passed away from here and were reborn there—such virtue is present in me as well. With whatever kind of learning those deities were endowed, because of which they passed away from here and were reborn there—such learning is present in me as well. With whatever kind of generosity those deities were endowed, because of which they passed away from here and were reborn there—such generosity is present in me as well. With whatever kind of wisdom those deities were endowed, because of which they passed away from here and were reborn there—such wisdom is present in me as well.’ When, Mahānāma, a noble disciple recollects his own and those deities’ faith, virtue, learning, generosity, and wisdom, at that time his mind is not assailed by lust, not assailed by hatred, and not assailed by delusion. At that time his mind becomes upright, taking those deities as its object. With an upright mind, Mahānāma, the noble disciple gains inspiration in the meaning, gains inspiration in the Dhamma, gains joy connected with the Dhamma. When he is joyful, rapture arises; for one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil; one tranquil in body feels pleasure; the mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This, Mahānāma, is called: ‘a noble disciple who dwells evenly among an uneven generation, who dwells without affliction among an afflicted generation, who has entered the stream of the Dhamma and develops the recollection of the deities.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, ānāpānassati evaṃ bahulīkatā cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūreti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，如是修习、如是多作的入出息念，确实能圆满四念处。
rows.english: Monks, mindfulness of breathing thus developed and cultivated fulfills the four foundations of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā, pītisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, pītisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 已发起精进者，生起无染之喜。诸比丘，于何时，已发起精进的比丘生起无染之喜，于彼时，比丘的喜觉支(pītisambojjhaṅga)已被发起；于彼时，比丘修习喜觉支；于彼时，比丘的喜觉支到达修习圆满。
rows.english: For one with aroused energy, unworldly rapture arises. When, monks, unworldly rapture arises for a monk with aroused energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture is initiated for him. At that time, the monk develops the enlightenment factor of rapture, and for him the enlightenment factor of rapture goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pītimanassa kāyopi passambhati, cittampi passambhati. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pītimanassa kāyopi passambhati, cittampi passambhati, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 心怀喜悦者，身亦轻安，心亦轻安。诸比丘，于何时，心怀喜悦的比丘身亦轻安、心亦轻安，于彼时，比丘的轻安觉支(passaddhisambojjhaṅga)已被发起；于彼时，比丘修习轻安觉支；于彼时，比丘的轻安觉支到达修习圆满。
rows.english: For one with a joyful mind, the body becomes tranquil and the mind becomes tranquil. Bhikkhus, at the time when, for a bhikkhu with a joyful mind, the body becomes tranquil and the mind becomes tranquil, at that time the tranquility factor of enlightenment is initiated for that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the tranquility factor of enlightenment. At that time, for that bhikkhu, the tranquility factor of enlightenment goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, samādhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, samādhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “身轻安而有乐者，心便得定。诸比丘，当比丘身轻安而有乐，心便得定之时，彼时，比丘的定觉支(samādhisambojjhaṅga)即已发起；彼时，比丘修习定觉支；彼时，比丘的定觉支即达到修习圆满。”
rows.english: For one with a tranquil body who is happy, the mind becomes concentrated. Bhikkhus, at the time when the mind of a bhikkhu with a tranquil body who is happy becomes concentrated, at that time the concentration factor of enlightenment is initiated for that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the concentration factor of enlightenment. At that time, for that bhikkhu, the concentration factor of enlightenment goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicayato parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicayato parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 当他以智慧探查、审察、审思彼法时，不退缩的精进已被发起。诸比丘，于何时，比丘以智慧探查、审察、审思彼法，不退缩的精进已被发起，于彼时，比丘的精进觉支(vīriyasambojjhaṅga)已被发起；于彼时，比丘修习精进觉支；于彼时，比丘的精进觉支到达修习圆满。
rows.english: For one who investigates, examines, and engages in thorough scrutiny of that phenomenon with wisdom, unflagging energy is aroused. When, monks, unflagging energy is aroused in a monk who investigates, examines, and engages in thorough scrutiny of that phenomenon with wisdom, the enlightenment factor of energy is initiated for him. At that time, the monk develops the enlightenment factor of energy, and for him the enlightenment factor of energy goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: ‘‘So tathāsato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicayati parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjati. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathāsato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicayati parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjati, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “他如是具念而住，以慧简择、详察、审度彼法。诸比丘，当比丘如是具念而住，以慧简择、详察、审度彼法之时，彼时，比丘的择法觉支(dhammavicayasambojjhaṅga)即已发起；彼时，比丘修习择法觉支；彼时，比丘的择法觉支即达到修习圆满。”
rows.english: Dwelling thus mindful, he investigates that dhamma with wisdom, scrutinizes it, and undertakes a full inquiry. Bhikkhus, at the time when a bhikkhu, dwelling thus mindful, investigates that dhamma with wisdom, scrutinizes it, and undertakes a full inquiry, at that time the investigation-of-dharmas factor of enlightenment is initiated for that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the investigation-of-dharmas factor of enlightenment. At that time, for that bhikkhu, the investigation-of-dharmas factor of enlightenment goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: ‘‘So tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “他于那如是等持之心善加舍观。诸比丘，当比丘于那如是等持之心善加舍观时，彼时，比丘的舍觉支(upekkhāsambojjhaṅga)即已发起；彼时，比丘修习舍觉支；彼时，比丘的舍觉支即达到修习圆满。”
rows.english: He becomes one who regards well with equanimity the mind thus concentrated. Bhikkhus, at the time when a bhikkhu becomes one who regards well with equanimity the mind thus concentrated, at that time the equanimity factor of enlightenment is initiated for that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the equanimity factor of enlightenment. At that time, for that bhikkhu, the equanimity factor of enlightenment goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说此语已。彼诸比丘心怀悦豫，欢喜领受世尊所说。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Delighted, those bhikkhus rejoiced in the Blessed One’s speech.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “学：‘我将觉知喜而出息’；学：‘我将觉知喜而入息’。学：‘我将觉知乐而出息’；学：‘我将觉知乐而入息’。学：‘我将觉知心行而出息’；学：‘我将觉知心行而入息’。学：‘我将平静心行而出息’；学：‘我将平静心行而入息’。”
rows.english: He trains thus: ‘Experiencing rapture, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing rapture, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing pleasure, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing pleasure, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mental formation, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mental formation, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Calming the mental formation, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Calming the mental formation, I will breathe in.’

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati ; ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “学：‘我将觉知心而出息’；学：‘我将觉知心而入息’。学：‘我将令心喜悦而出息’；学：‘我将令心喜悦而入息’。学：‘我将令心入定而出息’；学：‘我将令心入定而入息’。学：‘我将令心解脱而出息’；学：‘我将令心解脱而入息’。”
rows.english: He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mind, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Gladdening the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Gladdening the mind, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Concentrating the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Concentrating the mind, I will breathe in.’ He trains thus: ‘Liberating the mind, I will breathe out.’ He trains thus: ‘Liberating the mind, I will breathe in.’

rows.pali: 144 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde sambahulehi abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ – āyasmatā ca sāriputtena āyasmatā ca mahāmoggallānena mahāmoggalānena (ka.) āyasmatā ca mahākassapena āyasmatā ca mahākaccāyanena āyasmatā ca mahākoṭṭhikena āyasmatā ca mahākappinena āyasmatā ca mahācundena āyasmatā ca anuruddhena āyasmatā ca revatena āyasmatā ca ānandena, aññehi ca abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 144. 如是我闻：一时，世尊住在舍卫城(Sāvatthī)东园鹿母讲堂，与众多声名卓著的长老声闻共住，即具寿舍利弗、具寿大目犍连、具寿大迦叶、具寿摩诃迦旃延、具寿大拘𫄨罗、具寿摩诃劫宾那、具寿大纯陀、具寿阿那律、具寿瑞瓦达、具寿阿难，以及其他声名卓著的长老声闻。
rows.english: 144. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One was dwelling in Sāvatthī, at the Eastern Park, in the mansion of Migāra’s mother, together with many very distinguished elder disciples—with the Venerable Sāriputta, the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna, the Venerable Mahākassapa, the Venerable Mahākaccāyana, the Venerable Mahākoṭṭhika, the Venerable Mahākappina, the Venerable Mahācunda, the Venerable Anuruddha, the Venerable Revata, and the Venerable Ānanda, and with other very distinguished elder disciples.

rows.pali: 151 . ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vedanāsu…pe… citte… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ, upaṭṭhitāssa tasmiṃ samaye sati hoti asammuṭṭhā. Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno upaṭṭhitā sati hoti asammuṭṭhā, satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, satisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 151. “诸比丘，当比丘于诸受……于心……于诸法随观法而住，热勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧时，彼时，他的念已安住而无忘失。诸比丘，当比丘的念已安住而无忘失时，彼时，比丘的念觉支(satisambojjhaṅga)即已发起；彼时，比丘修习念觉支；彼时，比丘的念觉支即达到修习圆满。”
rows.english: 151. Bhikkhus, at the time when a bhikkhu dwells contemplating feelings in feelings... mind in mind... phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in the world, at that time his mindfulness is established and unconfused. Bhikkhus, at the time when a bhikkhu's mindfulness is established and unconfused, the mindfulness factor of enlightenment is initiated for that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the mindfulness factor of enlightenment. At that time, for that bhikkhu, the mindfulness factor of enlightenment goes to fulfillment by development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘samādahaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; citte cittānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānassatiṃ vadāmi. Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, citte cittānupassī tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，当一位比丘学：‘我将觉知心而出息’，学：‘我将觉知心而入息’；学：‘我将令心喜悦而出息’，学：‘我将令心喜悦而入息’；学：‘我将令心专注而出息’，学：‘我将令心专注而入息’；学：‘我将令心解脱而出息’，学：‘我将令心解脱而入息’时，诸比丘，那时，比丘于心随观心而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。诸比丘，我不为失念、不正知者说入出息念。是故，诸比丘，那时，比丘于心随观心而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。
rows.english: When, monks, a monk trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mind, I will breathe out,’ he trains thus: ‘Experiencing the mind, I will breathe in’; he trains thus: ‘Gladdening the mind, I will breathe out,’ he trains thus: ‘Gladdening the mind, I will breathe in’; he trains thus: ‘Concentrating the mind, I will breathe out,’ he trains thus: ‘Concentrating the mind, I will breathe in’; he trains thus: ‘Liberating the mind, I will breathe out,’ he trains thus: ‘Liberating the mind, I will breathe in’; at that time, monks, a monk dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure for the world. I do not say, monks, that mindfulness of breathing is for one with lapsed mindfulness and without clear comprehension.
