Sampasāde sati etarahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā. Ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āneñjūpagaṃ. Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyā āneñjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，诸比丘，圣弟子如是审思：‘凡是现法之欲、后世之欲；凡是现法之欲想、后世之欲想；凡是现法之色、后世之色；凡是现法之色想、后世之色想——此二者皆是无常。凡无常者，不应欢喜，不应称赞，不应执取。’对于如是行道、多安住于舍离此等想之行的他而言，其心于此所缘而澄净。心澄净时，或于现时证入不动，或以慧得解脱。身坏命终之后，其转生之识，有可能趣向不动。诸比丘，此被称为第三适合不动之行道。
rows.english: Furthermore, monks, a noble disciple reflects thus: ‘Whatever sensual pleasures are of the present life, and whatever sensual pleasures are of a future life; whatever perceptions of sensual pleasure are of the present life, and whatever perceptions of sensual pleasure are of a future life; whatever forms are of the present life, and whatever forms are of a future life; whatever perceptions of form are of the present life, and whatever perceptions of form are of a future life—both these are impermanent. What is impermanent is not fit to be delighted in, not fit to be welcomed, not fit to be clung to.’ For one who practices thus, who dwells frequently in this, the mind becomes serene in that base. When there is serenity, he either attains the imperturbable now, or is liberated by wisdom. After the breaking up of the body, after death, it is possible that the consciousness leading to rebirth would be one that has reached the imperturbable. This, monks, is declared as the third practice suitable for the imperturbable.

rows.pali: 66 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo. Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘bhikkhavo’’ti. ‘‘Bhadante’’ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etadavoca – ‘‘aniccā, bhikkhave, kāmā tucchā musā mosadhammā. Māyākatame taṃ, bhikkhave, bālalāpanaṃ. Ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā, ye ca samparāyikā kāmā; yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā – ubhayametaṃ māradheyyaṃ, mārassesa mārasseva (ka.) visayo, mārassesa nivāpo, mārassesa gocaro. Etthete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhāpi byāpādāpi sārambhāpi saṃvattanti. Teva ariyasāvakassa idhamanusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti. Tatra, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā, ye ca samparāyikā kāmā; yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā – ubhayametaṃ māradheyyaṃ, mārassesa visayo, mārassesa nivāpo, mārassesa gocaro. Etthete pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhāpi byāpādāpi sārambhāpi saṃvattanti, teva ariyasāvakassa idhamanusikkhato antarāyāya sambhavanti. Yaṃnūnāhaṃ vipulena mahaggatena cetasā vihareyyaṃ abhibhuyya lokaṃ adhiṭṭhāya manasā. Vipulena hi me mahaggatena cetasā viharato abhibhuyya lokaṃ adhiṭṭhāya manasā ye pāpakā akusalā mānasā abhijjhāpi byāpādāpi sārambhāpi te na bhavissanti. Tesaṃ pahānā aparittañca me cittaṃ bhavissati appamāṇaṃ subhāvita’nti. Tassa evaṃpaṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati. Sampasāde sati etarahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā. Ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āneñjūpagaṃ. Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā āneñjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 66. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住在俱卢国(Kurū)，一个名叫剑磨瑟昙(Kammāsadhamma)的俱卢人市镇。在那里，世尊对诸比丘说：“诸比丘！”“尊者！”那些比丘回答世尊。世尊这样说道：“诸比丘，诸欲是无常、空、虚妄、坏灭法。诸比丘，此乃幻术所为，是愚人之妄言。无论是现世的欲，还是来世的欲；无论是现世的欲想，还是来世的欲想——此二者皆是魔罗所属，是魔罗的境界，是魔罗的饵食，是魔罗的牧场。于此，诸恶、不善的意念：贪欲、瞋恚与争执得以生起。此等对于在此修学的圣弟子，会成为障碍。诸比丘，于此，圣弟子如此省察：‘无论是现世的欲，还是来世的欲；无论是现世的欲想，还是来世的欲想——此二者皆是魔罗所属，是魔罗的境界，是魔罗的饵食，是魔罗的牧场。于此，诸恶、不善的意念：贪欲、瞋恚与争执得以生起，此等对于在此修学的圣弟子，会成为障碍。我何不以广大、已达崇高之心，征服世间，以心确立而住？当我以广大、已达崇高之心，征服世间，以心确立而住时，那些恶、不善的意念：贪欲、瞋恚与争执，将不复存在。因舍断彼等，我的心将变得广大、无量、善修习。’对于如此行道、多安住于此者，其心于此基处得以澄净。心澄净时，或于当下证入不动，或以慧而胜解。身坏命终之后，有此可能：其导向彼处之识将趋于不动。诸比丘，这被称为第一不动适宜行道。”
rows.english: 66. Thus have I heard. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Kurus, at a town of the Kurus named Kammāsadhamma. There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus: “Bhikkhus!” “Venerable sir,” those bhikkhus replied. The Blessed One said this: “Bhikkhus, sensual pleasures are impermanent, hollow, false, and of a deceptive nature. They are a magic trick, bhikkhus, the babbling of fools. Both the sensual pleasures in this present life and the sensual pleasures in a future life, and both the perception of sensual pleasures in this present life and the perception of sensual pleasures in a future life—both of these are Māra’s realm, Māra’s domain, Māra’s fodder, Māra’s pasture. Herein arise these evil, unwholesome mental states: covetousness, ill will, and rivalry. These become an obstacle for a noble disciple training herein. There, bhikkhus, a noble disciple reflects thus: ‘Both the sensual pleasures in this present life and the sensual pleasures in a future life, and both the perception of sensual pleasures in this present life and the perception of sensual pleasures in a future life—both of these are Māra’s realm, Māra’s domain, Māra’s fodder, Māra’s pasture. Herein arise these evil, unwholesome mental states: covetousness, ill will, and rivalry. These become an obstacle for a noble disciple training herein. What if I were to dwell having overcome the world with a vast, exalted mind, with my mind well-established? For one dwelling with a vast, exalted mind, having overcome the world with the mind well-established, those evil, unwholesome mental states—covetousness, ill will, and rivalry—will not exist. Through their abandoning, my mind will become unlimited, immeasurable, and well-developed.’ For one who has undertaken this practice and dwells frequently in it, the mind becomes serene in that sphere. When there is serenity, he either attains the imperturbable now, or he is resolved upon it by wisdom. With the breakup of the body, after death, it is possible that the consciousness conducive to that state will go to the imperturbable. This, bhikkhus, is said to be the first practice conducive to the imperturbable.”

rows.pali: 336 . ‘‘‘Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ, ākāsānañcāyatana’nti vuccati. Katamaṃ nu kho ākāsānañcāyatananti ? Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, etadahosi – ‘idha bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Idaṃ vuccati ākāsānañcāyatana’nti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato rūpasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 336. “‘空无边处，空无边处’，如是说。那么，什么是空无边处呢？贤友，我生起此念：‘在此，比丘完全超越一切色想，因有对想的灭没，不作意种种想，思惟“虚空无边”，而证入并安住于空无边处。此即称为空无边处。’贤友，我确实完全超越一切色想，因有对想的灭没，不作意种种想，思惟‘虚空无边’，而证入并安住于空无边处。贤友，当我安住于此住处时，与色相应的想和作意不断现行。”
rows.english: 336. “‘The sphere of infinite space, the sphere of infinite space,’ it is said. What, then, is the sphere of infinite space? Then, friends, this thought occurred to me: ‘Here, a bhikkhu, with the complete transcending of perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of sensory impingement, and not attending to perceptions of diversity, (thinking) “Space is infinite,” enters and abides in the sphere of infinite space. This is called the sphere of infinite space.’ And so, friends, with the complete transcending of perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of sensory impingement, and not attending to perceptions of diversity, (thinking) ‘Space is infinite,’ I enter and abide in the sphere of infinite space. Friends, as I was dwelling in this abiding, perceptions and acts of attention accompanied by form assailed me.

rows.pali: ‘‘Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca – ‘moggallāna, moggallāna! Mā, brāhmaṇa, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ pamādo, ākāsānañcāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, ākāsānañcāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, ākāsānañcāyatane cittaṃ samādahā’ti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya…pe… mahābhiññataṃ patto’’ti. Pañcamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那时，世尊以神通来到我这里，对我说：‘目犍连，目犍连！婆罗门啊，莫于空无边处放逸，于空无边处安立心，于空无边处令心一境，于空无边处令心入定。’贤友，后来我完全超越色想，有对想灭尽，不作意种种想，思惟‘虚空无边’，证入并安住于空无边处。贤友，若有人正确地说……他已达到大神通。”第五。
rows.english: “Then, friends, the Blessed One approached me by his psychic power and said: ‘Moggallāna, Moggallāna! Brahmin, do not be negligent regarding the sphere of infinite space. Settle your mind in the sphere of infinite space, make your mind one-pointed in the sphere of infinite space, concentrate your mind in the sphere of infinite space.’ And so, friends, at a later time, with the complete transcending of perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of sensory impingement, and not attending to perceptions of diversity, (thinking) ‘Space is infinite,’ I entered and abided in the sphere of infinite space. Friends, if anyone, speaking rightly, were to say of someone that he has attained the state of great direct knowledge, it is of me that he would rightly speak.” The fifth.

rows.pali: 337 . ‘‘‘Viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ, viññāṇañcāyatana’nti vuccati. Katamaṃ nu kho viññāṇañcāyatananti? Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, etadahosi – ‘idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Idaṃ vuccati viññāṇañcāyatana’nti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi . Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākāsānañcāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 337. “‘识无边处，识无边处’，如是说。那么，什么是识无边处呢？贤友，我曾作是念：‘在此，比丘完全超越空无边处，思惟“识无边”，证入并安住于识无边处。这被称为识无边处。’贤友，我确实完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识无边’，证入并安住于识无边处。贤友，我如是住时，与空无边处相应的想与作意生起。”
rows.english: 337. “‘The sphere of infinite consciousness, the sphere of infinite consciousness,’ it is said. What, then, is the sphere of infinite consciousness? Then, friends, this thought occurred to me: ‘Here, a bhikkhu, having entirely transcended the sphere of infinite space, (perceiving) “Consciousness is infinite,” enters and abides in the sphere of infinite consciousness. This is called the sphere of infinite consciousness.’ And so, friends, having entirely transcended the sphere of infinite space, (perceiving) ‘Consciousness is infinite,’ I enter and abide in the sphere of infinite consciousness. Friends, as I was dwelling in this abiding, perceptions and acts of attention associated with the sphere of infinite space assailed me.

rows.pali: ‘‘Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca – ‘moggallāna, moggallāna! Mā, brāhmaṇa, viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ pamādo, viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ samādahā’ti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya…pe… mahābhiññataṃ patto’’ti. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那时，世尊以神通来到我处，对我说：‘目犍连，目犍连！婆罗门啊，莫于识无边处放逸，于识无边处安立心，于识无边处令心一境，于识无边处令心入定。’贤友，后来，我完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识无边’，证入并安住于识无边处。贤友，若有人正说……他已证得大神通。”第六。
rows.english: “Then, friends, the Blessed One approached me by his psychic power and said: ‘Moggallāna, Moggallāna! Brahmin, do not be negligent regarding the sphere of infinite consciousness. Settle your mind in the sphere of infinite consciousness, make your mind one-pointed in the sphere of infinite consciousness, concentrate your mind in the sphere of infinite consciousness.’ And so, friends, at a later time, having entirely transcended the sphere of infinite space, (perceiving) ‘Consciousness is infinite,’ I entered and abided in the sphere of infinite consciousness. Friends, if anyone, speaking rightly, were to say of someone that he has attained the state of great direct knowledge, it is of me that he would rightly speak.” Sixth.

rows.pali: 338 . ‘‘‘Ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ, ākiñcaññāyatana’nti vuccati. Katamaṃ nu kho ākiñcaññāyatananti? Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, etadahosi – ‘idha bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Idaṃ vuccati ākiñcaññāyatana’nti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato viññāṇañcāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 338. “‘无所有处，无所有处’，如是说。究竟什么是无所有处呢？贤友，我曾作是念：‘在此，比丘完全超越识无边处，作意“无有少许”，具足无所有处而住。这被称为无所有处。’贤友，我确实完全超越识无边处，作意“无有少许”，具足无所有处而住。贤友，我以此住而住时，与识无边处相应的想与作意持续生起。”
rows.english: 338. “‘The base of nothingness, the base of nothingness,’ it is said. What, then, is the base of nothingness? Then, friends, this thought occurred to me: ‘Here, a bhikkhu, having completely transcended the base of infinite consciousness, (thinking) “There is nothing,” enters and abides in the base of nothingness. This is called the base of nothingness.’ And so, friends, having completely transcended the base of infinite consciousness, (thinking) ‘There is nothing,’ I enter and abide in the base of nothingness. Friends, as I was dwelling in this abiding, perceptions and acts of attention associated with the base of infinite consciousness assailed me.

rows.pali: ‘‘Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca – ‘moggallāna, moggallāna! Mā, brāhmaṇa, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pamādo, ākiñcaññāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, ākiñcaññāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, ākiñcaññāyatane cittaṃ samādahā’ti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya…pe… mahābhiññataṃ patto’’ti. Sattamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那时，世尊以神通来到我处，如是说：‘目犍连，目犍连！婆罗门，莫于无所有处放逸，于无所有处安立其心，于无所有处令心一趣，于无所有处善安立心。’贤友，后来，我完全超越识无边处，作意“无有少许”，具足无所有处而住了。贤友，若有善说者应如是说……已达大神通。”第七。
rows.english: “Then, friends, the Blessed One approached me by psychic power and said this: ‘Moggallāna, Moggallāna! Brahmin, do not be heedless regarding the base of nothingness. Establish your mind in the base of nothingness, make your mind one-pointed in the base of nothingness, concentrate your mind in the base of nothingness.’ So, friends, at a later time, having completely transcended the base of infinite consciousness, thinking ‘There is nothing,’ I entered and abided in the base of nothingness. Friends, if one speaking rightly were to say… and so on… ‘he has attained great direct knowledge,’ it is of me that they would be speaking.” Seventh.

rows.pali: 339 . ‘‘‘Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ, nevasaññānāsaññāyatana’nti vuccati. Katamaṃ nu kho nevasaññānāsaññāyatananti? Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, etadahosi – ‘idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Idaṃ vuccati nevasaññānāsaññāyatana’nti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 339. “‘非想非非想处，非想非非想处’，如是说。究竟什么是非想非非想处呢？贤友，我曾作是念：‘在此，比丘完全超越无所有处，具足非想非非想处而住。这被称为非想非非想处。’贤友，我确实完全超越无所有处，具足非想非非想处而住。贤友，我以此住而住时，与无所有处相应的想与作意持续生起。”
rows.english: 339. “‘The base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception’—so it is said. What, friends, is the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception? Then, friends, this thought occurred to me: ‘Here, a monk, having completely transcended the base of nothingness, enters and abides in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. This is called the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception.’ So, friends, having completely transcended the base of nothingness, I enter and abide in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. To me, friends, while abiding in this abiding, perceptions and attentions associated with the base of nothingness arise.

rows.pali: ‘‘Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca – ‘moggallāna, moggallāna! Mā, brāhmaṇa, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pamādo, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ samādahā’ti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya…pe… mahābhiññataṃ patto’’ti. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那时，世尊以神通来到我处，对我说了这番话：‘目犍连，目犍连！梵志，莫对非想非非想处放逸，当于非想非非想处安立其心，当于非想非非想处令心专一，当于非想非非想处善安住心。’贤友，后来，我完全超越无所有处，到达非想非非想处而住。贤友，若有谁当正说……乃至……‘已达大神通。’”第八。
rows.english: “Then, friends, the Blessed One approached me by psychic power and said this: ‘Moggallāna, Moggallāna! Brahmin, do not be heedless regarding the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. Establish your mind in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, make your mind one-pointed in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, concentrate your mind in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception.’ So, friends, at a later time, having completely transcended the base of nothingness, I entered and abided in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. Friends, if one speaking rightly were to say… and so on… ‘he has attained great direct knowledge,’ it is of me that they would be speaking.” Eighth.

rows.pali: 340 . ‘‘‘Animitto cetosamādhi, animitto cetosamādhī’ti vuccati. Katamo nu kho animitto cetosamādhīti? Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, etadahosi – ‘idha bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccati animitto cetosamādhī’ti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharāmi. Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 340. “‘无相心定，无相心定’，有此一说。那么，什么是无相心定呢？贤友，我曾这样想：‘在此，比丘因不作意一切相，到达无相心定而住。这被称为无相心定。’贤友，我确实因不作意一切相，到达无相心定而住。贤友，当我以此状态安住时，生起了随相而行的识。”
rows.english: 340. “‘The signless concentration of mind, the signless concentration of mind’—so it is said. What, friends, is the signless concentration of mind? To me, friends, this thought occurred: ‘Here, a monk, by not attending to all signs, enters and abides in the signless concentration of mind. This is called the signless concentration of mind.’ So I, friends, by not attending to all signs, enter and abide in the signless concentration of mind. For me, friends, while abiding in this state, consciousness that follows after signs arises.

rows.pali: ‘‘Atha kho maṃ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca – ‘moggallāna, moggallāna! Mā, brāhmaṇa, animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ pamādo, animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ samādahā’ti. So khvāhaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. Yañhi taṃ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya – ‘satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ patto’ti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya – ‘satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ patto’’’ti. Navamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那时，世尊以神通来到我处，对我说了这番话：‘目犍连，目犍连！梵志，莫对无相心定放逸，当于无相心定安立其心，当于无相心定令心专一，当于无相心定善安住心。’贤友，后来，我因不作意一切相，到达无相心定而住。贤友，若有谁当正说：‘为导师所摄受的弟子已达大神通’，他正说的就是我：‘为导师所摄受的弟子已达大神通。’”第九。
rows.english: “Then, friends, the Blessed One approached me by means of psychic power and said this: ‘Moggallāna, Moggallāna! Brahmin, be not negligent regarding the signless concentration of mind. In the signless concentration of mind, establish your mind; in the signless concentration of mind, make your mind one-pointed; in the signless concentration of mind, concentrate your mind.’ So I, friends, at a later time, by not attending to all signs, entered and abided in the signless concentration of mind. Friends, if one were to speak rightly, one would say: ‘A disciple supported by the Teacher has attained to great direct knowledge.’ Speaking rightly, one would say this of me: ‘A disciple supported by the Teacher has attained to great direct knowledge.’” The ninth.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Nappajānāti nappajānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā duppaññoti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘贤友，因其“不了知，不了知”，故说为“劣慧”。’
rows.english: “Friend, because ‘one does not discern, one does not discern,’ for that reason one is called ‘one of little wisdom.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Sādhāvuso’ti kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi –
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘善哉，贤友！’具寿摩诃拘𫄨罗(Mahākoṭṭhika)对具寿舍利弗所说感到欢喜、随喜，又进一步问具寿舍利弗：
rows.english: “Good, friend.” The Venerable Mahākoṭṭhika, having delighted in and rejoiced at the words of the Venerable Sāriputta, asked the Venerable Sāriputta a further question:

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Pajānāti pajānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā paññavāti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，因为‘了知，了知’，因此被称为‘有慧者’。”
rows.english: “Friend, because ‘one discerns, one discerns,’ for that reason one is called ‘a wise person.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Vijānāti vijānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇanti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，因为‘识别，识别’，因此被称为‘识’。”
rows.english: “Friend, because ‘it cognizes, it cognizes,’ for that reason it is called ‘consciousness.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Vedeti vedetī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā vedanāti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，因为‘感受，感受’，因此被称为‘受’。”
rows.english: “Friend, because ‘it feels, it feels,’ for that reason it is called ‘feeling.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Sañjānāti sañjānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā saññāti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，因为‘认知，认知’，因此被称为‘想’。”
rows.english: “Friend, because ‘it perceives, it perceives,’ for that reason it is called ‘perception.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Neyyaṃ panāvuso, dhammaṃ kena pajānātī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，又以何法了知所应知之法呢？”
rows.english: ‘But, friend, by what does one discern the phenomenon that is to be known?’

rows.pali: ‘‘Neyyaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ paññācakkhunā pajānātī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，以智慧之眼了知所应知之法。”
rows.english: ‘Friend, one discerns the phenomenon that is to be known with the eye of wisdom.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Paññā panāvuso, kimatthiyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，智慧是为了什么呢？”
rows.english: ‘But, friend, for what purpose is wisdom?’

rows.pali: ‘‘Paññā kho, āvuso, abhiññatthā pariññatthā pahānatthā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，智慧是为了证知、遍知与舍断。”
rows.english: ‘Wisdom, friend, is for direct knowledge, for full understanding, and for abandoning.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Katihi panāvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā cā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，由几支所资助的正见，是有心解脱果与心解脱效益，以及慧解脱果与慧解脱效益的呢？”
rows.english: “But, friend, supported by how many factors does right view have liberation of mind as its fruit and benefit, and liberation by wisdom as its fruit and benefit?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ panāvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hotī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，在未来，如何有再有之生起呢？”
rows.english: “But how, friend, does the production of renewed existence in the future come to be?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ panāvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti na hotī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，在未来，如何不有再有之生起呢？”
rows.english: “But, friend, how is it that the production of renewed existence in the future does not come to be?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Āyu panāvuso, kiṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，寿又依何而住？”
rows.english: “But upon what, friend, does vitality depend?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Āyu usmaṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “寿依暖而住。”
rows.english: “Vitality depends on heat.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Usmā panāvuso, kiṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，暖又依何而住？”
rows.english: “But upon what, friend, does heat depend?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Usmā āyuṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “暖依寿而住。”
rows.english: “Heat depends on vitality.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yathā kathaṃ panāvuso, imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabbo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，此话之义当如何理解？”
rows.english: “But how, friend, is the meaning of this statement to be understood?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kati panāvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，又有多少因缘能证入无相心解脱呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, how many conditions are there for the attainment of the signless liberation of mind?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kati panāvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，又有多少因缘能使无相心解脱安住呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, how many conditions are there for the stability of the signless liberation of mind?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kati panāvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，又有多少因缘能从无相心解脱出定呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, how many conditions are there for emerging from the signless liberation of mind?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo cāvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānātthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca’’?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，是怎样的理路，依此理路，这些法义理与文句各异呢？”
rows.english: “And what, friend, is the way according to which these phenomena are different in meaning and different in phrasing?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti’’?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，什么是无所有处心解脱呢？”
rows.english: “And what, friend, is the liberation of mind of nothingness?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, suññatā cetovimutti’’?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，什么是空心解脱呢？”
rows.english: “And what, friend, is the emptiness liberation of mind?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, animittā cetovimutti’’?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，什么是无相心解脱呢？”
rows.english: “And what, friend, is the signless liberation of mind?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo cāvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nānaṃ’’?
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，然则，是何理趣，依此理趣，此等诸法义同而文异呢？
rows.english: “And what, friend, is the way according to which these phenomena are one in meaning, with only the phrasing being different?”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Duppañño duppañño’ti, āvuso, vuccati. Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, duppaññoti vuccatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘贤友，所谓“劣慧，劣慧”。贤友，以何而说为“劣慧”呢？’
rows.english: “Friend, it is said, ‘one of little wisdom, one of little wisdom.’ To what extent, friend, is one said to be ‘one of little wisdom’?”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Paññavā paññavā’ti, āvuso, vuccati. Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, paññavāti vuccatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，说‘有慧者，有慧者’。贤友，究竟以何而被称为‘有慧者’呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, it is said, ‘a wise person, a wise person.’ To what extent, friend, is one said to be ‘a wise person’?”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Saññā saññā’ti, āvuso, vuccati. Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, saññāti vuccatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，被称为‘想，想’。贤友，以何义被称为‘想’呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, it is said, ‘perception, perception.’ To what extent, friend, is it called ‘perception’?”

rows.pali: 458 . ‘‘Kati panāvuso, paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 458. “贤友，不苦不乐心解脱的等至有几多缘呢？”
rows.english: 458. “Friend, how many conditions are there for the attainment of the liberation of mind that is neither-painful-nor-pleasant?”

rows.pali: 452 . ‘‘Kati panāvuso, paccayā sammādiṭṭhiyā uppādāyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 452. “贤友，正见生起的因缘有几种呢？”
rows.english: 452. “But how many, friend, are the conditions for the arising of right view?”

rows.pali: 453 . ‘‘Kati panāvuso, bhavā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 453. “贤友，有几种有呢？”
rows.english: 453. “But how many kinds of existence are there, friend?”

rows.pali: 450 . ‘‘‘Vedanā vedanā’ti, āvuso, vuccati. Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso , vedanāti vuccatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 450. “贤友，被称为‘受，受’。贤友，以何义被称为‘受’呢？”
rows.english: 450. “Friend, it is said, ‘feeling, feeling.’ To what extent, friend, is it called ‘feeling’?”

rows.pali: Idamavocāyasmā sāriputto. Attamano āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 具寿舍利弗说了此语。具寿摩诃拘𫄨罗心生欢喜，随喜具寿舍利弗所说。
rows.english: This is what Venerable Sāriputta said. Venerable Mahākoṭṭhika, being pleased, delighted in the words of Venerable Sāriputta.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati – idaṃ vuccati, āvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhāna’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻、有伺，具足离生喜乐，进入并安住于初禅。贤友，这称为初禅。”
rows.english: “Here, friend, a monk, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and abides in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, with rapture and pleasure born of seclusion. This, friend, is called the first jhāna.”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Viññāṇaṃ viññāṇa’nti, āvuso, vuccati. Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, viññāṇanti vuccatī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，说‘识，识’。贤友，究竟以何而被称为‘识’呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, it is said, ‘consciousness, consciousness.’ To what extent, friend, is it called ‘consciousness’?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāya – sabbanimittānañca manasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā amanasikāro. Ime kho, āvuso, dve paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāyā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有两种因缘能从无相心解脱出定：即作意一切相，以及不作意无相界。贤友，此即能从无相心解脱出定的两种因缘。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are two conditions for emerging from the signless liberation of mind: the attention to all signs, and the non-attention to the signless element. These, friend, are the two conditions for emerging from the signless liberation of mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañcahi kho, āvuso, aṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca. Idhāvuso, sammādiṭṭhi sīlānuggahitā ca hoti, sutānuggahitā ca hoti, sākacchānuggahitā ca hoti, samathānuggahitā ca hoti, vipassanānuggahitā ca hoti. Imehi kho, āvuso, pañcahaṅgehi anuggahitā sammādiṭṭhi cetovimuttiphalā ca hoti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca, paññāvimuttiphalā ca hoti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā cā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，由五支所资助的正见，是有心解脱果与心解脱效益，以及慧解脱果与慧解脱效益的。于此，贤友，正见为戒所资助，为闻所资助，为论议所资助，为止所资助，为观(vipassanā)所资助。贤友，由这五支所资助的正见，是有心解脱果与心解脱效益，以及慧解脱果与慧解脱效益的。”
rows.english: “Friend, right view supported by five factors has liberation of mind as its fruit and benefit, and liberation by wisdom as its fruit and benefit. Here, friend, right view is supported by virtue, supported by learning, supported by discussion, supported by tranquility, and supported by insight. Friend, right view supported by these five factors has liberation of mind as its fruit and benefit, and liberation by wisdom as its fruit and benefit.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Dve kho, āvuso, paccayā sammādiṭṭhiyā uppādāya – parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāro. Ime kho, āvuso, dve paccayā sammādiṭṭhiyā uppādāyā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，正见生起的因缘有两个：从他闻法音与如理作意。贤友，这就是正见生起的两个因缘。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are two conditions for the arising of right view: the voice of another and wise attention. These, friend, are the two conditions for the arising of right view.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañcimāni, āvuso, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti, seyyathidaṃ – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ. Imesaṃ kho, āvuso, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ, na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ, mano paṭisaraṇaṃ, mano ca nesaṃ gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhotī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，此五根所缘各异，行境各异，不体验彼此的行境所缘。也就是：眼根、耳根、鼻根、舌根、身根。贤友，对于这所缘各异、行境各异、不体验彼此行境所缘的五根，意是其依止，意也体验其行境所缘。”
rows.english: “Friend, these five faculties have different ranges and different pastures, and they do not experience the range and pasture of one another. That is, the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, and the body faculty. Of these five faculties, friend, with their different ranges and different pastures, not experiencing the range and pasture of one another, the mind is their resort, and it is the mind that experiences their range and pasture.”

rows.pali: 455 . ‘‘Pañcimāni , āvuso, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti, seyyathidaṃ – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ. Imesaṃ kho, āvuso, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ, na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ, kiṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ, ko ca nesaṃ gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhotī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 455. “贤友，有此五根，所缘各异，行境各异，互不体验彼此的所缘行境。此即：眼根、耳根、鼻根、舌根、身根。贤友，对于所缘各异、行境各异、互不体验彼此所缘行境的此五根，什么是它们的所依？又是什么在体验它们的所缘行境呢？”
rows.english: 455. “Friend, these five faculties have different ranges and different pastures, and they do not experience the range and pasture of one another. That is, the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, and the body faculty. Of these five faculties, friend, with their different ranges and different pastures, not experiencing the range and pasture of one another, what is their resort, and what experiences their range and pasture?”

rows.pali: 457 . ‘‘Teva nu kho, āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā, te vedaniyā dhammā udāhu aññe āyusaṅkhārā aññe vedaniyā dhammā’’ti? ‘‘Na kho , āvuso, teva āyusaṅkhārā te vedaniyā dhammā. Te ca hāvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na yidaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha. Yasmā ca kho, āvuso, aññe āyusaṅkhārā aññe vedaniyā dhammā, tasmā saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 457. “贤友，命行与感受法是同一的，还是命行是其一，感受法是另一呢？”“贤友，命行与感受法并非同一。贤友，倘若命行与感受法是同一的，那么已入想受灭定的比丘，其出定则不可知。贤友，正因为命行是其一，感受法是另一，所以已入想受灭定的比丘，其出定是可知的。”
rows.english: 457. “Friend, are those life-formations the same as the phenomena of feeling, or are the life-formations one thing and the phenomena of feeling another?” “No, friend, the life-formations are not the same as the phenomena of feeling. If, friend, those life-formations were the same as the phenomena of feeling, then the emergence of a bhikkhu who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling would not be discerned. But because, friend, the life-formations are one thing and the phenomena of feeling are another, therefore the emergence of a bhikkhu who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling is discerned.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayome, āvuso, bhavā – kāmabhavo , rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有是这三种：欲有、色有、无色有。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are these three kinds of existence: the sensual existence, the form existence, and the formless existence.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yā cāyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti – atthi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānātthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca; atthi ca kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanameva nānaṃ’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，这无量心解脱、无所有处心解脱、空心解脱、无相心解脱——贤友，确实有这样一种理路，依此理路，这些法义理与文句各异；贤友，也确实有这样一种理路，依此理路，这些法义理相同，只是文句不同。”
rows.english: “Friend, regarding this immeasurable liberation of mind, this liberation of mind of nothingness, this liberation of mind of emptiness, and this signless liberation of mind—there is a way, friend, according to which these phenomena are different in meaning and different in phrasing; and there is also a way, friend, according to which these phenomena are one in meaning, with only the phrasing being different.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā – sabbanimittānañca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro, pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro. Ime kho, āvuso, tayo paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有三种因缘能使无相心解脱安住：即不作意一切相，作意于无相界，以及先前的决意。贤友，此即能使无相心解脱安住的三种因缘。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are three conditions for the stability of the signless liberation of mind: the non-attention to all signs, the attention to the signless element, and prior determination. These, friend, are the three conditions for the stability of the signless liberation of mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Avijjāvirāgā kho, āvuso, vijjuppādā taṇhānirodhā – evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti na hotī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，因无明离染而明生起，因贪爱灭尽，如是在未来不有再有之生起。”
rows.english: “Friend, with the fading away of ignorance, with the arising of true knowledge, and with the cessation of craving—thus the production of renewed existence in the future does not come to be.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, animittā cetovimutti. Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānātthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，于此，有比丘因不作意一切相，进入无相心定而住。贤友，此被称为无相心解脱。贤友，此即是其理趣，依此理趣，此等诸法义异文亦异。
rows.english: “Here, friend, a bhikkhu, by not attending to all signs, enters and dwells in the signless concentration of mind. This, friend, is called the signless liberation of mind. This, friend, is the way according to which these phenomena are different in meaning and different in phrasing.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yā cāvuso, paññā yañca viññāṇaṃ – imesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṃsaṭṭhānaṃ no visaṃsaṭṭhānaṃ kiṃ nānākaraṇa’’nti? ‘‘Yā cāvuso, paññā yañca viññāṇaṃ – imesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṃsaṭṭhānaṃ no visaṃsaṭṭhānaṃ paññā bhāvetabbā, viññāṇaṃ pariññeyyaṃ. Idaṃ nesaṃ nānākaraṇa’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，此慧与此识——对于这些相应而非不相应的法，其差别为何？”“贤友，此慧与此识——对于这些相应而非不相应的法，慧当修习，识当遍知。此即其差别。”
rows.english: “Friend, as to this wisdom and this consciousness—these phenomena being conjoined, not disjoined—what is the difference between them?” “Friend, as to this wisdom and this consciousness—these phenomena being conjoined, not disjoined—wisdom is to be developed, and consciousness is to be fully understood. This is the difference between them.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idāneva kho mayaṃ, āvuso, āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ evaṃ ājānāma – ‘āyu usmaṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’ti. Idāneva pana mayaṃ, āvuso, āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ evaṃ ājānāma – ‘usmā āyuṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，我们刚才才如此理解具寿舍利弗所说：‘寿依暖而住’。贤友，我们现在又如此理解具寿舍利弗所说：‘暖依寿而住’。”
rows.english: “Just now, friend, we understood the Venerable Sāriputta’s statement thus: ‘Vitality depends on heat.’ And just now, friend, we understood the Venerable Sāriputta’s statement thus: ‘Heat depends on vitality.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañcimāni, āvuso, indriyāni, seyyathidaṃ – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ. Imāni kho, āvuso, pañcindriyāni āyuṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhantī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有此五根，也就是：眼根、耳根、鼻根、舌根、身根。贤友，此五根依寿而住。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are these five faculties: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, and the body faculty. These five faculties, friend, depend on vitality.”

rows.pali: 456 . ‘‘Pañcimāni, āvuso, indriyāni, seyyathidaṃ – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ. Imāni kho, āvuso, pañcindriyāni kiṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhantī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 456. “贤友，有此五根，也就是：眼根、耳根、鼻根、舌根、身根。贤友，此五根依何而住？”
rows.english: 456. “Friend, there are these five faculties: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, and the body faculty. Upon what, friend, do these five faculties depend?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ kho, āvuso, sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ tatratatrābhinandanā – evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hotī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，对于为无明所障蔽、为贪爱所结缚的众生，因其处处欢喜，如是在未来有再有之生起。”
rows.english: “Friend, for beings hindered by ignorance and fettered by craving, delighting in this and that—thus the production of renewed existence in the future comes to be.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā – sabbanimittānañca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro. Ime kho, āvuso, dve paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有两种因缘能证入无相心解脱：即不作意一切相，以及作意于无相界。贤友，此即证入无相心解脱的两种因缘。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are two conditions for the attainment of the signless liberation of mind: the non-attention to all signs, and the attention to the signless element. These, friend, are the two conditions for the attainment of the signless liberation of mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca sañjānāti? Nīlakampi sañjānāti, pītakampi sañjānāti, lohitakampi sañjānāti, odātampi sañjānāti. ‘Sañjānāti sañjānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā saññāti vuccatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “又认知什么呢？认知青色，认知黄色，认知红色，认知白色。贤友，因为‘认知，认知’，因此被称为‘想’。”
rows.english: “And what does it perceive? It perceives blue, it perceives yellow, it perceives red, and it perceives white. Because ‘it perceives, it perceives,’ friend, for that reason it is called ‘perception.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yadā kho, āvuso, imaṃ kāyaṃ tayo dhammā jahanti – āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ; athāyaṃ kāyo ujjhito avakkhitto seti, yathā kaṭṭhaṃ acetana’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，当寿、暖与识这三法舍离此身后，此身就被抛弃、被丢弃地躺着，犹如无心识的木头。”
rows.english: “When, friend, three phenomena abandon this body—vitality, heat, and consciousness—then this body lies discarded, cast aside, like a senseless piece of wood.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañcaṅgikaṃ. Idhāvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca. Paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ evaṃ pañcaṅgika’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，初禅有五支。贤友，于此，进入初禅的比丘，有寻、有伺、有喜、有乐与心一境性生起。贤友，初禅就是这样具有五支。”
rows.english: “The first jhāna, friend, has five factors. Here, friend, for a monk who has attained the first jhāna, applied thought occurs, sustained thought occurs, rapture occurs, pleasure occurs, and one-pointedness of mind occurs. Thus, friend, the first jhāna has five factors.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro kho, āvuso, paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ime kho, āvuso, cattāro paccayā adukkhamasukhāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有四种因缘能证入不苦不乐心解脱。贤友，于此，比丘因舍离乐、舍离苦，以及先前已灭除喜与忧，遂进入并安住于不苦不乐、由舍而得念清净的第四禅。贤友，此即证入不苦不乐心解脱的四种因缘。”
rows.english: “Friend, there are four conditions for the attainment of the liberation of mind that is neither-painful-nor-pleasant. Here, friend, a bhikkhu, with the abandoning of pleasure and the abandoning of pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and sorrow, enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. These, friend, are the four conditions for the attainment of the liberation of mind that is neither-painful-nor-pleasant.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca vijānāti? Sukhantipi vijānāti, dukkhantipi vijānāti, adukkhamasukhantipi vijānāti. ‘Vijānāti vijānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇanti vuccatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “识别什么呢？识别乐，也识别苦，也识别不苦不乐。贤友，因为‘识别，识别’，因此被称为‘识’。”
rows.english: “And what does it cognize? It cognizes what is pleasant, it cognizes what is painful, and it cognizes what is neither-painful-nor-pleasant. Because ‘it cognizes, it cognizes,’ friend, for that reason it is called ‘consciousness.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca vedeti? Sukhampi vedeti, dukkhampi vedeti, adukkhamasukhampi vedeti. ‘Vedeti vedetī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā vedanāti vuccatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “又感受什么呢？感受乐，感受苦，感受不苦不乐。贤友，因为‘感受，感受’，因此被称为‘受’。”
rows.english: “And what does it feel? It feels what is pleasant, it feels what is painful, and it feels what is neither-painful-nor-pleasant. Because ‘it feels, it feels,’ friend, for that reason it is called ‘feeling.’”

rows.pali: 449 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 449. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住舍卫城(Sāvatthī)祇陀林(Jetavana)给孤独(Anāthapiṇḍika)园。尔时，具寿摩诃拘𫄨罗(Mahākoṭṭhika)于日暮时分，从宴坐而起，往诣具寿舍利弗(Sāriputta)所。至已，与具寿舍利弗共相问候，交换可喜可忆之言后，坐于一面。坐于一面已，具寿摩诃拘𫄨罗对具寿舍利弗说：
rows.english: 449. Thus have I heard. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park. Then, in the evening, the Venerable Mahākoṭṭhika arose from seclusion and approached the Venerable Sāriputta. Having approached, he exchanged greetings with the Venerable Sāriputta. After concluding their courteous and memorable talk, he sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the Venerable Mahākoṭṭhika said this to the Venerable Sāriputta:

rows.pali: ‘‘Tena hāvuso, upamaṃ te karissāmi; upamāyapidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti. Seyyathāpi, āvuso, telappadīpassa jhāyato acciṃ paṭicca ābhā paññāyati, ābhaṃ paṭicca acci paññāyati; evameva kho, āvuso, āyu usmaṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, usmā āyuṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “那么，贤友，我为你作一譬喻；于此教法中，有些智者通过譬喻能了知所说之义。贤友，譬如燃烧的油灯，依火焰而有光明可见，依光明而有火焰可见；正是如此，贤友，寿依暖而住，暖依寿而住。”
rows.english: “In that case, friend, I shall give you a simile; for by means of a simile, some intelligent people here understand the meaning of what is said. Just as, friend, when an oil lamp is burning, light is perceived in dependence on the flame, and the flame is perceived in dependence on the light; in the same way, friend, vitality depends on heat, and heat depends on vitality.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yadā nu kho, āvuso, imaṃ kāyaṃ kati dhammā jahanti; athāyaṃ kāyo ujjhito avakkhitto seti, yathā kaṭṭhaṃ acetana’’nti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，当有几法舍离此身后，此身才会被抛弃、被丢弃地躺着，犹如无心识的木头呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, when how many phenomena abandon this body, does this body then lie discarded, cast aside, like a senseless piece of wood?”

rows.pali: 459 . ‘‘Yā cāyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti – ime dhammā nānātthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ekatthā byañjanameva nāna’’nti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 459. “贤友，此无量心解脱、无所有心解脱、空心解脱、无相心解脱——这些法是义异文亦异，还是义同文有异？”
rows.english: 459. “Friend, this immeasurable liberation of mind, this liberation of mind of nothingness, this liberation of mind of emptiness, and this signless liberation of mind—are these phenomena different in meaning and different in phrasing, or are they one in meaning, with only the phrasing being different?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，在此，比丘完全地超越识无边处，作意‘无任何所有’，进入并安住于无所有处。贤友，这被称为无所有处心解脱。”
rows.english: “Here, friend, a bhikkhu, by completely transcending the base of the infinity of consciousness, attending to ‘There is nothing,’ enters and dwells in the base of nothingness. This, friend, is called the liberation of mind of nothingness.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ neyya’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，以脱离五根、清净的意识，应知空无边处为‘虚空无边’，应知识无边处为‘识无边’，应知无所有处为‘一无所有’。”
rows.english: ‘Friend, by the purified mind-consciousness that is divested of the five faculties, the base of the infinity of space is to be known as “infinite space”; the base of the infinity of consciousness is to be known as “infinite consciousness”; and the base of nothingness is to be known as “there is nothing.”’

rows.pali: ‘‘Idhāvuso, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘suññamidaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā’ti. Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, suññatā cetovimutti’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，在此，比丘去到林野、或去到树下、或去到空静处，如此省察：‘此身空无我及我所。’贤友，这被称为空心解脱。”
rows.english: “Here, friend, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, to the root of a tree, or to an empty dwelling, reflects thus: ‘This is empty of self or of what belongs to self.’ This, friend, is called the emptiness liberation of mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yā cāvuso, vedanā yā ca saññā yañca viññāṇaṃ – ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā udāhu visaṃsaṭṭhā? Labbhā ca panimesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetu’’nti? ‘‘Yā cāvuso, vedanā yā ca saññā yañca viññāṇaṃ – ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā, no visaṃsaṭṭhā. Na ca labbhā imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ. Yaṃ hāvuso yañcāvuso (syā. kaṃ. ka.) , vedeti taṃ sañjānāti, yaṃ sañjānāti taṃ vijānāti. Tasmā ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā no visaṃsaṭṭhā. Na ca labbhā imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetu’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，此受、此想与此识，这些法是结合的还是分离的？能否分别、辨别出这些法的差异呢？”“贤友，此受、此想与此识，这些法是结合的，非分离的。不能分别、辨别出这些法的差异。贤友，所感受的，即被认知；所认知的，即被识知。因此，这些法是结合的，非分离的。不能分别、辨别出这些法的差异。”
rows.english: ‘Friend, as to this feeling, this perception, and this consciousness—are these phenomena conjoined or disjoined? And is it possible, having separated them again and again, to make known the difference between them?’ ‘Friend, as to this feeling, this perception, and this consciousness—these phenomena are conjoined, not disjoined. And it is not possible, having separated them again and again, to make known the difference between them. For, friend, what one feels, that one perceives; and what one perceives, that one cognizes. Therefore, these phenomena are conjoined, not disjoined. And it is not possible, having separated them again and again, to make known the difference between them.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Idhāvuso, bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati. Karuṇāsahagatena cetasā…pe… muditāsahagatena cetasā… upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati. Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，在此，比丘以与慈俱行之心，遍满一方而住；像那样第二方，像那样第三方，像那样第四方。像这样，上、下、横向，于一切处，对一切众生，以与慈俱行的、广大的、崇高的、无量的、无怨、无害之心，遍满包含一切的世界而住。以与悲俱行之心……以与喜俱行之心……以与舍俱行之心，遍满一方而住；像那样第二方，像那样第三方，像那样第四方。像这样，上、下、横向，于一切处，对一切众生，以与舍俱行的、广大的、崇高的、无量的、无怨、无害之心，遍满包含一切的世界而住。贤友，这被称为无量心解脱。”
rows.english: “Here, friend, a bhikkhu dwells pervading one direction with a mind accompanied by loving-kindness, likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. Thus above, below, and across, everywhere, for all, he dwells pervading the entire world with a mind accompanied by loving-kindness—abundant, exalted, immeasurable, without hostility, without ill will. With a mind accompanied by compassion… with a mind accompanied by altruistic joy… with a mind accompanied by equanimity, he dwells pervading one direction, likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. Thus above, below, and across, everywhere, for all, he dwells pervading the entire world with a mind accompanied by equanimity—abundant, exalted, immeasurable, without hostility, without ill will. This, friend, is called the immeasurable liberation of mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yvāyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅkato, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno – imesaṃ kiṃ nānākaraṇa’’nti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那已死、命终者，与那已入想受灭定的比丘——此二者有何差别呢？”
rows.english: “Friend, what is the difference between that being who is dead, who has passed away, and that bhikkhu who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca pajānāti? ‘Idaṃ dukkha’nti pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti pajānāti. ‘Pajānāti pajānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā paññavāti vuccatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “了知什么呢？了知‘此是苦’，了知‘此是苦之集’，了知‘此是苦之灭’，了知‘此是导向苦灭之道’。贤友，因为‘了知，了知’，因此被称为‘有慧者’。”
rows.english: “And what does one discern? One discerns: ‘This is suffering.’ One discerns: ‘This is the origin of suffering.’ One discerns: ‘This is the cessation of suffering.’ One discerns: ‘This is the path leading to the cessation of suffering.’ Because ‘one discerns, one discerns,’ friend, for that reason one is called ‘a wise person.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yvāyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅkato tassa kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā , vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu parikkhīṇo, usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni paribhinnāni. Yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno tassapi kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu na parikkhīṇo, usmā avūpasantā, indriyāni vippasannāni. Yvāyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅkato, yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno – idaṃ nesaṃ nānākaraṇa’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那已死、命终者，其身行已止息、已寂静，语行已止息、已寂静，心行已止息、已寂静，寿已尽，暖已消，诸根已毁坏。而那已入想受灭定的比丘，其身行亦已止息、已寂静，语行亦已止息、已寂静，心行亦已止息、已寂静，但寿未尽，暖未消，诸根极为清明。贤友，那已死、命终者，与那已入想受灭定的比丘——此即是他们二者的差别。”
rows.english: “Friend, for that being who is dead, who has passed away, the bodily formations have ceased and are stilled, the verbal formations have ceased and are stilled, the mental formations have ceased and are stilled, vitality is exhausted, the heat has been extinguished, and the faculties are destroyed. As for that bhikkhu who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling, for him also the bodily formations have ceased and are stilled, the verbal formations have ceased and are stilled, the mental formations have ceased and are stilled, but vitality is not exhausted, the heat has not been extinguished, and the faculties are exceedingly clear. Friend, between that being who is dead, who has passed away, and that bhikkhu who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling—this is the difference between them.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Rāgo kho, āvuso, pamāṇakaraṇo, doso pamāṇakaraṇo, moho pamāṇakaraṇo. Te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. Yāvatā kho, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo, akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati. Sā kho panākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena, suññā dosena, suññā mohena. Rāgo kho, āvuso, kiñcano, doso kiñcano, moho kiñcano. Te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. Yāvatā kho, āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimuttiyo, akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati. Sā kho panākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena, suññā dosena , suññā mohena. Rāgo kho, āvuso, nimittakaraṇo, doso nimittakaraṇo, moho nimittakaraṇo. Te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. Yāvatā kho, āvuso, animittā cetovimuttiyo, akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati. Sā kho panākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena, suññā dosena, suññā mohena. Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nāna’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，贪是作限量者，嗔是作限量者，痴是作限量者。彼等于漏尽比丘已被舍断，根已被切，如截顶之多罗树，已成无有，于未来为不生之法。贤友，所有无量心解脱，不动心解脱于其中被称为最上。而彼不动心解脱，空于贪，空于嗔，空于痴。贤友，贪是障碍，嗔是障碍，痴是障碍。彼等于漏尽比丘已被舍断，根已被切，如截顶之多罗树，已成无有，于未来为不生之法。贤友，所有无所有心解脱，不动心解脱于其中被称为最上。而彼不动心解脱，空于贪，空于嗔，空于痴。贤友，贪是作相者，嗔是作相者，痴是作相者。彼等于漏尽比丘已被舍断，根已被切，如截顶之多罗树，已成无有，于未来为不生之法。贤友，所有无相心解脱，不动心解脱于其中被称为最上。而彼不动心解脱，空于贪，空于嗔，空于痴。贤友，此即是其理趣，依此理趣，此等诸法义同而文异。
rows.english: “Friend, lust is a measure-maker, hatred is a measure-maker, delusion is a measure-maker. For a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, these have been abandoned, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, brought to non-existence, and are of a nature not to arise in the future. Insofar as there are immeasurable liberations of mind, friend, the unshakable liberation of mind is declared the highest among them. And that unshakable liberation of mind is empty of lust, empty of hatred, and empty of delusion. Friend, lust is an impediment, hatred is an impediment, delusion is an impediment. For a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, these have been abandoned, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, brought to non-existence, and are of a nature not to arise in the future. Insofar as there are liberations of mind of nothingness, friend, the unshakable liberation of mind is declared the highest among them. And that unshakable liberation of mind is empty of lust, empty of hatred, and empty of delusion. Friend, lust is a sign-maker, hatred is a sign-maker, delusion is a sign-maker. For a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, these have been abandoned, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, brought to non-existence, and are of a nature not to arise in the future. Insofar as there are signless liberations of mind, friend, the unshakable liberation of mind is declared the highest among them. And that unshakable liberation of mind is empty of lust, empty of hatred, and empty of delusion. This, friend, is the way according to which these phenomena are one in meaning, with only the phrasing being different.”

rows.pali: 451 . ‘‘Nissaṭṭhena hāvuso nissaṭṭhena panāvuso (?) , pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena kiṃ neyya’’nti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 451. “贤友，以脱离五根、清净的意识，可知何法？”
rows.english: 451. ‘Friend, by the purified mind-consciousness that is divested of the five faculties, what is to be known?’

rows.pali: ‘‘Yā cāvuso, paññā yañca viññāṇaṃ – ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā udāhu visaṃsaṭṭhā? Labbhā ca panimesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujjitvā vinibbhujjitvā (ka.) vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetu’’nti? ‘‘Yā cāvuso, paññā yañca viññāṇaṃ – ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā, no visaṃsaṭṭhā. Na ca labbhā imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetuṃ. Yaṃ hāvuso yañcāvuso (syā. kaṃ. ka.) , pajānāti taṃ vijānāti, yaṃ vijānāti taṃ pajānāti. Tasmā ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā, no visaṃsaṭṭhā. Na ca labbhā imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetu’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，此慧与此识——这些法是相应的，还是不相应的？能否将这些法一一分离，而宣示其差别呢？”“贤友，此慧与此识——这些法是相应的，非不相应。且无法将这些法一一分离，而宣示其差别。贤友，凡所了知者，即是所识别者；凡所识别者，即是所了知者。是故，这些法是相应的，非不相应。且无法将这些法一一分离，而宣示其差别。”
rows.english: “Friend, as to this wisdom and this consciousness—are these phenomena conjoined or disjoined? And is it possible, having separated them again and again, to make known the difference between them?” “Friend, as to this wisdom and this consciousness—these phenomena are conjoined, not disjoined. And it is not possible, having separated them again and again, to make known the difference between them. For, friend, what one discerns, that one cognizes; and what one cognizes, that one discerns. Therefore, these phenomena are conjoined, not disjoined. And it is not possible, having separated them again and again, to make known the difference between them.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ pañcaṅgavippahīnaṃ, pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ. Idhāvuso, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thīnamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti; vitakko ca vattati, vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca. Paṭhamaṃ kho, āvuso, jhānaṃ evaṃ pañcaṅgavippahīnaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgata’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，初禅舍弃五支、具备五支。贤友，当比丘进入初禅时，欲贪已被舍断，瞋恚已被舍断，惛沉、睡眠已被舍断，掉举、追悔已被舍断，疑已被舍断；并且有寻、有伺、有喜、有乐与心一境性生起。贤友，初禅就是这样舍弃五支、具备五支。”
rows.english: “The first jhāna, friend, has five factors abandoned and is endowed with five factors. Here, friend, for a monk who has attained the first jhāna, sensual desire is abandoned, ill will is abandoned, sloth and torpor are abandoned, restlessness and remorse are abandoned, and doubt is abandoned; and applied thought occurs, sustained thought occurs, rapture occurs, pleasure occurs, and one-pointedness of mind occurs. Thus, friend, the first jhāna has five factors abandoned and is endowed with five factors.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Paṭhamaṃ panāvuso, jhānaṃ kataṅgavippahīnaṃ kataṅgasamannāgata’’nti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，那么，初禅舍弃了哪几支，又具备了哪几支呢？”
rows.english: “But, friend, how many factors are abandoned in the first jhāna, and with how many factors is it endowed?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca nappajānāti? ‘Idaṃ dukkha’nti nappajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti nappajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti nappajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti nappajānāti. ‘Nappajānāti nappajānātī’ti kho, āvuso, tasmā duppaññoti vuccatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘不了知什么呢？不了知“此是苦”，不了知“此是苦之集”，不了知“此是苦之灭”，不了知“此是导向苦灭之道”。贤友，因其“不了知，不了知”，故说为“劣慧”。’
rows.english: “And what does one not discern? One does not discern: ‘This is suffering.’ One does not discern: ‘This is the origin of suffering.’ One does not discern: ‘This is the cessation of suffering.’ One does not discern: ‘This is the path leading to the cessation of suffering.’ Because ‘one does not discern, one does not discern,’ friend, for that reason one is called ‘one of little wisdom.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ panāyye, sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，有身见又如何不生起呢？”
rows.english: “And how, venerable lady, does identity view not come to be?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ariyo kho, āvuso visākha, aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhato’’ti .
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，圣八支道是有为的。”
rows.english: “The Noble Eightfold Path, friend Visākha, is conditioned.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ariyena nu kho, ayye, aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena tayo khandhā saṅgahitā udāhu tīhi khandhehi ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅgahito’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “大姐，是圣八支道含摄三蕴，还是三蕴含摄圣八支道呢？”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, are the three aggregates included in the Noble Eightfold Path, or is the Noble Eightfold Path included in the three aggregates?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo panāyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “大姐，那么，什么是定？哪些法是定的相？哪些法是定的资具？什么是定的修习？”
rows.english: “But, venerable lady, what is concentration? What qualities are the signs of concentration? What qualities are the requisites for concentration? What is the development of concentration?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo panāyye, kāyasaṅkhāro, katamo vacīsaṅkhāro, katamo cittasaṅkhāro’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，什么是身行，什么是语行，什么是心行？”
rows.english: “But what, venerable lady, is the bodily formation, what is the verbal formation, what is the mental formation?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Assāsapassāsā kho, āvuso visākha, kāyasaṅkhāro, vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，出入息(assāsapassāsa)是身行，寻(vitakka)与伺(vicāra)是语行，想(saññā)与受(vedanā)是心行。”
rows.english: “In-breaths and out-breaths, friend Visākha, are the bodily formation; applied thought and sustained thought are the verbal formation; perception and feeling are the mental formation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kasmā panāyye, assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro, kasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, kasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，为何出入息是身行？为何寻与伺是语行？为何想与受是心行？”
rows.english: “But why, venerable lady, are in-breaths and out-breaths the bodily formation, why are applied thought and sustained thought the verbal formation, and why are perception and feeling the mental formation?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ panāyye, saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ hotī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，那么，从想受灭定的出定是如何发生的呢？”
rows.english: “But how, venerable lady, does emergence from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling come about?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā panāyye, sukhā vedanā, katamā dukkhā vedanā, katamā adukkhamasukhā vedanā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，什么是乐受，什么是苦受，什么是不苦不乐受呢？”
rows.english: “But, venerable lady, what is pleasant feeling, what is painful feeling, and what is neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhā panāyye, vedanā kiṃsukhā kiṃdukkhā, dukkhā vedanā kiṃsukhā kiṃdukkhā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā kiṃsukhā kiṃdukkhā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，乐受有何乐，有何苦？苦受有何乐，有何苦？不苦不乐受有何乐，有何苦？”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, in what way is pleasant feeling pleasant and in what way painful? In what way is painful feeling pleasant and in what way painful? In what way is neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling pleasant and in what way painful?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo anusetī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，于乐受中，贪随眠潜伏；于苦受中，瞋随眠潜伏；于不苦不乐受中，无明随眠潜伏。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, the underlying tendency to lust lies dormant in pleasant feeling, the underlying tendency to aversion lies dormant in painful feeling, and the underlying tendency to ignorance lies dormant in neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbāya nu kho, ayye, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo anusetī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，是否于一切乐受中，贪随眠都潜伏？于一切苦受中，瞋随眠都潜伏？于一切不苦不乐受中，无明随眠都潜伏？”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, does the underlying tendency to lust lie dormant in all pleasant feeling, does the underlying tendency to aversion lie dormant in all painful feeling, and does the underlying tendency to ignorance lie dormant in all neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya rāgānusayo pahātabbo, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo pahātabbo, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo pahātabbo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，于乐受，确实应舍断贪随眠；于苦受，应舍断瞋随眠；于不苦不乐受，应舍断无明随眠。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, in pleasant feeling, the underlying tendency to lust is to be abandoned; in painful feeling, the underlying tendency to aversion is to be abandoned; in neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, the underlying tendency to ignorance is to be abandoned.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbāya nu kho, ayye, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo pahātabbo, sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo pahātabbo, sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo pahātabbo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，是否于一切乐受皆应舍断贪随眠，于一切苦受皆应舍断瞋随眠，于一切不苦不乐受皆应舍断无明随眠？”
rows.english: Venerable lady, is the underlying tendency to lust to be abandoned in all pleasant feeling, is the underlying tendency to aversion to be abandoned in all painful feeling, and is the underlying tendency to ignorance to be abandoned in all neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling?

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya dukkhā vedanā paṭibhāgo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，苦受是乐受的对应。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, painful feeling is the counterpart to pleasant feeling.

rows.pali: ‘‘Dukkhāya pannāyye, vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，苦受的对应是什么？”
rows.english: Venerable lady, what is the counterpart to painful feeling?

rows.pali: ‘‘Dukkhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya sukhā vedanā paṭibhāgo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，乐受是苦受的对应。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, pleasant feeling is the counterpart to painful feeling.

rows.pali: ‘‘Adukkhamasukhāya panāyye, vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，不苦不乐受的对应是什么？”
rows.english: But, venerable lady, what is the counterpart to neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling?

rows.pali: ‘‘Adukkhamasukhāya kho, āvuso visākha, vedanāya avijjā paṭibhāgo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，无明是不苦不乐受的对应。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, ignorance is the counterpart to neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

rows.pali: ‘‘Avijjāya panāyye, kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，无明的对应是什么？”
rows.english: But, venerable lady, what is the counterpart to ignorance?

rows.pali: ‘‘Avijjāya kho, āvuso visākha, vijjā paṭibhāgo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，明是无明的对应。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, knowledge is the counterpart to ignorance.

rows.pali: ‘‘Vijjāya panāyye, kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，明的对应是什么？”
rows.english: Venerable lady, what is the counterpart to knowledge?

rows.pali: ‘‘Vijjāya kho, āvuso visākha, vimutti paṭibhāgo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，解脱是明的对应。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, liberation is the counterpart to knowledge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Vimuttiyā panāyye , kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，解脱的对应是什么？”
rows.english: But, venerable lady, what is the counterpart to liberation?

rows.pali: ‘‘Vimuttiyā kho, āvuso visākha, nibbānaṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，解脱的同分是涅槃。”
rows.english: Friend Visākha, Nibbāna is the counterpart to liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti, ayye, vuccati. Katamā nu kho, ayye, sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā vuttā bhagavatā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，有言‘导向有身灭的行道（sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā），导向有身灭的行道’。尊者，世尊所说的导向有身灭的行道是什么呢？”
rows.english: “‘The path leading to the cessation of identity, the path leading to the cessation of identity,’ venerable lady, it is said. Now what, venerable lady, is the path leading to the cessation of identity declared by the Blessed One?”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Sakkāyanirodho sakkāyanirodho’ti, ayye, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, ayye, sakkāyanirodho vutto bhagavatā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，人们常说‘有身灭(sakkāyanirodho)、有身灭’。尊者，世尊所说的有身灭是什么呢？”
rows.english: “‘The cessation of identity, the cessation of identity,’ venerable lady, it is said. Now what, venerable lady, is the cessation of identity declared by the Blessed One?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ panāyye, bhikkhuṃ kati phassā phusantī’’ti? ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuṃ tayo phassā phusanti – suññato phasso, animitto phasso, appaṇihito phasso’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，那么，有几种触会触及已从想受灭定出定的比丘呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，有三种触会触及已从想受灭定出定的比丘：空触、无相触、无愿触。”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, when a bhikkhu has emerged from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, how many contacts touch him?” “Friend Visākha, when a bhikkhu has emerged from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, three contacts touch him: the emptiness contact, the signless contact, and the desireless contact.”

rows.pali: 462 . ‘‘Katamo panāyye, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 462. “大姐，那么，什么是圣八支道呢？”
rows.english: 462. “And what, venerable lady, is the Noble Eightfold Path?”

rows.pali: 466 . ‘‘Sukhāya panāyye, vedanāya kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 466. “尊者，乐受的对应是什么？”
rows.english: 466. And, venerable lady, what is the counterpart to pleasant feeling?

rows.pali: 464 . ‘‘Kathaṃ panāyye, saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti hotī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 464. “尊者，想受灭等持(saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti)是如何成就的呢？”
rows.english: 464. “But how, venerable lady, does the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling come to be?”

rows.pali: 463 . ‘‘Kati panāyye, saṅkhārā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 463. “尊者，行(saṅkhāra)有几种呢？”
rows.english: 463. “But, venerable lady, how many formations are there?”

rows.pali: 465 . ‘‘Kati panāyye, vedanā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 465. “尊者，有多少种受呢？”
rows.english: 465. “But, venerable lady, how many feelings are there?”

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamano visākho upāsako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了此话。优婆塞毘舍佉心满意足，欢喜于世尊所说。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Pleased, the lay follower Visākha greatly rejoiced in the Blessed One's words.

rows.pali: ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa panāyye, bhikkhuno katame dhammā paṭhamaṃ nirujjhanti – yadi vā kāyasaṅkhāro, yadi vā vacīsaṅkhāro, yadi vā cittasaṅkhāro’’ti? ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuno paṭhamaṃ nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato cittasaṅkhāro’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，那么，对于进入想受灭的比丘，是哪些法先寂灭呢？是身行，是语行，还是心行？”“贤友毘舍佉，对于进入想受灭的比丘，先寂灭的是语行，其后是身行，其后是心行。”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, when a bhikkhu is attaining the cessation of perception and feeling, which phenomena cease first: the bodily formation, or the verbal formation, or the mental formation?” “Friend Visākha, when a bhikkhu is attaining the cessation of perception and feeling, the verbal formation ceases first, then the bodily formation, then the mental formation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa panāyye, bhikkhuno katame dhammā paṭhamaṃ uppajjanti – yadi vā kāyasaṅkhāro, yadi vā vacīsaṅkhāro, yadi vā cittasaṅkhāro’’ti? ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuno paṭhamaṃ uppajjati cittasaṅkhāro, tato kāyasaṅkhāro, tato vacīsaṅkhāro’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，那么，对于从想受灭定出定的比丘，是哪些法先生起呢？是身行，是语行，还是心行？”“贤友毘舍佉，对于从想受灭定出定的比丘，先生起的是心行，其后是身行，其后是语行。”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, when a bhikkhu is emerging from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, which phenomena arise first: the bodily formation, or the verbal formation, or the mental formation?” “Friend Visākha, when a bhikkhu is emerging from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, the mental formation arises first, then the bodily formation, then the verbal formation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso kho imā, āvuso visākha, vedanā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，有此三种受：乐受、苦受、不苦不乐受。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, there are these three feelings: pleasant feeling, painful feeling, and neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yo kho, āvuso visākha, tassāyeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo; ayaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, sakkāyanirodho vutto bhagavatā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，凡是对那渴爱的无余离欲灭尽、舍弃、放下、解脱、不执著，贤友毘舍佉，这即是世尊所说的有身灭。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, the remainderless fading away and cessation of that very craving, the abandoning, the relinquishing, the release from it, and the non-adherence to it—this, friend Visākha, is the cessation of identity declared by the Blessed One.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayome, āvuso visākha, saṅkhārā – kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāro’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，有三种行：身行(kāyasaṅkhāra)、语行(vacīsaṅkhāra)、心行(cittasaṅkhāra)。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, there are these three formations: the bodily formation, the verbal formation, and the mental formation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yā kho, āvuso visākha, cittassa ekaggatā ayaṃ samādhi; cattāro satipaṭṭhānā samādhinimittā; cattāro sammappadhānā samādhiparikkhārā. Yā tesaṃyeva dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, ayaṃ ettha samādhibhāvanā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，心的一境性(ekaggatā)即是定(samādhi)；四念处(satipaṭṭhāna)是定相(samādhinimitta)；四正勤(sammappadhāna)是定资具(samādhiparikkhāra)。对这些法的修习(āsevanā)、培育(bhāvanā)、多作(bahulīkamma)，于此，此即是修定(samādhibhāvanā)。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, the singleness of mind is concentration; the four foundations of mindfulness are the signs of concentration; the four right exertions are the requisites for concentration. The pursuit, development, and frequent practice of these very qualities is, in this context, the development of concentration.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Na kho, āvuso visākha, saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjissa’nti vā, ‘ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā, ‘ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno’ti vā. Atha khvāssa pubbeva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tathattāya upanetī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，正在进入想受灭等持的比丘，不会生起这样的心：‘我将要进入想受灭等持’，或‘我正在进入想受灭等持’，或‘我已经进入想受灭等持’。然而，他的心先前就已如此培育，而那能引他达到那种状态。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, it is not that when a bhikkhu is attaining the cessation of perception and feeling, it occurs to him: ‘I will attain the cessation of perception and feeling,’ or ‘I am attaining the cessation of perception and feeling,’ or ‘I have attained the cessation of perception and feeling.’ Rather, his mind has previously been developed in such a way that it leads to such a state.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Nibbānassa panāyye, kiṃ paṭibhāgo’’ti? ‘‘Accayāsi, āvuso accasarāvuso (sī. pī.), accassarāvuso (syā. kaṃ.) visākha, pañhaṃ, nāsakkhi pañhānaṃ pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. Nibbānogadhañhi, āvuso visākha, brahmacariyaṃ, nibbānaparāyanaṃ nibbānapariyosānaṃ. Ākaṅkhamāno ca tvaṃ, āvuso visākha, bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyāsi, yathā ca te bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāsī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，那么涅槃的同分是什么呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，你已超越了问题，不能把握问题的边际。贤友毘舍佉，梵行浸入涅槃，以涅槃为归宿，以涅槃为终结。贤友毘舍佉，你若愿意，可前往拜见世尊请教此义，并依世尊的解释而受持。”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, what is the counterpart to Nibbāna?” “You have gone beyond the question, friend Visākha; you were not able to grasp the limit of questions. For the holy life, friend Visākha, plunges into Nibbāna, has Nibbāna as its destination, and Nibbāna as its final end. If you wish, friend Visākha, you may approach the Blessed One and ask him about this matter. And as the Blessed One explains it to you, so you should bear it in mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Na kho, āvuso visākha, sabbāya sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, na sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, na sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo anusetī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，贪随眠并非于一切乐受潜伏，瞋随眠并非于一切苦受潜伏，无明随眠并非于一切不苦不乐受潜伏。”
rows.english: “It is not, friend Visākha, that the underlying tendency to lust lies dormant in all pleasant feeling, nor that the underlying tendency to aversion lies dormant in all painful feeling, nor that the underlying tendency to ignorance lies dormant in all neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ayameva kho, āvuso visākha, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā vuttā bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，这圣八支道（ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo）正是世尊所说的导向有身灭的行道，也就是：正见、正思惟、正语、正业、正命、正精进、正念、正定。”
rows.english: “It is this very Noble Eightfold Path, friend Visākha, that has been declared by the Blessed One as the path leading to the cessation of identity; that is: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Assāsapassāsā kho, āvuso visākha, kāyikā ete dhammā kāyappaṭibaddhā, tasmā assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro. Pubbe kho, āvuso visākha, vitakketvā vicāretvā pacchā vācaṃ bhindati, tasmā vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro. Saññā ca vedanā ca cetasikā ete dhammā cittappaṭibaddhā, tasmā saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，出入息是身所生的(kāyika)，此等法与身相连(kāyappaṭibaddha)，是故出入息为身行。贤友毘舍佉，先有寻、伺，而后才发语，是故寻、伺为语行。想与受是心所(cetasika)，此等法与心相连(cittappaṭibaddha)，是故想与受为心行。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, in-breaths and out-breaths are bodily; these phenomena are bound up with the body. Therefore, in-breaths and out-breaths are the bodily formation. First, friend Visākha, one applies thought and sustains thought, and afterwards one utters speech. Therefore, applied thought and sustained thought are the verbal formation. Perception and feeling are mental; these phenomena are bound up with the mind. Therefore, perception and feeling are the mental formation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ayameva kho, āvuso visākha, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhī’’ti. ‘‘Ariyo panāyye, aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhato udāhu asaṅkhato’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，此即圣八支道，也就是：正见、正思惟、正语、正业、正命、正精进、正念、正定。”“大姐，那么，圣八支道是有为的还是无为的呢？”
rows.english: “It is this very Noble Eightfold Path, friend Visākha; that is: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration. But, venerable lady, is the Noble Eightfold Path conditioned or unconditioned?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhā kho, āvuso visākha, vedanā ṭhitisukhā vipariṇāmadukkhā; dukkhā vedanā ṭhitidukkhā vipariṇāmasukhā ; adukkhamasukhā vedanā ñāṇasukhā aññāṇadukkhā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，乐受于存续时是乐，于变易时是苦；苦受于存续时是苦，于变易时是乐；不苦不乐受于了知时是乐，于不了知时是苦。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, pleasant feeling is pleasant in its persistence and painful in its change; painful feeling is painful in its persistence and pleasant in its change; neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling is pleasant when there is knowledge and painful when there is no knowledge.”

rows.pali: 461 . ‘‘Kathaṃ panāyye, sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotī’’ti? ‘‘Idhāvuso visākha, assutavā puthujjano, ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto, rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. Vedanaṃ…pe… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. Evaṃ kho , āvuso visākha, sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotī’’ti.
