rows.chinese_simplified: 461. “尊者，有身见（sakkāyadiṭṭhi）如何生起呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，在此，无闻凡夫（assutavā puthujjano），不见圣者，不善巧圣法，于圣法未受调伏；不见善人，不善巧善人法，于善人法未受调伏，他视色为我，或视我为有色者，或视色在我中，或视我在色中。对受、想、行也是如此。他视识为我，或视我为有识者，或视识在我中，或视我在识中。贤友毘舍佉，有身见如是生起。”
rows.english: 461. “But how, venerable lady, does identity view come to be?” “Here, friend Visākha, an uninstructed worldling, who does not see the noble ones, is unskilled in the noble Dhamma, and is undisciplined in the noble Dhamma; who does not see true persons, is unskilled in the Dhamma of true persons, and is undisciplined in the Dhamma of true persons, regards form as self, or self as possessing form, or form as in self, or self as in form. He regards feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness as self, or self as possessing consciousness, or consciousness as in self, or self as in consciousness. This, friend Visākha, is how identity view comes to be.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Na kho, āvuso visākha, ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena tayo khandhā saṅgahitā; tīhi ca kho, āvuso visākha, khandhehi ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅgahito. Yā cāvuso visākha, sammāvācā yo ca sammākammanto yo ca sammāājīvo ime dhammā sīlakkhandhe saṅgahitā. Yo ca sammāvāyāmo yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāsamādhi ime dhammā samādhikkhandhe saṅgahitā. Yā ca sammādiṭṭhi yo ca sammāsaṅkappo, ime dhammā paññākkhandhe saṅgahitā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，并非圣八支道含摄三蕴，而是三蕴含摄圣八支道。贤友毘舍佉，凡是正语、正业、正命，此等诸法被含摄于戒蕴中。凡是正精进、正念、正定，此等诸法被含摄于定蕴中。凡是正见、正思惟，此等诸法被含摄于慧蕴中。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, the three aggregates are not included in the Noble Eightfold Path; rather, friend Visākha, the Noble Eightfold Path is included in the three aggregates. Whatever is right speech, right action, and right livelihood—these things are included in the aggregate of virtue. Whatever is right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration—these things are included in the aggregate of concentration. Whatever is right view and right intention—these things are included in the aggregate of wisdom.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sādhayye’’ti kho visākho upāsako dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi – ‘‘‘sakkāyasamudayo sakkāyasamudayo’ti, ayye, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, ayye, sakkāyasamudayo vutto bhagavatā’’ti? ‘‘Yāyaṃ, āvuso visākha, taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandīrāgasahagatā tatratatrābhinandinī, seyyathidaṃ – kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā; ayaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, sakkāyasamudayo vutto bhagavatā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “善哉，尊者！”优婆塞毘舍佉欢喜、随喜法施比丘尼所说，并进一步提问：“尊者，人们常说‘有身集(sakkāyasamudaya)、有身集’。尊者，世尊所说的有身集是什么呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，正是那导致再生(ponobbhavikā)、伴随喜贪(nandīrāgasahagatā)、处处耽著(tatratatrābhinandinī)的渴爱(taṇhā)，即：欲爱(kāmataṇhā)、有爱(bhavataṇhā)、无有爱(vibhavataṇhā)。贤友毘舍佉，这就是世尊所说的有身集。”
rows.english: “Very good, venerable lady,” said the lay follower Visākha, having delighted in and rejoiced at the words of the bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā, asked her a further question: “‘The origin of identity, the origin of identity,’ venerable lady, it is said. Now what, venerable lady, is the origin of identity declared by the Blessed One?” “It is this craving, friend Visākha, which leads to renewed existence, is accompanied by delight and lust, and delights in this or that, namely: craving for sensual pleasures, craving for existence, and craving for non-existence. This, friend Visākha, is the origin of identity declared by the Blessed One.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idhāvuso visākha, sutavā ariyasāvako, ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto, na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. Na vedanaṃ…pe… na saññaṃ… na saṅkhāre…pe… na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ , na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. Evaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，于此，有闻圣弟子得见诸圣者，善巧于圣法，于圣法中善受教导；得见诸善士，善巧于善士法，于善士法中善受教导。彼不观色为我，不观我为有色者，不观色于我中，亦不观我于色中。不观受……不观想……不观行……不观识为我，不观我为有识者，不观识于我中，亦不观我于识中。贤友毘舍佉，如是则无有身见。”
rows.english: “Here, friend Visākha, an instructed noble disciple, who sees the noble ones, is skilled in the noble Dhamma, and is well-disciplined in the noble Dhamma; who sees true persons, is skilled in the Dhamma of true persons, and is well-disciplined in the Dhamma of true persons, does not regard form as self, or self as possessing form, or form as in self, or self as in form. He does not regard feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness as self, or self as possessing consciousness, or consciousness as in self, or self as in consciousness. This, friend Visākha, is how identity view does not come to be.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā sukhaṃ sātaṃ vedayitaṃ – ayaṃ sukhā vedanā. Yaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ – ayaṃ dukkhā vedanā. Yaṃ kho, āvuso visākha, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā neva sātaṃ nāsātaṃ vedayitaṃ – ayaṃ adukkhamasukhā vedanā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，凡是身的或心的、快乐的、愉悦的感受，这是乐受。贤友毘舍佉，凡是身的或心的、痛苦的、不愉悦的感受，这是苦受。贤友毘舍佉，凡是身的或心的、非愉悦非不愉悦的感受，这是不苦不乐受。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, whatever is felt, whether bodily or mental, that is pleasant and agreeable—this is pleasant feeling. Whatever is felt, whether bodily or mental, that is painful and disagreeable—this is painful feeling. Whatever is felt, whether bodily or mental, that is neither agreeable nor disagreeable—this is neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.”

rows.pali: 460 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. Atha kho visākho upāsako yena dhammadinnā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho visākho upāsako dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca – ‘‘‘sakkāyo sakkāyo’ti, ayye, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, ayye, sakkāyo vutto bhagavatā’’ti? ‘‘Pañca kho ime, āvuso visākha, upādānakkhandhā sakkāyo vutto bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ – rūpupādānakkhandho, vedanupādānakkhandho, saññupādānakkhandho, saṅkhārupādānakkhandho, viññāṇupādānakkhandho. Ime kho, āvuso visākha, pañcupādānakkhandhā sakkāyo vutto bhagavatā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 460. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住在王舍城(Rājagaha)的竹林迦兰陀园(Kalandakanivāpa)。那时，优婆塞毘舍佉(Visākha)去到比丘尼法施(Dhammadinnā)那里；上前礼敬法施比丘尼，然后坐在一旁。坐在一旁后，优婆塞毘舍佉对法施比丘尼说：“尊者，人们常说‘有身(sakkāya)、有身’。尊者，世尊所说的有身是什么呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，这五取蕴(upādānakkhandhā)是世尊所说的有身，即：色取蕴、受取蕴、想取蕴、行取蕴、识取蕴。贤友毘舍佉，这五取蕴是世尊所说的有身。”
rows.english: 460. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrels' Feeding Place. Then the lay follower Visākha approached the bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā; having approached, he paid homage to the bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, the lay follower Visākha said this to the bhikkhunī Dhammadinnā: “‘Identity, identity,’ venerable lady, it is said. Now what, venerable lady, is the identity declared by the Blessed One?” “These five aggregates of clinging, friend Visākha, are the identity declared by the Blessed One; that is—the form aggregate of clinging, the feeling aggregate of clinging, the perception aggregate of clinging, the volitional formations aggregate of clinging, and the consciousness aggregate of clinging. These, friend Visākha, are the five aggregates of clinging declared as identity by the Blessed One.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Na kho, āvuso visākha, sabbāya sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo pahātabbo, na sabbāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo pahātabbo , na sabbāya adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo pahātabbo. Idhāvuso visākha, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Rāgaṃ tena pajahati, na tattha rāgānusayo anuseti. Idhāvuso visākha, bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘kudāssu nāmāhaṃ tadāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yadariyā etarahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantī’ti? Iti anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihāppaccayā domanassaṃ. Paṭighaṃ tena pajahati, na tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Idhāvuso visākha, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā, dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā, adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Avijjaṃ tena pajahati, na tattha avijjānusayo anusetī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友毘舍佉，不是对一切乐受都要断除贪随眠，不是对一切苦受都要断除瞋随眠，不是对一切不苦不乐受都要断除无明随眠。贤友毘舍佉，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻有伺，由离而生喜与乐，具足初禅而住。他由此舍断贪，于彼，贪随眠不潜伏。贤友毘舍佉，于此，比丘如此省察：‘诸圣者如今具足何处而住，我何时才能具足彼处而住？’如是，当他对无上解脱生起渴望时，缘于渴望而生起忧。他由此舍断瞋，于彼，瞋随眠不潜伏。贤友毘舍佉，于此，比丘因舍离乐、舍离苦，以及先前已灭除喜与忧，具足不苦不乐、由舍而念清净的第四禅而住。他由此舍断无明，于彼，无明随眠不潜伏。
rows.english: It is not, friend Visākha, that the underlying tendency to lust is to be abandoned in all pleasant feeling, nor that the underlying tendency to aversion is to be abandoned in all painful feeling, nor that the underlying tendency to ignorance is to be abandoned in all neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. Here, friend Visākha, a bhikkhu, secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by directed thought and evaluation, with rapture and pleasure born of seclusion. By that, he abandons lust, and the underlying tendency to lust does not lie dormant therein. Here, friend Visākha, a bhikkhu reflects thus: ‘When shall I enter and dwell in that sphere that the noble ones now enter and dwell in?’ As he generates longing for the unsurpassed liberations, grief arises in him on account of that longing. By that, he abandons aversion, and the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie dormant therein. Here, friend Visākha, a bhikkhu, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous passing away of joy and grief, enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. By that, he abandons ignorance, and the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant therein.

rows.pali: 467 . Atha kho visākho upāsako dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho visākho upāsako yāvatako ahosi dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi. Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā visākhaṃ upāsakaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘paṇḍitā, visākha, dhammadinnā bhikkhunī, mahāpaññā, visākha, dhammadinnā bhikkhunī. Maṃ cepi tvaṃ, visākha, etamatthaṃ puccheyyāsi, ahampi taṃ evamevaṃ byākareyyaṃ, yathā taṃ dhammadinnāya bhikkhuniyā byākataṃ. Eso cevetassa esovetassa (syā. kaṃ.) attho. Evañca naṃ evametaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.) dhārehī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 467. 于是，优婆塞毘舍佉对法施比丘尼所说感到欢喜、随喜，从座而起，礼敬法施比丘尼，右绕后，前往世尊之处。抵达后，他礼敬世尊，坐于一旁。坐于一旁的优婆塞毘舍佉，将他与法施比丘尼的全部谈话都禀告了世尊。如是禀告后，世尊对优婆塞毘舍佉说：‘毘舍佉，法施比丘尼是贤智的；毘舍佉，法施比丘尼是大慧的。毘舍佉，你若以此义问我，我也会如法施比丘尼所解释的那样解释。此即是其义，你当如是受持。’”
rows.english: 467. Then the lay follower Visākha, having rejoiced and delighted in the words of the nun Dhammadinnā, rose from his seat, paid homage to the nun Dhammadinnā, circumambulated her respectfully, and went to the Blessed One. Having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the lay follower Visākha reported to the Blessed One the entire conversation he had with the nun Dhammadinnā. When this was said, the Blessed One said to the lay follower Visākha: “The nun Dhammadinnā is wise, Visākha; the nun Dhammadinnā has great wisdom. If you were to ask me about this matter, Visākha, I would explain it in exactly the same way as the nun Dhammadinnā explained it. This is indeed its meaning. And you should bear it in mind thus.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa panāyye, bhikkhuno kiṃninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti kiṃpoṇaṃ kiṃpabbhāra’’nti? ‘‘Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāra’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，从想受灭尽定出定的比丘，心倾向于什么？趋向于什么？偏向于什么呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，从想受灭尽定出定的比丘，心倾向于远离，趋向于远离，偏向于远离。”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, when a bhikkhu has emerged from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, to what is his mind inclined, to what does it lean, to what does it tend?” “Friend Visākha, when a bhikkhu has emerged from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, his mind is inclined to seclusion, it leans to seclusion, it tends to seclusion.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhāya panāyye, vedanāya kiṃ anusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya kiṃ anusayo anuseti, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya kiṃ anusayo anusetī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，于乐受中，有何随眠潜伏？于苦受中，有何随眠潜伏？于不苦不乐受中，有何随眠潜伏？”
rows.english: “But, venerable lady, what underlying tendency lies dormant in pleasant feeling, what underlying tendency lies dormant in painful feeling, and what underlying tendency lies dormant in neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Na kho, āvuso visākha, saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahissa’nti vā, ‘ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhahāmī’ti vā, ‘ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhito’ti vā. Atha khvāssa pubbeva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tathattāya upanetī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友毘舍佉，从想受灭定出定的比丘，实则不会生起这样的心：‘我将从想受灭定出定’，或‘我正从想受灭定出定’，或‘我已从想受灭定出定’。而是他先前就已如此培育的心，将他引向那种状态。”
rows.english: “Friend Visākha, it is not that when a bhikkhu is emerging from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling, it occurs to him: ‘I will emerge from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling,’ or ‘I am emerging from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling,’ or ‘I have emerged from the attainment of the cessation of perception and feeling.’ Rather, his mind has previously been developed in such a way that it leads to such a state.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Taññeva nu kho, ayye, upādānaṃ te teva (sī.) pañcupādānakkhandhā udāhu aññatra pañcahupādānakkhandhehi upādāna’’nti? ‘‘Na kho, āvuso visākha, taññeva upādānaṃ te pañcupādānakkhandhā, nāpi aññatra pañcahupādānakkhandhehi upādānaṃ. Yo kho, āvuso visākha, pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādāna’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，是执取（upādāna）就是那五取蕴呢，还是执取在五取蕴之外呢？”“贤友毘舍佉，执取既非那五取蕴，亦非在五取蕴之外。贤友毘舍佉，凡于五取蕴中的欲贪（chandarāga），那就是此处的执取。”
rows.english: “Venerable lady, is that clinging the same as the five aggregates of clinging, or is clinging something apart from the five aggregates of clinging?” “Friend Visākha, clinging is not the same as the five aggregates of clinging, nor is clinging something apart from the five aggregates of clinging. But, friend Visākha, whatever desire and lust there is regarding the five aggregates of clinging—that is the clinging in that case.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa kāmacchandassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa kāmacchandassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa kāmacchandassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于此，诸比丘，比丘若自身内有欲贪(kāmacchanda)，则了知‘我自身内有欲贪’；若自身内无欲贪，则了知‘我自身内无欲贪’。并且了知未生起的欲贪如何生起，已生起的欲贪如何断除，以及已断除的欲贪于未来如何不再生起。
rows.english: Here, monks, when sensual desire is present internally, a monk understands: ‘Sensual desire is present in me internally’; when sensual desire is not present internally, he understands: ‘Sensual desire is not present in me internally.’ He understands how unarisen sensual desire comes to arise, how arisen sensual desire is abandoned, and how abandoned sensual desire does not arise again in the future.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ byāpādaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ byāpādo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ byāpādaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ byāpādo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa byāpādassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa byāpādassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa byāpādassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “若自身内有瞋(byāpāda)，则了知‘我自身内有瞋’；若自身内无瞋，则了知‘我自身内无瞋’。并且了知未生起的瞋如何生起，已生起的瞋如何断除，以及已断除的瞋于未来如何不再生起。
rows.english: When ill will is present internally, he understands: ‘Ill will is present in me internally’; when ill will is not present internally, he understands: ‘Ill will is not present in me internally.’ He understands how unarisen ill will comes to arise, how arisen ill will is abandoned, and how abandoned ill will does not arise again in the future.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vicikicchaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ vicikicchā’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vicikicchaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ vicikicchā’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannāya vicikicchāya uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannāya vicikicchāya pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnāya vicikicchāya āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 或于内有疑，了知：‘我于内有疑。’或于内无疑，了知：‘我于内无疑。’亦了知未生之疑如何生起，亦了知已生之疑如何断除，亦了知已断除之疑于未来如何不生。
rows.english: When doubt is present internally, he understands: ‘Doubt is present in me internally’; when doubt is not present internally, he understands: ‘Doubt is not present in me internally.’ He understands how unarisen doubt comes to arise, how arisen doubt is abandoned, and how abandoned doubt does not arise again in the future.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhuñca pajānāti, rūpe ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，于此，比丘了知眼根，亦了知色，亦了知缘此二者而生起的结；亦了知未生之结如何生起，亦了知已生之结如何断除，亦了知已断之结未来如何不复生起。
rows.english: “Here, monks, a monk knows distinctly the eye, and he knows distinctly forms, and he knows distinctly the fetter that arises dependent on both. He knows distinctly how the arising of an unarisen fetter comes to be; he knows distinctly how the abandonment of an arisen fetter comes to be; and he knows distinctly how the non-arising in the future of an abandoned fetter comes to be.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sotañca pajānāti, sadde ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “了知耳根，亦了知声，亦了知缘此二者而生起的结；亦了知未生之结如何生起，亦了知已生之结如何断除，亦了知已断之结未来如何不复生起。
rows.english: “He knows distinctly the ear, and he knows distinctly sounds, and he knows distinctly the fetter that arises dependent on both. He knows distinctly how the arising of an unarisen fetter comes to be; he knows distinctly how the abandonment of an arisen fetter comes to be; and he knows distinctly how the non-arising in the future of an abandoned fetter comes to be.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ghānañca pajānāti, gandhe ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “了知鼻根，亦了知香，亦了知缘此二者而生起的结；亦了知未生之结如何生起，亦了知已生之结如何断除，亦了知已断之结未来如何不复生起。
rows.english: “He knows distinctly the nose, and he knows distinctly odors, and he knows distinctly the fetter that arises dependent on both. He knows distinctly how the arising of an unarisen fetter comes to be; he knows distinctly how the abandonment of an arisen fetter comes to be; and he knows distinctly how the non-arising in the future of an abandoned fetter comes to be.

rows.pali: ‘‘Jivhañca pajānāti, rase ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti , yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “了知舌根，亦了知味，亦了知缘此二者而生起的结；亦了知未生之结如何生起，亦了知已生之结如何断除，亦了知已断之结未来如何不复生起。
rows.english: “He knows distinctly the tongue, and he knows distinctly tastes, and he knows distinctly the fetter that arises dependent on both. He knows distinctly how the arising of an unarisen fetter comes to be; he knows distinctly how the abandonment of an arisen fetter comes to be; and he knows distinctly how the non-arising in the future of an abandoned fetter comes to be.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kāyañca pajānāti, phoṭṭhabbe ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 了知身，了知所触，亦了知缘于彼二者所生起之结；了知未生之结如何生起，了知已生之结如何断除，亦了知已断之结于未来如何不复生起。
rows.english: “He knows distinctly the body, and he knows distinctly tangible objects, and he knows distinctly the fetter that arises dependent on both. He knows distinctly how the arising of an unarisen fetter comes to be; he knows distinctly how the abandonment of an arisen fetter comes to be; and he knows distinctly how the non-arising in the future of an abandoned fetter comes to be.

rows.pali: ‘‘Manañca pajānāti, dhamme ca pajānāti, yañca tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṃyojanaṃ tañca pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa saṃyojanassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa saṃyojanassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa saṃyojanassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 了知意，了知法，亦了知缘于彼二者所生起之结；了知未生之结如何生起，了知已生之结如何断除，亦了知已断之结于未来如何不复生起。
rows.english: “He knows distinctly the mind, and he knows distinctly mental objects, and he knows distinctly the fetter that arises dependent on both. He knows distinctly how the arising of an unarisen fetter comes to be; he knows distinctly how the abandonment of an arisen fetter comes to be; and he knows distinctly how the non-arising in the future of an abandoned fetter comes to be.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 自身内部有择法觉支(dhammavicayasambojjhaṅga)时，了知：‘我自身内部有择法觉支’；自身内部无择法觉支时，了知：‘我自身内部无择法觉支’。了知未生的择法觉支生起的因缘，亦了知已生的择法觉支通过培育而圆满的因缘。
rows.english: When the investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor is present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor is present in me internally.’ When the investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ vīriyasambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 自身内部有精进觉支(vīriyasambojjhaṅga)时，了知：‘我自身内部有精进觉支’；自身内部无精进觉支时，了知：‘我自身内部无精进觉支’。了知未生的精进觉支生起的因缘，亦了知已生的精进觉支通过培育而圆满的因缘。
rows.english: When the energy enlightenment factor is present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The energy enlightenment factor is present in me internally.’ When the energy enlightenment factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The energy enlightenment factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen energy enlightenment factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen energy enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若于内有喜觉支，则如实了知‘我于内有喜觉支’；若于内无喜觉支，则如实了知‘我于内无喜觉支’。亦如实了知未生之喜觉支以何因缘而生起，亦如实了知已生之喜觉支以何因缘而修习圆满。
rows.english: When the rapture enlightenment factor is present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The rapture enlightenment factor is present in me internally.’ When the rapture enlightenment factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The rapture enlightenment factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen rapture enlightenment factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen rapture enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若于内有轻安觉支，则如实了知‘我于内有轻安觉支’；若于内无轻安觉支，则如实了知‘我于内无轻安觉支’。亦如实了知未生之轻安觉支以何因缘而生起，亦如实了知已生之轻安觉支以何因缘而修习圆满。
rows.english: When the tranquility enlightenment factor is present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The tranquility enlightenment factor is present in me internally.’ When the tranquility enlightenment factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The tranquility enlightenment factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen tranquility enlightenment factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen tranquility enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ samādhisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若于内有定觉支，则如实了知‘我于内有定觉支’；若于内无定觉支，则如实了知‘我于内无定觉支’。亦如实了知未生之定觉支以何因缘而生起，亦如实了知已生之定觉支以何因缘而修习圆满。
rows.english: When the concentration enlightenment factor is present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The concentration enlightenment factor is present in me internally.’ When the concentration enlightenment factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The concentration enlightenment factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen concentration enlightenment factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen concentration enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti , asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若于内有舍觉支，则如实了知‘我于内有舍觉支’；若于内无舍觉支，则如实了知‘我于内无舍觉支’。亦如实了知未生之舍觉支以何因缘而生起，亦如实了知已生之舍觉支以何因缘而修习圆满。
rows.english: When the equanimity enlightenment factor is present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The equanimity enlightenment factor is present in me internally.’ When the equanimity enlightenment factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The equanimity enlightenment factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen equanimity enlightenment factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen equanimity enlightenment factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: 382 . ‘‘Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu. Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu?
rows.chinese_simplified: 382. “再者，诸比丘，比丘如何于诸法随观法而住？于此，诸比丘，比丘于五盖(pañcanīvaraṇa)中，于诸法随观法而住。再者，诸比丘，比丘如何于五盖中，于诸法随观法而住？”
rows.english: 382. And how, monks, does a monk dwell contemplating phenomena in phenomena? Here, monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the five hindrances. And how, monks, does a monk dwell contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the five hindrances?

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ajjhattaṃ vā …pe… viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，或于内身随观身而住……乃至……而住。
rows.english: Thus he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally...

rows.pali: 384 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu. Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu?
rows.chinese_simplified: 384. 再者，诸比丘，比丘于六内外处之法中随观法而住。诸比丘，比丘如何于六内外处之法中随观法而住呢？
rows.english: 384. “Furthermore, monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the six internal and external sense bases. And how, monks, does a monk dwell contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the six internal and external sense bases?

rows.pali: 376 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā…pe… evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 376. 再者，诸比丘，比丘于前进、后退时，具足正知；于前视、旁视时，具足正知；于屈、伸时，具足正知；于持僧伽梨、衣钵时，具足正知；于食、饮、嚼、尝时，具足正知；于大小便时，具足正知；于行、住、坐、卧、醒、语、默时，具足正知。如是，于内身……（中略）……诸比丘，比丘亦如是于身随观身而住。
rows.english: 376. Furthermore, O monks, a monk acts with clear comprehension when going forward and returning; he acts with clear comprehension when looking straight ahead and looking aside; he acts with clear comprehension when bending and stretching his limbs; he acts with clear comprehension in wearing the double-robe, bowl, and other robes; he acts with clear comprehension when eating, drinking, chewing, and savoring; he acts with clear comprehension in the act of defecating and urinating; he acts with clear comprehension when walking, standing, sitting, sleeping, waking, speaking, and keeping silent. Thus he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally... and so forth... In this way too, O monks, a monk dwells contemplating the body in the body.

rows.pali: 385 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu. Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ satisambojjhaṅgo’ti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 385. 再者，诸比丘，比丘于法，于七觉支(bojjhaṅga)中，随观法而住。诸比丘，比丘如何于法，于七觉支中，随观法而住？在此，诸比丘，比丘自身内部有念觉支(satisambojjhaṅga)时，了知：‘我自身内部有念觉支’；自身内部无念觉支时，了知：‘我自身内部无念觉支’。了知未生的念觉支生起的因缘，亦了知已生的念觉支通过培育而圆满的因缘。
rows.english: 385. Furthermore, O monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the seven factors of enlightenment. And how, O monks, does a monk dwell contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the seven factors of enlightenment? Here, O monks, when the mindfulness-enlightenment-factor is present internally, a monk knows distinctly, ‘The mindfulness-enlightenment-factor is present in me internally.’ When the mindfulness-enlightenment-factor is not present internally, he knows distinctly, ‘The mindfulness-enlightenment-factor is not present in me internally.’ He also knows distinctly the cause whereby the unarisen mindfulness-enlightenment-factor arises, and he knows distinctly the cause whereby the arisen mindfulness-enlightenment-factor comes to fulfillment through development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cakkhusamphassajā vedanā loke… sotasamphassajā vedanā loke… ghānasamphassajā vedanā loke… jivhāsamphassajā vedanā loke… kāyasamphassajā vedanā loke… manosamphassajā vedanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “眼触所生受于世间……耳触所生受于世间……鼻触所生受于世间……舌触所生受于世间……身触所生受于世间……意触所生受于世间是可爱、可喜之法，此爱生起时即于此生起，安住时即于此安住。”
rows.english: Feeling born of eye-contact in the world… feeling born of ear-contact in the world… feeling born of nose-contact in the world… feeling born of tongue-contact in the world… feeling born of body-contact in the world… feeling born of mind-contact in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cakkhusamphassajā vedanā loke… sotasamphassajā vedanā loke … ghānasamphassajā vedanā loke… jivhāsamphassajā vedanā loke… kāyasamphassajā vedanā loke… manosamphassajā vedanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “眼触所生受在世间……耳触所生受在世间……鼻触所生受在世间……舌触所生受在世间……身触所生受在世间……意触所生受在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。”
rows.english: Feeling born of eye-contact in the world… feeling born of ear-contact in the world… feeling born of nose-contact in the world… feeling born of tongue-contact in the world… feeling born of body-contact in the world… feeling born of mind-contact in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sā kho panesā, bhikkhave, taṇhā kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati, kattha nivisamānā nivisati? Yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，此爱于何处生起而生起，于何处安住而安住？于世间，凡是可爱、可喜之法，此爱即于彼处生起而生起，于彼处安住而安住。”
rows.english: And where, bhikkhus, does this craving, when arising, arise? Where, when settling, does it settle? Whatever in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature, it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpā loke… saddā loke… gandhā loke… rasā loke… phoṭṭhabbā loke… dhammā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “色于世间……声于世间……香于世间……味于世间……触于世间……法于世间是可爱、可喜之法，此爱生起时即于此生起，安住时即于此安住。”
rows.english: Forms in the world… sounds in the world… odors in the world… tastes in the world… tangible objects in the world… mental phenomena in the world are of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ loke… sotaviññāṇaṃ loke… ghānaviññāṇaṃ loke… jivhāviññāṇaṃ loke… kāyaviññāṇaṃ loke… manoviññāṇaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “眼识于世间……耳识于世间……鼻识于世间……舌识于世间……身识于世间……意识于世间是可爱、可喜之法，此爱生起时即于此生起，安住时即于此安住。”
rows.english: Eye-consciousness in the world… ear-consciousness in the world… nose-consciousness in the world… tongue-consciousness in the world… body-consciousness in the world… mind-consciousness in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cakkhusamphasso loke… sotasamphasso loke… ghānasamphasso loke… jivhāsamphasso loke… kāyasamphasso loke… manosamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “眼触于世间……耳触于世间……鼻触于世间……舌触于世间……身触于世间……意触于世间是可爱、可喜之法，此爱生起时即于此生起，安住时即于此安住。”
rows.english: Eye-contact in the world… ear-contact in the world… nose-contact in the world… tongue-contact in the world… body-contact in the world… mind-contact in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpasaññā loke… saddasaññā loke… gandhasaññā loke… rasasaññā loke… phoṭṭhabbasaññā loke… dhammasaññā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于世间，色想……于世间，声想……于世间，香想……于世间，味想……于世间，触想……于世间，法想是可爱之法、可喜之法。当此爱生起时，即于此生起；当其安住时，即于此安住。
rows.english: Perception of forms in the world… perception of sounds in the world… perception of odors in the world… perception of tastes in the world… perception of tangible objects in the world… perception of mental phenomena in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpasañcetanā loke… saddasañcetanā loke… gandhasañcetanā loke… rasasañcetanā loke… phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā loke… dhammasañcetanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于世间，色思……于世间，声思……于世间，香思……于世间，味思……于世间，触思……于世间，法思是可爱之法、可喜之法。当此爱生起时，即于此生起；当其安住时，即于此安住。
rows.english: Volition regarding forms in the world… volition regarding sounds in the world… volition regarding odors in the world… volition regarding tastes in the world… volition regarding tangible objects in the world… volition regarding mental phenomena in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpataṇhā loke… saddataṇhā loke… gandhataṇhā loke… rasataṇhā loke… phoṭṭhabbataṇhā loke… dhammataṇhā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于世间，色爱……于世间，声爱……于世间，香爱……于世间，味爱……于世间，触爱……于世间，法爱是可爱之法、可喜之法。当此爱生起时，即于此生起；当其安住时，即于此安住。
rows.english: Craving for forms in the world… craving for sounds in the world… craving for odors in the world… craving for tastes in the world… craving for tangible objects in the world… craving for mental phenomena in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpavitakko loke… saddavitakko loke… gandhavitakko loke… rasavitakko loke… phoṭṭhabbavitakko loke… dhammavitakko loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于世间，色寻……于世间，声寻……于世间，香寻……于世间，味寻……于世间，触寻……于世间，法寻是可爱之法、可喜之法。当此爱生起时，即于此生起；当其安住时，即于此安住。
rows.english: Initial thought regarding forms in the world… initial thought regarding sounds in the world… initial thought regarding odors in the world… initial thought regarding tastes in the world… initial thought regarding tangible objects in the world… initial thought regarding mental phenomena in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sā kho panesā, bhikkhave, taṇhā kattha pahīyamānā pahīyati, kattha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati? Yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “那么，比丘们，此爱在哪里被舍弃，在哪里被灭尽呢？凡世间有可爱、可喜之法，此爱即于此处被舍弃，即于此处被灭尽。
rows.english: And where, bhikkhus, when this craving is being abandoned, is it abandoned? Where, when it is ceasing, does it cease? Whatever in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature, it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpā loke… saddā loke… gandhā loke… rasā loke… phoṭṭhabbā loke… dhammā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “色在世间……声在世间……香在世间……味在世间……触在世间……法在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。”
rows.english: Visible forms in the world… sounds in the world… odors in the world… tastes in the world… tangible objects in the world… mental phenomena in the world are of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ loke… sotaviññāṇaṃ loke… ghānaviññāṇaṃ loke… jivhāviññāṇaṃ loke… kāyaviññāṇaṃ loke… manoviññāṇaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “眼识在世间……耳识在世间……鼻识在世间……舌识在世间……身识在世间……意识在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。”
rows.english: Eye-consciousness in the world… ear-consciousness in the world… nose-consciousness in the world… tongue-consciousness in the world… body-consciousness in the world… mind-consciousness in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cakkhusamphasso loke… sotasamphasso loke… ghānasamphasso loke… jivhāsamphasso loke… kāyasamphasso loke… manosamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “眼触在世间……耳触在世间……鼻触在世间……舌触在世间……身触在世间……意触在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。”
rows.english: Eye-contact in the world… ear-contact in the world… nose-contact in the world… tongue-contact in the world… body-contact in the world… mind-contact in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpasaññā loke… saddasaññā loke… gandhasaññā loke… rasasaññā loke… phoṭṭhabbasaññā loke… dhammasaññā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “色想在世间……声想在世间……香想在世间……味想在世间……触想在世间……法想在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。”
rows.english: Perception of forms in the world… perception of sounds in the world… perception of odors in the world… perception of tastes in the world… perception of tangible objects in the world… perception of mental phenomena in the world is a dear form and a pleasant form; therein this craving, being abandoned, is abandoned; therein, ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpasañcetanā loke… saddasañcetanā loke… gandhasañcetanā loke… rasasañcetanā loke… phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā loke… dhammasañcetanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “世间中的色思……声思……香思……味思……触思……世间中的法思是可爱、可喜的。此渴爱于此被断时即断，于此灭时即灭。”
rows.english: Volition regarding forms in the world… volition regarding sounds in the world… volition regarding odors in the world… volition regarding tastes in the world… volition regarding tangible objects in the world… volition regarding mental phenomena in the world is a dear form and a pleasant form; therein this craving, being abandoned, is abandoned; therein, ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpataṇhā loke… saddataṇhā loke… gandhataṇhā loke… rasataṇhā loke… phoṭṭhabbataṇhā loke… dhammataṇhā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “世间中的色渴爱……声渴爱……香渴爱……味渴爱……触渴爱……世间中的法渴爱是可爱、可喜的。此渴爱于此被断时即断，于此灭时即灭。”
rows.english: Craving for forms in the world… craving for sounds in the world… craving for odors in the world… craving for tastes in the world… craving for tangible objects in the world… craving for mental phenomena in the world is a dear form and a pleasant form; therein this craving, being abandoned, is abandoned; therein, ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpavitakko loke… saddavitakko loke… gandhavitakko loke… rasavitakko loke… phoṭṭhabbavitakko loke… dhammavitakko loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “世间中的色寻……声寻……香寻……味寻……触寻……世间中的法寻是可爱、可喜的。此渴爱于此被断时即断，于此灭时即灭。”
rows.english: Initial thought on forms in the world… initial thought on sounds in the world… initial thought on odors in the world… initial thought on tastes in the world… initial thought on tangible objects in the world… initial thought on mental phenomena in the world is a dear form and a pleasant form; therein this craving, being abandoned, is abandoned; therein, ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: Iti ajjhattaṃ vā…pe… evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如是，于内……乃至……比丘们，比丘亦如是于身随观身而住。”
rows.english: Thus he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally... and so forth... In this way too, O monks, a monk dwells contemplating the body in the body.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ? Cakkhu loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati. Sotaṃ loke…pe… ghānaṃ loke… jivhā loke… kāyo loke… mano loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “世间什么是可喜的、可悦的？眼在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。耳在世间……乃至……鼻在世间……舌在世间……身在世间……意在世间是可喜的、可悦的，此渴爱于此被舍断，于此而灭尽。”
rows.english: And what in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature? The eye in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases. The ear in the world… the nose in the world… the tongue in the world… the body in the world… the mind in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when being abandoned, is abandoned; it is there that, when ceasing, it ceases.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ kaṅkehi vā khajjamānaṃ sunakhehi vā khajjamānaṃ byagghehi vā khajjamānaṃ dīpīhi vā khajjamānaṃ siṅgālehi vā gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ, suvānehi vā khajjamānaṃ, sigālehi vā khajjamānaṃ, (syā. pī.) khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ. So imameva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati – ‘ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸比丘，比丘犹如看见被弃于墓地的尸体，正被乌鸦啄食，或被鹰(kulala)啄食，或被秃鹫啄食，或被鹭(kaṅka)啄食，或被狗啃食，或被虎啃食，或被豹啃食，或被豺狼啃食，或被种种生物啃食。他便将此应用于自身：‘此身亦有如是法，成如是状，不越于此。’
rows.english: Furthermore, O monks, a monk might see a body discarded in a charnel ground, being devoured by crows, hawks, vultures, herons, dogs, tigers, leopards, jackals, or by various kinds of creatures. He applies this to his own body, thinking: ‘This body, too, has such a nature, will become like that, and has not gone beyond that state.’

rows.pali: 373 . ‘‘Ekāyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā, sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 373. “诸比丘，此是唯一的道路，为众生之清净，为超越愁、悲，为灭尽苦、忧，为证得正道，为作证涅槃，此即是四念处。
rows.english: 373. “Bhikkhus, this is the one and only path for the purification of beings, for the overcoming of sorrow and lamentation, for the disappearance of pain and grief, for the attainment of the true way, for the realization of Nibbāna—namely, the four foundations of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati ‘atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，或于内诸法中，安住于法随观；或于外诸法中，安住于法随观；或于内外诸法中，安住于法随观。或于诸法中，安住于观集法；或于诸法中，安住于观灭法；或于诸法中，安住于观集灭法。或‘有法’之念现前，仅为智、仅为念。他无所依而住，且不执取世间任何事物。诸比丘，比丘亦如是于五盖诸法中，安住于法随观。
rows.english: Thus he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena internally, or externally, or both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in phenomena, or the nature of passing away in phenomena, or the nature of both arising and passing away in phenomena. Or his mindfulness is established with the thought, 'Phenomena exist,' just for the sake of knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way too, monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the five hindrances.

rows.pali: 401 . ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhaṃ dukkhanirodho (syā.) ariyasaccaṃ? Yo tassāyeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 401. “比丘们，什么是苦灭圣谛？即是对那渴爱的无余离贪与灭尽、舍弃、舍离、解脱、无执著。
rows.english: 401. And what, bhikkhus, is the Noble Truth of the Cessation of Suffering? It is the remainderless fading and cessation of that very craving, the relinquishing, the casting off, the liberation from, and the non-reliance on it.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhantu, bhikkhave, sattavassāni. Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya cha vassāni…pe… pañca vassāni… cattāri vassāni… tīṇi vassāni… dve vassāni… ekaṃ vassaṃ… tiṭṭhatu, bhikkhave, ekaṃ vassaṃ. Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya sattamāsāni, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme aññā; sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，且置七年。比丘们，若有任何人如此修习此四念处六年……五年……四年……三年……二年……一年……比丘们，且置一年。比丘们，若有任何人如此修习此四念处七个月，于二果之中，可预期其一：于现法中得究竟智；或于有余依时，得不还果。”
rows.english: “Let alone seven years, bhikkhus. Whoever, bhikkhus, should develop these four foundations of mindfulness in this way for six years… five years… four years… three years… two years… one year… Let alone one year, bhikkhus. Whoever, bhikkhus, should develop these four foundations of mindfulness in this way for seven months, one of two fruits is to be expected for him: either final knowledge in this very life or, if there is a residue of clinging, non-returning.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katame cattāro? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ, vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ, citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ, dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “是哪四种呢？诸比丘，于此，比丘于身随观身而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于受随观受而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于心随观心而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于法随观法而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。
rows.english: “What are the four? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and grief in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and grief in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and grief in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating dhammas in dhammas, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and grief in regard to the world.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo? Nekkhammasaṅkappo abyāpādasaṅkappo avihiṃsāsaṅkappo, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是正思惟？出离思惟、无瞋思惟、无害思惟，比丘们，这被称为正思惟。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Intention? The intention of renunciation, the intention of non-ill will, and the intention of non-harming—this, bhikkhus, is called Right Intention.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ thinamiddha’nti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ thinamiddha’nti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa thinamiddhassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa thinamiddhassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa thinamiddhassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “若自身内有昏沉睡眠(thinamiddha)，则了知‘我自身内有昏沉睡眠’；若自身内无昏沉睡眠，则了知‘我自身内无昏沉睡眠’。并且了知未生起的昏沉睡眠如何生起，已生起的昏沉睡眠如何断除，以及已断除的昏沉睡眠于未来如何不再生起。”
rows.english: When sloth and torpor are present internally, he understands: ‘Sloth and torpor are present in me internally’; when sloth and torpor are not present internally, he understands: ‘Sloth and torpor are not present in me internally.’ He understands how unarisen sloth and torpor come to arise, how arisen sloth and torpor are abandoned, and how abandoned sloth and torpor do not arise again in the future.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkuccaṃ ‘atthi me ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkucca’nti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkuccaṃ ‘natthi me ajjhattaṃ uddhaccakukkucca’nti pajānāti, yathā ca anuppannassa uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādo hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa uddhaccakukkuccassa pahānaṃ hoti tañca pajānāti, yathā ca pahīnassa uddhaccakukkuccassa āyatiṃ anuppādo hoti tañca pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 或于内有掉举、追悔，了知：‘我于内有掉举、追悔。’或于内无掉举、追悔，了知：‘我于内无掉举、追悔。’亦了知未生之掉举、追悔如何生起，亦了知已生之掉举、追悔如何断除，亦了知已断除之掉举、追悔于未来如何不生。
rows.english: When restlessness and remorse are present internally, he understands: ‘Restlessness and remorse are present in me internally’; when restlessness and remorse are not present internally, he understands: ‘Restlessness and remorse are not present in me internally.’ He understands how unarisen restlessness and remorse come to arise, how arisen restlessness and remorse are abandoned, and how abandoned restlessness and remorse do not arise again in the future.

rows.pali: 378 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ yathāṭhitaṃ yathāpaṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati – ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 378. “再者，比丘们，比丘即于此身，如其所住，如其所置，依界省察：‘于此身中，有地界、水界、火界、风界。’”
rows.english: 378. Furthermore, O monks, a monk reflects on this very body, just as it is placed, just as it is disposed, by way of the elements: ‘In this body there is the earth element, the water element, the fire element, and the air element.’

rows.pali: 402 . ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ? Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 402. “比丘们，什么是导向苦灭的行道圣谛？正是此八支圣道，即：正见、正思惟、正语、正业、正命、正精进、正念、正定。”
rows.english: 402. “And what, bhikkhus, is the Noble Truth of the Path Leading to the Cessation of Suffering? It is this very Noble Eightfold Path, namely: Right View, Right Intention, Right Speech, Right Action, Right Livelihood, Right Effort, Right Mindfulness, and Right Concentration.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sammākammanto? Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī adinnādānā veramaṇī kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammākammanto.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是正业？即远离杀生、远离不与取、远离邪淫。比丘们，这被称为正业。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Action? Abstaining from the destruction of life, abstaining from taking what is not given, and abstaining from sexual misconduct—this, bhikkhus, is called Right Action.”

rows.pali: 375 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gacchanto vā ‘gacchāmī’ti pajānāti, ṭhito vā ‘ṭhitomhī’ti pajānāti, nisinno vā ‘nisinnomhī’ti pajānāti, sayāno vā ‘sayānomhī’ti pajānāti, yathā yathā vā panassa kāyo paṇihito hoti, tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 375. 再者，诸比丘，比丘行走时，了知‘我正在行走’；站立时，了知‘我正在站立’；坐着时，了知‘我正在坐着’；躺卧时，了知‘我正在躺卧’。或其身如何安住，他即如是了知。如是，于内身随观身而住，或于外身随观身而住，或于内外身随观身而住。于身随观集法而住，或于身随观灭法而住，或于身随观集灭法而住。或复，他的念现前：‘有身’，仅为增长智见与正念。他无所依止而住，于世间无所执取。诸比丘，比丘亦如是于身随观身而住。
rows.english: 375. Furthermore, O monks, a monk, when walking, knows, ‘I am walking.’ When standing, he knows, ‘I am standing.’ When sitting, he knows, ‘I am sitting.’ When lying down, he knows, ‘I am lying down.’ Or, in whatever way his body is disposed, he knows it in that very way. Thus he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally, or he dwells contemplating the body in the body externally, or he dwells contemplating the body in the body both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the phenomena of arising in the body, or he dwells contemplating the phenomena of passing away in the body, or he dwells contemplating the phenomena of arising and passing away in the body. Or, his mindfulness is established with the thought, ‘The body exists,’ just to the extent necessary for knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way too, O monks, a monk dwells contemplating the body in the body.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi , bhikkhave, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā catumahāpathe bilaso vibhajitvā nisinno assa, evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ yathāṭhitaṃ yathāpaṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati – ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，譬如熟练的屠牛者或其弟子，屠牛之后，于四衢道口，将其分成部分而坐。正是如此，比丘们，比丘即于此身，如其所住，如其所置，依界省察：‘于此身中，有地界、水界、火界、风界。’”
rows.english: Just as, O monks, a skilled butcher or a butcher’s apprentice, having killed a cow, might sit at a crossroads after dividing it into portions; in the same way, O monks, a monk reflects on this very body—just as it is placed, just as it is disposed—by way of the elements: ‘In this body there is the earth element, the water element, the fire element, and the air element.’

rows.pali: 393 . ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ? Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 393. “诸比丘，什么是苦？诸比丘，凡是身体的痛苦、身体的不快，由身触所生的痛苦、不快的感受，诸比丘，这被称为苦。”
rows.english: 393. And what, bhikkhus, is pain? Whatever, bhikkhus, is bodily pain, bodily displeasure, the painful, unpleasant feeling born of bodily contact—this, bhikkhus, is called pain.

rows.pali: 377 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati – ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ, hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ, antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ karīsaṃ matthaluṅgaṃ (ka.) , pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā mutta’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 377. “再者，比丘们，比丘省察此身，自足底而上，自发顶而下，以皮为边际，充满种种不净：‘于此身中，有发、毛、爪、齿、皮，肉、筋、骨、骨髓、肾，心、肝、肋膜、脾、肺，肠、肠间膜、胃中物、粪，胆汁、痰、脓、血、汗、脂肪，泪、膏、唾、涕、关节滑液、尿。’”
rows.english: 377. Furthermore, O monks, a monk reflects on this very body, upwards from the soles of the feet, downwards from the tips of the hair, bounded by skin, and full of many kinds of impurities: ‘In this body there are head-hairs, body-hairs, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, bone-marrow, kidneys, heart, liver, pleura, spleen, lungs, large intestine, small intestine, stomach contents, feces, bile, phlegm, pus, blood, sweat, solid fat, tears, liquid fat, saliva, nasal mucus, synovial fluid, and urine.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ…pe… aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ nimaṃsalohitamakkhitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ…pe… aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ apagatamaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ…pe… aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni apagatanhārusambandhāni (syā.) disā vidisā vikkhittāni, aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphakaṭṭhikaṃ ‘‘aññena gopphakaṭṭhika’’nti idaṃ sī. syā. pī. potthakesu natthi aññena jaṅghaṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūruṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭiṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭaṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhaṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṇḍakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsukaṭṭhikaṃ aññena uraṭṭhikaṃ aññena aṃsaṭṭhikaṃ aññena bāhuṭṭhikaṃ (syā.) aññena phāsukaṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhiṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandhaṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭaṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhaṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṇḍakaṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsukaṭṭhikaṃ aññena uraṭṭhikaṃ aññena aṃsaṭṭhikaṃ aññena bāhuṭṭhikaṃ (syā.) aññena gīvaṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanukaṭṭhikaṃ aññena dantaṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ. So imameva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati – ‘ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸比丘，比丘犹如看见被弃于墓地的尸体：一具骸骨，尚有血肉，筋腱相连……乃至……一具骸骨，无肉，血迹斑斑，筋腱相连……乃至……一具骸骨，无有血肉，筋腱相连……乃至……骸骨四散，分离零落，手骨一处，脚骨一处，踝骨一处，胫骨一处，股骨一处，髋骨一处，肋骨一处，脊骨一处，肩骨一处，颈骨一处，颚骨一处，牙骨一处，头盖骨一处。他即以此身相比对：‘此身亦是如此法，亦成如此状，未超越此状。’
rows.english: Furthermore, monks, just as a monk might see a body discarded in a charnel ground: a skeleton with flesh and blood, held together by sinews... a skeleton without flesh but smeared with blood, held together by sinews... a skeleton without flesh and blood, held together by sinews... bones unconnected and scattered in various directions—a hand-bone in one place, a foot-bone in another, an ankle-bone in another, a shin-bone in another, a thigh-bone in another, a hip-bone in another, a rib-bone in another, a spine-bone in another, a shoulder-bone in another, a neck-bone in another, a jaw-bone in another, a tooth-bone in another, a skull in another. He applies this to his own body, reflecting: ‘This body, too, is of such a nature, it will become like that, it cannot transcend it.’

rows.pali: 400 . ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ dukkhasamudayo (syā.) ariyasaccaṃ? Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā ponobhavikā (sī. pī.) nandīrāgasahagatā nandirāgasahagatā (sī. syā. pī.) tatratatrābhinandinī, seyyathidaṃ – kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 400. “诸比丘，什么是苦集圣谛？即此引致再生、与喜贪俱行、于处处喜乐之爱，也就是：欲爱、有爱、无有爱。”
rows.english: 400. And what, bhikkhus, is the Noble Truth of the Origin of Suffering? It is this craving, which brings about renewed existence, is accompanied by delight and lust, and delights in this and that. It is as follows: craving for sensual pleasures, craving for existence, and craving for non-existence.

rows.pali: 394 . ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, domanassaṃ? Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, domanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 394. “诸比丘，什么是忧？诸比丘，凡是心的痛苦、心的不快，由意触所生的痛苦、不快的感受，诸比丘，这被称为忧。”
rows.english: 394. And what, bhikkhus, is distress? Whatever, bhikkhus, is mental pain, mental displeasure, the painful, unpleasant feeling born of mental contact—this, bhikkhus, is called distress.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sammāvācā? Musāvādā veramaṇī veramaṇi (ka.) pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī samphappalāpā veramaṇī, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammāvācā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是正语？即远离妄语、远离离间语、远离粗恶语、远离无益语。比丘们，这被称为正语。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Speech? Abstaining from false speech, abstaining from divisive speech, abstaining from harsh speech, and abstaining from idle chatter—this, bhikkhus, is called Right Speech.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sammāājīvo? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako micchāājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammāājīvo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是正命？比丘们，于此，圣弟子舍离邪命，以正命维持生命。比丘们，这被称为正命。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Livelihood? Here, bhikkhus, a noble disciple, having abandoned wrong livelihood, earns his living by Right Livelihood—this, bhikkhus, is called Right Livelihood.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati. ‘Atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya, anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，或于内法随观法而住，或于外法随观法而住，或于内外法随观法而住。或于诸法随观集法而住，或随观灭法而住，或随观集灭法而住。或‘有诸法’之念现前，仅为增长智与念；无所依而住，于世间无所取着。诸比丘，比丘如是于六内外处随观法而住。
rows.english: “Thus he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena internally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena externally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of both arising and passing away in phenomena. Or, his mindfulness that ‘phenomena exist’ is established just for the sake of knowledge and continued mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way, monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the six internal and external sense bases.”

rows.pali: 404 . ‘‘Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya sattavassāni, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme aññā; sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 404. “比丘们，若有任何人如此修习此四念处七年，于二果之中，可预期其一：于现法中得究竟智(aññā)；或于有余依时，得不还果(anāgāmitā)。”
rows.english: 404. “Bhikkhus, whoever develops these four foundations of mindfulness in this way for seven years, one of two fruits is to be expected for him: either final knowledge in this very life, or, if there is a residue of clinging, non-returning.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi? Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是正见？比丘们，凡于苦之智，于苦集之智，于苦灭之智，于导向苦灭之道之智，比丘们，这被称为正见。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right View? Knowledge of suffering, bhikkhus, knowledge of the origin of suffering, knowledge of the cessation of suffering, and knowledge of the path leading to the cessation of suffering—this, bhikkhus, is called Right View.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati ‘atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati sattasu bojjhaṅgesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，或于内法随观法而住，或于外法随观法而住，或于内外法随观法而住。或于诸法随观集法而住，或于诸法随观灭法而住，或于诸法随观集灭法而住。又，彼‘有法’之念现前，仅为增长智与念故。彼无所依而住，且不执取世间任何事物。诸比丘，比丘即如是于七觉支诸法中随观法而住。
rows.english: Thus he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena internally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena externally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of arising and passing away in phenomena. Or his mindfulness is established with the thought, ‘Phenomena exist,’ just for the sake of knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way, O monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the seven factors of enlightenment.

rows.pali: 403 . ‘‘Iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati. ‘Atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catūsu ariyasaccesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 403. “如是，或于内法随观法而住，或于外法随观法而住，或于内外法随观法而住。或于诸法中随观集法而住，或于诸法中随观灭法而住，或于诸法中随观生灭法而住。或他生起‘有法’之念，仅为增长智见与正念故，无所依止而住，亦不执取世间任何事物。比丘们，比丘亦如是于四圣谛，于诸法随观法而住。”
rows.english: 403. “Thus he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena internally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena externally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of origination in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of dissolution in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of origination and dissolution in phenomena. Or, his mindfulness is established with the thought, ‘Phenomena exist,’ just to the extent necessary for knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the Four Noble Truths.”

rows.pali: 399 . ‘‘Katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā? Seyyathidaṃ – rūpupādānakkhandho, vedanupādānakkhandho, saññupādānakkhandho, saṅkhārupādānakkhandho, viññāṇupādānakkhandho. Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 399. “再者，比丘们，简要而言，作为苦的五取蕴是什么？即：色取蕴、受取蕴、想取蕴、行取蕴、识取蕴。比丘们，简要而言，这五种取蕴被称为苦。比丘们，这被称为苦圣谛。”
rows.english: 399. And what, bhikkhus, in brief, are the five aggregates of clinging that are suffering? They are as follows: the aggregate of clinging to form, the aggregate of clinging to feeling, the aggregate of clinging to perception, the aggregate of clinging to formations, and the aggregate of clinging to consciousness. These, bhikkhus, in brief, are called the five aggregates of clinging that are suffering. This, bhikkhus, is called the Noble Truth of Suffering.

rows.pali: 379 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātaṃ. So imameva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati – ‘ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 379. 复次，诸比丘，比丘犹如看见被弃于墓地的尸体，死后一日、或二日、或三日，已肿胀、青瘀、脓烂。他便将此应用于自身：‘此身亦有如是法，成如是状，不越于此。’
rows.english: 379. Furthermore, O monks, a monk might see a body discarded in a charnel ground—dead for one day, two days, or three days—bloated, discolored, and festering. He applies this to his own body, thinking: ‘This body, too, has such a nature, will become like that, and has not gone beyond that state.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpavicāro loke… saddavicāro loke… gandhavicāro loke… rasavicāro loke… phoṭṭhabbavicāro loke… dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于世间，色伺……于世间，声伺……于世间，香伺……于世间，味伺……于世间，触伺……于世间，法伺是可爱之法、可喜之法。当此爱生起时，即于此生起；当其安住时，即于此安住。比丘们，这被称为苦集圣谛。
rows.english: Sustained thought regarding forms in the world… sustained thought regarding sounds in the world… sustained thought regarding odors in the world… sustained thought regarding tastes in the world… sustained thought regarding tangible objects in the world… sustained thought regarding mental phenomena in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles. This, bhikkhus, is called the Noble Truth of the Origin of Suffering.

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpavicāro loke… saddavicāro loke… gandhavicāro loke… rasavicāro loke… phoṭṭhabbavicāro loke… dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ , etthesā taṇhā pahīyamānā pahīyati, ettha nirujjhamānā nirujjhati. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “世间中的色伺……声伺……香伺……味伺……触伺……世间中的法伺是可爱、可喜的。此渴爱于此被断时即断，于此灭时即灭。比丘们，这被称为苦灭圣谛。”
rows.english: Sustained thought on forms in the world… sustained thought on sounds in the world… sustained thought on odors in the world… sustained thought on tastes in the world… sustained thought on tangible objects in the world… sustained thought on mental phenomena in the world is a dear form and a pleasant form; therein this craving, being abandoned, is abandoned; therein, ceasing, it ceases. This, bhikkhus, is called the Noble Truth of the Cessation of Suffering.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, dakkho bhamakāro vā bhamakārantevāsī vā dīghaṃ vā añchanto ‘dīghaṃ añchāmī’ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā añchanto ‘rassaṃ añchāmī’ti pajānāti evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘rassaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘rassaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti. ‘Sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho evampi (sī. syā. pī.) , bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，譬如善巧的旋匠或其弟子，拉长时，了知：‘我拉长’；拉短时，了知：‘我拉短’。正是如此，诸比丘，比丘长出息时，了知：‘我长出息’；长入息时，了知：‘我长入息’；短出息时，了知：‘我短出息’；短入息时，了知：‘我短入息’。他修学：‘我将觉知全身而出息’；他修学：‘我将觉知全身而入息’。他修学：‘我将令身行寂止而出息’；他修学：‘我将令身行寂止而入息’。如是，于内身随观身而住，或于外身随观身而住，或于内外身随观身而住。或于身随观集法而住，或于身随观灭法而住，或于身随观集灭法而住。又，彼‘有身’之念现前，仅为智与念。他无所依而住，且于世间无所执取。诸比丘，比丘亦如是于身随观身而住。”
rows.english: “Just as, bhikkhus, a skilled turner or his apprentice, when making a long turn, knows: ‘I am making a long turn,’ or when making a short turn, knows: ‘I am making a short turn’; even so, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, breathing in long, knows: ‘I breathe in long’; or breathing out long, he knows: ‘I breathe out long’; breathing in short, he knows: ‘I breathe in short’; or breathing out short, he knows: ‘I breathe out short’. He trains himself: ‘I shall breathe in experiencing the whole body’; he trains himself: ‘I shall breathe out experiencing the whole body’. He trains himself: ‘I shall breathe in calming the bodily formation’; he trains himself: ‘I shall breathe out calming the bodily formation’. In this way he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally, or he dwells contemplating the body in the body externally, or he dwells contemplating the body in the body both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in the body, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in the body, or he dwells contemplating the nature of both arising and passing away in the body. Or his mindfulness is established with the thought: ‘The body exists,’ just to the extent necessary for knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way too, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body.

rows.pali: 395 . ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, upāyāso? Yo kho, bhikkhave, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upāyāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 395. “诸比丘，什么是恼？诸比丘，凡是有人遭遇某种灾患，被某种苦法所触，而有恼、剧恼、恼乱的状态、剧恼的状态，诸比丘，这被称为恼。”
rows.english: 395. And what, bhikkhus, is despair? Whatever, bhikkhus, for one who is beset by some misfortune or other, who is touched by some painful state or other, is the tribulation, the deep tribulation, the state of tribulation, the state of deep tribulation—this, bhikkhus, is called despair.

rows.pali: 391 . ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, soko? Yo kho, bhikkhave, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, soko.
rows.chinese_simplified: 391. “诸比丘，什么是愁？诸比丘，凡是有人遭遇某种灾患，被某种苦法所触，而生起愁、愁思、愁苦、内愁、内剧愁，诸比丘，这被称为愁。”
rows.english: 391. And what, bhikkhus, is sorrow? Whatever, bhikkhus, for one who is beset by some misfortune or other, who is touched by some painful state or other, is the sorrow, the sorrowing, the state of sorrow, inner sorrow, inner deep sorrow—this, bhikkhus, is called sorrow.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ? Cakkhu loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati. Sotaṃ loke…pe… ghānaṃ loke… jivhā loke… kāyo loke… mano loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etthesā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于世间，什么是可爱、可喜之法？眼于世间是可爱、可喜之法，此爱生起时即于此生起，安住时即于此安住。耳于世间……乃至……鼻于世间……舌于世间……身于世间……意于世间是可爱、可喜之法，此爱生起时即于此生起，安住时即于此安住。”
rows.english: And what in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature? The eye in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles. The ear in the world… the nose in the world… the tongue in the world… the body in the world… the mind in the world is of a dear nature and a pleasant nature; it is there that this craving, when arising, arises; it is there that, when settling, it settles.

rows.pali: 372 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kurūsu viharati kammāsadhammaṃ nāma kurūnaṃ nigamo. Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘bhikkhavo’’ti. ‘‘Bhaddante’’ti bhadanteti (sī. syā. pī.) te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 372. 如是我闻：一时，世尊住于俱卢国(Kurū)，一个名叫剑磨瑟昙(Kammāsadhamma)的俱卢人市镇。在那里，世尊对诸比丘说：“诸比丘。”那些比丘回答世尊：“大德。”世尊如此说道：
rows.english: 372. Thus have I heard. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Kurus, at a market town of the Kurus named Kammāsadhamma. There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus: "Bhikkhus." "Venerable sir," they replied. The Blessed One said this:

rows.pali: 388 . ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, jāti? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, jāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 388. 诸比丘，何为生？于彼彼有情类中，彼彼有情之生、出生、入胎、再生，诸蕴之显现，诸处之获得，诸比丘，此被称为生。
rows.english: 388. And what, bhikkhus, is birth? Whatever, for various beings in the various orders of beings, is the birth, coming to be, descent, production, the manifestation of the aggregates, the acquisition of the sense bases—this, bhikkhus, is called birth.

rows.pali: 392 . ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, paridevo? Yo kho, bhikkhave, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave paridevo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 392. “诸比丘，什么是悲？诸比丘，凡是有人遭遇某种灾患，被某种苦法所触，而有哀号、悲叹、号哭、哀泣、号哭的状态、哀泣的状态，诸比丘，这被称为悲。”
rows.english: 392. And what, bhikkhus, is lamentation? Whatever, bhikkhus, for one who is beset by some misfortune or other, who is touched by some painful state or other, is the wailing, the lamenting, the act of wailing, the act of lamenting, the state of one who wails, the state of one who laments—this, bhikkhus, is called lamentation.

rows.pali: 387 . ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ?
