Jātipi dukkhā, jarāpi dukkhā, maraṇampi dukkhaṃ, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāpi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogopi dukkho, piyehi vippayogopi dukkho appiyehi…pe… vippayogo dukkhotipāṭho ceva taṃniddeso ca katthaci na dissati, aṭṭhakathāyaṃpi taṃsaṃvaṇṇanā natthi , yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā pañcupādānakkhandhāpi (ka.) dukkhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 387. 诸比丘，何为苦圣谛？生是苦，老是苦，死是苦，愁、悲、苦、忧、恼是苦，与不爱者会合是苦，与所爱者别离是苦，所求不得亦是苦。简言之，五取蕴是苦。
rows.english: 387. And what, bhikkhus, is the Noble Truth of Suffering? Birth is suffering, aging is suffering, death is suffering; sorrow, lamentation, pain, distress, and despair are suffering; association with the unloved is suffering; separation from the loved is suffering; not getting what one wants is suffering; in brief, the five aggregates subject to clinging are suffering.

rows.pali: 389 . ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, jarā? Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, jarā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 389. “诸比丘，什么是老？对于种种有情，于其种种有情众中，凡有年老、衰朽、齿坏、发白、皮皱、寿命损减、诸根衰熟，诸比丘，这被称为老。”
rows.english: 389. And what, bhikkhus, is aging? Whatever, for various beings in the various orders of beings, is the aging, decrepitude, brokenness of teeth, graying of hair, wrinkling of skin, the decline of life, the ripening of the faculties—this, bhikkhus, is called aging.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhantu , bhikkhave, satta māsāni. Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya cha māsāni…pe… pañca māsāni… cattāri māsāni… tīṇi māsāni … dve māsāni… ekaṃ māsaṃ… aḍḍhamāsaṃ… tiṭṭhatu, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāso. Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāveyya sattāhaṃ, tassa dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme aññā; sati vā upādisese anāgāmitāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，且置七个月。任何比丘若如是修习此四念处六个月……五个月……四个月……三个月……二个月……一个月……半个月……诸比丘，且置半个月。任何比丘若如是修习此四念处七日，可预期二果之一：于现法中得究竟智；或若有余依，则为不还果。”
rows.english: “Let alone seven months, bhikkhus. Whoever, bhikkhus, should develop these four foundations of mindfulness in this way for six months… five months… four months… three months… two months… one month… half a month… Let alone half a month, bhikkhus. Whoever, bhikkhus, should develop these four foundations of mindfulness in this way for seven days, one of two fruits is to be expected for him: either final knowledge in this very life or, if there is a residue of clinging, non-returning.”

rows.pali: 383 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu. Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu – ‘iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo; iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo; iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo, iti saññāya atthaṅgamo; iti saṅkhārā, iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo, iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti, iti ajjhattaṃ vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā dhammesu viharati. ‘Atthi dhammā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya, anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati . Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 383. 再者，诸比丘，比丘于五取蕴之法中随观法而住。诸比丘，比丘如何于五取蕴之法中随观法而住呢？诸比丘，于此，比丘[了知]：‘此即是色，此即是色之生起，此即是色之灭；此即是受，此即是受之生起，此即是受之灭；此即是想，此即是想之生起，此即是想之灭；此即是诸行，此即是诸行之生起，此即是诸行之灭；此即是识，此即是识之生起，此即是识之灭。’如是，或于内诸法中随观法而住，或于外诸法中随观法而住，或于内外诸法中随观法而住。或于诸法中随观生法而住，或于诸法中随观灭法而住，或于诸法中随观生灭法而住。或复，彼之念现起：‘有诸法。’仅为长养智与念。彼无所依而住，于世间中不执取任何事物。诸比丘，比丘亦如是于五取蕴之法中随观法而住。
rows.english: 383. “Furthermore, monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the five aggregates of clinging. And how, monks, does a monk dwell contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the five aggregates of clinging? Here, monks, a monk understands: ‘Such is form, such is the arising of form, such is the cessation of form; such is feeling, such is the arising of feeling, such is the cessation of feeling; such is perception, such is the arising of perception, such is the cessation of perception; such are formations, such is the arising of formations, such is the cessation of formations; such is consciousness, such is the arising of consciousness, such is the cessation of consciousness.’ Thus he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena internally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena externally, or he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in phenomena, or he dwells contemplating the nature of both arising and passing away in phenomena. Or, his mindfulness that ‘phenomena exist’ is established just for the sake of knowledge and continued mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way, monks, a monk dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the five aggregates of clinging.”

rows.pali: 405 . ‘‘Ekāyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti. Iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vutta’’nti. Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 405. “诸比丘，此是唯一的道路，为了众生的清净，为了超越愁悲，为了灭尽苦忧，为了获得正理，为了证悟涅槃，此即四念处。如是所说，即是依此而说。”世尊说此语已，彼诸比丘心生欢喜，赞叹世尊所说。
rows.english: 405. “Bhikkhus, this is the direct path for the purification of beings, for the overcoming of sorrow and lamentation, for the cessation of pain and grief, for the attainment of the right method, and for the realization of Nibbāna—namely, the four foundations of mindfulness. Thus it was said, and it was in reference to this that it was said. This is what the Blessed One said. The bhikkhus were delighted and rejoiced in the Blessed One’s words.”

rows.pali: 374 . ‘‘Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. So satova assasati, satova passasati. Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti. Rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘rassaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘rassaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti. ‘Sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati , ‘sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati. ‘Passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 374. “再者，诸比丘，比丘如何于身随观身而住呢？诸比丘，于此，比丘或去到林野，或去到树下，或去到空静处，结跏趺坐，端正其身，置念于面前。他具念地出息，具念地入息。出息长时，他了知：‘我出息长’；入息长时，他了知：‘我入息长’。出息短时，他了知：‘我出息短’；入息短时，他了知：‘我入息短’。他修学：‘我将觉知全息身而出息’；他修学：‘我将觉知全息身而入息’。他修学：‘我将平息身行而出息’；他修学：‘我将平息身行而入息’。
rows.english: 374. “And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu dwell contemplating the body in the body? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, having gone to the forest, or to the root of a tree, or to an empty place, sits down. Having folded his legs crosswise, set his body erect, and established mindfulness in front of him, ever mindful he breathes in, and ever mindful he breathes out. Breathing in long, he knows: ‘I breathe in long’; or breathing out long, he knows: ‘I breathe out long’. Breathing in short, he knows: ‘I breathe in short’; or breathing out short, he knows: ‘I breathe out short’. He trains himself: ‘I shall breathe in experiencing the whole body’; he trains himself: ‘I shall breathe out experiencing the whole body’. He trains himself: ‘I shall breathe in calming the bodily formation’; he trains himself: ‘I shall breathe out calming the bodily formation’.

rows.pali: 390 . ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ? Yaṃ aṭṭhakathā oloketabbā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvitindriyassupacchedo, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 390. “诸比丘，什么是死？对于种种有情，从其种种有情众中，凡有死没、逝去、崩坏、消失、死亡、命终、寿尽、诸蕴的破坏、身体的舍弃、命根的断绝，诸比丘，这被称为死。”
rows.english: 390. And what, bhikkhus, is death? Whatever, for various beings from this or that order of beings, is the passing, the passing away, the breaking up, the disappearance, dying, death, the completion of time, the breaking up of the aggregates, the casting off of the body, the cutting off of the life faculty—this, bhikkhus, is called death.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sammāsati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ; vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ; citte cittānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ; dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammāsati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是正念？诸比丘，于此，比丘于身随观身而住，热忱，正知，具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于受随观受而住，热忱，正知，具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于心随观心而住，热忱，正知，具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于法随观法而住，热忱，正知，具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。诸比丘，这称为正念。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Mindfulness? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. This, bhikkhus, is called Right Mindfulness.”

rows.pali: 396 . ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho? Idha yassa te honti aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā, ye vā panassa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukakāmā ayogakkhemakāmā, yā tehi saddhiṃ saṅgati samāgamo samodhānaṃ missībhāvo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 396. 诸比丘，何为与不爱者结合之苦？于此，对某人而言，有不可意、不喜爱、不合意的色、声、香、味、触、法；或有欲其无利、无益、不安乐、不安稳者。与彼等相会、聚合、和合、杂处，诸比丘，此谓与不爱者结合之苦。
rows.english: 396. And what, bhikkhus, is the suffering of association with the unloved? Here, for a person, there are forms, sounds, smells, tastes, tangible objects, or mental phenomena which are unwished for, unloved, and disagreeable; or there are those who wish one ill, who wish one harm, who wish one discomfort, who wish one insecurity; whatever association, meeting, coming together, or mixing with them there is—this, bhikkhus, is called the suffering of association with the unloved.

rows.pali: 380 . ‘‘Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti . Dukkhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Adukkhamasukhaṃ vā vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Sāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti, nirāmisaṃ vā sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Sāmisaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘sāmisaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti, nirāmisaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘nirāmisaṃ dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Sāmisaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘sāmisaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti, nirāmisaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘nirāmisaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā vedanāsu viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā vedanāsu viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā vedanāsu viharati. ‘Atthi vedanā’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 380. 那么，诸比丘，比丘如何于诸受中随观受而住？诸比丘，于此，比丘感受乐受时，了知‘我感受乐受’；感受苦受时，了知‘我感受苦受’；感受不苦不乐受时，了知‘我感受不苦不乐受’。感受有染的乐受时，了知‘我感受有染的乐受’；感受无染的乐受时，了知‘我感受无染的乐受’。感受有染的苦受时，了知‘我感受有染的苦受’；感受无染的苦受时，了知‘我感受无染的苦受’。感受有染的不苦不乐受时，了知‘我感受有染的不苦不乐受’；感受无染的不苦不乐受时，了知‘我感受无染的不苦不乐受’。如是，或于内于诸受随观受而住，或于外于诸受随观受而住，或于内外于诸受随观受而住。或于诸受随观集法而住，或于诸受随观灭法而住，或于诸受随观集灭法而住。或‘有受’之念现前，仅为增长智与念。他无所依止而住，于世间不执取任何事物。诸比丘，比丘亦如是于诸受中随观受而住。
rows.english: 380. And how, monks, does a monk dwell contemplating feelings in feelings? Here, monks, when experiencing a pleasant feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing a pleasant feeling.’ When experiencing a painful feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing a painful feeling.’ When experiencing a neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing a neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.’ When experiencing a worldly pleasant feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing a worldly pleasant feeling’; when experiencing an unworldly pleasant feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing an unworldly pleasant feeling.’ When experiencing a worldly painful feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing a worldly painful feeling’; when experiencing an unworldly painful feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing an unworldly painful feeling.’ When experiencing a worldly neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing a worldly neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling’; when experiencing an unworldly neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, he discerns: ‘I am experiencing an unworldly neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.’ Thus he dwells contemplating feelings in feelings internally, or he dwells contemplating feelings in feelings externally, or he dwells contemplating feelings in feelings both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in feelings, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in feelings, or he dwells contemplating the nature of arising and passing away in feelings. Or his mindfulness is established that ‘There is feeling,’ just to the extent necessary for knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way too, monks, a monk dwells contemplating feelings in feelings.

rows.pali: 398 . ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ? Jātidhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati – ‘aho vata mayaṃ na jātidhammā assāma, na ca vata no jāti āgaccheyyā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ, idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. Jarādhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati – ‘aho vata mayaṃ na jarādhammā assāma, na ca vata no jarā āgaccheyyā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ, idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. Byādhidhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati ‘aho vata mayaṃ na byādhidhammā assāma, na ca vata no byādhi āgaccheyyā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ, idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. Maraṇadhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati ‘aho vata mayaṃ na maraṇadhammā assāma, na ca vata no maraṇaṃ āgaccheyyā’ti. Na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ, idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ. Sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammānaṃ, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ evaṃ icchā uppajjati ‘aho vata mayaṃ na sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā assāma, na ca vata no sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā āgaccheyyu’nti. Na kho panetaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ, idampi yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 398. “比丘们，什么是‘所求不得也是苦’？比丘们，有生法的众生生起这样的愿望：‘啊，愿我们没有生法，愿生不要降临于我们！’但这并不能通过愿望而得到，这也是所求不得之苦。比丘们，有老法的众生生起这样的愿望：‘啊，愿我们没有老法，愿老不要降临于我们！’但这并不能通过愿望而得到，这也是所求不得之苦。比丘们，有病法的众生生起这样的愿望：‘啊，愿我们没有病法，愿病不要降临于我们！’但这并不能通过愿望而得到，这也是所求不得之苦。比丘们，有死法的众生生起这样的愿望：‘啊，愿我们没有死法，愿死不要降临于我们！’但这并不能通过愿望而得到，这也是所求不得之苦。比丘们，有愁、悲、苦、忧、恼法的众生生起这样的愿望：‘啊，愿我们没有愁、悲、苦、忧、恼法，愿愁、悲、苦、忧、恼不要降临于我们！’但这并不能通过愿望而得到，这也是所求不得之苦。”
rows.english: 398. And what, bhikkhus, is ‘not getting what one wishes is also suffering’? To beings subject to birth, bhikkhus, this wish arises: ‘Oh, that we were not subject to birth, and that birth would not come to us!’ But this is not to be attained by wishing. This, too, is not getting what one wishes, which is suffering. To beings subject to aging, bhikkhus, this wish arises: ‘Oh, that we were not subject to aging, and that aging would not come to us!’ But this is not to be attained by wishing. This, too, is not getting what one wishes, which is suffering. To beings subject to illness, bhikkhus, this wish arises: ‘Oh, that we were not subject to illness, and that illness would not come to us!’ But this is not to be attained by wishing. This, too, is not getting what one wishes, which is suffering. To beings subject to death, bhikkhus, this wish arises: ‘Oh, that we were not subject to death, and that death would not come to us!’ But this is not to be attained by wishing. This, too, is not getting what one wishes, which is suffering. To beings subject to sorrow, lamentation, pain, distress, and despair, bhikkhus, this wish arises: ‘Oh, that we were not subject to sorrow, lamentation, pain, distress, and despair, and that sorrow, lamentation, pain, distress, and despair would not come to us!’ But this is not to be attained by wishing. This, too, is not getting what one wishes, which is suffering.

rows.pali: 397 . ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, piyehi vippayogo dukkho? Idha yassa te honti iṭṭhā kantā manāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā, ye vā panassa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukakāmā yogakkhemakāmā mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā, yā tehi saddhiṃ asaṅgati asamāgamo asamodhānaṃ amissībhāvo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, piyehi vippayogo dukkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 397. 诸比丘，何为与爱者分离之苦？于此，对某人而言，有可意、喜爱、合意的色、声、香、味、触、法；或有欲其有利、有益、安乐、安稳的母亲、父亲、兄弟、姐妹、朋友、同僚、亲戚血亲。与彼等不相会、不聚合、不和合、不杂处，诸比丘，此谓与爱者分离之苦。
rows.english: 397. And what, bhikkhus, is the suffering of separation from the loved? Here, for a person, there are forms, sounds, smells, tastes, tangible objects, or mental phenomena which are wished for, loved, and agreeable; or there are those who wish one well, who wish one good, who wish one comfort, who wish one security—mother or father, brother or sister, friends or companions, or blood relatives; whatever non-association, non-meeting, not coming together, or non-mixing with them there is—this, bhikkhus, is called the suffering of separation from the loved.

rows.pali: 381 . ‘‘Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu citte cittānupassī viharati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘sarāgaṃ citta’nti pajānāti, vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītarāgaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘sadosaṃ citta’nti pajānāti, vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītadosaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Samohaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘samohaṃ citta’nti pajānāti, vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vītamohaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Saṅkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘saṅkhittaṃ citta’nti pajānāti, vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vikkhittaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ ‘mahaggataṃ citta’nti pajānāti, amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ ‘amahaggataṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ ‘sauttaraṃ citta’nti pajānāti, anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ ‘anuttaraṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘samāhitaṃ citta’nti pajānāti, asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘asamāhitaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘vimuttaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ ‘avimuttaṃ citta’nti pajānāti. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā citte cittānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā cittasmiṃ viharati, ‘atthi citta’nti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati . Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu citte cittānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 381. 诸比丘，比丘如何于心随观心而住？诸比丘，于此，比丘如实了知有贪之心为‘有贪之心’，如实了知离贪之心为‘离贪之心’；如实了知有瞋之心为‘有瞋之心’，如实了知离瞋之心为‘离瞋之心’；如实了知有痴之心为‘有痴之心’，如实了知离痴之心为‘离痴之心’；如实了知收敛之心为‘收敛之心’，如实了知散乱之心为‘散乱之心’；如实了知广大之心为‘广大之心’，如实了知非广大之心为‘非广大之心’；如实了知有上之心为‘有上之心’，如实了知无上之心为‘无上之心’；如实了知得定之心为‘得定之心’，如实了知非得定之心为‘非得定之心’；如实了知解脱之心为‘解脱之心’，如实了知未解脱之心为‘未解脱之心’。如是，或于内于心随观心而住，或于外于心随观心而住，或于内外于心随观心而住。或随观于心之集法而住，或随观于心之灭法而住，或随观于心之集灭法而住。或者，他的念现前，仅知‘有心’，这只是为了增长智见与正念。他无所依止而住，于世间不执取任何事物。诸比丘，比丘即如是于心随观心而住。
rows.english: 381. And how, monks, does a monk dwell contemplating the mind in the mind? Here, monks, he understands a mind with lust as 'a mind with lust,' and a mind without lust as 'a mind without lust.' He understands a mind with hatred as 'a mind with hatred,' and a mind without hatred as 'a mind without hatred.' He understands a mind with delusion as 'a mind with delusion,' and a mind without delusion as 'a mind without delusion.' He understands a constricted mind as 'a constricted mind,' and a scattered mind as 'a scattered mind.' He understands an exalted mind as 'an exalted mind,' and an unexalted mind as 'an unexalted mind.' He understands a surpassable mind as 'a surpassable mind,' and an unsurpassable mind as 'an unsurpassable mind.' He understands a concentrated mind as 'a concentrated mind,' and an unconcentrated mind as 'an unconcentrated mind.' He understands a liberated mind as 'a liberated mind,' and an unliberated mind as 'an unliberated mind.' Thus he dwells contemplating the mind in the mind internally, or he dwells contemplating the mind in the mind externally, or he dwells contemplating the mind in the mind both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in the mind, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in the mind, or he dwells contemplating the nature of both arising and passing away in the mind. Or his mindfulness is established with the thought, 'Mind exists,' just for the sake of knowledge and mindfulness. He dwells independent and clings to nothing in the world. In this way too, monks, a monk dwells contemplating the mind in the mind.

rows.pali: 386 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catūsu ariyasaccesu. Kathañca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati catūsu ariyasaccesu? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 386. 再者，诸比丘，比丘于四圣谛诸法中随观法而住。诸比丘，比丘如何于四圣谛诸法中随观法而住？于此，诸比丘，比丘如实了知：‘此是苦’；如实了知：‘此是苦集’；如实了知：‘此是苦灭’；如实了知：‘此是导向苦灭之道’。
rows.english: 386. Furthermore, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the four Noble Truths. And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu dwell contemplating phenomena in phenomena with regard to the four Noble Truths? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu understands as it actually is: ‘This is suffering’; he understands as it actually is: ‘This is the origin of suffering’; he understands as it actually is: ‘This is the cessation of suffering’; he understands as it actually is: ‘This is the path leading to the cessation of suffering.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sammāvāyāmo? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammāvāyāmo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是正精进？比丘们，于此，比丘为令未生起的诸恶不善法不生起而生起意欲、努力、发起精进、策励心、勤勉；为断除已生起的诸恶不善法而生起意欲、努力、发起精进、策励心、勤勉；为令未生起的诸善法生起而生起意欲、努力、发起精进、策励心、勤勉；为令已生起的诸善法住立、不忘失、增长、广大、修习、圆满而生起意欲、努力、发起精进、策励心、勤勉。比丘们，这被称为正精进。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Effort? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the non-arising of unarisen evil, unwholesome states. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the abandoning of arisen evil, unwholesome states. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the arising of unarisen wholesome states. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the maintenance, non-disappearance, growth, increase, development, and fulfillment of arisen wholesome states. This, bhikkhus, is called Right Effort.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sammāsamādhi? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati, sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave , sammāsamādhi. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是正定？诸比丘，于此，比丘确实远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻有伺，具足离生喜乐的初禅而住。寻、伺寂止，内有净信，心达一境，无寻无伺，具足定生喜乐的第二禅而住。又因离喜而住于舍，具念、正知，以身感受乐，圣者们称之为‘舍、念、乐住’，具足第三禅而住。又因断乐、断苦，先前喜、忧的止息，不苦不乐，具足舍念清净的第四禅而住。诸比丘，这称为正定。诸比丘，这称为导向苦灭之道的圣谛。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is Right Concentration? Here, bhikkhus, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, a bhikkhu enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by initial thought and sustained thought, with rapture and happiness born of seclusion. With the stilling of initial and sustained thought, he enters and dwells in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without initial and sustained thought, with rapture and happiness born of concentration. With the fading of rapture, he dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending; he experiences happiness with the body and enters and dwells in the third jhāna, of which the noble ones declare: ‘Equanimous and mindful, one dwells happily.’ With the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous passing away of joy and grief, he enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither painful nor pleasant and includes the purification of mindfulness by equanimity. This, bhikkhus, is called Right Concentration. This, bhikkhus, is called the Noble Truth of the Path Leading to the Cessation of Suffering.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni…pe… aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni terovassikāni …pe… aṭṭhikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni. So imameva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati – ‘ayampi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto’ti. Iti ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati, ajjhattabahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharati. Samudayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, vayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati, samudayavayadhammānupassī vā kāyasmiṃ viharati. ‘Atthi kāyo’ti vā panassa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāvadeva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati, na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. Evampi kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸比丘，比丘犹如看见被弃于墓地的尸体：骸骨色白，犹如螺贝……乃至……骸骨堆积，已逾三年……乃至……骸骨腐朽，化为粉末。他即以此身相比对：‘此身亦是如此法，亦成如此状，未超越此状。’如是，或于内身随观身而住，或于外身随观身而住，或于内外身随观身而住。或于身随观集法而住，或于身随观灭法而住，或于身随观集灭法而住。或‘有身’之念现前，仅为增长智与念。他无所依而住，且不执取世间任何事物。诸比丘，比丘亦如是于身随观身而住。
rows.english: Furthermore, monks, just as a monk might see a body discarded in a charnel ground: bones white, like the color of a conch shell... a heap of bones more than a year old... bones rotten and crumbled to dust. He applies this to his own body, reflecting: ‘This body, too, is of such a nature, it will become like that, it cannot transcend it.’ Thus he dwells contemplating the body in the body internally, or he dwells contemplating the body in the body externally, or he dwells contemplating the body in the body both internally and externally. He dwells contemplating the nature of arising in the body, or he dwells contemplating the nature of passing away in the body, or he dwells contemplating the nature of arising and passing away in the body. Or his mindfulness that ‘there is a body’ is established, just to the extent necessary for knowledge and mindfulness. And he dwells independent, not clinging to anything in the world. In this way too, monks, a monk dwells contemplating the body in the body.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ubhatomukhā putoḷi mūtoḷī (syā.), mutoli (pī.) pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa, seyyathidaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ. Tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso muñcitvā paccavekkheyya – ‘ime sālī, ime vīhī ime muggā ime māsā ime tilā ime taṇḍulā’ti. Evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati – ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā…pe… mutta’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，譬如一个两端开口的袋子，装满了种种谷物，即：稻、谷、绿豆、黑豆、芝麻、米。有眼之人将它解开后，当如此省察：‘这是稻，这是谷，这是绿豆，这是黑豆，这是芝麻，这是米。’正是如此，比丘们，比丘省察此身，自足底而上，自发顶而下，以皮为边际，充满种种不净：‘于此身中，有发、毛……乃至……尿。’”
rows.english: Just as, O monks, there might be a bag with an opening at both ends, full of many kinds of grain—such as fine rice, paddy, mung beans, black gram, sesame seeds, and husked rice—and a man with good eyesight, having opened it, might reflect: ‘These are fine rice, these are paddy, these are mung beans, these are black gram, these are sesame seeds, these are husked rice.’ In the very same way, O monks, a monk reflects on this very body, upwards from the soles of the feet, downwards from the tips of the hair, bounded by skin, and full of many kinds of impurities: ‘In this body there are head-hairs, body-hairs... and so forth... and urine.’

rows.pali: 250 . ‘‘Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vedanā. Katamā tisso? Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vedanāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 250. “诸比丘，有此三种受。是哪三种呢？乐受、苦受、不苦不乐受。诸比丘，此即是三种受。”
rows.english: 250. “Bhikkhus, there are these three feelings. What are the three? Pleasant feeling, painful feeling, and neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. These, bhikkhus, are the three feelings.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sukhaṃ vā yadi vā dukkhaṃ, adukkhamasukhaṃ saha; Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca, yaṃ kiñci atthi veditaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “无论是乐或苦，以及不苦不乐，内在的与外在的，凡有任何所受之法，
rows.english: “Whether pleasant or painful, together with the neither-painful-nor-pleasant, both internally and externally, whatever feeling there is,

rows.pali: ‘‘Etaṃ dukkhanti ñatvāna, mosadhammaṃ palokinaṃ; Phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ tattha virajjatī’’ti. dutiyaṃ;
rows.chinese_simplified: 了知‘此是苦’，是虚妄、坏灭之法；再再触及而见其消逝，如是于彼离染。”第二。
rows.english: having known this as suffering, of a deceptive and perishable nature, repeatedly contacting its passing away, one thus becomes dispassionate towards it.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ? Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato , mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为比无染更无染之乐？诸比丘，漏尽比丘省察其心已从贪解脱、从瞋解脱、从痴解脱时所生起的乐与喜悦，诸比丘，此被称为比无染更无染之乐。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the pleasure that is more unworldly still? Whatever pleasure and mental joy arise for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed when he reviews his mind as liberated from lust, liberated from hatred, and liberated from delusion—this, bhikkhus, is called the pleasure that is more unworldly still.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti? Yā kho, bhikkhave, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati pīti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为更无染之喜？诸比丘，当漏尽比丘省察心从贪解脱、从瞋解脱、从痴解脱时所生起的喜，诸比丘，此谓更无染之喜。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the joy that is more unworldly still? Whatever joy arises for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed when he reviews his mind as liberated from lust, liberated from hatred, and liberated from delusion—this, bhikkhus, is called the joy that is more unworldly still.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā? Yā kho, bhikkhave, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati upekkhā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是比无染更无染的舍？诸比丘，漏尽比丘省察心从贪解脱、省察心从瞋解脱、省察心从痴解脱时所生起的舍，诸比丘，这被称为比无染更无染的舍。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the equanimity that is more unworldly still? Whatever equanimity arises for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed when he reviews his mind as liberated from lust, liberated from hatred, and liberated from delusion—this, bhikkhus, is called the equanimity that is more unworldly still.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho? Yo kho, bhikkhave, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ paccavekkhato uppajjati vimokkho, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho’’ti. Ekādasamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是比无染更无染的解脱？诸比丘，漏尽比丘省察心从贪解脱、省察心从瞋解脱、省察心从痴解脱时所生起的解脱，诸比丘，这被称为比无染更无染的解脱。”第十一。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the liberation that is more unworldly still? Whatever liberation arises for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed when he reviews his mind as liberated from lust, liberated from hatred, and liberated from delusion—this, bhikkhus, is called the liberation that is more unworldly still.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sāmiso vimokkho? Rūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho sāmiso vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是有染解脱？与色相应的解脱，是有染解脱。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is worldly liberation? Liberation connected with form is worldly liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, nirāmiso vimokkho? Arūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho nirāmiso vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是无染解脱？与无色相应的解脱，是无染解脱。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is unworldly liberation? Liberation connected with the formless is unworldly liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, nirāmisā upekkhā? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā, dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā, adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisā upekkhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为无染之舍？诸比丘，于此，比丘因断乐、断苦，以及先前喜、忧的灭没，进入并安住于不苦不乐、舍念清净的第四禅。诸比丘，此被称为无染之舍。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is unworldly equanimity? Here, bhikkhus, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous passing away of joy and sorrow, a bhikkhu enters and abides in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. This, bhikkhus, is called unworldly equanimity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, nirāmisā pīti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisā pīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为无染喜？诸比丘，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离不善法，有寻有伺，具足离生喜乐，进入初禅而住。寻伺止息，内净，心一境性，无寻无伺，具足定生喜乐，进入第二禅而住。诸比丘，此谓无染喜。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is unworldly joy? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and abides in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by initial application and sustained application, with rapture and pleasure born of seclusion. With the stilling of initial application and sustained application, he enters and abides in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without initial application and sustained application, and has rapture and pleasure born of concentration. This, bhikkhus, is called unworldly joy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sāmisā upekkhā? Pañcime, bhikkhave, kāmaguṇā. Katame pañca? Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā…pe… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāmaguṇā. Yā kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati upekkhā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sāmisā upekkhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为有染之舍？诸比丘，有此五种欲功德。是哪五种？眼所识之色，是可欲、可意、可悦、悦人的，与欲相应、能引染著；……乃至……身所识之触，是可欲、可意、可悦、悦人的，与欲相应、能引染著。诸比丘，此即五种欲功德。诸比丘，凡缘此五种欲功德而生起之舍，此被称为有染之舍。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is worldly equanimity? There are these five cords of sensual pleasure. What five? Forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing… and so on… tangibles cognizable by the body that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing. These, bhikkhus, are the five cords of sensual pleasure. The equanimity that arises in dependence on these five cords of sensual pleasure—this, bhikkhus, is called worldly equanimity.

rows.pali: 279 . ‘‘Atthi , bhikkhave, sāmisā pīti, atthi nirāmisā pīti, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti; atthi sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, atthi nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ; atthi sāmisā upekkhā, atthi nirāmisā upekkhā, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā; atthi sāmiso vimokkho, atthi nirāmiso vimokkho, atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho. Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sāmisā pīti? Pañcime, bhikkhave, kāmaguṇā. Katame pañca? Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā…pe… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāmaguṇā. Yā kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati pīti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sāmisā pīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 279. “诸比丘，有有食饵的喜，有无食饵的喜，有比无食饵更无食饵的喜；有有食饵的乐，有无食饵的乐，有比无食饵更无食饵的乐；有有食饵的舍，有无食饵的舍，有比无食饵更无食饵的舍；有有食饵的解脱，有无食饵的解脱，有比无食饵更无食饵的解脱。诸比丘，什么是那有食饵的喜呢？诸比丘，有此五种欲。是哪五种呢？眼所识的色，是所期望的、可喜的、可悦的、悦意的、与欲相应的、引生染着的……乃至……身所识的触，是所期望的、可喜的、可悦的、悦意的、与欲相应的、引生染着的。诸比丘，此即是五种欲。诸比丘，凡缘此五种欲而生的喜，诸比丘，这称为有食饵的喜。
rows.english: 279. “Bhikkhus, there is worldly joy, there is unworldly joy, and there is a joy more unworldly still; there is worldly pleasure, there is unworldly pleasure, and there is a pleasure more unworldly still; there is worldly equanimity, there is unworldly equanimity, and there is an equanimity more unworldly still; there is worldly liberation, there is unworldly liberation, and there is a liberation more unworldly still. And what, bhikkhus, is worldly joy? There are these five cords of sensual pleasure. What five? Forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing… and so on… tangibles cognizable by the body that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing. These, bhikkhus, are the five cords of sensual pleasure. The joy that arises in dependence on these five cords of sensual pleasure—this, bhikkhus, is called worldly joy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ? Pañcime, bhikkhave, kāmaguṇā. Katame pañca? Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā…pe… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā. Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca kāmaguṇā. Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为有染乐？诸比丘，有五妙欲。是哪五种？眼所识之色，为所欲、所爱、所喜、悦意、与欲相应、引人染著……乃至……身所识之触，为所欲、所爱、所喜、悦意、与欲相应、引人染著。诸比丘，此即五妙欲。诸比丘，凡缘此五妙欲而生的乐与喜悦，此谓有染乐。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is worldly pleasure? There are these five cords of sensual pleasure. What five? Forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing… and so on… tangibles cognizable by the body that are desirable, lovely, agreeable, pleasing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing. These, bhikkhus, are the five cords of sensual pleasure. Whatever pleasure and mental joy arise in dependence on these five cords of sensual pleasure—this, bhikkhus, is called worldly pleasure.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti – ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, nirāmisaṃ sukhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为无染之乐？诸比丘，于此，比丘已离诸欲、离诸不善法，有寻有伺，进入并安住于离生喜乐的初禅。寻、伺寂止，内安靖，心一境性，无寻无伺，进入并安住于定生喜乐的第二禅。又因离喜而住于舍，具念、正知，以身感受乐，即圣者们所宣说的‘具舍、具念、乐住者’，进入并安住于第三禅。诸比丘，此被称为无染之乐。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is unworldly pleasure? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states… enters and abides in the first jhāna… he enters and abides in the second jhāna. With the fading away of rapture, he abides in equanimity, and mindful and clearly comprehending, he experiences pleasure with the body. He enters and abides in the third jhāna, of which the Noble Ones declare: ‘Equanimous and mindful, he abides in pleasure.’ This, bhikkhus, is called unworldly pleasure.

rows.pali: 401 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ. ‘‘Sato, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vihareyya sampajāno. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 401. 舍卫城因缘。“诸比丘，比丘应具念、具正知而住。这是我们对你们的教诫。”
rows.english: 401. At Sāvatthī. ‘Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending. This is our instruction to you.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sato hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ; vedanāsu…pe… citte…pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sato hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何具念呢？诸比丘，于此，比丘于身随观身而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲和忧恼；于受……于心……于法随观法而住，热忱、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲和忧恼。诸比丘，比丘如此就是具念。
rows.english: ‘And how, Bhikkhus, is a bhikkhu mindful? Here, Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings… mind in mind… dhammas in dhammas, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. Thus, Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is mindful.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca , bhikkhave, bhikkhu sampajāno hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti , viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Viditā vitakkā uppajjanti , viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sampajāno hoti. Sato, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vihareyya sampajāno. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī’’ti. Pañcamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何具正知呢？诸比丘，于此，比丘了知受的生起，了知受的显现，了知受的灭去；了知寻的生起，了知寻的显现，了知寻的灭去；了知想的生起，了知想的显现，了知想的灭去。诸比丘，比丘如此就是具正知。诸比丘，比丘应具念、具正知而住。这是我们对你们的教诫。”第五。
rows.english: ‘And how, Bhikkhus, is a bhikkhu clearly comprehending? Here, Bhikkhus, for a bhikkhu, feelings are known as they arise, known as they are present, and known as they cease. Thoughts are known as they arise, known as they are present, and known as they cease. Perceptions are known as they arise, known as they are present, and known as they cease. Thus, Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu is clearly comprehending. Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending. This is our instruction to you.’ Fifth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Atthi kho, ānanda, ekadhammo bhāvito bahulīkato cattāro dhamme paripūreti, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti, satta dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā dve dhamme paripūrentī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，确实有一法，修习、多作即能圆满四法；四法修习、多作即能圆满七法；七法修习、多作即能圆满二法。”
rows.english: “There is, Ānanda, one quality that, when developed and cultivated, fulfills four qualities. Four qualities, when developed and cultivated, fulfill seven qualities. Seven qualities, when developed and cultivated, fulfill two qualities.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ bhāvito kho, ānanda, ānāpānassatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūreti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，像这样修习、这样多修习入出息念定，就能圆满四念处。”
rows.english: “Thus developed, Ānanda, and thus frequently practiced, concentration through mindfulness of breathing fulfills the four establishments of mindfulness.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhuno āraddhavīriyassa uppajjati pīti nirāmisā – pītisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, pītisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 已发起精进者，生起离俗之喜。阿难，当已发起精进的比丘生起离俗之喜时——在那个时候，比丘的喜觉支已被发起；在那个时候，比丘修习喜觉支；在那个时候，比丘的喜觉支达到修习圆满。
rows.english: “For one with aroused energy, unworldly rapture arises. Ānanda, at a time when unworldly rapture arises in a bhikkhu with aroused energy—at that time, the rapture enlightenment factor is aroused in that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the rapture enlightenment factor, and at that time, the rapture enlightenment factor in that bhikkhu reaches the culmination of its development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Pītimanassa kāyopi passambhati, cittampi passambhati. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhuno pītimanassa kāyopi passambhati, cittampi passambhati – passaddhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 心喜悦者，身亦轻安，心亦轻安。阿难，当比丘心喜悦而身心皆轻安时——在那个时候，比丘的轻安觉支已被发起；在那个时候，比丘修习轻安觉支；在那个时候，比丘的轻安觉支达到修习圆满。
rows.english: “For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil and the mind becomes tranquil. Ānanda, at a time when the body and mind of a bhikkhu with a rapturous mind become tranquil—at that time, the tranquility enlightenment factor is aroused in that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the tranquility enlightenment factor, and at that time, the tranquility enlightenment factor in that bhikkhu reaches the culmination of its development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhuno passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati – samādhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, samādhisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 身轻安而安乐者，心便得定。阿难，当比丘身轻安而安乐，心便得定时——在那个时候，比丘的定觉支已被发起；在那个时候，比丘修习定觉支；在那个时候，比丘的定觉支达到修习圆满。
rows.english: “For one whose body is tranquil and who is happy, the mind becomes concentrated. Ānanda, at a time when the mind of a happy bhikkhu whose body is tranquil becomes concentrated—at that time, the concentration enlightenment factor is aroused in that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the concentration enlightenment factor, and at that time, the concentration enlightenment factor in that bhikkhu reaches the culmination of its development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo pana, bhante, ekadhammo eko dhammo (sī.) bhāvito bahulīkato cattāro dhamme paripūreti, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti, satta dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā dve dhamme paripūrentī’’ti? ‘‘Ānāpānassatisamādhi kho, ānanda, ekadhammo bhāvito bahulīkato cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūreti, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrenti, satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrenti’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “大德，是哪一法，修习、多作即能圆满四法；四法修习、多作即能圆满七法；七法修习、多作即能圆满二法呢？”“阿难，入出息念定此一法，修习、多作即能圆满四念处；四念处修习、多作即能圆满七觉支；七觉支修习、多作即能圆满明与解脱。”
rows.english: “But what, venerable sir, is that one quality which, when developed and cultivated, fulfills four qualities? What are the four qualities which, when developed and cultivated, fulfill seven qualities? And what are the seven qualities which, when developed and cultivated, fulfill two qualities?” “The concentration of mindfulness of in-and-out breathing, Ānanda, is the one quality which, when developed and cultivated, fulfills the four establishments of mindfulness. The four establishments of mindfulness, when developed and cultivated, fulfill the seven factors of enlightenment. The seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, fulfill knowledge and liberation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘So tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti – upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti , upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他善于平舍那如此得定的心。阿难，当比丘善于平舍那如此得定的心时——那时，比丘的舍觉支(upekkhāsambojjhaṅga)已发起；那时，比丘修习舍觉支；那时，比丘的舍觉支修习圆满。
rows.english: He well regards with equanimity the mind that is thus concentrated. When, Ānanda, a bhikkhu well regards with equanimity the mind that is thus concentrated—at that time the enlightenment factor of equanimity is aroused for the bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, and at that time for that bhikkhu, the enlightenment factor of equanimity reaches the culmination of its development.

rows.pali: 989 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ. Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami ; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘atthi nu kho, bhante , ekadhammo eko dhammo (sī.) bhāvito bahulīkato cattāro dhamme paripūreti, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti, satta dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā dve dhamme paripūrentī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 989. 缘起于舍卫城(Sāvatthī)。尔时，具寿阿难前往世尊之处。抵达后，礼敬世尊，坐于一旁。坐于一旁的具寿阿难对世尊说：“大德，是否存在一法，修习、多作即能圆满四法；四法修习、多作即能圆满七法；七法修习、多作即能圆满二法？”
rows.english: 989. At Sāvatthī. Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and sat down to one side. Sitting there, the Venerable Ānanda said to the Blessed One: “Venerable sir, is there one quality which, when developed and cultivated, fulfills four qualities; four qualities which, when developed and cultivated, fulfill seven qualities; and seven qualities which, when developed and cultivated, fulfill two qualities?”

rows.pali: ‘‘So tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsamāpajjati. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsamāpajjati – dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “他如此具念而住，以智慧辨别、考察、审察该法。阿难，当比丘如此具念而住，以智慧辨别、考察、审察该法时——那时，比丘的择法觉支（dhammavicayasambojjhaṅga）即已发起；那时，比丘修习择法觉支；那时，比丘的择法觉支达到修习圆满。”
rows.english: “Dwelling thus mindful, he investigates that Dhamma with wisdom, examines it, and arrives at a thorough inquiry. Ānanda, at a time when a bhikkhu, dwelling thus mindful, investigates that Dhamma with wisdom, examines it, and arrives at a thorough inquiry—the investigation-of-dhammas enlightenment factor is aroused in him at that time. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the investigation-of-dhammas enlightenment factor, and at that time, the investigation-of-dhammas enlightenment factor in him reaches the culmination of its development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicarato parivīmaṃsamāpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhuno taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicarato parivīmaṃsamāpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ – vīriyasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他以智慧辨别、考察、审察该法，便发起不懈的精进。阿难，当比丘以智慧辨别、考察、审察该法而发起不懈的精进时——在那个时候，比丘的精进觉支已被发起；在那个时候，比丘修习精进觉支；在那个时候，比丘的精进觉支达到修习圆满。
rows.english: “For one who investigates that Dhamma with wisdom, examines it, and arrives at a thorough inquiry, energy is aroused and unwavering. Ānanda, at a time when the energy of a bhikkhu who is investigating that Dhamma with wisdom, examining it, and arriving at a thorough inquiry is aroused and unwavering—at that time, the energy enlightenment factor is aroused in that bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the energy enlightenment factor, and at that time, the energy enlightenment factor in that bhikkhu reaches the culmination of its development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ bhāvitā, ānanda, satta bojjhaṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrenti? Idhānanda, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti …pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, ānanda, satta bojjhaṅgā evaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrentī’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，七觉支如何修习、如何多修习，才能圆满明与解脱呢？阿难，在此，比丘修习念觉支，依于远离，依于离贪，依于灭，导向舍弃；修习择法觉支……修习舍觉支，依于远离，依于离贪，依于灭，导向舍弃。阿难，如是修习、如是多修习七觉支，便能圆满明与解脱。”第三。
rows.english: How, Ānanda, are the seven factors of enlightenment developed and cultivated so as to fulfill knowledge and liberation? Here, Ānanda, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, which is based on seclusion, based on dispassion, based on cessation, culminating in relinquishment. He develops the enlightenment factor of the investigation of phenomena… he develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based on seclusion, based on dispassion, based on cessation, culminating in relinquishment. Indeed, Ānanda, when the seven factors of enlightenment are developed and cultivated in this way, they fulfill knowledge and liberation.” The third.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu ‘cittappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘cittappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ…pe… samādahaṃ cittaṃ…pe… ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati – citte cittānupassī, ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Taṃ kissa hetu? Nāhaṃ, ānanda, muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānassatisamādhibhāvanaṃ vadāmi. Tasmātihānanda, citte cittānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，当比丘学‘我将体验心而出息’，学‘我将体验心而入息’；令心喜悦……乃至……令心入定……乃至……学‘我将令心解脱而出息’，学‘我将令心解脱而入息’时——阿难，那时比丘于心随观心而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。此是何因？阿难，对失念、不正知者，我不说有入出息念定的修习。是故，阿难，那时比丘于心随观心而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。”
rows.english: “Ānanda, at a time when a bhikkhu trains, thinking: ‘I will breathe out experiencing the mind,’ and ‘I will breathe in experiencing the mind’; … ‘I will breathe out gladdening the mind,’ … ‘I will breathe out concentrating the mind,’ … ‘I will breathe out liberating the mind,’ and ‘I will breathe in liberating the mind’—at that time, Ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. For what reason? I do not say, Ānanda, that the development of concentration through mindfulness of breathing is for one who is unmindful and lacks clear comprehension. Therefore, Ānanda, at that time a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the mind in the mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu aniccānupassī…pe… virāgānupassī…pe… nirodhānupassī…pe… ‘paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati – dhammesu dhammānupassī, ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. So yaṃ taṃ hoti abhijjhādomanassānaṃ pahānaṃ taṃ paññāya disvā sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti. Tasmātihānanda, dhammesu dhammānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，当比丘随观无常……乃至……随观离贪……乃至……随观灭尽……乃至……学‘我将随观舍弃而出息’，学‘我将随观舍弃而入息’——阿难，那时比丘于诸法随观法而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。他以智慧见到那贪欲与忧恼的舍断，并善加舍住。因此，阿难，那时比丘于诸法随观法而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。”
rows.english: “Ānanda, at a time when a bhikkhu trains, thinking: ‘I will breathe out contemplating impermanence,’ … ‘I will breathe out contemplating dispassion,’ … ‘I will breathe out contemplating cessation,’ … ‘I will breathe out contemplating relinquishment,’ and ‘I will breathe in contemplating relinquishment’—at that time, Ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. Having seen with wisdom that abandoning of covetousness and displeasure, he regards it well with equanimity. Therefore, Ānanda, at that time a bhikkhu dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu ‘pītippaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati …pe… sukhappaṭisaṃvedī…pe… cittasaṅkhārappaṭisaṃvedī…pe… ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati – vedanāsu vedanānupassī, ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Taṃ kissa hetu? Vedanāññatarāhaṃ, ānanda, etaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ – assāsapassāsānaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikāraṃ. Tasmātihānanda, vedanāsu vedanānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，当比丘学‘我将体验喜而出息’……乃至……体验乐……乃至……体验心行……乃至……学‘我将平静心行而出息’，学‘我将平静心行而入息’时——阿难，那时比丘于诸受随观受而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。此是何因？阿难，我说这是感受的一种，即对入出息的善作意。是故，阿难，那时比丘于诸受随观受而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。”
rows.english: “Ānanda, at a time when a bhikkhu trains, thinking: ‘I will breathe out experiencing rapture,’ … ‘I will breathe out experiencing pleasure,’ … ‘I will breathe out experiencing the mental formation,’ … ‘I will breathe out calming the mental formation,’ and ‘I will breathe in calming the mental formation’—at that time, Ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating feelings in feelings, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. For what reason? For I say, Ānanda, that this is a certain kind of feeling, that is, the proper attention to in-breaths and out-breaths. Therefore, Ānanda, at that time a bhikkhu dwells contemplating feelings in feelings, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.”

rows.pali: ‘‘So tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti – upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, ānanda, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā evaṃ bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrenti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他善于平舍那如此得定的心。阿难，当比丘善于平舍那如此得定的心时——那时，比丘的舍觉支已发起；那时，比丘修习舍觉支；那时，比丘的舍觉支修习圆满。阿难，如此修习、多修习此四念处，即能圆满七觉支。
rows.english: He well regards with equanimity the mind that is thus concentrated. When, Ānanda, a bhikkhu well regards with equanimity the mind that is thus concentrated—at that time the enlightenment factor of equanimity is aroused for the bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, and at that time for that bhikkhu, the enlightenment factor of equanimity reaches the culmination of its development. Indeed, Ānanda, when the four foundations of mindfulness are thus developed and thus frequently practiced, they bring the seven factors for enlightenment to fulfillment.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ bhāvito, ānanda, ānāpānassatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūreti? Idhānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. So satova assasati, satova passasati. Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti…pe… ‘paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati’’. ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti; rassaṃ vā…pe… ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati – kāye kāyānupassī, ānanda, bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Taṃ kissa hetu? Kāyaññatarāhaṃ, ānanda, etaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ – assāsapassāsaṃ . Tasmātihānanda, kāye kāyānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，如何修习入出息念定，如何多修习能圆满四念处？阿难，于此，比丘前往森林，或前往树下，或前往空静处，结跏趺坐，保持身体端直，于面前建立正念。他具念地出息，具念地入息。出息长时，他了知：‘我出息长’；入息长时，他了知：‘我入息长’……他学：‘我将随观舍弃而出息’；他学：‘我将随观舍弃而入息’。”“阿难，当比丘出息长时，了知：‘我出息长’；入息长时，了知：‘我入息长’；短时……他学：‘我将平静身行而出息’；他学：‘我将平静身行而入息’——阿难，那时比丘于身随观身而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。此是何因？阿难，我说此出息入息，是众多身中的一种。是故，阿难，那时比丘于身随观身而住，精勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪欲与忧恼。”
rows.english: “How, Ānanda, is the concentration of mindfulness of in-and-out breathing developed and cultivated so as to fulfill the four establishments of mindfulness? Here, Ānanda, a monk, gone to the forest or to the root of a tree or to an empty dwelling, sits down cross-legged, keeps his body erect, and establishes mindfulness before him. Mindful, he breathes out; mindful, he breathes in. Breathing out long, he knows, ‘I am breathing out long’; or breathing in long, he knows, ‘I am breathing in long’… He trains, ‘I will breathe out contemplating relinquishment’; he trains, ‘I will breathe in contemplating relinquishment.’ “Ānanda, at the time when a monk, breathing out long, knows, ‘I am breathing out long,’ or breathing in long, knows, ‘I am breathing in long’; or breathing out short… he trains, ‘I will breathe out calming the bodily formation’; he trains, ‘I will breathe in calming the bodily formation’—at that time, Ānanda, the monk dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. For what reason? Ānanda, I say that this—that is, the in-breath and the out-breath—is a certain body among the bodies. Therefore, at that time, Ānanda, the monk dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ bhāvitā cānanda, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā kathaṃ bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrenti? Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati – upaṭṭhitāssa upaṭṭhitassati (pī. ka.) tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno tasmiṃ samaye ānanda bhikkhuno (pī. ka.), tasmiṃ samaye (ma. ni. 3.149) sati hoti asammuṭṭhā. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhuno upaṭṭhitā sati hoti asammuṭṭhā – satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, satisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，四念处要如何修习、如何多修习，才能圆满七觉支呢？阿难，当比丘于身随观身而住时——那时，比丘的念已建立且不忘失。阿难，当比丘的念已建立且不忘失时——那时，比丘的念觉支（satisambojjhaṅga）即已发起；那时，比丘修习念觉支；那时，比丘的念觉支达到修习圆满。”
rows.english: “And how, Ānanda, when developed and frequently practiced, do the four establishments of mindfulness fulfill the seven factors of enlightenment? Ānanda, at a time when a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, then mindfulness is established in that bhikkhu, unforgotten. Ānanda, at a time when mindfulness is established in the bhikkhu, unforgotten, then the mindfulness enlightenment factor is aroused in that bhikkhu; at that time the bhikkhu develops the mindfulness enlightenment factor, and at that time the mindfulness enlightenment factor in that bhikkhu reaches the culmination of its development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhu vedanāsu…pe… citte…pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati – upaṭṭhitāssa tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno sati hoti asammuṭṭhā. Yasmiṃ samaye, ānanda, bhikkhuno upaṭṭhitā sati hoti asammuṭṭhā – satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, satisambojjhaṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. (Yathā paṭhamaṃ satipaṭṭhānaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ).
rows.chinese_simplified: 阿难，当比丘于诸受……于心……于诸法随观法而住时，那时，比丘的念现前而不忘失。阿难，当比丘的念现前而不忘失时——那时，比丘的念觉支(satisambojjhaṅga)已发起；那时，比丘修习念觉支；那时，比丘的念觉支修习圆满。（应如第一念处那般广说。）
rows.english: When, Ānanda, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating feelings in feelings... mind in mind... dhammas in dhammas—at that time the bhikkhu's mindfulness is established and unmuddled. When, Ānanda, the bhikkhu's mindfulness is established and unmuddled—at that time the enlightenment factor of mindfulness is aroused for the bhikkhu. At that time, the bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, and at that time for that bhikkhu, the enlightenment factor of mindfulness reaches the culmination of its development. (This should be elaborated in the same way as the first foundation of mindfulness.)

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati; evameva kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca nīvaraṇā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，譬如这身体是依食而住的，缘食而存续，无食则不存续。正是如此，诸比丘，这五盖也是依食而住的，缘食而存续，无食则不存续。
rows.english: Just as, monks, this body is sustained by nutriment, persists in dependence on nutriment, and does not persist without nutriment; even so, monks, these five hindrances are sustained by nutriment, persist in dependence on nutriment, and do not persist without nutriment.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati; evameva kho, bhikkhave, ime satta bojjhaṅgā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhantī’’ti. Dutiyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，譬如这身体依食而住，缘食而立，无食则不立；亦复如是，诸比丘，此七觉支亦依食而住，缘食而立，无食则不立。”第二。
rows.english: Just as, bhikkhus, this body is sustained by nutriment, subsists in dependence on nutriment, and does not subsist without nutriment; even so, bhikkhus, these seven enlightenment factors are sustained by nutriment, subsist in dependence on nutriment, and do not subsist without nutriment.

rows.pali: ‘‘Seyyathāpi , bhikkhave, ayaṃ kāyo āhāraṭṭhitiko, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, anāhāro no tiṭṭhati; evameva kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā āhāraṭṭhitikā, āhāraṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhanti, anāhārā no tiṭṭhanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，譬如这身体是依食而住的，缘食而存续，无食则不存续。正是如此，诸比丘，这七觉支也是依食而住的，缘食而存续，无食则不存续。
rows.english: Just as, monks, this body is sustained by nutriment, persists in dependence on nutriment, and does not persist without nutriment; even so, monks, these seven factors of enlightenment are sustained by nutriment, persist in dependence on nutriment, and do not persist without nutriment.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, subhanimittaṃ. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā kāmacchandassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā kāmacchandassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘！什么是能令未生起的欲贪生起，或令已生起的欲贪增长、广大之食呢？诸比丘！有净相。于彼多行不如理作意——此即是能令未生起的欲贪生起，或令已生起的欲贪增长、广大之食。”
rows.english: 1. “And what, bhikkhus, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sensual desire, or for the increase and expansion of arisen sensual desire? There is, bhikkhus, the sign of the beautiful. Therein, the frequent practice of unwise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sensual desire, or for the increase and expansion of arisen sensual desire.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, paṭighanimittaṃ. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘！什么是能令未生起的瞋恚生起，或令已生起的瞋恚增长、广大之食呢？诸比丘！有瞋相。于彼多行不如理作意——此即是能令未生起的瞋恚生起，或令已生起的瞋恚增长、广大之食。”
rows.english: 182. “And what, bhikkhus, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, or for the increase and expansion of arisen ill will? There is, bhikkhus, the sign of aversion. Therein, the frequent practice of unwise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen ill will, or for the increase and expansion of arisen ill will.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, cetaso avūpasamo. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā uddhaccakukkuccassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘！什么是能令未生起的掉举、追悔生起，或令已生起的掉举、追悔增长、广大之食呢？诸比丘！有心不寂静。于彼多行不如理作意——此即是能令未生起的掉举、追悔生起，或令已生起的掉举、追悔增长、广大之食。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, or for the increase and expansion of arisen restlessness and remorse? There is, monks, a lack of tranquility in the mind. Therein, frequent unwise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen restlessness and remorse, or for the increase and expansion of arisen restlessness and remorse.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi, bhikkhave, vicikicchāṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannāya vā vicikicchāya uppādāya, uppannāya vā vicikicchāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，什么是能令未生之疑生起，或令已生之疑增长、广大之食呢？诸比丘，有作为疑之依处的诸法。于彼处，多作不如理作意——此即是能令未生之疑生起，或令已生之疑增长、广大之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, or for the increase and expansion of arisen doubt? There are, monks, things that are a basis for doubt. Therein, frequent unwise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen doubt, or for the increase and expansion of arisen doubt.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，什么是能令未生之念觉支生起，或令已生之念觉支修习圆满之食呢？诸比丘，有作为念觉支之依处的诸法。于彼处，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生之念觉支生起，或令已生之念觉支修习圆满之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness? There are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of mindfulness. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为令未生之喜觉支生起，已生之喜觉支修习圆满之食？诸比丘，有喜觉支所缘法(pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā)。于此，多作如理作意——此为令未生之喜觉支生起，已生之喜觉支修习圆满之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture? There are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of rapture. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave , kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为令未生之轻安觉支生起，已生之轻安觉支修习圆满之食？诸比丘，有身轻安(kāyapassaddhi)、心轻安(cittapassaddhi)。于此，多作如理作意——此为令未生之轻安觉支生起，已生之轻安觉支修习圆满之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility? There are, monks, tranquility of body and tranquility of mind. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of tranquility, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of tranquility.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为能令未生之舍觉支生起，或令已生之舍觉支修习圆满的食？诸比丘，有作为舍觉支之基的诸法。于彼多修习如理作意——此即是能令未生之舍觉支生起，或令已生之舍觉支修习圆满的食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity? There are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of equanimity. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of equanimity, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of equanimity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ samādhinimittaṃ (syā.) abyagganimittaṃ. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为令未生之定觉支生起，已生之定觉支修习圆满之食？诸比丘，有止相(samathanimitta)、不散乱相(abyagganimitta)。于此，多作如理作意——此为令未生之定觉支生起，已生之定觉支修习圆满之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration? There are, monks, the sign of serenity and the sign of non-distraction. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of concentration, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of concentration.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, kusalākusalā dhammā, sāvajjānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，什么是能令未生之择法觉支生起，或令已生之择法觉支修习圆满之食呢？诸比丘，有善与不善法、有罪与无罪法、下劣与胜妙法、黑白有对法。于彼处，多作如理作意——此即是能令未生之择法觉支生起，或令已生之择法觉支修习圆满之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena? There are, monks, phenomena that are wholesome and unwholesome, blameworthy and blameless, inferior and superior, counterparts to the dark and the bright. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? Atthi , bhikkhave, arati tandi vijambhitā bhattasammado cetaso ca līnattaṃ. Tattha ayonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā thinamiddhassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā thinamiddhassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘！什么是能令未生起的昏沉睡眠生起，或令已生起的昏沉睡眠增长、广大之食呢？诸比丘！有不乐、倦怠、呵欠、食后昏沉及心之退缩。于彼多行不如理作意——此即是能令未生起的昏沉睡眠生起，或令已生起的昏沉睡眠增长、广大之食。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, or for the increase and expansion of arisen sloth and torpor? There are, monks, discontent, laziness, stretching, drowsiness from food, and sluggishness of mind. Therein, frequent unwise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of unarisen sloth and torpor, or for the increase and expansion of arisen sloth and torpor.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, ārambhadhātu ārabbhadhātu (syā. ka.) nikkamadhātu parakkamadhātu. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为令未生之精进觉支生起，已生之精进觉支修习圆满之食？诸比丘，有发起界(ārambhadhātu)、出离界(nikkamadhātu)、精勤界(parakkamadhātu)。于此，多作如理作意——此为令未生之精进觉支生起，已生之精进觉支修习圆满之食。
rows.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy? There are, monks, the element of initiative, the element of exertion, and the element of striving. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of energy, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, paññindriyaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya, sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. So ‘idaṃ dukkha’nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, paññindriyaṃ. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañcindriyānī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
