rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是慧根？比丘们，于此，圣弟子有智慧，他具足了导向（苦的）生起与灭尽、圣、决择、正向苦尽的智慧。他如实了知‘这是苦’，如实了知‘这是苦的集起’，如实了知‘这是苦的灭尽’，如实了知‘这是导向苦灭的道’——比丘们，这称为慧根。比丘们，这些是五根。”第十。
rows.english: “And what, Bhikkhus, is the faculty of wisdom? Here, Bhikkhus, a noble disciple is wise, endowed with wisdom that comprehends arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and rightly leads to the destruction of suffering. He knows as it really is: 'This is suffering.' He knows as it really is: 'This is the origin of suffering.' He knows as it really is: 'This is the cessation of suffering.' He knows as it really is: 'This is the path leading to the cessation of suffering.' This, Bhikkhus, is called the faculty of wisdom. These, indeed, Bhikkhus, are the five faculties.” The tenth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, satindriyaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā. So kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ; vedanāsu…pe… citte…pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, satindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸位比丘，什么是念根？诸位比丘，于此，圣弟子具念，具备最上的念与慧，能忆持、随忆长久以前所作、长久以前所说之事。他于身随观身而住，热勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于受……于心……于法随观法而住，热勤、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。诸位比丘，这被称为念根。
rows.english: “And what, Bhikkhus, is the faculty of mindfulness? Here, Bhikkhus, a noble disciple is mindful, endowed with supreme maturity of mindfulness, one who remembers and recollects again and again what was done and said long ago. He dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings... he dwells contemplating mind in mind... he dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having subdued covetousness and displeasure in the world. This, Bhikkhus, is called the faculty of mindfulness.”

rows.pali: 480 . ‘‘Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. Katamāni pañca? Saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ. Katamañca, bhikkhave, saddhindriyaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saddhindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 480. “诸比丘，有此五根。是哪五个呢？信根……乃至……慧根。诸比丘，什么是信根呢？诸比丘，于此，圣弟子有信心，他相信如来的觉悟：‘彼世尊是阿罗汉、正自觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上调御丈夫、天人导师、佛陀、世尊。’诸比丘，这被称为信根。”
rows.english: 480. Monks, there are these five faculties. Which five? The faculty of faith... the faculty of wisdom. And what, monks, is the faculty of faith? Here, monks, a noble disciple has faith; he places his faith in the Tathāgata’s enlightenment: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is an arahant, perfectly enlightened, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, the Well-Gone, knower of the world, an unsurpassed trainer of persons to be tamed, teacher of gods and humans, the Enlightened One, the Blessed One.’ This, monks, is called the faculty of faith.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, vīriyindriyaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. So anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati; uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā samāpattiyā (syā. kaṃ. ka.) asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, vīriyindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是精进根呢？诸比丘，于此，圣弟子为断除不善法、为具足善法而住于发起精进，于诸善法，强力、勇猛、不舍其轭。他为使未生之恶不善法不生而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤；为断除已生之恶不善法而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤；为使未生之善法生起而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤；为使已生之善法住立、不忘、增长、广大、修习、圆满而生起意欲，努力，发起精进，策励于心，精勤。诸比丘，这被称为精进根。”
rows.english: “And what, Bhikkhus, is the faculty of energy? Here, Bhikkhus, a noble disciple dwells with energy aroused for abandoning unwholesome qualities and for acquiring wholesome qualities; he is strong, firm in exertion, not laying down the burden in regard to wholesome qualities. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the non-arising of unarisen evil, unwholesome qualities. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the abandoning of arisen evil, unwholesome qualities. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the arising of unarisen wholesome qualities. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the maintenance, non-confusion, increase, expansion, development, and fulfillment of arisen wholesome qualities. This, Bhikkhus, is called the faculty of energy.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ, labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ. So vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, samādhindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸位比丘，什么是定根？诸位比丘，于此，圣弟子以涅槃为所缘而得定，得心一境性。他远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻有伺，具足并安住于由远离所生的喜、乐的初禅。寻、伺寂灭故，内得净信，心专一性，无寻无伺，具足并安住于由定所生的喜、乐的第二禅。又因离喜，他住于舍，具念、正知，以身感受乐，具足并安住于第三禅，对此，圣者们宣说：‘舍者，具念，乐住。’舍乐、舍苦故，以及先前喜、忧已灭没故，不苦不乐，舍念清净，具足并安住于第四禅。诸位比丘，这被称为定根。
rows.english: “And what, Bhikkhus, is the faculty of concentration? Here, Bhikkhus, a noble disciple, making relinquishment his object, attains concentration, attains one-pointedness of mind. He, secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by applied and sustained thought, with rapture and happiness born of seclusion. With the stilling of applied and sustained thought, he enters and dwells in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without applied and sustained thought, and has rapture and happiness born of concentration. With the fading away of rapture, he dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending, and experiences happiness with the body; he enters and dwells in the third jhāna, of which the noble ones declare: 'Equanimous and mindful, he dwells happily.' With the abandoning of happiness and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and displeasure, he enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither painful nor pleasant and has the purification of mindfulness through equanimity. This, Bhikkhus, is called the faculty of concentration.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Saṃvaro ca pahānañca, bhāvanā anurakkhaṇā; Ete padhānā cattāro, desitādiccabandhunā; Yehi bhikkhu idhātāpī, khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe’’ti. catutthaṃ;
rows.chinese_simplified: 防护与舍断，修习及守护，此四种精进，日亲之所说。比丘于此勤，得达苦之尽。第四。
rows.english: “Restraint and abandoning, development and safeguarding: these four strivings were taught by the Kinsman of the Sun. By means of which a bhikkhu, being ardent here, may attain the destruction of suffering.” Fourth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, bhāvanāppadhānaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhāvanāppadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，什么是修习精进？诸比丘，于此，比丘修习念觉支，依止远离，依止离欲，依止灭，导向舍弃；修习择法觉支……修习精进觉支……修习喜觉支……修习轻安觉支……修习定觉支……修习舍觉支，依止远离，依止离欲，依止灭，导向舍弃。诸比丘，这称为修习精进。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the striving of development? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, based on seclusion, based on dispassion, based on cessation, resulting in relinquishment. He develops the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena… he develops the enlightenment factor of energy… he develops the enlightenment factor of rapture… he develops the enlightenment factor of tranquility… he develops the enlightenment factor of concentration… he develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, based on seclusion, based on dispassion, based on cessation, resulting in relinquishment. This, bhikkhus, is called the striving of development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, pahānappadhānaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti; uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ…pe… uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ…pe… uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, pahānappadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是断除精进呢？诸比丘，在此，比丘对已生起的欲寻(kāmavitakka)不容忍，舍弃、去除、灭除、令其不存在；对已生起的瞋寻……对已生起的害寻……对已生起的种种恶不善法不容忍，舍弃、去除、灭除、令其不存在。诸比丘，这称为断除精进。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the striving of abandoning? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu does not tolerate an arisen sensual thought; he abandons it, dispels it, brings it to an end, and causes it to go to non-existence. He does not tolerate an arisen thought of ill will… an arisen thought of harming… He does not tolerate any arisen evil, unwholesome states; he abandons them, dispels them, brings them to an end, and causes them to go to non-existence. This, bhikkhus, is called the striving of abandoning.

rows.pali: 14 . ‘‘Cattārimāni , bhikkhave, padhānāni. Katamāni cattāri? Saṃvarappadhānaṃ, pahānappadhānaṃ, bhāvanāppadhānaṃ, anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ. Katamañca, bhikkhave, saṃvarappadhānaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ , tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī, yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saṃvarappadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 14. “诸比丘，有此四种精进。是哪四种呢？防护精进(saṃvarappadhānaṃ)、断除精进(pahānappadhānaṃ)、修习精进(bhāvanāppadhānaṃ)、守护精进(anurakkhaṇappadhānaṃ)。诸比丘，什么是防护精进呢？诸比丘，在此，比丘以眼见色后，不执取相，不执取随相。凡是因他住于不防护眼根，贪欲、忧愁等恶不善法即会流入，他为防护此而行道，守护眼根，成就眼根的防护。以耳听声后……以鼻嗅香后……以舌尝味后……以身触所触后……以意知法后，不执取相，不执取随相。凡是因他住于不防护意根，贪欲、忧愁等恶不善法即会流入，他为防护此而行道，守护意根，成就意根的防护。诸比丘，这称为防护精进。”
rows.english: 14. “Bhikkhus, there are these four strivings. What are the four? The striving of restraint, the striving of abandoning, the striving of development, and the striving of safeguarding. And what, bhikkhus, is the striving of restraint? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu, having seen a form with the eye, does not grasp at its signs or its secondary characteristics. Insofar as, if he were to dwell with his eye faculty unrestrained, evil, unwholesome states of covetousness and displeasure might assail him, he practices for its restraint, he guards the eye faculty, he undertakes the restraint of the eye faculty. Having heard a sound with the ear… having smelled an odor with the nose… having tasted a flavor with the tongue… having touched a tangible with the body… having cognized a mental object with the mind, he does not grasp at its signs or its secondary characteristics. Insofar as, if he were to dwell with his mind faculty unrestrained, evil, unwholesome states of covetousness and displeasure might assail him, he practices for its restraint, he guards the mind faculty, he undertakes the restraint of the mind faculty. This, bhikkhus, is called the striving of restraint.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhaddakaṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati aṭṭhikasaññaṃ puḷavakasaññaṃ vinīlakasaññaṃ vicchiddakasaññaṃ uddhumātakasaññaṃ. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri padhānānī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，什么是守护精进？诸比丘，于此，比丘守护已生起的善妙定相，即骨想、虫食想、青瘀想、断坏想、肿胀想。诸比丘，这称为守护精进。诸比丘，此等即是四种精进。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the striving of safeguarding? Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu safeguards an arisen, auspicious sign of concentration: the perception of a skeleton, the perception of a worm-eaten corpse, the perception of a bluish corpse, the perception of a split-open corpse, the perception of a bloated corpse. This, bhikkhus, is called the striving of safeguarding. These, bhikkhus, are the four strivings.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ vīriyaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ bahiddhā pañca kāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittaṃ anuvisaṭaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ vīriyaṃ…pe….
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是向外散乱的精进？诸比丘，凡是缘于外在的五种欲而散乱、流散的精进，诸比丘，这称为向外散乱的精进……乃至……”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is externally scattered energy? That energy, bhikkhus, which is scattered forth and spread out externally with regard to the five strands of sensual pleasure—this, bhikkhus, is called externally scattered energy... and so on...

rows.pali: 832 . ‘‘Cattārome, bhikkhave, iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 832. “诸比丘，此四神足若已修习、已多作，则有大果、大益。”
rows.english: 832. “Monks, these four bases of psychic power, when developed and cultivated, are of great fruit and great benefit.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti – ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti…pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti. Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，当比丘这样培育、这样多修四神足时，便能体验种种神通：从一身变成多身，从多身变成一身……乃至能以身行使威力远及梵天界。比丘们，当比丘这样培育、这样多修四神足时，由于诸漏灭尽，便在现法中以自证智，现证无漏的心解脱、慧解脱，成就而住。”第十。
rows.english: When these four bases for spiritual power have been thus developed and cultivated, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu experiences various kinds of spiritual power: having been one, he becomes many; having been many, he becomes one… he wields mastery with his body even as far as the Brahmā world. When these four bases for spiritual power have been thus developed and cultivated, bhikkhus, with the destruction of the taints, he dwells having realized for himself with direct knowledge, in this very life, the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom, and having entered upon it. The tenth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca , bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ālokasaññā suggahitā hoti divāsaññā svādhiṭṭhitā. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何以敞开、无覆之心修习光明之心？诸比丘，于此，比丘善受持光明想，善安立白昼想。诸比丘，比丘如此以敞开、无覆之心修习光明之心。”
rows.english: And how, monks, does a monk develop a luminous mind with a mind that is open and unenveloped? Here, monks, a monk's perception of light is well grasped, and the perception of daytime is well established. In this way, monks, a monk develops a luminous mind with a mind that is open and unenveloped.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, atilīnaṃ vīriyaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ kosajjasahagataṃ kosajjasampayuttaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atilīnaṃ vīriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，何为过于萎靡的精进？诸比丘，若有精进与懈怠俱行、与懈怠相应，诸比丘，此谓过于萎靡的精进。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is energy that is too slack? Whatever energy, monks, is accompanied by laziness, associated with laziness—this, monks, is called energy that is too slack.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, atippaggahitaṃ vīriyaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ uddhaccasampayuttaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahitaṃ vīriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，何为过于策励的精进？诸比丘，若有精进与掉举俱行、与掉举相应，诸比丘，此谓过于策励的精进。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is energy that is too exerted? Whatever energy, monks, is accompanied by restlessness, associated with restlessness—this, monks, is called energy that is too exerted.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, atilīnaṃ cittaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ kosajjasahagataṃ kosajjasampayuttaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atilīnaṃ cittaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是过于萎靡的心？诸比丘，凡与懈怠俱行、与懈怠相应的心，诸比丘，这称为过于萎靡的心。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is an overly sluggish mind? That mind, bhikkhus, which is accompanied by laziness, conjoined with laziness—this, bhikkhus, is called an overly sluggish mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, atippaggahitaṃ cittaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ uddhaccasahagataṃ uddhaccasampayuttaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahitaṃ cittaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是过于高昂的心？诸比丘，凡与掉举俱行、与掉举相应的心，诸比丘，这称为过于高昂的心。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is an over-exerted mind? That mind, bhikkhus, which is accompanied by restlessness, conjoined with restlessness—this, bhikkhus, is called an over-exerted mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, atilīno chando? Yo, bhikkhave, chando kosajjasahagato kosajjasampayutto – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atilīno chando.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是过萎靡的欲？诸比丘，凡与懈怠俱行、与懈怠相应之欲，诸比丘，这称为过萎靡的欲。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is desire that is too slack? Whatever desire is accompanied by laziness, associated with laziness—this, monks, is called desire that is too slack.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando? Yo, bhikkhave, chando uddhaccasahagato uddhaccasampayutto – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是过高昂的欲？诸比丘，凡与掉举俱行、与掉举相应之欲，诸比丘，这称为过高昂的欲。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is desire that is too exerted? Whatever desire is accompanied by restlessness, associated with restlessness—this, monks, is called desire that is too exerted.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, atilīnā vīmaṃsā? Yā, bhikkhave, vīmaṃsā kosajjasahagatā kosajjasampayuttā – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atilīnā vīmaṃsā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是过于萎靡的考察？诸比丘，凡与懈怠俱行、与懈怠相应的考察，诸比丘，这称为过于萎靡的考察。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is excessively sluggish investigation? That investigation, bhikkhus, which is accompanied by laziness, conjoined with laziness—this, bhikkhus, is called excessively sluggish investigation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, atippaggahitā vīmaṃsā? Yā, bhikkhave, vīmaṃsā uddhaccasahagatā uddhaccasampayuttā – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahitā vīmaṃsā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是过于高昂的考察？诸比丘，凡与掉举俱行、与掉举相应的考察，诸比丘，这称为过于高昂的考察。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is over-exerted investigation? That investigation, bhikkhus, which is accompanied by restlessness, conjoined with restlessness—this, bhikkhus, is called over-exerted investigation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhitto chando? Yo, bhikkhave, chando bahiddhā pañca kāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhitto anuvisaṭo – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhitto chando.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是于外散乱的欲？诸比丘，凡是缘于外在五欲而散乱、流散的欲，诸比丘，这称为于外散乱的欲。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is externally scattered desire? Whatever desire, taking the five strands of sensual pleasure as its object, is scattered and dispersed externally—this, monks, is called externally scattered desire.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca , bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi divā chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi rattiṃ chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti; yehi vā pana ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi rattiṃ chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi divā chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何安住于如昼如夜、如夜如昼？诸比丘，于此，比丘白日以何等行相、何等特征、何等相状，修习欲定勤行成就的神足，他夜晚也以彼等行相、彼等特征、彼等相状，修习欲定勤行成就的神足；或者，他夜晚以何等行相、何等特征、何等相状，修习欲定勤行成就的神足，他白日也以彼等行相、彼等特征、彼等相状，修习欲定勤行成就的神足。诸比丘，比丘如此安住于如昼如夜、如夜如昼。”
rows.english: And how, monks, does a monk dwell as by day, so by night; as by night, so by day? Here, monks, with whatever modes, signs, and indications a monk develops by day the basis of power endowed with concentration founded on desire and the formations of striving, with those same modes, signs, and indications he develops it by night. And with whatever modes, signs, and indications he develops by night the basis of power endowed with concentration founded on desire and the formations of striving, with those same modes, signs, and indications he develops it by day. In this way, monks, a monk dwells as by day, so by night; as by night, so by day.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittā vīmaṃsā? Yā, bhikkhave, vīmaṃsā bahiddhā pañca kāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittā anuvisaṭā – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittā vīmaṃsā…pe… evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是向外散乱的考察呢？比丘们，凡是向外攀缘五欲（kāmaguṇa），并散乱、流荡的考察，比丘们，这就叫做向外散乱的考察。……比丘们，就是这样，比丘以敞开、无覆障的心，培育光明心。比丘们，像这样培育、像这样多修的四神足（iddhipāda），便有大果报、大利益。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is externally scattered investigation? That investigation, bhikkhus, which, taking as its object the five strands of sensual pleasure, is scattered about and dispersed externally—this is called, bhikkhus, externally scattered investigation. … Thus, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops a luminous mind with a consciousness that is open and unwrapped. When the four bases for spiritual power are thus developed and cultivated, they are of great fruit and great benefit.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca , bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ bahiddhā pañca kāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittaṃ anuvisaṭaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ…pe… evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是向外散乱的心？诸比丘，凡是缘于外在的五种欲而散乱、流散的心，诸比丘，这称为向外散乱的心……乃至……诸比丘，如此，比丘便以敞开、无覆盖之心修习光明的心。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is an externally scattered mind? That mind, bhikkhus, which is scattered forth and spread out externally with regard to the five strands of sensual pleasure—this, bhikkhus, is called an externally scattered mind... and so on... Thus, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops a mind that is open, uncovered, and luminous.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure? Idha , bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pacchāpuresaññā suggahitā hoti sumanasikatā sūpadhāritā suppaṭividdhā paññāya. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何安住于前后想——如前亦如后，如后亦如前？诸比丘，于此，比丘的前后想已善把握、善作意、善忆持、以慧善通达。诸比丘，如此，比丘便安住于前后想——如前亦如后，如后亦如前。”
rows.english: And how, monks, does a monk dwell perceiving what is after as what is before: as before, so after; as after, so before? Here, monks, for a monk, the perception of what is after as what is before is well grasped, well attended to, well considered, and well penetrated by wisdom. Thus, monks, a monk dwells perceiving what is after as what is before: as before, so after; as after, so before.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati – ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā mutta’nti. Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，比丘如何如下亦如上，如上亦如下地安住？诸比丘，于此，比丘省察此身，从脚底向上，从发顶向下，以皮肤为界，充满种种不净：‘此身中有发、毛、指甲、齿、皮、肉、筋、骨、骨髓、肾、心、肝、肋膜、脾、肺、大肠、小肠、胃中物、粪便、胆汁、痰、脓、血、汗、脂肪、泪、脂膏、唾液、鼻涕、关节滑液、尿。’诸比丘，如此，比丘便如下亦如上，如上亦如下地安住。”
rows.english: And how, monks, does a monk dwell so that as it is below, so it is above; as it is above, so it is below? Here, monks, a monk reviews this very body, upwards from the soles of the feet, downwards from the top of the hair, enclosed by skin and full of various kinds of impurity: 'In this body there are head-hairs, body-hairs, nails, teeth, skin, flesh, sinews, bones, bone marrow, kidneys, heart, liver, pleura, spleen, lungs, large intestines, small intestines, stomach contents, feces, bile, phlegm, pus, blood, sweat, solid fat, tears, liquid fat, saliva, snot, synovial fluid, and urine.' Thus, monks, a monk dwells so that as it is below, so it is above; as it is above, so it is below.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā? Idha, bhikkhave , bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – ‘iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atippaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati’. Pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – ‘yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure; yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho; yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā’. Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. Vīriyasamādhi…pe… cittasamādhi…pe… vīmaṃsāsamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – ‘iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati, na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati’. Pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati – ‘yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure; yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho; yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā’. Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，四神足如何修习、如何多作，乃有大果、大益？诸比丘，于此，比丘修习欲三摩地勤行成就神足，作意：‘我此欲不至于过萎靡，不至于过高昂，不至于于内收摄，不至于于外散乱。’并且安住于前后想：‘如前如后，如后如前；如下如上，如上如下；如昼如夜，如夜如昼。’如此，他以敞开、无覆盖之心修习光明之心。修习精进三摩地……心三摩地……观三摩地勤行成就神足，作意：‘我此观不至于过萎靡，不至于过高昂，不至于于内收摄，不至于于外散乱。’并且安住于前后想：‘如前如后，如后如前；如下如上，如上如下；如昼如夜，如夜如昼。’如此，他以敞开、无覆盖之心修习光明之心。”
rows.english: And how, monks, are the four bases of power, when developed and cultivated, of great fruit and great benefit? Here, monks, a monk develops the basis of power that is endowed with concentration founded on desire and the formations of striving, thinking: 'Thus my desire will be neither too slack nor too exerted, neither constricted internally nor scattered externally.' And he dwells perceiving what is after as what is before: 'As before, so after; as after, so before. As below, so above; as above, so below. As by day, so by night; as by night, so by day.' Thus, with an open and unenveloped mind, he develops a luminous mind. He develops the basis of power that is endowed with concentration founded on energy... concentration founded on mind... concentration founded on investigation and the formations of striving, thinking: 'Thus my investigation will be neither too slack nor too exerted, neither constricted internally nor scattered externally.' And he dwells perceiving what is after as what is before: 'As before, so after; as after, so before. As below, so above; as above, so below. As by day, so by night; as by night, so by day.' Thus, with an open and unenveloped mind, he develops a luminous mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ vīriyaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, vīriyaṃ thinamiddhasahagataṃ thinamiddhasampayuttaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ vīriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，何为内在收摄的精进？诸比丘，若有精进与昏沉惛眠俱行、与昏沉惛眠相应，诸比丘，此谓内在收摄的精进。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is internally constricted energy? Whatever energy, monks, is accompanied by sloth and torpor, associated with sloth and torpor—this, monks, is called internally constricted energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañca, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ cittaṃ? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ thinamiddhasahagataṃ thinamiddhasampayuttaṃ – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittaṃ cittaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是内在收缩的心？诸比丘，凡与昏沉睡眠俱行、与昏沉睡眠相应的心，诸比丘，这称为内在收缩的心。”
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is the internally constricted mind? That mind, bhikkhus, which is accompanied by sloth and torpor, conjoined with sloth and torpor—this, bhikkhus, is called the internally constricted mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto chando? Yo, bhikkhave, chando thinamiddhasahagato thinamiddhasampayutto – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto chando.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，什么是于内收摄的欲？诸比丘，凡与昏沉睡眠俱行、与昏沉睡眠相应的欲，诸比丘，这称为于内收摄的欲。”
rows.english: And what, monks, is internally constricted desire? Whatever desire is accompanied by sloth and torpor, associated with sloth and torpor—this, monks, is called internally constricted desire.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā ca, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā vīmaṃsā? Yā, bhikkhave, vīmaṃsā thinamiddhasahagatā thinamiddhasampayuttā – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā vīmaṃsā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，什么是内在收缩的考察呢？比丘们，凡是与昏沉睡眠（thinamiddha）俱行、与昏沉睡眠相应的考察，比丘们，这就叫做内在收缩的考察。
rows.english: And what, bhikkhus, is the internally constricted investigation? That investigation, bhikkhus, which is accompanied by sloth and torpor, conjoined with sloth and torpor—this is called, bhikkhus, the internally constricted investigation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “任何识，无论是过去、未来、现在，是内、是外，是粗、是细，是劣、是胜，是远、是近，一切识都应以正慧如实地观：‘这不是我的，我不是这个，这不是我的我。’”
rows.english: “Whatever consciousness there is—whether past, future, or present; internal or external; gross or subtle; inferior or superior; far or near—all consciousness should be seen as it actually is with right wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’”

rows.pali: Imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti. Sattamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 又，当此解说被宣说时，五群比丘的心无所执取，从诸漏中解脱。第七经。
rows.english: And while this discourse was being spoken, the minds of the monks of the group of five were liberated from the taints through non-clinging. The Seventh.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yā kāci saññā…pe… ye keci saṅkhārā atītānāgatapaccuppannā ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā…pe… ye dūre santike vā, sabbe saṅkhārā – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “任何想……任何行，无论是过去、未来、现在，是内、是外……是远、是近，一切行都应以正慧如实地观：‘这些不是我的，我不是这些，这些不是我的我。’”
rows.english: “Whatever perception there is… Whatever volitional formations there are—whether past, future, or present; internal or external… far or near—all volitional formations should be seen as they actually are with right wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Yā kāci vedanā atītānāgatapaccuppannā ajjhattā vā bahiddhā vā…pe… yā dūre santike vā, sabbā vedanā – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，因此，于此，任何色，无论是过去、未来、现在，是内、是外，是粗、是细，是劣、是胜，是远、是近，一切色都应以正慧如实地观：‘这不是我的，我不是这个，这不是我的我。’任何受，无论是过去、未来、现在，是内、是外……是远、是近，一切受都应以正慧如实地观：‘这不是我的，我不是这个，这不是我的我。’”
rows.english: “Therefore, bhikkhus, whatever form there is—whether past, future, or present; internal or external; gross or subtle; inferior or superior; far or near—all form should be seen as it actually is with right wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Whatever feeling there is—whether past, future, or present; internal or external… far or near—all feeling should be seen as it actually is with right wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’”

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ abhinandunti (ka.) .
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了这番话。五群比丘心满意足，欢喜世尊之所说。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. The monks of the group of five, delighted, rejoiced in the Blessed One's speech.

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati. Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，如是观的多闻圣弟子，于色厌离，于受厌离，于想厌离，于行厌离，于识厌离。因厌离而离贪，因离贪而解脱。于解脱时，生起‘我已解脱’之智。他了知：‘生已尽，梵行已立，所作已办，不受后有。’”
rows.english: “Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple becomes disenchanted with form, disenchanted with feeling, disenchanted with perception, disenchanted with volitional formations, and disenchanted with consciousness. Being disenchanted, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion, he is liberated. When he is liberated, the knowledge arises: ‘I am liberated.’ He understands: ‘Birth is destroyed, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this state of being.’”

rows.pali: 59 . Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye. Tatra kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘bhikkhavo’’ti. ‘‘Bhadante’’ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 59. 一时，世尊住在波罗奈（Bārāṇasī）仙人堕处（Isipatana）的鹿野苑。在那里，世尊对五比丘说：‘诸比丘！’那些比丘回答世尊：‘尊者！’世尊这样说：
rows.english: 59. At one time the Blessed One was dwelling at Bārāṇasī, in the Deer Park at Isipatana. There the Blessed One addressed the group of five bhikkhus: “Bhikkhus.” “Venerable sir,” those bhikkhus replied to the Blessed One. The Blessed One said this:

rows.pali: ‘‘Vedanā anattā. Vedanā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca vedanāya – ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’ti. Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, vedanā anattā, tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati , na ca labbhati vedanāya – ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，受是无我。诸比丘，如果此受是我，此受就不会导向病痛，并且能在受上得遂所愿：‘愿我的受是这样，愿我的受不是这样。’诸比丘，正因为受是无我，所以受导向病痛，并且不能在受上得遂所愿：‘愿我的受是这样，愿我的受不是这样。’”
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, feeling is not-self. If, bhikkhus, feeling were self, this feeling would not lead to affliction, and it would be possible to have one's way with feeling: ‘Let my feeling be thus; let my feeling not be thus.’ But because, bhikkhus, feeling is not-self, therefore feeling leads to affliction, and it is not possible to have one's way with feeling: ‘Let my feeling be thus; let my feeling not be thus.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anattā. Rūpañca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca rūpe – ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti. Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ anattā, tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati rūpe – ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，色是无我。诸比丘，如果此色是我，此色就不会导向病痛，并且能在色上得遂所愿：‘愿我的色是这样，愿我的色不是这样。’诸比丘，正因为色是无我，所以色导向病痛，并且不能在色上得遂所愿：‘愿我的色是这样，愿我的色不是这样。’”
rows.english: “Bhikkhus, form is not-self. If, bhikkhus, form were self, this form would not lead to affliction, and one could exercise mastery over form, thinking: ‘Let my form be thus; let my form not be thus.’ But because, bhikkhus, form is not-self, therefore form leads to affliction, and one cannot exercise mastery over form, thinking: ‘Let my form be thus; let my form not be thus.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Viññāṇaṃ anattā. Viññāṇañca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca viññāṇe – ‘evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī’ti. Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ anattā, tasmā viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati viññāṇe – ‘evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī’’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “识是无我。诸比丘，此识若为我者，则此识不应引生疾苦，且于识上应能得随己意：‘愿我识如是，愿我识不如是。’诸比丘，然正因识是无我，是故识引生疾苦，且于识上不得随己意：‘愿我识如是，愿我识不如是。’”
rows.english: “Consciousness is not-self. If, bhikkhus, consciousness were self, it would not lead to affliction, and it would be possible to have one's way with consciousness: ‘Let my consciousness be thus; let my consciousness not be thus.’ But because, bhikkhus, consciousness is not-self, it leads to affliction, and it is not possible to have one's way with consciousness: ‘Let my consciousness be thus; let my consciousness not be thus.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Aniccaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Dukkhaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ – ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’’’ti? ‘‘No hetaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Vedanā… saññā… saṅkhārā… viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Aniccaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Dukkhaṃ , bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ – ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’’’ti? ‘‘No hetaṃ, bhante’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，你们认为如何？色是常还是无常？”“世尊，是无常。”“凡无常者，是苦还是乐？”“世尊，是苦。”“凡无常、是苦、有变易法者，还适合看作‘这是我的，我是此，这是我的我’吗？”“不，世尊。”“受……想……行……识是常还是无常？”“世尊，是无常。”“凡无常者，是苦还是乐？”“世尊，是苦。”“凡无常、是苦、有变易法者，还适合看作‘这是我的，我是此，这是我的我’吗？”“不，世尊。”
rows.english: “What do you think, bhikkhus, is form permanent or impermanent?” “Impermanent, venerable sir.” “And is that which is impermanent suffering or happiness?” “Suffering, venerable sir.” “And is it fitting to regard that which is impermanent, suffering, and subject to change thus: ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self’?” “No, venerable sir.” “Is feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness permanent or impermanent?” “Impermanent, venerable sir.” “And is that which is impermanent suffering or happiness?” “Suffering, venerable sir.” “And is it fitting to regard that which is impermanent, suffering, and subject to change thus: ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self’?” “No, venerable sir.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Saññā anattā…pe… saṅkhārā anattā. Saṅkhārā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, nayidaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu – ‘evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesu’nti. Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā anattā, tasmā saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti, na ca labbhati saṅkhāresu – ‘evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesu’’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “想是无我……行是无我。诸比丘，此诸行若为我者，则此诸行不应引生疾苦，且于诸行上应能得随己意：‘愿我诸行如是，愿我诸行不如是。’诸比丘，然正因诸行是无我，是故诸行引生疾苦，且于诸行上不得随己意：‘愿我诸行如是，愿我诸行不如是。’”
rows.english: “Perception is not-self… Volitional formations are not-self. If, bhikkhus, volitional formations were self, they would not lead to affliction, and it would be possible to have one's way with volitional formations: ‘Let my volitional formations be thus; let my volitional formations not be thus.’ But because, bhikkhus, volitional formations are not-self, they lead to affliction, and it is not possible to have one's way with volitional formations: ‘Let my volitional formations be thus; let my volitional formations not be thus.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ vadetha? Vijānātīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘viññāṇa’nti vuccati. Kiñca vijānāti? Ambilampi vijānāti, tittakampi vijānāti, kaṭukampi vijānāti, madhurampi vijānāti, khārikampi vijānāti, akhārikampi vijānāti, loṇikampi vijānāti, aloṇikampi vijānāti. Vijānātīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘viññāṇa’nti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，如何称之为识？诸比丘，因为它能了别，所以称为‘识’。它了别什么呢？它了别酸，了别苦，了别辣，了别甜，了别咸，了别不咸，了别带盐的，了别不带盐的。诸比丘，因为它能了别，所以称为‘识’。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, do you call consciousness? ‘It cognizes,’ bhikkhus; therefore, it is called ‘consciousness.’ And what does it cognize? It cognizes sour, it cognizes bitter, it cognizes pungent, it cognizes sweet, it cognizes alkaline, it cognizes non-alkaline, it cognizes salty, it cognizes non-salty. ‘It cognizes,’ bhikkhus; therefore, it is called ‘consciousness.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca, bhikkhave, saññaṃ vadetha? Sañjānātīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘saññā’ti vuccati. Kiñca sañjānāti? Nīlampi sañjānāti, pītakampi sañjānāti, lohitakampi sañjānāti, odātampi sañjānāti. Sañjānātīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘saññā’ti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，为何称之为想(saññā)？诸比丘，因为它识记，所以被称为‘想’。它识记什么？它识记青色，识记黄色，识记红色，识记白色。诸比丘，因为它识记，所以被称为‘想’。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, do you call perception? It perceives, bhikkhus, therefore it is called ‘perception.’ And what does it perceive? It perceives blue, it perceives yellow, it perceives red, it perceives white. It perceives, bhikkhus, therefore it is called ‘perception.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Aniccaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Dukkhaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ – ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’’’ti? ‘‘No hetaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Vedanā … saññā… saṅkhārā… viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Aniccaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā’’ti? ‘‘Dukkhaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ – ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’’’ti? ‘‘No hetaṃ, bhante’’. ‘‘Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. Yā kāci vedanā… yā kāci saññā… ye keci saṅkhārā… yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ…pe… yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，你们怎么认为？色是常还是无常呢？”“无常，世尊。”“凡是无常的，那是苦还是乐呢？”“苦，世尊。”“凡是无常、苦、会变化的，还适合看作‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的我’吗？”“并非如此，世尊。”“受……想……行……识是常还是无常呢？”“无常，世尊。”“凡是无常的，那是苦还是乐呢？”“苦，世尊。”“凡是无常、苦、会变化的，还适合看作‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的我’吗？”“并非如此，世尊。”“因此，诸比丘，凡是任何色，无论是过去、未来、现在，是内还是外，是粗还是细，是劣还是胜，是远还是近，一切色都应以正慧如实地看：‘这不是我的，我不是这个，这不是我的我’。凡是任何受……任何想……任何行……任何识，无论是过去、未来、现在……是远还是近，一切识都应以正慧如实地看：‘这不是我的，我不是这个，这不是我的我’。”
rows.english: “What do you think, monks, is form permanent or impermanent?” “Impermanent, venerable sir.” “And what is impermanent, is that suffering or happiness?” “Suffering, venerable sir.” “And what is impermanent, suffering, and subject to change, is it proper to regard it thus: ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self’?” “No, venerable sir.” “Is feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness permanent or impermanent?” “Impermanent, venerable sir.” “And what is impermanent, is that suffering or happiness?” “Suffering, venerable sir.” “And what is impermanent, suffering, and subject to change, is it proper to regard it thus: ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self’?” “No, venerable sir.” “Therefore, monks, whatever form there is—past, future, or present, internal or external, gross or subtle, inferior or superior, far or near—all form should be seen as it truly is with right wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ Whatever feeling… whatever perception… whatever volitional formations… whatever consciousness there is—past, future, or present… far or near—all consciousness should be seen as it truly is with right wisdom thus: ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Namo te purisājañña, namo te purisuttama; Yassa te nābhijānāma, yampi nissāya jhāyasī’’ti. sattamaṃ;
rows.chinese_simplified: “‘礼敬您，人中尊！礼敬您，人中上！我们不知您依止什么而禅修。’第七。”
rows.english: “Homage to you, O thoroughbred of men! Homage to you, O supreme among men! We do not know that, relying on which, you meditate.” Seventh.

rows.pali: ‘‘Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi… saññāyapi… saṅkhāresupi… viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati. Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，像这样观察，多闻的圣弟子于色厌离，于受厌离，于想厌离，于诸行厌离，于识厌离。因厌离而离贪，因离贪而解脱。于解脱时，生起‘我已解脱’之智。他了知：‘生已尽，梵行已立，所作已作，不受后有。’
rows.english: Monks, seeing thus, the learned noble disciple becomes disenchanted with form, disenchanted with feeling, disenchanted with perception, disenchanted with volitional formations, and disenchanted with consciousness. Being disenchanted, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion, he is liberated. When he is liberated, the knowledge arises: ‘I am liberated.’ He understands: ‘Birth is destroyed, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is no more of this state of being.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca , bhikkhave, saṅkhāre vadetha? Saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharontīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘saṅkhārā’ti vuccati. Kiñca saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharonti? Rūpaṃ rūpattāya rūpatthāya (ka.) saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharonti. Saṅkhatamabhisaṅkharontīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘saṅkhārā’ti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，如何称之为行？诸比丘，因为造作有为法，所以称为‘行’。造作什么有为法呢？为色故，造作有为之色；为受故，造作有为之受；为想故，造作有为之想；为行故，造作有为之行；为识故，造作有为之识。诸比丘，因为造作有为法，所以称为‘行’。”
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, do you call formations? ‘They fashion the fashioned,’ bhikkhus, therefore they are called ‘formations.’ And what fashioned thing do they fashion? They fashion fashioned form for the state of form; they fashion fashioned feeling for the state of feeling; they fashion fashioned perception for the state of perception; they fashion fashioned formations for the state of formations; they fashion fashioned consciousness for the state of consciousness. ‘They fashion the fashioned,’ bhikkhus, therefore they are called ‘formations.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ vadetha? Ruppatīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘rūpa’nti vuccati. Kena ruppati? Sītenapi ruppati, uṇhenapi ruppati, jighacchāyapi ruppati, pipāsāyapi ruppati, ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassenapi … siriṃsapasamphassenapi (sī. pī.) ruppati. Ruppatīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘rūpa’nti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，为何称之为色(rūpa)？诸比丘，因为它会败坏，所以被称为‘色’。它因何而败坏？因寒冷而败坏，因炎热而败坏，因饥饿而败坏，因口渴而败坏，也因与虻、蚊、风、热、爬虫的接触而败坏。诸比丘，因为它会败坏，所以被称为‘色’。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, do you call form? It is afflicted, bhikkhus, therefore it is called ‘form.’ By what is it afflicted? It is afflicted by cold, it is afflicted by heat, it is afflicted by hunger, it is afflicted by thirst, it is afflicted by the touch of gadflies, mosquitoes, wind, sun, and creeping things. It is afflicted, bhikkhus, therefore it is called ‘form.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nevācināti na apacināti, apacinitvā ṭhito neva pajahati na upādiyati, pajahitvā ṭhito neva visineti na ussineti, visinetvā ṭhito neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti. Vidhūpetvā ṭhito kiñca nevācināti na apacināti? Apacinitvā ṭhito rūpaṃ nevācināti na apacināti; apacinitvā ṭhito vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ nevācināti na apacināti. Apacinitvā ṭhito kiñca neva pajahati na upādiyati? Pajahitvā ṭhito rūpaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati; pajahitvā ṭhito vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ neva pajahati na upādiyati. Pajahitvā ṭhito kiñca neva visineti na ussineti? Visinetvā ṭhito rūpaṃ neva visineti na ussineti; visinetvā ṭhito vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ neva visineti na ussineti. Visinetvā ṭhito kiñca neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti? Vidhūpetvā ṭhito rūpaṃ neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti; vidhūpetvā ṭhito vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti. Vidhūpetvā ṭhito evaṃvimuttacittaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saindā devā sabrahmakā sapajāpatikā ārakāva namassanti –
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，此比丘被称为：不积集，不毁坏；既已毁坏，则不舍弃，不执取；既已舍弃，则不散布，不积聚；既已散布，则不熄灭，不燃起。既已毁坏，那么他不积集、不毁坏什么？既已毁坏，他不积集、不毁坏色；既已毁坏，他不积集、不毁坏受、想、行、识。既已舍弃，那么他不舍弃、不执取什么？既已舍弃，他不舍弃、不执取色；既已舍弃，他不舍弃、不执取受、想、行、识。既已散布，那么他不散布、不积聚什么？既已散布，他不散布、不积聚色；既已散布，他不散布、不积聚受、想、行、识。既已熄灭，那么他不熄灭、不燃起什么呢？既已熄灭，他不熄灭、不燃起色；既已熄灭，他不熄灭、不燃起受、想、行、识。诸比丘，对于这样心解脱的比丘，有因陀罗、有梵天、有生主(Pajāpati)的诸天，亦从远处敬礼——”
rows.english: Monks, this monk is said to be one who neither accumulates nor diminishes; having diminished, he is established. He neither abandons nor clings; having abandoned, he is established. He neither disperses nor gathers; having dispersed, he is established. He neither extinguishes nor kindles; having extinguished, he is established. And what does he neither accumulate nor diminish? Having diminished, he is established; he neither accumulates nor diminishes form. Having diminished, he is established; he neither accumulates nor diminishes feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness. And what does he neither abandon nor cling to? Having abandoned, he is established; he neither abandons nor clings to form. Having abandoned, he is established; he neither abandons nor clings to feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness. And what does he neither disperse nor gather? Having dispersed, he is established; he neither disperses nor gathers form. Having dispersed, he is established; he neither disperses nor gathers feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness. And what does he neither extinguish nor kindle? Having extinguished, he is established; he neither extinguishes nor kindles form. Having extinguished, he is established; he neither extinguishes nor kindles feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness. Monks, the gods with Inda, with Brahmā, and with Pajāpati pay homage from afar to a monk whose mind is thus liberated:

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Ahaṃ kho etarahi vedanāya khajjāmi. Atītampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva vedanāya khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannāya vedanāya khajjāmi. Ahañceva kho pana anāgataṃ vedanaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ; anāgatampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva vedanāya khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannāya vedanāya khajjāmī’ti. So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītāya vedanāya anapekkho hoti; anāgataṃ vedanaṃ nābhinandati; paccuppannāya vedanāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “‘我如今正被受所啃噬。在过去，我也曾同样地被受所啃噬，就像如今被现在的受所啃噬一样。我若欣喜于未来的受，那么在未来，我也将同样地被受所啃噬，就像如今被现在的受所啃噬一样。’他如此省察后，对过去的受无所顾念，不欣喜于未来的受，为对现在的受厌离、离贪、灭尽而行道。
rows.english: “‘I am now being consumed by feeling. In the past, too, I was consumed by feeling in this same way, just as I am now being consumed by present feeling. If I were to delight in future feeling, in the future, too, I would be consumed by feeling in this same way, just as I am now being consumed by present feeling.’ Having reflected thus, he is unconcerned with past feeling; he does not delight in future feeling; he is practicing for the disenchantment, dispassion, and cessation of present feeling.

rows.pali: 79 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ. ‘‘Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussaramānā anussaranti sabbete pañcupādānakkhandhe anussaranti etesaṃ vā aññataraṃ. Katame pañca? ‘Evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhāna’nti – iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno rūpaṃyeva anussarati. ‘Evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītamaddhāna’nti – iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno vedanaṃyeva anussarati. ‘Evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītamaddhāna’nti… ‘evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītamaddhāna’nti… ‘evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhāna’nti – iti vā hi, bhikkhave, anussaramāno viññāṇameva anussarati’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 79. 缘起于舍卫城(Sāvatthī)。诸比丘，任何沙门(samaṇa)或婆罗门(brāhmaṇa)在忆念种种过去生时，他们所忆念的，都是这五取蕴，或其中的某一蕴。是哪五个呢？‘我在过去世曾有这样的色’——诸比丘，如此忆念时，他只是在忆念色蕴。‘我在过去世曾有这样的受’——诸比丘，如此忆念时，他只是在忆念受蕴。‘我在过去世曾有这样的想’……‘我在过去世曾有这样的行’……‘我在过去世曾有这样的识’——诸比丘，如此忆念时，他只是在忆念识蕴。
rows.english: 79. At Sāvatthī. “Bhikkhus, whatever ascetics or brahmins recall their manifold past lives, all of them recall these five aggregates subject to clinging, or one among them. Which five? ‘I was of such a form in the past’—thus, bhikkhus, in recalling, one recalls only form. ‘I was of such a feeling in the past’—thus, bhikkhus, in recalling, one recalls only feeling. ‘I was of such a perception in the past’… ‘I was of such formations in the past’… ‘I was of such a consciousness in the past’—thus, bhikkhus, in recalling, one recalls only consciousness.”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Ahaṃ kho etarahi viññāṇena khajjāmi. Atītampi addhānaṃ evameva viññāṇena khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena viññāṇena khajjāmi. Ahañceva kho pana anāgataṃ viññāṇaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ; anāgatampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva viññāṇena khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena viññāṇena khajjāmī’ti. So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ viññāṇasmiṃ anapekkho hoti; anāgataṃ viññāṇaṃ nābhinandati; paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “‘我如今正被识所啃噬。在过去，我也曾同样地被识所啃噬，就像如今被现在的识所啃噬一样。我若欣喜于未来的识，那么在未来，我也将同样地被识所啃噬，就像如今被现在的识所啃噬一样。’他如此省察后，对过去的识无所顾念，不欣喜于未来的识，为对现在的识厌离、离贪、灭尽而行道。
rows.english: ‘Indeed, I am now being consumed by consciousness. In the past, too, I was consumed by consciousness in this same way, just as I am now being consumed by present consciousness. If I were to delight in future consciousness, in the future, too, I would be consumed by consciousness in this same way, just as I am now being consumed by present consciousness.’ Having reflected thus, that person is unconcerned with past consciousness; he does not delight in future consciousness; he is practicing for the disenchantment, dispassion, and cessation of present consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Ahaṃ kho etarahi saññāya khajjāmi…pe… ahaṃ kho etarahi saṅkhārehi khajjāmi. Atītampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva saṅkhārehi khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmīti. Ahañceva kho pana anāgate saṅkhāre abhinandeyyaṃ ; anāgatampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva saṅkhārehi khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannehi saṅkhārehi khajjāmī’ti. So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītesu saṅkhāresu anapekkho hoti; anāgate saṅkhāre nābhinandati; paccuppannānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “‘我如今正被想所啃噬……我如今正被诸行所啃噬。在过去，我也曾同样地被诸行所啃噬，就像如今被现在的诸行所啃噬一样。我若欣喜于未来的诸行，那么在未来，我也将同样地被诸行所啃噬，就像如今被现在的诸行所啃噬一样。’他如此省察后，对过去的诸行无所顾念，不欣喜于未来的诸行，为对现在的诸行厌离、离贪、灭尽而行道。
rows.english: “‘I am now being consumed by perception… I am now being consumed by formations. In the past, too, I was consumed by formations in this same way, just as I am now being consumed by present formations. If I were to delight in future formations, in the future, too, I would be consumed by formations in this same way, just as I am now being consumed by present formations.’ Having reflected thus, he is unconcerned with past formations; he does not delight in future formations; he is practicing for the disenchantment, dispassion, and cessation of present formations.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako apacināti, no ācināti; pajahati no (sī.) , na upādiyati; visineti no (sī.) , na ussineti; vidhūpeti no (sī.) , na sandhūpeti. Kiñca apacināti, no ācināti? Rūpaṃ apacināti, no ācināti; vedanaṃ … saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ apacināti, no ācināti. Kiñca pajahati, na upādiyati? Rūpaṃ pajahati, na upādiyati; vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ pajahati, na upādiyati. Kiñca visineti, na ussineti? Rūpaṃ visineti, na ussineti; vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ visineti, na ussineti. Kiñca vidhūpeti, na sandhūpeti? Rūpaṃ vidhūpeti, na sandhūpeti; vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ vidhūpeti, na sandhūpeti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 比丘们，此圣弟子被称为：他毁坏而不积集，舍弃而不执取，散布而不积聚，熄灭而不燃起。毁坏什么而不积集？毁坏色而不积集，毁坏受而不积集，毁坏想而不积集，毁坏诸行而不积集，毁坏识而不积集。舍弃什么而不执取？舍弃色而不执取，舍弃受而不执取，舍弃想而不执取，舍弃诸行而不执取，舍弃识而不执取。散布什么而不积聚？散布色而不积聚，散布受而不积聚，散布想而不积聚，散布诸行而不积聚，散布识而不积聚。熄灭什么而不燃起？熄灭色而不燃起，熄灭受而不燃起，熄灭想而不燃起，熄灭诸行而不燃起，熄灭识而不燃起。
rows.english: Monks, this noble disciple is said to be one who diminishes, not one who accumulates; one who abandons, not one who clings; one who disperses, not one who gathers; one who extinguishes, not one who kindles. And what does he diminish, not accumulate? He diminishes form, he does not accumulate it; he diminishes feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness, he does not accumulate it. And what does he abandon, not cling to? He abandons form, he does not cling to it; he abandons feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness, he does not cling to it. And what does he disperse, not gather? He disperses form, he does not gather it; he disperses feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness, he does not gather it. And what does he extinguish, not kindle? He extinguishes form, he does not kindle it; he extinguishes feeling… perception… volitional formations… consciousness, he does not kindle it.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tatra, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘ahaṃ kho etarahi rūpena khajjāmi. Atītampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi. Ahañceva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ, anāgatampāhaṃ addhānaṃ evameva rūpena khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathāpi etarahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmī’ti. So iti paṭisaṅkhāya atītasmiṃ rūpasmiṃ anapekkho hoti ; anāgataṃ rūpaṃ nābhinandati; paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，于此，有闻法的圣弟子这样审慎思考：‘我现在确实被色所吞噬。过去我也同样被色所吞噬，正如现在被现在之色所吞噬一样。如果我欣喜未来的色，未来我也将同样被色所吞噬，正如现在被现在之色所吞噬一样。’他这样审慎思考后，对过去的色不再依恋；不欣喜未来的色；为了厌离、离贪、息灭现在的色而修行。”
rows.english: “Therein, bhikkhus, a learned noble disciple reflects thus: ‘I am now being consumed by form. In the past, too, I was consumed by form in just this way, just as I am now being consumed by present form. And if I were to delight in future form, in the future, too, I would be consumed by form in just this way, just as I am now being consumed by present form.’ Having reflected thus, he is unconcerned with past form; he does not delight in future form; and he is practicing for the disenchantment, dispassion, and cessation of present form.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kiñca, bhikkhave, vedanaṃ vadetha? Vedayatīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘vedanā’ti vuccati. Kiñca vedayati? Sukhampi vedayati, dukkhampi vedayati, adukkhamasukhampi vedayati. Vedayatīti kho, bhikkhave, tasmā ‘vedanā’ti vuccati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，为何称之为受(vedanā)？诸比丘，因为它感受，所以被称为‘受’。它感受什么？它感受乐，感受苦，也感受不苦不乐。诸比丘，因为它感受，所以被称为‘受’。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, do you call feeling? It feels, bhikkhus, therefore it is called ‘feeling.’ And what does it feel? It feels pleasure, it feels pain, and it feels neither-pain-nor-pleasure. It feels, bhikkhus, therefore it is called ‘feeling.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, cha vedanākāyā veditabbā, cha taṇhākāyā veditabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 应知六内处，应知六外处，应知六识身，应知六触身，应知六受身，应知六渴爱身。
rows.english: “Six internal sense bases are to be known, six external sense bases are to be known, six groups of consciousness are to be known, six groups of contact are to be known, six groups of feeling are to be known, and six groups of craving are to be known.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sotañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ…pe….
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，缘于耳与声而生起耳识……（余文同前）。
rows.english: Monks, dependent on the ear and sounds, ear-consciousness arises...and so on...

rows.pali: ‘‘Ghānañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ…pe….
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，缘于鼻与香而生起鼻识……（余文同前）。
rows.english: Monks, dependent on the nose and odors, nose-consciousness arises...and so on...

rows.pali: ‘‘Jivhañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ…pe… .
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，缘于舌与味而生起舌识……（余文同前）。
rows.english: Monks, dependent on the tongue and tastes, tongue-consciousness arises...and so on...

rows.pali: ‘‘Kāyañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ…pe….
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，缘于身与所触而生起身识……（余文同前）。
rows.english: Monks, dependent on the body and tangible objects, body-consciousness arises...and so on...

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti. Imasmiṃ kho pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了此语。彼诸比丘心怀喜悦，欣然信受世尊所说。于此记说被宣说时，六十位比丘的心，无所执取，从诸漏中解脱。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Those monks, delighted, rejoiced in the Blessed One’s statement. And while this exposition was being delivered, the minds of sixty monks were liberated from the taints through non-clinging.

rows.pali: 424 . ‘‘Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā – cakkhuṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati; rūpe ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati; cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati; cakkhusamphassaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati; vedanaṃ ‘etaṃ mama , esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati; taṇhaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati; sotaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati…pe… ghānaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati…pe… jivhaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati…pe… kāyaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati…pe… manaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, dhamme ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, manoviññāṇaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, manosamphassaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, vedanaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, taṇhaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 424. 诸比丘，再者，这是导致有身集起的行道：随观眼为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观色为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观眼识为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观眼触为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观受为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观爱为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’。随观耳为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’……乃至……随观鼻为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’……乃至……随观舌为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’……乃至……随观身为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’……乃至……随观意为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观法为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观意识为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观意触为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观受为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’；随观爱为‘这是我的，我是这个，这是我的自我’。
rows.english: 424. Furthermore, bhikkhus, this is the path leading to the origination of identity: one regards the eye thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards forms thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards eye-consciousness thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards eye-contact thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards feeling thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards craving thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards the ear thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ … One regards the nose thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ … One regards the tongue thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ … One regards the body thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ … One regards the mind thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards mental phenomena thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards mind-consciousness thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards mind-contact thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards feeling thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’ One regards craving thus, ‘This is mine, this I am, this is my self.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Manañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā. So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati. Tassa rāgānusayo nānuseti. Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati. Tassa paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. Tassa avijjānusayo nānuseti. So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ pahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro bhavissatīti – ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，以意为缘，以法为缘，生起意识；三者和合为触；以触为缘而生起感受：乐受、苦受或不苦不乐受。他为乐受所触时，不欢喜，不称扬，不执著而住，其贪随眠便不潜伏。他为苦受所触时，不忧愁，不疲惫，不悲叹，不捶胸号哭，不陷入昏乱，其瞋恚随眠便不潜伏。他为不苦不乐受所触时，如实了知该感受的生起、灭没、乐味、过患与出离，其无明随眠便不潜伏。诸比丘，诚然，彼人舍断了缘于乐受的贪随眠，遣除了缘于苦受的瞋恚随眠，根除了缘于不苦不乐受的无明随眠，舍断无明而生起明，于现法中即能终结痛苦——此事是可能的。
rows.english: Monks, dependent on the mind and mental objects, mind-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact. Conditioned by contact, a feeling arises—pleasant, painful, or neither-pleasant-nor-painful. Touched by a pleasant feeling, one does not delight in it, does not welcome it, and does not remain attached to it. The underlying tendency to lust does not lie latent in him. Touched by a painful feeling, one does not sorrow, does not become weary, does not lament, does not beat one’s breast and cry, and does not fall into bewilderment. The underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent in him. Touched by a neither-pleasant-nor-painful feeling, one understands as it truly is the arising, the passing away, the gratification, the danger, and the escape concerning that feeling. The underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent in him. Monks, that one—having abandoned the underlying tendency to lust for pleasant feeling, having dispelled the underlying tendency to aversion for painful feeling, having uprooted the underlying tendency to ignorance for neither-pleasant-nor-painful feeling, having abandoned ignorance and having caused knowledge to arise—will in this very life make an end of suffering: this is possible.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā – cakkhuṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Rūpe ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Cakkhusamphassaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Vedanaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Taṇhaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Sotaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati…pe… ghānaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati… jivhaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati… kāyaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati… manaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Dhamme ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Manoviññāṇaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Manosamphassaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Vedanaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati. Taṇhaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，实则，此乃导向有身灭之道：随观眼为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观色为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观眼识为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观眼触为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观受为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观爱为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’。随观耳为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’……随观鼻为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’……随观舌为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’……随观身为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’……随观意为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观法为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观意识为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观意触为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观受为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’；随观爱为‘此非我所，此非是我，此非我之我’。”
rows.english: Furthermore, bhikkhus, this is the path leading to the cessation of identity: one regards the eye thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards forms thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards eye-consciousness thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards eye-contact thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards feeling thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards craving thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards the ear thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ … One regards the nose thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ … One regards the tongue thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ … One regards the body thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ … One regards the mind thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards mental phenomena thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards mind-consciousness thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards mind-contact thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards feeling thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’ One regards craving thus, ‘This is not mine, this I am not, this is not my self.’

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Taṇhā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. Taṇhāya uppādopi vayopi paññāyati. Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati, ‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti. Tasmā taṃ na upapajjati – ‘taṇhā attā’ti yo vadeyya. Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā, manosamphasso anattā, vedanā anattā, taṇhā anattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若有人说‘渴爱是我’，此说不成立。因为渴爱的生起与坏灭可被了知。凡是其生起与坏灭可被了知者，他就会得出‘我的我生起又坏灭’这样的结论。因此，若有人说‘渴爱是我’，此说不成立。是故，意是无我，法是无我，意识是无我，意触是无我，受是无我，渴爱是无我。
rows.english: If anyone were to say, 'Craving is self,' that would not be tenable. The arising and passing away of craving are discerned. For one for whom arising and passing away are discerned, it would follow thus: 'My self arises and ceases.' Therefore, it would not be tenable for anyone to say, 'Craving is self.' Thus, the mind is not-self, mental phenomena are not-self, mind-consciousness is not-self, mind-contact is not-self, feeling is not-self, and craving is not-self.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ . Kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? Rūpāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ. ‘Cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. Idaṃ dutiyaṃ chakkaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘应知六外处’——此话是这样说的。此是依何而说？色处、声处、香处、味处、触处、法处。所谓‘应知六外处’，此话是依此而说。此是第二组六法。
rows.english: “‘Six external sense bases are to be known’—so it was said. And in reference to what was this said? The form sense base, the sound sense base, the odor sense base, the taste sense base, the tangible sense base, and the mental-object sense base. ‘Six external sense bases are to be known’—that which was said, was said in reference to this. This is the second set of six.

rows.pali: 425 . ‘‘Cakkhuñca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā. So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. Tassa rāgānusayo anuseti. Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati. Tassa paṭighānusayo anuseti. Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. Tassa avijjānusayo anuseti. So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ appahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ appaṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ asamūhanitvā avijjaṃ appahāya vijjaṃ anuppādetvā diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro bhavissatīti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 425. 诸比丘，缘眼与色而生眼识，三者和合为触；缘触而生受，或乐、或苦、或不苦不乐。彼为乐受所触时，便欢喜、称誉、执取而住，其贪随眠即潜伏。彼为苦受所触时，便忧愁、疲惫、悲叹、捶胸号哭、陷入迷乱，其瞋随眠即潜伏。彼为不苦不乐受所触时，不如实了知该受的集、灭、味、患、离，其无明随眠即潜伏。诸比丘，彼于乐受不舍弃贪随眠，于苦受不遣除瞋随眠，于不苦不乐受不根除无明随眠，不舍弃无明、不生起明，而能于现法中作苦之边际者，实无是处。
rows.english: 425. Monks, dependent on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact. Conditioned by contact, a feeling arises—pleasant, painful, or neither-pleasant-nor-painful. Touched by a pleasant feeling, one delights in it, welcomes it, and remains attached to it. The underlying tendency to lust lies latent in him. Touched by a painful feeling, one sorrows, becomes weary, laments, beats one’s breast, and falls into bewilderment. The underlying tendency to aversion lies latent in him. Touched by a neither-pleasant-nor-painful feeling, one does not understand as it truly is the arising, the passing away, the gratification, the danger, and the escape concerning that feeling. The underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent in him. Monks, that one, without abandoning the underlying tendency to lust for pleasant feeling, without dispelling the underlying tendency to aversion for painful feeling, without uprooting the underlying tendency to ignorance for neither-pleasant-nor-painful feeling, without abandoning ignorance and without causing knowledge to arise, will make an end of suffering in this very life—this is not possible.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Vedanā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. Vedanāya uppādopi vayopi paññāyati. Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati, ‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti. Tasmā taṃ na upapajjati – ‘vedanā attā’ti yo vadeyya. Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā, manosamphasso anattā, vedanā anattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若有人说‘受是我’，此说不成立。因为受的生起与坏灭可被了知。凡是其生起与坏灭可被了知者，他就会得出‘我的我生起又坏灭’这样的结论。因此，若有人说‘受是我’，此说不成立。是故，意是无我，法是无我，意识是无我，意触是无我，受是无我。
rows.english: If anyone were to say, 'Feeling is self,' that would not be tenable. The arising and passing away of feeling are discerned. For one for whom arising and passing away are discerned, it would follow thus: 'My self arises and ceases.' Therefore, it would not be tenable for anyone to say, 'Feeling is self.' Thus, the mind is not-self, mental phenomena are not-self, mind-consciousness is not-self, mind-contact is not-self, and feeling is not-self.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Cakkhusamphasso attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. Cakkhusamphassassa uppādopi vayopi paññāyati . Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati, ‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti. Tasmā taṃ na upapajjati – ‘cakkhusamphasso attā’ti yo vadeyya. Iti cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā, cakkhusamphasso anattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “若有人说‘眼触是我’，此说不成立。因为眼触的生起与坏灭是可知的。凡是生起与坏灭可知者，对他来说，就会得出‘我的我生起又坏灭’这样的结论。因此，若有人说‘眼触是我’，此说不成立。所以，眼是无我，色是无我，眼识是无我，眼触是无我。”
rows.english: “If anyone were to say, ‘Eye-contact is self,’ that is not tenable. The arising and passing away of eye-contact are discerned. For one for whom arising and passing away are discerned, it would follow thus: ‘My self arises and ceases.’ Therefore, it is not tenable for anyone to say, ‘Eye-contact is self.’ Thus, the eye is not-self, forms are not-self, eye-consciousness is not-self, eye-contact is not-self.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Manosamphasso attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. Manosamphassassa uppādopi vayopi paññāyati. Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati, ‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti. Tasmā taṃ na upapajjati – ‘manosamphasso attā’ti yo vadeyya. Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā, manosamphasso anattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 若有人说‘意触是我’，此说不成立。因为意触的生起与坏灭可被了知。凡是其生起与坏灭可被了知者，他就会得出‘我的我生起又坏灭’这样的结论。因此，若有人说‘意触是我’，此说不成立。是故，意是无我，法是无我，意识是无我，意触是无我。
rows.english: If anyone were to say, 'Mind-contact is self,' that would not be tenable. The arising and passing away of mind-contact are discerned. For one for whom arising and passing away are discerned, it would follow thus: 'My self arises and ceases.' Therefore, it would not be tenable for anyone to say, 'Mind-contact is self.' Thus, the mind is not-self, mental phenomena are not-self, mind-consciousness is not-self, and mind-contact is not-self.

rows.pali: 421 . ‘‘‘Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? Cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ , kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ. ‘Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ chakkaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 421. ‘应知六内处’——此话是这样说的。此是依何而说？眼处、耳处、鼻处、舌处、身处、意处。所谓‘应知六内处’，此话是依此而说。此是第一组六法。
rows.english: 421. “‘Six internal sense bases are to be known’—so it was said. And in reference to what was this said? The eye sense base, the ear sense base, the nose sense base, the tongue sense base, the body sense base, and the mind sense base. ‘Six internal sense bases are to be known’—that which was said, was said in reference to this. This is the first set of six.

rows.pali: 427 . ‘‘Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃ cakkhusmimpi (syā. kaṃ.) evamitaresupi nibbindati, rūpesu nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇe nibbindati, cakkhusamphasse nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, taṇhāya nibbindati. Sotasmiṃ nibbindati, saddesu nibbindati…pe… ghānasmiṃ nibbindati, gandhesu nibbindati… jivhāya nibbindati, rasesu nibbindati… kāyasmiṃ nibbindati, phoṭṭhabbesu nibbindati… manasmiṃ nibbindati, dhammesu nibbindati, manoviññāṇe nibbindati, manosamphasse nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, taṇhāya nibbindati. Nibbindaṃ virajjati , virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 427. 诸比丘，如此观察，多闻圣弟子于眼厌离，于色厌离，于眼识厌离，于眼触厌离，于受厌离，于爱厌离。于耳厌离，于声厌离……于鼻厌离，于香厌离……于舌厌离，于味厌离……于身厌离，于触厌离……于意厌离，于法厌离，于意识厌离，于意触厌离，于受厌离，于爱厌离。因厌离而离贪，因离贪而解脱。于解脱时，生起‘已解脱’之智。他了知：‘生已尽，梵行已立，所作已办，不再有此存在。’
rows.english: 427. “Seeing thus, Bhikkhus, the learned noble disciple becomes disenchanted with the eye, disenchanted with forms, disenchanted with eye-consciousness, disenchanted with eye-contact, disenchanted with feeling, and disenchanted with craving. He becomes disenchanted with the ear and with sounds… and so forth… with the nose and with odors… with the tongue and with tastes… with the body and with tangible objects… with the mind, with mental objects, with mind-consciousness, with mind-contact, with feeling, and with craving. Being disenchanted, he becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion, he is liberated. When he is liberated, the knowledge arises, ‘I am liberated.’ He understands: ‘Birth is destroyed, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this state of being.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. Cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādopi vayopi paññāyati. Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati, ‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti. Tasmā taṃ na upapajjati – ‘cakkhuviññāṇaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya. Iti cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “若有人说‘眼识是我’，此说不成立。因为眼识的生起与坏灭是可知的。凡是生起与坏灭可知者，对他来说，就会得出‘我的我生起又坏灭’这样的结论。因此，若有人说‘眼识是我’，此说不成立。所以，眼是无我，色是无我，眼识是无我。”
rows.english: “If anyone were to say, ‘Eye-consciousness is self,’ that is not tenable. The arising and passing away of eye-consciousness are discerned. For one for whom arising and passing away are discerned, it would follow thus: ‘My self arises and ceases.’ Therefore, it is not tenable for anyone to say, ‘Eye-consciousness is self.’ Thus, the eye is not-self, forms are not-self, eye-consciousness is not-self.

rows.pali: ‘‘‘Manoviññāṇaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. Manoviññāṇassa uppādopi vayopi paññāyati.
