Taking life, friends, is unwholesome; taking what is not given is unwholesome; misconduct in sensual pleasures is unwholesome; false speech is unwholesome; slanderous speech is unwholesome; harsh speech is unwholesome; idle chatter is unwholesome; covetousness is unwholesome; ill will is unwholesome; wrong view is unwholesome—this, friends, is called the unwholesome. And what, friends, is the root of the unwholesome? Greed is a root of the unwholesome, hatred is a root of the unwholesome, delusion is a root of the unwholesome. This, friends, is called the root of the unwholesome.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako evaṃ akusalaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ akusalamūlaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ kusalaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ kusalamūlaṃ pajānāti, so sabbaso rāgānusayaṃ pahāya, paṭighānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā, ‘asmī’ti diṭṭhimānānusayaṃ samūhanitvā, avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā, diṭṭhevadhamme dukkhassantakaro hoti – ettāvatāpi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ujugatāssa diṭṭhi, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato, āgato imaṃ saddhamma’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，当圣弟子如此了知不善、如此了知不善根、如此了知善、如此了知善根时，他完全舍断贪随眠，去除瞋随眠，根除‘我是’之见慢随眠，舍断无明而生起明，就在现法中成为苦的终结者。贤友们，仅以此，圣弟子即是正见者，其见正直，于法具足不坏净，已到达此正法。”
rows.english: “Friends, when a noble disciple thus understands the unwholesome, thus understands the root of the unwholesome, thus understands the wholesome, and thus understands the root of the wholesome, he, having entirely abandoned the underlying tendency to lust, having dispelled the underlying tendency to aversion, having uprooted the underlying tendency of the view and conceit ‘I am,’ having abandoned ignorance and aroused true knowledge, makes an end of suffering in this very life. To that extent also, friends, a noble disciple is one of right view, whose view is straight, who is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma, and has arrived at this Good Dhamma.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Siyā, āvuso. Yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako dukkhañca pajānāti, dukkhasamudayañca pajānāti, dukkhanirodhañca pajānāti, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañca pajānāti – ettāvatāpi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ujugatāssa diṭṭhi, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato, āgato imaṃ saddhammaṃ. Katamaṃ panāvuso, dukkhaṃ, katamo dukkhasamudayo, katamo dukkhanirodho, katamā dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā? Jātipi dukkhā, jarāpi dukkhā, maraṇampi dukkhaṃ, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāpi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogopi dukkho, piyehi vippayogopi dukkho, yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ, saṃkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā pañcupādānakkhandhāpi (ka.) dukkhā – idaṃ vuccatāvuso, dukkhaṃ. Katamo cāvuso, dukkhasamudayo? Yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandīrāgasahagatā ponobhavikā (sī. pī.) tatratatrābhinandinī nandirāgasahagatā (sī. pī.) , seyyathidaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā – ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, dukkhasamudayo. Katamo cāvuso, dukkhanirodho? Yo tassāyeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo – ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, dukkhanirodho. Katamā cāvuso, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā? Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi…pe… sammāsamādhi – ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “是有的，贤友们。贤友们，当圣弟子了知苦、了知苦集、了知苦灭、了知导向苦灭之道时——贤友们，仅以此，圣弟子即成为正见者，其见解正直，于法具足不坏净，已到达此正法。贤友们，什么是苦？什么是苦集？什么是苦灭？什么是导向苦灭之道？生亦是苦，老亦是苦，死亦是苦，愁、悲、苦、忧、恼亦是苦，与不爱者相会亦是苦，与所爱者分离亦是苦，所求不得亦是苦；简言之，五取蕴是苦——贤友们，这被称为苦。贤友们，什么是苦集？即是引向再生的渴爱，与喜和贪俱行，于处处寻求喜乐，也就是：欲爱、有爱、无有爱——贤友们，这被称为苦集。贤友们，什么是苦灭？即是那渴爱的无余离贪、灭尽、舍弃、舍离、解脱、无执——贤友们，这被称为苦灭。贤友们，什么是导向苦灭之道？就是此圣八支道，即：正见……乃至……正定——贤友们，这被称为导向苦灭之道。”
rows.english: “There might be, friends. When a noble disciple understands suffering, understands the origin of suffering, understands the cessation of suffering, and understands the practice leading to the cessation of suffering—to this extent, friends, a noble disciple is one of right view, whose view is straight, who is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma, and has arrived at this true Dhamma. But what, friends, is suffering? What is the origin of suffering? What is the cessation of suffering? What is the practice leading to the cessation of suffering? Birth is suffering, aging is suffering, death is suffering; sorrow, lamentation, pain, grief, and despair are suffering; association with the unloved is suffering; separation from the loved is suffering; not getting what one desires is suffering. In short, the five aggregates of clinging are suffering. This, friends, is called suffering. And what, friends, is the origin of suffering? It is this craving which produces renewed existence, is accompanied by delight and lust, and finds delight here and there—that is, craving for sensual pleasures, craving for existence, and craving for non-existence. This, friends, is called the origin of suffering. And what, friends, is the cessation of suffering? It is the remainderless fading away and cessation of that very craving, its relinquishment, abandonment, release, and freedom from attachment. This, friends, is called the cessation of suffering. And what, friends, is the practice leading to the cessation of suffering? It is this very Noble Eightfold Path, namely: right view… right concentration. This, friends, is called the practice leading to the cessation of suffering.

rows.pali: 1024 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca – ‘‘yato kho, gahapati, ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni ca honti, catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇatiracchānayoniyo (sabbattha) khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto; sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 1024. 缘起于舍卫城。世尊对坐在一旁的给孤独居士说了这番话：‘居士，当圣弟子的五种怖畏与怨敌平息，具足四预流支，并以智慧善见、善通达圣道时，他若愿意，即可亲自对自己记说：“我已尽地狱，尽畜生趣，尽饿鬼界，尽恶趣、恶道、堕处。我是预流者，不堕恶趣法，决定以正等觉为归趣。”’
rows.english: 1024. At Sāvatthī. The Blessed One said to the householder Anāthapiṇḍika, who was seated to one side: 'Householder, when for a noble disciple five fears and enmities are allayed, and he is endowed with the four factors of stream-entry, and the noble method is well-seen and well-penetrated by him with wisdom, then, if he so wishes, he may declare of himself: “I am finished with hell, finished with the animal realm, finished with the realm of ghosts, finished with the states of deprivation, bad destinations, and perdition; I am a stream-enterer, not subject to perdition, assured, with enlightenment as my final destination.”'

rows.pali: ‘‘Yato kho, gahapati, ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ayañcassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho . So ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto; sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’ti. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “居士，当圣弟子的这五种怖畏与怨恨平息，具备这四种入流支(sotāpattiyaṅga)，并且此圣理已由智慧善见、善通达时，他若愿意，即可由自己对自己记说：‘我地狱已尽，畜生道已尽，饿鬼界已尽，恶趣、恶道、堕处已尽。我是入流者(sotāpanna)，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。’”第八。
rows.english: When, householder, for a noble disciple these five fears and enmities are allayed, when he is endowed with these four factors of stream-entry, and this noble principle has been well seen and well penetrated by him with wisdom, he may, if he wishes, declare of himself: ‘I am finished with hell, finished with the animal realm, finished with the sphere of ghosts, finished with the planes of misery, the bad destinations, and the states of ruin. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to the lower realms, assured, with enlightenment as my final destination.’ The eighth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti? Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi…pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi. Imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘具足哪四预流支呢？居士，于此，圣弟子于佛具足不坏净：‘彼世尊亦即是：阿罗汉、正等觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士、调御丈夫、天人师、佛、世尊。’于法……于僧……具足圣者所喜爱之戒，无断……能引生禅定。他具足这四预流支。’
rows.english: “With which four factors of stream-entry is he endowed? Here, householder, a noble disciple is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is an Arahant… Teacher of gods and humans, the Enlightened One, the Blessed One.’ He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Saṅgha… He is endowed with the virtues dear to the noble ones, which are unbroken… and conducive to concentration. He is endowed with these four factors of stream-entry.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti? Yaṃ, gahapati, pāṇātipātī pāṇātipātappaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati. Pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa evaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti. Yaṃ, gahapati, adinnādāyī…pe… yaṃ, gahapati, kāmesumicchācārī…pe… yaṃ, gahapati, musāvādī…pe… yaṃ, gahapati, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhāyī surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānappaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati. Surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa evaṃ taṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti. Imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘是哪五种怖畏与怨敌平息了呢？居士，杀生者因杀生之缘故，于现法中产生怖畏与怨敌，于来世中也产生怖畏与怨敌，且感受到心所的苦与忧。对远离杀生者而言，那样的怖畏与怨敌就平息了。居士，不与取者……居士，欲邪行者……居士，妄语者……居士，服用导致放逸的酒类与麻醉品者，因服用导致放逸的酒类与麻醉品之缘故，于现法中产生怖畏与怨敌，于来世中也产生怖畏与怨敌，且感受到心所的苦与忧。对远离服用导致放逸的酒类与麻醉品者而言，那样的怖畏与怨敌就平息了。这五种怖畏与怨敌平息了。’
rows.english: “What are the five fears and enmities that are allayed? Householder, one who destroys life, on account of destroying life, generates fear and enmity in this very life and generates fear and enmity in the life to come, and he experiences mental suffering and displeasure. For one who abstains from destroying life, that fear and enmity is thus allayed. Householder, one who takes what is not given… one who engages in sexual misconduct… one who speaks falsely… Householder, one who partakes of liquors, wines, and intoxicants which are the basis for heedlessness, on account of partaking of liquors, wines, and intoxicants which are the basis for heedlessness, generates fear and enmity in this very life and generates fear and enmity in the life to come, and he experiences mental suffering and displeasure. For one who abstains from partaking of liquors, wines, and intoxicants which are the basis for heedlessness, that fear and enmity is thus allayed. These are the five fears and enmities that are allayed.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho? Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasi karoti – iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati; iti imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati; yadidaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ…pe… evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti. Avijjāya tveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho…pe… phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho… evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti. Ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “居士，什么是他以智慧善见、善通达的圣理呢？在此，居士，圣弟子善于如理作意缘起(paṭiccasamuppāda)本身：‘此有故彼有，此生故彼生；此无故彼无，此灭故彼灭。’也就是：无明缘行，行缘识……像这样，这整个苦蕴便生起。又因无明的无余离贪灭尽，行便灭……像这样，这整个苦蕴便灭尽。这就是他以智慧善见、善通达的圣理。”
rows.english: And what, for him, is the noble principle that is well seen and well penetrated with wisdom? Here, householder, a noble disciple attends well and wisely to dependent origination itself thus: ‘When this exists, that comes to be; with the arising of this, that arises. When this does not exist, that does not come to be; with the cessation of this, that ceases.’ That is: with ignorance as condition, formations come to be; with formations as condition, consciousness comes to be… Thus is the origin of this whole mass of suffering. But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of that very ignorance, comes the cessation of formations… Thus is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering. This, for him, is the noble principle that is well seen and well penetrated with wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Na hiṃse pāṇabhūtāni, vijjamāne parakkame; Musā ca na bhaṇe jānaṃ, adinnaṃ na parāmase.
rows.chinese_simplified: “即使有能力，也不应伤害有情；明知而不应说妄语，不应取未予之物。
rows.english: When making an effort, one should not harm living beings; knowing, one should not speak falsely, nor take what is not given.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, ariyasāvako dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti. Ayamassa dutiyo ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，舍利弗，圣弟子于法具足不坏净信：‘世尊善说之法，是现见的、无时的、来见的、能导向的、智者们各自当证知的。’这是他所获得的第二种增上心之现法乐住，为令未清净之心清净，为令未洁白之心洁白。
rows.english: “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a noble disciple is possessed of unwavering confidence in the Dhamma thus: ‘The Dhamma is well-proclaimed by the Blessed One, visible here and now, immediate, inviting one to come and see, leading onward, to be realized by the wise for themselves.’ This is the second abiding pertaining to the higher mind, a pleasant dwelling in this very life, that is attained for the purification of an impure mind and for the cleansing of an uncleansed mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ye ca sante upāsanti, sappaññe dhīrasammate; Saddhā ca nesaṃ sugate, mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 而若亲近具慧、为智者所敬重之贤圣，彼等对善逝之信，则根生而确立。
rows.english: But those who attend upon the good persons, who are wise and esteemed by the wise, their faith in the Well-gone One has taken root and is established.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamesu pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammanto hoti? Idha , sāriputta, ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti. Imesu pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammanto hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘于哪五学处中守护其行？舍利弗，于此，圣弟子远离杀生，远离不与取，远离欲邪行，远离妄语，远离作为放逸之基的谷酒与果酒。此为于五学处中守护其行。’
rows.english: “In which five training precepts are his actions restrained? Here, Sāriputta, a noble disciple abstains from the destruction of life, abstains from taking what is not given, abstains from misconduct in sensual pleasures, abstains from false speech, and abstains from distilled and fermented intoxicants which are a cause for heedlessness. It is in these five training precepts that his actions are restrained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Bālā ca avijānantā, dummedhā assutāvino; Bahiddhā dadanti dānāni, na hi sante upāsare.
rows.chinese_simplified: 愚人无知，劣慧寡闻，于教外行布施，实不亲近贤圣。
rows.english: The foolish, not knowing, unwise, and unlearned give gifts outside the Dispensation; they do not attend upon the good persons.

rows.pali: ‘‘Devalokañca te yanti, kule vā idha jāyare; Anupubbena nibbānaṃ, adhigacchanti paṇḍitā’’ti. navamaṃ;
rows.chinese_simplified: 他们或往生天界，或在此世生于善族；贤者们次第证得涅槃。”第九。
rows.english: They go to the heavenly world, or are born here in a noble family; sequentially, the wise attain Nibbāna. The ninth sutta is finished.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yaṃ kañci, sāriputta, jāneyyātha gihiṃ odātavasanaṃ – imesu pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammantaṃ, imesañca catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhiṃ akicchalābhiṃ akasiralābhiṃ, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “舍利弗，无论你们知道有何居家白衣，于此五学处中行为受防护，对于这四种增上心所的现法乐住，随意获得，无困难获得，不费力获得，他若愿意，可自行记说：‘我已尽地狱，尽畜生胎，尽饿鬼界，已尽恶趣、苦趣、堕处；我是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。’”
rows.english: Sāriputta, whatever householder clad in white you may know to be one whose actions are restrained with regard to these five training precepts, and who obtains at will, without difficulty, and without trouble these four higher mental states that are pleasant abidings in this very life—he, if he wishes, may declare of himself: ‘Hell is ended for me, the animal realm is ended, the realm of ghosts is ended, the plane of misery, the bad destination, the state of downfall is ended. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to downfall, assured, and destined for enlightenment.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī? Idha, sāriputta, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti. Ayamassa paṭhamo ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘为哪四种增上心之现法乐住的随意得者、无难得者、不疲得者？舍利弗，于此，圣弟子于佛具足不坏净信：“彼世尊亦是阿罗汉、正等觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士调御丈夫、天人师、佛、世尊。”此为他所证得的第一种增上心之现法乐住，能令未清净心得以清净，未皎洁心得以皎洁。’
rows.english: “Of which four abidings pertaining to the higher mind, which are pleasant dwellings in this very life, is one an obtainer at will, without difficulty, and without trouble? Here, Sāriputta, a noble disciple is possessed of unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, a Sublime One, a Knower of the world, an unsurpassed guide for persons to be tamed, a Teacher of gods and humans, an Enlightened One, a Blessed One.’ This is the first abiding pertaining to the higher mind, a pleasant dwelling in this very life, that is attained for the purification of an impure mind and for the cleansing of an uncleansed mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, ariyasāvako saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti. Ayamassa tatiyo ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，舍利弗，圣弟子于僧具足不坏净信：‘世尊的弟子僧团是善行道者，世尊的弟子僧团是正直行道者，世尊的弟子僧团是为求涅槃而行道者，世尊的弟子僧团是如法行道者，即四双八辈之人。这世尊的弟子僧团是应供养者、应款待者、应布施者、应合掌者，是世间无上福田。’这是他所获得的第三种增上心之现法乐住，为令未清净之心清净，为令未洁白之心洁白。
rows.english: “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a noble disciple is possessed of unwavering confidence in the Saṅgha thus: ‘The Saṅgha of the Blessed One’s disciples is practicing the good way, practicing the straight way, practicing the methodical way, practicing the proper way. That is, the four pairs of persons, the eight individuals. This Saṅgha of the Blessed One’s disciples is worthy of gifts, worthy of hospitality, worthy of offerings, worthy of reverential salutation, an unsurpassed field of merit for the world.’ This is the third abiding pertaining to the higher mind, a pleasant dwelling in this very life, that is attained for the purification of an impure mind and for the cleansing of an uncleansed mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, ariyasāvako ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi. Ayamassa catuttho ābhicetasiko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro adhigato hoti avisuddhassa cittassa visuddhiyā apariyodātassa cittassa pariyodapanāya. Imesaṃ catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，舍利弗，圣弟子具足圣者所爱之戒，其戒不破、不穿、不杂、不染、自在、为智者所称赞、不为邪见所执取、能引生禅定。这是他所获得的第四种增上心之现法乐住，为令未清净之心清净，为令未洁白之心洁白。对于这四种增上心之现法乐住，他能随意获得，不难获得，不费力获得。
rows.english: “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a noble disciple is possessed of virtues dear to the noble ones—unbroken, unblemished, unspotted, unmarred, liberating, praised by the wise, ungrasped, and conducive to concentration. This is the fourth abiding pertaining to the higher mind, a pleasant dwelling in this very life, that is attained for the purification of an impure mind and for the cleansing of an uncleansed mind. Of these four abidings pertaining to the higher mind, which are pleasant dwellings in this very life, one is an obtainer at will, without difficulty, and without trouble.

rows.pali: 179 . Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘yaṃ kañci yaṃ kiñci (sī. pī.) , sāriputta, jāneyyātha gihiṃ odātavasanaṃ pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammantaṃ catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhiṃ akicchalābhiṃ akasiralābhiṃ, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 179. 尔时，给孤独长者为大约五百位优婆塞所围绕，前往世尊所在之处。抵达后，顶礼世尊，坐于一旁。尔时，世尊对具寿舍利弗说：‘舍利弗，你们当知，任何白衣居士，于五学处中守护其行，为四种增上心之现法乐住(diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāra)的随意得者、无难得者、不疲得者，他若愿意，可亲自记说自己：“我已尽地狱，尽畜生胎，尽饿鬼界，尽恶趣、恶道、堕处。我乃入流者(sotāpanna)，不堕法者，决定趣向正觉。”’
rows.english: 179. Then the householder Anāthapiṇḍika, surrounded by about five hundred lay followers, approached the Blessed One. Having approached and paid homage to the Blessed One, he sat down to one side. Then the Blessed One addressed the Venerable Sāriputta: “Sāriputta, should you know of any householder clad in white whose actions are restrained in regard to the five training precepts, and who obtains at will, without difficulty, and without trouble, the four abidings pertaining to the higher mind, which are pleasant dwellings in this very life, that person, if they so wish, could declare of themselves: ‘For me, hell is destroyed, the animal realm is destroyed, the realm of petas is destroyed; the planes of misery, the bad destinations, the state of ruin are destroyed. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to downfall, assured, and bound for enlightenment.’”

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了此语。那些比丘心满意足，欢喜世尊所说。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Pleased, those bhikkhus delighted in the Blessed One’s words.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, upāsikā ca gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu, no ca kho upāsikā gihiniyo odātavasanā kāmabhoginiyo ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa tenaṅgena. Yasmā ca kho, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino ārādhakā, upāsikā ca gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo ārādhikā, upāsikā ca gihiniyo odātavasanā kāmabhoginiyo ārādhikā; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ tenaṅgena.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，如果尊者乔达摩成就此法，比丘们成就此法，比丘尼们成就此法，在家白衣、行梵行的优婆塞成就此法，在家白衣、受用欲乐的优婆塞成就此法，在家白衣、行梵行的优婆夷成就此法，而在家白衣、受用欲乐的优婆夷不能成就此法；那么，此梵行因这一部分便为不圆满。然而，尊者乔达摩，正因为尊者乔达摩成就此法，比丘们成就此法，比丘尼们成就此法，在家白衣、行梵行的优婆塞成就此法，在家白衣、受用欲乐的优婆塞成就此法，在家白衣、行梵行的优婆夷成就此法，在家白衣、受用欲乐的优婆夷也能成就此法；所以，此梵行因这一部分而为圆满。”
rows.english: “If, Master Gotama, you had accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks had accomplished it, and the nuns had accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—had accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—had accomplished it, and the female lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—had accomplished it, but the female lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—had not accomplished it, then this holy life would have been incomplete in that respect. But since, Master Gotama, you have accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks have accomplished it, and the nuns have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—have accomplished it, and the female lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—have accomplished it, and the female lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—have also accomplished it, this holy life is complete in that respect.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, no ca kho upāsikā gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa tenaṅgena. Yasmā ca kho, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino ārādhakā , upāsikā ca gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo ārādhikā; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ tenaṅgena.
rows.chinese_simplified: “乔达摩尊者，倘若您乔达摩能成就此法，比丘们能成就此法，比丘尼们能成就此法，行梵行的在家白衣优婆塞能成就此法，受用欲乐的在家白衣优婆塞能成就此法，而行梵行的在家白衣优婆夷不能成就此法；那么这梵行就因这一部分而不圆满。乔达摩尊者，正因为您乔达摩能成就此法，比丘们能成就此法，比丘尼们能成就此法，行梵行的在家白衣优婆塞能成就此法，受用欲乐的在家白衣优婆塞能成就此法，以及行梵行的在家白衣优婆夷也能成就此法；所以这梵行因这一部分而圆满。”
rows.english: “If, Master Gotama, you had accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks had accomplished it, and the nuns had accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—had accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—had accomplished it, but the female lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—had not accomplished it, then this holy life would have been incomplete in that respect. But since, Master Gotama, you have accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks have accomplished it, and the nuns have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—have accomplished it, and the female lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—have also accomplished it, this holy life is complete in that respect.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, no ca kho upāsakā gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa tenaṅgena. Yasmā ca kho, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino ārādhakā; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ tenaṅgena.
rows.chinese_simplified: 乔达摩尊者，倘若您本人能成就此法，比丘能成就，比丘尼能成就，行梵行的白衣在家优婆塞能成就，而受用欲乐的白衣在家优婆塞不能成就，那么，这梵行于此方面则为不圆满。而正因为，乔达摩尊者，您本人能成就此法，比丘能成就，比丘尼能成就，行梵行的白衣在家优婆塞能成就，以及受用欲乐的白衣在家优婆塞也能成就，因此，这梵行于此方面是圆满的。
rows.english: “If, Master Gotama, you had accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks had accomplished it, and the nuns had accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—had accomplished it, but the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—had not accomplished it, then this holy life would have been incomplete in that respect. But since, Master Gotama, you have accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks have accomplished it, and the nuns have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures—have also accomplished it, this holy life is complete in that respect.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu, no ca kho upāsakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa tenaṅgena. Yasmā ca kho, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā, upāsakā ca gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino ārādhakā; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ tenaṅgena.
rows.chinese_simplified: 乔达摩尊者，倘若您本人能成就此法，比丘能成就，比丘尼能成就，而行梵行的白衣在家优婆塞不能成就，那么，这梵行于此方面则为不圆满。而正因为，乔达摩尊者，您本人能成就此法，比丘能成就，比丘尼能成就，以及行梵行的白衣在家优婆塞也能成就，因此，这梵行于此方面是圆满的。
rows.english: “If, Master Gotama, you had accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks had accomplished it, and the nuns had accomplished it, but the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—had not accomplished it, then this holy life would have been incomplete in that respect. But since, Master Gotama, you have accomplished this Dhamma, and the monks have accomplished it, and the nuns have accomplished it, and the male lay disciples—householders clad in white who lead the holy life—have also accomplished it, this holy life is complete in that respect.”

rows.pali: 195 . ‘‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo. Atthi pana te bhoto gotamassa ekabhikkhupi sāvako yo āsavānaṃ khayā sāvako āsavānaṃ khayā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) evamuparipi anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti? ‘‘Na kho, vaccha, ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyova ye bhikkhū mama sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 195. “暂且不谈尊者乔达摩您。但尊者乔达摩，您的弟子中是否哪怕只有一位比丘，因灭尽诸漏，于现法中以殊胜智亲自证知、作证，成就并安住于无漏的心解脱与慧解脱呢？”“婆蹉，我的比丘弟子中，因灭尽诸漏，于现法中以殊胜智亲自证知、作证，成就并安住于无漏的心解脱与慧解脱者，不仅一百，也不是二百、三百、四百、五百，实则远多于此。”
rows.english: 195. 'Let that be, Venerable Gotama. But is there even one bhikkhu disciple of the Venerable Gotama who, through the destruction of the taints, dwells having realized for himself with direct knowledge, in this very life, the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom?' 'It is not just one hundred, Vaccha, not two hundred, not three hundred, not four hundred, not five hundred, but indeed many more are the bhikkhus, my disciples, who, through the destruction of the taints, dwell having realized for themselves with direct knowledge, in this very life, the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom.'

rows.pali: ‘‘So tvaṃ, vaccha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi – ‘dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ – ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti; iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajāneyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati satiāyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆蹉，只要你希望：‘愿我以清净、超人之天眼，得见众生死时、生时，卑劣、高尚，貌美、貌丑，善趣、恶趣；愿我了知众生如何随业而趣——“贤友们，这些众生具足身恶行、语恶行、意恶行，诽谤圣者，有邪见，受持由邪见所引之业，他们身坏命终后，往生到苦界、恶趣、堕处、地狱。而贤友们，这些众生具足身善行、语善行、意善行，不谤圣者，有正见，受持由正见所引之业，他们身坏命终后，往生到善趣、天界。”如是，愿我以清净、超人之天眼，得见众生死时、生时，卑劣、高尚，貌美、貌丑，善趣、恶趣，了知众生如何随业而趣’，那么在每一个这样的范畴中，只要因缘具足，你就能获得亲证的能力。”
rows.english: “Then you, Vaccha, should you wish: ‘With the divine eye, purified and surpassing the human, may I see beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, of good appearance and bad appearance, in good destinations and in bad destinations; may I know distinctly how beings fare according to their kamma: “Indeed, these good beings, endowed with misconduct of body, speech, and mind, who were revilers of the noble ones, held wrong view, and were undertakers of actions based on wrong view—they, with the breakup of the body, after death, have been reborn in the plane of deprivation, a bad destination, a state of ruin, in hell. Or indeed, these good beings, endowed with good conduct of body, speech, and mind, who were not revilers of the noble ones, held right view, and were undertakers of actions based on right view—they, with the breakup of the body, after death, have been reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world.” Thus, with the divine eye, purified and surpassing the human, may I see beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, of good appearance and bad appearance, in good destinations and in bad destinations; may I know distinctly how beings fare according to their kamma’—in each and every case you will attain the ability to witness it, when the basis for mindfulness is present.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu, no ca kho bhikkhuniyo ārādhikā abhavissaṃsu; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa tenaṅgena. Yasmā ca kho, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako, bhikkhū ca ārādhakā, bhikkhuniyo ca ārādhikā; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ tenaṅgena.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，如果尊者乔达摩您能成就此法，比丘们也能成就，但比丘尼们不能成就，那么这梵行就会因这一方面而不圆满。然而，尊者乔达摩，正因为尊者乔达摩您能成就此法，比丘们能成就，比丘尼们也能成就，所以这梵行才因这一方面而圆满。”
rows.english: “For if, Venerable Gotama, the Venerable Gotama were the accomplisher of this Dhamma, and the monks were the accomplishers, but the nuns were not the accomplishers, then in that aspect this holy life would be incomplete. And because, Venerable Gotama, the Venerable Gotama is the accomplisher of this Dhamma, and the monks are the accomplishers, and the nuns are the accomplishers, in that aspect this holy life is complete.”

rows.pali: 194 . ‘‘Lobho kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, alobho kusalaṃ; doso kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, adoso kusalaṃ; moho kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, amoho kusalaṃ. Iti kho, vaccha, ime tayo dhammā akusalā, tayo dhammā kusalā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 194. “瓦差，贪实为不善，无贪为善；瞋实为不善，无瞋为善；痴实为不善，无痴为善。瓦差，如是，此三法为不善，三法为善。”
rows.english: 194. Greed, Vaccha, is unwholesome; non-greed is wholesome. Aversion, Vaccha, is unwholesome; non-aversion is wholesome. Delusion, Vaccha, is unwholesome; non-delusion is wholesome. Thus, Vaccha, these three things are unwholesome, and these three things are wholesome.

rows.pali: ‘‘Yato kho, vaccha, bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, so hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆蹉，当比丘的渴爱已断，根已被截，如多罗树桩，已成非有，于未来为不生之法，彼比丘即是阿罗汉、漏尽者、梵行已立、所作已办、已舍重担、已证己利、已尽有结、正智解脱者。”
rows.english: Vaccha, when a bhikkhu's craving has been abandoned, its root cut off, made like a palm-tree stump, brought to non-existence, and is of a nature not to arise again in the future, that bhikkhu is an Arahant, one whose taints are destroyed, who has lived the holy life, done what had to be done, laid down the burden, attained his own goal, for whom the fetter of existence is destroyed, and who is liberated through right understanding.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhuniyo, tiṭṭhantu upāsakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino, tiṭṭhantu upāsakā gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino, tiṭṭhantu upāsikā gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo. Atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekupāsikāpi sāvikā gihinī odātavasanā kāmabhoginī sāsanakarā ovādappaṭikarā yā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharatī’’ti? ‘‘Na kho, vaccha, ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyova yā upāsikā mama sāvikā gihiniyo odātavasanā kāmabhoginiyo sāsanakarā ovādappaṭikarā tiṇṇavicchikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharantī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩暂且不提，比丘们暂且不提，比丘尼们暂且不提，在家、穿白衣、修梵行的优婆塞们暂且不提，在家、穿白衣、受用欲乐的优婆塞们暂且不提，在家、穿白衣、修梵行的优婆夷们暂且不提。那么，尊者乔达摩，是否有哪怕一位优婆夷弟子，是在家、穿白衣、受用欲乐者，遵行教法，实践教诲，已度脱疑惑，除去犹豫，获得无畏，不依赖他人而住于导师的教法中呢？”“瓦查，不仅一百，不仅二百，不仅三百，不仅四百，不仅五百，而是有更多我的优婆夷弟子，是在家、穿白衣、受用欲乐者，遵行教法，实践教诲，已度脱疑惑，除去犹豫，获得无畏，不依赖他人而住于导师的教法中。”
rows.english: “Let the Venerable Gotama be, let the monks be, let the nuns be, let the male lay followers who are householders clad in white and live the holy life be, let the male lay followers who are householders clad in white and enjoy sensual pleasures be, let the female lay followers who are householders clad in white and live the holy life be. But is there even one female lay disciple, a disciple of the Venerable Gotama—a householder clad in white who enjoys sensual pleasures, who follows the instruction, acts according to the admonition, has overcome doubt, is free from questioning, has attained intrepidity, and dwells not dependent on another in the Teacher's dispensation?” “Vaccha, it is not just one hundred, not two hundred, not three hundred, not four hundred, not five hundred, but far more numerous are the female lay disciples who are my disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures, who follow the instruction, act according to the admonition, have overcome doubt, are free from questioning, have attained intrepidity, and dwell not dependent on another in the Teacher's dispensation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘So tvaṃ, vaccha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi – ‘anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ, seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattālīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi; anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe – amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ; tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapannoti; iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati satiāyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 瓦差，你只要期望——‘愿我能忆起种种宿住，即：一生、二生、三生、四生、五生、十生、二十生、三十生、四十生、五十生、百生、千生、十万生；以及许多坏劫、许多成劫、许多坏成劫——在某某处我曾是如此名、如此姓、如此相貌、食如此食、感受如此苦乐、寿量如此。我从那里死后，生于某某处；在那里，我也是如此名、如此姓、如此相貌、食如此食、感受如此苦乐、寿量如此。我从那里死后，生于此处。像这样，连同行相与纲要，愿我能忆起种种宿住。’只要有念为其因缘，你就能在那些境界中一一达到亲证的能力。
rows.english: “Then you, Vaccha, should you wish: ‘May I recollect my manifold former existences, that is to say: one birth, two births, three births, four births, five births, ten births, twenty births, thirty births, forty births, fifty births, a hundred births, a thousand births, a hundred thousand births; many aeons of contraction, many aeons of expansion, many aeons of contraction and expansion: “In that existence I had such a name, belonged to such a clan, had such an appearance, was nourished by such food, experienced such pleasure and pain, and had such a life-span. Passing away from there, I reappeared elsewhere. There, too, I had such a name, belonged to such a clan, had such an appearance, was nourished by such food, experienced such pleasure and pain, and had such a life-span. Passing away from there, I have been reborn here.” Thus may I recollect my manifold former existences with their aspects and details’—in each and every case you will attain the ability to witness it, when the basis for mindfulness is present.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhuniyo, tiṭṭhantu upāsakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino. Atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekupāsakopi sāvako gihī odātavasano kāmabhogī sāsanakaro ovādappaṭikaro yo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane viharatī’’ti? ‘‘Na kho, vaccha, ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni , atha kho bhiyyova ye upāsakā mama sāvakā gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino sāsanakarā ovādappaṭikarā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane viharantī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，且不提他；比丘们，且不提他们；比丘尼们，且不提她们；在家、穿白衣、修梵行的优婆塞们，且不提他们。尊者乔达摩可有一位优婆塞弟子，是在家、穿白衣、受用欲乐者，遵行教诲，依教奉行，已度脱疑惑，去除犹豫，获得无畏，于导师的教法中不依赖他人而住吗？”“瓦差(Vaccha)，非只一百，非只二百，非只三百，非只四百，非只五百，实则更多。我的优婆塞弟子们，是在家、穿白衣、受用欲乐者，遵行教诲，依教奉行，已度脱疑惑，去除犹豫，获得无畏，于导师的教法中不依赖他人而住。”
rows.english: “Let the Venerable Gotama be, let the monks be, let the nuns be, let the male lay followers who are householders clad in white and live the holy life be. But is there even one male lay follower, a disciple of the Venerable Gotama—a householder clad in white who enjoys sensual pleasures, who follows the instruction, acts according to the admonition, has overcome doubt, is free from questioning, has attained intrepidity, and dwells not dependent on another in the Teacher's dispensation?” “Vaccha, it is not just one hundred, not two hundred, not three hundred, not four hundred, not five hundred, but far more numerous are the male lay followers who are my disciples—householders clad in white who enjoy sensual pleasures, who follow the instruction, act according to the admonition, have overcome doubt, are free from questioning, have attained intrepidity, and dwell not dependent on another in the Teacher's dispensation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhuniyo, tiṭṭhantu upāsakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino, tiṭṭhantu upāsakā gihī odātavasanā kāmabhogino. Atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekupāsikāpi sāvikā gihinī odātavasanā brahmacārinī yā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā’’ti? ‘‘Na kho, vaccha, ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyova yā upāsikā mama sāvikā gihiniyo odātavasanā brahmacāriniyo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyiniyo anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，且不提他；比丘们，且不提他们；比丘尼们，且不提她们；在家、穿白衣、修梵行的优婆塞们，且不提他们；在家、穿白衣、受用欲乐的优婆塞们，且不提他们。尊者乔达摩可有一位优婆夷弟子，是在家、穿白衣、修梵行者，因五下分结(orambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni)已尽，而为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，自彼世间不复还吗？”“瓦差(Vaccha)，非只一百，非只二百，非只三百，非只四百，非只五百，实则更多。我的优婆夷弟子们，是在家、穿白衣、修梵行者，因五下分结已尽，而为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，自彼世间不复还。”
rows.english: “Let the Venerable Gotama be, let the monks be, let the nuns be, let the male lay followers who are householders clad in white and live the holy life be, let the male lay followers who are householders clad in white and enjoy sensual pleasures be. But is there even one female lay disciple, a disciple of the Venerable Gotama—a householder clad in white who lives the holy life—who, with the complete destruction of the five lower fetters, is of spontaneous birth, will attain final Nibbāna there, and is of the nature of not returning from that world?” “Vaccha, it is not just one hundred, not two hundred, not three hundred, not four hundred, not five hundred, but far more numerous are the female lay disciples who are my disciples—householders clad in white who live the holy life—who, with the complete destruction of the five lower fetters, are of spontaneous birth, will attain final Nibbāna there, and are of the nature of not returning from that world.”

rows.pali: ‘‘So tvaṃ, vaccha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi – ‘dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ – dibbe ca mānuse ca, ye dūre santike cā’ti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati satiāyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘瓦差，只要你意欲——“愿我以清净、超人的天耳界(dibba-sotadhātu)，听闻天界与人界的两种声音，无论远近。”——若其因缘具足，你就能在在处处亲证其事。’
rows.english: “Then you, Vaccha, should you wish: ‘With the divine ear element, purified and surpassing the human, may I hear both kinds of sounds, divine and human, those that are far and near’—in each and every case you will attain the ability to witness it, when the basis for mindfulness is present.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pāṇātipāto kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, pāṇātipātā veramaṇī kusalaṃ; adinnādānaṃ kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, adinnādānā veramaṇī kusalaṃ; kāmesumicchācāro kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī kusalaṃ; musāvādo kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, musāvādā veramaṇī kusalaṃ; pisuṇā vācā kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ , pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī kusalaṃ; pharusā vācā kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī kusalaṃ; samphappalāpo kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, samphappalāpā veramaṇī kusalaṃ; abhijjhā kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, anabhijjhā kusalaṃ; byāpādo kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ, abyāpādo kusalaṃ; micchādiṭṭhi kho, vaccha, akusalaṃ sammādiṭṭhi kusalaṃ. Iti kho, vaccha, ime dasa dhammā akusalā, dasa dhammā kusalā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆蹉，杀生实为不善，远离杀生为善；不与取实为不善，远离不与取为善；欲邪行实为不善，远离欲邪行为善；妄语实为不善，远离妄语为善；两舌实为不善，远离两舌为善；恶口实为不善，远离恶口为善；绮语实为不善，远离绮语为善；贪欲实为不善，无贪为善；瞋恚实为不善，无瞋为善；邪见实为不善，正见为善。婆蹉，如是，此十法为不善，十法为善。”
rows.english: The taking of life, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from taking life is wholesome. Taking what is not given, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from taking what is not given is wholesome. Misconduct in sensual pleasures, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from misconduct in sensual pleasures is wholesome. False speech, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from false speech is wholesome. Divisive speech, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from divisive speech is wholesome. Harsh speech, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from harsh speech is wholesome. Frivolous speech, Vaccha, is unwholesome; abstinence from frivolous speech is wholesome. Covetousness, Vaccha, is unwholesome; non-covetousness is wholesome. Ill will, Vaccha, is unwholesome; non-ill will is wholesome. Wrong view, Vaccha, is unwholesome; right view is wholesome. Thus, Vaccha, these ten things are unwholesome, and these ten things are wholesome.

rows.pali: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā vacchagotto addhamāsūpasampanno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā vacchagotto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘yāvatakaṃ, bhante, sekhena ñāṇena sekhāya vijjāya pattabbaṃ, anuppattaṃ taṃ mayā; uttari ca me uttariṃ me (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) bhagavā dhammaṃ desetū’’ti. ‘‘Tena hi tvaṃ, vaccha, dve dhamme uttari bhāvehi – samathañca vipassanañca. Ime kho te, vaccha, dve dhammā uttari bhāvitā – samatho ca vipassanā ca – anekadhātupaṭivedhāya saṃvattissanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 当时，具寿瓦差种(Vacchagotta)受具足戒未久，仅半月，便前往世尊之处。抵达后，他顶礼世尊，然后坐于一旁。坐于一旁的具寿瓦差种对世尊说：‘世尊，凡应由有学之智、有学之明所证得者，我皆已证得。请世尊为我开示更上之法。’‘瓦差，既然如此，你当再修习二法——止(samatha)与观(vipassanā)。瓦差，你若再修习此二法——止与观，它们将导向对种种界的通达。’
rows.english: Then the Venerable Vacchagotta, who had been fully ordained not long ago, for half a month, approached the Blessed One. Having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the Venerable Vacchagotta said this to the Blessed One: “Venerable sir, whatever is to be attained by the knowledge and wisdom of a trainee, all that has been attained by me. May the Blessed One teach me the Dhamma further.” “In that case, Vaccha, you should further develop two things: tranquility and insight. These two things, Vaccha, when further developed—tranquility and insight—will lead to the penetration of the manifold elements.”

rows.pali: 198 . ‘‘So tvaṃ, vaccha, yāvadeva yāvade (pī.) ākaṅkhissasi – ‘anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ – ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhāpi hutvā eko assaṃ; āvibhāvaṃ, tirobhāvaṃ; tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gaccheyyaṃ, seyyathāpi ākāse; pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ kareyyaṃ, seyyathāpi udake; udakepi abhijjamāne gaccheyyaṃ, seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ; ākāsepi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ, seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo; imepi candimasūriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parimaseyyaṃ, parimajjeyyaṃ; yāvabrahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati satiāyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 198. ‘瓦差，只要你意欲——“愿我能体验种种神通(iddhividha)：一身化为多身，多身合为一身；或显或隐；穿墙、透壁、赴山，无有障碍，犹如行于虚空；于地中出没，犹如在水；于水上行走不沉，犹如在地；于空中结跏趺坐而行，犹如飞鸟；以手触碰、抚摸这有如此大神通、如此大威力的日月；乃至以身对梵界行使自在。”——若其因缘具足，你就能在在处处亲证其事。’
rows.english: 198. “Then you, Vaccha, should you wish: ‘May I experience the various kinds of psychic power: being one, may I become many; being many, may I become one; may I appear and disappear; may I go unhindered through a wall, a rampart, and a mountain as if through space; may I dive into and emerge from the earth as if it were water; may I walk on water without it breaking as if on earth; may I travel cross-legged through the sky like a winged bird; with my hand, may I touch and stroke these sun and moon, so mighty and powerful; may I exercise mastery with the body even as far as the Brahma-world’—in each and every case you will attain the ability to witness it, when the basis for mindfulness is present.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhuniyo. Atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekupāsakopi sāvako gihī odātavasano brahmacārī yo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā’’ti? ‘‘Na kho, vaccha, ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyova ye upāsakā mama sāvakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，暂且不论；诸比丘，暂且不论；诸比丘尼，暂且不论。尊者乔达摩是否有哪怕一位优婆塞弟子，为居家白衣、修梵行者，因五下分结已断尽，为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，不复从彼世界返回？”“瓦查，非只一百，非只二百，非只三百，非只四百，非只五百，实则更多。我的优婆塞弟子，为居家白衣、修梵行者，因五下分结已断尽，为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，不复从彼世界返回。”
rows.english: “Let the Venerable Gotama be, let the monks be, let the nuns be. But is there even one male lay follower, a disciple of the Venerable Gotama—a householder clad in white who lives the holy life—who, with the complete destruction of the five lower fetters, is of spontaneous birth, will attain final Nibbāna there, and is of the nature of not returning from that world?” “Vaccha, it is not just one hundred, not two hundred, not three hundred, not four hundred, not five hundred, but far more numerous are the male lay followers who are my disciples—householders clad in white who live the holy life—who, with the complete destruction of the five lower fetters, are of spontaneous birth, will attain final Nibbāna there, and are of the nature of not returning from that world.”

rows.pali: 196 . ‘‘Sace hi, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavaṃyeva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa, no ca kho bhikkhū ārādhakā abhavissaṃsu ; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ aparipūraṃ abhavissa tenaṅgena. Yasmā ca kho, bho gotama, imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavañceva gotamo ārādhako bhikkhū ca ārādhakā; evamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paripūraṃ tenaṅgena.
rows.chinese_simplified: 196. “尊者乔达摩，如果只有尊者乔达摩您能成就此法，而比丘们不能成就，那么这梵行就会因这一方面而不圆满。然而，尊者乔达摩，正因为尊者乔达摩您能成就此法，比丘们也能成就，所以这梵行才因这一方面而圆满。”
rows.english: 196. “For if, Venerable Gotama, only the Venerable Gotama were the accomplisher of this Dhamma, and the monks were not the accomplishers, then in that aspect this holy life would be incomplete. And because, Venerable Gotama, both the Venerable Gotama is the accomplisher of this Dhamma and the monks are the accomplishers, in that aspect this holy life is complete.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū. Atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekā bhikkhunīpi sāvikā yā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti? ‘‘Na kho, vaccha, ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyova yā bhikkhuniyo mama sāvikā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者乔达摩，暂且不论；诸比丘，暂且不论。尊者乔达摩是否有哪怕一位比丘尼弟子，因诸漏已尽，于现法中自以殊胜智作证，具足住于无漏心解脱、慧解脱？”“瓦查，非只一百，非只二百，非只三百，非只四百，非只五百，实则更多。我的比丘尼弟子，因诸漏已尽，于现法中自以殊胜智作证，具足住于无漏心解脱、慧解脱。”
rows.english: “Let the Venerable Gotama be, let the monks be. But is there even one nun, a disciple of the Venerable Gotama, who, through the destruction of the taints, dwells having realized for herself with direct knowledge in this very life the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom?” “Vaccha, it is not just one hundred, not two hundred, not three hundred, not four hundred, not five hundred, but far more numerous are the nuns who are my disciples and who, through the destruction of the taints, dwell having realized for themselves with direct knowledge in this very life the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom.”

rows.pali: 193 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘dīgharattāhaṃ bhotā gotamena sahakathī. Sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo saṃkhittena kusalākusalaṃ desetū’’ti. ‘‘Saṃkhittenapi kho te ahaṃ, vaccha, kusalākusalaṃ deseyyaṃ, vitthārenapi kho te ahaṃ, vaccha, kusalākusalaṃ deseyyaṃ; api ca te ahaṃ, vaccha, saṃkhittena kusalākusalaṃ desessāmi. Taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī’’ti. ‘‘Evaṃ, bho’’ti kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavato paccassosi. Bhagavā etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 193. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住王舍城(Rājagaha)的迦兰陀竹园。尔时，游方者瓦差种(Vacchagotta)前往世尊之处。抵达后，与世尊相互致意，在交换了令人欢喜、值得忆念的寒暄后，坐于一旁。坐于一旁后，游方者瓦差种对世尊说此言：‘尊者乔达摩，我与您相识交谈已久。善哉，愿乔达摩尊者为我简要地开示善与不善。’‘瓦差，我固然能为你简要地开示善与不善，也能为你详细地开示善与不善。然而，瓦差，我将为你简要地开示善与不善。你且谛听，善思念之，我当说。’游方者瓦差种回答世尊：‘是的，尊者。’世尊说此言：
rows.english: 193. Thus have I heard. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrels' Feeding Place. Then the wanderer Vacchagotta approached the Blessed One and exchanged greetings with him. When they had concluded their greetings and cordial talk, he sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Blessed One: 'Venerable Gotama, for a long time I have been one who converses with you. It would be good if the Venerable Gotama would teach me briefly about the wholesome and the unwholesome.' 'Vaccha, I could teach you about the wholesome and the unwholesome briefly, and I could also teach you about the wholesome and the unwholesome in detail. However, Vaccha, I will teach you about the wholesome and the unwholesome briefly. Listen to that and apply your mind well; I will speak.' 'Yes, Venerable Sir,' the wanderer Vacchagotta replied to the Blessed One. The Blessed One said this:

rows.pali: 199 . Atha kho āyasmā vacchagotto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. Atha kho āyasmā vacchagotto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi. ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsi. Aññataro kho panāyasmā vacchagotto arahataṃ ahosi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 199. 于是，具寿瓦差种欢喜、随喜世尊所说，从座起身，顶礼世尊，右绕后离去。其后，具寿瓦差种独处静居，不放逸、热忱、专精而住，不久，他便在现法中，亲身以殊胜智证知、作证、具足而住于那无上梵行之究竟——良家子们正是为此而正确地从在家出家、趋向无家生活。他证知：‘生已尽，梵行已立，所作已办，更无后有。’具寿瓦差种遂成为阿罗汉之一。
rows.english: 199. Then the Venerable Vacchagotta, having delighted in and rejoiced at the Blessed One’s words, rose from his seat, paid homage to the Blessed One, circumambulated him respectfully, and departed. Then, dwelling alone, secluded, diligent, ardent, and resolute, the Venerable Vacchagotta, before long, realized for himself with direct knowledge, in this very life, that unsurpassed culmination of the holy life for the sake of which clansmen rightly go forth from the household life into homelessness, and having attained it, he dwelled therein. He knew directly: ‘Birth is destroyed, the holy life has been lived, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this state of being.’ And the Venerable Vacchagotta became one of the Arahants.

rows.pali: ‘‘So tvaṃ, vaccha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi – ‘āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati satiāyatane’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆蹉，只要你希望：‘愿我于现法中，通过亲身证智，证悟并圆满安住于因诸漏已尽而得的无漏心解脱、慧解脱’，那么在那个范畴中，只要因缘具足，你就能获得亲证的能力。”
rows.english: So, Vaccha, inasmuch as you shall wish: ‘Through the destruction of the taints, may I, in this very life, realize for myself with direct knowledge the taintless liberation of mind, the liberation by wisdom, and having attained it, may I dwell therein’—in that very matter you will attain the capability of realization, when there is a basis for mindfulness.”

rows.pali: 197 . ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bho gotama, gaṅgā nadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā samuddaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati, evamevāyaṃ bhoto gotamassa parisā sagahaṭṭhapabbajitā nibbānaninnā nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā nibbānaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati. Abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama…pe… esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca. Labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampada’’nti . ‘‘Yo kho, vaccha, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati. Catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya; api ca mettha puggalavemattatā viditā’’ti. ‘‘Sace, bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya; ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi. Catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyā’’ti. Alattha kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 197. “乔达摩尊者，譬如恒河趋向大海、倾向大海、奔向大海，抵达大海而安住；同样地，乔达摩尊者的此一会众，包括在家众与出家众，都趋向涅槃、倾向涅槃、奔向涅槃，抵达涅槃而安住。妙极了，乔达摩尊者！……我今皈依乔达摩尊者、法以及比丘僧团。愿我能在乔达摩尊者座下出家，得受具足戒。”“瓦差，凡曾为外道者，欲在此法与律中出家、求受具足戒，他须行别住四个月。四个月后，若比丘们心悦，则为他出家、授具足戒，令成比丘。然而，于此，我了知个人之差异。”“尊者，如果曾为外道者，欲在此法与律中出家、求受具足戒，须行别住四个月，四个月后，若比丘们心悦，则为他出家、授具足戒，令成比丘；那么，我愿行别住四年。四年之后，愿心悦的比丘们为我出家、授我具足戒，令我成为比丘！”游方者瓦差种就在世尊座下获得了出家，获得了具足戒。
rows.english: 197. “Just as, Master Gotama, the river Ganges slopes, inclines, and tends towards the ocean, and comes to rest in the ocean; even so, this assembly of yours—both householders and renunciants—slopes, inclines, and tends towards Nibbāna, and comes to rest in Nibbāna. Excellent, Master Gotama! … I go for refuge to Master Gotama, to the Dhamma, and to the Saṅgha of bhikkhus. May I receive the going forth in the presence of Master Gotama, may I receive the higher ordination.” “Vaccha, whoever was formerly of another sect and wishes for the going forth and the higher ordination in this Dhamma and Discipline undergoes probation for four months. After the passing of four months, the bhikkhus, being satisfied, give the going forth and the higher ordination for the state of a bhikkhu. However, I recognize individual differences in this matter.” “If, venerable sir, those who were formerly of other sects and wish for the going forth and the higher ordination in this Dhamma and Discipline undergo probation for four months, and after the passing of four months, the bhikkhus, being satisfied, give them the going forth and the higher ordination for the state of a bhikkhu, then I will undergo probation for four years. After the passing of four years, may the bhikkhus, being satisfied, give me the going forth and the higher ordination for the state of a bhikkhu.” Then the wanderer Vacchagotta received the going forth and the higher ordination in the presence of the Blessed One.

rows.pali: 200 . Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ dassanāya gacchanti. Addasā kho āyasmā vacchagotto te bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante. Disvāna yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca – ‘‘handa! Kahaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto gacchathā’’ti? ‘‘Bhagavantaṃ kho mayaṃ, āvuso, dassanāya gacchāmā’’ti . ‘‘Tenahāyasmanto mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha, evañca vadetha – ‘vacchagotto, bhante, bhikkhu bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, evañca vadeti – pariciṇṇo me bhagavā, pariciṇṇo me sugato’’’ti. ‘‘Evamāvuso’’ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vacchagottassa paccassosuṃ. Atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ – ‘‘āyasmā, bhante, vacchagotto bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, evañca vadeti – ‘pariciṇṇo me bhagavā, pariciṇṇo me sugato’’’ti. ‘‘Pubbeva me, bhikkhave, vacchagotto bhikkhu cetasā ceto paricca vidito – ‘tevijjo vacchagotto bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo’ti. Devatāpi me etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ – ‘tevijjo, bhante, vacchagotto bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo’’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 200. 那时，众多比丘正前往拜见世尊。具寿瓦差种远远地看见那些比丘走来。看见后，便走向那些比丘，走近后，对他们说：‘那么，具寿们，你们要去哪里？’‘贤友，我们正前往拜见世尊。’‘那么，具寿们，请你们代我以头顶礼世尊双足，并如此说：“大德，瓦差种比丘以头顶礼世尊双足，并如此说：‘我已圆满承事世尊，我已圆满承事善逝。’”’那些比丘应允具寿瓦差种：‘好的，贤友。’于是，那些比丘前往世尊之处，抵达后，顶礼世尊，然后坐于一旁。坐于一旁后，那些比丘对世尊说：‘大德，具寿瓦差种以头顶礼世尊双足，并如此说：“我已圆满承事世尊，我已圆满承事善逝。”’‘诸比丘，我早已以心遍知瓦差种比丘之心，知道：“瓦差种比丘是三明者，具大神通、大威力。”天神们也向我告知此事：“大德，瓦差种比丘是三明者，具大神通、大威力。”’
rows.english: 200. Now at that time, many bhikkhus were going to see the Blessed One. The Venerable Vacchagotta saw those bhikkhus coming from afar. Having seen them, he went to where those bhikkhus were, and having approached them, he said this: “Come now, venerable sirs, where are you going?” “Friend, we are going to see the Blessed One.” “In that case, venerable sirs, in my name, bow with your heads at the feet of the Blessed One and say this: ‘Venerable sir, the bhikkhu Vacchagotta bows with his head at the feet of the Blessed One and says this: “The Blessed One has been fully served by me; the Well-Farer has been fully served by me.”’” “Yes, friend,” those bhikkhus replied to the Venerable Vacchagotta. Then those bhikkhus went to where the Blessed One was. Having approached, they paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, those bhikkhus said this to the Blessed One: “Venerable sir, the Venerable Vacchagotta bows with his head at the feet of the Blessed One and says this: ‘The Blessed One has been fully served by me; the Well-Farer has been fully served by me.’” “Bhikkhus, I had already known the mind of the bhikkhu Vacchagotta, having encompassed it with my own mind: ‘The bhikkhu Vacchagotta possesses the three knowledges, is of great psychic power, and of great might.’ Deities also informed me of this matter, saying: ‘Venerable sir, the bhikkhu Vacchagotta possesses the three knowledges, is of great psychic power, and of great might.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘So tvaṃ, vaccha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi – ‘parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ – sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṃkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ sauttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ; vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ, avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyya’nti, tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati satiāyatane.
rows.chinese_simplified: “婆蹉(Vaccha)，只要你意欲：‘我当以心遍知其他众生、其他个人的心——有贪的心，我当了知为“有贪的心”；离贪的心，我当了知为“离贪的心”；有瞋的心，我当了知为“有瞋的心”；离瞋的心，我当了知为“离瞋的心”；有痴的心，我当了知为“有痴的心”；离痴的心，我当了知为“离痴的心”；收敛的心，我当了知为“收敛的心”；散乱的心，我当了知为“散乱的心”；广大的心，我当了知为“广大的心”；不广大的心，我当了知为“不广大的心”；有上的心，我当了知为“有上的心”；无上的心，我当了知为“无上的心”；得定的心，我当了知为“得定的心”；未得定的心，我当了知为“未得定的心”；解脱的心，我当了知为“解脱的心”；未解脱的心，我当了知为“未解脱的心”’，只要有念的因缘，你就能在在处处达到能够作证的状态。”
rows.english: “Then you, Vaccha, should you wish: ‘Having encompassed them with my own mind, may I know distinctly the minds of other beings, other individuals: a mind with lust as a mind with lust, a mind without lust as a mind without lust; a mind with hate as a mind with hate, a mind without hate as a mind without hate; a mind with delusion as a mind with delusion, a mind without delusion as a mind without delusion; a contracted mind as a contracted mind, a scattered mind as a scattered mind; a sublime mind as a sublime mind, a non-sublime mind as a non-sublime mind; a surpassable mind as a surpassable mind, an unsurpassable mind as an unsurpassable mind; a concentrated mind as a concentrated mind, an unconcentrated mind as an unconcentrated mind; a liberated mind as a liberated mind, an unliberated mind as an unliberated mind’—in each and every case you will attain the ability to witness it, when the basis for mindfulness is present.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamāni pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni? Rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā – imāni pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa saṃyojanānī’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “是哪五种上分结？色贪、无色贪、慢、掉举、无明——此为五上分结。诸比丘，此即是十结。”第三经。
rows.english: What are the five higher fetters? Lust for form, lust for the formless, conceit, restlessness, and ignorance—these are the five higher fetters. Indeed, bhikkhus, these are the ten fetters.

rows.pali: 13 . ‘‘Dasayimāni , bhikkhave, saṃyojanāni. Katamāni dasa? Pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni, pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni. Katamāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni? Sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo – imāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
rows.chinese_simplified: 13. “诸比丘，有此十结。是哪十种？五下分结与五上分结。是哪五种下分结？有身见、疑、戒禁取、欲贪、嗔恚——此为五下分结。”
rows.english: 13. Bhikkhus, there are these ten fetters. What ten? The five lower fetters and the five higher fetters. What are the five lower fetters? Identity view, doubt, clinging to precepts and practices, sensual desire, and ill will—these are the five lower fetters.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo pana, bhante ānanda, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者阿难，由那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉世尊所宣说的一法，究竟是哪一法？于此法中，比丘不放逸、热勤、自我策励而住，未解脱的心得以解脱，未灭尽的诸漏得以灭尽，未证得的无上瑜伽安稳得以证得？”
rows.english: “But what, Venerable Ānanda, is that single teaching declared by the Blessed One—who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One—whereby for a monk dwelling heedful, ardent, and resolute, his mind, if not yet liberated, becomes liberated; his undestroyed taints come to destruction; and he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Atthi kho, gahapati, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘居士，彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊，确实曾宣说一法。若比丘住于此法，不放逸、勇猛、策励自勤，则未解脱心得以解脱，未尽诸漏得以灭尽，未证无上瑜伽安稳得以证得。’
rows.english: “Indeed, householder, there is a single teaching declared by the Blessed One—who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One—whereby for a monk dwelling heedful, ardent, and resolute, his mind, if not yet liberated, becomes liberated; his undestroyed taints come to destruction; and he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage.”

rows.pali: 18 . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘atthi nu kho, bhante ānanda, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti , ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 18. 坐于一旁后，八城居士达萨玛对具寿阿难说：‘阿难尊者，彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊，是否曾宣说一法？若比丘住于此法，不放逸、勇猛、策励自勤，则未解脱心得以解脱，未尽诸漏得以灭尽，未证无上瑜伽安稳得以证得。’
rows.english: 18. Seated to one side, the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara said to the Venerable Ānanda: 'Venerable Ānanda, is there a single teaching declared by the Blessed One—who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One—whereby for a monk dwelling heedful, ardent, and resolute, his mind, if not yet liberated, becomes liberated, his undestroyed taints come to destruction, and he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage?'

rows.pali: 17 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati beluvagāmake veḷuvagāmake (syā. kaṃ. ka.) . Tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena. Atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro yena kukkuṭārāmo yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca – ‘‘kahaṃ nu kho, bhante, āyasmā ānando etarahi viharati? Dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ āyasmantaṃ ānanda’’nti. ‘‘Eso, gahapati, āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati beluvagāmake’’ti. Atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputte taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena vesālī yena beluvagāmako yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 17. 如是我闻。一时，具寿阿难住在毗舍离(Vesālī)的韦芦瓦村(Beluvagāmaka)。尔时，有位名为达萨玛(Dasama)的八城(Aṭṭhaka)居士，因某要事抵达华氏城(Pāṭaliputta)。于是，八城居士达萨玛前往鸡园寺(Kukkuṭārāma)，去到某位比丘那里；走近后，他礼敬那位比丘，然后坐于一旁。坐于一旁后，八城居士达萨玛对那位比丘说：‘尊者，具寿阿难如今住在何处？我等渴望拜见具寿阿难。’‘居士，具寿阿难住在毗舍离的韦芦瓦村。’于是，八城居士达萨玛在华氏城办完要事后，便前往毗舍离的韦芦瓦村，去到具寿阿难那里；走近后，他礼敬具寿阿难，然后坐于一旁。
rows.english: 17. Thus have I heard: At one time the Venerable Ānanda was staying in Vesālī, at Beluva village. Now at that time the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara had arrived at Pāṭaliputta on some business. Then the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara approached a certain monk at the Kukkuṭārāma, and after approaching, he paid homage to him and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara said to that monk: “Where, venerable sir, is the Venerable Ānanda staying now? For we wish to see the Venerable Ānanda.” “That Venerable Ānanda, householder, is staying in Vesālī, at Beluva village.” Then the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara, having concluded his business in Pāṭaliputta, approached the Venerable Ānanda at Beluva village in Vesālī. Having approached, he paid homage to the Venerable Ānanda and sat down to one side.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā…pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘idampi kho tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ…pe… anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，居士，比丘因对喜的离染……等……，具足并安住于第三禅。他如此省察：‘此第三禅也是有为的、思量的……等……’，他次第到达无上的瑜伽安稳。
rows.english: “Furthermore, householder, with the fading away of rapture, a monk enters and dwells in the third jhāna… He reflects thus: ‘This third jhāna is also conditioned and volitionally produced…’ …and he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘idampi kho catutthaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ… anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，居士，比丘因舍离乐……等……，具足并安住于第四禅。他如此省察：‘此第四禅也是有为的、思量的……’，他次第到达无上的瑜伽安稳。
rows.english: “Furthermore, householder, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain… a monk enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna. He reflects thus: ‘This fourth jhāna is also conditioned and volitionally produced…’ …and he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage.

rows.pali: 20 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘idampi kho dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ… anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 20. “再者，居士，比丘寻、伺寂灭，内等净，心一趣，无寻、无伺，定生喜乐，具足并安住于第二禅。他如此审察：‘此第二禅亦为所造作、所思量而成。凡所有造作、思量而成者，皆是无常、灭法。’他如此了知。他安住于此，得诸漏尽。若不得诸漏尽，则因对法的喜爱与欣悦，五下分结断尽，成为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，自彼世间成为不还者。居士，这也是由那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉世尊所宣说的一法，于此法中，比丘不放逸、热勤、自我策励而住，未解脱的心得以解脱，未灭尽的诸漏得以灭尽，未证得的无上瑜伽安稳得以证得。”
rows.english: 20. “Furthermore, householder, with the stilling of applied and sustained thought, a monk enters and dwells in the second jhāna… He reflects thus: ‘This second jhāna is also conditioned and volitionally produced…’ …and he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘ayampi kho ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. Yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamma’nti pajānāti. So tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. No ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā. Ayampi kho, gahapati, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo akkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttañceva cittaṃ vimuccati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，居士，比丘完全超越识无边处(viññāṇañcāyatana)，了知‘无所有’，而成就无所有处(ākiñcaññāyatana)而住。他如此省察：‘此无所有处等至亦为所造作、所思量。凡是所造作、所思量者，彼即是无常的、灭法。’他如此了知。他安住于此，即证得诸漏的灭尽。若他未证得诸漏的灭尽，则因对该法的贪爱、对该法的喜悦，以及五下分结的灭尽，他成为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，从那个世界不再返回。居士，这也是为那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊所宣说的一法，比丘安住于此，不放逸、热忱、自我策励，则未解脱的心得以解脱，未灭尽的诸漏得以灭尽，未证得的无上离轭安稳得以证得。
rows.english: Furthermore, householder, a bhikkhu, by completely transcending the sphere of infinite consciousness, thinking, ‘There is nothing,’ enters and dwells in the sphere of nothingness. He reflects thus: ‘This attainment of the sphere of nothingness is also fabricated and volitionally produced. But whatever is fabricated and volitionally produced is impermanent, of a nature to cease.’ Thus he knows. Established therein, he attains the destruction of the taints. If he does not attain the destruction of the taints, then through that very attachment to the Dhamma, through that delight in the Dhamma, with the destruction of the five lower fetters, he becomes one of spontaneous rebirth, attaining final Nibbāna there, not being of a nature to return from that world. This, householder, is also one Dhamma declared by that Blessed One—the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One—wherein for a bhikkhu dwelling diligent, ardent, and resolute, the mind that is not yet liberated becomes liberated, the taints that are not yet destroyed come to destruction, and he attains the unexcelled security from bondage not yet attained.

rows.pali: 21 . Evaṃ vutte, dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘seyyathāpi, bhante ānanda, puriso ekaṃva nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya; evameva kho ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto sakideva sakiṃ deva (ka.) ekādasa amatadvārāni alatthaṃ bhāvanāya. Seyyathāpi, bhante, purisassa agāraṃ ekādasadvāraṃ, so tasmiṃ agāre āditte ekamekenapi dvārena sakkuṇeyya attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ; evameva kho ahaṃ, bhante, imesaṃ ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ ekamekenapi amatadvārena sakkuṇissāmi attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ. Imehi nāma, bhante, aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti, kimaṅgaṃ kiṃ (sī. pī.) panāhaṃ āyasmato ānandassa pūjaṃ na karissāmī’’ti ! Atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputtakañca vesālikañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi, ekamekañca bhikkhuṃ paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesi, āyasmantañca ānandaṃ ticīvarena acchādesi, āyasmato ca ānandassa pañcasatavihāraṃ kārāpesīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 21. 如是说已，八城的第十居士对具寿阿难说此言：‘尊者阿难，譬如有人寻求一个宝藏口，却于一时得十一个宝藏口；尊者，我亦如是，寻求一个不死之门，却为修习故，于一时得十一个不死之门。尊者，譬如某人的房舍有十一道门，当其房舍起火时，他能由任何一道门而令自身安稳；尊者，我亦如是，能从此十一个不死之门中的任何一个不死之门而令自身安稳。尊者，此等外道尚且为师长寻求师长之财，我如何能不为具寿阿难作供养呢！’于是，八城的第十居士集聚了在华氏城与毗舍离的比丘僧团，亲手以精美的嚼食与啖食令其满足、饱足，并以一一双衣供养每一位比丘，以三衣供养具寿阿难，且为具寿阿难建造了一座价值五百的精舍。
rows.english: 21. When this was said, the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara said this to the Venerable Ānanda: ‘Venerable Ānanda, it is as if a man, while seeking a single opening to a treasure, were to find eleven openings to treasures at once. In the very same way, venerable sir, while seeking a single door to the Deathless, I have at once found eleven doors to the Deathless for cultivation. Venerable Ānanda, it is as if there were a man’s house with eleven doors. If that house were on fire, he would be able to make himself safe through any one of those doors. In the very same way, venerable sir, I will be able to make myself safe through any one of these eleven doors to the Deathless. Venerable Ānanda, these followers of other paths seek a teacher’s fee for their teacher. Why then should I not make an offering to the Venerable Ānanda?’ Then the householder Dasama of Aṭṭhakanāgara, having assembled the Saṅgha of bhikkhus from Pāṭaliputta and Vesālī, with his own hands satisfied and served them with excellent hard and soft foods. He clothed each bhikkhu individually with a pair of cloths, and he clothed the Venerable Ānanda with the three robes. And for the Venerable Ānanda, he had a monastery worth five hundred built.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘ayampi kho viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. Yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamma’nti pajānāti. So tattha ṭhito…pe… anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，居士，比丘完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识无边’，证入识无边处而住。彼如是省察：‘此识无边处定亦是所造作的、所意图的。凡是所造作的、所意图的，彼即是无常的、是灭法。’如是了知。彼安住于彼……到达无上离轭安稳。
rows.english: “Furthermore, householder, a monk, by completely transcending the sphere of infinite space, thinking, ‘Consciousness is infinite,’ enters and dwells in the sphere of infinite consciousness. He reflects thus: ‘This attainment of the sphere of infinite consciousness is also conditioned and volitionally produced. But whatever is conditioned and volitionally produced is impermanent, subject to cessation.’ He understands this. Established therein… he attains the unattained, unexcelled security from bondage.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā…pe… muditāsahagatena cetasā…pe… upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati. So iti paṭisañcikkhati – ‘ayampi kho upekkhācetovimutti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. Yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamma’nti pajānāti. So tattha ṭhito… anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，居士，比丘以与悲俱行之心……乃至……以与喜俱行之心……乃至……以与舍俱行之心遍满一方而住，如是第二方，如是第三方，如是第四方。如是，于上方、下方、横向，于一切处，推己及人，以广大、崇高、无量、无怨、无恼害的与舍俱行之心，遍满一切有情世间而住。彼如是省察：‘此舍心解脱亦是所造作的、所意图的。凡是所造作的、所意图的，彼即是无常的、是灭法。’如是了知。彼安住于彼……到达无上离轭安稳。
