rows.pali: ‘‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, ‘sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamañña’nti – evaṃdiṭṭhi evaṃdiṭṭhī (sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.) bhavaṃ gotamo’’ti? ‘‘Na kho ahaṃ, vaccha, evaṃdiṭṭhi – ‘sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamañña’’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “具寿乔达摩，‘世间是常，唯此是实，余者虚妄’——乔达摩尊者持如是见吗？”“瓦差，我不持如是见——‘世间是常，唯此是实，余者虚妄’。”
rows.english: “Master Gotama, do you hold the view: ‘The world is eternal; only this is true, anything else is futile’?” “No, Vaccha, I do not hold the view: ‘The world is eternal; only this is true, anything else is futile’.”

rows.pali: Evaṃ vutte, vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘seyyathāpi, bho gotama, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahāsālarukkho. Tassa aniccatā sākhāpalāsā palujjeyyuṃ sākhāpalāsaṃ palujjeyya , tacapapaṭikā palujjeyyuṃ, pheggū palujjeyyuṃ pheggu palujjeyya (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) ; so aparena samayena apagatasākhāpalāso apagatatacapapaṭiko apagataphegguko suddho assa, sāre patiṭṭhito; evameva bhoto gotamassa pāvacanaṃ apagatasākhāpalāsaṃ apagatatacapapaṭikaṃ apagatapheggukaṃ suddhaṃ, sāre patiṭṭhitaṃ. Abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama…pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是说已，游方者瓦差种对世尊说：“乔达摩尊者，譬如村庄或市镇附近有一棵大娑罗树。因其无常，枝叶会凋落，树皮、外皮会剥落，虚材会腐朽；其后，彼树舍离枝叶，舍离树皮、外皮，舍离虚材，纯净而住立于心材。同样地，乔达摩尊者的言教也舍离枝叶，舍离树皮、外皮，舍离虚材，纯净而住立于核心。乔达摩尊者，此乃殊胜！……愿乔达摩尊者忆持我为优婆塞，从今日起，终生归依。”
rows.english: When this was said, the wanderer Vacchagotta said to the Blessed One: 'Venerable Gotama, it is as if, not far from a village or a town, there were a great sāl tree. Due to its impermanence, its branches and leaves would fall away, its bark and outer bark would fall away, and its sapwood would fall away. In time, devoid of branches and leaves, devoid of bark and outer bark, devoid of sapwood, it would be established in the pure heartwood. In the very same way, the teaching of the Venerable Gotama is devoid of branches and leaves, devoid of bark and outer bark, devoid of sapwood, and is established in the pure heartwood. It is excellent, Venerable Gotama… May the Venerable Gotama remember me as a lay disciple who has gone for refuge for life, from this day forward.'

rows.pali: ‘‘Kacci te, kassapa, khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ? Kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti; paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no abhikkamo’’ti? ‘‘Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “迦叶，你尚可忍耐、尚可维持吗？痛苦的感受是减退而非增加吗？其减退而非增加，尚能辨别吗？”“世尊，我不能忍耐，不能维持。我剧烈的痛苦感受正在增加而非减退；其增加而非减退，可以辨别。”
rows.english: “Kassapa, are you enduring? Are you getting by? Are your painful feelings receding and not increasing? Is their receding evident, and not their increase?” “Venerable sir, I am not enduring; I am not getting by. My severe painful feelings are increasing, not receding; their increase is evident, not their receding.”

rows.pali: 195 . Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pippaliguhāyaṃ vipphaliguhāyaṃ (sī.) viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 195. 一时，世尊住在王舍城(Rājagaha)竹林(Veḷuvana)的迦兰陀园。那时，具寿大迦叶(Mahākassapa)住在毕巴离洞窟(Pippaliguhā)，他患病、痛苦、病重。当时，世尊于傍晚时分从独住处出来，前往具寿大迦叶那里。抵达后，便在已设好的座位上坐下。坐下后，世尊对具寿大迦叶说了这番话：
rows.english: 195. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrels’ Feeding Place. Now at that time the Venerable Mahākassapa was dwelling in the Pipphali Cave, afflicted, suffering, and gravely ill. Then, in the evening, the Blessed One emerged from seclusion and approached the Venerable Mahākassapa. Having approached, he sat down on the prepared seat. Having sat down, the Blessed One said this to the Venerable Mahākassapa:

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamano āyasmā mahākassapo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi. Vuṭṭhahi cāyasmā mahākassapo tamhā ābādhā. Tathāpahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosīti. Catutthaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了这话。具寿大迦叶心生欢喜，信受世尊所说。具寿大迦叶从那疾病中痊愈，具寿大迦叶的那场病就这样被断除了。第四经。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Pleased, the Venerable Mahākassapa delighted in the Blessed One’s speech. And the Venerable Mahākassapa arose from that illness. And that illness of the Venerable Mahākassapa was thus abandoned. The Fourth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sattime, kassapa, bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti. Katame satta? Satisambojjhaṅgo kho, kassapa, mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati…pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho, kassapa, mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. Ime kho, kassapa, satta bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī’’ti. ‘‘Taggha, bhagavā, bojjhaṅgā; taggha, sugata, bojjhaṅgā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “迦叶，此七觉支由我善说，若经修习、多修习，则导向证智、正觉、涅槃。是哪七支？迦叶，念觉支由我善说，若经修习、多修习，则导向证智、正觉、涅槃……乃至……迦叶，舍觉支由我善说，若经修习、多修习，则导向证智、正觉、涅槃。迦叶，此七觉支由我善说，若经修习、多修习，则导向证智、正觉、涅槃。”“诚然，世尊，是觉支！诚然，善逝，是觉支！”
rows.english: “Kassapa, these seven factors of enlightenment have been well proclaimed by me. When developed and cultivated, they conduce to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. What seven? The enlightenment factor of mindfulness, Kassapa, has been well proclaimed by me. When developed and cultivated, it conduces to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna… The enlightenment factor of equanimity, Kassapa, has been well proclaimed by me. When developed and cultivated, it conduces to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. These, Kassapa, are the seven factors of enlightenment that have been well proclaimed by me. When developed and cultivated, they conduce to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.” “Truly, O Blessed One, they are factors of enlightenment! Truly, O Sugata, they are factors of enlightenment!”

rows.pali: ‘‘Kacci te, moggallāna, khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ? Kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti; paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no abhikkamo’’ti? ‘‘Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “目犍连，你尚可忍受吗？尚能维持吗？痛苦的感受是正在减退，而非增长吗？能察觉到是在减退，而非增长吗？”“世尊，我不能忍受，也无法维持。我剧烈的痛苦感受正在增长，而非减退；能察觉到是在增长，而非减退。”
rows.english: “Moggallāna, are you enduring? Are you getting by? Are your painful feelings receding and not increasing? Is their receding apparent, and not their increasing?” “Venerable sir, I am not enduring; I am not getting by. My severe painful feelings are increasing, not receding; their increasing is apparent, not their receding.”

rows.pali: 196 . Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 196. 一时，世尊住在王舍城(Rājagaha)竹林(Veḷuvana)的迦兰陀园(Kalandakanivāpa)。那时，具寿大目犍连住在鹫峰山(Gijjhakūṭa)，他患病、痛苦、病情严重。于是，世尊在傍晚时分从独住处出来，前往具寿大目犍连那里。抵达后，在已设好的座位上坐下。坐下后，世尊对具寿大目犍连说了这番话：
rows.english: 196. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrels’ Feeding Place. Now at that time the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna was dwelling on the Vulture Peak Mountain, afflicted, suffering, and gravely ill. Then in the evening, the Blessed One arose from seclusion and approached the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna. Having approached, he sat down on the prepared seat. Having sat down, the Blessed One said this to the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna:

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamano āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi. Vuṭṭhahi cāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tamhā ābādhā. Tathāpahīno cāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa so ābādho ahosīti. Pañcamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了此言。具寿大目犍连心怀欢喜，欣受世尊所说。具寿大目犍连从那疾病中痊愈，具寿大目犍连的那场病就这样被断除了。第五。
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Pleased, the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna delighted in the Blessed One’s speech. And the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna arose from that illness. Thus that illness of the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna was abandoned. The Fifth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sattime, moggallāna, bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti. Katame satta? Satisambojjhaṅgo kho, moggallāna, mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati…pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho, moggallāna, mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. Ime kho, moggallāna, satta bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī’’ti. ‘‘Taggha , bhagavā, bojjhaṅgā; taggha, sugata, bojjhaṅgā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “目犍连，此七觉支由我善说，修习、多作，导向证智、正觉、涅槃。是哪七支呢？目犍连，念觉支由我善说，修习、多作，导向证智、正觉、涅槃……乃至……目犍连，舍觉支由我善说，修习、多作，导向证智、正觉、涅槃。目犍连，此七觉支由我善说，修习、多作，导向证智、正觉、涅槃。”“善哉，世尊！此乃觉支。善哉，善逝！此乃觉支。”
rows.english: “Moggallāna, these seven factors of enlightenment have been well proclaimed by me. When developed and cultivated, they conduce to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. What seven? The enlightenment factor of mindfulness, Moggallāna, has been well proclaimed by me; when developed and cultivated, it conduces to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna… The enlightenment factor of equanimity, Moggallāna, has been well proclaimed by me; when developed and cultivated, it conduces to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. These, Moggallāna, are the seven factors of enlightenment that have been well proclaimed by me; when developed and cultivated, they conduce to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.” “Truly, O Blessed One, they are factors of enlightenment! Truly, O Sugata, they are factors of enlightenment!”

rows.pali: Idamavocāyasmā cundo. Samanuñño satthā ahosi. Vuṭṭhahi ca bhagavā tamhā ābādhā. Tathāpahīno ca bhagavato so ābādho ahosīti. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 具寿纯陀说了此语。导师随喜赞同。世尊从那场病中起身。世尊的那个病痛就这样消退了。第六。
rows.english: The Venerable Cunda said this. The Teacher approved. And the Blessed One arose from that illness. And that illness of the Blessed One was thus abandoned. The Sixth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sattime, bhante, bojjhaṅgā bhagavatā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti. Katame satta? Satisambojjhaṅgo kho, bhante, bhagavatā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati…pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho, bhante, bhagavatā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. Ime kho, bhante, satta bojjhaṅgā bhagavatā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī’’ti. ‘‘Taggha , cunda, bojjhaṅgā; taggha, cunda, bojjhaṅgā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “大德，此七觉支乃世尊所善说，修习、多修后，能导向胜智、正觉、涅槃。是哪七种呢？大德，念觉支乃世尊所善说，修习、多修后，能导向胜智、正觉、涅槃……（中略）……大德，舍觉支乃世尊所善说，修习、多修后，能导向胜智、正觉、涅槃。大德，此七觉支乃世尊所善说，修习、多修后，能导向胜智、正觉、涅槃。”“诚然，纯陀，此乃觉支；诚然，纯陀，此乃觉支。”
rows.english: “Venerable Sir, these seven factors of enlightenment have been well proclaimed by the Blessed One. When developed and cultivated, they conduce to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. What seven? The enlightenment factor of mindfulness, Venerable Sir, has been well proclaimed by the Blessed One. When developed and cultivated, it conduces to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna… The enlightenment factor of equanimity, Venerable Sir, has been well proclaimed by the Blessed One. When developed and cultivated, it conduces to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. These, Venerable Sir, are the seven factors of enlightenment that have been well proclaimed by the Blessed One. When developed and cultivated, they conduce to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.” “Truly, Cunda, they are factors of enlightenment! Truly, Cunda, they are factors of enlightenment!”

rows.pali: 197 . Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. Atha kho āyasmā mahācundo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahācundaṃ bhagavā etadavoca – ‘‘paṭibhantu taṃ, cunda, bojjhaṅgā’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 197. 一时，世尊住在王舍城竹林，迦兰陀饲喂处。那时，世尊患病、痛苦、重病。于是，具寿大纯陀前往世尊之处；抵达后，礼敬世尊，然后坐于一旁。世尊对坐于一旁的具寿大纯陀说了这番话：“纯陀，愿觉支于你明了。”
rows.english: 197. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrels’ Feeding Place. Now at that time the Blessed One was afflicted, suffering, and gravely ill. Then the Venerable Mahācunda approached the Blessed One; having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. To the Venerable Mahācunda, as he was sitting to one side, the Blessed One said this: “Cunda, may the factors of enlightenment occur to you.”

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamano āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说此语。具寿舍利弗心生欢喜，欣悦世尊所说。
rows.english: Thus spoke the Blessed One. The Venerable Sāriputta, delighted, rejoiced at the Blessed One's words.

rows.pali: 438 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 438. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住在王舍城（Rājagaha）竹林（Veḷuvana）的迦兰陀园。尔时，具寿舍利弗于傍晚时分从宴坐起，前往世尊之处；抵达后，向世尊顶礼，然后坐于一旁。世尊对坐于一旁的具寿舍利弗如是说：
rows.english: 438. Thus have I heard. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha in the Veḷuvana, the Kalandakanivāpa. Then, in the evening, the Venerable Sāriputta, having arisen from seclusion, approached the Blessed One. Having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. The Blessed One said this to the Venerable Sāriputta who was sitting to one side:

rows.pali: 439 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi nu kho me tattha sotaviññeyyesu saddesu…pe… ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu… jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu … kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu… manoviññeyyesu dhammesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti? Sace , sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi me tattha manoviññeyyesu dhammesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, natthi me tattha manoviññeyyesu dhammesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 439. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我经由何道入村乞食，于何处行乞，复经由何道自村乞食而返，于彼处，于耳识所识之声……鼻识所识之香……舌识所识之味……身识所识之触……意识所识之法，我是否有欲求、贪染、瞋恚、愚痴或心之抗拒？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时，如是了知：‘我经由何道入村乞食，于何处行乞，复经由何道自村乞食而返，于彼处，于意识所识之法，我有欲求、贪染、瞋恚、愚痴或心之抗拒。’舍利弗，彼比丘应为断除彼等恶不善法而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时，如是了知：‘我经由何道入村乞食，于何处行乞，复经由何道自村乞食而返，于彼处，于意识所识之法，我无欲求、贪染、瞋恚、愚痴或心之抗拒。’舍利弗，彼比丘应以其喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 439. “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘On the path by which I entered the village for alms, in the area where I walked for alms, and on the path by which I returned from the village after the alms-round—was there in me, regarding sounds cognizable by the ear… smells cognizable by the nose… tastes cognizable by the tongue… tactile objects cognizable by the body… mind-objects cognizable by the mind, any desire, or passion, or aversion, or delusion, or mental resistance?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘On the path by which I entered the village for alms, in the area where I walked for alms, and on the path by which I returned from the village after the alms-round—there is in me, regarding mind-objects cognizable by the mind, desire, or passion, or aversion, or delusion, or mental resistance,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the abandoning of those very evil, unwholesome states. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘On the path by which I entered the village for alms, in the area where I walked for alms, and on the path by which I returned from the village after the alms-round—there is not in me, regarding mind-objects cognizable by the mind, any desire, or passion, or aversion, or delusion, or mental resistance,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.”

rows.pali: 450 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘bhāvitā nu kho me samatho ca vipassanā cā’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘abhāvitā kho me samatho ca vipassanā cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā samathavipassanānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘bhāvitā kho me samatho ca vipassanā cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 450. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已修习止与观否？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我尚未修习止与观’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为修习止观而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我已修习止与观’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 450. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have serenity and insight been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘Serenity and insight have not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of serenity and insight. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘Serenity and insight have been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: 451 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘sacchikatā nu kho me vijjā ca vimutti cā’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘asacchikatā kho me vijjā ca vimutti cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā vijjāya vimuttiyā sacchikiriyāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘sacchikatā kho me vijjā ca vimutti cā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 451. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已亲证阿罗汉道与阿罗汉果否？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我尚未亲证阿罗汉道与阿罗汉果’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为亲证阿罗汉道与阿罗汉果而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我已亲证阿罗汉道与阿罗汉果’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 451. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: 'Have knowledge and liberation been realized by me?' If, Sāriputta, upon reflection, a bhikkhu knows: 'Knowledge and liberation have not been realized by me,' then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the realization of knowledge and liberation. But if, Sāriputta, upon reflection, a bhikkhu knows: 'Knowledge and liberation have been realized by me,' then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome qualities.

rows.pali: 449 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘bhāvito nu kho me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘abhāvito kho me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘bhāvito kho me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo’ti , tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 449. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已修习圣八支道否？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我尚未修习圣八支道’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为修习圣八支道而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我已修习圣八支道’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 449. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Has the Noble Eightfold Path been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The Noble Eightfold Path has not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of the Noble Eightfold Path. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The Noble Eightfold Path has been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: 440 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘pahīnā nu kho me pañca kāmaguṇā’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘appahīnā kho me pañca kāmaguṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘pahīnā kho me pañca kāmaguṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 440. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已断除五欲(kāmaguṇā)否？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是了知：‘我未断除五欲。’舍利弗，彼比丘应为断除五欲而精进。又，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是了知：‘我已断除五欲。’舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 440. “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the five strands of sensual pleasure been abandoned by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five strands of sensual pleasure have not been abandoned by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the abandoning of the five strands of sensual pleasure. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five strands of sensual pleasure have been abandoned by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: 441 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘pahīnā nu kho me pañca nīvaraṇā’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘appahīnā kho me pañca nīvaraṇā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ. rows.chinese_simplified: 441. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已断除五盖(nīvaraṇā)否？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是了知：‘我未断除五盖。’舍利弗，彼比丘应为断除五盖而精进。又，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是了知：‘我已断除五盖。’舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 441. “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the five hindrances been abandoned by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five hindrances have not been abandoned by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the abandoning of the five hindrances. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five hindrances have been abandoned by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘abhāvitā kho me cattāro satipaṭṭhānā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ. rows.chinese_simplified: 443. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已修习四念处(satipaṭṭhāna)了吗？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时，知：‘我尚未修习四念处’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为修习四念处而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时，知：‘我已修习四念处’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 443. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the four foundations of mindfulness been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The four foundations of mindfulness have not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of the four foundations of mindfulness. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘bhāvitā kho me cattāro sammappadhānā’ti , tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 444. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已修习四正勤(sammappadhāna)了吗？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时，知：‘我尚未修习四正勤’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为修习四正勤而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时，知：‘我已修习四正勤’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。

rows.chinese_simplified: 445. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已修习四神足(iddhipāda)了吗？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时，知：‘我尚未修习四神足’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为修习四神足而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时，知：‘我已修习四神足’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 445. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the four bases of spiritual power been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The four bases of spiritual power have not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of the four bases of spiritual power. rows.chinese_simplified: 447. “再者，舍利弗，比丘应当这样省察：‘我的五力是否已修习？’舍利弗，如果比丘省察时这样知道：‘我的五力尚未修习’，舍利弗，那位比丘就应当为修习五力而努力。但是，舍利弗，如果比丘省察时这样知道：‘我的五力已修习’，舍利弗，那位比丘就应当以那样的喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜修学而安住。”
rows.english: 447. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the five strengths been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five strengths have not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of the five strengths. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five strengths have been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: 448 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘bhāvitā nu kho me satta bojjhaṅgā’ti? Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘bhāvitā kho me satta bojjhaṅgā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 448. “再者，舍利弗，比丘应当这样省察：‘我的七觉支是否已修习？’舍利弗，如果比丘省察时这样知道：‘我的七觉支尚未修习’，舍利弗，那位比丘就应当为修习七觉支而努力。但是，舍利弗，如果比丘省察时这样知道：‘我的七觉支已修习’，舍利弗，那位比丘就应当以那样的喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜修学而安住。”
rows.english: 448. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the seven factors of enlightenment been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The seven factors of enlightenment have not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of the seven factors of enlightenment. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The seven factors of enlightenment have been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: 446 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘bhāvitāni nu kho me pañcindriyānī’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘abhāvitāni kho me pañcindriyānī’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvanāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘bhāvitāni kho me pañcindriyānī’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 446. “再者，舍利弗，比丘应当这样省察：‘我的五根是否已修习？’舍利弗，如果比丘省察时这样知道：‘我的五根尚未修习’，舍利弗，那位比丘就应当为修习五根而努力。但是，舍利弗，如果比丘省察时这样知道：‘我的五根已修习’，舍利弗，那位比丘就应当以那样的喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜修学而安住。”
rows.english: 446. Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the five faculties been cultivated by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five faculties have not been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the cultivation of the five faculties. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five faculties have been cultivated by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: ‘‘Vippasannāni kho te, sāriputta, indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto. Katamena kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharasī’’ti? ‘‘Suññatāvihārena kho ahaṃ, bhante, etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmī’’ti. ‘‘Sādhu, sādhu, sāriputta! Mahāpurisavihārena kira tvaṃ, sāriputta, etarahi bahulaṃ viharasi. Mahāpurisavihāro eso hesa (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) , sāriputta, yadidaṃ – suññatā. Tasmātiha, sāriputta, bhikkhu sace ākaṅkheyya – ‘suññatāvihārena bahulaṃ etarahi bahulaṃ (sī. pī.) vihareyya’nti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi nu kho me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, atthi me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā tesaṃyeva pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘yena cāhaṃ maggena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ, yasmiñca padese piṇḍāya acariṃ, yena ca maggena gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamiṃ, natthi me tattha cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu chando vā rāgo vā doso vā moho vā paṭighaṃ vāpi cetaso’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: “舍利弗，你的诸根确实明净，肤色清净皎洁。舍利弗，你现在多以何住而住呢？”“世尊，我现在多以空住而住。”“善哉，善哉，舍利弗！你现在确实多以大士住而住。舍利弗，此即是大士住，也就是空。是故，舍利弗，于此，若有比丘希望：‘愿我多以空住而住’，舍利弗，彼比丘应如是省察：‘我循何道为乞食而入村，于何处为乞食而行，又循何道自村乞食返回，于其中，于眼所识之色，我心是否存有欲、贪、瞋、痴或心之抵触？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我循何道为乞食而入村，于何处为乞食而行，又循何道自村乞食返回，于其中，于眼所识之色，我心确实存有欲、贪、瞋、痴或心之抵触’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应为断除彼等恶不善法而努力。然而，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是知：‘我循何道为乞食而入村，于何处为乞食而行，又循何道自村乞食返回，于其中，于眼所识之色，我心实无欲、贪、瞋、痴或心之抵触’，舍利弗，彼比丘即应以彼喜和悦，于诸善法中，日夜随学而住。”
rows.english: “Sāriputta, your faculties are indeed serene, your complexion is pure and bright. By which dwelling do you now frequently abide, Sāriputta?” “Venerable Sir, I now frequently abide by the dwelling of emptiness.” “Good, good, Sāriputta! It seems you now frequently abide by the dwelling of a great man. This, Sāriputta, is the dwelling of a great man, that is to say, emptiness. Therefore, Sāriputta, if a bhikkhu should wish, ‘May I frequently abide by the dwelling of emptiness,’ that bhikkhu, Sāriputta, should reflect thus: ‘On the path by which I entered the village for alms, in the area where I walked for alms, and on the path by which I returned from the village after the alms-round—was there in me, regarding forms cognizable by the eye, any desire, or passion, or aversion, or delusion, or mental resistance?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘On the path by which I entered the village for alms, in the area where I walked for alms, and on the path by which I returned from the village after the alms-round—there is in me, regarding forms cognizable by the eye, desire, or passion, or aversion, or delusion, or mental resistance,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the abandoning of those very evil, unwholesome states. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘On the path by which I entered the village for alms, in the area where I walked for alms, and on the path by which I returned from the village after the alms-round—there is not in me, regarding forms cognizable by the eye, any desire, or passion, or aversion, or delusion, or mental resistance,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.

rows.pali: 442 . ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhunā iti paṭisañcikkhitabbaṃ – ‘pariññātā nu kho me pañcupādānakkhandhā’ti? Sace, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘apariññātā kho me pañcupādānakkhandhā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ pariññāya vāyamitabbaṃ. Sace pana, sāriputta, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti – ‘pariññātā kho me pañcupādānakkhandhā’ti, tena, sāriputta, bhikkhunā teneva pītipāmojjena vihātabbaṃ ahorattānusikkhinā kusalesu dhammesu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 442. 再者，舍利弗，比丘应如是省察：‘我已遍知五取蕴(pañcupādānakkhandhā)否？’舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是了知：‘我未遍知五取蕴。’舍利弗，彼比丘应为遍知五取蕴而精进。又，舍利弗，若比丘省察时如是了知：‘我已遍知五取蕴。’舍利弗，彼比丘即应以那喜悦与欢欣，于诸善法中日夜随学而住。
rows.english: 442. “Furthermore, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu should reflect thus: ‘Have the five aggregates of clinging been fully comprehended by me?’ If, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five aggregates of clinging have not been fully comprehended by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should strive for the full comprehension of the five aggregates of clinging. But if, Sāriputta, a bhikkhu, upon reflecting, knows thus: ‘The five aggregates of clinging have been fully comprehended by me,’ then, Sāriputta, that bhikkhu should dwell with that very joy and gladness, training day and night in wholesome states.”

rows.pali: 452 . ‘‘Ye hi keci, sāriputta, atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhesuṃ, sabbe te evameva paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhesuṃ. Yepi hi keci, sāriputta, anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhessanti, sabbe te evameva paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhessanti. Yepi hi keci, sāriputta, etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhenti, sabbe te evameva paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhenti. Tasmātiha, sāriputta vo sāriputta evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ (sī. pī.) , ‘paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā piṇḍapātaṃ parisodhessāmā’ti – evañhi vo, sāriputta, sikkhitabba’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 452. “舍利弗，过去任何沙门或婆罗门，皆是如此反复省察后，方清净其施食。舍利弗，未来任何沙门或婆罗门，亦将如此反复省察后，方清净其施食。舍利弗，现在任何沙门或婆罗门，亦皆如此反复省察后，方清净其施食。是故，舍利弗，于此，你们当如是学：‘我等将反复省察而清净施食。’”
rows.english: 452. Sāriputta, whatever ascetics and brahmins in the past purified their almsfood, all did so by repeatedly reflecting on it. Whatever ascetics and brahmins in the future will purify their almsfood, all will do so by repeatedly reflecting on it. Whatever ascetics and brahmins at present purify their almsfood, all do so by repeatedly reflecting on it. Therefore, Sāriputta, you should train yourselves thus: ‘We will purify our almsfood by repeatedly reflecting on it.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Indriyesu aguttadvāratā ca bhojane amattaññutā ca.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸根不护门与饮食不知量。
rows.english: Having unguarded sense faculties and lack of moderation in eating.

rows.pali: ‘‘Indriyesu guttadvāratā ca bhojane mattaññutā ca.
rows.chinese_simplified: 诸根护门与饮食知量。
rows.english: Guarding the sense faculties and moderation in eating.

rows.pali: ‘‘Diṭṭhivisuddhi kho pana yathā diṭṭhissa ca padhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 见清净与如见者相应的精勤。
rows.english: Purification of view, and the striving of one who has seen thus.

rows.pali: ‘‘Saṃvego ca saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃviggassa ca yoniso padhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于悚惧事起悚惧，与已悚惧者之如理精勤。
rows.english: A sense of urgency regarding grounds for urgency, and the wise striving of one who is stirred.

rows.pali: ‘‘Asantuṭṭhitā ca kusalesu dhammesu appaṭivānitā ca padhānasmiṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于诸善法不满足，与于精进不退转。
rows.english: Non-contentment with wholesome qualities and unremittingness in striving.

rows.pali: ‘‘Dasa asekkhā dhammā – asekkhā sammādiṭṭhi, asekkho sammāsaṅkappo, asekkhā sammāvācā, asekkho sammākammanto, asekkho sammāājīvo, asekkho sammāvāyāmo, asekkhā sammāsati, asekkho sammāsamādhi, asekkhaṃ sammāñāṇaṃ, asekkhā sammāvimutti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 十无学法：无学正见、无学正思惟、无学正语、无学正业、无学正命、无学正精进、无学正念、无学正定、无学正智、无学正解脱。
rows.english: The ten qualities of one beyond training: the right view of one beyond training, the right intention of one beyond training, the right speech of one beyond training, the right action of one beyond training, the right livelihood of one beyond training, the right effort of one beyond training, the right mindfulness of one beyond training, the right concentration of one beyond training, the right knowledge of one beyond training, and the right liberation of one beyond training.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso vijjā – pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ vijjā, sattānaṃ cutūpapāteñāṇaṃ vijjā, āsavānaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ vijjā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三明：宿住随念智、有情死生智、诸漏尽智。
rows.english: Three true knowledges: the knowledge of recollecting previous lives, the knowledge of the passing away and reappearance of beings, and the knowledge of the destruction of the taints.

rows.pali: ‘‘Dasa kusalakammapathā – pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī, anabhijjhā, abyāpādo, sammādiṭṭhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 十善业道：离杀生，离不与取，离欲邪行，离妄语，离离间语，离粗恶语，离绮语，无贪欲，无嗔恚，正见。
rows.english: The ten wholesome courses of action: abstaining from destroying life, abstaining from taking what is not given, abstaining from sexual misconduct, abstaining from false speech, abstaining from slanderous speech, abstaining from harsh speech, abstaining from frivolous chatter, non-covetousness, non-ill will, and right view.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro āhārā – kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “四食：或粗或细的段食，第二为触，第三为意思，第四为识。”
rows.english: There are four nutriments: physical food, whether coarse or subtle; contact as the second; mental volition as the third; and consciousness as the fourth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha gāravā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo viharati sappatisso; dhamme sagāravo viharati sappatisso; saṅghe sagāravo viharati sappatisso; sikkhāya sagāravo viharati sappatisso; appamāde sagāravo viharati sappatisso; paṭisanthāre sagāravo viharati sappatisso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六恭敬。贤友，于此，比丘对导师恭敬、顺从而住；对法恭敬、顺从而住；对僧团恭敬、顺从而住；对学处恭敬、顺从而住；对不放逸恭敬、顺从而住；对接待恭敬、顺从而住。
rows.english: Six kinds of respect. Here, friends, a bhikkhu dwells with respect and with deference for the Teacher; he dwells with respect and with deference for the Dhamma; he dwells with respect and with deference for the Saṅgha; he dwells with respect and with deference for the training; he dwells with respect and with deference for diligence; he dwells with respect and with deference for hospitality.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta sappurisadhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七善士法：贤友们，于此，有比丘知法、知义、知己、知量、知时、知众、知人。”
rows.english: The seven qualities of a true person: Here, friends, a bhikkhu knows the Dhamma, knows the meaning, knows himself, knows the right measure, knows the right time, knows the assembly, and knows individuals.

rows.pali: ‘‘Catasso paṭipadā – dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四行道：苦行道而迟通达，苦行道而速通达，乐行道而迟通达，乐行道而速通达。
rows.english: There are four ways of practice: painful practice with slow direct knowledge, painful practice with quick direct knowledge, pleasant practice with slow direct knowledge, and pleasant practice with quick direct knowledge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañcakkhandhā. Rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五蕴：色蕴、受蕴、想蕴、行蕴、识蕴。
rows.english: The five aggregates: the aggregate of form, the aggregate of feeling, the aggregate of perception, the aggregate of formations, the aggregate of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañcindriyāni – cakkhundriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “五根：眼根、耳根、鼻根、舌根、身根。”
rows.english: There are five faculties: the eye faculty, the ear faculty, the nose faculty, the tongue faculty, and the body faculty.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta asaddhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti, duppañño hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七非正法：贤友们，于此，有比丘无信、无惭、无愧、寡闻、懈怠、失念、劣慧。”
rows.english: The seven ignoble qualities: Here, friends, a bhikkhu is without faith, without moral shame, without moral dread, has little learning, is lazy, is unmindful, and is unwise.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta saddhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, upaṭṭhitassati hoti, paññavā hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七正法：贤友们，于此，有比丘有信、有惭、有愧、多闻、发起精进、念现前、具慧。”
rows.english: The seven noble qualities: Here, friends, a bhikkhu has faith, has moral shame, has moral dread, is learned, has aroused energy, has established mindfulness, and is wise.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ tatiyaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于内无色想者，外观有限的、美的与丑的色，他有‘我已胜过彼，我知、我见’之想。这是第三胜处。”
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms, limited, of good and bad color. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the third sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ catutthaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某一于内无色想者，外观无量、善色与恶色的色，他有‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见’之想。这是第四胜处。
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms, immeasurable, of good and bad color. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the fourth sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭha lokadhammā – lābho ca, alābho ca, yaso ca, ayaso ca, nindā ca, pasaṃsā ca, sukhañca, dukkhañca.
rows.chinese_simplified: “八世间法(lokadhammā)：得与失、誉与毁、讥与赞、乐与苦。”
rows.english: Eight worldly conditions: gain and loss, fame and disgrace, censure and praise, pleasure and pain.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ pañcamī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，有众生完全超越色想，灭尽有对想，不作意种种想，思惟‘空无边’而到达空无边处。此为第五识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who, by completely transcending perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of resistance, and by not attending to perceptions of diversity, aware that ‘space is infinite,’ have reached the dimension of infinite space. This is the fifth station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ catuttho vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “以一切色想之超越，以有对想之灭没，以不作意种种想，‘虚空无边’，而入于空无边处而住。此为第四解脱。”
rows.english: With the complete transcendence of perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of resistance, and with non-attention to perceptions of diversity, aware that ‘space is infinite,’ one enters and dwells in the sphere of infinite space. This is the fourth liberation.

rows.pali: 348 . ‘‘Dasa ariyavāsā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ekārakkho, caturāpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭhesano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.
rows.chinese_simplified: 348. 十圣住。贤友，于此，比丘舍断五支，具足六支，具一守护，具四依止，已舍弃个别真理，已完全舍弃寻求，思虑澄净，身行轻安，心善解脱，慧善解脱。
rows.english: 348. The ten noble dwellings. Here, friends, a bhikkhu has abandoned five factors, is endowed with six factors, has a single guard, has four supports, has dispelled individual truths, has stilled his quest, has untroubled intentions, has tranquil bodily formation, is well-liberated in mind, and is well-liberated in wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso vidhā – seyyohamasmīti vidhā, sadisohamasmīti vidhā, hīnohamasmīti vidhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三慢：‘我为胜’慢、‘我为等’慢、‘我为劣’慢。
rows.english: Three kinds of conceit: the conceit ‘I am superior,’ the conceit ‘I am equal,’ and the conceit ‘I am inferior.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo addhā – atīto addhā, anāgato addhā, paccuppanno addhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三时：过去时、未来时、现在时。
rows.english: Three times: past time, future time, and present time.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso vedanā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三受：乐受、苦受、不苦不乐受。
rows.english: Three feelings: pleasant feeling, painful feeling, and neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo rāsī – micchattaniyato rāsi, sammattaniyato rāsi, aniyato rāsi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三聚：邪定聚、正定聚、不定聚。
rows.english: Three groups: the group fixed in wrongness, the group fixed in rightness, and the unfixed group.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso paññā – sekkhā paññā, asekkhā paññā, nevasekkhānāsekkhā paññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “三种慧：有学慧、无学慧、非有学非无学慧。”
rows.english: Three kinds of wisdom: the wisdom of one in training, the wisdom of one beyond training, and the wisdom of one who is neither in training nor beyond training.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo samādhī – savitakkasavicāro samādhi, avitakkavicāramatto samādhi, avitakkaavicāro samādhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三定：有寻有伺定、无寻唯伺定、无寻无伺定。
rows.english: Three kinds of concentration: concentration with applied thought and sustained thought; concentration without applied thought, with sustained thought only; and concentration without applied thought and without sustained thought.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni, tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi ceva raho ca. Ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对于那些无缺、无穿、无斑、无点、清净、为智者所称誉、不为贪见所执取、能导向定的戒，于公开及私下，与同梵行者戒行平等而住。此法亦是可忆念的……导向和合。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, with regard to those virtues that are unbroken, unflawed, unspotted, unblemished, liberating, praised by the wise, ungrasped, and conducive to concentration, a bhikkhu dwells in commonality of virtue with his fellow monastics, both openly and in private. This dhamma is also one to be remembered... conducing to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭha micchattā – micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākammanto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo micchāsati, micchāsamādhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: “八邪性：邪见、邪思惟、邪语、邪业、邪命、邪精进、邪念、邪定。”
rows.english: Eight wrong states: wrong view, wrong intention, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, and wrong concentration.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭha sammattā – sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: “八正性：正见、正思惟、正语、正业、正命、正精进、正念、正定。”
rows.english: Eight right states: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭha parisā – khattiyaparisā, brāhmaṇaparisā, gahapatiparisā, samaṇaparisā, cātumahārājikaparisā, tāvatiṃsaparisā, māraparisā, brahmaparisā .
rows.chinese_simplified: “八众：刹帝利众(khattiyaparisā)、婆罗门众(brāhmaṇaparisā)、居士众(gahapatiparisā)、沙门众(samaṇaparisā)、四大王天众(cātumahārājikaparisā)、三十三天众(tāvatiṃsaparisā)、魔众(māraparisā)、梵众(brahmaparisā)。”
rows.english: Eight assemblies: the assembly of nobles, the assembly of brahmins, the assembly of householders, the assembly of recluses, the assembly of the devas of the Four Great Kings, the assembly of the Tāvatiṃsa devas, the assembly of Māra, and the assembly of Brahmā.

rows.pali: 347 . ‘‘Dasa akusalakammapathā – pāṇātipāto, adinnādānaṃ, kāmesumicchācāro, musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, byāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 347. 十不善业道：杀生、不与取、欲邪行、妄语、离间语、粗恶语、绮语、贪欲、嗔恚、邪见。
rows.english: 347. The ten unwholesome courses of action: destroying life, taking what is not given, sexual misconduct, false speech, slanderous speech, harsh speech, frivolous chatter, covetousness, ill will, and wrong view.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri apassenāni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四依止。贤友，于此教法中，比丘省察后受用一法，省察后忍受一法，省察后回避一法，省察后去除一法。
rows.english: There are four reliances. Here, friends, a monk uses one thing after reflection, endures one thing after reflection, avoids one thing after reflection, and dispels one thing after reflection. These are the four reliances.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha vedanākāyā – cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, jivhāsamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六受身：眼触所生受、耳触所生受、鼻触所生受、舌触所生受、身触所生受、意触所生受。
rows.english: Six groups of feeling: feeling born of eye-contact, feeling born of ear-contact, feeling born of nose-contact, feeling born of tongue-contact, feeling born of body-contact, and feeling born of mind-contact.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta ariyadhanāni – saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七圣财：信财、戒财、惭财、愧财、闻财、舍财、慧财。”
rows.english: The seven noble treasures: the treasure of faith, the treasure of virtue, the treasure of moral shame, the treasure of moral dread, the treasure of learning, the treasure of generosity, and the treasure of wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta bojjhaṅgā – satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo , vīriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七觉支：念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。”
rows.english: The seven factors of enlightenment: the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta samādhiparikkhārā – sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七定资粮：正见、正思惟、正语、正业、正命、正精进、正念。”
rows.english: The seven requisites for concentration: Right View, Right Intention, Right Speech, Right Action, Right Livelihood, Right Effort, and Right Mindfulness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta saññā – aniccasaññā, anattasaññā, asubhasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七想：无常想、无我想、不净想、过患想、舍断想、离贪想、灭想。”
rows.english: Seven perceptions: the perception of impermanence, the perception of not-self, the perception of foulness, the perception of danger, the perception of abandoning, the perception of dispassion, and the perception of cessation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta balāni – saddhābalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “七力：信力、精进力、惭力、愧力、念力、定力、慧力。”
rows.english: Seven powers: the power of faith, the power of energy, the power of moral shame, the power of moral dread, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, and the power of wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta anusayā – kāmarāgānusayo, paṭighānusayo, diṭṭhānusayo, vicikicchānusayo, mānānusayo, bhavarāgānusayo, avijjānusayo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “有七种随眠：欲贪随眠、瞋随眠、见随眠、疑随眠、慢随眠、有贪随眠、无明随眠。”
rows.english: Seven latent tendencies: the latent tendency of sensual lust, the latent tendency of aversion, the latent tendency of views, the latent tendency of doubt, the latent tendency of conceit, the latent tendency of craving for existence, and the latent tendency of ignorance.

rows.pali: 316 . ‘‘Pañca abhabbaṭṭhānāni. Abhabbo, āvuso, khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropetuṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyituṃ ādātuṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.) . Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevituṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sampajānamusā bhāsituṃ. Abhabbo khīṇāsavo bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ kāme paribhuñjituṃ, seyyathāpi pubbe āgārikabhūto.
rows.chinese_simplified: 316. 五不可能之事。贤友，漏尽比丘不可能故意断有情之命；漏尽比丘不可能取未给予的、可算作偷盗之物；漏尽比丘不可能行淫法；漏尽比丘不可能故意说妄语；漏尽比丘不可能像以前在家时那样，积蓄受用欲乐。
rows.english: 316. There are five impossibilities. Friends, a monk whose taints are destroyed is incapable of intentionally depriving a living being of life. A monk whose taints are destroyed is incapable of taking what is not given, amounting to theft. A monk whose taints are destroyed is incapable of engaging in sexual intercourse. A monk whose taints are destroyed is incapable of knowingly speaking a falsehood. A monk whose taints are destroyed is incapable of enjoying stored-up sensual pleasures as he did formerly when a householder.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca sikkhāpadāni – pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, musāvādā veramaṇī, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五学处：离杀生，离不与取，离邪淫，离妄语，离作为放逸之因的酒类。
rows.english: There are five training precepts: abstinence from the destruction of life, abstinence from taking what is not given, abstinence from sexual misconduct, abstinence from false speech, and abstinence from distilled and fermented intoxicants which are the basis for heedlessness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha viññāṇakāyā – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六识身：眼识、耳识、鼻识、舌识、身识、意识。
rows.english: Six groups of consciousness: eye-consciousness, ear-consciousness, nose-consciousness, tongue-consciousness, body-consciousness, and mind-consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha phassakāyā – cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphasso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六触身：眼触、耳触、鼻触、舌触、身触、意触。
rows.english: Six groups of contact: eye-contact, ear-contact, nose-contact, tongue-contact, body-contact, and mind-contact.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha saññākāyā – rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六想身：色想、声想、香想、味想、触想、法想。
rows.english: Six groups of perception: perception of form, perception of sound, perception of odor, perception of taste, perception of tangible objects, and perception of mind-objects.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha sañcetanākāyā – rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六思身：色思、声思、香思、味思、触思、法思。
rows.english: Six groups of volition: volition regarding form, volition regarding sound, volition regarding odor, volition regarding taste, volition regarding tangible objects, and volition regarding mind-objects.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha taṇhākāyā – rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六爱身：色爱、声爱、香爱、味爱、触爱、法爱。
rows.english: Six groups of craving: craving for form, craving for sound, craving for odor, craving for taste, craving for tangible objects, and craving for mind-objects.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattampi, tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī. Ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘凡是如法、如法获得的利养，乃至仅有钵中所容之物，对于此等利养，他与具戒的同梵行者不分而食，共同受用。此法亦是可忆念的……乃至……导向同一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, whatever gains a bhikkhu has that are righteous and righteously obtained, even down to the contents of his alms-bowl, he is one who enjoys them without division, sharing them in common with his virtuous fellow monastics. This dhamma is also one to be remembered... conducing to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha dhātuyo – pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu.
rows.chinese_simplified: “六界：地界、水界、火界、风界、空界、识界。”
rows.english: There are six elements: the earth element, the water element, the fire element, the air element, the space element, and the consciousness element.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha anussatiṭṭhānāni – buddhānussati, dhammānussati, saṅghānussati, sīlānussati, cāgānussati, devatānussati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “六随念处：佛随念、法随念、僧随念、戒随念、舍随念、天随念。”
rows.english: Six grounds for recollection: recollection of the Buddha, recollection of the Dhamma, recollection of the Saṅgha, recollection of virtue, recollection of generosity, and recollection of the deities.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso , sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ sattamī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，有众生完全超越识无边处，思惟‘无所有’而到达无所有处。此为第七识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who, by completely transcending the dimension of infinite consciousness, aware that ‘there is nothing,’ have reached the dimension of nothingness. This is the seventh station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭha puggalā dakkhiṇeyyā – sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; anāgāmī, anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno; arahā, arahattaphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno.
rows.chinese_simplified: “八种应供的个人：入流者、为证入流果而行道者；一来者、为证一来果而行道者；不还者、为证不还果而行道者；阿罗汉、为证阿罗汉果而行道者。”
rows.english: Eight individuals worthy of offerings: the stream-enterer, one practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry; the once-returner, one practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning; the non-returner, one practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning; and the arahant, one practicing for the realization of the fruit of arahantship.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ chaṭṭho vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 全然超越识无边处，作‘无任何所有’想，成就无所有处而住。此为第六解脱。
rows.english: Having completely transcended the sphere of infinite consciousness, one attains and abides in the sphere of nothingness, aware that 'There is nothing whatsoever.' This is the sixth liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro anariyavohārā – adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, assute sutavāditā, amute mutavāditā, aviññāte viññātavāditā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “另有四种非圣言说：于未见说见，于未闻说闻，于未觉说觉，于未知说知。”
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other ignoble forms of speech: in regard to the unseen, stating it has been seen; in regard to the unheard, stating it has been heard; in regard to the unsensed, stating it has been sensed; in regard to the uncognized, stating it has been cognized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro ariyavohārā – adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, assute assutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “另有四种圣言说：于未见说未见，于未闻说未闻，于未觉说未觉，于未知说未知。”
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other noble forms of speech: in regard to the unseen, stating it has not been seen; in regard to the unheard, stating it has not been heard; in regard to the unsensed, stating it has not been sensed; in regard to the uncognized, stating it has not been cognized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro anariyavohārā – diṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, sute assutavāditā, mute amutavāditā, viññāte aviññātavāditā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “另有四种非圣言说：于已见说未见，于已闻说未闻，于已觉说未觉，于已知说未知。”
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other ignoble forms of speech: in regard to the seen, stating it has not been seen; in regard to the heard, stating it has not been heard; in regard to the sensed, stating it has not been sensed; in regard to the cognized, stating it has not been cognized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro ariyavohārā – diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “另有四种圣言说：于已见说已见，于已闻说已闻，于已觉说已觉，于已知说已知。”
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other noble forms of speech: in regard to the seen, stating it has been seen; in regard to the heard, stating it has been heard; in regard to the sensed, stating it has been sensed; in regard to the cognized, stating it has been cognized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino seyyathāpi devā brahmakāyikā paṭhamābhinibbattā. Ayaṃ dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，有众生身异想一，如初生的梵众天诸天。此为第二识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings diverse in body but unified in perception, such as the devas of Brahmā’s retinue who are first reborn there. This is the second station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti – evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ dutiyaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于内有色想者，外观无量的、美的与丑的色，他有‘我已胜过彼，我知、我见’之想。这是第二胜处。”
rows.english: Perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms, immeasurable, of good and bad color. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the second sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparāpi catasso paṭipadā – akkhamā paṭipadā, khamā paṭipadā, damā paṭipadā, samā paṭipadā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 另有四行道：不忍耐行道、忍耐行道、调御行道、寂静行道。
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four ways of practice: the unenduring practice, the enduring practice, the disciplined practice, and the tranquil practice.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri dhammapadāni – anabhijjhā dhammapadaṃ, abyāpādo dhammapadaṃ, sammāsati dhammapadaṃ, sammāsamādhi dhammapadaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四法句：无贪法句、无瞋法句、正念法句、正定法句。
rows.english: There are four Dhamma-principles: non-covetousness is a Dhamma-principle, non-ill will is a Dhamma-principle, right mindfulness is a Dhamma-principle, and right concentration is a Dhamma-principle.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro ganthā – abhijjhā kāyagantho, byāpādo kāyagantho, sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四身结：贪身结、瞋身结、戒禁取身结、执取此为真理身结。
rows.english: There are four bodily knots: the bodily knot of covetousness, the bodily knot of ill will, the bodily knot of clinging to rules and observances, and the bodily knot of dogmatic insistence that 'this alone is true'.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca gatiyo – nirayo, tiracchānayoni, pettivisayo, manussā, devā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五趣：地狱、畜生、饿鬼、人、天。
rows.english: There are five destinations: hell, the animal realm, the sphere of petas, human beings, and devas.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca macchariyāni – āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五悭：住处悭、家悭、利养悭、容色悭、法悭。
rows.english: There are five kinds of stinginess: stinginess regarding dwellings, stinginess regarding families, stinginess regarding gains, stinginess regarding appearance, and stinginess regarding the Dhamma.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca nīvaraṇāni – kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五盖：贪欲盖、嗔恚盖、昏沉睡眠盖、掉举恶作盖、疑盖。
rows.english: There are five hindrances: the hindrance of sensual desire, the hindrance of ill will, the hindrance of sloth and torpor, the hindrance of restlessness and remorse, and the hindrance of doubt.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca anāgāmino – antarāparinibbāyī, upahaccaparinibbāyī, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, uddhaṃsotoakaniṭṭhagāmī.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五种不还者：中般涅槃者、越中般涅槃者、无行般涅槃者、有行般涅槃者、上流至色究竟天者。
rows.english: There are five kinds of non-returners: one who attains parinibbāna in the interval, one who attains parinibbāna after passing the middle of the lifespan, one who attains parinibbāna without exertion, one who attains parinibbāna with exertion, and one who goes upstream to the Akaniṭṭha realm.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparānipi pañcindriyāni – sukhindriyaṃ, dukkhindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ, domanassindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “又有五根：乐根、苦根、喜根、忧根、舍根。”
rows.english: There are another five faculties: the faculty of pleasure, the faculty of pain, the faculty of gladness, the faculty of sadness, and the faculty of equanimity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparānipi pañcindriyāni – saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “又有五根：信根、精进根、念根、定根、慧根。”
rows.english: There are another five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of concentration, and the faculty of wisdom.

rows.pali: 338 . ‘‘Aṭṭha abhibhāyatanāni. Ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 338. “八胜处(abhibhāyatanāni)。于内有色想者，外观有限的、美的与丑的色，他有‘我已胜过彼，我知、我见’之想。这是第一胜处。”
rows.english: 338. There are eight spheres of mastery. Perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms, limited, of good and bad color. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the first sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena piṇḍapātena, itarītarapiṇḍapātasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca piṇḍapātahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati; aladdhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati; tāya ca pana itarītarapiṇḍapātasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti. Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato , ayaṃ vuccatāvuso – ‘bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘满足于随所得食，且称赞对随所得食的满足；不因食物而行邪求、不适宜之事；未得食物时不焦躁，已得食物时不贪着、不沉迷、不执著，见其过患，具出离慧而受用。又，他因对随所得食的满足，既不自赞，亦不毁他。贤友，凡于此娴熟、不懈怠、具正知、具正念者，此比丘被称为‘安住于古老、第一的圣种’。”
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is content with any kind of almsfood, and he speaks in praise of contentment with any kind of almsfood. He does not, on account of almsfood, engage in improper and unsuitable searching. If he does not obtain almsfood, he is not distressed; and when he has obtained almsfood, he uses it without being greedy, infatuated, or attached, seeing the danger and possessing the wisdom of escape. And by means of that contentment with any kind of almsfood, he neither exalts himself nor disparages others. Whichever monk is skilled, not lazy, clearly comprehending, and mindful therein—this, friends, is called a monk who is established in the ancient, foremost noble lineage.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena senāsanena, itarītarasenāsanasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca senāsanahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati; aladdhā ca senāsanaṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca senāsanaṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati; tāya ca pana itarītarasenāsanasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti. Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato, ayaṃ vuccatāvuso – ‘bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘满足于随所得住处，且称赞对随所得住处的满足；不因住处而行邪求、不适宜之事；未得住处时不焦躁，已得住处时不贪着、不沉迷、不执著，见其过患，具出离慧而受用。又，他因对随所得住处的满足，既不自赞，亦不毁他。贤友，凡于此娴熟、不懈怠、具正知、具正念者，此比丘被称为‘安住于古老、第一的圣种’。”
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is content with any kind of lodging, and he speaks in praise of contentment with any kind of lodging. He does not, on account of lodging, engage in improper and unsuitable searching. If he does not obtain lodging, he is not distressed; and when he has obtained lodging, he uses it without being greedy, infatuated, or attached, seeing the danger and possessing the wisdom of escape. And by means of that contentment with any kind of lodging, he neither exalts himself nor disparages others. Whichever monk is skilled, not lazy, clearly comprehending, and mindful therein—this, friends, is called a monk who is established in the ancient, foremost noble lineage.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca vimuttiparipācanīyā saññā – aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五种令解脱成熟的想：无常想、于无常中苦想、于苦中无我想、断想、离贪想。
rows.english: There are five perceptions conducive to the ripening of liberation: the perception of impermanence, the perception of suffering in what is impermanent, the perception of non-self in what is suffering, the perception of abandoning, and the perception of dispassion.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino seyyathāpi devā ābhassarā. Ayaṃ tatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，有众生身一想异，如光音天诸天。此为第三识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings unified in body but diverse in perception, such as the devas of Streaming Radiance. This is the third station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā. Ayaṃ catutthī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，有众生身一想一，如遍净天诸天。此为第四识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings unified in body and unified in perception, such as the devas of Refulgent Glory. This is the fourth station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta puggalā dakkhiṇeyyā – ubhatobhāgavimutto , paññāvimutto, kāyasakkhi, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī.
rows.chinese_simplified: “有七种应供之人：俱分解脱者、慧解脱者、身证者、见至者、信解脱者、随法行者、随信行者。”
rows.english: Seven persons worthy of offerings: one liberated in both ways, one liberated by wisdom, a body-witness, one who has attained the view, one liberated by faith, a Dhamma-follower, and a faith-follower.

rows.pali: 324 . ‘‘Cha agāravā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso; dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso; saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso; sikkhāya agāravo viharati appatisso; appamāde agāravo viharati appatisso; paṭisanthāre paṭisandhāre (ka.) agāravo viharati appatisso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 324. 六不敬。贤友，于此，比丘对导师不恭敬、不顺从而住；对法不恭敬、不顺从而住；对僧团不恭敬、不顺从而住；对学处不恭敬、不顺从而住；对不放逸不恭敬、不顺从而住；对接待不恭敬、不顺从而住。
rows.english: 324. Six kinds of disrespect. Here, friends, a bhikkhu dwells without respect and without deference for the Teacher; he dwells without respect and without deference for the Dhamma; he dwells without respect and without deference for the Saṅgha; he dwells without respect and without deference for the training; he dwells without respect and without deference for diligence; he dwells without respect and without deference for hospitality.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi ceva raho ca. Ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对同梵行者，于公开及私下，皆现起慈意业。此法亦是可忆念的……乃至……导向同一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu's mental action accompanied by loving-kindness is established towards his fellow monastics, both openly and in private. This dhamma is also one to be remembered... conducing to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya, tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi ceva raho ca. Ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对于那圣者的、出离的、能引导实行者正确地灭尽苦的见，于公开及私下，与同梵行者见解平等而住。此法亦是可忆念的，能引生喜爱，能引生尊重，导向摄益、无诤、和合与同一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, with regard to that view that is noble and emancipating, which leads one who acts accordingly to the complete destruction of suffering, a bhikkhu dwells in commonality of view with his fellow monastics, both openly and in private. This dhamma is also one to be remembered, creating affection, creating respect, and conducing to cohesion, non-dispute, harmony, and unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tīṇi akusalamūlāni – lobho akusalamūlaṃ, doso akusalamūlaṃ, moho akusalamūlaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三不善根：贪不善根、嗔不善根、痴不善根。
rows.english: Three unwholesome roots: greed is an unwholesome root, hatred is an unwholesome root, and delusion is an unwholesome root.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tīṇi kusalamūlāni – alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三善根：无贪善根、无嗔善根、无痴善根。
rows.english: Three wholesome roots: non-greed is a wholesome root, non-hatred is a wholesome root, and non-delusion is a wholesome root.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo antā – sakkāyo anto, sakkāyasamudayo anto, sakkāyanirodho anto.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三边：有身边、有身集边、有身灭边。
rows.english: Three extremes: the existing body, the origin of the existing body, and the cessation of the existing body.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo kiñcanā – rāgo kiñcanaṃ, doso kiñcanaṃ, moho kiñcanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三障：贪为障，嗔为障，痴为障。
rows.english: Three impediments: greed, hatred, and delusion.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tīṇi puññakiriyavatthūni – dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三福业事：布施所成福业事、持戒所成福业事、修习所成福业事。
rows.english: Three grounds for meritorious action: the ground for meritorious action consisting of giving, the ground for meritorious action consisting of moral virtue, and the ground for meritorious action consisting of mental development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparāpi tisso paññā – cintāmayā paññā, sutamayā paññā, bhāvanāmayā paññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “复有三种慧：思所成慧、闻所成慧、修所成慧。”
rows.english: Three other kinds of wisdom: wisdom consisting of thought, wisdom consisting of learning, and wisdom consisting of mental development.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi tayo samādhī – suññato samādhi, animitto samādhi, appaṇihito samādhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复有三定：空定、无相定、无愿定。
rows.english: Furthermore, there are three other concentrations: the emptiness concentration, the signless concentration, and the undirected concentration.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo vihārā – dibbo vihāro, brahmā vihāro, ariyo vihāro.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三住：天住、梵住、圣住。
rows.english: Three abidings: the divine abiding, the sublime abiding, and the noble abiding.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparānipi cattāri ñāṇāni – dukkhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 另有四种智：苦智、苦集智、苦灭智、苦灭道智。
rows.english: “There are another four knowledges: knowledge in suffering, knowledge in the origin of suffering, knowledge in the cessation of suffering, and knowledge in the path leading to the cessation of suffering.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri sāmaññaphalāni – sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “四沙门果：预流果、一来果、不还果、阿罗汉果。”
rows.english: There are four fruits of recluseship: the fruit of stream-entry, the fruit of once-returning, the fruit of non-returning, and the fruit of arahantship.

rows.pali: ‘‘Catasso dhātuyo – pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu.
rows.chinese_simplified: “四界：地界、水界、火界、风界。”
rows.english: There are four elements: the earth element, the water element, the fire element, and the air element.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro dhammakkhandhā – sīlakkhandho, samādhikkhandho, paññākkhandho, vimuttikkhandho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四法蕴：戒蕴、定蕴、慧蕴、解脱蕴。
rows.english: There are four aggregates of Dhamma: the aggregate of virtue, the aggregate of concentration, the aggregate of wisdom, and the aggregate of liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri balāni – vīriyabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四力：精进力、念力、定力、慧力。
rows.english: There are four powers: the power of energy, the power of mindfulness, the power of concentration, and the power of wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri adhiṭṭhānāni – paññādhiṭṭhānaṃ, saccādhiṭṭhānaṃ, cāgādhiṭṭhānaṃ, upasamādhiṭṭhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四决意：慧决意、真实决意、舍决意、寂静决意。
rows.english: There are four determinations: the determination of wisdom, the determination of truth, the determination of relinquishment, and the determination of peace.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro oghā – kāmogho, bhavogho, diṭṭhogho, avijjogho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四暴流：欲暴流、有暴流、见暴流、无明暴流。
rows.english: There are four floods: the flood of sensuality, the flood of becoming, the flood of views, and the flood of ignorance.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro yogā – kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四轭：欲轭、有轭、见轭、无明轭。
rows.english: There are four yokes: the yoke of sensuality, the yoke of becoming, the yoke of views, and the yoke of ignorance.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro visaññogā – kāmayogavisaññogo, bhavayogavisaññogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo, avijjāyogavisaññogo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四离轭：离欲轭、离有轭、离见轭、离无明轭。
rows.english: There are four disjoinings from the yokes: disjoining from the yoke of sensuality, disjoining from the yoke of becoming, disjoining from the yoke of views, and disjoining from the yoke of ignorance.

rows.pali: ‘‘Catasso yoniyo – aṇḍajayoni, jalābujayoni, saṃsedajayoni, opapātikayoni.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四生：卵生、胎生、湿生、化生。
rows.english: There are four modes of birth: egg-born, womb-born, moisture-born, and spontaneously arisen.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro anariyavohārā – musāvādo, pisuṇāvācā, pharusāvācā, samphappalāpo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “有四种非圣言说：妄语、两舌、恶口、绮语。”
rows.english: There are four ignoble forms of speech: false speech, divisive speech, harsh speech, and idle chatter.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro ariyavohārā – musāvādā veramaṇī veramaṇi (ka.) , pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī.
rows.chinese_simplified: “有四种圣言说：离妄语、离两舌、离恶口、离绮语。”
rows.english: There are four noble forms of speech: abstinence from false speech, abstinence from divisive speech, abstinence from harsh speech, and abstinence from idle chatter.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni – cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六内处：眼处、耳处、鼻处、舌处、身处、意处。
rows.english: Six internal sense bases: the eye-base, the ear-base, the nose-base, the tongue-base, the body-base, and the mind-base.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha bāhirāni āyatanāni – rūpāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六外处：色处、声处、香处、味处、触处、法处。
rows.english: Six external sense bases: the form-base, the sound-base, the odor-base, the taste-base, the tangible-object-base, and the mind-object-base.

rows.pali: 327 . ‘‘Cha anuttariyāni – dassanānuttariyaṃ, savanānuttariyaṃ, lābhānuttariyaṃ, sikkhānuttariyaṃ, pāricariyānuttariyaṃ, anussatānuttariyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 327. “六种无上：见无上、闻无上、得无上、学无上、奉事无上、随念无上。”
rows.english: 327. Six unsurpassed things: unsurpassed seeing, unsurpassed hearing, unsurpassed gain, unsurpassed training, unsurpassed service, and unsurpassed recollection.

rows.pali: 332 . ‘‘Satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. Santāvuso, sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā. Ayaṃ paṭhamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 332. “七识住：贤友们，有众生身异想异，如人、某些天神及某些堕处生。此为第一识住。”
rows.english: 332. Seven stations of consciousness. There are, friends, beings diverse in body and diverse in perception, such as humans, some devas, and some beings in the states of deprivation. This is the first station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ sattamo vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 全然超越无所有处，成就非想非非想处而住。此为第七解脱。
rows.english: Having completely transcended the sphere of nothingness, one attains and abides in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. This is the seventh liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā, ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ me ābādho paccudāvatteyya, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’’ti! So vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘病愈未久。他这样想：‘我病愈未久，我的病确有复发的可能。我当发起精进，为达到未达，为证得未证，为现证未现证！’于是他发起精进，为达到未达，为证得未证，为现证未现证。这是第八发起精进事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has recovered from an illness, having recently recovered from his affliction. He thinks: ‘I have recovered from an illness, having recently recovered from my affliction. There is a possibility that my illness might return. Now, let me arouse energy for attaining the unattained, for achieving the unachieved, for realizing the unrealized!’ So he arouses energy for attaining the unattained, for achieving the unachieved, for realizing the unrealized. This is the eighth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Dasa nāthakaraṇā dhammā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti. Pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 十种作依怙法。贤友，于此，比丘具戒，防护波罗提木叉律仪而住，具足正行与行处，于微细过失中见怖畏，于诸学处中受持而学。贤友，比丘具戒，防护波罗提木叉律仪而住，具足正行与行处，于微细过失中见怖畏，于诸学处中受持而学，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Ten qualities that make a refuge. Here, friends, a monk is virtuous. He dwells restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint, endowed with good conduct and suitable resort, seeing danger in the slightest faults, he undertakes and trains in the training rules.
