Friends, that a monk is virtuous, dwells restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint, endowed with good conduct and suitable resort, seeing danger in the slightest faults, and trains by undertaking the training rules—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo balavā kammañño, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… so vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ ārambhavatthu .
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘为乞食行于村或镇时，获得足够的粗糙或精致的食物。他这样想：‘我为乞食行于村或镇时，已获得足够的粗糙或精致的食物，我的身体有力、适于作业。那么，我当发起精进……’他便发起精进……这是第六发起精进之事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, while walking for alms in a village or town, obtains enough coarse or fine food to fill his belly. He thinks: ‘While walking for alms in a village or town, I obtained enough coarse or fine food to fill my belly. My body is strong and fit for work. Now, let me arouse energy…’ So he arouses energy… This is the sixth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro puggalā. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya. Idhāvuso , ekacco puggalo neva attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo attahitāya ceva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
rows.chinese_simplified: “另有四种人。贤友，于此，有一种人，为自利行道而非为他利。贤友，于此，有一种人，为他利行道而非为自利。贤友，于此，有一种人，既不为自利行道，亦不为他利。贤友，于此，有一种人，既为自利行道，亦为他利。”
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other persons. Here, friends, a certain person is one who practices for his own welfare, but not for the welfare of others. Here, friends, a certain person is one who practices for the welfare of others, but not for his own welfare. Here, friends, a certain person is one who practices neither for his own welfare nor for the welfare of others. Here, friends, a certain person is one who practices for his own welfare as well as for the welfare of others.

rows.pali: 335 . ‘‘Aṭṭha ārambhavatthūni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘kammaṃ kho me kātabbaṃ bhavissati, kammaṃ kho pana me karontena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya, asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti! So vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 335. 有八种发起精进事。贤友，在此，有比丘应做某项事务。他如此想：‘我将有事务应做，然而我做事务时，不容易作意诸佛的教导。现在我当发起精进，为达到未达，为证得未证，为现证未现证！’于是他发起精进，为达到未达，为证得未证，为现证未现证。这是第一发起精进事。
rows.english: 335. “Eight grounds for arousing energy. Here, friends, a bhikkhu has some work to do. He thinks: ‘I will have to do some work. While doing the work, it will not be easy for me to attend to the teaching of the Buddhas. Now, let me arouse energy for attaining the unattained, for achieving the unachieved, for realizing the unrealized.’ So he arouses energy for attaining the unattained, for achieving the unachieved, for realizing the unrealized. This is the first ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Catasso gabbhāvakkantiyo. Idhāvuso, ekacco asampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, asampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, ayaṃ paṭhamā gabbhāvakkanti. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, idhekacco sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, asampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, ayaṃ dutiyā gabbhāvakkanti. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, idhekacco sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, sampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, ayaṃ tatiyā gabbhāvakkanti. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, idhekacco sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, sampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, sampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, ayaṃ catutthā gabbhāvakkanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友们，有四种入胎（gabbhāvakkanti）。于此，有一类者无正知而入母胎，无正知而住母胎，无正知而出母胎，此为第一种入胎。再者，贤友们，于此，有一类者有正知而入母胎，无正知而住母胎，无正知而出母胎，此为第二种入胎。再者，贤友们，于此，有一类者有正知而入母胎，有正知而住母胎，无正知而出母胎，此为第三种入胎。再者，贤友们，于此，有一类者有正知而入母胎，有正知而住母胎，有正知而出母胎，此为第四种入胎。
rows.english: There are four descents into a womb. Here, friends, a certain person descends into the mother’s womb without clear comprehension, remains in the mother’s womb without clear comprehension, and emerges from the mother’s womb without clear comprehension. This is the first descent into a womb. Furthermore, friends, here a certain person descends into the mother’s womb with clear comprehension, but remains in the mother’s womb without clear comprehension, and emerges from the mother’s womb without clear comprehension. This is the second descent into a womb. Furthermore, friends, here a certain person descends into the mother’s womb with clear comprehension, remains in the mother’s womb with clear comprehension, but emerges from the mother’s womb without clear comprehension. This is the third descent into a womb. Furthermore, friends, here a certain person descends into the mother’s womb with clear comprehension, remains in the mother’s womb with clear comprehension, and emerges from the mother’s womb with clear comprehension. This is the fourth descent into a womb.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tayo tamā tisso kaṅkhā (bahūsu) aṭṭhakathā oloketabbā – atītaṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati, anāgataṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati, etarahi vā paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三暗：于过去时，怀疑、犹豫，不决断，不信乐；于未来时，怀疑、犹豫，不决断，不信乐；于现在时，怀疑、犹豫，不决断，不信乐。
rows.english: Three kinds of doubt: with regard to the past, one doubts, is uncertain, is not resolved, and is not confident; with regard to the future, one doubts, is uncertain, is not resolved, and is not confident; with regard to the present, one doubts, is uncertain, is not resolved, and is not confident.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro sammappadhānā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. Uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. Anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. Uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四正勤。贤友们，于此，比丘为使未生之恶不善法不生，生起欲，努力，发起精进，策励其心，精勤。为断已生之恶不善法，生起欲，努力，发起精进，策励其心，精勤。为使未生之善法生起，生起欲，努力，发起精进，策励其心，精勤。为使已生之善法住立、不忘、增长、广大、修习、圆满，生起欲，努力，发起精进，策励其心，精勤。
rows.english: Four right strivings. Here, friends, a monk generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the non-arising of evil, unwholesome states that have not yet arisen. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the abandoning of evil, unwholesome states that have arisen. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the arising of wholesome states that have not yet arisen. He generates desire, makes an effort, arouses energy, exerts his mind, and strives for the maintenance, non-fading, increase, expansion, development, and culmination of wholesome states that have arisen.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ . Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo lahuko kammañño, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… so vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ pañcamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘为乞食行于村或镇时，未获得足够的粗糙或精致的食物。他这样想：‘我为乞食行于村或镇时，未获得足够的粗糙或精致的食物，我的身体轻快、适于作业。那么，我当发起精进……’他便发起精进……这是第五发起精进之事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, while walking for alms in a village or town, does not obtain enough coarse or fine food to fill his belly. He thinks: ‘While walking for alms in a village or town, I did not obtain enough coarse or fine food to fill my belly. My body is light and fit for work. Now, let me arouse energy…’ So he arouses energy… This is the fifth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro puggalā – samaṇamacalo, samaṇapadumo, samaṇapuṇḍarīko, samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 另有四种人：不动摇沙门、红莲沙门、白莲沙门、沙门中之微妙沙门。
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other persons: the unshakable ascetic, the red lotus ascetic, the white lotus ascetic, and the refined ascetic among ascetics.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca orambhāgiyāni saññojanāni – sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五下分结：有身见、疑、戒禁取、欲贪、嗔恚。
rows.english: There are five lower fetters: identity view, doubt, clinging to rites and rituals, sensual desire, and ill will.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca uddhambhāgiyāni saññojanāni – rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五上分结：色贪、无色贪、慢、掉举、无明。
rows.english: There are five higher fetters: lust for form, lust for the formless, conceit, restlessness, and ignorance.

rows.pali: 318 . ‘‘Pañca suddhāvāsā – avihā, atappā, sudassā, sudassī, akaniṭṭhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 318. 五净居天：无烦天、无热天、善见天、善现天、色究竟天。
rows.english: 318. There are five Pure Abodes: Avihā, Atappā, Sudassā, Sudassī, and Akaniṭṭhā.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati. Ayaṃ dutiyo vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于内无色想者，外观诸遍处色。此为第二解脱。”
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, one sees external forms. This is the second liberation.

rows.pali: 308 . ‘‘Catasso appamaññā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. Tathā dutiyaṃ. Tathā tatiyaṃ. Tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena abyāpajjhena (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) pharitvā viharati. Karuṇāsahagatena cetasā…pe… muditāsahagatena cetasā…pe… upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. Tathā dutiyaṃ. Tathā tatiyaṃ. Tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 308. 四无量。贤友，于此教法中，比丘以与慈俱行之心，遍满一方而住；如是第二、第三、第四方。如是，向上、向下、横向，于一切处，以一切为己，以广大的、已达崇高的、无量的、无怨的、无恼害的与慈俱行之心，遍满一切世间而住。以与悲俱行之心……以与喜俱行之心……以与舍俱行之心，遍满一方而住；如是第二、第三、第四方。如是，向上、向下、横向，于一切处，以一切为己，以广大的、已达崇高的、无量的、无怨的、无恼害的与舍俱行之心，遍满一切世间而住。
rows.english: 308. There are four boundless states. Here, friends, a monk dwells pervading one direction with a mind imbued with loving-kindness; likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. Thus above, below, across, everywhere, identifying with all, he dwells pervading the entire world with a mind imbued with loving-kindness—vast, sublime, immeasurable, without enmity, without ill will. With a mind imbued with compassion… with a mind imbued with appreciative joy… with a mind imbued with equanimity, he dwells pervading one direction; likewise the second, likewise the third, likewise the fourth. Thus above, below, across, everywhere, identifying with all, he dwells pervading the entire world with a mind imbued with equanimity—vast, sublime, immeasurable, without enmity, without ill will. These are the four boundless states.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño, māsācitaṃ maññe , handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘到村庄或市镇为食行乞时，无论是粗食或美食，都获得了足以饱腹的食物。他这样想：‘我到村庄或市镇为食行乞，无论是粗食或美食，都已获得足以饱腹的食物。我的身体沉重且不适合作业，感觉就像浸水的豆子，我还是躺下吧！’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第六懈怠事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, while walking for alms in a village or town, obtains enough coarse or fine food to fill his belly. He thinks: ‘While walking for alms in a village or town, I obtained enough coarse or fine food to fill my belly. My body is heavy and unfit for work; it feels like it is filled with wet beans. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the sixth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: 309 . ‘‘Cattāro ariyavaṃsā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarena cīvarena, itarītaracīvarasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca cīvarahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati; aladdhā ca cīvaraṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca cīvaraṃ agadhito agathito (sī. pī.) amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati; tāya ca pana itarītaracīvarasantuṭṭhiyā nevattānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti. Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato, ayaṃ vuccatāvuso – ‘bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 309. “贤友，有四圣种。于此，比丘满足于随所得衣，且称赞对随所得衣的满足；不因衣服而行邪求、不适宜之事；未得衣服时不焦躁，已得衣服时不贪着、不沉迷、不执著，见其过患，具出离慧而受用。又，他因对随所得衣的满足，既不自赞，亦不毁他。贤友，凡于此娴熟、不懈怠、具正知、具正念者，此比丘被称为‘安住于古老、第一的圣种’。”
rows.english: 309. “There are four noble lineages. Here, friends, a monk is content with any kind of robe, and he speaks in praise of contentment with any kind of robe. He does not, on account of a robe, engage in improper and unsuitable searching. If he does not obtain a robe, he is not distressed; and when he has obtained a robe, he uses it without being greedy, infatuated, or attached, seeing the danger and possessing the wisdom of escape. And by means of that contentment with any kind of robe, he neither exalts himself nor disparages others. Whichever monk is skilled, not lazy, clearly comprehending, and mindful therein—this, friends, is called a monk who is established in the ancient, foremost noble lineage.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro attabhāvapaṭilābhā. Atthāvuso, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanāyeva kamati, no parasañcetanā. Atthāvuso, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe parasañcetanāyeva kamati, no attasañcetanā. Atthāvuso, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā ceva kamati parasañcetanā ca. Atthāvuso, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe neva attasañcetanā kamati, no parasañcetanā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友们，有四种自体之获得（attabhāvapaṭilābha）。贤友们，有一种自体之获得，其中仅自发意愿（attasañcetanā）起作用，无他发意愿（parasañcetanā）。贤友们，有一种自体之获得，其中仅他发意愿起作用，无自发意愿。贤友们，有一种自体之获得，其中自发意愿与他发意愿皆起作用。贤友们，有一种自体之获得，其中自发意愿与他发意愿皆不起作用。
rows.english: There are four acquisitions of individual existence. Friends, there is an acquisition of individual existence in which one's own volition is effective, but not another's volition. Friends, there is an acquisition of individual existence in which another's volition is effective, but not one's own volition. Friends, there is an acquisition of individual existence in which both one's own volition and another's volition are effective. Friends, there is an acquisition of individual existence in which neither one's own volition nor another's volition is effective.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友们，此四法乃由彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵……为天人之义利、福祉、安乐。
rows.english: Friends, these four dhammas have been well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together... for the good, welfare, and happiness of devas and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cha dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，这六法乃为彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵……为天与人之利益、福祉与安乐。”
rows.english: These, friends, are the six principles well proclaimed by the Blessed One—the one who knows, the one who sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Herein, all should chant together... for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of gods and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Satta adhikaraṇasamathā – uppannuppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇavatthārako.
rows.chinese_simplified: “有七种灭诤法，为平息、止息已生起的诸诤事：应行现前毘尼、忆念毘尼、不痴毘尼；依自承而行；多数决；觅罪相；草覆法。”
rows.english: Seven principles for settling disputes: For the settling and pacification of disputes that have arisen, the procedure of being in the presence should be employed, the procedure of mindfulness should be employed, the procedure for one who is no longer confused should be employed, an act should be carried out on admission, a decision by majority, a verdict of misconduct, and the covering over with grass.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena satta dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，此等七法，乃为彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵……为天与人之利益、福祉与安乐。”
rows.english: These, friends, are the seven qualities well proclaimed by the Blessed One—who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant in unison... for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena aṭṭha dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友们，此八法乃由彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，汝等一切应合诵……为诸天与人之利益、福祉、安乐。
rows.english: These, friends, are the eight qualities well-expounded by that Blessed One—the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. All should recite them together… for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of gods and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena nava dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，这九种法是那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊所善说的。于此，我们所有人都应合诵……为诸天与人的义利、利益与安乐。
rows.english: “These, friends, are the nine qualities well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together… for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. Rūpūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpāramaṇaṃ (?) rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati; vedanūpāyaṃ vā āvuso…pe… saññūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso…pe… saṅkhārūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati saṅkhārārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有四识住。贤友，识若依止色而住，以色为所缘，以色为立足处，以喜为浇灌，则会增长、生长、广大；贤友，或依止受……贤友，或依止想……贤友，或依止行而住，以行为所缘，以行为立足处，以喜为浇灌，则会增长、生长、广大。
rows.english: There are four stations of consciousness. When, friends, consciousness, while standing, stands with form as its support, with form as its object, established upon form, sprinkled with delight, it attains growth, increase, and expansion. When, friends, with feeling as its support… when, friends, with perception as its support… when, friends, consciousness, while standing, stands with formations as its support, with formations as its object, established upon formations, sprinkled with delight, it attains growth, increase, and expansion.

rows.pali: 307 . ‘‘Catasso samādhibhāvanā. Atthāvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati. Atthāvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati. Atthāvuso samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati. Atthāvuso samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 307. 有四种定的修习。贤友，有一种定的修习，修习、多修习之，能导向现法乐住。贤友，有一种定的修习，修习、多修习之，能导向智见的获得。贤友，有一种定的修习，修习、多修习之，能导向正念正知。贤友，有一种定的修习，修习、多修习之，能导向诸漏的灭尽。
rows.english: 307. There are four developments of concentration. Friends, there is a development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to a pleasant abiding in the present life. Friends, there is a development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to the attainment of knowledge and vision. Friends, there is a development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to mindfulness and clear comprehension. Friends, there is a development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to the destruction of the taints.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro taṇhuppādā – cīvarahetu vā, āvuso, bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati; piṇḍapātahetu vā, āvuso, bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati; senāsanahetu vā, āvuso, bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati; itibhavābhavahetu vā, āvuso, bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有四种爱的生起。贤友，比丘或因衣而生起爱；或因乞食而生起爱；或因坐卧处而生起爱；或因种种精妙资具而生起爱。
rows.english: There are four arisings of craving. Friends, for a bhikkhu, craving, while arising, arises on account of robes; friends, for a bhikkhu, craving, while arising, arises on account of almsfood; friends, for a bhikkhu, craving, while arising, arises on account of lodgings; friends, for a bhikkhu, craving, while arising, arises on account of this or that state of being.

rows.pali: 313 . ‘‘Catasso dakkhiṇāvisuddhiyo. Atthāvuso, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato. Atthāvuso, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato. Atthāvuso, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato. Atthāvuso, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
rows.chinese_simplified: 313. 贤友们，有四种布施之清净（dakkhiṇāvisuddhi）。贤友们，有一种布施，由施者而清净，非由受者。贤友们，有一种布施，由受者而清净，非由施者。贤友们，有一种布施，既非由施者清净，亦非由受者清净。贤友们，有一种布施，由施者与受者二者而清净。
rows.english: 313. There are four purifications of an offering. Friends, there is an offering that is purified on the part of the giver, but not on the part of the recipient. Friends, there is an offering that is purified on the part of the recipient, but not on the part of the giver. Friends, there is an offering that is purified neither on the part of the giver nor on the part of the recipient. Friends, there is an offering that is purified on the part of both the giver and the recipient.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo kilanto akammañño, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ pañcamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘到村庄或市镇为食行乞时，无论是粗食或美食，都未能获得足以饱腹的食物。他这样想：‘我到村庄或市镇为食行乞，无论是粗食或美食，都未能获得足以饱腹的食物。我的身体疲惫且不适合作业，我还是躺下吧！’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第五懈怠事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, while walking for alms in a village or town, does not obtain enough coarse or fine food to fill his belly. He thinks: ‘While walking for alms in a village or town, I did not obtain enough coarse or fine food to fill my belly. My body is tired and unfit for work. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the fifth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo cāvuso, amhākaṃ bhagavatā bhagavato (ka. sī.) dhammo svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito; yattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ?
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘贤友们，我等世尊所善说、善宣示、能出离、导向寂静、由正等觉者所宣示的法，是哪一个呢？于此法中，应由所有人共同合诵，不应争论，这样此梵行才能长久、持续，这将为了众人的利益，为了众人的安乐，为了怜悯世间，为了天与人的义利、福祉与安乐。’
rows.english: ‘And which, friends, is the Dhamma well-proclaimed by our Blessed One, well-expounded, leading out, conducive to peace, and declared by a Perfectly Enlightened One, wherein all should chant in unison, without disputing, so that this holy life might be long-lasting and endure for a long time, for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans?

rows.pali: 311 . ‘‘Cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni – sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhammānudhammappaṭipatti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 311. 四种预流支：亲近善士、听闻正法、如理作意、法随法行。
rows.english: 311. “There are four factors of stream-entry: association with true persons, hearing the true Dhamma, wise attention, and practice in accordance with the Dhamma.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Aparepi cattāro puggalā – tamo tamaparāyano, tamo jotiparāyano, joti tamaparāyano, joti jotiparāyano.
rows.chinese_simplified: 另有四种人：从黑暗到黑暗者，从黑暗到光明者，从光明到黑暗者，从光明到光明者。
rows.english: Furthermore, there are four other persons: the one in darkness bound for darkness, the one in darkness bound for light, the one in light bound for darkness, and the one in light bound for light.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha nibbedhabhāgiyā saññā nibbedhabhāgiyasaññā (syā. kaṃ.) – aniccasaññā anicce, dukkhasaññā dukkhe, anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “六决择分想：无常想、于无常中苦想、于苦中无我想、断想、离贪想、灭想。”
rows.english: Six perceptions conducive to penetration: the perception of impermanence, the perception of suffering in the impermanent, the perception of not-self in suffering, the perception of abandoning, the perception of dispassion, and the perception of cessation.

rows.pali: 329 . ‘‘Chaḷābhijātiyo. Idhāvuso, ekacco kaṇhābhijātiko samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. Idha panāvuso, ekacco kaṇhābhijātiko samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. Idha panāvuso, ekacco kaṇhābhijātiko samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati. Idha panāvuso, ekacco sukkābhijātiko samāno sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. Idha panāvuso, ekacco sukkābhijātiko samāno kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati. Idha panāvuso, ekacco sukkābhijātiko samāno akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 329. “六种生类。贤友，于此，某一黑生类者，产生黑法。贤友，于此，某一黑生类者，产生白法。贤友，于此，某一黑生类者，产生非黑非白的涅槃。贤友，于此，某一白生类者，产生白法。贤友，于此，某一白生类者，产生黑法。贤友，于此，某一白生类者，产生非黑非白的涅槃。”
rows.english: 329. Six kinds of birth. Here, friends, a certain person of dark birth gives rise to a dark state. Here, friends, a certain person of dark birth gives rise to a bright state. Here, friends, a certain person of dark birth gives rise to the neither-dark-nor-bright Nibbāna. Here, friends, a certain person of bright birth gives rise to a bright state. Here, friends, a certain person of bright birth gives rise to a dark state. Here, friends, a certain person of bright birth gives rise to the neither-dark-nor-bright Nibbāna.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca byasanāni – ñātibyasanaṃ, bhogabyasanaṃ, rogabyasanaṃ, sīlabyasanaṃ, diṭṭhibyasanaṃ. Nāvuso, sattā ñātibyasanahetu vā bhogabyasanahetu vā rogabyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. Sīlabyasanahetu vā, āvuso, sattā diṭṭhibyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五种衰损：亲属衰损、财富衰损、疾病衰损、戒衰损、见衰损。贤友，众生不是因亲属衰损、财富衰损或疾病衰损，而于身坏命终后，投生于苦界、恶趣、堕处、地狱。贤友，众生是因戒衰损或见衰损，而于身坏命终后，投生于苦界、恶趣、堕处、地狱。
rows.english: There are five calamities: the calamity of relatives, the calamity of wealth, the calamity of illness, the calamity of virtue, and the calamity of view. Friends, beings are not reborn in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a downfall, in hell, after the breakup of the body, after death, on account of the calamity of relatives, the calamity of wealth, or the calamity of illness. But, friends, beings are reborn in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a downfall, in hell, after the breakup of the body, after death, on account of the calamity of virtue or the calamity of view.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ appamattako ābādho, ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ me ābādho pavaḍḍheyya, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… so vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ sattamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘生起轻微的疾病。他这样想：‘我生起了这轻微的疾病，此病有可能会加重。那么，我当发起精进……’他便发起精进……这是第七发起精进之事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a minor illness has arisen in a bhikkhu. He thinks: ‘This minor illness has arisen in me. There is a possibility that my illness might worsen. Now, let me arouse energy…’ So he arouses energy… This is the seventh ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: 305 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena tayo dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame tayo?
rows.chinese_simplified: 305. 贤友们，彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊确实已善说三法。于此，我等皆应合诵……（中略）……为天人的义利、福祉与安乐。是哪三法呢？
rows.english: 305. Friends, there are three dhammas that have been well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Herein, all should chant together in unison... for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of devas and humans. What are the three?

rows.pali: 315 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena pañca dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame pañca?
rows.chinese_simplified: 315. 贤友们，有五法乃由彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵……为天人之义利、福祉、安乐。是哪五法？
rows.english: 315. Friends, there are indeed five dhammas well-proclaimed by that Blessed One—who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant in unison… for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of devas and humans. What are the five?

rows.pali: 323 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cha dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame cha?
rows.chinese_simplified: 323. 贤友，那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊善说了六法。于此，我们所有人都应一起合诵……乃至……为了天人的义利、利益与安乐。是哪六法？
rows.english: 323. Friends, there are six principles well-expounded by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Herein, all should chant together... for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of devas and humans. What are the six?

rows.pali: 330 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena satta dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame satta?
rows.chinese_simplified: 330. “贤友，有七法乃为彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵……为天与人之利益、福祉与安乐。是哪七法？”
rows.english: 330. There are, friends, seven qualities well proclaimed by the Blessed One—who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant in unison... for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans. What are the seven?

rows.pali: 333 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena aṭṭha dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame aṭṭha?
rows.chinese_simplified: 333. “贤友们，有八法，为彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵……为天与人之利益、福祉与安乐。是哪八法？”
rows.english: 333. Friends, there are eight qualities well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One; therein, all should recite in unison… for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans. What are these eight?

rows.pali: 340 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena nava dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame nava?
rows.chinese_simplified: 340. 贤友们，有九法乃由彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，汝等一切应合诵……为诸天与人之利益、福祉、安乐。云何为九？
rows.english: 340. There are, friends, nine qualities well-expounded by that Blessed One—the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. All should recite them together… for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of gods and humans. What are the nine?

rows.pali: 345 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame dasa?
rows.chinese_simplified: 345. 贤友，有十种法是那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊所善说的。于此，我们所有人都应合诵……为诸天与人的义利、利益与安乐。是哪十种呢？
rows.english: 345. “Friends, there are ten qualities well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together… for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans. What are the ten?

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso , bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti .
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是有一守护呢？贤友，于此，比丘具足由念守护之心。贤友，比丘如是有一守护。
rows.english: And how, friends, does a bhikkhu have a single guard? Here, friends, a bhikkhu is endowed with a mind guarded by mindfulness. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu has a single guard.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca sampadā – ñātisampadā, bhogasampadā, ārogyasampadā, sīlasampadā, diṭṭhisampadā. Nāvuso, sattā ñātisampadāhetu vā bhogasampadāhetu vā ārogyasampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti. Sīlasampadāhetu vā, āvuso, sattā diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五种圆满：亲属圆满、财富圆满、健康圆满、戒圆满、见圆满。贤友，众生不是因亲属圆满、财富圆满或健康圆满，而于身坏命终后，投生于善趣、天界。贤友，众生是因戒圆满或见圆满，而于身坏命终后，投生于善趣、天界。
rows.english: There are five accomplishments: accomplishment in relatives, accomplishment in wealth, accomplishment in health, accomplishment in virtue, and accomplishment in view. Friends, beings are not reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world, after the breakup of the body, after death, on account of an accomplishment in relatives, an accomplishment in wealth, or an accomplishment in health. But, friends, beings are reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world, after the breakup of the body, after death, on account of an accomplishment in virtue or an accomplishment in view.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino, seyyathāpi devā asaññasattā asaññisattā (syā. kaṃ.) . Ayaṃ pañcamo sattāvāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有些有情无想、无所觉受，如无想有情天(Asaññasattā)。此为第五有情居。
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who are non-percipient and non-experiencing, such as the non-percipient gods. This is the fifth abode of beings.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ, kammaṃ kho panāhaṃ karonto nāsakkhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… so vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ dutiyaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘已做完某项事务。他如此想：‘我做了事务，然而我做事务时，没能作意诸佛的教导。现在我当发起精进……’于是他发起精进……这是第二发起精进事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has done some work. He thinks: ‘I have done some work, but while doing it, I was unable to attend to the teaching of the Buddhas. Now, let me arouse energy…’ So he arouses energy… This is the second ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañcāvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhadrakaṃ bhaddakaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.) samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati – aṭṭhikasaññaṃ, puḷuvakasaññaṃ puḷavakasaññaṃ (sī. pī.) , vinīlakasaññaṃ, vicchiddakasaññaṃ, uddhumātakasaññaṃ. Idaṃ vuccatāvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，何为随护勤？贤友，于此，比丘守护已生起的善妙定相：骨想、虫食想、青瘀想、裂坏想、肿胀想。贤友，此谓随护勤。
rows.english: “And what, friends, is the striving of preservation? Here, friends, a monk preserves a good sign for concentration that has arisen—the perception of a skeleton, the perception of a worm-eaten corpse, the perception of a discolored corpse, the perception of a fissured corpse, the perception of a bloated corpse. This, friends, is called the striving of preservation.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ, maggaṃ kho panāhaṃ gacchanto nāsakkhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… so vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ catutthaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，有比丘已行路。他这样想：‘我已行路，然我行路时，未能作意诸佛的教导。那么，我当发起精进……’他便发起精进……这是第四发起精进之事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has made a journey. He thinks: ‘I have made a journey. While traveling, I was unable to attend to the teaching of the Buddhas. Now, let me arouse energy…’ So he arouses energy… This is the fourth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati lohitakāni lohitakavaṇṇāni lohitakanidassanāni lohitakanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma bandhujīvakapupphaṃ lohitakaṃ lohitakavaṇṇaṃ lohitakanidassanaṃ lohitakanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ lohitakaṃ lohitakavaṇṇaṃ lohitakanidassanaṃ lohitakanibhāsaṃ. Evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati lohitakāni lohitakavaṇṇāni lohitakanidassanāni lohitakanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ sattamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “某人于内无色想，外观诸赤色，其色赤、其相赤、其显赤、其光赤。犹如盘陀耆婆花(bandhujīvakapupphaṃ)，其色赤、其相赤、其显赤、其光赤；又如两面光洁的波罗奈衣，其色赤、其相赤、其显赤、其光赤。正是如此，某人于内无色想，外观诸赤色，其色赤、其相赤、其显赤、其光赤，他有‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见’之想。此为第七胜处。”
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—red, of red color, with a red appearance, and a red radiance. Just as a bandhujīvaka flower is red, of red color, with a red appearance, and a red radiance, or just as a Benares cloth, smoothed on both sides, is red, of red color, with a red appearance, and a red radiance; even so, not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—red, of red color, with a red appearance, and a red radiance. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the seventh sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro iddhipādā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Vīriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四神足。贤友们，于此，比丘修习以欲为首，具足定与精勤行的神足；修习以心为首，具足定与精勤行的神足；修习以精进为首，具足定与精勤行的神足；修习以观慧为首，具足定与精勤行的神足。
rows.english: There are four bases of spiritual power. Here, friends, a monk develops the basis of spiritual power that is endowed with concentration due to desire and the formations of striving. He develops the basis of spiritual power that is endowed with concentration due to mind and the formations of striving. He develops the basis of spiritual power that is endowed with concentration due to energy and the formations of striving. He develops the basis of spiritual power that is endowed with concentration due to investigation and the formations of striving.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena pañca dhammā sammadakkhātā; tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ saṅgitiyapañcakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) .
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者的世尊善说了这五法。于此，我们所有人都应一起合诵……乃至……为了天人的义利、利益与安乐。
rows.english: These, friends, are the five principles well expounded by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Herein, all should chant together... for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of devas and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘有善友，有善伴，倾向于善友。贤友，比丘有善友，有善伴，倾向于善友，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk has good friends, good companions, and is inclined towards good friends. Friends, that a monk has good friends, good companions, and is inclined towards good friends—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ. Evameva evamevaṃ (ka.) ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ pañcamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某一于内无色想者，外观青色，其色青、其相青、其光青。犹如亚麻花(umāpupphaṃ)，其色青、其相青、其光青；或如波罗奈布(bārāṇaseyyakaṃ)，两面光洁，其色青、其相青、其光青。正是如此，某一于内无色想者，外观青色，其色青、其相青、其光青，他有‘我已胜伏它们，我知，我见’之想。此为第五胜处。
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—blue, of blue color, with a blue appearance, and a blue radiance. Just as a flax flower is blue, of blue color, with a blue appearance, and a blue radiance, or just as a Benares cloth, smoothed on both sides, is blue, of blue color, with a blue appearance, and a blue radiance; even so, not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—blue, of blue color, with a blue appearance, and a blue radiance. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the fifth sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Codakena , āvuso, bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo. Kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacittena mettācittena (katthaci) vakkhāmi no dosantarenāti. Codakena, āvuso, bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，想要劝诫他人的比丘，应在自身建立五法后，才可劝诫他人：‘我将适时而说，非不适时；我将如实而说，非不如实；我将柔和而说，非粗暴；我将为利益而说，非为无益；我将以慈心而说，非怀嗔恨。’贤友，想要劝诫他人的比丘，应在自身建立这五法后，才可劝诫他人。
rows.english: Friends, a monk who wishes to admonish another should establish five qualities within himself before admonishing another: ‘I will speak at the right time, not at the wrong time; I will speak with what is true, not with what is untrue; I will speak gently, not harshly; I will speak with what is beneficial, not with what is unbeneficial; I will speak with a mind of loving-kindness, not with inner aversion.’ Friends, a monk who wishes to admonish another should establish these five qualities within himself before admonishing another.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati pītāni pītavaṇṇāni pītanidassanāni pītanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma kaṇikārapupphaṃ kaṇṇikārapupphaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) pītaṃ pītavaṇṇaṃ pītanidassanaṃ pītanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ pītaṃ pītavaṇṇaṃ pītanidassanaṃ pītanibhāsaṃ. Evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati pītāni pītavaṇṇāni pītanidassanāni pītanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某一于内无色想者，外观黄色，其色黄、其相黄、其光黄。犹如迦尼迦罗花(kaṇikārapupphaṃ)，其色黄、其相黄、其光黄；或如波罗奈布(bārāṇaseyyakaṃ)，两面光洁，其色黄、其相黄、其光黄。正是如此，某一于内无色想者，外观黄色，其色黄、其相黄、其光黄，他有‘我已胜伏它们，我知，我见’之想。此为第六胜处。
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—yellow, of yellow color, with a yellow appearance, and a yellow radiance. Just as a kaṇikāra flower is yellow, of yellow color, with a yellow appearance, and a yellow radiance, or just as a Benares cloth, smoothed on both sides, is yellow, of yellow color, with a yellow appearance, and a yellow radiance; even so, not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—yellow, of yellow color, with a yellow appearance, and a yellow radiance. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the sixth sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘maggo kho me gantabbo bhavissati, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. Handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… so vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ tatiyaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘应行路。他如此想：‘我将要行路，然而我行路时，不容易作意诸佛的教导。现在我当发起精进……’于是他发起精进……这是第三发起精进事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has a journey to make. He thinks: ‘I will have to make a journey, and while traveling, it will not be easy for me to attend to the teaching of the Buddhas. Now, let me arouse energy…’ So he arouses energy… This is the third ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma osadhitārakā odātā odātavaṇṇā odātanidassanā odātanibhāsā, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ odātaṃ odātavaṇṇaṃ odātanidassanaṃ odātanibhāsaṃ. Evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni , ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “某人于内无色想，外观诸白色，其色白、其相白、其显白、其光白。犹如启明星(osadhitārakā)，其色白、其相白、其显白、其光白；又如两面光洁的波罗奈衣，其色白、其相白、其显白、其光白。正是如此，某人于内无色想，外观诸白色，其色白、其相白、其显白、其光白，他有‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见’之想。此为第八胜处。”
rows.english: Not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—white, of white color, with a white appearance, and a white radiance. Just as the morning star is white, of white color, with a white appearance, and a white radiance, or just as a Benares cloth, smoothed on both sides, is white, of white color, with a white appearance, and a white radiance; even so, not perceiving form internally, a certain person sees external forms—white, of white color, with a white appearance, and a white radiance. He is one who perceives thus: ‘Having mastered them, I know, I see.’ This is the eighth sphere of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso , sattā sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma samatikkamma santametaṃ paṇītametanti (syā. kaṃ.) nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ navamo sattāvāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友们，有众生完全超越无所有处而到达非想非非想处。这是第九众生居。
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who, having completely transcended the sphere of nothingness, have reached the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. This is the ninth abode of beings.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是有四依止呢？贤友，于此，比丘审虑后受用一者，审虑后忍受一者，审虑后回避一者，审虑后去除一者。贤友，比丘如是为有四依止。
rows.english: And how, friends, does a bhikkhu have four supports? Here, friends, a bhikkhu, after reflection, makes use of one thing; after reflection, endures one thing; after reflection, avoids one thing; and after reflection, dispels one thing. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu has four supports.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappo hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmasaṅkappo pahīno hoti, byāpādasaṅkappo pahīno hoti, vihiṃsāsaṅkappo pahīno hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappo hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是思惟无浊者呢？贤友，于此，比丘的欲思惟已断除，嗔思惟已断除，害思惟已断除。贤友，比丘如是为思惟无浊者。
rows.english: And how, friends, does a bhikkhu have untroubled intentions? Here, friends, for a bhikkhu, sensual intention is abandoned, the intention of ill will is abandoned, and the intention of harming is abandoned. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu has untroubled intentions.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañcupādānakkhandhā. Rūpupādānakkhandho rūpūpādānakkhandho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) evamitaresupi vedanupādānakkhandho saññupādānakkhandho saṅkhārupādānakkhandho viññāṇupādānakkhandho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五取蕴：色取蕴、受取蕴、想取蕴、行取蕴、识取蕴。
rows.english: The five aggregates of clinging: the aggregate of form subject to clinging, the aggregate of feeling subject to clinging, the aggregate of perception subject to clinging, the aggregate of formations subject to clinging, the aggregate of consciousness subject to clinging.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha domanassūpavicārā. Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六种忧的审察。眼见色已，审察忧恼处之色……乃至……意知法已，审察忧恼处之法。
rows.english: Six investigations accompanied by displeasure. Having seen a form with the eye, one investigates a form that is a basis for displeasure... having cognized a mind-object with the mind, one investigates a mind-object that is a basis for displeasure.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… pettivisayaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ tatiyo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，……投生于饿鬼界。这是第三种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person is reborn in the realm of spirits. This is the third inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… asurakāyaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ catuttho akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，……投生于阿修罗众。这是第四种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person is reborn in the host of asuras. This is the fourth inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Vedanāsu vedanānupassī…pe… citte cittānupassī…pe… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四念处。贤友们，于此，比丘于身随观身而住，热诚、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧；于受随观受……于心随观心……于法随观法而住，热诚、正知、具念，调伏世间的贪与忧。
rows.english: Four foundations of mindfulness. Here, friends, a monk dwells contemplating the body in the body—ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful—having removed covetousness and displeasure with regard to the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings... mind in mind... phenomena in phenomena—ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful—having removed covetousness and displeasure with regard to the world.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri upādānāni – kāmupādānaṃ kāmūpādānaṃ (sī. pī.) evamitaresupi , diṭṭhupādānaṃ, sīlabbatupādānaṃ, attavādupādānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四取：欲取、见取、戒禁取、我论取。
rows.english: There are four kinds of clinging: clinging to sensual pleasures, clinging to views, clinging to rules and observances, and clinging to a doctrine of self.

rows.pali: 314 . ‘‘Cattāro puggalā. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo parantapo hoti paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo attantapo ca hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto. Idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo neva attantapo hoti na attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto. So anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sītibhūto (ka.) sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 314. “有四种人。贤友，于此，有一种人是自我折磨者，致力于自我折磨的修行。贤友，于此，有一种人是折磨他人者，致力于折磨他人的修行。贤友，于此，有一种人既是自我折磨者，致力于自我折磨的修行，也是折磨他人者，致力于折磨他人的修行。贤友，于此，有一种人既非自我折磨者，不致力于自我折磨的修行，也非折磨他人者，不致力于折磨他人的修行。他不折磨自己，不折磨他人，于现法中无渴爱、已寂灭、已清凉、感受乐，以梵化的自身安住。”
rows.english: 314. There are four persons. Here, friends, a certain person is a self-tormentor, devoted to the practice of self-torment. Here, friends, a certain person is a tormentor of others, devoted to the practice of tormenting others. Here, friends, a certain person is both a self-tormentor, devoted to the practice of self-torment, and a tormentor of others, devoted to the practice of tormenting others. Here, friends, a certain person is neither a self-tormentor, not devoted to the practice of self-torment, nor a tormentor of others, not devoted to the practice of tormenting others. He, being neither a self-tormentor nor a tormentor of others, in this very life is without craving, extinguished, cooled, and experiences bliss, abiding with a self that has become sublime.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca kāmaguṇā. Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajanīyā , sotaviññeyyā saddā… ghānaviññeyyā gandhā… jivhāviññeyyā rasā… kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajanīyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 五妙欲：眼所识之色，可欲、可爱、可意、悦人、引欲、可染；耳所识之声……鼻所识之香……舌所识之味……身所识之触，可欲、可爱、可意、悦人、引欲、可染。
rows.english: The five cords of sensual pleasure: forms cognizable by the eye that are desirable, agreeable, pleasing, endearing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing; sounds cognizable by the ear… odors cognizable by the nose… flavors cognizable by the tongue… tangibles cognizable by the body that are desirable, agreeable, pleasing, endearing, connected with sensual desire, and enticing.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañcāvuso, pahānapadhānaṃ? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti byantī karoti (syā. kaṃ.) anabhāvaṃ gameti. Uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ…pe… uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ… uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantiṃ karoti anabhāvaṃ gameti. Idaṃ vuccatāvuso, pahānapadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，何为断勤？贤友，于此，比丘不容忍已生起的欲寻，将其舍断、去除、终结，令其消失。不容忍已生起的恚寻……不容忍已生起的害寻……不容忍已生起的种种恶不善法，将其舍断、去除、终结，令其消失。贤友，此谓断勤。
rows.english: “And what, friends, is the striving of abandoning? Here, friends, a monk does not tolerate an arisen thought of sensual desire; he abandons it, dispels it, brings it to an end, causes it to go to non-existence. He does not tolerate an arisen thought of ill will… an arisen thought of cruelty… any arisen evil unwholesome states; he abandons them, dispels them, brings them to an end, causes them to go to non-existence. This, friends, is called the striving of abandoning.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri kammāni – atthāvuso, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ; atthāvuso, kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ; atthāvuso, kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ; atthāvuso, kammaṃ akaṇhaasukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四业。贤友，有黑业黑报；贤友，有白业白报；贤友，有黑白业黑白报；贤友，有非黑非白业、非黑非白报，导向业的灭尽。
rows.english: There are four kinds of kamma. Friends, there is dark kamma with a dark result; there is bright kamma with a bright result; there is dark and bright kamma with a dark and bright result; and there is kamma that is neither dark nor bright with a neither-dark-nor-bright result, which conduces to the destruction of kamma.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso , bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarehi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi . Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti…pe… parikkhārehi. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘满足于所得的任何衣、食、卧坐具、病缘医药资具。贤友，比丘满足于……资具，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is content with whatever robes, almsfood, lodging, and medicinal requisites for the sick he may receive. Friends, that a monk is content... with requisites—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso , bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti, bhavesanā pahīnā hoti, brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是已舍弃一切寻求者呢？贤友，于此，比丘的欲寻求已断除，有寻求已断除，梵行寻求已平息。贤友，比丘如是为已舍弃一切寻求者。
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one whose quests have been allayed? Here, friends, for a bhikkhu, the quest for sensual pleasures is abandoned, the quest for existence is abandoned, and the quest for the holy life is pacified. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu is one whose quests have been allayed.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是心善解脱者呢？贤友，于此，比丘的心已从贪解脱，心已从嗔解脱，心已从痴解脱。贤友，比丘如是为心善解脱者。
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu well-liberated in mind? Here, friends, a bhikkhu’s mind is liberated from lust, his mind is liberated from hatred, and his mind is liberated from delusion. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu is well-liberated in mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pahānārāmo hoti pahānarato, bhāvanārāmo hoti bhāvanārato; tāya ca pana pahānārāmatāya pahānaratiyā bhāvanārāmatāya bhāvanāratiyā nevattānukkaṃseti na paraṃ vambheti. Yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato ayaṃ vuccatāvuso – ‘bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito’.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘乐于断、喜于断，乐于修、喜于修；因其乐于断、喜于断，乐于修、喜于修，既不自赞，亦不毁他。贤友，凡于此娴熟、不懈怠、具正知、具正念者，此比丘被称为‘安住于古老、第一的圣种’。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk delights in abandoning and is devoted to abandoning; he delights in development and is devoted to development. And because of this delight in abandoning and devotion to abandoning, and this delight in development and devotion to development, he neither exalts himself nor disparages others. Whichever monk is skilled, not lazy, clearly comprehending, and mindful therein—this, friends, is called a monk who is established in the ancient, foremost noble lineage.”

rows.pali: 306 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame cattāro?
rows.chinese_simplified: 306. 贤友，有彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者、世尊所善说的四法。于此，我等一切众应共合诵，不应争论……为诸天人之义利、饶益、安乐。是哪四法？
rows.english: 306. Friends, there are four things that have been well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who is the knowing one, the seeing one, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together and not dispute... for the good, for the welfare, and for the happiness of gods and humans. What are the four?

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri dhammasamādānāni – atthāvuso, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañceva āyatiñca dukkhavipākaṃ. Atthāvuso, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhaṃ āyatiṃ sukhavipākaṃ. Atthāvuso, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ. Atthāvuso, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañceva āyatiñca sukhavipākaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有四种法的受持。贤友，有法的受持，现法苦而未来有苦报；贤友，有法的受持，现法苦而未来有乐报；贤友，有法的受持，现法乐而未来有苦报；贤友，有法的受持，现法乐而未来有乐报。
rows.english: There are four undertakings of Dhamma. Friends, there is an undertaking of Dhamma that is painful in the present and has a painful result in the future. Friends, there is an undertaking of Dhamma that is painful in the present but has a pleasant result in the future. Friends, there is an undertaking of Dhamma that is pleasant in the present but has a painful result in the future. Friends, there is an undertaking of Dhamma that is pleasant in the present and has a pleasant result in the future.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu suvaco hoti sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato khamo padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu suvaco hoti…pe… padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘易于教诫，具足使之易于教诫的法，堪忍，且恭敬地接受教诫。贤友，比丘易于教诫……且恭敬地接受教诫，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is easy to admonish, possesses qualities that make him easy to admonish, is patient, and respectfully accepts instruction. Friends, that a monk is easy to admonish... and respectfully accepts instruction—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tividhena rūpasaṅgaho – sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ sanidassanasappaṭigharūpaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) evamitaradvayepi , anidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassanaappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 色之三类：有见有对色、无见有对色、无见无对色。
rows.english: A threefold classification of material form: visible and resistant material form, invisible and resistant material form, and invisible and non-resistant material form.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena tayo dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ…pe… atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，此三法乃由彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者、世尊所善说。于此，我等一切众应共合诵……为诸天人之义利、饶益、安乐。
rows.english: Friends, these are the three things that have been well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who is the knowing one, the seeing one, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together... for the good, for the welfare, and for the happiness of gods and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri saṅgahavatthūni – dānaṃ, peyyavajjaṃ piyavajjaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.) , atthacariyā, samānattatā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四摄事（saṅgahavatthu）：布施、爱语、利行、同事。
rows.english: There are four grounds for fellowship: generosity, kind speech, beneficial conduct, and impartiality.

rows.pali: 322 . ‘‘Pañca vimuttāyatanāni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī. Yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī . Tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 322. 有五解脱处。贤友，于此，导师或某位值得尊敬的同梵行者为比丘说法。贤友，导师或某位值得尊敬的同梵行者怎样为比丘说法，他就怎样于彼法了知其义、了知其法。了知义、了知法的他生起欣悦；心欣悦者生起喜；意喜者名身轻安；名身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入定。此是第一解脱处。
rows.english: 322. There are five grounds for liberation. Here, friends, the Teacher teaches the Dhamma to a bhikkhu, or a fellow practitioner worthy of respect does. In whatever way, friends, the Teacher teaches the Dhamma to a bhikkhu, or a fellow practitioner worthy of respect does, in that same way he comes to experience the meaning and the Dhamma. For one who experiences the meaning and the Dhamma, gladness is born. For one who is gladdened, rapture is born. For one of rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One with a tranquil body experiences happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the first ground for liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu satimā hoti…pe… saritā anussaritā. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘有念，具足最高的念与慧，能忆持、随念很久以前所做、所说之事。贤友，比丘有念……能忆持、随念，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is mindful, endowed with supreme mindfulness and discernment, able to remember and recollect what was done and said long ago. Friends, that a monk is mindful... able to remember and recollect—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussāna’’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，此十法乃由彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，全体皆应合诵，不应争论，如是此梵行得以长时、久住，那将是为了众生的利益与安乐，为了怜悯世间，为了天人的义利、利益与安乐。
rows.english: These, friends, are the ten qualities well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who is the Knowing One, the Seeing One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One. Herein, all should chant in unison, without dispute, so that this holy life may be long-lasting and endure for a long time. This would be for the benefit of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha upekkhūpavicārā. Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ upekkhāṭhāniyaṃ (ka.) rūpaṃ upavicarati…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六种舍的审察。眼见色已，审察舍处之色……乃至……意知法已，审察舍处之法。
rows.english: Six investigations accompanied by equanimity. Having seen a form with the eye, one investigates a form that is a basis for equanimity... having cognized a mind-object with the mind, one investigates a mind-object that is a basis for equanimity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… aññataraṃ dīghāyukaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ pañcamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，……投生于某一长寿天众中。这是第五种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person is reborn in a certain long-lived host of gods. This is the fifth inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati…pe… anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘住于发起精进，为断除诸不善法、为具足诸善法，强健、坚固勇猛，于诸善法不舍弃重担。贤友，比丘住于发起精进……于诸善法不舍弃重担，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk dwells with energy aroused for the abandoning of unwholesome states and for the attainment of wholesome states; he is resolute, firm in his striving, and does not throw off the burden in regard to wholesome states. Friends, that a monk dwells with aroused energy... and does not throw off the burden in regard to wholesome states—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha sāraṇīyā dhammā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi āvī (ka. sī. pī. ka.) ceva raho ca. Ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六种可忆念法。贤友，在此，比丘对同梵行者，于公开及私下，皆现起慈身业。此法亦是可忆念的，能引生爱敬，导向摄受、无诤、和合与同一。
rows.english: Six states to be remembered. Here, friends, a bhikkhu's bodily action accompanied by loving-kindness is established towards his fellow monastics, both openly and in private. This dhamma is also one to be remembered, creating affection, creating respect, and conducing to cohesion, non-dispute, harmony, and unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Ayaṃ, āvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，修习、多作何种定，能导向正念正知呢？贤友，于此，比丘的受明了地生起，明了地现起，明了地灭去；想明了地生起，明了地现起，明了地灭去；寻明了地生起，明了地现起，明了地灭去。贤友，此即是修习、多作而能导向正念正知的定。
rows.english: And what, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to mindfulness and clear comprehension? Here, friends, for a monk, feelings arise known, are present known, and cease known. Perceptions arise known, are present known, and cease known. Thoughts arise known, are present known, and cease known. This, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to mindfulness and clear comprehension.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno vihesaṃ manasikaroto vihesāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Avihesaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto avihesāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ vihesāya. Ye ca vihesāpaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ vihesāya nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘作意伤害时，心不趣入、不澄净、不安住、不倾向于伤害。而当他作意无伤害时，心则趣入、澄净、安住、倾向于无伤害。他的那心是善至、善修、善起、善解脱，与伤害不相应。凡缘于伤害而生的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从中解脱，他不再感受那种受。这被称为伤害的出离。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to vexation, his mind does not enter into vexation, does not become serene, is not established, and is not released. But when he attends to non-vexation, his mind enters into non-vexation, becomes serene, is established, and is released. That mind of his is well-gone, well-developed, well-risen, well-freed from vexation, and disassociated from vexation. And whatever taints, distress, and torments arise on account of vexation, he is freed from them; he does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from vexation.

rows.pali: 312 . ‘‘Cattāri pañhabyākaraṇāni – cattāro pañhābyākaraṇā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho, ṭhapanīyo pañho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 312. 四记说：一向记说、反诘记说、分别记说、舍置记说。
rows.english: 312. There are four ways of answering questions: a question to be answered categorically, a question to be answered by questioning in return, a question to be answered analytically, and a question to be set aside.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti, udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti…pe… sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘有慧，具足了知生灭、圣、能摧破、正导向苦尽的智慧。贤友，比丘有慧……具足正导向苦尽的智慧，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is wise, endowed with wisdom concerning arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and leads rightly to the complete destruction of suffering. Friends, that a bhikkhu is wise, endowed with wisdom concerning arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and leads rightly to the complete destruction of suffering—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thinamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是舍断五支呢？贤友，于此，比丘的欲贪已断，嗔恚已断，昏沉睡眠已断，掉举追悔已断，疑已断。贤友，比丘如是舍断五支。
rows.english: And how, friends, has a bhikkhu abandoned five factors? Here, friends, for a bhikkhu, sensual desire is abandoned, ill will is abandoned, sloth and torpor are abandoned, restlessness and remorse are abandoned, and doubt is abandoned. In this way, friends, a bhikkhu has abandoned five factors.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno byāpādaṃ manasikaroto byāpāde cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Abyāpādaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto abyāpāde cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ byāpādena. Ye ca byāpādapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘作意嗔恚时，心不趣入、不澄净、不安住、不倾向于嗔恚。而当他作意无嗔时，心则趣入、澄净、安住、倾向于无嗔。他的那心是善至、善修、善起、善解脱，与嗔恚不相应。凡缘于嗔恚而生的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从中解脱，他不再感受那种受。这被称为嗔恚的出离。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to ill will, his mind does not leap forward into ill will, does not become serene, is not established, and is not liberated. But when he attends to non-ill will, his mind leaps forward into non-ill will, becomes serene, is established, and is liberated. His mind is thus well-gone, well-developed, well-risen, well-liberated, and disjoined from ill will. And whatever taints, distresses, and torments arise on account of ill will, he is freed from them; he does not experience that feeling. This is declared as the escape from ill will.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno rūpe manasikaroto rūpesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Arūpaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto arūpe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ rūpehi. Ye ca rūpapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘作意色时，其心不跃入、不澄净、不安住、不倾信于色。而当他作意无色时，其心则跃入、澄净、安住、倾信于无色。他的那颗心是善行、善修、善起、善解脱、与诸色不相应的。凡缘于色而生的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从中解脱，他不再感受那种感受。这被称为诸色的出离。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to form, his mind does not enter into forms, does not become serene, is not established, and is not released. But when he attends to the immaterial, his mind enters into the immaterial, becomes serene, is established, and is released. That mind of his is well-gone, well-developed, well-risen, well-freed from forms, and disassociated from forms. And whatever taints, distress, and torments arise on account of form, he is freed from them; he does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from forms.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno sakkāyaṃ manasikaroto sakkāye cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Sakkāyanirodhaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ sakkāyena. Ye ca sakkāyapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ sakkāyassa nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘作意有身时，其心不跃入、不澄净、不安住、不倾信于有身。而当他作意有身灭时，其心则跃入、澄净、安住、倾信于有身灭。他的那颗心是善行、善修、善起、善解脱、与有身不相应的。凡缘于有身而生的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从中解脱，他不再感受那种感受。这被称为有身的出离。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to embodied identity, his mind does not enter into embodied identity, does not become serene, is not established, and is not released. But when he attends to the cessation of embodied identity, his mind enters into the cessation of embodied identity, becomes serene, is established, and is released. That mind of his is well-gone, well-developed, well-risen, well-freed from embodied identity, and disassociated from embodied identity. And whatever taints, distress, and torments arise on account of embodied identity, he is freed from them; he does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from embodied identity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gilānā vuṭṭhito gilānavuṭṭhito (saddanīti) a. ni. 6.16 nakulapitusuttaṭīkā passitabbā hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā, tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，再者，有比丘病愈未久。他如此想：‘我病愈未久，身体虚弱，不堪作业。现在我该躺下了！’于是他便躺下，不为到达未达、证得未证、现证未现证而发起精进。此为第八懈怠事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has recovered from an illness, having recently recovered from his affliction. He thinks: ‘I have recovered from an illness, having recently recovered from my affliction. My body is weak and unfit for work. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy for attaining the unattained, for achieving the unachieved, for realizing the unrealized. This is the eighth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: 346 . Dasa kasiṇāyatanāni. Pathavīkasiṇameko sañjānāti, uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. Āpokasiṇameko sañjānāti…pe… tejokasiṇameko sañjānāti… vāyokasiṇameko sañjānāti… nīlakasiṇameko sañjānāti… pītakasiṇameko sañjānāti… lohitakasiṇameko sañjānāti… odātakasiṇameko sañjānāti… ākāsakasiṇameko sañjānāti… viññāṇakasiṇameko sañjānāti, uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 346. 十种遍处。有人了知地遍，上、下、横，无二、无量。有人了知水遍……乃至……有人了知火遍……有人了知风遍……有人了知青遍……有人了知黄遍……有人了知赤遍……有人了知白遍……有人了知空遍……有人了知识遍，上、下、横，无二、无量。
rows.english: 346. The ten kasiṇa-bases. One perceives the earth-kasiṇa: above, below, across, non-dual, immeasurable. One perceives the water-kasiṇa... one perceives the fire-kasiṇa... one perceives the wind-kasiṇa... one perceives the blue-kasiṇa... one perceives the yellow-kasiṇa... one perceives the red-kasiṇa... one perceives the white-kasiṇa... one perceives the space-kasiṇa... one perceives the consciousness-kasiṇa: above, below, across, non-dual, immeasurable.

rows.pali: 300 . Atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu pāveyyakesu mallesu tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ anuviloketvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘vigatathinamiddho vigatathīnamiddho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) kho, sāriputta, bhikkhusaṅgho. Paṭibhātu taṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammīkathā. Piṭṭhi me āgilāyati. Tamahaṃ āyamissāmī’’ti āyameyyāmīti (syā. kaṃ.) . ‘‘Evaṃ, bhante’’ti kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato paccassosi. Atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 300. 那时，帕维亚的末罗人离去不久，世尊环顾寂静的比丘僧团后，对具寿舍利弗说：‘舍利弗，比丘僧团已远离昏沉与睡眠。舍利弗，愿你为比丘们开示法要。我的背痛，我将伸展一下。’‘是的，世尊。’具寿舍利弗回答世尊。于是，世尊将僧伽梨衣叠成四叠铺好，右胁而卧，行狮子卧，一足叠于另一足上，保持正念正知，作意于起身之想。
rows.english: 300. Then, not long after the Mallas of Pāvā had departed, the Blessed One, having surveyed the silent Saṅgha of monks, addressed the Venerable Sāriputta: “Sāriputta, the Saṅgha of monks is free from sloth and torpor. Let a talk on the Dhamma occur to you, Sāriputta, for the monks. My back is tired; I shall stretch it.” “So be it, Venerable Sir,” the Venerable Sāriputta replied to the Blessed One. Then the Blessed One, having folded his outer robe in four, lay down on his right side in the lion's posture, placing one foot slightly over the other, mindful and fully aware, establishing in his mind the perception of rising.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso kāmūpapattiyo kāmuppattiyo (sī.), kāmupapattiyo (syā. pī. ka.) – santāvuso sattā paccupaṭṭhitakāmā, te paccupaṭṭhitesu kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā. Ayaṃ paṭhamā kāmūpapatti. Santāvuso, sattā nimmitakāmā, te nimminitvā nimminitvā kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti, seyyathāpi devā nimmānaratī. Ayaṃ dutiyā kāmūpapatti. Santāvuso sattā paranimmitakāmā, te paranimmitesu kāmesu vasaṃ vattenti, seyyathāpi devā paranimmitavasavattī. Ayaṃ tatiyā kāmūpapatti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有三种欲受用。贤友，有诸众生受用现前之欲，彼等于现前之欲行使自在，犹如人、某些天及某些堕恶趣者。此是第一种欲受用。贤友，有诸众生受用自所化作之欲，彼等化作复化作，于诸欲中行使自在，犹如化乐天(Nimmānaratī)之天神。此是第二种欲受用。贤友，有诸众生受用他所化作之欲，彼等于他所化作之欲行使自在，犹如他化自在天(Paranimmitavasavattī)之天神。此是第三种欲受用。”
rows.english: Three kinds of attainment of sensual pleasures: Friends, there are beings for whom sensual pleasures are readily available, and they wield power over these readily available sensual pleasures. Such are human beings, some devas, and some beings in states of deprivation. This is the first kind of attainment of sensual pleasures. Friends, there are beings who create sensual pleasures, and having created them again and again, they wield power over those sensual pleasures. Such are the devas who delight in creation. This is the second kind of attainment of sensual pleasures. Friends, there are beings who wield power over sensual pleasures created by others. Such are the devas who wield power over the creations of others. This is the third kind of attainment of sensual pleasures.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri jhānāni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti – ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā, adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) upasampajja viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 有四种禅。贤友，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，具足并安住于初禅：有寻、有伺，由远离而生喜乐。寻、伺止息故，内得净信，心一境性，无寻、无伺，由定而生喜乐，具足并安住于第二禅。又，离喜故，安住于舍，具念、正知，以身感受乐——圣者们称之为‘具舍、具念、乐住者’——具足并安住于第三禅。断乐、断苦故，以及先前喜、忧已灭故，不苦不乐，舍念清净，具足并安住于第四禅。
rows.english: There are four jhānas. Here, friends, a monk—quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states—enters and dwells in the first jhāna, which has applied and sustained thought, with rapture and pleasure born of seclusion. With the stilling of applied and sustained thought, he enters and dwells in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, without applied and sustained thought, with rapture and pleasure born of concentration. With the fading away of rapture, he dwells equanimously, mindful and clearly comprehending, and experiences pleasure with the body—that of which the noble ones declare, ‘Equanimous and mindful, he dwells in pleasure’—and so he enters and dwells in the third jhāna. With the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous passing away of joy and grief, he enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither painful nor pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity.

rows.pali: 304 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dve dhammā sammadakkhātā.
