Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katame dve dve dhammo (syā. kaṃ.) evamuparipi ?
rows.chinese_simplified: 304. 贤友，那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊，已善说二法。于此，我等皆应合诵，不应争论，如是此梵行方能长时久住，此是为了众人的利益与安乐，为了对世间的怜悯，为了天与人的义利、利益与安乐。是哪二法？
rows.english: 304. Friends, there are two Dhammas well-proclaimed by that Blessed One—the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together and not dispute, so that this holy life may be long-lasting and endure for a long time. That would be for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans. What are the two?

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamañcāvuso , bhāvanāpadhānaṃ? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. Dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. Idaṃ vuccatāvuso, bhāvanāpadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，何为修习勤？贤友，于此，比丘修习念觉支，其依止远离、依止离贪、依止灭，导向舍离。他修习择法觉支……修习精进觉支……修习喜觉支……修习轻安觉支……修习定觉支……修习舍觉支，其依止远离、依止离贪、依止灭，导向舍离。贤友，此谓修习勤。
rows.english: “And what, friends, is the striving of development? Here, friends, a monk develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, which is based on seclusion, based on dispassion, based on cessation, culminating in relinquishment. He develops the enlightenment factor of investigation of phenomena… he develops the enlightenment factor of energy… he develops the enlightenment factor of rapture… he develops the enlightenment factor of tranquility… he develops the enlightenment factor of concentration… he develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based on seclusion, based on dispassion, based on cessation, culminating in relinquishment. This, friends, is called the striving of development.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Nava āghātavatthūni. ‘Anatthaṃ me acarī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati; ‘anatthaṃ me caratī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati; ‘anatthaṃ me carissatī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati; ‘piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acarī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… anatthaṃ caratīti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… anatthaṃ carissatīti āghātaṃ bandhati; ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acarī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… atthaṃ caratīti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… atthaṃ carissatīti āghātaṃ bandhati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 九种怨恨事：‘他曾对我行无益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他正对我行无益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他将对我行无益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他曾对我喜爱、称意之人行无益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他正对我喜爱、称意之人行无益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他将对我喜爱、称意之人行无益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他曾对我所不喜爱、不称意之人行有益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他正对我所不喜爱、不称意之人行有益之事’，便结怨恨；‘他将对我所不喜爱、不称意之人行有益之事’，便结怨恨。
rows.english: Nine grounds for resentment. One harbors resentment, thinking: ‘He has done me harm.’ One harbors resentment, thinking: ‘He is doing me harm.’ One harbors resentment, thinking: ‘He will do me harm.’ One harbors resentment, thinking: ‘He has done harm to a person dear and beloved to me.’… ‘He is doing harm to a person dear and beloved to me.’… ‘He will do harm to a person dear and beloved to me.’ One harbors resentment, thinking: ‘He has benefited a person not dear and unloved by me.’… ‘He is benefiting a person not dear and unloved by me.’… ‘He will benefit a person not dear and unloved by me.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Nava āghātapaṭivinayā. ‘Anatthaṃ me acari acarīti (syā. ka.) evaṃ ‘‘carati carissati’’ padesupi , taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti ; ‘anatthaṃ me carati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘anatthaṃ me carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari…pe… anatthaṃ carati…pe… anatthaṃ carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari…pe… atthaṃ carati…pe… atthaṃ carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 九种调伏怨恨：‘他曾对我行不利之事，于此何可得？’，如是调伏怨恨；‘他正对我行不利之事，于此何可得？’，如是调伏怨恨；‘他将对我行不利之事，于此何可得？’，如是调伏怨恨；‘他曾对我喜爱、悦意之人行不利之事……他正行不利之事……他将行不利之事，于此何可得？’，如是调伏怨恨；‘他曾对我所不喜爱、不悦意之人行利益之事……他正行利益之事……他将行利益之事，于此何可得？’，如是调伏怨恨。
rows.english: Nine removals of resentment. One removes resentment, thinking: ‘He has done me harm—but how could it have been otherwise?’ One removes resentment, thinking: ‘He is doing me harm—but how could it be otherwise?’ One removes resentment, thinking: ‘He will do me harm—but how could it be otherwise?’ One removes resentment, thinking: ‘He has done harm to a person dear and beloved to me… is doing harm… will do harm—but how could it have been otherwise?’ One removes resentment, thinking: ‘He has benefited a person not dear and unloved by me… is benefiting… will benefit—but how could it have been otherwise?’

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato, alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ…pe… alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对于同梵行者们的种种大小事务，是熟练而不懈怠的，具足于此善巧的审察力，能够亲自执行、能够安排办理。贤友，比丘对于同梵行者们的……能够安排办理，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, regarding the various duties, high and low, for his companions in the holy life, a monk is skilled, not lazy, endowed with investigation into the means thereto, capable of doing them, and capable of arranging for them to be done. Friends, that a monk, regarding the various duties for his companions in the holy life... is capable of arranging for them to be done—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: 303 . ‘‘Atthi kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena eko dhammo sammadakkhāto. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ , tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ. Katamo eko dhammo? Sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā. Sabbe sattā saṅkhāraṭṭhitikā. Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena eko dhammo sammadakkhāto. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ , yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 303. 贤友，那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊，已善说一法。于此，我等皆应合诵，不应争论，如是此梵行方能长时久住，此是为了众人的利益与安乐，为了对世间的怜悯，为了天与人的义利、利益与安乐。何为一法？一切有情依食而住，一切有情依行而住。贤友，此即那位知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说之一法。于此，我等皆应合诵，不应争论，如是此梵行方能长时久住，此是为了众人的利益与安乐，为了对世间的怜悯，为了天与人的义利、利益与安乐。
rows.english: 303. Friends, there is one Dhamma well-proclaimed by that Blessed One—the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together and not dispute, so that this holy life may be long-lasting and endure for a long time. That would be for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans. What is that one Dhamma? All beings are sustained by nutriment; all beings are sustained by formations. This, friends, is that one Dhamma well-proclaimed by that Blessed One—the Knower, the Seer, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant together and not dispute, so that this holy life may be long-lasting and endure for a long time. That would be for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ, āvuso , samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，是哪种定的修习，修习、多修习之，能导向现法乐住呢？贤友，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法……乃至……具足并安住于第四禅。贤友，此即是定的修习，修习、多修习之，能导向现法乐住。
rows.english: And which, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to a pleasant abiding in the present life? Here, friends, a monk—quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states... enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna. This, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to a pleasant abiding in the present life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi ceva raho ca. Ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对同梵行者，于公开及私下，皆现起慈语业。此法亦是可忆念的……乃至……导向同一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu's verbal action accompanied by loving-kindness is established towards his fellow monastics, both openly and in private. This dhamma is also one to be remembered... conducing to unity.

rows.pali: 331 . ‘‘Satta niddasavatthūni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca sikkhāsamādāne avigatapemo. Dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca dhammanisantiyā avigatapemo. Icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca icchāvinaye avigatapemo. Paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca paṭisallāne avigatapemo. Vīriyārambhe tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca vīriyārambhe avigatapemo. Satinepakke tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca satinepakke avigatapemo . Diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 331. “七可称誉事：贤友们，于此，比丘于受持学处有强烈的意乐，且对未来受持学处不失爱乐；于审察法有强烈的意乐，且对未来审察法不失爱乐；于调伏欲有强烈的意乐，且对未来调伏欲不失爱乐；于独住有强烈的意乐，且对未来独住不失爱乐；于发起精进有强烈的意乐，且对未来发起精进不失爱乐；于念与慧有强烈的意乐，且对未来念与慧不失爱乐；于通达见有强烈的意乐，且对未来通达见不失爱乐。”
rows.english: 331. Seven grounds for commendation: Here, friends, a bhikkhu has a strong desire for undertaking the training, and in the future has undiminished affection for undertaking the training. He has a strong desire for investigating the Dhamma, and in the future has undiminished affection for investigating the Dhamma. He has a strong desire for the removal of craving, and in the future has undiminished affection for the removal of craving. He has a strong desire for seclusion, and in the future has undiminished affection for seclusion. He has a strong desire for arousing energy, and in the future has undiminished affection for arousing energy. He has a strong desire for mindfulness and prudence, and in the future has undiminished affection for mindfulness and prudence. He has a strong desire for the penetration of right view, and in the future has undiminished affection for the penetration of right view.

rows.pali: 336 . ‘‘Aṭṭha dānavatthūni. Āsajja dānaṃ deti, bhayā dānaṃ deti, ‘adāsi me’ti dānaṃ deti, ‘dassati me’ti dānaṃ deti, ‘sāhu dāna’nti dānaṃ deti, ‘ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, nārahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ na dātu’nti dānaṃ deti, ‘idaṃ me dānaṃ dadato kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchatī’ti dānaṃ deti. Cittālaṅkāra-cittaparikkhāratthaṃ dānaṃ deti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 336. 八种布施之因：因来访而布施，因恐惧而布施，因‘他曾给我’而布施，因‘他将会给我’而布施，因‘布施是善’而布施，因‘我烹煮，他们不烹煮，我作为烹煮者，不布施给不烹煮者是不合宜的’而布施，因‘我作此布施时，美好的名声将远扬’而布施，为定心与观心之庄严与资具而布施。
rows.english: 336. There are eight grounds for giving. One gives a gift upon being approached. One gives a gift out of fear. One gives a gift thinking, ‘He gave to me.’ One gives a gift thinking, ‘He will give to me.’ One gives a gift thinking, ‘Giving is good.’ One gives a gift thinking, ‘I cook, but these others do not cook; it is not proper for me, who cooks, not to give to those who do not cook.’ One gives a gift thinking, ‘By giving this gift, a good report of my fame will spread.’ One gives a gift for the adornment and equipment of the mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tīṇi tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni – parisuddhakāyasamācāro āvuso tathāgato, natthi tathāgatassa kāyaduccaritaṃ, yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya – ‘mā me idaṃ paro aññāsī’ti. Parisuddhavacīsamācāro āvuso, tathāgato, natthi tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ, yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya – ‘mā me idaṃ paro aññāsī’ti. Parisuddhamanosamācāro, āvuso, tathāgato, natthi tathāgatassa manoduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya – ‘mā me idaṃ paro aññāsī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如来之三不护：贤友，如来身行清净，如来无有‘莫令他人知我此事’而需守护的身恶行。贤友，如来语行清净，如来无有‘莫令他人知我此事’而需守护的语恶行。贤友，如来意行清净，如来无有‘莫令他人知我此事’而需守护的意恶行。
rows.english: Three things the Tathāgata has no need to guard: Friends, the Tathāgata is of purified bodily conduct; there is no bodily misconduct of the Tathāgata that he would need to guard, thinking, ‘May no one else know this of me.’ Friends, the Tathāgata is of purified verbal conduct; there is no verbal misconduct of the Tathāgata that he would need to guard, thinking, ‘May no one else know this of me.’ Friends, the Tathāgata is of purified mental conduct; there is no mental misconduct of the Tathāgata that he would need to guard, thinking, ‘May no one else know this of me.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu ‘rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo’ti pajānāti. ‘Doso me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo’ti pajānāti. ‘Moho me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo’ti pajānāti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是慧善解脱者呢？贤友，于此，比丘了知：‘我的贪已被舍断，根已被切断，如断头多罗树，已成不有，于未来为不生之法。’了知：‘我的嗔已被舍断，根已被切断，如断头多罗树，已成不有，于未来为不生之法。’了知：‘我的痴已被舍断，根已被切断，如断头多罗树，已成不有，于未来为不生之法。’贤友，比丘如是为慧善解脱者。
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu well-liberated in wisdom? Here, friends, a bhikkhu understands thus: ‘My lust is abandoned, its root has been cut off, it has been made like a palm stump, brought to a state of non-existence, and is of a nature not to arise in the future.’ He understands thus: ‘My hatred is abandoned...’ He understands thus: ‘My delusion is abandoned, its root has been cut off, it has been made like a palm stump, brought to a state of non-existence, and is of a nature not to arise in the future.’ It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu is well-liberated in wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati. Iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo. Iti vedanā…pe… iti saññā… iti saṅkhārā… iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo. Ayaṃ, āvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，修习、多作何种定，能导向诸漏灭尽呢？贤友，于此，比丘于五取蕴随观生灭而住：‘此是色，此是色之集起，此是色之灭去；此是受……此是想……此是行……此是识，此是识之集起，此是识之灭去。’贤友，此即是修习、多作而能导向诸漏灭尽的定。
rows.english: And what, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to the destruction of the taints? Here, friends, a monk dwells contemplating rise and fall in the five aggregates of clinging: ‘Such is form, such its arising, such its passing away. Such is feeling… such is perception… such are formations… such is consciousness, such its arising, such its passing away.’ This, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to the destruction of the taints.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ appamattako ābādho; atthi kappo nipajjituṃ, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ sattamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘生起轻微的疾病。他这样想：‘我生起了这轻微的疾病，正好适合躺下，我还是躺下吧！’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第七懈怠事。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a minor illness has arisen in a bhikkhu. He thinks: ‘This minor illness has arisen in me; it is suitable to lie down. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the seventh ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri ñāṇāni – dhamme ñāṇaṃ, anvaye ñāṇaṃ, pariye paricce (sī. ka.), paricchede (syā. pī. ka.) ṭīkā oloketabbā ñāṇaṃ, sammutiyā ñāṇaṃ sammatiñāṇaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) .
rows.chinese_simplified: 四种智：法智、类智、他心智、世俗智。
rows.english: “There are four knowledges: knowledge in the Dhamma, knowledge in what follows, knowledge in comprehending others' minds, and knowledge in convention.”

rows.pali: 310 . ‘‘Cattāri padhānāni. Saṃvarapadhānaṃ pahānapadhānaṃ bhāvanāpadhānaṃ bhāvanāppadhānaṃ (syā.) anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ anurakkhanāppadhānaṃ (syā.) . Katamañcāvuso, saṃvarapadhānaṃ? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī. Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati. Idaṃ vuccatāvuso, saṃvarapadhānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 310. 有四正勤：律仪勤、断勤、修勤、随护勤。贤友，何为律仪勤？贤友，于此，比丘以眼见色时，不取相，不取随相。若他于眼根不防护而住，贪与忧等恶不善法即会流入，故他为防护而行道，守护眼根，于眼根达成防护。以耳闻声……以鼻嗅香……以舌尝味……以身触所触……以意知法时，不取相，不取随相。若他于意根不防护而住，贪与忧等恶不善法即会流入，故他为防护而行道，守护意根，于意根达成防护。贤友，此谓律仪勤。
rows.english: 310. “There are four strivings: the striving of restraint, the striving of abandoning, the striving of development, and the striving of preservation. And what, friends, is the striving of restraint? Here, friends, a monk, having seen a form with the eye, does not grasp at its signs or features. In consequence of which, were he to dwell with the eye-faculty unrestrained, evil, unwholesome states of covetousness and displeasure might assail him; therefore, he practices for its restraint, he guards the eye-faculty, he undertakes the restraint of the eye-faculty. Having heard a sound with the ear… having smelled an odor with the nose… having tasted a flavor with the tongue… having felt a tactile object with the body… having cognized a mental object with the mind, he does not grasp at its signs or features. In consequence of which, were he to dwell with the mind-faculty unrestrained, evil, unwholesome states of covetousness and displeasure might assail him; therefore, he practices for its restraint, he guards the mind-faculty, he undertakes the restraint of the mind-faculty. This, friends, is called the striving of restraint.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno na heva kho satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti…pe… api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti…pe… api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati…pe… api ca khvassa aññataraṃ samādhinimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya. Yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhuno aññataraṃ samādhinimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti , sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ pañcamaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，并非导师或某位尊长同梵行者为比丘说法，而是他将所听闻、所受持的法为他人详细解说……乃至……或者他将所听闻、所受持的法详细地诵读……乃至……或者他将所听闻、所受持的法用心思惟、审察、以意随观……乃至……或者，某个定相被他善取、善作意、善省察、以慧善通达。贤友，比丘越是善取、善作意、善省察、以慧善通达某个定相，他就越能于其法了知义、了知法。他了知义、了知法，便生起喜悦；喜悦者生起欢喜；心怀欢喜者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；有乐者心入于定。这是第五解脱处。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, the Teacher does not teach the Dhamma to a bhikkhu, nor does a respected fellow practitioner... but he teaches the Dhamma in detail to others as he has heard and learned it... or he recites the Dhamma in detail as he has heard and learned it... or he reflects on, considers, and mentally examines the Dhamma as he has heard and learned it... or a certain sign of concentration has been well-grasped by him, well-attended to, well-considered, and well-penetrated with wisdom. In whatever way, friends, a certain sign of concentration has been well-grasped by the bhikkhu, well-attended to, well-considered, and well-penetrated with wisdom, in that same way he comes to experience the meaning and the Dhamma. For one who experiences the meaning and the Dhamma, gladness is born. For one who is gladdened, rapture is born. For one of rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One with a tranquil body experiences happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the fifth ground for liberation.

rows.pali: 296 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena pāvā nāma mallānaṃ nagaraṃ tadavasari. Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane.
rows.chinese_simplified: 296. 如是我闻。一时，世尊与大比丘僧团，约五百人，于末罗国(Mallesu)游行，抵达末罗人名为波婆(Pāvā)的城市。尔时，世尊住于波婆，金匠之子纯陀的芒果园中。
rows.english: 296. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One, while wandering on tour among the Mallas with a great Saṅgha of monks, with five hundred monks, arrived at the city of the Mallas named Pāvā. There the Blessed One was dwelling in Pāvā, in the mango grove of Cunda the smith's son.

rows.pali: 321 . ‘‘Pañca nissaraṇiyā nissāraṇīyā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) ṭīkā oloketabbā dhātuyo. Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāme manasikaroto kāmesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Nekkhammaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ kāmehi. Ye ca kāmapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā vighātapariḷāhā (syā. kaṃ.) , mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ kāmānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 321. 贤友，有五种出离界。于此，比丘作意诸欲时，心不趣入、不澄净、不安住、不倾向于诸欲。而当他作意出离时，心则趣入、澄净、安住、倾向于出离。他的那心是善至、善修、善起、善解脱，与诸欲不相应。凡缘于欲而生的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从中解脱，他不再感受那种受。这被称为诸欲的出离。
rows.english: 321. There are five elements of escape. Here, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to sensual pleasures, his mind does not leap forward into sensual pleasures, does not become serene, does not become established, and is not liberated. But when he attends to renunciation, his mind leaps forward into renunciation, becomes serene, becomes established, and is liberated. His mind is thus well-gone, well-developed, well-risen, well-liberated, and disjoined from sensual pleasures. And whatever taints, distresses, and torments arise on account of sensual pleasures, he is freed from them; he does not experience that feeling. This is declared as the escape from sensual pleasures.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro, abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo uḷārapāmujjo (sī. pī.), oḷārapāmojjo (syā. kaṃ.) . Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti…pe… uḷārapāmojjo uḷārapāmujjo (sī. pī.), oḷārapāmojjo (syā. kaṃ.) . Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘喜爱法，言谈令人愉悦，于阿毗达摩与胜律有大欢喜。贤友，比丘喜爱法……有大欢喜，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is a lover of the Dhamma, one who speaks in a pleasing manner, and has great joy in the higher Dhamma and the higher Vinaya. Friends, that a monk is a lover of the Dhamma... and has great joy—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti ? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是身行已寂止者呢？贤友，于此，比丘因舍断乐、舍断苦，以及先前喜、忧已灭没，进入并住于不苦不乐、舍念清净的第四禅。贤友，比丘如是为身行已寂止者。
rows.english: And how, friends, does a bhikkhu have tranquil bodily formation? Here, friends, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous passing away of joy and sorrow, a bhikkhu enters and abides in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu has tranquil bodily formation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu makkhī hoti paḷāsī…pe… issukī hoti maccharī…pe… saṭho hoti māyāvī… pāpiccho hoti micchādiṭṭhī… sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī…pe… yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī, so sattharipi agāravo viharati appatisso, dhammepi agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghepi agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāyapi na paripūrakārī hoti. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso , sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṃ janeti. Yo hoti vivādo bahujanaahitāya bahujanaasukhāya anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ. Evarūpaṃ ce tumhe, āvuso, vivādamūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, āvuso, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānāya vāyameyyātha. Evarūpaṃ ce tumhe, āvuso, vivādamūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā na samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, āvuso, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavāya paṭipajjeyyātha. Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānaṃ hoti. Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavo hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘是抹煞他人功德者、好胜者……是嫉妒者、吝啬者……是奸诈者、虚伪者……是恶欲者、邪见者……是固执己见者、执取不放者、难以舍弃者……贤友，凡是固执己见、执取不放、难以舍弃的比丘，他对导师不敬、不顺从地住，对法不敬、不顺从地住，对僧团不敬、不顺从地住，于学也不圆满奉行。贤友，凡是对导师不敬、不顺从地住，对法不敬、不顺从地住，对僧团不敬、不顺从地住，于学不圆满奉行的比丘，他在僧团中制造争论。那争论为众多人带来不利、不乐，为天人带来无益、不利与痛苦。贤友，你们若于内或于外见到这样的争论之根，你们就应为断除那邪恶的争论之根而努力。贤友，你们若于内或于外未见到这样的争论之根，你们就应为那邪恶的争论之根将来不流入而行道。这样，这邪恶的争论之根就被断除；这样，这邪恶的争论之根将来就不会流入。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is disparaging and rivalrous… is envious and stingy… is crafty and deceitful… has evil desires… clings to his own views, holds to them tenaciously, and relinquishes them with difficulty. That bhikkhu, friends, who clings to his own views, holds to them tenaciously, and relinquishes them with difficulty, dwells without reverence or deference toward the Teacher, the Dhamma, and the Saṅgha, and does not fulfill the training. That bhikkhu, friends, who dwells without reverence or deference toward the Teacher, the Dhamma, and the Saṅgha, and does not fulfill the training, creates disputes in the Saṅgha. That dispute is for the harm and unhappiness of many people, for the non-benefit, harm, and suffering of devas and humans. If you, friends, perceive such a root of dispute either internally or externally, then you, friends, should strive for the abandoning of that same evil root of dispute. If you, friends, do not perceive such a root of dispute either internally or externally, then you, friends, should practice for the non-recurrence in the future of that same evil root of dispute. Thus there is the abandoning of this evil root of dispute. Thus there is its non-recurrence in the future.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu paṇunnapaccekasacco hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni, sabbāni tāni nunnāni honti paṇunnāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu paṇunnapaccekasacco hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何是舍弃个别真理者呢？贤友，于此，比丘对众多沙门、婆罗门的种种个别真理，已全部去除、舍弃、抛弃、吐出、解脱、断除、弃绝。贤友，比丘如是为舍弃个别真理者。
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who has dispelled the individual truths? Here, friends, for a bhikkhu, whatever many individual truths of the many ascetics and brahmins there are, all of them have been removed, completely removed, given up, relinquished, released, abandoned, and cast off. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu is one who has dispelled the individual truths.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro sacchikaraṇīyā dhammā – pubbenivāso satiyā sacchikaraṇīyo; sattānaṃ cutūpapāto cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyo; aṭṭha vimokkhā kāyena sacchikaraṇīyā; āsavānaṃ khayo paññāya sacchikaraṇīyo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四应作证法：应以念作证宿住；应以眼作证有情之死生；应以身作证八解脱；应以慧作证诸漏尽。
rows.english: There are four dhammas to be realized: previous existences are to be realized by means of mindfulness; the passing away and rebirth of beings are to be realized by means of the divine eye; the eight liberations are to be realized by means of the body; and the destruction of the taints is to be realized by means of wisdom.

rows.pali: 334 . ‘‘Aṭṭha kusītavatthūni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘kammaṃ kho me kātabbaṃ bhavissati, kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilamissati, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 334. “八种懈怠事。贤友们，于此，有比丘应做事务，他这样想：‘我将有事务应做，但做事务时我的身体会疲劳，不如我躺下吧！’他于是躺下，不为证得未得、获得未获、现证未现证而发起精进。此为第一懈怠事。”
rows.english: 334. Eight grounds for laziness. Here, friends, a bhikkhu has some work to do. He thinks: ‘I will have to do some work, and doing it will tire my body. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy for attaining the unattained, for gaining the ungained, for realizing the unrealized. This is the first ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. So ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo, nappaṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitānamatthamaññātuṃ. Ayaṃ aṭṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……某人重生于中土，但他却是慧劣、愚钝、痴哑者，无力了知善说与恶说之义。此为第八非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person is reborn in the middle countries, but he is unwise, dull, and a deaf-mute, unable to understand the meaning of what is well-spoken and ill-spoken. This is the eighth inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamā cāvuso, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasi karoti, divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā. Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. Ayaṃ, āvuso samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，修习、多作何种定，能导向天眼智的获得呢？贤友，于此，比丘作意光明想，确立白昼想，如昼，如是夜；如夜，如是昼。如是以敞开、无障蔽之心，修习光明之心。贤友，此即是修习、多作而能导向天眼智获得的定。
rows.english: And what, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to the acquisition of knowledge and vision? Here, friends, a monk attends to the perception of light; he establishes the perception of daytime: ‘As by day, so by night; as by night, so by day.’ Thus, with a mind that is open and unconfined, he develops a luminous mind. This, friends, is the development of concentration that, when developed and cultivated, conduces to the acquisition of knowledge and vision.

rows.pali: 349 . Atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi – ‘sādhu sādhu, sāriputta, sādhu kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhūnaṃ saṅgītipariyāyaṃ abhāsī’ti. Idamavocāyasmā sāriputto, samanuñño satthā ahosi. Attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 349. 尔时，世尊从座而起，对具寿舍利弗说：‘善哉，善哉，舍利弗！舍利弗，你为比丘们善说了此《合诵经》。’具寿舍利弗说了这番话，导师予以嘉许。彼等比丘心满意足，欢喜领受具寿舍利弗所说。
rows.english: 349. Then the Blessed One arose and addressed the Venerable Sāriputta: 'Good, good, Sāriputta! It is good, Sāriputta, that you have delivered the discourse on communal recitation to the bhikkhus.' The Venerable Sāriputta spoke thus, and the Teacher was approving. Those bhikkhus, being delighted, rejoiced in the words of the Venerable Sāriputta.

rows.pali: 301 . Tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto pāvāyaṃ adhunākālaṅkato hoti. Tassa kālaṅkiriyāya bhinnā nigaṇṭhā dvedhikajātā ddheḷhakajātā (syā. kaṃ.) bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti vicaranti (syā. kaṃ.) – ‘‘na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi, ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi, kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi! Micchāpaṭipanno tvamasi, ahamasmi sammāpaṭipanno. Sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. Purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. Adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ, āropito te vādo, niggahito tvamasi, cara vādappamokkhāya, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī’’ti. Vadhoyeva kho maññe nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu vattati. Yepi yepi te (sī. pī.) nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā , tepi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbinnarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā, yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.
rows.chinese_simplified: 301. 那时，尼乾陀·若提子(Nigaṇṭha Nāṭaputta)刚在帕瓦(Pāvā)去世。他去世后，尼乾陀们分裂了，分为两派，发生争论、争吵、辩论，他们互相以口舌为矛攻击：‘你不懂此法与律，我才懂此法与律！你怎么会懂此法与律呢！你行的是邪道，我行的才是正道。我说的有益，你说的无益。该先说的你后说，该后说的你先说。你的所学是颠倒的，你的论点已被驳斥，你已被折服！去为摆脱指责而行吧，如果可以，就去解释吧！’我想，在尼乾陀·若提子的弟子们中，简直只有败坏在发生。那些尼乾陀·若提子的在家白衣弟子，也对尼乾陀·若提子的弟子们感到厌恶、离染、反感，就如同对待那被恶说、恶导、非出离、不导向寂静、非正等觉者所宣说、如破塔、无归依处的法与律一般。
rows.english: 301. Now at that time, the Nigaṇṭha Nāṭaputta had recently passed away at Pāvā. Due to his passing, the Nigaṇṭhas became divided, forming two factions, becoming quarrelsome, contentious, and falling into dispute, and they dwelt piercing one another with verbal spears: ‘You do not know this Dhamma and Vinaya; I know this Dhamma and Vinaya. How could you know this Dhamma and Vinaya? You are one of wrong practice; I am one of right practice. My words are coherent; yours are incoherent. What should have been said before, you said after; what should have been said after, you said before. Your long-practiced view is overturned. Your doctrine is censured. You are defeated. Go, practice for release from this argument, or disentangle it if you can!’ It seems that only slaughter prevailed among the Nigaṇṭhas, the followers of Nāṭaputta. Even those lay disciples of Nigaṇṭha Nāṭaputta who wear white clothes were disgusted with, disaffected from, and reproachful of the Nigaṇṭhas, followers of Nāṭaputta, just as one would be towards a Dhamma and Vinaya that is badly proclaimed, badly expounded, not leading out, not conducive to peace, not declared by a Perfectly Enlightened One, with a shattered stūpa and without a refuge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘maggo kho me gantabbo bhavissati, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilamissati, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ tatiyaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘有路当行。他这样想：‘我将要行路，但行路时我的身体会疲惫，我还是躺下吧！’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第三懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has a journey to make. He thinks: ‘I will have to make a journey, and traveling will tire my body. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the third ground for laziness.

rows.pali: 344 . ‘‘Nava anupubbanirodhā. Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa kāmasaññā niruddhā hoti. Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti. Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti. Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāssā niruddhā honti. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa rūpasaññā niruddhā hoti. Viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti. Ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti. Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 344. 九次第灭。对已入初禅者，欲想已灭。对已入第二禅者，寻、伺已灭。对已入第三禅者，喜已灭。对已入第四禅者，出息入息已灭。对已入空无边处者，色想已灭。对已入识无边处者，空无边处想已灭。对已入无所有处者，识无边处想已灭。对已入非想非非想处者，无所有处想已灭。对已入想受灭者，想与受已灭。
rows.english: 344. “There are nine successive cessations. For one who has attained the first jhāna, perception of sensuality has ceased. For one who has attained the second jhāna, applied and sustained thought have ceased. For one who has attained the third jhāna, rapture has ceased. For one who has attained the fourth jhāna, in-breathing and out-breathing have ceased. For one who has attained the base of the infinity of space, perception of form has ceased. For one who has attained the base of the infinity of consciousness, the perception of the base of the infinity of space has ceased. For one who has attained the base of nothingness, the perception of the base of the infinity of consciousness has ceased. For one who has attained the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, the perception of the base of nothingness has ceased. For one who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling, perception and feeling have ceased.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilanto, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati… idaṃ catutthaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘已行过路。他这样想：‘我已行过路了，行路时我的身体疲惫了，我还是躺下吧！’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第四懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has made a journey. He thinks: ‘I have made a journey, and my body is tired from traveling. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the fourth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: 299 . Atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena sandhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā sandhāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi. Bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā sandhāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā. Pāveyyakāpi kho mallā pāde pakkhāletvā sandhāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā. Atha kho bhagavā pāveyyake malle bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi – ‘‘abhikkantā kho, vāseṭṭhā, ratti. Yassadāni tumhe kālaṃ maññathā’’ti. ‘‘Evaṃ, bhante’’ti kho pāveyyakā mallā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 299. 于是，世尊著衣，持衣钵，与比丘僧团一同前往集会堂。抵达后，洗足已，进入集会堂，倚中央柱，面向东方而坐。比丘僧团也洗足已，进入集会堂，倚西墙，面向东方，以世尊为前而坐。帕维亚的末罗人也洗足已，进入集会堂，倚东墙，面向西方，以世尊为前而坐。其后，世尊为帕维亚的末罗人长夜说法，开示、劝导、策励、令喜，然后遣之离去，说：‘婆悉咤（Vāseṭṭha）们，夜已深。现在，汝等知其时。’‘诚然，世尊。’帕维亚的末罗人应诺世尊后，从座而起，顶礼世尊，行右绕后离去。
rows.english: 299. Then the Blessed One, having put on his lower robe and taken his bowl and outer robe, approached the assembly hall together with the Saṅgha of monks. Having approached, he washed his feet, entered the assembly hall, and sat down facing east, leaning against the central pillar. The Saṅgha of monks also washed their feet, entered the assembly hall, and sat down facing east, leaning against the western wall, with the Blessed One before them. The Mallas of Pāvā also washed their feet, entered the assembly hall, and sat down facing west, leaning against the eastern wall, with the Blessed One before them. Then the Blessed One, for a great part of the night, instructed, established, roused, and gladdened the Mallas of Pāvā with a talk on the Dhamma, and then dismissed them, saying: “Vāseṭṭhas, the night is far advanced. Now is the time for that which you deem fit.” “So be it, Venerable Sir,” the Mallas of Pāvā replied to the Blessed One, and rising from their seats, they paid homage to the Blessed One, circumambulated him respectfully, and departed.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，比丘如何具足六支呢？贤友，于此，比丘以眼见色后，不喜不忧，住于舍，具念、正知。以耳闻声后……以意了法后，不喜不忧，住于舍，具念、正知。贤友，比丘如是具足六支。
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu endowed with six factors? Here, friends, a bhikkhu, having seen a form with the eye, is neither gladdened nor saddened, but dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending. Having heard a sound with the ear... Having cognized a mental object with the mind, he is neither gladdened nor saddened, but dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu is endowed with six factors.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cha somanassūpavicārā . Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati; sotena saddaṃ sutvā… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā. Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya somanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 六种喜的审察。眼见色已，审察喜悦处之色；耳闻声已……鼻嗅香已……舌尝味已……身触所触已；意知法已，审察喜悦处之法。
rows.english: Six investigations accompanied by joy. Having seen a form with the eye, one investigates a form that is a basis for joy; having heard a sound with the ear... having smelled an odor with the nose... having tasted a flavor with the tongue... having touched a tangible object with the body... having cognized a mind-object with the mind, one investigates a mind-object that is a basis for joy.

rows.pali: 319 . ‘‘Pañca cetokhilā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṃ paṭhamo cetokhilo. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu dhamme kaṅkhati vicikicchati…pe… saṅghe kaṅkhati vicikicchati… sikkhāya kaṅkhati vicikicchati… sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṃ pañcamo cetokhilo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 319. “有五种心的荒芜。贤友，于此，比丘对导师怀疑、犹豫，不信解，不净信。贤友，凡是对导师怀疑、犹豫，不信解，不净信的比丘，其心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤。其心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤者，此即是第一种心的荒芜。再者，贤友，比丘对法怀疑、犹豫……对僧团怀疑、犹豫……对学处怀疑、犹豫……对同梵行者忿怒、不悦、心有抵触、心生僵滞。贤友，凡是对同梵行者忿怒、不悦、心有抵触、心生僵滞的比丘，其心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤。其心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤者，此即是第五种心的荒芜。”
rows.english: 319. There are five barrennesses of mind. Here, friends, a bhikkhu doubts and is uncertain about the Teacher, is not resolved, and is not confident. Friends, for whichever bhikkhu doubts and is uncertain about the Teacher, is not resolved, and is not confident, his mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion. For one whose mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion, this is the first barrenness of mind. Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu doubts and is uncertain about the Dhamma… doubts and is uncertain about the Saṅgha… doubts and is uncertain about the training… is angry with his companions in the holy life, is displeased, has a mind that is hurt, and has become barren. Friends, for whichever bhikkhu is angry with his companions in the holy life, is displeased, has a mind that is hurt, and has become barren, his mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion. For one whose mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion, this is the fifth barrenness of mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ, kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilanto, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti! So nipajjati na vīriyaṃ ārabhati…pe… idaṃ dutiyaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友们，有比丘已做完事务，他这样想：‘我已做了事务，身体也疲倦了，不如我躺下吧！’他于是躺下，不发起精进……此为第二懈怠事。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has done some work. He thinks: ‘I have done some work, and my body is tired from doing it. Now, let me lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the second ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tisso sukhūpapattiyo sukhupapattiyo (syā. pī. ka.) – santāvuso sattā sattā sukhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) uppādetvā uppādetvā sukhaṃ viharanti, seyyathāpi devā brahmakāyikā. Ayaṃ paṭhamā sukhūpapatti. Santāvuso, sattā sukhena abhisannā parisannā paripūrā paripphuṭā. Te kadāci karahaci udānaṃ udānenti – ‘aho sukhaṃ, aho sukha’nti , seyyathāpi devā ābhassarā. Ayaṃ dutiyā sukhūpapatti. Santāvuso, sattā sukhena abhisannā parisannā paripūrā paripphuṭā. Te santaṃyeva tusitā santusitā (syā. kaṃ.) sukhaṃ cittasukhaṃ (syā. ka.) paṭisaṃvedenti, seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā. Ayaṃ tatiyā sukhūpapatti .
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有三种乐受用。贤友，有诸众生令乐生起复生起而住于乐中，犹如梵众天(Brahmakāyikā)之天神。此是第一种乐受用。贤友，有诸众生为乐所浸润、遍润、充满、遍满，彼等有时会发出感叹：‘啊，乐哉！啊，乐哉！’犹如光音天(Ābhassarā)之天神。此是第二种乐受用。贤友，有诸众生为乐所浸润、遍润、充满、遍满，彼等满足而感受寂静之乐，犹如遍净天(Subhakiṇhā)之天神。此是第三种乐受用。”
rows.english: Three kinds of attainment of happiness: Friends, there are beings who, having repeatedly generated happiness, dwell happily; such are the devas of Brahmā's retinue. This is the first attainment of happiness. Friends, there are beings who are drenched, steeped, filled, and suffused with happiness. At certain times, they utter the inspired utterance: 'Oh, what happiness! Oh, what happiness!'; such are the devas of Streaming Radiance. This is the second attainment of happiness. Friends, there are beings who are drenched, steeped, filled, and suffused with happiness. They, being satisfied, experience a sublime and peaceful happiness; such are the devas of Refulgent Glory. This is the third attainment of happiness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. Ayañca puggalo tiracchānayoniṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ dutiyo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，如来、阿罗汉、正等觉者出现于世，法亦被宣说——导向寂止、导向般涅槃、引向正觉、善逝所宣说之法，而此人却投生于畜生界。这是第二种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a Tathāgata has arisen in the world, an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, and the Dhamma is taught—conducive to peace, leading to Nibbāna, leading to awakening, proclaimed by the Sugata. But this person has been reborn in the animal realm. This is the second inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti milakkhesu milakkhakesu (syā. kaṃ.) milakkhūsu (ka.) aviññātāresu, yattha natthi gati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ. Ayaṃ chaṭṭho akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，……重生于边地的愚昧蛮族中，彼处无比丘、比丘尼、优婆塞、优婆夷的往来。这是第六种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person is reborn in the border regions among barbarians who are uncomprehending, where there is no access for bhikkhus, bhikkhunīs, laymen, or laywomen. This is the sixth inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: 342 . ‘‘Nava akkhaṇā asamayā brahmacariyavāsāya. Idhāvuso , tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. Ayañca puggalo nirayaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ paṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 342. 贤友们，有九种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。贤友们，于此，如来、阿罗汉、正等觉者出现于世，法亦被宣说——导向寂止、导向般涅槃、引向正觉、善逝所宣说之法，而此人却投生于地狱。这是第一种非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: 342. Nine inopportune moments, unseasonable for living the holy life. Here, friends, a Tathāgata has arisen in the world, an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, and the Dhamma is taught—conducive to peace, leading to Nibbāna, leading to awakening, proclaimed by the Sugata. But this person has been reborn in hell. This is the first inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri sotāpannassa aṅgāni. Idhāvuso, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho, bhagavā’ti. Dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko opanayiko (syā. kaṃ.) paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti. Saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti. Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，入流者有四支。在此，圣弟子于佛具足不坏净：‘彼世尊是阿罗汉、正自觉者、明行具足、善逝、世间解、无上士、调御丈夫、天人师、佛、世尊。’于法具足不坏净：‘法乃世尊所善说，是现见的、无时的、来而可见的、能引向的、智者各自证知的。’于僧具足不坏净：‘世尊的弟子僧是善行道者、直行道者、如理行道者、正当行道者，即四双八辈个人。此世尊的弟子僧是应供养者、应款待者、应受施者、应合掌者，是世间无上的福田。’具足圣者所喜爱的戒，是不毁的、无瑕的、无斑的、无点的、自在的、为智者所称赞的、不执取的、导向定的。”
rows.english: There are four qualities of a stream-enterer. Here, friends, a noble disciple possesses unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is an Arahant, perfectly self-enlightened, accomplished in true knowledge and conduct, sublime, knower of the world, unsurpassed trainer of persons to be tamed, teacher of gods and humans, the Enlightened One, the Blessed One.’ He possesses unwavering confidence in the Dhamma thus: ‘The Dhamma is well-expounded by the Blessed One, directly visible, immediate, inviting one to come and see, leading onward, to be personally experienced by the wise.’ He possesses unwavering confidence in the Saṅgha thus: ‘The Saṅgha of the Blessed One's disciples is practicing the good way, practicing the straight way, practicing the true way, practicing the proper way; that is, the four pairs of persons, the eight types of individuals—this Saṅgha of the Blessed One's disciples is worthy of gifts, worthy of hospitality, worthy of offerings, worthy of reverential salutation, the unsurpassed field of merit for the world.’ He possesses virtues dear to the noble ones—unbroken, unpierced, unspotted, unblotched, liberating, praised by the wise, ungrasped, conducive to concentration.

rows.pali: 302 . Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘nigaṇṭho, āvuso, nāṭaputto pāvāyaṃ adhunākālaṅkato, tassa kālaṅkiriyāya bhinnā nigaṇṭhā dvedhikajātā…pe… bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe’’. ‘‘Evañhetaṃ, āvuso, hoti durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite. Ayaṃ kho panāvuso amhākaṃ asmākaṃ (pī.) bhagavatā bhagavato (ka. sī.) dhammo svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 302. 尔时，具寿舍利弗对比丘们说：‘贤友们，尼乾陀·若提子(Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto)最近于波婆(Pāvā)命终。因其命终，尼乾陀们分裂，分为两派……犹如破塔，无有依怙。贤友们，在恶说、恶宣示、非出离、不导向寂静、非由正等觉者所宣示的法与律中，此事诚然如此。然而，贤友们，我等世尊的法，是善说、善宣示、能出离、导向寂静、由正等觉者所宣示的。于此，应由所有人共同合诵，不应争论，这样此梵行才能长久、持续，这将为了众人的利益，为了众人的安乐，为了怜悯世间，为了天与人的义利、福祉与安乐。’
rows.english: 302. Then the venerable Sāriputta addressed the monks: ‘Friends, the Nigaṇṭha Nāṭaputta has recently passed away at Pāvā. Due to his passing, the Nigaṇṭhas have become divided, forming two factions… with a shattered stūpa and without a refuge.’ ‘So it is, friends, in a Dhamma and Vinaya that is badly proclaimed, badly expounded, not leading out, not conducive to peace, and not declared by a Perfectly Enlightened One. But this Dhamma of ours, friends, has been well-proclaimed by the Blessed One, well-expounded, leading out, conducive to peace, and declared by a Perfectly Enlightened One. Therein, all should chant in unison, without disputing, so that this holy life might be long-lasting and endure for a long time. That would be for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, benefit, and happiness of devas and humans.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo. Ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ (sī. syā. pī.) kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā (ka. sī. syā. kaṃ.) dhātā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā, yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto hoti…pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘多闻，受持所闻，积聚所闻。凡是那些初善、中善、后善，义妙、文妙，宣说完全圆满、遍净梵行的法，像这样的法他已多闻、忆持、言语熟悉、意所随观、以慧善通达。贤友，比丘多闻……以慧善通达，此法亦能作依怙。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a monk is very learned, a retainer of what has been heard, one who has accumulated what has been heard. Those teachings that are good in the beginning, good in the middle, and good in the end, with right meaning and phrasing, which proclaim the perfectly complete and pure holy life—such teachings have been much heard by him, retained, practiced verbally, reflected upon mentally, and well penetrated by wisdom. Friends, that a monk is very learned... and well penetrated by wisdom—this too is a quality that makes a refuge.

rows.pali: 317 . ‘‘Pañca padhāniyaṅgāni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato, lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti. Appābādho hoti appātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. Asaṭho hoti amāyāvī, yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu. Āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. Paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 317. 贤友们，有五精勤支。于此，比丘有信，他信受如来的菩提：‘彼世尊亦即是阿罗汉、正等觉者、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士调御丈夫、天人师、佛、世尊。’他少病少恼，消化功能均衡，不过冷、不过热、适中，堪于精勤。他不奸诈，不虚伪，在导师、或智者、或同梵行者前，如实地显露自己。他为断除诸不善法、为具足诸善法而住，发起精进，强健、坚毅，于诸善法不舍其担。他有智慧，具足了观照生灭、圣、能洞穿、能正导至苦尽的智慧。
rows.english: 317. There are five factors for striving. Here, friends, a bhikkhu is faithful; he has faith in the Tathāgata's enlightenment: ‘Thus is the Blessed One an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, a Fortunate One, a Knower of the World, an Unsurpassed Trainer of persons to be tamed, a Teacher of gods and humans, an Enlightened One, a Blessed One.’ He is without illness, without affliction, endowed with a digestive power that is well-balanced, neither too cold nor too hot, but moderate and suitable for striving. He is not deceitful or fraudulent; he reveals himself as he truly is to the Teacher, or to the wise, or to his companions in the holy life. He dwells with aroused energy for the abandoning of unwholesome states and for the attainment of wholesome states; he is strong, firm in exertion, not casting off the burden in wholesome states. He is wise, endowed with wisdom that comprehends arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and leads to the complete destruction of suffering.

rows.pali: 343 . ‘‘Nava anupubbavihārā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā…pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā…pe… ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 343. 九次第住。贤友，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻、有伺，由远离所生，具足喜乐，进入并安住于初禅。寻与伺平息故……进入并安住于第二禅。又因喜的离贪……进入并安住于第三禅。又因舍断乐……进入并安住于第四禅。完全超越色想……进入并安住于空无边处。完全超越空无边处，作意‘识无边’，进入并安住于识无边处。完全超越识无边处，作意‘无所有’，进入并安住于无所有处。完全超越无所有处，进入并安住于非想非非想处。完全超越非想非非想处，进入并安住于想受灭。
rows.english: 343. “There are nine successive abidings. Here, friends, a monk, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and abides in the first jhāna, which is accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, with rapture and happiness born of seclusion. With the stilling of applied and sustained thought… he enters and abides in the second jhāna. With the fading away of rapture… he enters and abides in the third jhāna. With the abandoning of pleasure… he enters and abides in the fourth jhāna. With the complete transcendence of perceptions of form… he enters and abides in the base of the infinity of space. With the complete transcendence of the base of the infinity of space, perceiving ‘consciousness is infinite,’ he enters and abides in the base of the infinity of consciousness. With the complete transcendence of the base of the infinity of consciousness, perceiving ‘there is nothing,’ he enters and abides in the base of nothingness. With the complete transcendence of the base of nothingness, he enters and abides in the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. With the complete transcendence of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, he enters and abides in the cessation of perception and feeling.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, tathāgato ca loke na katthaci nakāro na dissati uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca na desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. Ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo, paṭibalo subhāsita-dubbhāsitānamatthamaññātuṃ. Ayaṃ navamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，如来、阿罗汉、正等觉者未出现于世，法亦未被开示——导向寂止、导向般涅槃、引向正觉、善逝所宣说之法。但此人却重生于中土，且有慧、不愚钝、不痴哑，有力了知善说与恶说之义。此为第九非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a Tathāgata, an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, has not arisen in the world, and the Dhamma is not taught that is conducive to peace, leading to Nibbāna, leading to enlightenment, proclaimed by the Well-Gone One. And this person is reborn in the middle countries, and he is wise, not dull, not a deaf-mute, and is able to understand the meaning of what is well-spoken and ill-spoken. This is the ninth inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. Atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī’ti. So ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ animittāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca panassa nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ bhavissati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, sabbanimittānaṃ, yadidaṃ animittā cetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，于此，有比丘会这么说：‘我的无相心解脱已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基础，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，但我的识仍然追随于相。’他应被告知：‘不要这样说。具寿，不要这样说，不要诽谤世尊，因为诽谤世尊是不善的，世尊不会这样说。贤友们，这是不可能、无有是处的：当无相心解脱已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基础，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励时，他的识仍然会追随于相，这种情况是不存在的。贤友们，此即是一切相的出离，也就是无相心解脱。’”
rows.english: Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the signless liberation of mind, cultivated it, made it a vehicle, made it a basis, established it, repeatedly practiced it, and well undertaken it. Yet, my consciousness still follows after signs.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say so, venerable sir. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not say such a thing. It is impossible, friends, it cannot be that when the signless liberation of mind has been developed, cultivated, made a vehicle, made a basis, established, repeatedly practiced, and well undertaken, his consciousness would still follow after signs. That situation does not exist. For this, friends, is the escape from all signs: that is, the signless liberation of mind.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘karuṇā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. Atha ca pana me vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti, so ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ karuṇāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca panassa vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, vihesāya, yadidaṃ karuṇā cetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 又，贤友，于此，有比丘会这么说：‘我的悲心解脱(karuṇā cetovimutti)已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，但恼害(vihesā)仍然持续占据我的心。’他应被告知：‘具寿，不要这么说，不要诬蔑世尊，因为诬蔑世尊是不好的，世尊不会这么说。贤友，这是不可能、无有是处的：当悲心解脱已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，而恼害仍然会持续占据他的心，此理不存在。贤友，此即是恼害的出离，也就是悲心解脱。’
rows.english: Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through compassion, practiced it frequently, made it a vehicle, made it a foundation, established it, become familiar with it, and undertaken it well. And yet, cruelty still overcomes my mind and remains.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say so, venerable sir. Do not speak thus. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not speak thus. It is impossible, friends, it cannot be, that when the liberation of mind through compassion has been developed, practiced frequently, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, become familiar with, and undertaken well, cruelty would still overcome his mind and remain. That situation does not exist. For this, friends, is the escape from cruelty, namely, the liberation of mind through compassion.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘muditā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. Atha ca pana me arati cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti, so ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca panassa arati cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, aratiyā, yadidaṃ muditā cetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，于此，有比丘会这么说：‘我的喜心解脱(muditā cetovimutti)已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，但不乐(arati)仍然持续占据我的心。’他应被告知：‘具寿，莫作是说，莫诽谤世尊，因为诽谤世尊是不善的，世尊不会这么说。贤友，此是无有是处、不可能的：当喜心解脱已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励时，不乐仍会占据他的心，此理不存在。贤友，此即是不乐的出离，也就是喜心解脱。’”
rows.english: Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through sympathetic joy, practiced it frequently, made it a vehicle, made it a foundation, established it, become familiar with it, and undertaken it well. And yet, discontent still overcomes my mind and remains.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say so, venerable sir. Do not speak thus. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not speak thus. It is impossible, friends, it cannot be, that when the liberation of mind through sympathetic joy has been developed, practiced frequently, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, become familiar with, and undertaken well, discontent would still overcome his mind and remain. That situation does not exist. For this, friends, is the escape from discontent, namely, the liberation of mind through sympathetic joy.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘upekkhā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. Atha ca pana me rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca panassa rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, rāgassa, yadidaṃ upekkhā cetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，于此，有比丘会这么说：‘我的舍心解脱(upekkhā cetovimutti)已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，但贪(rāgo)仍然持续占据我的心。’他应被告知：‘具寿，莫作是说，莫诽谤世尊，因为诽谤世尊是不善的，世尊不会这么说。贤友，此是无有是处、不可能的：当舍心解脱已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励时，贪仍会占据他的心，此理不存在。贤友，此即是贪的出离，也就是舍心解脱。’”
rows.english: Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through equanimity, practiced it frequently, made it a vehicle, made it a foundation, established it, become familiar with it, and undertaken it well. And yet, lust still overcomes my mind and remains.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say so, venerable sir. Do not speak thus. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not speak thus. It is impossible, friends, it cannot be, that when the liberation of mind through equanimity has been developed, practiced frequently, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, become familiar with, and undertaken well, lust would still overcome his mind and remain. That situation does not exist. For this, friends, is the escape from lust, namely, the liberation of mind through equanimity.’

rows.pali: 298 . Atha kho pāveyyakā mallā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena sandhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ (ka.) sandhāgāraṃ santharitvā bhagavato āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhapetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho te pāveyyakā mallā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ – ‘‘sabbasantharisanthataṃ sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ (sī. pī. ka.) , bhante, sandhāgāraṃ, bhagavato āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telapadīpo āropito. Yassadāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 298. 于是，帕维亚的末罗人得知世尊已应允，便从座而起，顶礼世尊，行右绕后，前往集会堂。抵达后，他们将集会堂遍铺敷具，为世尊设好座位，备妥水瓶，点上油灯，然后前往世尊之处。抵达后，他们顶礼世尊，立于一旁。立于一旁后，那些帕维亚的末罗人对世尊说：‘世尊，集会堂已遍铺敷具，座位已设好，水瓶已备妥，油灯已点上。世尊，现在，世尊知其时。’
rows.english: 298. Then the Mallas of Pāvā, having understood the Blessed One’s consent, rose from their seats, paid homage to the Blessed One, circumambulated him respectfully, and approached the assembly hall. Having approached, they spread the assembly hall completely with coverings, prepared seats for the Blessed One, set up a water pot, and placed an oil lamp. Then they approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and stood to one side. Standing to one side, those Mallas of Pāvā said this to the Blessed One: “Venerable Sir, the assembly hall is completely spread with coverings, seats for the Blessed One have been prepared, a water pot has been set up, and an oil lamp has been placed. Now, Venerable Sir, it is for the Blessed One to do as he deems fit.”

rows.pali: 325 . Cha vivādamūlāni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti upanāhī. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu kodhano hoti upanāhī, so sattharipi agāravo viharati appatisso, dhammepi agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghepi agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāyapi na paripūrakārī paripūrīkārī (syā. kaṃ.) hoti. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṃ janeti. Yo hoti vivādo bahujanaahitāya bahujanaasukhāya anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ. Evarūpaṃ ce tumhe, āvuso, vivādamūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, āvuso, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānāya vāyameyyātha. Evarūpaṃ ce tumhe, āvuso, vivādamūlaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā na samanupasseyyātha. Tatra tumhe, āvuso, tasseva pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavāya paṭipajjeyyātha. Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa pahānaṃ hoti. Evametassa pāpakassa vivādamūlassa āyatiṃ anavassavo hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 325. 有六种诤根。贤友，于此，有比丘忿怒、怀恨。贤友，凡是比丘忿怒、怀恨，他对导师不恭敬、不顺从地住；对法不恭敬、不顺从地住；对僧团不恭敬、不顺从地住；于学也不圆满。贤友，凡是比丘对导师不恭敬、不顺从地住，对法不恭敬、不顺从地住，对僧团不恭敬、不顺从地住，于学不圆满，他便在僧团中引生诤论。此诤论是为众人的不利与不乐，为天与人的无义、不利与痛苦。贤友，你们若于内或于外见到此等诤根，贤友，你们当为断除那邪恶的诤根而努力。贤友，你们若于内或于外未见到此等诤根，贤友，你们当为使那邪恶的诤根于未来不复生起而行道。如是，此邪恶的诤根得以断除。如是，此邪恶的诤根于未来不复生起。
rows.english: 325. Six roots of disputes. Here, friends, a bhikkhu is wrathful and bears a grudge. That bhikkhu, friends, who is wrathful and bears a grudge dwells without reverence or deference toward the Teacher, the Dhamma, and the Saṅgha, and does not fulfill the training. That bhikkhu, friends, who dwells without reverence or deference toward the Teacher, the Dhamma, and the Saṅgha, and does not fulfill the training, creates disputes in the Saṅgha. That dispute is for the harm and unhappiness of many people, for the non-benefit, harm, and suffering of devas and humans. If you, friends, perceive such a root of dispute either internally or externally, then you, friends, should strive for the abandoning of that same evil root of dispute. If you, friends, do not perceive such a root of dispute either internally or externally, then you, friends, should practice for the non-arising in the future of that same evil root of dispute. Thus there is the abandoning of this evil root of dispute. Thus there is its non-arising in the future.

rows.pali: 326 . ‘‘Cha nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘mettā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, atha ca pana me byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So ‘mā hevaṃ’, tissa vacanīyo, ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya. Atha ca panassa byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, byāpādassa, yadidaṃ mettā cetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 326. 六出离界。贤友，于此，有比丘会这么说：‘我的慈心解脱(mettā cetovimutti)已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，但嗔恚仍然持续占据我的心。’他应被告知：‘具寿，不要这么说，不要诬蔑世尊，因为诬蔑世尊是不好的，世尊不会这么说。贤友，这是不可能、无有是处的：当慈心解脱已修习、已多作，已作为车乘、已作为基石，已实行、已熟习、已善加策励，而嗔恚仍然会持续占据他的心，此理不存在。贤友，此即是嗔恚的出离，也就是慈心解脱。’
rows.english: 326. There are six elements that lead to escape. Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through loving-kindness, practiced it frequently, made it a vehicle, made it a foundation, established it, become familiar with it, and undertaken it well. And yet, ill will still overcomes my mind and remains.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say so, venerable sir. Do not speak thus. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not speak thus. It is impossible, friends, it cannot be, that when the liberation of mind through loving-kindness has been developed, practiced frequently, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, become familiar with, and undertaken well, ill will would still overcome his mind and remain. That situation does not exist. For this, friends, is the escape from ill will, namely, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘asmīti kho me vigataṃ vighātaṃ (sī. pī.), vigate (syā. ka.) , ayamahamasmīti na samanupassāmi, atha ca pana me vicikicchākathaṅkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso, yaṃ asmīti vigate vighāte (sī. pī.) ayamahamasmīti asamanupassato, atha ca panassa vicikicchākathaṅkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, vicikicchākathaṅkathāsallassa, yadidaṃ asmimānasamugghāto’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，于此，有比丘会这么说：‘我的“我是”之慢已离，我不审视“我即是此”，但疑惑、如何之箭仍盘踞我心。’他应被告知：‘不要这样说。具寿，不要这样说，不要诽谤世尊，因为诽谤世尊是不善的，世尊不会这样说。贤友们，这是不可能、无有是处的：当“我是”之慢已离，不审视“我即是此”时，他的心仍然会被疑惑、如何之箭所盘踞，这种情况是不存在的。贤友们，此即是疑惑、如何之箭的出离，也就是我慢的根除。’”
rows.english: Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: 'The thought ‘I am’ has vanished for me, and I do not perceive ‘I am this.’ Yet, the dart of doubt and perplexity still overwhelms my mind and persists.' He should be told: 'Do not say so, venerable sir. Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not say such a thing. It is impossible, friends, it cannot be that when the thought ‘I am’ has vanished and one does not perceive ‘I am this,’ the dart of doubt and perplexity would overwhelm his mind and persist. That situation does not exist. For this, friends, is the escape from the dart of doubt and perplexity: that is, the uprooting of the conceit ‘I am.’'

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāya. Idhāvuso, sīlavā sīlasampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati, ayaṃ paṭhamo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, sīlavato sīlasampannassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, ayaṃ dutiyo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, sīlavā sīlasampanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto, ayaṃ tatiyo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, sīlavā sīlasampanno asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, ayaṃ catuttho ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, sīlavā sīlasampanno kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati, ayaṃ pañcamo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 具戒者因戒行圆满有五种利益。贤友，于此，具戒、戒行圆满者，以不放逸为因，获得大宗财富。这是具戒者因戒行圆满的第一种利益。再者，贤友，具戒、戒行圆满者善名远扬。这是具戒者因戒行圆满的第二种利益。再者，贤友，具戒、戒行圆满者，无论前往何等会众——无论是刹帝利会众、婆罗门会众、居士会众，还是沙门会众——都无所畏惧、不窘迫地前往。这是具戒者因戒行圆满的第三种利益。再者，贤友，具戒、戒行圆满者不迷乱地死去。这是具戒者因戒行圆满的第四种利益。再者，贤友，具戒、戒行圆满者，身坏命终之后，往生于善趣、天界。这是具戒者因戒行圆满的第五种利益。
rows.english: There are five benefits for one who is virtuous, due to accomplishment in virtue. Here, friends, a virtuous person who is accomplished in virtue, on account of heedfulness, acquires a great mass of wealth. This is the first benefit for one who is virtuous, due to accomplishment in virtue. Furthermore, friends, a good reputation spreads about a virtuous person who is accomplished in virtue. This is the second benefit for one who is virtuous, due to accomplishment in virtue. Furthermore, friends, whatever assembly a virtuous person who is accomplished in virtue approaches—be it an assembly of nobles, an assembly of brahmins, an assembly of householders, or an assembly of ascetics—he approaches it confidently and not crestfallen. This is the third benefit for one who is virtuous, due to accomplishment in virtue. Furthermore, friends, a virtuous person who is accomplished in virtue dies unconfused. This is the fourth benefit for one who is virtuous, due to accomplishment in virtue. Furthermore, friends, a virtuous person who is accomplished in virtue, after the breakup of the body, after death, is reborn in a good destination, a heavenly world. This is the fifth benefit for one who is virtuous, due to accomplishment in virtue.

rows.pali: ‘‘Pañca ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā. Idhāvuso , dussīlo sīlavipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati, ayaṃ paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, ayaṃ dutiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, dussīlo sīlavipanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, avisārado upasaṅkamati maṅkubhūto, ayaṃ tatiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, dussīlo sīlavipanno sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, ayaṃ catuttho ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, ayaṃ pañcamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 无戒者因戒毁坏有五种过患。贤友，于此，无戒、戒已毁坏者，以放逸为因，遭受巨大的财富损失，这是无戒者因戒毁坏的第一种过患。再者，贤友，无戒、戒已毁坏者，恶名传扬，这是无戒者因戒毁坏的第二种过患。再者，贤友，无戒、戒已毁坏者，无论前往何等集会——无论是刹帝利众、婆罗门众、居士众或沙门众——都畏缩、窘迫地前往，这是无戒者因戒毁坏的第三种过患。再者，贤友，无戒、戒已毁坏者，迷乱地命终，这是无戒者因戒毁坏的第四种过患。再者，贤友，无戒、戒已毁坏者，于身坏命终后，投生于恶趣、恶道、堕处、地狱，这是无戒者因戒毁坏的第五种过患。
rows.english: There are five drawbacks for one who is immoral, due to failure in virtue. Here, friends, an immoral person who has failed in virtue, on account of heedlessness, incurs a great loss of wealth. This is the first drawback for one who is immoral, due to failure in virtue. Furthermore, friends, a bad reputation spreads about an immoral person who has failed in virtue. This is the second drawback for one who is immoral, due to failure in virtue. Furthermore, friends, whatever assembly an immoral person who has failed in virtue approaches—be it an assembly of nobles, an assembly of brahmins, an assembly of householders, or an assembly of ascetics—he approaches it timidly and crestfallen. This is the third drawback for one who is immoral, due to failure in virtue. Furthermore, friends, an immoral person who has failed in virtue dies confused. This is the fourth drawback for one who is immoral, due to failure in virtue. Furthermore, friends, an immoral person who has failed in virtue, after the breakup of the body, after death, is reborn in a state of deprivation, a bad destination, a downfall, in hell. This is the fifth drawback for one who is immoral, due to failure in virtue.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti. So ca hoti micchādiṭṭhiko viparītadassano – ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ sukaṭa dukkaṭānaṃ (sī. pī.) kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti. Ayaṃ sattamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……某人重生于中土，但他持有邪见与颠倒见：‘无所施，无供养，无祭祀；无善作、恶作诸业的果与报；无此世，无他世；无母，无父；无化生有情；世间无已达善趣、已入正道的沙门、婆罗门，能以亲身证知、实现后而宣说此世与他世。’此为第七非时、非机，不适于修梵行。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person is reborn in the middle countries, but he holds wrong view and has a perverted perspective: ‘There is no result in what is given, no result in what is sacrificed, no result in what is offered; there is no fruit or result of good and bad deeds; there is no this world, no other world; there is no mother, no father; there are no spontaneously arisen beings; there are in the world no ascetics and brahmins who are well-gone and well-practiced, who, having realized this world and the next for themselves by direct knowledge, make it known.’ This is the seventh inopportune moment, unseasonable for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, idhekacco dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ…pe… seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ. So yaṃ deti taṃ paccāsīsati. Tassa sutaṃ hoti – ‘cātumahārājikā cātummahārājikā (sī. syā. pī.) devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā’’ti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā cātumahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya’’nti! So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti, tassa taṃ cittaṃ hīne vimuttaṃ uttari abhāvitaṃ tatrūpapattiyā saṃvattati. Tañca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa. Ijjhatāvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi visuddhattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，在此，有人布施饮食……乃至床座、住所、灯具给沙门或婆罗门。他布施时有所期求。他听闻：‘四大王天(Cātumahārājikā)的诸天长寿、美貌、多乐。’他这样想：‘啊，愿我身坏命终之后，能投生为四大王天诸天的同伴！’他确立彼心，坚持彼心，培育彼心。他的那个心倾向于低劣，未向更高培育，这导致他投生到那里。而这，我说是对有戒者而言，非对无戒者。贤友，有戒者的心愿因其清净而得以成就。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, here a certain person gives a gift to a recluse or a brahmin: food, drink… a bed, a dwelling, and a lamp. What he gives, he hopes for in return. He has heard: ‘The devas of the realm of the Four Great Kings are long-lived, beautiful, and have abundant happiness.’ To him, this thought occurs: ‘Oh, that on the dissolution of the body, after death, I might be reborn in the company of the devas of the realm of the Four Great Kings!’ He establishes that thought, resolves upon that thought, and develops that thought. That thought of his, being inclined towards the inferior and not developed for what is higher, conduces to rebirth there. And this, I say, is for one who is virtuous, not for one who is unvirtuous. Friends, the aspiration of the virtuous succeeds on account of its purity.
