rows.pali: 320 . ‘‘Pañca cetasovinibandhā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Ayaṃ paṭhamo cetaso vinibandho. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kāye avītarāgo hoti…pe… rūpe avītarāgo hoti…pe… puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati…pe… puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati – ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati – ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Ayaṃ pañcamo cetaso vinibandho.
rows.chinese_simplified: 320. “贤友，有五种心的结缚。贤友，于此，有比丘于诸欲未离贪、未离欲、未离爱、未离渴、未离热恼、未离渴爱。贤友，凡是比丘于诸欲未离贪、未离欲、未离爱、未离渴、未离热恼、未离渴爱，其心则不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤。若心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤，此为第一种心的结缚。再者，贤友，有比丘于身未离贪……于色未离贪……再者，贤友，有比丘随欲饱食后，耽于躺卧之乐、侧卧之乐、昏沉之乐而住……再者，贤友，有比丘期望生为某一类天神而修梵行，心想：‘我以此戒、或禁行、或苦行、或梵行，将成为天神或某一类天神。’贤友，凡是比丘期望生为某一类天神而修梵行，心想：‘我以此戒、或禁行、或苦行、或梵行，将成为天神或某一类天神。’其心则不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤。若心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒毅、精勤，此为第五种心的结缚。”
rows.english: 320. There are five bonds of the mind. Here, friends, a bhikkhu is not free from passion for sensual pleasures; his desire has not departed, his affection has not departed, his thirst has not departed, his torment has not departed, his craving has not departed. Friends, for whichever bhikkhu is not free from passion for sensual pleasures, whose desire has not departed, whose affection has not departed, whose thirst has not departed, whose torment has not departed, whose craving has not departed, his mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion. For one whose mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion, this is the first bond of the mind. Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is not free from passion for the body… is not free from passion for form… Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, having eaten to his belly's fill, dwells devoted to the pleasure of lying down, the pleasure of reclining on his side, and the pleasure of drowsiness… Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu practices the holy life aspiring to some group of devas, thinking: ‘By this virtue or observance or austerity or holy life, I will become a deva or one of the devas.’ Friends, for whichever bhikkhu practices the holy life aspiring to some group of devas, thinking: ‘By this virtue or observance or austerity or holy life, I will become a deva or one of the devas,’ his mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion. For one whose mind does not incline toward ardency, dedication, perseverance, and exertion, this is the fifth bond of the mind.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, idhekacco dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ. So yaṃ deti taṃ paccāsīsati. Tassa sutaṃ hoti – ‘brahmakāyikā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā’ti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya’nti! So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti, tassa taṃ cittaṃ hīne vimuttaṃ uttari abhāvitaṃ tatrūpapattiyā saṃvattati. Tañca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa; vītarāgassa no sarāgassa. Ijjhatāvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi vītarāgattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，在此，有人布施饮食、衣物、车乘、花环、香、涂香、床座、住所、灯具给沙门或婆罗门。他布施时有所期求。他听闻：‘梵众天(Brahmakāyikā devā)长寿、美貌、多乐。’他这样想：‘啊，愿我身坏命终之后，能投生为梵众天众的同伴！’他确立彼心，坚持彼心，培育彼心。他的那个心，倾向于低劣者，未向更高者培育，这导致他投生到那里。我说是对有戒者而非无戒者，对离贪者而非有贪者而言。贤友，有戒者的心愿因离贪而得以成就。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, here a certain person gives a gift to a recluse or a brahmin: food, drink, clothing, a vehicle, garlands, scents, and ointments, a bed, a dwelling, and a lamp. What he gives, he hopes for in return. He has heard: ‘The devas of the Brahmā world are long-lived, beautiful, and have abundant happiness.’ To him, this thought occurs: ‘Oh, that on the dissolution of the body, after death, I might be reborn in the company of the devas of the Brahmā world!’ He establishes that thought, resolves upon that thought, and develops that thought. That thought of his, being inclined towards the inferior and not developed for what is higher, conduces to rebirth there. And this, I say, is for one who is virtuous, not for one who is unvirtuous; for one free from passion, not for one with passion. Friends, the aspiration of the virtuous succeeds on account of freedom from passion.

rows.pali: 297 . Tena kho pana samayena pāveyyakānaṃ mallānaṃ ubbhatakaṃ nāma navaṃ sandhāgāraṃ santhāgāraṃ (sī. pī.), saṇṭhāgāraṃ (syā. kaṃ.) acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ anajjhāvutthaṃ (sī. syā. pī. ka.) samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena. Assosuṃ kho pāveyyakā mallā – ‘‘bhagavā kira mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi pāvaṃ anuppatto pāvāyaṃ viharati cundassa kammāraputtassa ambavane’’ti. Atha kho pāveyyakā mallā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho pāveyyakā mallā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ – ‘‘idha, bhante, pāveyyakānaṃ mallānaṃ ubbhatakaṃ nāma navaṃ sandhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena. Tañca kho, bhante, bhagavā paṭhamaṃ paribhuñjatu, bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā pāveyyakā mallā paribhuñjissanti. Tadassa pāveyyakānaṃ mallānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā’’ti. Adhivāsesi kho bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena.
rows.chinese_simplified: 297. 当时，帕维亚的末罗人有一座名为乌拔塔迦(Ubbhataka)的新集会堂，刚建成不久，尚未被任何沙门、婆罗门或任何世人居住过。帕维亚的末罗人听说：‘据说世尊与约五百位比丘的大比丘僧团在末罗(Malla)国游行，已抵达帕维亚，住在金匠之子纯陀的芒果园中。’于是，帕维亚的末罗人前往世尊之处；抵达后，他们顶礼世尊，然后坐于一旁。坐于一旁后，帕维亚的末罗人对世尊说：‘尊者，我们帕维亚的末罗人有一座名为乌拔塔迦的新集会堂，刚建成不久，尚未被任何沙门、婆罗门或任何世人居住过。尊者，愿世尊首先启用它。世尊首先启用之后，帕维亚的末罗人才会使用。这将为帕维亚的末罗人带来长远的利益与安乐。’世尊以沉默表示同意。
rows.english: 297. At that time, the Mallas of Pāvā had a new, recently built assembly hall named Ubbhataka, which had not yet been dwelt in by any recluse, brahmin, or any human being. The Mallas of Pāvā heard: “The Blessed One, it is said, while wandering on tour among the Mallas with a great Saṅgha of monks, with five hundred monks, has arrived at Pāvā and is dwelling in the mango grove of Cunda the smith's son.” Then the Mallas of Pāvā approached the Blessed One; having approached, they paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the Mallas of Pāvā said this to the Blessed One: “Venerable Sir, there is here a new, recently built assembly hall of the Mallas of Pāvā named Ubbhataka, which has not yet been dwelt in by any recluse, brahmin, or any human being. May the Blessed One, Venerable Sir, be the first to use it. After it has been used by the Blessed One, the Mallas of Pāvā will use it afterwards. That will be for the long-term welfare and happiness of the Mallas of Pāvā.” The Blessed One consented by means of silence.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ime kho, āvuso, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dve dhammā sammadakkhātā. Tattha sabbeheva saṅgāyitabbaṃ, na vivaditabbaṃ, yathayidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友们，此二法为彼知者、见者、阿罗汉、正等觉者世尊所善说。于此，我等皆应合诵，不应争论，以使此梵行得以长久住立，此将为大众的利益、大众的安乐、对世间的怜悯，以及天人的义利、福祉与安乐。
rows.english: Friends, these two dhammas have been well-proclaimed by that Blessed One who knows and sees, the Arahant, the Perfectly Enlightened One. Herein, all should chant together in unison, without dispute, so that this holy life may be long-lasting and endure for a long time. This would be for the welfare and happiness of the multitude, out of compassion for the world, for the benefit, welfare, and happiness of devas and humans.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāro āruppā. arūpā (syā. kaṃ. pī.) Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四无色。贤友，于此，比丘完全超越诸色想，灭除诸有对想，不作意种种想，思惟‘空无边’，具足空无边处而住。完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识无边’，具足识无边处而住。完全超越识无边处，思惟‘无所有’，具足无所有处而住。完全超越无所有处，具足非想非非想处而住。
rows.english: There are four immaterial attainments. Here, friends, a monk, by completely surmounting perceptions of form, by the disappearance of perceptions of sensory impact, by not attending to perceptions of diversity, perceiving ‘space is infinite,’ enters and dwells in the base of infinite space. By completely surmounting the base of infinite space, perceiving ‘consciousness is infinite,’ he enters and dwells in the base of infinite consciousness. By completely surmounting the base of infinite consciousness, perceiving ‘there is nothing,’ he enters and dwells in the base of nothingness. By completely surmounting the base of nothingness, he enters and dwells in the base of neither perception nor non-perception. These are the four immaterial attainments.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, idhekacco dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ…pe… seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ. So yaṃ deti taṃ paccāsīsati. Tassa sutaṃ hoti – ‘tāvatiṃsā devā…pe… yāmā devā…pe… tusitā devā …pe… nimmānaratī devā…pe… paranimmitavasavattī devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā’ti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya’’nti! So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti, tassa taṃ cittaṃ hīne vimuttaṃ uttari abhāvitaṃ tatrūpapattiyā saṃvattati. Tañca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa. Ijjhatāvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi visuddhattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，在此，有人布施饮食……乃至床座、住所、灯具给沙门或婆罗门。他布施时有所期求。他听闻：‘三十三天(Tāvatiṃsā)的诸天……夜摩天(Yāmā)的诸天……兜率天(Tusitā)的诸天……化乐天(Nimmānaratī)的诸天……他化自在天(Paranimmitavasavattī)的诸天长寿、美貌、多乐。’他这样想：‘啊，愿我身坏命终之后，能投生为他化自在天诸天的同伴！’他确立彼心，坚持彼心，培育彼心。他的那个心倾向于低劣，未向更高培育，这导致他投生到那里。而这，我说是对有戒者而言，非对无戒者。贤友，有戒者的心愿因其清净而得以成就。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, here a certain person gives a gift to a recluse or a brahmin: food, drink… a bed, a dwelling, and a lamp. What he gives, he hopes for in return. He has heard: ‘The Tāvatiṃsa devas… the Yāma devas… the Tusita devas… the Nimmānaratī devas… the Paranimmitavasavattī devas are long-lived, beautiful, and have abundant happiness.’ To him, this thought occurs: ‘Oh, that on the dissolution of the body, after death, I might be reborn in the company of the Paranimmitavasavattī devas!’ He establishes that thought, resolves upon that thought, and develops that thought. That thought of his, being inclined towards the inferior and not developed for what is higher, conduces to rebirth there. And this, I say, is for one who is virtuous, not for one who is unvirtuous. Friends, the aspiration of the virtuous succeeds on account of its purity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Cattāri agatigamanāni – chandāgatiṃ gacchati, dosāgati gacchati, mohāgatiṃ gacchati, bhayāgatiṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 四不行处：行于欲，行于瞋，行于痴，行于怖。
rows.english: There are four wrong courses: one goes the wrong course through desire, one goes the wrong course through hatred, one goes the wrong course through delusion, one goes the wrong course through fear.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ chaṭṭhī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，有众生完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识无边’而到达识无边处。此为第六识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who, by completely transcending the dimension of infinite space, aware that ‘consciousness is infinite,’ have reached the dimension of infinite consciousness. This is the sixth station of consciousness.

rows.pali: 337 . ‘‘Aṭṭha dānūpapattiyo . Idhāvuso, ekacco dānaṃ deti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṃ. So yaṃ deti taṃ paccāsīsati paccāsiṃsati (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) . So passati khattiyamahāsālaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya’nti! So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti, tassa taṃ cittaṃ hīne vimuttaṃ uttari abhāvitaṃ tatrūpapattiyā saṃvattati . Tañca kho sīlavato vadāmi no dussīlassa. Ijjhatāvuso, sīlavato cetopaṇidhi visuddhattā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 337. 贤友，有八种布施所生的趣处。在此，贤友，有人布施饮食、衣物、车乘、花环、香、涂香、床座、住所、灯具给沙门或婆罗门。他布施时有所期求。他看见刹帝利大富、婆罗门大富或居士大富，受用着圆满具足的五种欲乐。他这样想：‘啊，愿我身坏命终之后，能投生为刹帝利大富、婆罗门大富或居士大富的同伴！’他确立彼心，坚持彼心，培育彼心。他的那个心，倾向于低劣者，未向更高者培育，这导致他投生到那里。我说是对有戒者而言，非对无戒者。贤友，有戒者的心愿因清净而得以成就。
rows.english: 337. There are eight kinds of rebirth resulting from giving. Here, friends, a certain person gives a gift to a recluse or a brahmin: food, drink, clothing, a vehicle, garlands, scents, and ointments, a bed, a dwelling, and a lamp. What he gives, he hopes for in return. He sees wealthy nobles, wealthy brahmins, or wealthy householders furnished and endowed with, and enjoying, the five strands of sensual pleasure. To him, this thought occurs: ‘Oh, that on the dissolution of the body, after death, I might be reborn in the company of wealthy nobles, wealthy brahmins, or wealthy householders!’ He establishes that thought, resolves upon that thought, and develops that thought. That thought of his, being inclined towards the inferior and not developed for what is higher, conduces to rebirth there. And this, I say, is for one who is virtuous, not for one who is unvirtuous. Friends, the aspiration of the virtuous succeeds on account of its purity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Tīṇi kathāvatthūni – atītaṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya – ‘evaṃ ahosi atītamaddhāna’nti; anāgataṃ vā addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya – ‘evaṃ bhavissati anāgatamaddhāna’nti; etarahi vā paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya – ‘evaṃ hoti etarahi paccuppannaṃ addhāna’nti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 三论事：或缘于过去时而说：‘过去曾如是’；或缘于未来时而说：‘未来将如是’；或缘于现在时而说：‘现在正乃如是’。
rows.english: Three grounds for talk: one might speak with reference to the past, saying, ‘Thus it was in the past’; or one might speak with reference to the future, saying, ‘Thus it will be in the future’; or one might speak with reference to the present, saying, ‘Thus it is now in the present.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime dasa dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如是，此十法是实有、谛实、如是、不虚妄、不变异的，为如来所正等觉。”
rows.english: Thus, these ten Dhammas are real, actual, true, not otherwise, and unalterable; they have been perfectly and fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime vīsati dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如此，这二十法是存在的、真实的、如实的、不虚妄的、无异的，已被如来正等觉悟。
rows.english: Thus, these twenty Dhammas are real, actual, true, not otherwise, and unalterable; they have been perfectly and fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime tiṃsa dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，此三十法是真实、确凿、如是、不虚、不异，为如来所正等觉。
rows.english: Thus, these thirty states are actual, factual, thus, unfalsified, unalterable, and have been perfectly, fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime cattārīsadhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，此四十法是真实(bhūtā)、谛实(tacchā)、如是(tathā)、不虚(avitathā)、不异(anaññathā)，为如来所正等觉。
rows.english: Thus, these forty states are actual, factual, thus, unfalsified, unalterable, and have been perfectly, fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime paññāsa dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如是，此五十法是真实的、确凿的、如是的、不虚妄的、不异的，为如来所正等觉。”
rows.english: Thus, these fifty dhammas are real, actual, unerring, unfalsified, not otherwise, and have been rightly and fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘的慈语业……乃至……导向合一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu maintains a verbal action of loving-kindness... it is conducive to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno mettaṃ manokammaṃ…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘的慈意业……乃至……导向合一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu maintains a mental action of loving-kindness... it is conducive to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattampi, tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对于所有如法、依法获得的利养，乃至仅有入于钵中的食物，皆与具戒的同梵行者们不分别而受用，共同受用。此法亦应忆念……乃至……导向合一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, whatever gains a bhikkhu has that are righteous, obtained righteously, even down to the contents of his alms-bowl, with such gains he is one who partakes without apportionment, who partakes in common with his virtuous fellow practitioners. This dhamma, too, is a state to be remembered... it is conducive to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu, yāni tāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni, tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi ceva raho ca, ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo…pe… ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对于那些不破、无穿、无斑、无杂、自在、为智者所称赞、不被执取、导向禅定的戒，于此等戒，与同梵行者们，无论公开或私下，皆戒行等同而住。此法亦应忆念……乃至……导向合一。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu dwells in commonality of virtue with his fellow practitioners, both openly and in private, in regard to those virtues that are unbroken, flawless, spotless, unblotched, liberating, praised by the wise, ungrasped, and conducive to concentration. This dhamma, too, is a state to be remembered... it is conducive to unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca, ye dūre santike ca.
rows.chinese_simplified: 以清净、超人之天耳界，听闻天上与人间二种声音，无论远近。
rows.english: “With the divine ear element, which is purified and surpasses the human, he hears both kinds of sounds, divine and human, whether far or near.”

rows.pali: ‘‘So anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathidaṃ ekampi jātiṃ…pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
rows.chinese_simplified: 他忆念起多种多样的宿世住处，即：一生……乃至……像这样，他忆念起多种多样的、有行相、有概述的宿世住处。
rows.english: “He recollects his manifold past lives, that is, one birth… Thus with their aspects and details he recollects his manifold past lives.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti …pe…
rows.chinese_simplified: 他以清净、超越凡人的天眼，看见众生死亡、再生，卑劣、高贵，美色、丑色，善趣、恶趣，他了知众生随业而往……
rows.english: With the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, he sees beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, beautiful and ugly, fortunate and unfortunate—and he knows beings as they fare according to their kamma…

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime saṭṭhi dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，这六十法是真实的、确凿的、不谬的、不虚妄的、不变异的，为如来所正等觉。
rows.english: Thus, these sixty dhammas are actual, real, unerring, unperverted, and not otherwise, rightly and fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Itime sattati dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 如是，此等七十法是真实的、确凿的、如是的、不虚妄的、不变异的，为如来所正等觉。
rows.english: Thus, these seventy phenomena are real, true, thus, not unreal, not otherwise, and are perfectly awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime asīti dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如是，此八十法是真实的、确实的、如是的、不虚妄的、不相异的，为如来所正等觉。”
rows.english: Thus, these eighty states are actual, real, true, not false, not otherwise, rightly fully realized by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime navuti dhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如是，此等九十法是真实、不虚、如实、不谬、不异的，为如来所正等觉。”
rows.english: Thus, these ninety things are actual, true, real, unfailing, not otherwise, and have been rightly and fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.

rows.pali: Tīhi vaggehi paṭimaṇḍito sakalo
rows.chinese_simplified: 全由三品庄严之
rows.english: Adorned with three vaggas, the entire

rows.pali: 351 . ‘‘Eko, āvuso, dhammo bahukāro, eko dhammo bhāvetabbo, eko dhammo pariññeyyo, eko dhammo pahātabbo, eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo, eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo, eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho, eko dhammo uppādetabbo, eko dhammo abhiññeyyo, eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 351. 诸贤友，有一法多所助益，有一法应修习，有一法应遍知，有一法应断除，有一法导向衰退，有一法导向殊胜，有一法难以通达，有一法应生起，有一法应证知，有一法应作证。
rows.english: 351. Friends, one Dhamma is of great benefit, one Dhamma is to be developed, one Dhamma is to be fully understood, one Dhamma is to be abandoned, one Dhamma partakes of decline, one Dhamma partakes of distinction, one Dhamma is difficult to penetrate, one Dhamma is to be aroused, one Dhamma is to be directly known, one Dhamma is to be realized.

rows.pali: 352 . ‘‘Dve dhammā bahukārā, dve dhammā bhāvetabbā, dve dhammā pariññeyyā, dve dhammā pahātabbā , dve dhammā hānabhāgiyā, dve dhammā visesabhāgiyā, dve dhammā duppaṭivijjhā, dve dhammā uppādetabbā, dve dhammā abhiññeyyā, dve dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 352. “二法多所助益，二法应修习，二法应遍知，二法应断除，二法为衰退分，二法为殊胜分，二法难以彻知，二法应生起，二法应胜知，二法应作证。”
rows.english: 352. Two Dhammas are of great benefit, two Dhammas are to be developed, two Dhammas are to be fully understood, two Dhammas are to be abandoned, two Dhammas partake of decline, two Dhammas partake of distinction, two Dhammas are difficult to penetrate, two Dhammas are to be aroused, two Dhammas are to be directly known, two Dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame cha dhammā sacchikātabbā? Cha abhiññā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti – ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti , bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti. Āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ. Tirokuṭṭaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse . Pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake. Udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi pathaviyaṃ. Ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. Imepi candimasūriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parāmasati parimajjati. Yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
rows.chinese_simplified: （癸）“哪六法应被现证？六神通。贤友，在此，比丘行使种种神通之力：由一变多，由多变一；或显或隐；穿墙、穿壁、穿山，无有障碍，犹如行于虚空；于地出没犹如于水；于水不分而行犹如于地；于空中结跏趺而行犹如飞鸟；以手触摸、抚摩有如是大神力、大威德的日月；乃至以身行使威力至于梵界。
rows.english: (Ña) "What six dhammas are to be realized? The six higher knowledges. Here, friends, a bhikkhu experiences various kinds of psychic power: being one, he becomes many; being many, he becomes one. He appears and vanishes. He goes unhindered through a wall, a rampart, or a mountain as if through space. He dives into and emerges from the earth as if it were water. He walks on water without breaking through as if on earth. He travels cross-legged in the sky like a winged bird. He touches and strokes with his hand these moon and sun, so mighty and powerful. He exercises mastery with his body even as far as the Brahmā world."

rows.pali: 353 . ‘‘Tayo dhammā bahukārā, tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā…pe… tayo dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 353. 三法多所饶益，三法应修习……（略）……三法应作证。
rows.english: 353. Three Dhammas are of great benefit, three Dhammas are to be developed… and so on… three Dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: 354 . ‘‘Cattāro dhammā bahukārā, cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā…pe… cattāro dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 354. 四法多所饶益，四法应修习……四法应现证。
rows.english: 354. Four states are of great service, four states are to be developed... four states are to be realized.

rows.pali: 355 . ‘‘Pañca dhammā bahukārā…pe… pañca dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 355. “五法多有助益……乃至……五法应被现证。”
rows.english: 355. Five states are of great benefit… five states are to be realized.

rows.pali: 356 . ‘‘Cha dhammā bahukārā…pe… cha dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 356. “六法有大助益……乃至……六法应现证。”
rows.english: 356. Six dhammas are very helpful... six dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: 357 . ‘‘Satta dhammā bahukārā…pe… satta dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 357. 七法有大助益……七法应当被亲证。
rows.english: 357. Seven dhammas are of great service... seven dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: 358 . ‘‘Aṭṭha dhammā bahukārā…pe… aṭṭha dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 358. 八法多所饶益……八法应被亲证。
rows.english: 358. Eight phenomena are of great help... eight phenomena are to be realized.

rows.pali: 359 . ‘‘Nava dhammā bahukārā…pe… nava dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 359. “九法多所助益……（中略）……九法应被亲证。”
rows.english: 359. Nine states are of great benefit... nine states are to be realized.

rows.pali: 360 . ‘‘Dasa dhammā bahukārā…pe… dasa dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 360. “十法多有助益……十法应予现证。”
rows.english: 360. Ten things are of great benefit... ten things are to be realized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ catuttho vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “遍超色想，有对想灭，不作意种种想，以‘虚空无边’，成就空无边处而住。这是第四解脱。”
rows.english: With the complete surmounting of perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of sensory impact, with non-attention to perceptions of diversity, aware that ‘space is infinite,’ one enters and dwells in the dimension of infinite space. This is the fourth liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ chaṭṭho sattāvāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有情完全超越色想，灭除有对想，不作意种种想，而到达‘虚空无边’的空无边处（ākāsānañcāyatana）。这是第六有情居。
rows.english: Friends, there are beings who, by completely transcending perceptions of form, with the disappearance of perceptions of resistance, and by not attending to perceptions of diversity, have reached the base of infinite space, perceiving, ‘Space is infinite.’ This is the sixth abode of beings.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame satta dhammā sacchikātabbā? Satta khīṇāsavabalāni – idhāvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aniccato sabbe saṅkhārā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti. Yaṃpāvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aniccato sabbe saṅkhārā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti, idampi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti, yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti – ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何为应亲证的七法？七漏尽力。贤友，于此，漏尽比丘以正慧如实善见诸行无常。贤友，漏尽比丘以正慧如实善见诸行无常，此亦为漏尽比丘之力，依此力，漏尽比丘宣称诸漏已尽：‘我诸漏已尽。’”
rows.english: (J) What seven dhammas are to be realized? The seven powers of one whose taints are destroyed: Here, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, all formations are well seen with right wisdom as they actually are: as impermanent. That, friends, which for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed is that all formations are well seen with right wisdom as they actually are, as impermanent, this is a power of the bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed. Relying on this power, the bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed professes the destruction of the taints: ‘My taints are destroyed.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā…pe… ‘ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ pañcamī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有众生完全超越一切色想……达到‘虚空无边’的空无边处。这是第五识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who, by completely surmounting perceptions of form... perceiving, ‘Space is infinite,’ have reached the base of the infinity of space. This is the fifth station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ chaṭṭho vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “遍超识无边处，以‘无所有’，成就无所有处而住。这是第六解脱。”
rows.english: Having entirely transcended the dimension of infinite consciousness, aware that ‘there is nothing,’ one enters and dwells in the dimension of nothingness. This is the sixth liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ aṭṭhamo sattāvāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有情完全超越识无边处，而到达‘一无所有’的无所有处（ākiñcaññāyatana）。这是第八有情居。
rows.english: Friends, there are beings who, by completely transcending the base of infinite consciousness, have reached the base of nothingness, perceiving, ‘There is nothing.’ This is the eighth abode of beings.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso , sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathāpi devā brahmakāyikā paṭhamābhinibbattā. Ayaṃ dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有众生身异想一，例如最初出生的梵众天。这是第二识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings with diverse bodies and unified perception, such as the devas of Brahmā’s retinue who are first arisen. This is the second station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ vivekaṭṭhaṃ nekkhammābhirataṃ byantībhūtaṃ sabbaso āsavaṭṭhāniyehi dhammehi. Yaṃpāvuso…pe… ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，漏尽比丘的心倾向涅槃、趋向涅槃、趣向涅槃、安住涅槃、乐于出离，于一切漏处法已作终结。贤友，这也是漏尽比丘的力量，依靠此力，漏尽比丘了知诸漏已尽：‘我诸漏已尽。’
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, his mind is inclined to seclusion, sloping towards seclusion, tending towards seclusion, established in seclusion, delighting in renunciation, and is rid of all things that are a basis for the taints. For which reason, friends... he knows distinctly, 'My taints are destroyed.'

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti – evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ dutiyaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某人于内有色想，外观无量善色、恶色之色，有如是想：‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见。’此是第二胜处。
rows.english: One, percipient of form internally, sees external forms that are immeasurable, of good and bad appearance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the second base of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ tatiyaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某人于内无色想，外观少量善色、恶色之色，有如是想：‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见。’此是第三胜处。
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are limited, of good and bad appearance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the third base of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ catutthaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某人于内无色想，外观无量善色、恶色之色，有如是想：‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见。’此是第四胜处。
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are immeasurable, of good and bad appearance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the fourth base of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu satimā hoti, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘具念，具足最上之念与慧，能忆念、能随念久远所作、久远所说。诸贤友，比丘……能忆念、能随念久远所作、久远所说，此法亦能作为依止。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is mindful, endowed with supreme mindfulness and sagacity, able to remember and recollect what was done and said long ago. That a bhikkhu... this too is a refuge-making quality.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā ekattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathāpi devā ābhassarā. Ayaṃ tatiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有众生身一想异，例如光音天。这是第三识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings with unified bodies and diverse perceptions, such as the devas of Streaming Radiance. This is the third station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā ekattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā. Ayaṃ catutthī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有众生身一想一，例如遍净天的天神。这是第四识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings with unified bodies and unified perception, such as the devas of Refulgent Glory. This is the fourth station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā asaññino appaṭisaṃvedino, seyyathāpi devā asaññasattā. Ayaṃ pañcamo sattāvāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有情无想、无感受，例如无想有情（asaññasattā）天神。这是第五有情居。
rows.english: Friends, there are beings who are non-percipient and do not experience feeling, such as the non-percipient devas. This is the fifth abode of beings.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati…pe… kusalesu dhammesu. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘发起精进……于诸善法而住。诸贤友，比丘……此法亦能作为依止。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu dwells with aroused energy... in wholesome qualities. That a bhikkhu... this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Dasa ariyavāsā – idhāvuso , bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ekārakkho, caturāpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭhesano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.
rows.chinese_simplified: （六）“什么是十种难通达之法？十种圣住。贤友，于此，比丘已断五支，具足六支，具足一守护，具足四依止，已舍离种种谛，寻觅已止息，思惟无浊，身行已寂止，心善解脱，慧善解脱。”
rows.english: (Cha) What are the ten qualities that are difficult to penetrate? The ten noble abodes. Here, friends, a bhikkhu has abandoned five factors, is endowed with six factors, has a single guard, has four supports, has dispelled individual truths, has abandoned all quests, has untroubled intentions, has calmed bodily formations, is well-liberated in mind, and is well-liberated in wisdom.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ , tassa me kāyo lahuko kammañño, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… idaṃ pañcamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘为乞食行于村或镇，不得随意饱足之粗或美食。他如是思惟：‘我为乞食行于村或镇，未得随意饱足之粗或美食，我身轻快堪任。我当发起精进！’……此是第五发起精进事。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a bhikkhu, while wandering for alms in a village or a town, does not obtain his fill of coarse or fine food, as much as he desires. It occurs to him: ‘While wandering for alms in a village or a town, I did not obtain my fill of coarse or fine food, as much as I desired. My body is light and fit for work. Come now, I shall arouse energy…’ This is the fifth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati. Ayaṃ dutiyo vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于内无色想者，外观诸色。这是第二解脱。”
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees forms externally. This is the second liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ sattamo vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “遍超无所有处，成就非想非非想处而住。这是第七解脱。”
rows.english: Having entirely transcended the dimension of nothingness, one enters and dwells in the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception. This is the seventh liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhā honti. Yaṃpāvuso…pe… ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，漏尽比丘以正慧如实善见诸欲犹如炭火坑。贤友，……乃至……‘我诸漏已尽。’”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, sensual pleasures are well seen with right wisdom as they actually are: as comparable to a pit of glowing embers. That, friends… ‘My taints are destroyed.’

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ , tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño, māsācitaṃ maññe, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati…pe… idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘进入村庄或市镇乞食，获得粗劣或精美的食物，直至饱足。他如此想：‘我进入村庄或市镇乞食，获得了粗劣或精美的食物，直至饱足，我的身体沉重，不适于作业，我想，犹如豆子堆积，我应躺下。’于是他躺下……这是第六懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, while walking for alms in a village or town, obtains his fill of coarse or fine food. It occurs to him: ‘While walking for alms in a village or town, I have obtained my fill of coarse or fine food. My body is heavy and unfit for work, as if stuffed with beans. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down… This is the sixth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘maggo kho me gantabbo bhavissati, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… idaṃ tatiyaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘当行路。他如是思惟：‘我当行路，然我行路时，不易作意诸佛之教。我当发起精进！’……此是第三发起精进事。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a bhikkhu has a journey to make. It occurs to him: ‘I will have a journey to make, and while traveling, it will not be easy to bear in mind the teaching of the Buddhas. Come now, I shall arouse energy…’ This is the third ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā honti subhāvitā . Yaṃpāvuso…pe… ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，漏尽比丘的四念处已修习、善修习。贤友，这也是漏尽比丘的力量，依靠此力，漏尽比丘了知诸漏已尽：‘我诸漏已尽。’
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, the four establishments of mindfulness are developed and well developed. For which reason, friends... he knows distinctly, 'My taints are destroyed.'

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā honti subhāvitā. Yaṃpāvuso…pe… ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，漏尽比丘的七觉支已修习、善修习。贤友，这也是漏尽比丘的力量，依靠此力，漏尽比丘了知诸漏已尽：‘我诸漏已尽。’
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, the seven factors of enlightenment are cultivated and well cultivated. For which reason, friends... he knows distinctly, 'My taints are destroyed.'

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itarītarehi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu …pe… ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘于任何衣、食、住处、病缘医药资具，皆能知足。诸贤友，比丘……皆能知足，此法亦能作为依止。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is content with whatever robes, almsfood, lodging, and medicinal requisites for the sick he may get. That a bhikkhu... this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ appamattako ābādho ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ me ābādho pavaḍḍheyya, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… idaṃ sattamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘生起少许疾病。他如此想：‘我生起了这少许疾病，此病有加重的可能。那么，我当发起精进……’这是第七发起精进事。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a minor illness has arisen in a bhikkhu. It occurs to him: ‘This minor illness has arisen in me. There is a possibility that my illness might worsen. Come now, I shall arouse energy…’ This is the seventh ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Aṭṭha ārambhavatthūni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ hoti, tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘kammaṃ kho me kātabbaṃ bhavissati, kammaṃ kho pana me karontena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti. So vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 哪些是八种殊胜分法？是八种精进事。贤友，在此，比丘有应做之事，他如此想：‘我将有应做之事，而当我在做事时，不易作意佛陀的教法。我应为证得未曾证得者，为获得未曾获得者，为现证未曾现证者而发起精进。’他为证得未曾证得者，为获得未曾获得者，为现证未曾现证者而发起精进。这是第一精进事。
rows.english: What are the eight qualities that partake of distinction? The eight grounds for arousing effort. Here, friends, a bhikkhu has work to do, and it occurs to him: ‘I will have work to do, and while doing it, it will not be easy to attend to the teaching of the Buddhas. Let me arouse energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized.’ So he arouses energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized. This is the first ground for arousing effort.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo pahātabbo? Asmimāno. Ayaṃ eko dhammo pahātabbo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （四）何为应断除之一法？‘我是’之我慢。此即应断除之一法。
rows.english: (d) Which one Dhamma is to be abandoned? The conceit 'I am.' This one Dhamma is to be abandoned.

rows.pali: ‘‘Taṃ kho pana dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti – kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca. Ayaṃ tatiyo hetu tatiyo paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “听闻此法后，以两种远离而成就：身的远离与心的远离。此是第三因、第三缘，能令未获得的初梵行慧得以获得，已获得的得以增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: Having heard that Dhamma, he accomplishes a twofold seclusion: seclusion of body and seclusion of mind. This is the third cause, the third condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ, kammaṃ kho panāhaṃ karonto nāsakkhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… idaṃ dutiyaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘已作业。他如是思惟：‘我已作业，然我作业时，未能作意诸佛之教。我当发起精进！’……此是第二发起精进事。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a bhikkhu has done some work. It occurs to him: ‘I have done work, but while doing it, I was unable to bear in mind the teaching of the Buddhas. Come now, I shall arouse energy…’ This is the second ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame satta dhammā pariññeyyā? Satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo – santāvuso, sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā. Ayaṃ paṭhamā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: （丙）“哪些是应当遍知的七法？七识住：贤友，有众生身异想异，例如人类、某些天神以及某些堕处众生。这是第一识住。
rows.english: (C) What seven dhammas are to be fully understood? The seven stations of consciousness: There are, friends, beings with diverse bodies and diverse perceptions, such as humans, some devas, and some beings in the states of deprivation. This is the first station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satārakkhena cetasā samannāgato hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu ekārakkho hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是具一守护者？贤友，于此，比丘具足为念所守护之心。贤友，比丘如是为具一守护者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who has one guard? Here, friends, a bhikkhu is endowed with a mind guarded by mindfulness. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one who has one guard.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā abhiññeyyā? Aṭṭha abhibhāyatanāni – ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni , ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti – evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 应遍知哪八法？八胜处：某人于内有色想，外观少量善色、恶色之色，有如是想：‘我已胜伏彼等，我知，我见。’此是第一胜处。
rows.english: What eight qualities are to be directly known? The eight bases of mastery. One, percipient of form internally, sees external forms that are limited, of good and bad appearance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the first base of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ, maggaṃ kho panāhaṃ gacchanto nāsakkhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… idaṃ catutthaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘已行路。他如是思惟：‘我已行路，然我行路时，未能作意诸佛之教。我当发起精进！’……此是第四发起精进事。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a bhikkhu has gone on a journey. It occurs to him: ‘I have gone on a journey, but while traveling, I was unable to bear in mind the teaching of the Buddhas. Come now, I shall arouse energy…’ This is the fourth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato. Cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā. Ayaṃ sattamo hetu sattamo paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘具念，成就最高的念与明辨，能忆念、随念久远所作、久远所说之事。此是第七因，第七缘，有助于获得未得之初梵行慧，并使已得之慧增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is mindful, endowed with supreme mindfulness and discretion, able to remember and recollect what was done and said long ago. This is the seventh cause, the seventh condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ. Seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ pañcamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某人于内有无色想，观外诸色为青、青色、青见、青光。譬如乌摩花(umāpuppha)，是青、青色、青见、青光。又如迦尸国(Bārāṇasī)所制之衣，两面光洁，是青、青色、青见、青光。如是，某人于内有无色想，观外诸色为青、青色、青见、青光，有‘我胜解彼等，我知、我见’之想。此为第五胜处。
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are blue, blue in color, blue in appearance, blue in radiance. Just as a flax flower is blue, blue in color, blue in appearance, blue in radiance, or just as a cloth from Benares, smoothed on both sides, is blue, blue in color, blue in appearance, blue in radiance; even so, not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are blue, blue in color, blue in appearance, blue in radiance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the fifth base of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati pītāni pītavaṇṇāni pītanidassanāni pītanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma kaṇikārapupphaṃ pītaṃ pītavaṇṇaṃ pītanidassanaṃ pītanibhāsaṃ. Seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ pītaṃ pītavaṇṇaṃ pītanidassanaṃ pītanibhāsaṃ , evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati pītāni pītavaṇṇāni pītanidassanāni pītanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某人于内有无色想，观外诸色为黄、黄色、黄见、黄光。譬如迦尼迦罗花(kaṇikārapuppha)，是黄、黄色、黄见、黄光。又如迦尸国(Bārāṇasī)所制之衣，两面光洁，是黄、黄色、黄见、黄光。如是，某人于内有无色想，观外诸色为黄、黄色、黄见、黄光，有‘我胜解彼等，我知、我见’之想。此为第六胜处。
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are yellow, yellow in color, yellow in appearance, yellow in radiance. Just as a kaṇikāra flower is yellow, yellow in color, yellow in appearance, yellow in radiance, or just as a cloth from Benares, smoothed on both sides, is yellow, yellow in color, yellow in appearance, yellow in radiance; even so, not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are yellow, yellow in color, yellow in appearance, yellow in radiance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the sixth base of mastery.

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati lohitakāni lohitakavaṇṇāni lohitakanidassanāni lohitakanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma bandhujīvakapupphaṃ lohitakaṃ lohitakavaṇṇaṃ lohitakanidassanaṃ lohitakanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ lohitakaṃ lohitakavaṇṇaṃ lohitakanidassanaṃ lohitakanibhāsaṃ, evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati lohitakāni lohitakavaṇṇāni lohitakanidassanāni lohitakanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ sattamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 某人于内有无色想，观外诸色为赤、赤色、赤见、赤光。譬如槃陀耆婆花(bandhujīvakapuppha)，是赤、赤色、赤见、赤光。又如迦尸国(Bārāṇasī)所制之衣，两面光洁，是赤、赤色、赤见、赤光。如是，某人于内有无色想，观外诸色为赤、赤色、赤见、赤光，有‘我胜解彼等，我知、我见’之想。此为第七胜处。
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are red, red in color, red in appearance, red in radiance. Just as a bandhujīvaka flower is red, red in color, red in appearance, red in radiance, or just as a cloth from Benares, smoothed on both sides, is red, red in color, red in appearance, red in radiance; even so, not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are red, red in color, red in appearance, red in radiance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the seventh base of mastery.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo bhāvetabbo? Kāyagatāsati sātasahagatā. Ayaṃ eko dhammo bhāvetabbo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （二）何为应修习之一法？伴随喜悦之身至念。此即应修习之一法。
rows.english: (b) Which one Dhamma is to be developed? Mindfulness directed to the body, accompanied by pleasure. This one Dhamma is to be developed.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo? Ayoniso manasikāro. Ayaṃ eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （五）何为导向衰退之一法？不如理作意。此即导向衰退之一法。
rows.english: (e) Which one Dhamma partakes of decline? Unwise attention. This one Dhamma partakes of decline.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo? Yoniso manasikāro. Ayaṃ eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （六）何为导向殊胜之一法？如理作意。此即导向殊胜之一法。
rows.english: (f) Which one Dhamma partakes of distinction? Wise attention. This one Dhamma partakes of distinction.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho? Ānantariko cetosamādhi. Ayaṃ eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho.
rows.chinese_simplified: （七）“何为难以彻知之一法？无间心定。此为难以彻知之一法。”
rows.english: (g) Which one Dhamma is difficult to penetrate? The immediate concentration of mind. This one Dhamma is difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo uppādetabbo? Akuppaṃ ñāṇaṃ. Ayaṃ eko dhammo uppādetabbo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （八）“何为应生起之一法？不动智。此为应生起之一法。”
rows.english: (h) Which one Dhamma is to be aroused? Unshakable knowledge. This one Dhamma is to be aroused.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo sacchikātabbo? Akuppā cetovimutti. Ayaṃ eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （十）“何为应作证之一法？不动心解脱。此为应作证之一法。”
rows.english: (j) Which one Dhamma is to be realized? The unshakable liberation of mind. This one Dhamma is to be realized.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame dve dhammā pariññeyyā? Nāmañca rūpañca. Ime dve dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （三）“何为应遍知之二法？名与色。此为应遍知之二法。”
rows.english: (c) What two Dhammas are to be fully understood? Mentality and materiality. These two Dhammas are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame dve dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Sovacassatā ca kalyāṇamittatā ca. Ime dve dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （六）“何为殊胜分之二法？易教诫与善友。此为殊胜分之二法。”
rows.english: (f) What two Dhammas partake of distinction? Being easy to admonish and having good friends. These two Dhammas partake of distinction.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, tassa me kāyo kilanto akammañño, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti…pe… idaṃ pañcamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘到村落或城镇乞食，未获得足量的粗劣或上妙食物。他这样想：‘我到村落或城镇乞食，没有获得足量的粗劣或上妙食物，我的身体疲劳且不适于工作，我还是躺下吧。’……这是第五种懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu, while walking for alms in a village or town, does not obtain his fill of coarse or fine food. It occurs to him: ‘While walking for alms in a village or town, I did not obtain my fill of coarse or fine food. My body is tired and unfit for work. Suppose I lie down.’ … This is the fifth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. Ayaṃ catuttho hetu catuttho paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘具戒，住于守护波罗提木叉，具足正行与行处，于微细罪中见其怖畏，于诸学处受持而学。此是第四因，第四缘，有助于获得未得之初梵行慧，并使已得之慧增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is virtuous; he dwells restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint, is endowed with right conduct and resort, and sees danger in the slightest faults. He trains by undertaking the training rules. This is the fourth cause, the fourth condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. Ayaṃ chaṭṭho hetu chaṭṭho paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘发起精进而住，以断除诸不善法、具足诸善法；他强健、勇猛精进，于诸善法不舍重担。此是第六因，第六缘，有助于获得未得之初梵行慧，并使已得之慧增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu dwells with energy aroused for the abandoning of unwholesome phenomena and for the attainment of wholesome phenomena; he is strong, steadfast in exertion, and does not throw off the burden in regard to wholesome phenomena. This is the sixth cause, the sixth condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ayaṃ aṭṭhamo vimokkho. Ime aṭṭha dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “遍超非想非非想处，成就想受灭而住。这是第八解脱。这八法应被现证。”
rows.english: Having entirely transcended the base of neither perception nor non-perception, one enters and dwells in the cessation of perception and feeling. This is the eighth liberation. These eight states are to be realized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu caturāpasseno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是具四依止者？贤友，于此，比丘审察后受用其一，审察后忍受其一，审察后回避其一，审察后遣除其一。贤友，比丘如是为具四依止者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who has four supports? Here, friends, a bhikkhu, with reflection, makes use of something; with reflection, he endures something; with reflection, he avoids something; with reflection, he dispels something. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one who has four supports.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno na heva kho satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, nāpi yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, nāpi yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti. Api ca kho, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati. Yathā yathā , āvuso , bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthappaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ catutthaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘并非导师为他说法，也并非其他可敬的同梵行者为他说法，也并非将自己所闻所学之法广为他人宣说，也并非广为讽诵自己所闻所学之法，而是他以心随寻、随伺、以意随观自己所闻所学之法。贤友，比丘每当如此以心随寻、随伺、以意随观自己所闻所学之法时，他便能于该法中感知其义，感知其法。当他感知其义、感知其法时，便生起欢悦；心生欢悦，则生起喜；心喜时，身轻安；身轻安时，感受乐；有乐者，心入定。这是第四解脱处。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, the Teacher does not teach the Dhamma to the bhikkhu, nor does a respected fellow in the holy life; nor does the bhikkhu teach the Dhamma in detail to others as he has heard it and as he has learned it, nor does he recite it in detail. But rather, he mentally considers, examines, and contemplates the Dhamma as he has heard it and as he has learned it. In whatever way, friends, the bhikkhu mentally considers, examines, and contemplates the Dhamma as he has heard it and as he has learned it, in that way, in that Dhamma, he becomes one who experiences the meaning and one who experiences the Dhamma. For him, who experiences the meaning and experiences the Dhamma, joy arises. For one who is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. With a tranquil body, he feels happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the fourth ground for liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… pettivisayaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ tatiyo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……投生于饿鬼界。这是第三种为修习梵行的无暇与非时。
rows.english: Furthermore… he has been reborn in the realm of the petas. This is the third inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘maggo kho me gantabbo bhavissati, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilamissati, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati…pe… idaṃ tatiyaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘将要远行，他这样想：‘我将要远行，而远行时我的身体将会疲劳，我还是躺下吧。’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第三种懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has a journey to make. It occurs to him: ‘I will have a journey to make, and while traveling, my body will become tired. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the third ground for laziness.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo bahukāro? Appamādo kusalesu dhammesu. Ayaṃ eko dhammo bahukāro.
rows.chinese_simplified: （一）何为多所助益之一法？于诸善法不放逸。此即多所助益之一法。
rows.english: (a) Which one Dhamma is of great benefit? Heedfulness in wholesome qualities. This one Dhamma is of great benefit.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo pariññeyyo? Phasso sāsavo upādāniyo. Ayaṃ eko dhammo pariññeyyo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （三）何为应遍知之一法？有漏且能引生执取之触。此即应遍知之一法。
rows.english: (c) Which one Dhamma is to be fully understood? Contact that is tainted and a basis for clinging. This one Dhamma is to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katamo eko dhammo abhiññeyyo? Sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā. Ayaṃ eko dhammo abhiññeyyo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （九）“何为应胜知之一法？一切有情依食而住。此为应胜知之一法。”
rows.english: (i) Which one Dhamma is to be directly known? All beings are sustained by nutriment. This one Dhamma is to be directly known.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame dve dhammā bahukārā? Sati ca sampajaññañca. Ime dve dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （一）“何为多所助益之二法？念与正知。此为多所助益之二法。”
rows.english: (a) What two Dhammas are of great benefit? Mindfulness and clear comprehension. These two Dhammas are of great benefit.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame dve dhammā bhāvetabbā? Samatho ca vipassanā ca. Ime dve dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （二）“何为应修习之二法？止与观。此为应修习之二法。”
rows.english: (b) What two Dhammas are to be developed? Serenity and insight. These two Dhammas are to be developed.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame dve dhammā pahātabbā? Avijjā ca bhavataṇhā ca. Ime dve dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （四）“何为应断除之二法？无明与有爱。此为应断除之二法。”
rows.english: (d) What two Dhammas are to be abandoned? Ignorance and craving for existence. These two Dhammas are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame dve dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Dovacassatā ca pāpamittatā ca. Ime dve dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （五）“何为衰退分之二法？难教诫与恶友。此为衰退分之二法。”
rows.english: (e) What two Dhammas partake of decline? Being difficult to admonish and having bad friends. These two Dhammas partake of decline.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame dve dhammā sacchikātabbā? Vijjā ca vimutti ca. Ime dve dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （十）哪二法应被作证？明与解脱。此二法应被作证。
rows.english: (j) What two Dhammas are to be realized? True knowledge and liberation. These two Dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā bahukārā? Sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, dhammānudhammappaṭipatti. Ime tayo dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （一）哪三法多所饶益？亲近善士，听闻正法，法随法行。此三法多所饶益。
rows.english: (a) What three Dhammas are of great benefit? Associating with true persons, listening to the true Dhamma, and practicing in accordance with the Dhamma. These three Dhammas are of great benefit.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmesanā pahīnā hoti, bhavesanā pahīnā hoti, brahmacariyesanā paṭippassaddhā. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭhesano hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是寻已止息者呢？贤友，于此，比丘的欲寻已被断除，有寻已被断除，梵行寻已寂止。贤友，比丘如是成为寻已止息者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one whose quests are allayed and discarded? Here, friends, for a bhikkhu the quest for sensual pleasures is abandoned, the quest for existence is abandoned, and the quest for the holy life is calmed. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one whose quests are allayed and discarded.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso , bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappā hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmasaṅkappo pahīno hoti, byāpādasaṅkappo pahīno hoti, vihiṃsāsaṅkappo pahīno hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu anāvilasaṅkappo hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是思惟无浊者呢？贤友，于此，比丘的欲思惟已被断除，瞋思惟已被断除，害思惟已被断除。贤友，比丘如是成为思惟无浊者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one with untroubled intentions? Here, friends, a bhikkhu has abandoned sensual intentions, abandoned intentions of ill will, and abandoned intentions of cruelty. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one with untroubled intentions.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, dosā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, mohā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttacitto hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是心善解脱者呢？贤友，于此，比丘的心从贪解脱，从瞋解脱，从痴解脱。贤友，比丘如是成为心善解脱者。”
rows.english: “And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one with a well-liberated mind? Here, friends, a bhikkhu’s mind is liberated from lust, liberated from hatred, and liberated from delusion. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one with a well-liberated mind.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno na heva kho satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, nāpi yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti. Api ca kho, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti. Yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthappaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ tatiyaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘并非导师为他说法，也并非其他可敬的同梵行者为他说法，也并非将自己所闻所学之法广为他人宣说，而是他广为讽诵自己所闻所学之法。贤友，比丘每当如此广为讽诵自己所闻所学之法时，他便能于该法中感知其义，感知其法。当他感知其义、感知其法时，便生起欢悦；心生欢悦，则生起喜；心喜时，身轻安；身轻安时，感受乐；有乐者，心入定。这是第三解脱处。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, the Teacher does not teach the Dhamma to the bhikkhu, nor does a respected fellow in the holy life, nor does the bhikkhu teach the Dhamma in detail to others as he has heard it and as he has learned it. But rather, he recites the Dhamma in detail as he has heard it and as he has learned it. In whatever way, friends, the bhikkhu recites the Dhamma in detail as he has heard it and as he has learned it, in that way, in that Dhamma, he becomes one who experiences the meaning and one who experiences the Dhamma. For him, who experiences the meaning and experiences the Dhamma, joy arises. For one who is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. With a tranquil body, he feels happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the third ground for liberation.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame dve dhammā uppādetabbā? Dve ñāṇāni – khaye ñāṇaṃ, anuppāde ñāṇaṃ. Ime dve dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （八）哪二法应被生起？二智：尽智与无生智。此二法应被生起。
rows.english: (h) What two Dhammas are to be aroused? Two kinds of knowledge: the knowledge of destruction and the knowledge of non-arising. These two Dhammas are to be aroused.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ, maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilanto, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati…pe… idaṃ catutthaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘已经远行过了，他这样想：‘我远行过了，我的身体因远行而疲劳了，我还是躺下吧。’于是他躺下，不发起精进……这是第四种懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has made a journey. It occurs to him: ‘I have made a journey, and while traveling, my body became tired. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the fourth ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… aññataraṃ dīghāyukaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ catuttho akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……投生于某一长寿的天众中。这是第四种为修习梵行的无暇与非时。
rows.english: Furthermore… he has been reborn into a certain group of long-lived devas. This is the fourth inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame cha dhammā bahukārā? Cha sāraṇīyā dhammā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi ceva raho ca, ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: （甲）“哪六法有大助益？六和敬法。在此，贤友们，比丘于同梵行者中，无论公开或私下，皆现起慈身业，此法亦令人忆念、令人喜爱、令人尊重，有助于摄受、无诤、和谐、合一。”
rows.english: What six dhammas are very helpful? The six states to be remembered. Here, friends, a bhikkhu maintains a bodily action of loving-kindness toward his fellow practitioners, both openly and in private. This dhamma, too, is a state to be remembered, endearing, inspiring respect, and is conducive to cohesion, non-dispute, concord, and unity.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno vihesaṃ manasikaroto vihesāya cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Avihesaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto avihesāya cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati . Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ vihesāya. Ye ca vihesāpaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi. Na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ vihesāya nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，贤友，比丘作意恼害时，其心于恼害不趋入、不澄净、不安住、不倾注。然而，当他作意无恼害时，其心于无恼害则趋入、澄净、安住、倾注。彼之心善行、善修习、善出离、善解脱，不与恼害相应。凡缘于恼害而生起的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从彼等解脱。他不感受那种感受。此被称为恼害的出离。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to harming, his mind does not enter into, does not become clear about, does not stand firm in, and is not inclined towards harming. But when he attends to harmlessness, his mind enters into, becomes clear about, stands firm in, and is inclined towards harmlessness. That mind of his is well-directed, well-developed, well-risen from, well-liberated from, and disjoined from harming. And those taints, mental weariness, and mental fevers that arise on account of harming—he is liberated from them. He does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from harming.”

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame dve dhammā abhiññeyyā? Dve dhātuyo – saṅkhatā ca dhātu asaṅkhatā ca dhātu. Ime dve dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （九）哪二法应被证知？二界：有为界与无为界。此二法应被证知。
rows.english: (i) What two Dhammas are to be directly known? Two elements: the conditioned element and the unconditioned element. These two Dhammas are to be directly known.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā pariññeyyā? Tisso vedanā – sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā. Ime tayo dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （三）哪三法应遍知？三受：乐受、苦受、不苦不乐受。此三法应遍知。
rows.english: What three states are to be fully understood? Three kinds of feeling: pleasant feeling, painful feeling, and neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling. These three states are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā pahātabbā? Tisso taṇhā – kāmataṇhā, bhavataṇhā, vibhavataṇhā. Ime tayo dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （四）哪三法应断除？三爱：欲爱、有爱、无有爱。此三法应断除。
rows.english: What three states are to be abandoned? Three kinds of craving: craving for sensual pleasures, craving for existence, and craving for non-existence. These three states are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā abhiññeyyā? Tisso dhātuyo – kāmadhātu, rūpadhātu, arūpadhātu. Ime tayo dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Jha) 哪三法应以殊胜智了知？三界：欲界(kāmadhātu)、色界(rūpadhātu)、无色界(arūpadhātu)。此三法应以殊胜智了知。
rows.english: What three states are to be directly known? Three elements: the sense-sphere element, the form-sphere element, and the formless-sphere element. These three states are to be directly known.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā pahātabbā? Cattāro oghā – kāmogho, bhavogho, diṭṭhogho, avijjogho. Ime cattāro dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (丁) 哪四法应断除？四暴流(cattāro oghā)：欲暴流(kāmogho)、有暴流(bhavogho)、见暴流(diṭṭhogho)、无明暴流(avijjogho)。此四法应断除。
rows.english: Which four states are to be abandoned? The four floods: the flood of sensuality, the flood of becoming, the flood of views, and the flood of ignorance. These four states are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Cattāro yogā – kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo. Ime cattāro dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (戊) 哪四法是退分？四轭(cattāro yogā)：欲轭(kāmayogo)、有轭(bhavayogo)、见轭(diṭṭhiyogo)、无明轭(avijjāyogo)。此四法是退分。
rows.english: Which four states partake of decline? The four yokes: the yoke of sensuality, the yoke of becoming, the yoke of views, and the yoke of ignorance. These four states partake of decline.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Cattāro visaññogā – kāmayogavisaṃyogo, bhavayogavisaṃyogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo, avijjāyogavisaṃyogo. Ime cattāro dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (己) 哪四法是胜分？四离轭(cattāro visaṃyogā)：离欲轭(kāmayogavisaṃyogo)、离有轭(bhavayogavisaṃyogo)、离见轭(diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo)、离无明轭(avijjāyogavisaṃyogo)。此四法是胜分。
rows.english: Which four states partake of distinction? The four disjunctions: disjunction from the yoke of sensuality, disjunction from the yoke of becoming, disjunction from the yoke of views, and disjunction from the yoke of ignorance. These four states partake of distinction.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Cattāro samādhī – hānabhāgiyo samādhi, ṭhitibhāgiyo samādhi, visesabhāgiyo samādhi, nibbedhabhāgiyo samādhi. Ime cattāro dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (庚) 哪四法是难通达的？四定(cattāro samādhī)：退分定(hānabhāgiyo samādhi)、住分定(ṭhitibhāgiyo samādhi)、胜分定(visesabhāgiyo samādhi)、决择分定(nibbedhabhāgiyo samādhi)。此四法是难通达的。
rows.english: Which four states are difficult to penetrate? The four concentrations: concentration partaking of decline, concentration partaking of stability, concentration partaking of distinction, and concentration partaking of penetration. These four states are difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā bahukārā? Aṭṭha hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. Katame aṭṭha? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthāraṃ satthāraṃ vā (syā. ka.) upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatthassa tibbaṃ hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañca gāravo ca. Ayaṃ paṭhamo hetu paṭhamo paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya . Paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: （一）“贤友，是哪八种法有大助益？有八因、八缘，能令未获得的初梵行慧得以获得，已获得的得以增长、广大、修习、圆满。是哪八种呢？贤友，于此，比丘依止导师，或依止某位堪为师表的同梵行者而住，对他已现起强烈的惭与愧，以及爱敬与尊重。此是第一因、第一缘，能令未获得的初梵行慧得以获得，已获得的得以增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: What are the eight phenomena that are of great help? There are eight causes, eight conditions that conduce to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained. What eight? Here, friends, a bhikkhu dwells in dependence on the Teacher or on a certain fellow practitioner in a position of respect, towards whom he has established a strong sense of moral shame and moral dread, as well as affection and reverence. This is the first cause, the first condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno na heva kho satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti. Tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthappaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ dutiyaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友们，导师不为比丘说法，某位值得尊敬的同梵行者也不为之说法，而是该比丘将所闻所学的法为他人详细解说。贤友们，该比丘以何种方式将所闻所学的法为他人详细解说，该比丘即以那种方式于法中感知义、感知法。感知义、感知法的他生起欣悦；欣悦者生起喜；喜意者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；乐者心入定。此为第二解脱处。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, the Teacher does not teach the Dhamma to the bhikkhu, nor does a respected fellow in the holy life. But rather, the bhikkhu teaches the Dhamma in detail to others as he has heard it and as he has learned it. In whatever way, friends, the bhikkhu teaches the Dhamma in detail to others as he has heard it and as he has learned it, in that way, in that Dhamma, he becomes one who experiences the meaning and one who experiences the Dhamma. For him, who experiences the meaning and experiences the Dhamma, joy arises. For one who is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. With a tranquil body, he feels happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the second ground for liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso , bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāmacchando pahīno hoti, byāpādo pahīno hoti, thinamiddhaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, vicikicchā pahīnā hoti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu pañcaṅgavippahīno hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是断五支者？贤友，于此，比丘的欲贪已断，瞋恚已断，惛沉、睡眠已断，掉举、恶作已断，疑已断。贤友，比丘如是为断五支者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, has a bhikkhu abandoned five factors? Here, friends, a bhikkhu has abandoned sensual desire, has abandoned ill will, has abandoned sloth and torpor, has abandoned restlessness and remorse, and has abandoned doubt. It is in this way, friends, that a bhikkhu has abandoned five factors.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno byāpādaṃ manasikaroto byāpāde cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Abyāpādaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto abyāpāde cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ byāpādena. Ye ca byāpādapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi. Na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，贤友，比丘作意瞋恚时，其心于瞋恚不趋入、不澄净、不安住、不倾注。然而，当他作意无瞋时，其心于无瞋则趋入、澄净、安住、倾注。彼之心善行、善修习、善出离、善解脱，不与瞋恚相应。凡缘于瞋恚而生起的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从彼等解脱。他不感受那种感受。此被称为瞋恚的出离。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to ill will, his mind does not enter into, does not become clear about, does not stand firm in, and is not inclined towards ill will. But when he attends to non-ill will, his mind enters into, becomes clear about, stands firm in, and is inclined towards non-ill will. That mind of his is well-directed, well-developed, well-risen from, well-liberated from, and disjoined from ill will. And those taints, mental weariness, and mental fevers that arise on account of ill will—he is liberated from them. He does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from ill will.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno rūpe manasikaroto rūpesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Arūpaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto arūpe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ rūpehi. Ye ca rūpapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi. Na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，贤友，比丘作意色时，其心于诸色不趋入、不澄净、不安住、不倾注。然而，当他作意名时，其心于名则趋入、澄净、安住、倾注。彼之心善行、善修习、善出离、善解脱，不与诸色相应。凡缘于色而生起的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从彼等解脱。他不感受那种感受。此被称为诸色的出离。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to forms, his mind does not enter, does not become serene, does not become established, and is not released in regard to forms. But when he attends to the formless, his mind enters, becomes serene, becomes established, and is released in regard to the formless. His mind is thus well-perfected, well-developed, well-risen from, well-released from, and disjoined from forms. And he is freed from the taints, vexations, and fevers that arise conditioned by forms. He does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from forms.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā abhiññeyyā? Pañca vimuttāyatanāni – idhāvuso, bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī. Yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhuno satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, tathā tathā so bhikkhu (syā. kaṃ.) tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthappaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “哪五法应被遍知？五种解脱处。贤友们，于此，导师为比丘说法，或某位值得尊敬的同梵行者为之说法。贤友们，导师以何种方式为比丘说法，或某位值得尊敬的同梵行者以何种方式说法，该比丘即以那种方式于法中感知义、感知法。感知义、感知法的他生起欣悦；欣悦者生起喜；喜意者身轻安；身轻安者感受乐；乐者心入定。此为第一解脱处。”
rows.english: What are the five things to be known by direct knowledge? The five grounds for liberation. Here, friends, the Teacher teaches the Dhamma to a bhikkhu, or a respected fellow in the holy life does. In whatever way, friends, the Teacher teaches the Dhamma to a bhikkhu, or a respected fellow in the holy life does, in that way, in that Dhamma, he becomes one who experiences the meaning and one who experiences the Dhamma. For him, who experiences the meaning and experiences the Dhamma, joy arises. For one who is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. With a tranquil body, he feels happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the first ground for liberation.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā? Tayo samādhī – savitakko savicāro samādhi, avitakko vicāramatto samādhi, avitakko avicāro samādhi. Ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （二）哪三法应修习？三定：有寻有伺定，无寻唯伺定，无寻无伺定。此三法应修习。
rows.english: (b) What three Dhammas are to be developed? Three kinds of concentration: concentration with applied thought and sustained thought; concentration without applied thought, with only sustained thought; and concentration without applied thought and without sustained thought. These three Dhammas are to be developed.
