rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Tīṇi akusalamūlāni – lobho akusalamūlaṃ, doso akusalamūlaṃ, moho akusalamūlaṃ. Ime tayo dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （五）哪三法是退分？三不善根：贪不善根、瞋不善根、痴不善根。此三法是退分。
rows.english: What three states partake of decline? Three unwholesome roots: greed as an unwholesome root, hatred as an unwholesome root, and delusion as an unwholesome root. These three states partake of decline.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Tīṇi kusalamūlāni – alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ. Ime tayo dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （六）哪三法是胜分？三善根：无贪善根、无瞋善根、无痴善根。此三法是胜分。
rows.english: What three states partake of distinction? Three wholesome roots: non-greed as a wholesome root, non-hatred as a wholesome root, and non-delusion as a wholesome root. These three states partake of distinction.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā uppādetabbā? Tīṇi ñāṇāni – atītaṃse ñāṇaṃ, anāgataṃse ñāṇaṃ, paccuppannaṃse ñāṇaṃ. Ime tayo dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Ja) 哪三法应生起？三智：过去分智(atītaṃse ñāṇa)、未来分智(anāgataṃse ñāṇa)、现在分智(paccuppannaṃse ñāṇa)。此三法应生起。
rows.english: What three states are to be brought into being? Three kinds of knowledge: knowledge concerning the past, knowledge concerning the future, and knowledge concerning the present. These three states are to be brought into being.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā sacchikātabbā? Cattāri sāmaññaphalāni – sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ . Ime cattāro dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (癸) 哪四法应作证？四沙门果(cattāri sāmaññaphalāni)：预流果(sotāpattiphalaṃ)、一来果(sakadāgāmiphalaṃ)、不还果(anāgāmiphalaṃ)、阿罗汉果(arahattaphalaṃ)。此四法应作证。
rows.english: Which four states are to be realized? The four fruits of recluseship: the fruit of stream-entry, the fruit of once-returning, the fruit of non-returning, and the fruit of arahantship. These four states are to be realized.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā pahātabbā? Pañca nīvaraṇāni – kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ, uddhaccakukuccanīvaraṇaṃ, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ. Ime pañca dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （四）“哪些法应当断除？五盖——贪欲盖、瞋恚盖、惛沉睡眠盖、掉举恶作盖、疑盖。此五法应当断除。”
rows.english: (Gha) “What are the five qualities that are to be abandoned? The five hindrances: the hindrance of sensual desire, the hindrance of ill will, the hindrance of sloth and torpor, the hindrance of restlessness and remorse, and the hindrance of doubt. These are the five qualities that are to be abandoned.”

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Pañcindriyāni – saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ. Ime pañca dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Ca) “哪些法属于殊胜分？五根——信根、精进根、念根、定根、慧根。此五法属于殊胜分。”
rows.english: (Ca) “What are the five qualities that partake of distinction? The five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of concentration, and the faculty of wisdom. These are the five qualities that partake of distinction.”

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā sacchikātabbā? Pañca dhammakkhandhā – sīlakkhandho , samādhikkhandho, paññākkhandho, vimuttikkhandho, vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandho. Ime pañca dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “哪些五法应被现证？五法蕴——戒蕴、定蕴、慧蕴、解脱蕴、解脱知见蕴。此五法应被现证。”
rows.english: What five dhammas are to be realized? The five aggregates of Dhamma: the aggregate of virtue, the aggregate of concentration, the aggregate of wisdom, the aggregate of liberation, and the aggregate of the knowledge and vision of liberation. These five dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti jānāti (syā. kaṃ.) , sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajānāti …pe… avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “以心遍知其他有情、其他个人的心：了知有贪之心为‘有贪之心’……了知未解脱之心为‘未解脱之心’。”
rows.english: “He knows the minds of other beings, of other persons, having encompassed them with his own mind. He knows a mind with lust as a mind with lust… and an unliberated mind as an unliberated mind.”

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā sacchikātabbā? Aṭṭha vimokkhā – rūpī rūpāni passati. Ayaṃ paṭhamo vimokkho.
rows.chinese_simplified: “哪些是应被现证的八法？八解脱：有色者观诸色。这是第一解脱。”
rows.english: What eight qualities are to be realized? The eight liberations: One possessing form sees forms. This is the first liberation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto …pe… diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā, yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto…pe… ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “复次，贤友，比丘多闻……以慧善通达。贤友，比丘多闻……此法亦能作依怙。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is learned... has thoroughly penetrated it by wisdom. That a bhikkhu is learned... this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: ‘‘Iti ime satadhammā bhūtā tacchā tathā avitathā anaññathā sammā tathāgatena abhisambuddhā’’ti. Idamavocāyasmā sāriputto. Attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “如是，此一百法是真实、确实、如是、不虚、无异，为如来所正等觉。”具寿舍利弗说了此语。彼等比丘心怀喜悦，欢喜具寿舍利弗所说。
rows.english: “Thus, these one hundred principles are actual, true, as they are, not unreal, not otherwise, and have been rightly and fully awakened to by the Tathāgata.” This is what the Venerable Sāriputta said. Gratified, those bhikkhus delighted in the Venerable Sāriputta’s words.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo. Ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. Ayaṃ pañcamo hetu pañcamo paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘多闻，受持所闻，积聚所闻。凡法初善、中善、后善，义妙、文妙，宣示完全圆满、清净之梵行者，如是诸法，彼皆多闻、受持、言语熟习、以意审观、以慧善通达。此是第五因，第五缘，有助于获得未得之初梵行慧，并使已得之慧增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has heard much, retains what he has heard, and accumulates what he has heard. Those teachings that are good in the beginning, good in the middle, and good in the end, with right meaning and phrasing, which proclaim the holy life that is utterly complete and pure—such teachings have been much heard by him, retained, practiced verbally, examined mentally, and well penetrated by view. This is the fifth cause, the fifth condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho, tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ appamattako ābādho atthi kappo nipajjituṃ, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati…pe… idaṃ sattamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘生起少许疾病，他如此想：‘我生起了这少许疾病，适宜躺卧，我应躺下。’于是他躺下……这是第七懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a minor illness has arisen in a bhikkhu. It occurs to him: ‘This minor illness has arisen in me. It is allowable to lie down. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down… This is the seventh ground for laziness.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Pañca nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo – idhāvuso, bhikkhuno kāme manasikaroto kāmesu cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Nekkhammaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto nekkhamme cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ kāmehi. Ye ca kāmapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi. Na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ kāmānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Cha) “什么是五种难通达法？五出离界。贤友们，于此，比丘作意欲乐时，其心不趋向、不澄净、不住立、不倾注于欲乐；而当他作意出离时，其心则趋向、澄净、住立、倾注于出离。其心善行、善修习、善出离、善解脱，已与欲乐分离。凡缘欲乐而生的诸漏、恼害、热恼，他已从中解脱，不再感受那种感受。此被称为欲之出离。”
rows.english: (Cha) “What are the five qualities that are difficult to penetrate? The five elements of escape: Here, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to sensual pleasures, his mind does not enter into, does not become clear about, does not stand firm in, and is not inclined towards sensual pleasures. But when he attends to renunciation, his mind enters into, becomes clear about, stands firm in, and is inclined towards renunciation. That mind of his is well-directed, well-developed, well-risen from, well-liberated from, and disjoined from sensual pleasures. And those taints, mental weariness, and mental fevers that arise on account of sensual pleasures—he is liberated from them. He does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from sensual pleasures.”

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame dve dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Yo ca hetu yo ca paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya, yo ca hetu yo ca paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā. Ime dve dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （七）“何为难以彻知之二法？有情染污之因缘，及有情清净之因缘。此为难以彻知之二法。”
rows.english: (g) What two Dhammas are difficult to penetrate? The cause and condition for the defilement of beings, and the cause and condition for the purification of beings. These two Dhammas are difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā uppādetabbā? Cattāri ñāṇāni – dhamme ñāṇaṃ, anvaye ñāṇaṃ, pariye ñāṇaṃ, sammutiyā ñāṇaṃ. Ime cattāro dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (辛) 哪四法应生起？四智(cattāri ñāṇāni)：法智(dhamme ñāṇaṃ)、类智(anvaye ñāṇaṃ)、他心智(pariye ñāṇaṃ)、世俗智(sammutiyā ñāṇaṃ)。此四法应生起。
rows.english: Which four states are to be produced? The four knowledges: knowledge in the cause, knowledge in the consequence, knowledge of the minds of others, and knowledge in convention. These four states are to be produced.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame cha dhammā bhāvetabbā? Cha anussatiṭṭhānāni – buddhānussati, dhammānussati, saṅghānussati, sīlānussati, cāgānussati, devatānussati. Ime cha dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （二）“哪六法应被修习？六随念处：佛随念、法随念、僧随念、戒随念、施随念、天随念。此六法应被修习。”
rows.english: What six dhammas are to be developed? The six bases of recollection: recollection of the Buddha, recollection of the Dhamma, recollection of the Sangha, recollection of virtue, recollection of generosity, and recollection of the devas. These six dhammas are to be developed.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame cha dhammā pahātabbā? Cha taṇhākāyā – rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. Ime cha dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （四）“哪六法应被断除？六爱身：色爱、声爱、香爱、味爱、触爱、法爱。此六法应被断除。”
rows.english: What six dhammas are to be abandoned? The six bodies of craving: craving for forms, craving for sounds, craving for smells, craving for tastes, craving for tactile objects, and craving for mental objects. These six dhammas are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame cha dhammā abhiññeyyā? Cha anuttariyāni – dassanānuttariyaṃ, savanānuttariyaṃ, lābhānuttariyaṃ, sikkhānuttariyaṃ, pāricariyānuttariyaṃ, anussatānuttariyaṃ. Ime cha dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （壬）“哪六法应被遍知？六无上——见无上、闻无上、利养无上、学无上、侍奉无上、随念无上。此六法应被遍知。
rows.english: (Jha) "What six dhammas are to be directly known? The six unsurpassed states: the unsurpassed seeing, the unsurpassed hearing, the unsurpassed gain, the unsurpassed training, the unsurpassed service, and the unsurpassed recollection. These six dhammas are to be directly known."

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ navamo sattāvāso. Ime nava dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 贤友，有情完全超越无所有处，而到达非想非非想处（nevasaññānāsaññāyatana）。这是第九有情居。这九法应被遍知。
rows.english: Friends, there are beings who, by completely transcending the base of nothingness, have reached the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception. This is the ninth abode of beings. These nine states are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… kalyāṇasampavaṅko. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: “复次，贤友，比丘有善友、善伴，倾向于善。贤友，比丘……倾向于善，此法亦能作依怙。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has good friends, good companions, and is inclined towards the virtuous. That a bhikkhu... is inclined towards the virtuous—this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā bahukārā? Dasa nāthakaraṇādhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu, yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti…pe… sikkhati sikkhāpadesu. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: （一）“哪些是十种多有助益的法？十种能作依怙的法——贤友，于此，比丘有戒，依波罗提木叉律仪防护而住，具足正行与行处，于微细罪中见其怖畏，受持学于诸学处。贤友，比丘有戒……受持学于诸学处，此法亦能作依怙。”
rows.english: (a) What are the ten things of great benefit? The ten refuge-making things. Here, friends, a bhikkhu is virtuous; he dwells restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint, accomplished in conduct and resort, seeing danger in the slightest faults; he undertakes and trains in the training rules. That a bhikkhu is virtuous... and trains in the training rules—this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā sacchikātabbā? Tisso vijjā – pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ vijjā, sattānaṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇaṃ vijjā, āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ vijjā. Ime tayo dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Ña) 哪三法应现证？三明：宿住随念智明(pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ vijjā)、有情死生智明(sattānaṃ cutūpapāte ñāṇaṃ vijjā)、诸漏尽智明(āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ vijjā)。此三法应现证。
rows.english: What three states are to be realized? Three kinds of true knowledge: the true knowledge of recollecting past lives, the true knowledge of the passing away and rebirth of beings, and the true knowledge of the destruction of the taints. These three states are to be realized.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame cha dhammā pariññeyyā? Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni – cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ. Ime cha dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （三）“哪六法应被遍知？六内处：眼处、耳处、鼻处、舌处、身处、意处。此六法应被遍知。”
rows.english: What six dhammas are to be fully understood? The six internal sense bases: the eye sense base, the ear sense base, the nose sense base, the tongue sense base, the body sense base, and the mind sense base. These six dhammas are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame satta dhammā bahukārā? Satta ariyadhanāni – saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ. Ime satta dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （甲）“哪些是具有大助益的七法？七圣财：信财、戒财、惭财、愧财、闻财、施财、慧财。这七法具有大助益。”
rows.english: (A) What seven dhammas are of great service? The seven noble treasures: the treasure of faith, the treasure of virtue, the treasure of moral shame, the treasure of moral dread, the treasure of learning, the treasure of generosity, and the treasure of wisdom. These seven dhammas are of great service.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame satta dhammā bhāvetabbā? Satta sambojjhaṅgā – satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, vīriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo . Ime satta dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （乙）“哪些是应当修习的七法？七觉支：念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。这七法应当被修习。”
rows.english: (B) What seven dhammas are to be developed? The seven factors of enlightenment: the mindfulness factor of enlightenment, the investigation of phenomena factor of enlightenment, the energy factor of enlightenment, the rapture factor of enlightenment, the tranquility factor of enlightenment, the concentration factor of enlightenment, and the equanimity factor of enlightenment. These seven dhammas are to be developed.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame satta dhammā pahātabbā? Sattānusayā – kāmarāgānusayo, paṭighānusayo, diṭṭhānusayo, vicikicchānusayo, mānānusayo, bhavarāgānusayo , avijjānusayo. Ime satta dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （丁）“哪些是应当断除的七法？七随眠：欲贪随眠、瞋恚随眠、见随眠、疑随眠、慢随眠、有贪随眠、无明随眠。此等七法应当断除。”
rows.english: (D) What seven dhammas are to be abandoned? The seven underlying tendencies: the underlying tendency to sensual desire, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to views, the underlying tendency to doubt, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to craving for existence, and the underlying tendency to ignorance. These seven dhammas are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame satta dhammā uppādetabbā? Satta saññā – aniccasaññā, anattasaññā, asubhasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā. Ime satta dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何为应生起的七法？七想：无常想、无我想、不净想、过患想、舍断想、离贪想、灭尽想。此为应生起的七法。”
rows.english: (H) What seven dhammas are to be brought into being? The seven perceptions: the perception of impermanence, the perception of non-self, the perception of foulness, the perception of danger, the perception of abandonment, the perception of dispassion, and the perception of cessation. These seven dhammas are to be brought into being.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame nava dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Nava āghātavatthūni – ‘anatthaṃ me acarī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati, ‘anatthaṃ me caratī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati, ‘anatthaṃ me carissatī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati; ‘piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acarī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… ‘anatthaṃ caratī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… ‘anatthaṃ carissatī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati; ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acarī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… ‘atthaṃ caratī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati…pe… ‘atthaṃ carissatī’ti āghātaṃ bandhati. Ime nava dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 何为九种退分法？九种怨事：‘他曾对我作不饶益’，如是结怨；‘他正对我作不饶益’，如是结怨；‘他将对我作不饶益’，如是结怨。‘他曾对我喜爱、合意之人作不饶益’，如是结怨……乃至……‘正作不饶益’……乃至……‘将作不饶益’，如是结怨。‘他曾对我所不喜爱、不合意之人作饶益’，如是结怨……乃至……‘正作饶益’……乃至……‘将作饶益’，如是结怨。此为九种退分法。
rows.english: (Ṅa) What nine states partake of decline? The nine grounds for resentment: one harbors resentment, thinking, ‘He has done me harm’; one harbors resentment, thinking, ‘He is doing me harm’; one harbors resentment, thinking, ‘He will do me harm’; one harbors resentment, thinking, ‘He has done harm to one who is dear and beloved to me’... ‘He is doing harm to one who is dear and beloved to me’... ‘He will do harm to one who is dear and beloved to me’; one harbors resentment, thinking, ‘He has done a service to one who is not dear and beloved to me’... ‘He is doing a service to one who is not dear and beloved to me’... ‘He will do a service to one who is not dear and beloved to me.’ These nine states partake of decline.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是身行已寂止者呢？贤友，于此，比丘因断除乐与苦，以及先前喜与忧的灭没，而进入并安住于不苦不乐、舍念清净的第四禅。贤友，比丘如是成为身行已寂止者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who has calmed bodily formation? Here, friends, with the abandoning of pleasure and pain, and with the previous disappearance of joy and sorrow, a bhikkhu enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna, which is neither-painful-nor-pleasant and has purity of mindfulness due to equanimity. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one who has calmed bodily formation.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa me kāyo balavā kammañño, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi…pe… idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ ārambhavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘为乞食行于村或镇，得随意饱足之粗或美食。他如是思惟：‘我为乞食行于村或镇，已得随意饱足之粗或美食，我身强壮堪任。我当发起精进！’……此是第六发起精进事。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a bhikkhu, while wandering for alms in a village or a town, obtains his fill of coarse or fine food, as much as he desires. It occurs to him: ‘While wandering for alms in a village or a town, I obtained my fill of coarse or fine food, as much as I desired. My body is strong and fit for work. Come now, I shall arouse energy…’ This is the sixth ground for arousing energy.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu paṇunnapaccekasacco hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ puthupaccekasaccāni, sabbāni tāni nunnāni honti paṇunnāni cattāni vantāni muttāni pahīnāni paṭinissaṭṭhāni. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu paṇunnapaccekasacco hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是已舍离种种谛者？贤友，于此，对比丘而言，凡是众多沙门、婆罗门的种种个别之谛，这一切都已被拔除、尽除、舍弃、吐出、解脱、断除、舍遣。贤友，比丘如是为已舍离种种谛者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who has dispelled individual truths? Here, friends, whatever various individual truths there are of the many ascetics and brahmins, all those are removed, repelled, given up, expelled, released, abandoned, and relinquished. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one who has dispelled individual truths.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā? Pañcaṅgiko sammāsamādhi – pītipharaṇatā, sukhapharaṇatā, cetopharaṇatā , ālokapharaṇatā, paccavekkhaṇanimittaṃ paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ (syā. kaṃ.) . Ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （二）“哪些法应当修习？五支正定——喜遍满、乐遍满、心遍满、光明遍满、省察相。此五法应当修习。”
rows.english: (Kha) “What are the five qualities that are to be developed? The five-factored right concentration: the state of being pervaded by rapture, the state of being pervaded by pleasure, the state of being pervaded by the knowledge of others' minds, the state of being pervaded by the divine eye knowledge, and the sign for reviewing. These are the five qualities that are to be developed.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni. Yaṃpāvuso…pe… ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，漏尽比丘的五根已修习、善修习。贤友，这也是漏尽比丘的力量，依靠此力，漏尽比丘了知诸漏已尽：‘我诸漏已尽。’
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, the five faculties are developed and well developed. For which reason, friends... he knows distinctly, 'My taints are destroyed.'

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā pahātabbā? Aṭṭha micchattā – micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākammanto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchāsati, micchāsamādhi. Ime aṭṭha dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （四）“何为应舍断的八法？八邪性，即：邪见、邪思惟、邪语、邪业、邪命、邪精进、邪念、邪定。此八法应被舍断。”
rows.english: What eight qualities should be abandoned? The eight wrongnesses: wrong view, wrong intention, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, and wrong concentration. These eight qualities should be abandoned.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… uḷārapāmojjo. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘乐法，言谈悦人，于阿毗达摩及胜律有广大之欢喜。诸贤友，比丘……有广大之欢喜，此法亦能作为依止。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is a lover of the Dhamma, is of pleasant speech, and has great joy in the higher Dhamma and the higher Vinaya. That a bhikkhu... has great joy—this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: 350 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi. Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘āvuso bhikkhave’’ti! ‘‘Āvuso’’ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ. Āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 350. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住于瞻波城(Campā)伽伽罗(Gaggarā)池畔，与大比丘僧团，即五百位比丘俱。其时，具寿舍利弗对诸比丘说：‘贤友诸比丘！’‘贤友！’彼等比丘应答具寿舍利弗。具寿舍利弗说此言：
rows.english: 350. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One was dwelling in Campā on the bank of the Gaggarā lotus pond, together with a great community of monks, with five hundred monks. There, the Venerable Sāriputta addressed the monks: 'Friends, monks!' 'Friend,' those monks replied to the Venerable Sāriputta. The Venerable Sāriputta said this:

rows.pali: ‘‘Āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. Ime cha dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 由于诸漏已尽，他于现法中，以自身证知、现证、具足而住于无漏的心解脱与慧解脱。这六法应当被亲证。
rows.english: Through the destruction of the taints, in this very life he realizes for himself with direct knowledge, and entering upon them, abides in the taintless liberation of mind and liberation by wisdom. These six dhammas are to be realized.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā pariññeyyā? Aṭṭha lokadhammā – lābho ca, alābho ca, yaso ca, ayaso ca, nindā ca, pasaṃsā ca, sukhañca, dukkhañca. Ime aṭṭha dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （三）“何为应遍知的八法？八世间法，即：利与衰，誉与非誉，毁与赞，乐与苦。此八法应被遍知。”
rows.english: What eight qualities are to be fully understood? The eight worldly conditions: gain and loss, fame and disrepute, censure and praise, pleasure and pain. These eight qualities are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Aṭṭha kusītavatthūni. Idhāvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ hoti, tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘kammaṃ kho me kātabbaṃ bhavissati, kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilamissati, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ paṭhamaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: （五）“哪些是退分的八法？是八种懈怠事。贤友，在此，有比丘将有工作要做，他这样想：‘我将有工作要做，而做这工作时我的身体将会疲劳，我还是躺下吧。’于是他就躺下，不为未得之得、未达之达、未证之证而发起精进。这是第一种懈怠事。
rows.english: What are the eight qualities that partake of decline? The eight grounds for laziness. Here, friends, a bhikkhu has work to do, and it occurs to him: ‘I will have work to do, and while doing it, my body will become tired. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy for attaining the unattained, achieving the unachieved, and realizing the unrealized. This is the first ground for laziness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti milakkhesu aviññātāresu, yattha natthi gati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ. Ayaṃ pañcamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……投生于边地无知的蛮族中，那里没有比丘、比丘尼、优婆塞、优婆夷的往来。这是第五种不宜修习梵行的非时、非机。
rows.english: Furthermore… he has been reborn in the border regions, among uncultured people who are not discerning, where there is no access for bhikkhus, bhikkhunīs, male lay-followers, or female lay-followers. This is the fifth inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti , so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo, nappaṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitānamatthamaññātuṃ. Ayaṃ sattamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……此人虽生于中部地区，却智慧浅薄、愚钝、暗哑，不能了知善说与恶说之义。这是第七种不宜修习梵行的非时、非机。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person has been reborn in the central regions, but he is unwise, dull, and mentally defective, unable to understand the meaning of what is well-spoken and badly spoken. This is the seventh inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: ‘‘Taṃ kho pana satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ , yatthassa tibbaṃ hirottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañca gāravo ca. Te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati – ‘idaṃ, bhante, kathaṃ? Imassa ko attho’ti? Tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañceva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca uttānī anuttānikatañca uttāniṃ (ka.) karonti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti. Ayaṃ dutiyo hetu dutiyo paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya, vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，他依止导师，或依止某位堪为师表的同梵行者而住，对他已现起强烈的惭与愧，以及爱敬与尊重。他适时地前往请教、详问：‘尊者，此是为何？此句是何义？’那些具寿为他开显未开显的，阐明未阐明的，并于种种疑处之法中断除其疑惑。此是第二因、第二缘，能令未获得的初梵行慧得以获得，已获得的得以增长、广大、修习、圆满。”
rows.english: Dwelling in dependence on that Teacher or on a certain fellow practitioner in a position of respect, towards whom he has established a strong sense of moral shame and moral dread, as well as affection and reverence, he approaches them from time to time to question and inquire: ‘Venerable sir, how is this? What is the meaning of this?’ Those venerable ones then reveal to him what is unrevealed, make clear what is not yet clear, and dispel his doubt concerning various matters that are grounds for doubt. This is the second cause, the second condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā bahukārā? Cattāri cakkāni – patirūpadesavāso, sappurisūpanissayo sappurisupassayo (syā. kaṃ.) , attasammāpaṇidhi, pubbe ca katapuññatā. Ime cattāro dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Ka) 哪四法多所饶益？四轮(cattāri cakkāni)：居住于适宜之地(patirūpadesavāso)，亲近善士(sappurisūpanissayo)，自我正愿(attasammāpaṇidhi)，以及往昔已作福业(pubbe ca katapuññatā)。此四法多所饶益。
rows.english: Which four states are of great service? The four wheels: residing in a suitable place, associating with good persons, establishing oneself rightly, and having previously made merit. These four states are of great service.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā pariññeyyā? Pañcupādānakkhandhā seyyathīdaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) – rūpupādānakkhandho, vedanupādānakkhandho, saññupādānakkhandho, saṅkhārupādānakkhandho viññāṇupādānakkhandho. Ime pañca dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （三）“哪些法应当遍知？五取蕴——色取蕴、受取蕴、想取蕴、行取蕴、识取蕴。此五法应当遍知。”
rows.english: (Ga) “What are the five qualities that are to be fully understood? The five aggregates of clinging: the form aggregate of clinging, the feeling aggregate of clinging, the perception aggregate of clinging, the formations aggregate of clinging, and the consciousness aggregate of clinging. These are the five qualities that are to be fully understood.”

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame satta dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Satta asaddhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti, duppañño hoti. Ime satta dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （戊）“哪些是退堕分法？七不善法：贤友，于此，比丘无信、无惭、无愧、寡闻、懈怠、失念、劣慧。此等七法是退堕分法。”
rows.english: (E) What seven dhammas are conducive to decline? The seven unwholesome dhammas: Here, friends, a bhikkhu is faithless, shameless, unscrupulous, of little learning, lazy, of lapsed mindfulness, and unwise. These seven dhammas are conducive to decline.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu suvaco hoti sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgato, khamo padakkhiṇaggāhī anusāsaniṃ. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… anusāsaniṃ. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘是易受教者，具足令成易受教之法，堪忍而恭敬领受教诫。诸贤友，比丘……恭敬领受教诫，此法亦能作为依止。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is easy to admonish, possessed of qualities that make one easy to admonish, is patient, and accepts instruction respectfully. That a bhikkhu... accepts instruction respectfully—this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā pariññeyyā? Dasāyatanāni – cakkhāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ. Ime dasa dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何等十法应遍知？十处：眼处、色处、耳处、声处、鼻处、香处、舌处、味处、身处、触处。此等十法应遍知。
rows.english: (Ga) What ten qualities are to be fully understood? The ten bases: the eye base, form base, ear base, sound base, nose base, odor base, tongue base, taste base, body base, and tangible base. These ten qualities are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā pahātabbā? Dasa micchattā – micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākammanto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchāsati, micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇaṃ, micchāvimutti. Ime dasa dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何等十法应断除？十邪性：邪见、邪思惟、邪语、邪业、邪命、邪精进、邪念、邪定、邪智、邪解脱。此等十法应断除。
rows.english: (Gha) What ten qualities are to be abandoned? The ten wrongnesses: wrong view, wrong thought, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, wrong concentration, wrong knowledge, and wrong liberation. These ten qualities are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā abhiññeyyā? Cattāri ariyasaccāni – dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhasamudayaṃ dukkhasamudayo (syā. kaṃ.) ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhanirodhaṃ dukkhanirodho (syā. kaṃ.) ariyasaccaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ. Ime cattāro dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (壬) 哪四法应证知？四圣谛(cattāri ariyasaccāni)：苦圣谛(dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ)、苦集圣谛(dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ)、苦灭圣谛(dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ)、苦灭道圣谛(dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ)。此四法应证知。
rows.english: Which four states are to be directly known? The four noble truths: the noble truth of suffering, the noble truth of the origin of suffering, the noble truth of the cessation of suffering, and the noble truth of the path leading to the cessation of suffering. These four states are to be directly known.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame satta dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Satta sappurisadhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca. Ime satta dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （六）“哪些是难以通达的七法？七善士法：贤友，于此，比丘知法、知义、知己、知量、知时、知众、知人。此等七法是难以通达的。”
rows.english: (G) What seven dhammas are difficult to penetrate? The seven dhammas of a true person: Here, friends, a bhikkhu is a knower of the Dhamma, a knower of the meaning, a knower of himself, a knower of moderation, a knower of the proper time, a knower of the assembly, and a knower of individuals. These seven dhammas are difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā bhāvetabbā? Ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi. Ime aṭṭha dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （二）“何为应修习的八法？八支圣道，即：正见、正思惟、正语、正业、正命、正精进、正念、正定。此八法应被修习。”
rows.english: What eight qualities should be developed? The Noble Eightfold Path, namely: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration. These eight qualities should be developed.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame nava dhammā bhāvetabbā? Nava pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgāni – sīlavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, cittavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, diṭṭhivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, maggāmaggañāṇadassana – visuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, ñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, paññāvisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ, vimuttivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅgaṃ. Ime nava dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （乙）“哪些是应修习的九法？九清净勤支(pārisuddhipadhāniyaṅga)：戒清净为清净勤支，心清净为清净勤支，见清净为清净勤支，度疑清净为清净勤支，道非道智见清净为清净勤支，行道智见清净为清净勤支，智见清净为清净勤支，慧清净为清净勤支，解脱清净为清净勤支。此九法应修习。”
rows.english: (Kha) What nine states are to be developed? The nine factors of the endeavor for purity: purity of virtue is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity of mind is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity of view is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity by overcoming doubt is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity of knowledge and vision of what is path and what is not path is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity of knowledge and vision of the way is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity of knowledge and vision is a factor of the endeavor for purity; purity of wisdom is a factor of the endeavor for purity; and purity of liberation is a factor of the endeavor for purity. These nine states are to be developed.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Nava nānattā – dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ, chandanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati pariḷāhanānattaṃ, pariḷāhanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati pariyesanānānattaṃ, pariyesanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati lābhanānattaṃ. Ime nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 何等为九难通达法？九种差异：缘界差异而生起触差异，缘触差异而生起受差异，缘受差异而生起想差异，缘想差异而生起思惟差异，缘思惟差异而生起欲差异，缘欲差异而生起热恼差异，缘热恼差异而生起遍求差异，缘遍求差异而生起得差异。此九法为难通达。
rows.english: What are the nine things that are hard to penetrate? The nine diversities: dependent on diversity of elements, diversity of contact arises; dependent on diversity of contact, diversity of feeling arises; dependent on diversity of feeling, diversity of perception arises; dependent on diversity of perception, diversity of thought arises; dependent on diversity of thought, diversity of desire arises; dependent on diversity of desire, diversity of burning arises; dependent on diversity of burning, diversity of seeking arises; dependent on diversity of seeking, diversity of gain arises. These nine things are hard to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Dasa akusalakammapathā – pāṇātipāto, adinnādānaṃ, kāmesumicchācāro, musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, byāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi. Ime dasa dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何等十法为退分？十不善业道：杀生、不与取、欲邪行、妄语、离间语、粗恶语、绮语、贪欲、瞋恚、邪见。此等十法为退分。
rows.english: (Ṅa) What are the ten qualities that partake of decline? The ten unwholesome courses of action: killing living beings, taking what is not given, sexual misconduct, false speech, divisive speech, harsh speech, idle chatter, covetousness, ill will, and wrong view. These ten qualities partake of decline.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘upekkhā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā…pe… atha ca pana me rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So – ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca…pe… nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, rāgassa yadidaṃ upekkhācetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 在此，贤友，有比丘如是说：‘我已修习舍心解脱……然而，贪欲却持续占据我心。’应如是告知他：‘勿作是言！具寿，勿作是言……贤友，此即贪欲之出离，所谓舍心解脱。’
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through equanimity… and yet lust still obsesses my mind.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say that, venerable sir! Do not misrepresent the Blessed One… For this, friends, is the escape from lust, namely, the liberation of mind through equanimity.’"

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame cha dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Cha agāravā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe… sikkhāya… appamāde… paṭisanthāre agāravo viharati appatisso. Ime cha dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，是哪六种为退失分之法？六种不敬。贤友们，于此，比丘对大师住于不敬、不顺从；对法……对僧……对学……对不放逸……对款待住于不敬、不顺从。此等为六种为退失分之法。”
rows.english: What six dhammas partake of decline? Six kinds of disrespect. Here, friends, a bhikkhu dwells with disrespect and without deference toward the Teacher, toward the Dhamma... toward the Sangha... toward the training... toward diligence... and toward hospitality. These six dhammas partake of decline.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame cha dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Cha gāravā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthari sagāravo viharati sappatisso dhamme…pe… saṅghe… sikkhāya… appamāde… paṭisanthāre sagāravo viharati sappatisso. Ime cha dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，是哪六种为殊胜分之法？六种恭敬。贤友们，于此，比丘对大师住于恭敬、顺从；对法……对僧……对学……对不放逸……对款待住于恭敬、顺从。此等为六种为殊胜分之法。”
rows.english: What six dhammas partake of distinction? Six kinds of respect. Here, friends, a bhikkhu dwells with respect and with deference toward the Teacher, toward the Dhamma... toward the Sangha... toward the training... toward diligence... and toward hospitality. These six dhammas partake of distinction.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame nava dhammā pariññeyyā? Nava sattāvāsā – santāvuso, sattā nānattakāyā nānattasaññino, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā. Ayaṃ paṭhamo sattāvāso.
rows.chinese_simplified: （丙）“哪些是应遍知的九法？九有情居(sattāvāsa)：贤友，有些有情身各异、想各异，例如人、某些天以及某些堕恶趣者。此为第一有情居。”
rows.english: (Ga) What nine states are to be fully understood? The nine abodes of beings. Friends, there are beings with diverse bodies and diverse perceptions, such as humans, some devas, and some of those in states of deprivation. This is the first abode of beings.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Dasa kusalakammapathā – pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī, anabhijjhā, abyāpādo, sammādiṭṭhi. Ime dasa dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何等十法为胜分？十善业道：离杀生、离不与取、离欲邪行、离妄语、离离间语、离粗恶语、离绮语、不贪欲、不瞋恚、正见。此等十法为胜分。
rows.english: (Ca) What are the ten qualities that partake of distinction? The ten wholesome courses of action: abstinence from killing living beings, abstinence from taking what is not given, abstinence from sexual misconduct, abstinence from false speech, abstinence from divisive speech, abstinence from harsh speech, abstinence from idle chatter, non-covetousness, non-ill will, and right view. These ten qualities partake of distinction.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā uppādetabbā? Dasa saññā – asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā, sabbalokeanabhiratisaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā. Ime dasa dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “哪些是当生起的十法？是十想：不净想、死想、食厌想、于一切世间不乐想、无常想、于无常中苦想、于苦中无我想、舍断想、离贪想、灭尽想。此等是当生起的十法。”
rows.english: “What ten things are to be developed? Ten perceptions: the perception of foulness, the perception of death, the perception of revulsion in food, the perception of non-delight in the entire world, the perception of impermanence, the perception of suffering in the impermanent, the perception of not-self in suffering, the perception of abandoning, the perception of dispassion, and the perception of cessation. These ten things are to be developed.”

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā sacchikātabbā? Dasa asekkhā dhammā – asekkhā sammādiṭṭhi, asekkho sammāsaṅkappo, asekkhā sammāvācā, asekkho sammākammanto, asekkho sammāājīvo, asekkho sammāvāyāmo, asekkhā sammāsati, asekkho sammāsamādhi, asekkhaṃ sammāñāṇaṃ, asekkhā sammāvimutti. Ime dasa dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “当现证之十法为何？十无学法：无学正见、无学正思惟、无学正语、无学正业、无学正命、无学正精进、无学正念、无学正定、无学正智、无学正解脱。此等为当现证之十法。”
rows.english: “What ten things are to be realized? The ten qualities of one beyond training: the right view of one beyond training, the right intention of one beyond training, the right speech of one beyond training, the right action of one beyond training, the right livelihood of one beyond training, the right effort of one beyond training, the right mindfulness of one beyond training, the right concentration of one beyond training, the right knowledge of one beyond training, and the right liberation of one beyond training. These ten things are to be realized.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ uccāvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato, alaṃ kātuṃ, alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ. Ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘于同梵行者所有种种大小事务，皆善巧、不懈怠，具足与此相应的审察智慧，能作、能安排。诸贤友，比丘……能安排，此法亦能作为依止。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, in regard to the various duties, great and small, for his companions in the holy life, a bhikkhu is skilled and not lazy, endowed with wisdom concerning the means thereto, able to carry them out, and able to arrange them. That a bhikkhu... is able to arrange them—this too is a refuge-making thing.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti . Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ, kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilanto, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati…pe… idaṃ dutiyaṃ kusītavatthu.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，有比丘已经做完了工作，他这样想：‘我做了工作，我的身体因工作而疲劳了，我还是躺下吧。’于是他就躺下，不发起精进……这是第二种懈怠事。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has done work. It occurs to him: ‘I have done work, and while doing it, my body became tired. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down and does not arouse energy… This is the second ground for laziness.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā uppādetabbā? Aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakkā – appicchassāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassa. Santuṭṭhassāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa. Pavivittassāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇikārāmassa. Āraddhavīriyassāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassa. Upaṭṭhitasatissāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo muṭṭhassatissa. Samāhitassāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa . Paññavato paññāvato (sī. pī.) ayaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassa. Nippapañcassāyaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassāti nippapañcārāmassa ayaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino, nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratinoti (sī. syā. pī.) aṅguttarepi tatheva dissati. aṭṭhakathāṭīkā pana oloketabbā ime aṭṭha dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 应生起哪八法？八种大士思惟：此是少欲者之法，非多欲者之法；此是知足者之法，非不知足者之法；此是独处者之法，非乐众者之法；此是发起精进者之法，非懈怠者之法；此是安住念者之法，非失念者之法；此是得定者之法，非不得定者之法；此是具慧者之法，非劣慧者之法；此是无戏论者之法，非乐戏论者之法。此等八法应生起。
rows.english: What eight qualities are to be developed? The eight reflections of a great man: This Dhamma is for one of few desires, not for one of many desires. This Dhamma is for the contented, not for the discontented. This Dhamma is for one who delights in seclusion, not for one who delights in company. This Dhamma is for one with aroused energy, not for the lazy. This Dhamma is for one with established mindfulness, not for one with lapsed mindfulness. This Dhamma is for one with a concentrated mind, not for one with an unconcentrated mind. This Dhamma is for one with wisdom, not for one without wisdom. This Dhamma is for one who does not delight in proliferation, not for one who delights in proliferation. These eight qualities are to be developed.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame satta dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Satta saddhammā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu saddho hoti, hirimā hiriko (syā. kaṃ.) hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, upaṭṭhitassati hoti, paññavā hoti. Ime satta dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （己）“哪些是殊胜分法？七善法：贤友，于此，比丘有信、有惭、有愧、多闻、发起精进、安住于念、具足智慧。此等七法是殊胜分法。”
rows.english: (F) What seven dhammas are conducive to distinction? The seven wholesome dhammas: Here, friends, a bhikkhu is faithful, conscientious, scrupulous, learned, with energy aroused, with mindfulness established, and wise. These seven dhammas are conducive to distinction.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame satta dhammā abhiññeyyā? Satta niddasavatthūni – idhāvuso, bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca sikkhāsamādāne avigatapemo. Dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca dhammanisantiyā avigatapemo. Icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca icchāvinaye avigatapemo. Paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca paṭisallāne avigatapemo. Vīriyāramme tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca vīriyāramme avigatapemo. Satinepakke tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca satinepakke avigatapemo. Diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo. Ime satta dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何为应遍知的七法？贤友，于此，比丘于受持学处有强烈意欲，且于未来对受持学处不失爱乐；于审察法有强烈意欲，且于未来对审察法不失爱乐；于调伏欲求有强烈意欲，且于未来对调伏欲求不失爱乐；于独处有强烈意欲，且于未来对独处不失爱乐；于发起精进有强烈意欲，且于未来对发起精进不失爱乐；于正念明智有强烈意欲，且于未来对正念明智不失爱乐；于洞见正见有强烈意欲，且于未来对洞见正见不失爱乐。此为应遍知的七法。”
rows.english: (I) What seven dhammas are to be known by direct knowledge? The seven grounds for instruction: Here, friends, a bhikkhu has a strong desire for undertaking the training, and in the future his love for undertaking the training is not lost. He has a strong desire for reflection on the Dhamma, and in the future his love for reflection on the Dhamma is not lost. He has a strong desire for the removal of craving, and in the future his love for the removal of craving is not lost. He has a strong desire for seclusion, and in the future his love for seclusion is not lost. He has a strong desire for arousing energy, and in the future his love for arousing energy is not lost. He has a strong desire for mindfulness and prudence, and in the future his love for mindfulness and prudence is not lost. He has a strong desire for the penetration of views, and in the future his love for the penetration of views is not lost. These seven dhammas are to be known by direct knowledge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito, ayañca puggalo tiracchānayoniṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ dutiyo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，如来出现于世，是阿罗汉、正等觉者，其法亦被开示，导向寂静、导向涅槃、趣向正觉，为善逝所宣说，而此人却投生于畜生界。这是第二种为修习梵行的无暇与非时。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a Tathāgata has arisen in the world, an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One; and the Dhamma is taught which is conducive to peace, which leads to Nibbāna, which leads to enlightenment, proclaimed by the Well-Farer. But this person has been reborn in the animal realm. This is the second inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: (Ga) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā pariññeyyā? Cattāro āhārā – kabaḷīkāro kavaḷīkāro (syā. kaṃ.) āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ. Ime cattāro dhammā pariññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (丙) 哪四法应遍知？四食(cattāro āhārā)：或粗或细的抟食(kabaḷīkāro āhāro)，第二为触(phasso)，第三为意思(manosañcetanā)，第四为识(viññāṇaṃ)。此四法应遍知。
rows.english: Which four states are to be fully understood? The four nutriments: edible food, whether gross or subtle; contact as the second; mental volition as the third; and consciousness as the fourth. These four states are to be fully understood.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame nava dhammā uppādetabbā? Nava saññā – asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā , sabbalokeanabhiratisaññā anabhiratasaññā (syā. ka.) , aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā. Ime nava dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 何等为九应令生起法？九想：不净想、死想、食厌想、于一切世间不乐想、无常想、于无常苦想、于苦无我想、断想、离贪想。此九法应令生起。
rows.english: What are the nine things that should be developed? The nine perceptions: the perception of unattractiveness, the perception of death, the perception of revulsion in food, the perception of non-delight in the entire world, the perception of impermanence, the perception of suffering in the impermanent, the perception of not-self in suffering, the perception of abandoning, and the perception of dispassion. These nine things should be developed.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato, ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. Yaṃpāvuso, bhikkhu…pe… ayampi dhammo nāthakaraṇo. Ime dasa dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，诸贤友，比丘有智慧，具足通达生灭、圣、洞见、能正导向苦尽之慧。诸贤友，比丘……具足此慧，此法亦能作为依止。此十法多所饶益。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu is wise, endowed with wisdom that comprehends arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and rightly leads to the complete destruction of suffering. That a bhikkhu... this too is a refuge-making quality. These ten qualities are of great benefit.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā? Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Vedanāsu…pe… citte… dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Kha) 哪四法应修习？四念住(cattāro satipaṭṭhānā)：贤友，于此，比丘于身随观身而住，热诚、正知、具念，调伏世间之贪与忧。于受……于心……于法随观法而住，热诚、正知、具念，调伏世间之贪与忧。此四法应修习。
rows.english: Which four states are to be developed? The four establishments of mindfulness. Here, friends, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. He dwells contemplating feelings in feelings... the mind in the mind... dhammas in dhammas, ardent, clearly comprehending, and mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world. These four states are to be developed.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是具足六支者？贤友，于此，比丘以眼见色后，不喜亦不忧，具念、正知而住于舍。以耳闻声……以鼻嗅香……以舌尝味……以身触所触……以意知法后，不喜亦不忧，具念、正知而住于舍。贤友，比丘如是为具足六支者。”
rows.english: And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who possesses six factors? Here, friends, a bhikkhu, having seen a form with the eye, is neither joyful nor dejected, but dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending. Having heard a sound with the ear… smelled an odor with the nose… tasted a flavor with the tongue… touched a tangible with the body… cognized a mental object with the mind, he is neither joyful nor dejected, but dwells equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending. Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one who possesses six factors.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘karuṇā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. Atha ca pana me vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So – ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo, ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi…pe… nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, vihesāya, yadidaṃ karuṇācetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友们，于此，有比丘如是说：‘我之悲心解脱已修习、多修、作为车乘、作为基础、已建立、已熟习、已善发起，然恼害仍盘踞我心。’应如是语彼：‘具寿，莫作是说，莫诽谤世尊……乃至……贤友，此即是恼害之出离，所谓悲心解脱。’”
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through compassion, cultivated it, made it my vehicle, made it my basis, established it, practiced it, and well-undertaken it, and yet harmfulness still obsesses my mind.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say that, venerable sir! Do not misrepresent the Blessed One… For this, friends, is the escape from harmfulness, namely, the liberation of mind through compassion.’"

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame tayo dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Tisso nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo – kāmānametaṃ nissaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ nekkhammaṃ, rūpānametaṃ nissaraṇaṃ yadidaṃ arūpaṃ, yaṃ kho pana kiñci bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ, nirodho tassa nissaraṇaṃ. Ime tayo dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Cha) 哪三法是难通达的？三出离界：出离(nekkhamma)，此为诸欲的出离；无色(arūpa)，此为诸色的出离；以及，凡是已生、有为、缘生者，其灭(nirodha)即是出离。此三法是难通达的。
rows.english: What three states are difficult to penetrate? Three elements of escape. The escape from sensual pleasures is this: renunciation. The escape from form is this: the formless. The escape from whatever has come to be, is conditioned and dependently arisen, is its cessation. These three states are difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame aṭṭha dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Aṭṭha akkhaṇā asamayā brahmacariyavāsāya. Idhāvuso, tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca desiyati opasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito. Ayañca puggalo nirayaṃ upapanno hoti. Ayaṃ paṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 什么是难以通达的八法？有八种为修习梵行的无暇与非时。贤友们，于此，如来出现于世，是阿罗汉、正等觉者，其法亦被开示，导向寂静、导向涅槃、趣向正觉，为善逝所宣说，而此人却投生于地狱。这是第一种为修习梵行的无暇与非时。
rows.english: What are the eight states that are difficult to penetrate? The eight inopportune, unsuitable moments for living the holy life. Here, venerable sirs, a Tathāgata has arisen in the world, an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One; and the Dhamma is taught which is conducive to peace, which leads to Nibbāna, which leads to enlightenment, proclaimed by the Well-Farer. But this person has been reborn in hell. This is the first inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: (Ca) ‘‘katame nava dhammā visesabhāgiyā? Nava āghātapaṭivinayā – ‘anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘anatthaṃ me carati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘anatthaṃ me carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari…pe… anatthaṃ carati…pe… anatthaṃ carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti; ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari…pe… atthaṃ carati…pe… atthaṃ carissati, taṃ kutettha labbhā’ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti. Ime nava dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 何为九种殊胜分法？九种除怨法：‘他曾对我作不饶益，此事于彼，何由可得？’如是止息怨恨；‘他正对我作不饶益，此事于彼，何由可得？’如是止息怨恨；‘他将对我作不饶益，此事于彼，何由可得？’如是止息怨恨。‘他曾对我喜爱、合意之人作不饶益……乃至……正作不饶益……乃至……将作不饶益，此事于彼，何由可得？’如是止息怨恨。‘他曾对我所不喜爱、不合意之人作饶益……乃至……正作饶益……乃至……将作饶益，此事于彼，何由可得？’如是止息怨恨。此为九种殊胜分法。
rows.english: (Ca) What nine states partake of distinction? The nine ways of subduing resentment: one subdues resentment, thinking, ‘He has done me harm—but what is to be gained from that?’; one subdues resentment, thinking, ‘He is doing me harm—but what is to be gained from that?’; one subdues resentment, thinking, ‘He will do me harm—but what is to be gained from that?’; one subdues resentment, thinking, ‘He has done harm to one who is dear and beloved to me... he is doing harm... he will do harm—but what is to be gained from that?’; one subdues resentment, thinking, ‘He has done a service to one who is not dear and beloved to me... he is doing a service... he will do a service—but what is to be gained from that?’. These nine states partake of distinction.

rows.pali: (Kha) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā? Dasa kasiṇāyatanāni – pathavīkasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. Āpokasiṇameko sañjānāti…pe… tejokasiṇameko sañjānāti… vāyokasiṇameko sañjānāti… nīlakasiṇameko sañjānāti… pītakasiṇameko sañjānāti… lohitakasiṇameko sañjānāti… odātakasiṇameko sañjānāti… ākāsakasiṇameko sañjānāti… viññāṇakasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ . Ime dasa dhammā bhāvetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “何等十法应修习？十遍处：一人了知地遍，上、下、横，无二、无量。一人了知水遍……（乃至）……一人了知火遍……一人了知风遍……一人了知青遍……一人了知黄遍……一人了知赤遍……一人了知白遍……一人了知空遍……一人了知识遍，上、下、横，无二、无量。此等十法应修习。
rows.english: (Kha) What ten qualities are to be developed? The ten kasiṇa bases. One perceives the earth kasiṇa above, below, and across, non-dual and immeasurable. One perceives the water kasiṇa... one perceives the fire kasiṇa... one perceives the air kasiṇa... one perceives the blue kasiṇa... one perceives the yellow kasiṇa... one perceives the red kasiṇa... one perceives the white kasiṇa... one perceives the space kasiṇa... one perceives the consciousness kasiṇa above, below, and across, non-dual and immeasurable. These ten qualities are to be developed.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā…pe… atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī’ti. So – ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca…pe… nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, sabbanimittānaṃ yadidaṃ animittā cetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 在此，贤友，有比丘如是说：‘我已修习无相心解脱……然而，我的识却随相而行。’应如是告知他：‘勿作是言！具寿，勿作是言……贤友，此即一切相之出离，所谓无相心解脱。’
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the signless liberation of mind… and yet my consciousness still follows after signs.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say that, venerable sir! Do not misrepresent the Blessed One… For this, friends, is the escape from all signs, namely, the signless liberation of mind.’"

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo, paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitānamatthamaññātuṃ. Ayaṃ aṭṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya. Ime aṭṭha dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……此人生于中部地区，有智慧，不愚钝，不暗哑，能了知善说与恶说之义。这是第八种不宜修习梵行的非时、非机。此等八法，难以彻知。
rows.english: Furthermore, a Tathāgata has not arisen in the world, an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One; and the Dhamma is not taught which is conducive to peace, which leads to Nibbāna, which leads to enlightenment, proclaimed by the Well-Farer. But this person has been reborn in the central regions, and he is wise, not dull, not mentally defective, and is able to understand the meaning of what is well-spoken and badly spoken. This is the eighth inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life. These eight states are difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: ‘‘Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti? Idhāvuso, bhikkhu ‘rāgo me pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo’ti pajānāti. ‘Doso me pahīno…pe… āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo’ti pajānāti. ‘Moho me pahīno …pe… āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo’ti pajānāti. Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu suvimuttapañño hoti. Ime dasa dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，比丘如何是慧善解脱者呢？贤友，于此，比丘了知：‘我的贪已被舍断，根已被截断，如同无顶的棕榈树，已成非有，于未来为不生之法。’了知：‘我的瞋已被舍断……于未来为不生之法。’了知：‘我的痴已被舍断……于未来为不生之法。’贤友，比丘如是成为慧善解脱者。此十法难通达。”
rows.english: “And how, friends, is a bhikkhu one who is well-liberated by wisdom? Here, friends, a bhikkhu understands: ‘Lust has been abandoned by me, its root cut off, made like a palm stump, brought to a state of non-existence, and is of a nature not to arise in the future.’ He understands: ‘Hatred has been abandoned by me… and is of a nature not to arise in the future.’ He understands: ‘Delusion has been abandoned by me… and is of a nature not to arise in the future.’ Thus, friends, a bhikkhu is one who is well-liberated by wisdom. These ten things are difficult to penetrate.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvito hoti subhāvito. Yaṃpāvuso, khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvito hoti subhāvito, idampi khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno balaṃ hoti, yaṃ balaṃ āgamma khīṇāsavo bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayaṃ paṭijānāti – ‘khīṇā me āsavā’ti. Ime satta dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，漏尽比丘已修习、善修习圣八支道。贤友，漏尽比丘已修习、善修习圣八支道，此亦是漏尽比丘之力，依此力，漏尽比丘确知诸漏已尽：‘我诸漏已尽。’此等七法应被亲证。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, the Noble Eightfold Path is developed and well developed. And friends, because the Noble Eightfold Path is developed and well developed for a bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, this too is a strength of the bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed, by relying on which strength the bhikkhu whose taints are destroyed knows distinctly the destruction of the taints: ‘My taints are destroyed.’ These seven phenomena are to be realized.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gilānāvuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gilānāvuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño, handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti. So nipajjati…pe… idaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ kusītavatthu. Ime aṭṭha dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘刚从病中康复，病愈未久。他如此想：‘我刚从病中康复，病愈未久。我的身体虚弱，不适于作业，我应躺下。’于是他躺下……这是第八懈怠事。这八种法是退堕分。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu has recovered from illness, not long recovered from his sickness. It occurs to him: ‘I have recovered from illness, not long recovered from my sickness. My body is weak and unfit for work. Suppose I lie down.’ So he lies down… This is the eighth ground for laziness. These eight qualities partake of decline.

rows.pali: (Gha) ‘‘katame nava dhammā pahātabbā? Nava taṇhāmūlakā dhammā – taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā, pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho, lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo, vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo , chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānaṃ, ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho, pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyaṃ, macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho, ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ paṭicca (syā. pī. ka.) daṇḍādānasatthādānakalahaviggahavivādatuvaṃtuvaṃpesuññamusāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti. Ime nava dhammā pahātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （丁）哪些是应被断除的九法？九种以渴爱（taṇhā）为根本的法：缘于渴爱而有寻求（pariyesanā），缘于寻求而有获得（lābha），缘于获得而有决断（vinicchaya），缘于决断而有欲贪（chandarāga），缘于欲贪而有执取（ajjhosāna），缘于执取而有拥有（pariggaha），缘于拥有而有吝啬（macchariya），缘于吝啬而有守护（ārakkha）；缘于守护，执杖、持刀、争吵、争论、争执、互相指责、离间语、妄语——如此种种恶不善法生起。这九法应被断除。
rows.english: (Gha) What nine states are to be abandoned? The nine states rooted in craving: dependent on craving, seeking arises; dependent on seeking, gain arises; dependent on gain, decision arises; dependent on decision, desire and lust arise; dependent on desire and lust, attachment arises; dependent on attachment, possessiveness arises; dependent on possessiveness, stinginess arises; dependent on stinginess, guarding arises; and with guarding as the cause, the taking up of rods and weapons, conflict, dispute, contention, ‘you, you’ speech, slander, and false speech—many such evil, unwholesome states come into being. These nine states are to be abandoned.

rows.pali: (Ña) ‘‘katame nava dhammā sacchikātabbā? Nava anupubbanirodhā – paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa kāmasaññā niruddhā hoti, dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāssā niruddhā honti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa rūpasaññā niruddhā hoti, viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākāsānañcāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa viññāṇañcāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākiñcaññāyatanasaññā niruddhā hoti, saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti. Ime nava dhammā sacchikātabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （九）“哪些是应现证的九法？九种次第灭：入初禅者，欲想灭尽；入第二禅者，寻、伺灭尽；入第三禅者，喜灭尽；入第四禅者，入出息灭尽；入空无边处者，色想灭尽；入识无边处者，空无边处想灭尽；入无所有处者，识无边处想灭尽；入非想非非想处者，无所有处想灭尽；入想受灭定者，想与受灭尽。此是应现证的九法。”
rows.english: What are the nine things to be realized? The nine successive cessations: For one who has attained the first jhāna, perception of sensual pleasure has ceased. For one who has attained the second jhāna, thought and examination have ceased. For one who has attained the third jhāna, rapture has ceased. For one who has attained the fourth jhāna, in-breaths and out-breaths have ceased. For one who has attained the sphere of infinite space, perception of form has ceased. For one who has attained the sphere of infinite consciousness, perception of the sphere of infinite space has ceased. For one who has attained the sphere of nothingness, perception of the sphere of infinite consciousness has ceased. For one who has attained the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, perception of the sphere of nothingness has ceased. For one who has attained the cessation of perception and feeling, perception and feeling have ceased. These nine things are to be realized.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame nava dhammā bahukārā? Nava yonisomanasikāramūlakā dhammā, yonisomanasikaroto pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, samāhite citte yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati, yathābhūtaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ nibbindati, nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati. Ime nava dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （甲）“哪些是多有助益的九法？九种以如理作意(yonisomanasikāra)为根本的法：如理作意者生起喜悦，喜悦者生起喜，心喜者身轻安，身轻安者感受乐，乐者心入定，心入定者如实知见，如实知见者厌离，厌离者离贪，因离贪而解脱。此九法多有助益。”
rows.english: (Ka) What nine states are of great benefit? The nine states rooted in wise attention. For one who attends wisely, gladness arises. For one who is gladdened, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the body becomes tranquil. One with a tranquil body experiences happiness. For one who is happy, the mind becomes concentrated. With a concentrated mind, one knows and sees things as they really are. Knowing and seeing things as they really are, one becomes disenchanted. Being disenchanted, one becomes dispassionate. Through dispassion, one is liberated. These nine states are of great benefit.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya, tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhi sāmaññagato viharati sabrahmacārīhi āvi ceva raho ca, ayampi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo, saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati. Ime cha dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友，比丘对于那圣、出离、能令其实践者完全灭尽痛苦的见，于此等见，与同梵行者们，无论公开或私下，皆见解等同而住。此法亦应忆念、能引生喜爱、能引生尊重，导向摄益、无诤、和合、合一。此等六法有大助益。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu dwells in commonality of view with his fellow practitioners, both openly and in private, in regard to that view which is noble, leading out, which leads one who practices it to the complete destruction of suffering. This dhamma, too, is a state to be remembered, endearing, inspiring respect, and is conducive to cohesion, non-dispute, concord, and unity. These six dhammas are very helpful.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ…pe… ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti micchādiṭṭhiko viparītadassano – ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti. Ayaṃ chaṭṭho akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者……此人虽生于中部地区，却持有邪见，见解颠倒——‘没有布施，没有供养，没有祭祀，没有善作、恶作业的果报，没有此世，没有他世，没有母亲，没有父亲，没有化生有情，世间没有正行、正向的沙门、婆罗门，能以亲证的无上智慧，如实证知此世、他世而为人宣说’。这是第六种不宜修习梵行的非时、非机。
rows.english: Furthermore… this person has been reborn in the central regions, but he has wrong view, a distorted perspective: ‘There is nothing given, nothing offered, nothing sacrificed. There is no fruit or result of good and bad actions. There is no this world, no other world. There is no mother, no father. There are no beings who are spontaneously reborn. There are no ascetics and brahmins in the world who are well-gone and well-practiced, who, having realized it for themselves by direct knowledge, proclaim this world and the other world.’ This is the sixth inopportune, unsuitable moment for living the holy life.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame cha dhammā uppādetabbā? Cha satatavihārā. Idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno. Sotena saddaṃ sutvā…pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno. Ime cha dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （辛）“哪六法应令生起？六恒住。贤友，在此，比丘以眼见色，不喜亦不忧，安住于舍，具念正知；以耳闻声……以鼻嗅香……以舌尝味……以身触所触……以意识法，不喜亦不忧，安住于舍，具念正知。此六法应令生起。
rows.english: (Ja) "What six dhammas are to be developed? The six constant abidings. Here, friends, a bhikkhu, having seen a form with the eye, is neither gladdened nor displeased, but abides equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending. Having heard a sound with the ear… having smelled an odor with the nose… having tasted a flavor with the tongue… having felt a tangible object with the body… having cognized a mental phenomenon with the mind, he is neither gladdened nor displeased, but abides equanimous, mindful, and clearly comprehending. These six dhammas are to be developed."

rows.pali: (Cha) ‘‘katame cha dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? Cha nissaraṇiyā dhātuyo – idhāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘mettā hi kho me, cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, atha ca pana me byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi. Na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ āvuso anavakāso yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya. Atha ca panassa byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, byāpādassa, yadidaṃ mettācetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “是哪六种难通达之法？六种出离界。贤友们，于此，有比丘如是说：‘我之慈心解脱已修习、多修、作为车乘、作为基础、已建立、已熟习、已善发起，然嗔恚仍盘踞我心。’应如是语彼：‘具寿，莫作是说，莫诽谤世尊。诽谤世尊，实为不善，世尊不作是说。贤友，此无有是处，无此机会——于慈心解脱已修习、多修、作为车乘、作为基础、已建立、已熟习、已善发起，而嗔恚仍盘踞其心，此理不存在。贤友，此即是嗔恚之出离，所谓慈心解脱。’”
rows.english: (Cha) "What six dhammas are hard to penetrate? The six elements of escape. Here, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through loving-kindness, cultivated it, made it my vehicle, made it my basis, established it, practiced it, and well-undertaken it, and yet ill will still obsesses my mind.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say that, venerable sir! Do not misrepresent the Blessed One. It is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One, for the Blessed One would not say such a thing. It is impossible, friends, it cannot happen that when the liberation of mind through loving-kindness has been developed, cultivated, made one’s vehicle, made one's basis, established, practiced, and well-undertaken, ill will would still obsess the mind. That is not possible. For this, friends, is the escape from ill will, namely, the liberation of mind through loving-kindness.’"

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā, ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ me ābādho paccudāvatteyya, handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti. So vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. Idaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthu. Ime aṭṭha dhammā visesabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，比丘从病中痊愈，病愈未久。他如此想：‘我从病中痊愈，病愈未久，此病有复发的可能。那么，我当发起精进，为达未达，为得未得，为证未证。’他便发起精进，为达未达，为得未得，为证未证。这是第八发起精进事。这八法是殊胜分法。
rows.english: Furthermore, venerable sirs, a bhikkhu has recovered from illness, not long recovered from his sickness. It occurs to him: ‘I have recovered from illness, not long recovered from my sickness. There is a possibility that my illness might recur. Come now, I shall arouse energy for the attainment of the unattained, for the realization of the unrealized, for the direct experience of the unexperienced.’ He arouses energy for the attainment of the unattained, for the realization of the unrealized, for the direct experience of the unexperienced. This is the eighth ground for arousing energy. These eight states partake of distinction.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu, udayabbayānupassī viharati – ‘iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo; iti vedanā iti vedanāya samudayo iti vedanāya atthaṅgamo; iti saññā iti saññāya samudayo iti saññāya atthaṅgamo; iti saṅkhārā iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo; iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo’ti. Ayaṃ aṭṭhamo hetu aṭṭhamo paccayo ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattati. Ime aṭṭha dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，贤友，比丘住于随观五取蕴的生灭：‘此是色，此是色之集，此是色之灭；此是受，此是受之集，此是受之灭；此是想，此是想之集，此是想之灭；此是行，此是行之集，此是行之灭；此是识，此是识之集，此是识之灭。’此是第八因，第八缘，导向未得之始梵行慧的获得，以及已得之慧的增长、广大、修习与圆满。此八法有大助益。”
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating arising and passing away in the five aggregates subject to clinging: ‘Such is form, such is the origin of form, such is the passing away of form; such is feeling, such is the origin of feeling, such is the passing away of feeling; such is perception, such is the origin of perception, such is the passing away of perception; such are formations, such is the origin of formations, such is the passing away of formations; such is consciousness, such is the origin of consciousness, such is the passing away of consciousness.’ This is the eighth cause, the eighth condition that conduces to the gaining of wisdom that is fundamental to the holy life—wisdom not yet gained—and for the increase, abundance, development, and fulfillment of wisdom already gained. These eight qualities are of great help.

rows.pali: (Ṅa) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā hānabhāgiyā? Pañca cetokhilā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati. Yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya . Ayaṃ paṭhamo cetokhilo. Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu dhamme kaṅkhati vicikicchati…pe… saṅghe kaṅkhati vicikicchati…pe… sikkhāya kaṅkhati vicikicchati…pe… sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto, yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu sabrahmacārīsu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya. Ayaṃ pañcamo cetokhilo. Ime pañca dhammā hānabhāgiyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: (Ṅa) “什么是五种退堕法？五种心之荒芜。贤友们，于此，有比丘对导师怀疑、犹豫、不信解、不净信。贤友们，若有比丘对导师怀疑、犹豫、不信解、不净信，其心则不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒常、精勤。心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒常、精勤，此是第一心之荒芜。复次，贤友们，有比丘对法怀疑、犹豫……对僧团怀疑、犹豫……对学处怀疑、犹豫……对同梵行者忿怒、不悦、心怀恼害、心生荒芜。贤友们，若有比丘对同梵行者忿怒、不悦、心怀恼害、心生荒芜，其心则不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒常、精勤。心不倾向于热忱、勤行、恒常、精勤，此是第五心之荒芜。此五法为退堕分。”
rows.english: (Ṅa) “What are the five qualities that partake of decline? The five mental barrennesses: Here, friends, a bhikkhu doubts the Teacher, is uncertain, is not inclined, and is not confident. That bhikkhu, friends, who doubts the Teacher, is uncertain, is not inclined, and is not confident, his mind does not incline towards ardent effort, towards repeated exertion, towards persistent effort, towards striving. The mind of one whose mind does not incline towards ardent effort, towards repeated exertion, towards persistent effort, towards striving—this is the first mental barrenness. Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu doubts the Dhamma, is uncertain… he doubts the Saṅgha… he doubts the training… he is angry with his fellow practitioners of the holy life, displeased, with a mind that wants to harm, a mind that has become barren. That bhikkhu, friends, who is angry with his fellow practitioners of the holy life, displeased, with a mind that wants to harm, a mind that has become barren, his mind does not incline towards ardent effort, towards repeated exertion, towards persistent effort, towards striving. The mind of one whose mind does not incline towards ardent effort, towards repeated exertion, towards persistent effort, towards striving—this is the fifth mental barrenness. These are the five qualities that partake of decline.”

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame dasa dhammā abhiññeyyā? Dasa nijjaravatthūni – sammādiṭṭhissa micchādiṭṭhi nijjiṇṇā hoti. Ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti. Sammāsaṅkappassa micchāsaṅkappo…pe… sammāvācassa micchāvācā… sammākammantassa micchākammanto… sammāājīvassa micchāājīvo… sammāvāyāmassa micchāvāyāmo… sammāsatissa micchāsati… sammāsamādhissa micchāsamādhi… sammāñāṇassa micchāñāṇaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ hoti. Sammāvimuttissa micchāvimutti nijjiṇṇā hoti. Ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te cassa nijjiṇṇā honti. Ime dasa dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “以胜智当知之十法为何？十种灭尽之由：具正见者，其邪见已灭尽；凡由邪见为缘而生之众多恶不善法，于彼亦皆已灭尽。具正思惟者，其邪思惟……具正语者，其邪语……具正业者，其邪业……具正命者，其邪命……具正精进者，其邪精进……具正念者，其邪念……具正定者，其邪定……具正智者，其邪智已灭尽。具正解脱者，其邪解脱已灭尽；凡由邪解脱为缘而生之众多恶不善法，于彼亦皆已灭尽。此等为以胜智当知之十法。”
rows.english: “What ten things are to be fully understood? The ten grounds for wearing away: for one with right view, wrong view is worn away. And whatever numerous evil, unwholesome things come into being dependent on wrong view, those too are worn away for him. For one with right intention, wrong intention… for one with right speech, wrong speech… for one with right action, wrong action… for one with right livelihood, wrong livelihood… for one with right effort, wrong effort… for one with right mindfulness, wrong mindfulness… for one with right concentration, wrong concentration… for one with right knowledge, wrong knowledge is worn away. For one with right liberation, wrong liberation is worn away. And whatever numerous evil, unwholesome things come into being dependent on wrong liberation, those too are worn away for him. These ten things are to be fully understood.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni. Seyyathāpi nāma osadhitārakā odātā odātavaṇṇā odātanidassanā odātanibhāsā, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ odātaṃ odātavaṇṇaṃ odātanidassanaṃ odātanibhāsaṃ, evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni, ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃsaññī hoti. Idaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ abhibhāyatanaṃ. Ime aṭṭha dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “于内无色想的某人，外观诸色，是白、白相、白显、白光。譬如启明星(osadhitārakā)，是白、白相、白显、白光；又譬如迦尸(Bārāṇasī)国产的布，两面光洁，是白、白相、白显、白光。正是如此，于内无色想的某人，外观诸色，是白、白相、白显、白光，他有这样的想：‘我已胜伏它们，我知，我见。’这是第八胜处。这八法应被遍知。”
rows.english: Not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are white, white in color, white in appearance, white in radiance.
