Just as the morning star is white, white in color, white in appearance, white in radiance, or just as a cloth from Benares, smoothed on both sides, is white, white in color, white in appearance, white in radiance; even so, not percipient of form internally, one sees external forms that are white, white in color, white in appearance, white in radiance. Having overpowered them, one is percipient thus: ‘I know, I see.’ This is the eighth base of mastery. These eight qualities are to be directly known.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno sakkāyaṃ manasikaroto sakkāye cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati. Sakkāyanirodhaṃ kho panassa manasikaroto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati. Tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ sakkāyena. Ye ca sakkāyapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi. Na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. Idamakkhātaṃ sakkāyassa nissaraṇaṃ. Ime pañca dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 复次，贤友，比丘作意有身(sakkāya)时，其心不趋入、不澄净、不安住、不解脱于有身。而当他作意有身之灭(sakkāyanirodha)时，其心则趋入、澄净、安住、解脱于有身之灭。彼心善至、善修习、善出离、善解脱，与有身不相应。凡以有身为缘而生起的诸漏、毁伤、热恼，他已从中解脱。他不感受彼受。此被称为有身的出离。此五法难以彻知。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, when a bhikkhu attends to embodied identity, his mind does not enter, does not become serene, does not become established, and is not released in regard to embodied identity. But when he attends to the cessation of embodied identity, his mind enters, becomes serene, becomes established, and is released in regard to the cessation of embodied identity. His mind is thus well-perfected, well-developed, well-risen from, well-released from, and disjoined from embodied identity. And he is freed from the taints, vexations, and fevers that arise conditioned by embodied identity. He does not experience that feeling. This is declared to be the escape from embodied identity. These five qualities are difficult to penetrate.

rows.pali: (Ja) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā uppādetabbā? Pañca ñāṇiko sammāsamādhi – ‘ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho ceva āyatiñca sukhavipāko’ti paccattaṃyeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. ‘Ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso’ti paccattaññeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. ‘Ayaṃ samādhi akāpurisasevito’ti paccattaṃyeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. ‘Ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhaladdho ekodibhāvādhigato, na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritagato’ti na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayha vāritavatoti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavārivāvato (ka.), na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāriyādhigato (?) paccattaṃyeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. ‘So kho panāhaṃ imaṃ samādhiṃ satova samāpajjāmi sato vuṭṭhahāmī’ti paccattaṃyeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati. Ime pañca dhammā uppādetabbā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （Ja）“应生起哪五法？具五智的正定（pañcañāṇiko sammāsamādhi）：‘此定是现法乐（paccuppannasukho），且未来有乐异熟（sukhavipāko）’，此智于自身生起。‘此定是圣（ariyo）的、无染（nirāmiso）的’，此智于自身生起。‘此定非为劣夫所行（akāpurisasevito）’，此智于自身生起。‘此定是寂静（santo）的、殊胜（paṇīto）的、由轻安而得（paṭippassaddhaladdho）、已达一心（ekodibhāvādhigato），非由有行、强力压制而得（na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritagato）’，此智于自身生起。‘我实于此定，正念而入，正念而出’，此智于自身生起。此五法应生起。”
rows.english: What are the five things that are to be brought into being? Right concentration is endowed with five kinds of knowledge: ‘This concentration is pleasant in the present and has a pleasant result in the future’—thus, knowledge arises in oneself. ‘This concentration is noble and unworldly’—thus, knowledge arises in oneself. ‘This concentration is resorted to by superior persons’—thus, knowledge arises in oneself. ‘This concentration is peaceful, sublime, obtained through tranquility, attained through unification, and not achieved by means of forceful suppression and restraint’—thus, knowledge arises in oneself. ‘Indeed, I enter this concentration mindfully and emerge from it mindfully’—thus, knowledge arises in oneself. These are the five things that are to be brought into being.

rows.pali: (Jha) ‘‘katame nava dhammā abhiññeyyā? Nava anupubbavihārā – idhāvuso, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sukhassa ca pahānā…pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā…pe… ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘natthi kiñcī’ti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. Sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. Ime nava dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （壬）“贤友们，什么是应以胜智了知的九法？九次第住。贤友们，于此，比丘远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻有伺，具足由远离而生的喜与乐，进入初禅而住。寻与伺寂止……进入第二禅而住。又因离喜……进入第三禅而住。又因舍乐……进入第四禅而住。完全超越色想……进入空无边处而住。完全超越空无边处，思惟‘识是无边的’，进入识无边处而住。完全超越识无边处，思惟‘什么都没有’，进入无所有处而住。完全超越无所有处，进入非想非非想处而住。完全超越非想非非想处，进入想受灭而住。贤友们，这九法是应以胜智了知的。”
rows.english: What are the nine things to be known through direct knowledge? The nine successive abidings: Here, friends, a bhikkhu, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states, enters and dwells in the first jhāna... he enters and dwells in the second jhāna... he enters and dwells in the third jhāna... he enters and dwells in the fourth jhāna... he enters and dwells in the sphere of infinite space... having completely transcended the sphere of infinite space, aware that ‘consciousness is infinite,’ he enters and dwells in the sphere of infinite consciousness... having completely transcended the sphere of infinite consciousness, aware that ‘there is nothing,’ he enters and dwells in the sphere of nothingness... having completely transcended the sphere of nothingness, he enters and dwells in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception... having completely transcended the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, he enters and dwells in the cessation of perception and feeling. These nine things are to be known through direct knowledge.

rows.pali: (Ka) ‘‘katame pañca dhammā bahukārā? Pañca padhāniyaṅgāni – idhāvuso, bhikkhu saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti. Appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. Asaṭho hoti amāyāvī yathābhūtamattānaṃ āvīkattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu. Āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. Paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā. Ime pañca dhammā bahukārā.
rows.chinese_simplified: （一）“贤友，哪五法多有助益？五精勤支——在此，比丘有信，信如来之菩提：‘彼世尊是阿罗汉、正等觉、明行足、善逝、世间解、无上士调御丈夫、天人师、佛、世尊。’他少病少恼，消化力均衡，不冷不热，适中，堪于精勤。他不狡诈，不虚伪，如实地于导师、或具慧者、或同梵行者前显现自己。他为断不善法、为具足善法而发起精进，安住其中，具足强力，坚固勇猛，于诸善法不舍重担。他有智慧，具足了知生灭之慧，此慧是圣、决择、能正导向苦之灭尽的。此五法多有助益。”
rows.english: (Ka) “What are the five qualities that are of great benefit? The five factors for striving: Here, friends, a bhikkhu has faith; he has confidence in the Tathāgata’s enlightenment thus: ‘For this reason, the Blessed One is an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, a Well-Gone One, a Knower of the world, an Unsurpassed Trainer of persons to be tamed, a Teacher of gods and humans, an Enlightened One, a Blessed One.’ He has few illnesses, few afflictions, and is endowed with a digestive power that is even, not too cold and not too hot, moderate, and suitable for striving. He is not deceitful or devious, but reveals himself as he truly is to the Teacher, or to the wise, or to his fellow practitioners of the holy life. He dwells with aroused energy for the abandoning of unwholesome qualities and for the undertaking of wholesome qualities; he is steadfast, firm in his exertion, not shirking the burden in regard to wholesome qualities. He is wise, endowed with the wisdom that discerns arising and passing away, which is noble, penetrative, and leads rightly to the complete destruction of suffering. These five qualities are of great benefit.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhuno na heva kho satthā dhammaṃ deseti, aññataro vā garuṭṭhāniyo sabrahmacārī, nāpi yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, nāpi yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, nāpi yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati; api ca khvassa aññataraṃ samādhinimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya. Yathā yathā, āvuso, bhikkhuno aññataraṃ samādhinimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca. Tassa atthappaṭisaṃvedino dhammappaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. Idaṃ pañcamaṃ vimuttāyatanaṃ. Ime pañca dhammā abhiññeyyā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，贤友们，对一位比丘而言，导师不为他说法，也没有任何一位值得尊敬的同梵行者为他说法；他既不为他人详尽开示所闻所学之法，也不详尽讽诵所闻所学之法，也不以心随寻、随伺、以意随观所闻所学之法；然而，他以智慧善取、善作意、善记持、善通达某一禅定之相。贤友们，比丘如是如是以智慧善取、善作意、善记持、善通达某一禅定之相，便能于该法中感知义、感知法。感知义、感知法者，便生起欢悦；心欢悦者，生起喜；有喜心者，身轻安；身轻安者，感受乐；有乐者，心入定。此为第五解脱处。此五法应被遍知。
rows.english: Furthermore, friends, the Teacher does not teach the Dhamma to the bhikkhu, nor does a respected fellow in the holy life; nor does the bhikkhu teach the Dhamma in detail to others as he has heard it and as he has learned it, nor does he recite it in detail, nor does he mentally consider, examine, and contemplate it. But a certain sign of concentration is well grasped by him, well attended to in the mind, well retained, and well penetrated with wisdom. In whatever way, friends, a certain sign of concentration is well grasped by the bhikkhu, well attended to in the mind, well retained, and well penetrated with wisdom, in that way, in that Dhamma, he becomes one who experiences the meaning and one who experiences the Dhamma. For one who experiences the meaning and the Dhamma, joy arises. For one who is joyful, rapture arises. For one with a rapturous mind, the mental body becomes tranquil. With a tranquil mental body, he feels happiness. The mind of one who is happy becomes concentrated. This is the fifth ground for liberation. These are the five things to be known by direct knowledge.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘muditā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā…pe… atha ca pana me arati cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So – ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca…pe… nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso aratiyā, yadidaṃ muditācetovimuttī’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 在此，贤友，有比丘如是说：‘我已修习喜心解脱……然而，不乐却持续占据我心。’应如是告知他：‘勿作是言！具寿，勿作是言……贤友，此即不乐之出离，所谓喜心解脱。’
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘I have developed the liberation of mind through sympathetic joy… and yet discontent still obsesses my mind.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say that, venerable sir! Do not misrepresent the Blessed One… For this, friends, is the escape from discontent, namely, the liberation of mind through sympathetic joy.’"

rows.pali: ‘‘Santāvuso, sattā sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma ‘anantaṃ viññāṇa’nti viññāṇañcāyatanūpagā. Ayaṃ chaṭṭhī viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “贤友，有众生完全超越空无边处，达到‘识无边’的识无边处。这是第六识住。”
rows.english: There are, friends, beings who, by completely surmounting the base of the infinity of space, perceiving, ‘Consciousness is infinite,’ have reached the base of the infinity of consciousness. This is the sixth station of consciousness.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha panāvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya – ‘asmīti kho me vigataṃ, ayamahamasmīti na samanupassāmi, atha ca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti. So – ‘mā hevaṃ’ tissa vacanīyo ‘māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya. Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ asmīti vigate ayamahamasmīti asamanupassato. Atha ca panassa vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati. Nissaraṇaṃ hetaṃ, āvuso, vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallassa, yadidaṃ asmimānasamugghāṭo’ti. Ime cha dhammā duppaṭivijjhā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 在此，贤友，有比丘如是说：‘我已离“我是”之念，亦不复观“此是我”，然而，疑惑之箭却持续占据我心。’应如是告知他：‘勿作是言！具寿，勿作是言，莫诽谤世尊。诽谤世尊实为不善，世尊亦不作是说。贤友，此事无有是处，绝无可能：于离“我是”之念、不复观“此是我”者，疑惑之箭仍会持续占据其心，此事绝无可能。贤友，此即疑惑之箭的出离，所谓拔除我慢。’此六法难以通达。
rows.english: “Furthermore, friends, a bhikkhu might say: ‘The conceit “I am” has been eliminated in me, and I do not perceive “I am this.” Yet, the dart of doubt and perplexity still obsesses my mind.’ He should be told: ‘Do not say that, venerable sir! Do not misrepresent the Blessed One, for it is not good to misrepresent the Blessed One. The Blessed One would not say such a thing. It is impossible, friends, it cannot happen that when the conceit “I am” has been eliminated and one does not perceive “I am this,” the dart of doubt and perplexity would still obsess one’s mind—that is not possible. For this, friends, is the escape from the dart of doubt and perplexity, namely, the uprooting of the conceit “I am.”’ These six dhammas are hard to penetrate.

rows.pali: ‘‘Parinibbātu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato. Parinibbānakālo dāni, bhante, bhagavato. Bhāsitā kho panesā, bhante, bhagavatā vācā – ‘na tāvāhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti…pe… yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti…pe… yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti. Etarahi, bhante, upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacāriniyo, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 尊者，现在请世尊般涅槃吧，请善逝般涅槃吧。尊者，现在是世尊般涅槃的时候了。尊者，世尊曾说过这样的话：‘波旬(pāpima)，只要我的比丘尼弟子们……乃至我的优婆塞弟子们……乃至我的优婆夷弟子们还未能善巧、善调、无畏、已达安稳、多闻、持法、行于法随法、行于正道、随法而行，未能领受自己的师教后，宣说、开示、施设、建立、开显、分别、阐明，未能以正法善加折伏、驳斥已生起的异论，宣说具有神效之法，我就不会般涅槃。’尊者，现在世尊的优婆夷弟子们已经善巧、善调、无畏、已达安稳、多闻、持法、行于法随法、行于正道、随法而行，已能领受自己的师教后，宣说、开示、施设、建立、开显、分别、阐明，已能以正法善加折伏、驳斥已生起的异论，宣说具有神效之法。
rows.english: “Venerable sir, let the Blessed One now attain final Nibbāna, let the Sugata attain final Nibbāna. Now, venerable sir, is the time for the Blessed One’s final Nibbāna. For the Blessed One has spoken these words: ‘I will not attain final Nibbāna, evil one, as long as my bhikkhunī disciples are not accomplished… (etc.)… as long as my upāsaka disciples are not accomplished… (etc.)… as long as my upāsikā disciples are not accomplished, disciplined, confident, secure from bondage, learned, upholders of the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, practicing fittingly, living in accordance with the Dhamma; as long as they have not, after learning their own teacher’s doctrine, declared it, taught it, proclaimed it, established it, revealed it, analyzed it, and made it clear; and as long as they have not, after having well refuted with principle an arisen opposing doctrine, taught the Dhamma with its wonders.’ But now, venerable sir, the Blessed One's upāsikā disciples are accomplished, disciplined, confident, secure from bondage, learned, upholders of the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, practicing fittingly, living in accordance with the Dhamma; they have, after learning their own teacher’s doctrine, declared it, taught it, proclaimed it, established it, revealed it, analyzed it, and made it clear; and they have, after having well refuted with principle an arisen opposing doctrine, taught the Dhamma with its wonders.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Parinibbātu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato. Parinibbānakālo dāni, bhante , bhagavato. Bhāsitā kho panesā, bhante, bhagavatā vācā – ‘na tāvāhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā idaṃ padaṃ dī. ni. 2.168 ca saṃ. ni. 5.822 ca na dissati bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānīkarissanti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desessantī’ti. Etarahi, bhante, bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakā viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammappaṭipannā sāmīcippaṭipannā anudhammacārino, sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānīkaronti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “尊者，现在请世尊般涅槃吧，请善逝般涅槃吧。尊者，现在是世尊般涅槃的时候了。尊者，世尊曾说过这样的话：‘恶者(pāpima)，只要我的比丘弟子们还未能善巧、善调、无畏、得安稳、多闻、持法、行于法随法、行于正道、随法而行，未能领受自己的师教后，宣说、开示、施设、建立、开显、分别、阐明，未能以正法善加折伏、驳斥已生起的异论，宣说具神效之法，我就不会般涅槃。’尊者，现在世尊的比丘弟子们已经善巧、善调、无畏、得安稳、多闻、持法、行于法随法、行于正道、随法而行，已能领受自己的师教后，宣说、开示、施设、建立、开显、分别、阐明，已能以正法善加折伏、驳斥已生起的异论，宣说具神效之法。”
rows.english: “Venerable sir, let the Blessed One now attain final Nibbāna, let the Sugata attain final Nibbāna. Now, venerable sir, is the time for the Blessed One's final Nibbāna. For, venerable sir, this word was spoken by the Blessed One: ‘I will not attain final Nibbāna, evil one, so long as my bhikkhu disciples are not accomplished, disciplined, confident, secure from bondage, learned, upholders of the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, practicing fittingly, living in accordance with the Dhamma; so long as they have not, after learning their own teacher's doctrine, declared it, taught it, proclaimed it, established it, revealed it, analyzed it, and made it clear; and so long as they have not, after having well refuted with principle an arisen opposing doctrine, taught the Dhamma with its wonders.’ But now, venerable sir, the Blessed One's bhikkhu disciples are accomplished, disciplined, confident, secure from bondage, learned, upholders of the Dhamma, practicing in accordance with the Dhamma, practicing fittingly, living in accordance with the Dhamma; they have, after learning their own teacher's doctrine, declared it, taught it, proclaimed it, established it, revealed it, analyzed it, and made it clear; and they have, after having well refuted with principle an arisen opposing doctrine, taught the Dhamma with its wonders.”

rows.pali: Atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi – ‘‘mahā vatāyaṃ bhūmicālo; sumahā vatāyaṃ bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu. Ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 那时，具寿阿难心想：“这地震真是大啊！这地震真是极大，骇人而令人毛骨悚然，天鼓也迸裂作响。是何因、何缘，导致这大地震的出现呢？”
rows.english: Then it occurred to the Venerable Ānanda: “How great, indeed, is this earthquake! How very great is this earthquake, terrifying and causing the hair to stand on end, and the celestial drums resounded. What, now, is the cause, what is the condition for the appearance of a great earthquake?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Parinibbātu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato. Parinibbānakālo dāni, bhante, bhagavato. Bhāsitā kho panesā, bhante, bhagavatā vācā – ‘na tāvāhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhañceva bhavissati phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ, yāva devamanussehi suppakāsita’nti. Etarahi, bhante, bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhañceva phītañca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ, yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 尊者，现在请世尊般涅槃吧，请善逝般涅槃吧。尊者，现在是世尊般涅槃的时候了。尊者，世尊曾说过这样的话：‘波旬(pāpima)，只要我的此梵行未能兴盛、昌隆、广传、为众人所知、普遍弘扬，未能由天人善为开示，我就不会般涅槃。’尊者，现在世尊的梵行已经兴盛、昌隆、广传、为众人所知、普遍弘扬，已由天人善为开示了。
rows.english: “Venerable sir, let the Blessed One now attain final Nibbāna, let the Sugata attain final Nibbāna. Now, venerable sir, is the time for the Blessed One’s final Nibbāna. For this saying was spoken by the Blessed One: ‘I will not attain final Nibbāna, evil one, as long as this holy life of mine is not successful, flourishing, widespread, widely known, extensive, and well-proclaimed among gods and humans.’ But now, venerable sir, the Blessed One’s holy life is successful, flourishing, widespread, widely known, extensive, and well-proclaimed among gods and humans.”

rows.pali: Atha kho bhagavā cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossaji. Ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu. Atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi –
rows.chinese_simplified: 于是，世尊在遮波罗支提（Cāpāla Cetiya），具念正知地舍弃了寿行。当世尊舍弃寿行时，发生了巨大、可怕、令人毛骨悚然的地震，天鼓也迸裂作响。于是，世尊了知此事后，在那时诵此优陀那（udāna）：
rows.english: Then the Blessed One, at the Cāpāla Shrine, mindful and clearly comprehending, relinquished the life-conditioning force. And when the Blessed One had relinquished the life-conditioning force, there was a great earthquake, terrifying and causing the hair to stand on end, and the celestial drums resounded. Then the Blessed One, understanding this matter, on that occasion uttered this inspired utterance:

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, tadāyaṃ pathavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Ayaṃ, ānanda, pañcamo hetu, pañcamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，当如来证悟无上正等觉时，此大地摇动、震动、遍动、彻动。阿难，此是第五因、第五缘，能令大地震出现。”
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, when the Tathāgata awakens to the unsurpassed perfect enlightenment, then this earth shakes, quakes, trembles intensely, and quivers violently. This, Ānanda, is the fifth cause, the fifth condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, yadā tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti, tadāyaṃ pathavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Ayaṃ, ānanda, chaṭṭho hetu, chaṭṭho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，当如来转动无上法轮时，此大地摇动、震动、遍动、剧动。阿难，此为大地震出现的第六因、第六缘。
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, when the Tathāgata sets in motion the unsurpassed Wheel of Dhamma, then this earth shakes, quakes, trembles intensely, and quivers violently. This, Ānanda, is the sixth cause, the sixth condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, yadā tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyati, tadāyaṃ pathavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Ayaṃ, ānanda, aṭṭhamo hetu, aṭṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. Ime kho, ānanda, aṭṭha hetū, aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，当如来于无余依涅槃界(anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā)般涅槃时，此大地摇动、震动、遍动、剧动。阿难，此为大地震出现的第八因、第八缘。阿难，此等即是出现大地震的八因、八缘。”第十经。
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, when the Tathāgata attains final Nibbāna with the Nibbāna-element without remainder, then this earth shakes, quakes, trembles intensely, and quivers violently. This, Ānanda, is the eighth cause, the eighth condition for the appearance of a great earthquake. These, Ānanda, are the eight causes, the eight conditions for the appearance of a great earthquake.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātukucchismā nikkhamati, tadāyaṃ pathavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Ayaṃ, ānanda, catuttho hetu, catuttho paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，当菩萨具念正知出母胎时，此大地摇动、震动、遍动、彻动。阿难，此是第四因、第四缘，能令大地震出现。”
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, when the Bodhisatta, mindful and clearly comprehending, emerges from his mother’s womb, then this earth shakes, quakes, trembles intensely, and quivers violently. This, Ānanda, is the fourth cause, the fourth condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, yadā tathāgato sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajjati, tadāyaṃ pathavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Ayaṃ, ānanda, sattamo hetu, sattamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，当如来具念正知地舍弃寿行时，此大地摇动、震动、遍动、剧动。阿难，此为大地震出现的第七因、第七缘。
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, when the Tathāgata, mindful and clearly comprehending, relinquishes the life-conditioning force, then this earth shakes, quakes, trembles intensely, and quivers violently. This, Ānanda, is the seventh cause, the seventh condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: Icchā alañca saṃkhittaṃ, gayā abhibhunā saha; Vimokkho dve ca vohārā, parisā bhūmicālenāti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 欲、足与简要，伽耶与征服，解脱、二言说，众会及地震。
rows.english: Desire, Enough, and Concise, Gayā along with Abhibhu; Liberation, the Two Expressions, the Assembly, and with the Earthquake.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, yadā bodhisatto tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, tadāyaṃ pathavī kampati saṅkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Ayaṃ, ānanda, tatiyo hetu; tatiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，当菩萨从兜率(Tusita)天殁，具念正知入母胎时，此大地摇动、震动、遍动、彻动。阿难，此是第三因、第三缘，能令大地震出现。”
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, when the Bodhisatta passes away from the Tusita realm and descends into his mother’s womb, mindful and clearly comprehending, then this earth shakes, quakes, trembles intensely, and quivers violently. This, Ānanda, is the third cause, the third condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: ‘‘Parinibbātu dāni, bhante, bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato. Parinibbānakālo dāni, bhante, bhagavato’’ti. ‘‘Appossukko tvaṃ, pāpima, hohi. Naciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati. Ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “世尊，现在请您般涅槃吧，请善逝般涅槃吧。世尊，现在是您般涅槃的时候了。”“波旬，你别操心了。如来不久即将般涅槃。从现在起，再过三个月，如来将般涅槃。”
rows.english: “Venerable sir, let the Blessed One now attain final Nibbāna, let the Sugata attain final Nibbāna. Now is the time, venerable sir, for the Blessed One’s final Nibbāna.” “Be unconcerned, evil one. The Tathāgata’s final Nibbāna will not be long. In three months from now the Tathāgata will attain final Nibbāna.”

rows.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘mahā vatāyaṃ, bhante, bhūmicālo ; sumahā vatāyaṃ, bhante, bhūmicālo bhiṃsanako salomahaṃso, devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu. Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāyā’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 那时，具寿阿难去到世尊那里，顶礼世尊后，坐于一旁。坐于一旁的具寿阿难对世尊说：“世尊，这地震真是大啊！世尊，这地震真是极大，骇人而令人毛骨悚然，天鼓也迸裂作响。世尊，是何因、何缘，导致这大地震的出现呢？”
rows.english: Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One; having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, the Venerable Ānanda said to the Blessed One: “How great, venerable sir, is this earthquake! How very great, venerable sir, is this earthquake—terrifying, causing the hair to stand on end, and the celestial drums resounded. What, venerable sir, is the cause, what is the condition for the appearance of a great earthquake?”

rows.pali: 70 . Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ. Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘gaṇhāhi, ānanda, nisīdanaṃ. Yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ pāvālacetiyaṃ (syā.), cāpālacetiyaṃ (pī. ka.) tenupasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā’’ti. ‘‘Evaṃ, bhante’’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
rows.chinese_simplified: 70. 一时，世尊住在毗舍离(Vesālī)的大林重阁讲堂(kūṭāgārasālā)。那时，世尊于上午时分，穿好下衣，取了衣钵，进入毗舍离乞食。在毗舍离乞食完毕，饭后从托钵处返回，对具寿阿难说：‘阿难，拿上坐具，我们到遮波罗支提(Cāpāla cetiya)去日住吧。’‘是的，世尊。’具寿阿难应诺世尊后，拿起坐具，紧随在世尊身后。
rows.english: 70. On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Vesālī in the Great Wood, at the Hall with the Peaked Roof. Then the Blessed One, having dressed in the morning, took his bowl and robe and entered Vesālī for alms. Having gone for alms in Vesālī, after the meal, on returning from the alms-round, he addressed the Venerable Ānanda: 'Take the sitting cloth, Ānanda. We shall approach the Cāpāla Shrine for the daytime abiding.' 'Yes, venerable sir,' the Venerable Ānanda replied to the Blessed One, and taking the sitting cloth, he followed closely behind the Blessed One.

rows.pali: ‘‘Aṭṭhime, ānanda, hetū, aṭṭha paccayā mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya. Katame aṭṭha? Ayaṃ, ānanda, mahāpathavī udake patiṭṭhitā; udakaṃ vāte patiṭṭhitaṃ; vāto ākāsaṭṭho hoti. So, ānanda, samayo yaṃ mahāvātā vāyanti; mahāvātā vāyantā udakaṃ kampenti; udakaṃ kampitaṃ pathaviṃ kampeti. Ayaṃ, ānanda, paṭhamo hetu, paṭhamo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，有此八因、八缘，能令大地震出现。是哪八者？阿难，此大地立于水上，水立于风上，风住于空中。阿难，有时大风吹起，大风吹时摇动水，水被摇动时则摇动大地。阿难，此是第一因、第一缘，能令大地震出现。”
rows.english: “Ānanda, there are these eight causes, eight conditions for the appearance of a great earthquake. What are the eight? This great earth, Ānanda, is established on water; the water is established on wind; the wind is established in space. There comes a time, Ānanda, when great winds blow; the great winds, blowing, shake the water; the shaken water shakes the earth. This, Ānanda, is the first cause, the first condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, ānanda, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā iddhimā cetovasippatto devatā vā mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā. Tassa parittā pathavīsaññā bhāvitā hoti, appamāṇā āposaññā. So imaṃ pathaviṃ kampeti saṅkampeti sampakampeti sampavedheti. Ayaṃ, ānanda, dutiyo hetu, dutiyo paccayo mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvāya.
rows.chinese_simplified: “再者，阿难，有沙门或婆罗门具神通、心得自在，或有天神具大神通、大威力。彼已修习少量地想与无量水想，令此大地摇动、震动、遍动、彻动。阿难，此是第二因、第二缘，能令大地震出现。”
rows.english: “Furthermore, Ānanda, a recluse or a brahmin who is powerful and has attained mastery of mind, or a deity of great power and might, has cultivated a limited perception of earth and an immeasurable perception of water. He makes this earth shake, quake, tremble intensely, and quiver violently. This, Ānanda, is the second cause, the second condition for the appearance of a great earthquake.

rows.pali: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘gaccha tvaṃ gaccha kho tvaṃ (saṃ. ni. 5.822) udā. 51 passitabbaṃ , ānanda, yassa dāni kālaṃ maññasī’’ti. ‘‘Evaṃ, bhante’’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā bhagavato avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi. Atha kho māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante ānande bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 于是，世尊对具寿阿难说：‘阿难，你走吧，去做你认为适时的事。’‘好的，世尊。’具寿阿难应诺世尊后，从座位上起来，礼敬世尊并右绕，然后在离世尊不远处的一棵树下坐下。在具寿阿难离开后不久，恶魔波旬(Māra pāpimā)来到世尊跟前，对世尊说了这番话：
rows.english: Then the Blessed One addressed the Venerable Ānanda: ‘You may go now, Ānanda, at the time you deem fit.’ ‘Yes, venerable sir,’ the Venerable Ānanda replied to the Blessed One, and having risen from his seat, paid homage to the Blessed One, circumambulated him keeping him to the right, and sat down at the root of a certain tree not far from the Blessed One. Then, not long after the Venerable Ānanda had departed, Māra the evil one said this to the Blessed One:

rows.pali: Atha kho bhagavā yena cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘ramaṇīyā , ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakaṃ cetiyaṃ; ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ. Yassa kassaci , ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno so, ānanda, kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā. Tathāgatassa kho, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā. Ākaṅkhamāno, ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā’’ti. Evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ; na bhagavantaṃ yāci – ‘‘tiṭṭhatu, bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussāna’’nti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于是，世尊前往遮波罗支提(Cāpāla cetiya)；抵达后，在铺设好的座位上坐下。坐下后，世尊对具寿阿难说：‘阿难，毗舍离(Vesālī)真令人愉悦，优提那支提(Udena cetiya)令人愉悦，乔达摩咖支提(Gotamaka cetiya)令人愉悦，七芒果支提(Sattamba cetiya)令人愉悦，多子支提(Bahuputtaka cetiya)令人愉悦，萨兰达达支提(Sārandada cetiya)令人愉悦，遮波罗支提也令人愉悦。阿难，任何人若已修习、多修习四神足，使之如车、使之作基，已确立、已熟习、已善始，他若愿意，便可住世一劫或一劫之余。阿难，如来的四神足已修习、多修习，使之如车、使之作基，已确立、已熟习、已善始。阿难，如来若愿意，便可住世一劫或一劫之余。’即使世尊作了如此粗显的相(nimitta)、如此粗显的光(obhāsa)，具寿阿难还是未能洞察，没有祈请世尊：‘世尊，请您住世一劫！善逝，请您住世一劫！为了众人的利益与安乐，为了悲悯世间，为了天人的义利、利益与安乐。’因为他的心已被魔罗(Māra)所占据。
rows.english: Then the Blessed One approached the Cāpāla Shrine; having approached, he sat down on the prepared seat. Having sat down, the Blessed One addressed the Venerable Ānanda: 'Delightful, Ānanda, is Vesālī; delightful is the Udena Shrine; delightful is the Gotamaka Shrine; delightful is the Sattamba Shrine; delightful is the Bahuputta Shrine; delightful is the Sārandada Shrine; delightful is the Cāpāla Shrine. For whosoever, Ānanda, the four bases of spiritual power have been developed, made much of, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, mastered, and well undertaken, he, Ānanda, if he so desires, could remain for an aeon or for the remainder of an aeon. For the Tathāgata, Ānanda, the four bases of spiritual power have been developed, made much of, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, mastered, and well undertaken. If he so desires, Ānanda, the Tathāgata could remain for an aeon or for the remainder of an aeon.' Even so, while this gross sign was being made by the Blessed One, while this gross hint was being made, the Venerable Ānanda was not able to penetrate it; he did not request the Blessed One: 'Venerable sir, may the Blessed One remain for an aeon, may the Sugata remain for an aeon, for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, welfare, and happiness of gods and humans,' just as one whose mind is overcome by Māra.

rows.pali: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā…pe… tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi – ‘‘ramaṇīyā, ānanda, vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ bahuputtakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ. Yassa kassaci, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno so, ānanda, kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā. Tathāgatassa kho, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā…pe… ākaṅkhamāno, ānanda, tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā’’ti. Evampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ; na bhagavantaṃ yāci – ‘‘tiṭṭhatu, bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussāna’’nti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
rows.chinese_simplified: 第二次，世尊也……（同上）……第三次，世尊对具寿阿难说：‘阿难，毗舍离令人愉悦，优提那(Udena)支提令人愉悦，乔达摩咖(Gotamaka)支提令人愉悦，七芒果(Sattamba)支提令人愉悦，多子(Bahuputtaka)支提令人愉悦，萨兰达达(Sārandada)支提令人愉悦，遮波罗(Cāpāla)支提令人愉悦。阿难，任何人若已修习、多修习四神足，并使之作为车乘与基础，已稳固、已熟悉、已善巧地发起，他若愿意，便可住世一劫或一劫之余。阿难，如来的四神足也……（同上）……阿难，如来若愿意，便可住世一劫或一劫之余。’纵然世尊做了如此粗显的相、如此粗显的暗示，具寿阿难还是未能洞察，没有祈请世尊：‘世尊，请您住世一劫！善逝，请您住世一劫！为了众人的利益，为了众人的安乐，为了悲悯世间，为了天与人的利益、福祉与安乐。’犹如心被魔罗所蒙蔽一般。
rows.english: For a second time… and for a third time, the Blessed One addressed the Venerable Ānanda: ‘Delightful, Ānanda, is Vesālī; delightful is the Udena Shrine; delightful is the Gotamaka Shrine; delightful is the Sattamba Shrine; delightful is the Bahuputta Shrine; delightful is the Sārandada Shrine; delightful is the Cāpāla Shrine. For whosoever, Ānanda, the four bases of spiritual power have been developed, made much of, made a vehicle, made a foundation, established, mastered, and well undertaken, he, Ānanda, if he so desires, could remain for an aeon or for the remainder of an aeon. For the Tathāgata, Ānanda, the four bases of spiritual power have been developed… If he so desires, Ānanda, the Tathāgata could remain for an aeon or for the remainder of an aeon.’ Even so, while this gross sign was being made by the Blessed One, while this gross hint was being given, the Venerable Ānanda was not able to penetrate it; he did not request the Blessed One: ‘Venerable sir, may the Blessed One remain for an aeon, may the Sugata remain for an aeon, for the welfare of the many, for the happiness of the many, out of compassion for the world, for the good, welfare, and happiness of gods and humans,’ as his mind was overcome by Māra.

rows.pali: 513 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sākete viharati añjanavane migadāye. Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi – ‘‘atthi nu kho, bhikkhave , pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma yāni pañcindriyāni tāni pañca balāni honti, yāni pañca balāni tāni pañcindriyāni hontī’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: 513. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住于娑枳多（Sāketa）的安膳那林（Añjanavana）鹿野苑（Migadāya）。其时，世尊对诸比丘说：‘诸比丘，是否有此理趣，依此理趣，五根即是五力，五力即是五根？’
rows.english: 513. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One was dwelling in Sāketa, in the Añjana Grove, the sanctuary for deer. There the Blessed One addressed the monks: 'Monks, is there a way, relying on which the five faculties become the five powers, and the five powers become the five faculties?'

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti? Yañca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa uttarante udakaṃ, yañca dakkhiṇante udakaṃ – ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti. Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ saddhindriyaṃ taṃ saddhābalaṃ, yaṃ saddhābalaṃ taṃ saddhindriyaṃ; yaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ taṃ vīriyabalaṃ, yaṃ vīriyabalaṃ taṃ vīriyindriyaṃ; yaṃ satindriyaṃ taṃ satibalaṃ , yaṃ satibalaṃ taṃ satindriyaṃ; yaṃ samādhindriyaṃ taṃ samādhibalaṃ, yaṃ samādhibalaṃ taṃ samādhindriyaṃ; yaṃ paññindriyaṃ taṃ paññābalaṃ, yaṃ paññābalaṃ taṃ paññindriyaṃ. Pañcannaṃ, bhikkhave, indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’’ti. Tatiyaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “比丘们，是何理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流呢？比丘们，那岛屿北端的水，以及南端的水——比丘们，此即是理趣，依此理趣，那条河可计为二流。同样地，比丘们，信根即是信力，信力即是信根；精进根即是精进力，精进力即是精进根；念根即是念力，念力即是念根；定根即是定力，定力即是定根；慧根即是慧力，慧力即是慧根。比丘们，比丘修习、多修习这五根，由于诸漏已尽，便能于现法中亲自证知、现证无漏的心解脱、慧解脱而住。”第三经。
rows.english: “And what, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’? The water, bhikkhus, at the northern end of that island and the water at the southern end—this, indeed, bhikkhus, is the reason by which that river comes to be reckoned as ‘two streams’. In this very same way, bhikkhus, that which is the faculty of faith is the power of faith; that which is the power of faith is the faculty of faith. That which is the faculty of energy is the power of energy; that which is the power of energy is the faculty of energy. That which is the faculty of mindfulness is the power of mindfulness; that which is the power of mindfulness is the faculty of mindfulness. That which is the faculty of concentration is the power of concentration; that which is the power of concentration is the faculty of concentration. That which is the faculty of wisdom is the power of wisdom; that which is the power of wisdom is the faculty of wisdom. Bhikkhus, due to having developed and frequently practiced the five faculties, a bhikkhu, through the destruction of the taints, dwells having attained the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom, having realized it for himself with direct knowledge in this very life.” The third.

rows.pali: ‘‘Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. Sādhu vata, bhante, bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī’’ti. ‘‘Atthi, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma yāni pañcindriyāni tāni pañca balāni honti, yāni pañca balāni tāni pañcindriyāni honti’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: ‘世尊，我等之法，以世尊为根本，以世尊为指导，以世尊为皈依处。善哉，世尊！唯愿世尊为我等开示此说之义。诸比丘从世尊听闻后，必当受持。’‘诸比丘，有此理趣，依此理趣，五根即是五力，五力即是五根。’
rows.english: “Venerable sir, our teachings are rooted in the Blessed One, guided by the Blessed One, and have the Blessed One as their refuge. It would be good, venerable sir, if the Blessed One himself would illuminate the meaning of this statement. Having heard it from the Blessed One, the monks will bear it in mind.” “There is, monks, a way, relying on which the five faculties become the five powers, and the five powers become the five faculties.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati? Yañca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa purimante puratthimante (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) udakaṃ, yañca pacchimante udakaṃ – ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，是何理趣，依此理趣，该河可算为一流呢？诸比丘，该岛屿东端之水与西端之水——诸比丘，这即是理趣，依此理趣，该河可算为一流。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the way, relying on which that river is reckoned as just one stream? The water at the eastern end of that island, monks, and the water at the western end—this, monks, is the way, relying on which that river is reckoned as just one stream.

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma yāni pañcindriyāni tāni pañca balāni honti, yāni pañca balāni tāni pañcindriyāni honti? Yaṃ, bhikkhave, saddhindriyaṃ taṃ saddhābalaṃ, yaṃ saddhābalaṃ taṃ saddhindriyaṃ; yaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ taṃ vīriyabalaṃ, yaṃ vīriyabalaṃ taṃ vīriyindriyaṃ; yaṃ satindriyaṃ taṃ satibalaṃ, yaṃ satibalaṃ taṃ satindriyaṃ; yaṃ samādhindriyaṃ taṃ samādhibalaṃ, yaṃ samādhibalaṃ taṃ samādhindriyaṃ; yaṃ paññindriyaṃ taṃ paññābalaṃ, yaṃ paññābalaṃ taṃ paññindriyaṃ. Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā, tassa majjhe dīpo. Atthi, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati saṅkhaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.) . Atthi pana, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā dve sotāni tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，是何理趣，依此理趣，五根即是五力，五力即是五根？诸比丘，信根即是信力，信力即是信根；精进根即是精进力，精进力即是精进根；念根即是念力，念力即是念根；定根即是定力，定力即是定根；慧根即是慧力，慧力即是慧根。诸比丘，譬如一条河流，向东流，向东倾，向东注，其中间有一岛屿。诸比丘，有此理趣，依此理趣，该河可算为一流。诸比丘，又有此理趣，依此理趣，该河可算为二流。”
rows.english: “And what, monks, is the way, relying on which the five faculties become the five powers, and the five powers become the five faculties? Whatever, monks, is the faculty of faith, that is the power of faith; whatever is the power of faith, that is the faculty of faith. Whatever is the faculty of energy, that is the power of energy; whatever is the power of energy, that is the faculty of energy. Whatever is the faculty of mindfulness, that is the power of mindfulness; whatever is the power of mindfulness, that is the faculty of mindfulness. Whatever is the faculty of concentration, that is the power of concentration; whatever is the power of concentration, that is the faculty of concentration. Whatever is the faculty of wisdom, that is the power of wisdom; whatever is the power of wisdom, that is the faculty of wisdom. Just as, monks, a river slopes to the east, inclines to the east, tends towards the east, and in its middle there is an island. There is, monks, a way, relying on which that river is reckoned as just one stream. And there is, monks, a way, relying on which that river is reckoned as two streams.

rows.pali: 998 . ‘‘Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
rows.chinese_simplified: 998. “诸比丘，具足四法的圣弟子，是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。
rows.english: 998. “Monks, a noble disciple endowed with four qualities is a stream-enterer, not subject to falling into states of woe, certain, with enlightenment as his destination.

rows.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā. Idaṃ vatvāna vatvā (sī. pī.) evamīdisesu ṭhānesu sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
rows.chinese_simplified: 世尊说了这些。善逝说了这些后，导师又说了以下的话：
rows.english: The Blessed One said this. Having said this, the Well-Farer, the Teacher, further said this:

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamehi catūhi? Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi…pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi. Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: “是哪四法呢？诸比丘，于此，圣弟子于佛具足不坏净信：‘彼世尊亦即是阿拉汉、正等正觉者、明行具足者、善逝、世间解、无上调御丈夫、天人导师、佛陀、世尊。’于法……于僧……具足圣者所爱、不破损……能引生禅定的戒。诸比丘，具足此四法的圣弟子，是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。”
rows.english: “With what four? Here, monks, a noble disciple is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is an Arahant, perfectly self-enlightened, accomplished in knowledge and conduct, the Well-Farer, knower of the world, unsurpassed trainer of persons to be tamed, teacher of devas and humans, the Enlightened One, the Blessed One.’ He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Saṅgha… He is endowed with virtues dear to the noble ones, which are unbroken… conducive to concentration. Monks, a noble disciple who is endowed with these four qualities is a stream-enterer, not subject to falling into states of woe, fixed in destiny, with enlightenment as his destination.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Yesaṃ saddhā ca sīlañca, pasādo dhammadassanaṃ; Te ve kālena paccenti, brahmacariyogadhaṃ sukha’’nti. dutiyaṃ;
rows.chinese_simplified: “凡有信与戒，有净信与见法者，彼等确实适时达到深入梵行之乐。”第二经竟。
rows.english: “Those for whom there is faith and virtue, confidence and vision of the Dhamma, they indeed, in due time, attain the happiness immersed in the holy life.”

rows.pali: 1004 . Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ñātike viharati giñjakāvasathe. Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami ; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
rows.chinese_simplified: 1004. 如是我闻。一时，世尊住在那提迦（Ñātika）的砖房。尔时，具寿阿难来到世尊之处，顶礼世尊后，坐于一旁。坐于一旁的具寿阿难对世尊说：
rows.english: 1004. Thus have I heard. At one time the Blessed One was staying at Ñātika in the Brick Hall. Then the Venerable Ānanda approached the Blessed One, and having approached, he paid homage to the Blessed One and sat down to one side. Sitting to one side, the Venerable Ānanda said this to the Blessed One:

rows.pali: ‘‘Sāḷho nāma, bhante, bhikkhu kālaṅkato; tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo? Nandā nāma, bhante, bhikkhunī kālaṅkatā; tassā kā gati ko abhisamparāyo? Sudatto nāma, bhante, upāsako kālaṅkato; tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo? Sujātā nāma, bhante, upāsikā kālaṅkatā; tassā kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo’’ti?
rows.chinese_simplified: “世尊，名为萨哈的比丘已经命终，他有何趣？有何来生？世尊，名为难陀的比丘尼已经命终，她有何趣？有何来生？世尊，名为善施的优婆塞已经命终，他有何趣？有何来生？世尊，名为善生的优婆夷已经命终，她有何趣？有何来生？”
rows.english: “Venerable sir, the monk named Sāḷha has passed away. What is his destination, what is his future state? Venerable sir, the bhikkhunī named Nandā has passed away. What is her destination, what is her future state? Venerable sir, the lay follower named Sudatta has passed away. What is his destination, what is his future state? Venerable sir, the laywoman named Sujātā has passed away. What is her destination, what is her future state?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Katamo ca so, ānanda, dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo; yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’?
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，何为那名为‘法镜’的法门？圣弟子具足此法门，若愿意，即可由自己对自己宣告：‘我地狱已尽，畜生生已尽，饿鬼界已尽，恶趣、苦趣、堕处已尽；我是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。’？”
rows.english: “And what, Ānanda, is that discourse on the Dhamma, the Mirror of the Dhamma, endowed with which a noble disciple, if he so wishes, could declare of himself: ‘Hell is destroyed for me, the animal realm is destroyed, the realm of ghosts is destroyed, the planes of misery, the bad destinations, the lower worlds are destroyed. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to falling into states of woe, assured, and destined for enlightenment’?”

rows.pali: ‘‘Anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ, ānanda, yaṃ manussabhūto kālaṃ kareyya; tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ce maṃ kālaṅkate upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ paṭipucchissatha. Vihesā pesā, ānanda, assa tathāgatassa. Tasmātihānanda , dhammādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi; yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，人死实不足为奇。如果每当有人命终，你们就来我这里询问此事，阿难，这对如来是一种烦劳。因此，阿难，我将宣说名为‘法镜’的法门；圣弟子具足此法门，若愿意，即可由自己对自己宣告：‘我地狱已尽，畜生生已尽，饿鬼界已尽，恶趣、苦趣、堕处已尽；我是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。’”
rows.english: “Indeed, Ānanda, it is not astonishing that a human being should pass away. If, each time someone has passed away, you were to approach me and ask about this matter, that would be a vexation for the Tathāgata. Therefore, Ānanda, I shall teach the discourse on the Dhamma named the Mirror of the Dhamma, endowed with which a noble disciple, if he so wishes, could declare of himself: ‘Hell is destroyed for me, the animal realm is destroyed, the realm of ghosts is destroyed, the planes of misery, the bad destinations, the lower worlds are destroyed. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to falling into states of woe, assured, and destined for enlightenment.’”

rows.pali: ‘‘Sāḷho , ānanda, bhikkhu kālaṅkato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi. Nandā, ānanda, bhikkhunī kālaṅkatā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā. Sudatto, ānanda, upāsako kālaṅkato tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī; sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissati. Sujātā, ānanda, upāsikā kālaṅkatā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，比丘萨哈已命终，他因诸漏已尽，于现法中以殊胜智亲证、现证，具足无漏心解脱、慧解脱而住。阿难，比丘尼难陀已命终，她因五下分结的灭尽，成为化生者，于彼处般涅槃，从彼世界不复返回。阿难，优婆塞善施已命终，他因三结的灭尽，以及贪、嗔、痴的薄弱，成为一来者；仅来此世间一次，就将作苦的终结。阿难，优婆夷善生已命终，她因三结的灭尽，成为入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。”
rows.english: “Ānanda, the bhikkhu Sāḷha, having passed away, due to the destruction of the taints, dwelt having for himself directly known, realized, and attained the taintless liberation of mind and liberation by wisdom in this very life. Ānanda, the bhikkhunī Nandā, having passed away, due to the complete destruction of the five lower fetters, was of spontaneous rebirth, destined to attain final Nibbāna there, being of the nature not to return from that world. Ānanda, the upāsaka Sudatta, having passed away, due to the complete destruction of the three fetters and the attenuation of greed, hatred, and delusion, became a once-returner; having come to this world only once, he will make an end of suffering. Ānanda, the upāsikā Sujātā, having passed away, due to the complete destruction of the three fetters, became a stream-enterer, not subject to falling into states of woe, assured, and destined for enlightenment.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha, ānanda, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi…pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi. Ayaṃ kho so, ānanda, dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo; yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’ti. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: “阿难，于此，圣弟子于佛具足不坏净信——‘彼世尊亦是……天人师、佛、世尊。’于法……于僧……具足圣者所喜爱之戒——不毁……导向禅定。阿难，此即法镜法门；圣弟子具足此法门，若愿意，即可为自己记说：‘我地狱已尽，畜生胎已尽，饿鬼界已尽，恶趣、恶道、堕处已尽。我是入流者，不堕法，决定，趣向正觉。’”第八。
rows.english: “Here, Ānanda, a noble disciple is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Thus is that Blessed One… the Teacher of gods and humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One.’ He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… in the Saṅgha… and he is endowed with virtues dear to the noble ones, which are unbroken… and conducive to concentration. This, Ānanda, is that teaching, the Mirror of the Dhamma, endowed with which a noble disciple, should he wish, could declare of himself by himself: ‘Hell is destroyed for me; the animal realm is destroyed for me; the realm of ghosts is destroyed for me; the plane of misery, the bad destination, and the lower world are destroyed for me. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to downfall, assured, and destined for enlightenment.’” The eighth.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato. So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti . Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于此，摩诃男，另有一人具足对佛的不坏净信——‘彼世尊亦是……天人导师、佛、世尊’；对法……对僧……然无欢喜慧，无捷慧，亦不具足解脱。彼人因三结的遍尽，贪、瞋、痴的薄弱，成为一来者，仅来此世间一次，即能作苦之边际。摩诃男，此人亦从地狱解脱，从畜生道解脱，从饿鬼境解脱，从恶趣、恶道、堕处解脱。
rows.english: Furthermore, Mahānāma, a certain person is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is… the Teacher of gods and humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One.’ He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… in the Saṅgha… He is not endowed with joyful wisdom nor swift wisdom, and is not endowed with liberation. Through the destruction of the three fetters and the attenuation of lust, hatred, and delusion, he becomes a once-returner, returning only once to this world to make an end of suffering. This person, Mahānāma, is freed from hell, freed from the animal realm, freed from the realm of ghosts, freed from the plane of misery, the bad destination, the state of ruin.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… hāsapañño javanapañño vimuttiyā ca samannāgato. So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “在此，摩诃男，某位个人具足对佛的不坏净信——即：‘那位世尊是阿罗汉……天人导师、佛、世尊。’对法……对僧……他有欣喜慧、速疾慧，并具足解脱。他由于诸漏已尽，于现法中自证、现证、具足无漏心解脱与慧解脱而住。摩诃男，这位个人也从地狱解脱，从畜生道解脱，从饿鬼界解脱，从恶趣、恶道、堕处解脱。”
rows.english: “Here, Mahānāma, a certain person is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘For this reason, the Blessed One is… the Teacher of gods and humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One.’ He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… in the Saṅgha… He has joyful wisdom, swift wisdom, and is endowed with liberation. Through the destruction of the taints, he has realized for himself with direct knowledge, in this very life, the taintless liberation of mind, liberation by wisdom, and dwells having attained it. This person also, Mahānāma, is freed from hell, freed from the animal realm, freed from the realm of ghosts, freed from the plane of misery, the bad destination, and the state of ruin.”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti… na dhamme…pe… na saṅghe…pe… na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato. Api cassa ime dhammā honti – saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ. Tathāgatappaveditā cassa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti. Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pettivisayaṃ agantā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于此，摩诃男，另有一人实不具足对佛的不坏净信……不具足对法……不具足对僧……无欢喜慧，无捷慧，亦不具足解脱。然彼人有此等法：信根、精进根、念根、定根、慧根。并且，如来所开示之法，彼人能以智慧适度地审察。摩诃男，此人亦不去地狱，不去畜生道，不去饿鬼境，不去恶趣、恶道、堕处。
rows.english: Furthermore, Mahānāma, a certain person is not endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha… nor in the Dhamma… nor in the Saṅgha… nor is he endowed with joyful wisdom nor swift wisdom, and is not endowed with liberation. However, he has these qualities: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of concentration, and the faculty of wisdom. And the teachings proclaimed by the Tathāgata are, to a certain measure, acceptable to his contemplation with wisdom. This person too, Mahānāma, will not go to hell, will not go to the animal realm, will not go to the realm of ghosts, will not go to the plane of misery, the bad destination, the state of ruin.

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti. Dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… hāsapañño javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato. So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā asmā (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.) lokā. Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
rows.chinese_simplified: “在此，摩诃男，另有某位个人具足对佛的不坏净信——即：‘那位世尊是阿罗汉……天人导师、佛、世尊。’对法……对僧……他有欣喜慧、速疾慧，但不具足解脱。他由于五下分结的遍尽，成为化生者，在那里般涅槃，不从那个世界返回。摩诃男，这位个人也从地狱解脱，从畜生道解脱，从饿鬼界解脱，从恶趣、恶道、堕处解脱。”
rows.english: “But here, Mahānāma, a certain person is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘For this reason, the Blessed One is… the Teacher of gods and humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One.’ He is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… in the Saṅgha… He does not have joyful wisdom, does not have swift wisdom, and is not endowed with liberation. Through the complete destruction of the five lower fetters, he is one of spontaneous birth, due to attain final Nibbāna there, not liable to return from that world. This person also, Mahānāma, is freed from hell, freed from the animal realm, freed from the realm of ghosts, freed from the plane of misery, the bad destination, and the state of ruin.”

rows.pali: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘idha, bhante, saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato. So bhagavatā byākato – ‘sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti. Tatra sudaṃ, bhante, sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti – ‘‘acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho! Ettha dāni ko na sotapanno bhavissati! Yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato; so bhagavatā byākato – ‘sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti. Saraṇāni sakko sikkhādubbalyamāpādi, majjapānaṃ apāyī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于是，释迦族人摩诃男来到世尊之处；抵达后，礼敬世尊，坐于一旁。坐于一旁的释迦族人摩诃男对世尊这样说：‘尊者，在此，释迦族人萨拉那尼去世了。他被世尊授记：“是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定，趣向正觉。”尊者，当时，许多释迦族人聚集在一起，抱怨、轻蔑、指责说：“诸位，真是稀有！诸位，真是未曾有！如今，这里谁还不会是入流者呢！既然释迦族人萨拉那尼去世了，他被世尊授记：‘是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定，趣向正觉。’而释迦族人萨拉那尼曾于学处有亏，曾饮酒。”’
rows.english: Then, Mahānāma the Sakyan approached the place where the Blessed One was. Having approached and paid homage to the Blessed One, he sat down to one side. Seated to one side, Mahānāma the Sakyan said this to the Blessed One: 'Venerable Sir, here Saraṇāni the Sakyan has passed away. He was declared by the Blessed One: “A stream-enterer, not subject to falling into a woeful state, assured, destined for enlightenment.” At that, Venerable Sir, many Sakyans, having gathered and assembled, complain, are disdainful, and speak disparagingly: “Sirs, it is indeed astonishing! Sirs, it is indeed wonderful! At this rate, who will not become a stream-enterer? For Saraṇāni the Sakyan has passed away, and he was declared by the Blessed One: ‘A stream-enterer, not subject to falling into a woeful state, assured, destined for enlightenment.’ Saraṇāni the Sakyan was weak in the training; he drank intoxicating liquor.”'

rows.pali: ‘‘Yo so, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya! Yañhi taṃ, mahānāma, sammā vadamāno vadeyya – ‘dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato’ti, saraṇāni sakkaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya. Saraṇāni , mahānāma, sakko dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato. So kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya!
rows.chinese_simplified: “摩诃男，那位优婆塞长久以来已皈依佛、皈依法、皈依僧，他怎会堕入恶趣呢！摩诃男，若有人如实地说：‘此优婆塞长久以来已皈依佛、皈依法、皈依僧’，他就是在如实地称说萨罗尼(Saraṇāni)释迦。摩诃男，萨罗尼释迦长久以来已皈依佛、皈依法、皈依僧。他怎会堕入恶趣呢！”
rows.english: “Mahānāma, that lay follower who for a long time has gone for refuge to the Buddha, gone for refuge to the Dhamma, and gone for refuge to the Saṅgha, how could he go to a state of ruin? Mahānāma, if one were to speak rightly, one would say: ‘A lay follower has for a long time gone for refuge to the Buddha, gone for refuge to the Dhamma, and gone for refuge to the Saṅgha.’ Speaking of Saraṇāni the Sakyan, one would speak rightly. Mahānāma, Saraṇāni the Sakyan was a lay follower who for a long time had gone for refuge to the Buddha, gone for refuge to the Dhamma, and gone for refuge to the Saṅgha. How could he go to a state of ruin!”

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti; dhamme…pe… saṅghe…pe… na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato. So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti . Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
rows.chinese_simplified: 于此，摩诃男，另有一人具足对佛的不坏净信——‘彼世尊亦是……天人导师、佛、世尊’；对法……对僧……然无欢喜慧，无捷慧，亦不具足解脱。彼人因三结的遍尽，成为入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。摩诃男，此人亦从地狱解脱，从畜生道解脱，从饿鬼境解脱，从恶趣、恶道、堕处解脱。
rows.english: Furthermore, Mahānāma, a certain person is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha thus: ‘Indeed, the Blessed One is… the Teacher of gods and humans, the Buddha, the Blessed One’; he is endowed with unwavering confidence in the Dhamma… in the Saṅgha… He is not endowed with joyful wisdom nor swift wisdom, and is not endowed with liberation. Through the destruction of the three fetters, he becomes a stream-enterer, is of a nature not to fall into the lower realms, is certain, and is destined for enlightenment. This person too, Mahānāma, is freed from hell, freed from the animal realm, freed from the realm of ghosts, freed from the plane of misery, the bad destination, the state of ruin.

rows.pali: 1020 . Kapilavatthunidānaṃ . Tena kho pana samayena saraṇāni sarakāni (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) sakko kālaṅkato hoti. So bhagavatā byākato – ‘‘sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’ti. Tatra sudaṃ sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti – ‘‘acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! Ettha dāni ko na sotāpanno bhavissati! Yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato; so bhagavatā byākato – ‘sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti. Saraṇāni sakko sikkhādubbalyamāpādi, majjapānaṃ apāyī’’ti.
rows.chinese_simplified: 1020. 迦毗罗卫因缘。那时，释迦族人萨拉那尼(Saraṇāni)去世了。他被世尊授记：‘是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定，趣向正觉。’当时，许多释迦族人聚集在一起，抱怨、轻蔑、指责说：‘诸位，真是稀有！诸位，真是未曾有！如今，这里谁还不会是入流者呢！既然释迦族人萨拉那尼去世了，他被世尊授记：“是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定，趣向正觉。”而释迦族人萨拉那尼曾于学处有亏，曾饮酒。’
rows.english: 1020. The origin at Kapilavatthu. At that time, Saraṇāni the Sakyan had passed away. He was declared by the Blessed One: 'A stream-enterer, not subject to falling into a woeful state, assured, destined for enlightenment.' Then, many Sakyans, having gathered and assembled, complained, were disdainful, and spoke disparagingly: 'Sirs, it is indeed astonishing! Sirs, it is indeed wonderful! At this rate, who will not become a stream-enterer? For Saraṇāni the Sakyan has passed away, and he was declared by the Blessed One: “A stream-enterer, not subject to falling into a woeful state, assured, destined for enlightenment.” Saraṇāni the Sakyan was weak in the training; he drank intoxicating liquor.'

rows.pali: ‘‘Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti… na dhamme…pe… na saṅghe…pe… na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato, api cassa ime dhammā honti saddhindriyaṃ…pe… paññindriyaṃ. Tathāgate cassa saddhāmattaṃ hoti pemamattaṃ. Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pettivisayaṃ agantā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ. Ime cepi, mahānāma, mahāsālā subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ime cāhaṃ imevāhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.), imesāhaṃ (ka.) mahāsāle byākareyyaṃ – ‘sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti; kimaṅgaṃ kimaṅga (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) pana saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ. Saraṇāni, mahānāma, sakko maraṇakāle sikkhaṃ samādiyī’’ti. Catutthaṃ.
rows.chinese_simplified: 再者，摩诃男，于此，有某个个人未具足于佛的不坏净信……于法……于僧……不具欢喜慧，不具捷慧，亦未具足解脱，然而他具有这些法：信根……慧根。并且，他对如来仅有信，仅有爱。摩诃男，此人亦不去地狱，不去畜生胎，不去饿鬼界，不去苦趣、恶趣、堕处。摩诃男，倘若这些大娑罗树能了知善说与恶说，我亦会为这些大娑罗树记说：‘是入流者，不堕法，决定，趣向正觉’；何况是释迦族人萨拉那尼(Saraṇāni)呢？摩诃男，释迦族人萨拉那尼于临终时受持了学处。”第四经。
rows.english: Furthermore, Mahānāma, a certain person is not endowed with unwavering confidence in the Buddha… nor in the Dhamma… nor in the Saṅgha… he is not possessed of joyful wisdom nor of swift wisdom, and is not endowed with liberation. Yet he has these qualities: the controlling faculty of faith… the controlling faculty of wisdom. And he has mere faith and mere affection for the Tathāgata. This person too, Mahānāma, will not go to hell, the animal realm, the sphere of ghosts, or to a state of deprivation, a woeful course, a place of ruin. Mahānāma, if these great sāla trees could know what is well-spoken and what is ill-spoken, I would declare of these great sāla trees: ‘They are stream-enterers, of a nature not to fall into states of woe, assured, with enlightenment as their destination.’ How much more so Saraṇāni the Sakyan? Mahānāma, Saraṇāni the Sakyan undertook the training at the time of death.”
